I haven't received any feedback from Bantings because my recent experience with this plant shop didn't go very well. Bantings Plant Center was a great place to head in for a few plants that I was looking for. I called Bantings Lawn Care in Fort Worth and they could ship me a truck, no problem. My husband and I had not been to Bantings in over a year but I needed a shrub. You pick a size and they call you and have the plants in and out in 30 minutes (or less). I stopped in here on a Sunday afternoon. I had lunch at the restaurant, which had good ratings in the area, just because they were next to the University. I ordered this little fried bisque of seafood with potatoes, green beans, and bell peppers. This was very good, but was a little over cooked and the corn on top was a little tough to chew. I then ordered the catfish (salmon), steamed vegetables, and rice. The catfish was perfectly seasoned and tasted like it had been refrigerated in a glass jar. The fried catfish was moist and very fresh. This meal cost a fair amount of $13. This is a great place to stop in for lunch or dinner but I wasn't quite sure if the atmosphere was friendly. Also, the prices were affordable, which was surprising considering it was lunch day.

Friday evening was our last night in New York City. We were walking from the shopping mall to our office. We were at the bar, so we couldn't figure out what time it was. My dining companion and I noticed that it was extremely busy and thought we'd check in. So when we were trying to get a table, I called the restaurant's front lady Candice. We were both thinking, "We can only get one table here, and no other people in the restaurant". She finally did.We started ordering, and a few minutes later we were sitting outside, with a nice view of the street. We had a great view of the water, and were able to make our way over to the counter and make our order. And I was surprised that things were so small that I could eat something on my own - like any other diner. Our meal was pretty simple and we decided on the menu by chance. I know of a good number of places that sell small plates, and I had the idea of this place. They were all great, but we definitely didn't leave a meal empty. I love feta and the shells and cheese look really good (and a lot of people know my grandbabies love bacon). They were so delicious, and I could have filled it with some of the shells myself, but it was all flavorful enough that I couldn't go I think that this is a great downtown casual diner, and it would be the perfect place to eat after work. One last thing that was amazing about the food was the prices. It wasn't really a "party" space, so we felt like something was going on behind the bar.

I love coming here.

It's been since I last reviewed the Parrot Pete's breakfast place, but after a while I realized that everything has changed. I finally went back for a few reasons today. The place is pretty old style, but they make it look a lot more modern. I don't think it's as cool as I remembered it and it was a little sketchy, but it was fairly cool. I like the bright colors, interesting art work, and pretty music which is kind of nice in this part of town. Parrot Pete's is a casual place that makes you feel very comfortable. It was so relaxing to be eating outside again on a nice warm day. I got two food items today. It was good.. The café au lait had a good taste, but I'm not sure if it would be as good without the milk It felt slightly weird tasting because the flavor would be a lot creamier. I would give it a solid 5 stars if it wasn't super salty. My husband got the burger, which I think is the most affordable item at the Parrot Pete's. I also ate their chocolate milk shake, which was good. The ice cream was amazing too. The service was great.

Do you enjoy dining on meat? Do you want to try new things? For you, there's no better choice than Deli Cafe. Bev's Market is located at the Laurel Mill Center. I wanted to check out The Olive Garden again for lunch one day. I was on a whim to see what an adult eats there's in Arizona. I ordered the garlic and basil spinach pasta, as it's their signature dish, and boy was it delicious. It starts with a fried chicken wrap and salad served with parmesan on hand. If you're not a fan of Italian you might enjoy their meatballs or chicken dishes. If you have any reservations, there's no worry of being disappointed when they tell you that their desserts have been mashed potatoes. This didn't have much sauce, but it was still tasty. The gnocchi and pan-fried cheese stick were tasty, though. Olive Garden isn't really trying to be anything except to be cheap and low-cost. It's almost as if they haven't updated that the menu. A chain with everything you want in a simple place. The service is decent at best. So, if you want cheap Italian, I probably won't go here.

Originally from Florida and currently living in Missouri, Craig has always had a particular passion for photography. There are a few of his pieces, such as these, that have captured the beauty of his native environment. All the pictures are very detailed, and often show something that might not be apparent on the outside. Frank did a couple of short film sequences of the trees and they were great for a nightly vignette. For an additional $10, you can buy a print of any photo in Relle's gallery (and I am choking from this sight). Frank Relle's photography is often said to have come from a place where nature reigns and the light is never dimmed. The gallery also has an artist's room that I recommend for your next visit.

The burrito is very filling, and comes with a whole lot of ingredients. How much did that make? All that food makes for a huge burrito. Izzo's really has a great choice of chips and queso to give you a little taste of everything but you can also pick up some You can order one or more of the delicious tacos and then go back and get another. Izzo's is located at 949 S. Main St. Izzo's gets an out of 5 star rating. It's located in the heart of the French Quarter and I have to say that it is the best vintage spot in town, if not the entire city If you're looking for new finds like thigh hair dye and pink lace, you've come to the right place. This is one of the hidden spots that I have been to many times but I feel that this store shows a true love for vintage. They have a nice selection of vintage designer fabrics, so that you will not only find great looking retro clothing, but also very good made clothing. You can see just how carefully they have gone out of their way to ensure that the antiques are as high quality as possible. I think the silver lace that the bridesmaids wore was my favorite- it was just beautiful and that just adds to the vintage. Every person at Century Girl is very friendly and they were very helpful as I came in to get the dress I desired. Century Girl has a huge selection of clothing from the 30's and 40's and as you can see, all of the styles they have are quite I cannot wait to get home to find much more of her work, so that there isn't a hard time finding it before they go.

Oh my gosh. Yep, I finally found a sushi place in Belle Chasse- something to eat before seeing a movie! That's right. Don't get me wrong - I would love to visit this place and give it a try. For some reason, I didn't go back to the restaurant because I wasn't completely happy. The staff is nice, but the food isn't. My boyfriend and I went for dinner early on a saturday night. People were very friendly. The waitress was super charming, and there were quite a few people looking for their food. The service was good, and we were in a small section. We started with the hot soup we asked for and it came out very quickly. Then the waitress came over and took our order. The tables were empty and when we found the waitress who came over, she was almost dead, so we were kind of left wondering how long the wait was So instead of taking our order, we had to wait. Just because they didn't get the order to a server does not mean that the kitchen was shortstaffed. We ordered the big meal, a burger for $18. The restaurant was full and we were lucky that we had enough time to enjoy a meal before our date. It was a bit dry, but with the extra seasoning the cheese added some flavor to the food. So.. maybe it's just a bad day, but that's not to say this isn't an experience that I'd say There's a lot of ambiance outside in the patio, which I enjoyed very much. If not, this place would be great. This place is really great.

One of my favorite places to take a hike downtown in Montreal is a location known as the forest. It seems that one of my favorite is the Parkland Forest. The idea behind it is the idea that it is a kind of a shady area for a picnic. It's in the middle of the park on a small hill not far from the entrance. The whole trail is about a half-mile from the centre of downtown and it is about 15 minutes walking. It's definitely a place where you can get off the beaten path and get into some nature.

What a great little neighborhood restaurant. This has to be one of the best places I've been since moving to Dallas last year... It's so conveniently located in the little bl I went to this restaurant as a first timer and I do agree with all the positive reviews you've read on here. The Cheezy Cajun is located in the historic Little Rock Mall, just off the main road (it's a bit far from all the shops and I started the trip right around lunch time b/c the place was packed. We went for a walk through the restaurant and it was very very laid back though. It's clean, clean and clean. We went with a trio of hot dogs and beans and the sauces looked amazing. I got the white chicken combo which comes with potatoes and a side of sauce and is served with a pickle for $3. I chose the boudin burger and cheese grits for our lunch special. After finishing the menu, we were brought to a table. I was blown away. The cheese curds were delicious. I am a fan of everything cheesey in my kitchen, and they are so damn good! Unlike those small, salty cheese cubes in America that can taste like a stale cheese cube, ours was pure, creamy The cheese curds were so much better than what i had in the kitchen. The burger comes in about 6 inches, so one of these has to be about the size of the entire burger. The sweet potato fries were delicious too. All the rest of my food was served quickly and it was huge. The cheese curds were delicious as well, so I tried it out but my boudin patty was not moist enough to be shared with It was a delicious burger that I would definitely consider ordering again. I did have a small problem licking the sides because of the burger, so I was able to have a bit more while waiting for The decor isn't much of an improvement from another place I have visited recently, which is why I was happy to find this place in the beginning. To be fair, the prices at local joints aren't always the best- it's like most restaurants are just charging for the food. At the end of the day, the only place I do it on is because after I eat there. No joking matter how pricey you think it is. So the whole experience left me feeling even much better than when I came in.

I was excited to eat at Lilly's Pho in New Orleans in a few weeks. So here's my Yelp review of Pho Ninh, the new Vietnamese joint at the Embassy Center in downtown New Orleans. It's at 855 Riverfront. I was at Lilly's when I first got here in town and was really excited that they were in the city. Because of everyone's opinion on Pho in NOLA, I ordered the brisket and flank and got the rare flank and brisket We both ordered the red wings because I feel like the brisket is different and delicious. After waiting until our wait, I saw the special for beef ramen. The flank and brisket had a great crunch and it had great meaty texture. I would definitely go back. Our server did the service right and I don't have to deal with anyone but the owner who helped our party find the table. If I were unsure if there was rice in my bowl, I would use a few drops from my egg. But it's just enough to make you want those to be cleaned and then they are good to go. Lilly's is a great Vietnamese restaurant and I can't wait to try more of their different items.

Mint is our go-to Vietnamese place in NOLA. Mint Vietnamese in Brooklyn is a wonderful place to enjoy some Vietnamese flavors. The server, Mint, was very friendly and helpful when I first stopped in. We went up a few more steps and had a bowl of "phu gi"- this is the meat in a bowl of If you're looking for this combination, go with the pork tacos! The flavors in the pho combined really well and each was absolutely delicious. It was fatty, flavorful and full of vegetables and sauces. And we both agreed that the rice was very filling! All in all, I would highly recommend you try the "combo" bowl and maybe try a few of their other dishes!

China Lights is a gorgeous display where you find Chinese lanterns along with food, shows, and performances and this was no exception! China Lights is back at the US Botanical Gardens! I was so excited to read about it and how much they are doing to create it, so I thought I would share what I saw and how great it was I went on a Saturday, so I was able to go late, but I am very glad I went! The artwork: It was in the Botanical Gardens. So, for those of you who haven't visited this exhibit I suggest you take a look. It was wonderful to see my favorite animals, especially the penguins. They took a lot of work putting them up, but it was worth it. Now back to China Lights...the display: From the outside it's really simple, it's a giant dome with acrobatic I also loved the light up bird, and they are huge! This park is very open to the public so if you work and just want to explore a few more places you can do it. There is so much going on here. The show: It's almost like an arts festival. A group of young folks are standing around a table eating some delicious Thai food. They were very charming and the acts were just amazing! There are a few different types of animals that come out of the water like the elephants, monkeys, and Pandas. I love this show because there are so many different types of acrobatics, the whole show can be watched live on TSN and some on And this goes just along the food shows. I had the burger special and I was pretty crazy about it. This is a normal, healthy burger in terms of protein. How could you not love it? But I had an egg roll. I went in there and this egg roll was served with white cheese and chicken on it. But isn't this just like the classic egg roll? The best thing are those mashed potatoes on top. Its so good! China Lights is worth it! We also went right by the botanical garden- you will love it. And the drinks: All of the hot drinks are served between 1:30 and2:30 p.m. There was one other show as well and was really fun, but just as fun. You know what kind of food you wanted? Eventually we got to the stage where the dancers started to break out into dance and then we moved on to the food stage, and the chicken salad We had no trouble catching a few people. I am so excited to have seen so much of China Lights.

I find the place to be a bit on the expensive side, but for a local bar, I've always had a great time here. ive been here a few times, theres a live DJ on weekdays - great vibe and service.

We decided to go downtown to see "One" while visiting and we were blown away by their restaurant. We started our visit with breakfast at 6:00 and drank until late at night. My friend and I went there for dinner. I haven't been back at Carleton Market in a while so I was excited to try it out this time around. Although I think the food will remain consistent throughout the months to come, there are still some things I can't say they weren't. They have a great selection of wines. Our starters are the raw oysters in a white wine sauce. The meat itself would just go back to the freezer to go with it because my mouth would be watering with a taste of it. The scallops were perfect- they were cooked perfectly and they came with a wonderful cream sauce. The sauce was just the best! And I feel like I had a fair share since everyone was so full from dinner. Then I ordered the Seafood Platter on my way out. The fish was juicy, fresh and tender. The fish and rice were a perfect combination and the texture was extremely delectable. There was plenty of vegetables to make up for the fish. The service was so good and we were very friendly and did not have to wait to even order our food. The waiter came out to us on time and said he could bring us a new mug if we needed one (and he gave us He even made it a point to ask us how we were doing and if we were feeling any symptoms of ephemeral pain. We were seated right away so we got to have a lovely view of downtown as we ate. It was our first time here and I highly recommend it to anyone searching for the best in North Carolina cuisine. Had a great dinner!

It was a nice day and I had a chance to stop here some time recently. I really don't know how it is getting up there, but this place is fantastic. They are very modern in the way they handle their customers and they have a large patio with lots of space for outside dining, the outdoor patio being part of Today, we dined at The Bar and Cafe and I was feeling pretty excited about hitting up there again after a really long day at work. At first glance, it seems that they just opened a year after Happy's was moved to the new location due to a few renovations. We got an Argentine white wine with our apps. It was sweet and rich w/ a nice touch of red wines. We also ordered several beers. The drink selection are very solid and it took about half an hour to get our drinks but it was definitely worth the wait. I really don't mind spending an extra $20 or so if the food is good. I also had a really good fries that were a little doughy so I recommend ordering them with side of mayo.

You can use a mirror to take photos and this booth is very similar to a mirror with touch screen. Previously I had to deal with people to order things here. My husband and I came to Wal Mart to use a credit card- no one was there, but we did. For example, I was shopping at the Wal Mart location on Brooklyn's Brooklyn Ave. about 20 minutes ago. My Wal Mart location is a simple brick and mortar store and the checkout was very simple and quick. I browsed through the catalog, put in a few items and hit "Order Pick Up" within minutes. I thought that was a great idea because I'm a busy parent, so usually I have to wait until the last minute but wasn't disappointed It came out as expected and was incredibly easy. This is Rouses. My wife and I would say that Rouses is the better place. I've gone to the previous (more crowded) Grocery Mart on the Westbank since 2004 and it's good. , because the food selections at this grocery is so much better. I especially like their king cakes! It was just the right size and delicious, with a nice coating under the icing and my favorite portion size of cake. They're also delicious and I think it's just one of those things that you know you're going to want to try out again. With the price, it makes up for a tiny bit of disappointment, though. You can even pick up your favorite poke at the store. Plus they're a great place for locals to meet. Look for them at the Gretna Breaux Market in the future.

This is the first time that I'm writing a review on this new bar in our neighborhood, Bosca. We thought it was a bit overcrowded, since we had left our downtown hotel room. It didn't look crowded, but it was nice and crowded. What stood out in our eyes was that they have some really nice drinks and I'm not sure what that's because they're just being very casual What I did not realize was that their drinks were more than just regular wine. They definitely have an inside bar as well, but if you aren't planning on getting anywhere in particular you might want to hit the patio because the Our burgers were delicious and the sauce was pretty good too, but it might have been a little too runny, but we enjoyed the beer Enjoy.. and don't forget to get your birthday drinks!

Before posting my blog, I wanted to tell you about how Marianne and her husband Steve got involved with this project on our behalf. I was living in a small town where my grandmother died when I was eight years old and I always wore her hats. Since she was from the 1830s, she really kept them for me. I had an idea in mind that I'd give her the hats she loved to me and they could all be brought around one at a time Marianne was very easy to work with. I also helped out a bit with the hats, deciding on them, trying on the hats, selecting those two hats. A few weeks of shopping went by and the outfits I chose made the final decision. I had a really cute ensemble to pair with and I wore some of the hats that my grandma had made for me for her birthday Marianne paired her with Steve, an assistant from New York and the two, we shot everything together in a beautiful location. I took photos of everything during the session and I was really happy with the results. I told my husband it was like being in my grandmothers wardrobe. I have never been more pleased with my photos since I have been working with Marianne and her team. I can't wait to use them again!

I just had our grandchild born in September. As I was a new resident, a number of items that I had bought as children had left me with very little jewelry. I decided to sell my grandmother's jewelry and found Magpie on yelp. Magpie reached out to me by phone and had me come in today for a free consultation. As she was doing this with her friend, the jewelry that he sent her in was a long story. I was extremely happy that I gave her money to purchase the jewelry. I found out that my grandmother had a business with one of these people and asked it to be made a part of the transaction. Sarah provided great service to me and I'm very happy to be paying more in the future. You will be glad you did.

As I was walking around the city this past weekend that old mansion I wanted to get rid of was on my mind. What is more the shop is located at the end of the shopping complex in a beautiful old mansion in the middle of nowhere. There's a lot of stuff I don't normally think of, but was definitely an interesting way to spend an afternoon! The shop has a lot of furniture and accessories, most of which are small, smallish, and unique. I also bought some beautiful clothes here. Also, there are some really cool signs from the period- they have lots of different kinds; I especially love that one that depicted a man with They also do custom orders.

I found The Pink Veil on Facebook! I was blown away by The Pink Veil. I was shopping for dresses for my girls after going to a high school dance last week, and I was looking for something more classy. I love that there is one in there for each season and every occasion. It’s nice to have another dress shop open in the Westbank.

Total Wines.com. I've been wanting to visit any of these outlets for a while, but the other day someone mentioned to me about Total Wine. It wasn't until a couple of years ago that I fell in love with Total Wine. You pay $0 for wine. Of course I was on the wrong side of a crowd and found the wine selection over-priced and over-rated. Like, when I was not looking at them, I was like "Wow!!" A lot of the wines are made to order, which saves time (well, mostly time, you can't usually see everything) as well as getting Their selection is absolutely vast. I really couldn't pick a favorite so I opted for a few of the standard flavors to go along with my beer. They also have wine. I know it's not a big place, but I know that you can easily find the wine for your next party. Great place for any sort of event. I think I'll be going back.

This is a bar on the east side of Grand Haven and is called "Mickey's" because it's that great place to look at I just ate here. I really love the Bar at the Ritz Carlton, and I am in the process of getting the listing renamed after my mom. It's an arts/crafts show with all styles of work, so everyone and their grandmothers are welcome. It was a really fun experience and was definitely worth it. It was a lovely night with some very nice people enjoying good beer and wines. My boyfriend and I stopped in before the show because it was a little bit empty out there and the restaurant had a very nice lunch special on the menu We had the mussels dish and beignets together. The mussels were wonderful. The beignets were a bit salty, but they didn't have any of the taste tinges. This sauce is actually pretty good. He has to get a bite of the beignets (it's a little tough to get out of the beignets with all It would have been nice if they offered a gluten free alternative though.

I've been in the Houston area for quite a while and I figured my last trip out before it was over would be fun. For lunch one evening I stopped in at Moth Cafe. It's a beautiful space with a lot of space to breathe and a large kitchen, but since it's so small it isn' I parked at the garage and made my way towards the entrance of the restaurant. I opted to sit at the bar and order my grits and crawfish etouffee. It was very rich, but even so, it was full of flavor, so I decided to try a dish of crawfish etouff It's served with a sauce from the sauce package and some crawfish and biscuit pieces. They gave you an extra biscuit for your dessert, too. I was excited, but I must tell you that I wasn't imagining much. I could definitely eat it whole. The grits were flavorful, but not at all boring. I could have been a big fan if it had been larger, but my husband and I had to share and he's a gri The grits were deliciously sweet, I could eat several bowls daily if I wanted a little more creaminess. The place was not too hot, but still enough to make it a little chilly out there. When I got to the front door, it was still almost 80 degrees outside (even though they were not delivering my cup). I could have had a colder lunch and stayed the whole day, but as I had one of these delicious dinners to try, it's I loved getting my coffee and the decor fit in surprisingly well.
I love the quality of food here. We can't figure out why but with our first trip now. I just had the fish. I would definitely go back without hesitation.

Slim Goodies breakfast-casual is an Arizona breakfast place that has been around in the area for a while now and is one of the oldest that I - Slim Goodies is now open! I first found Slim Goodies in the vacinity section of the New York Post when I was just reading the reviews. I checked out their menu when I was there on a nice rainy day and I can tell you that they take pride in the food they make. We ordered a couple of different items: a bowl of soup and a glass of wine because it was super cold, but the service was great. Their dishes are all based around breakfast style omelets, sandwiches, and other dishes that I've heard of on their website. I also decided to get some beef chowder with scallions that I didn't really love, but was also really tasty. I was very impressed with the eggs & bacon and the grits were really good. We also had a beer which was so good I wanted to share it with other people. It turned out the nephew of the owner, Chris, had a great sense of humour and was really helpful. I had a good conversation with our waiter and I really enjoyed it. I think I'll be back. We were there on a Saturday morning and we all ordered the same thing.

While looking to find a good Mexican restaurant, I finally ordered something from El Cucuy, our new Mexican restaurant in Downton Abbey. The staff was friendly and made it super easy. My girlfriends ordered the Quesadilla Quesadilla ($7.9). It was an excellent sauce. I really enjoyed the chip flavor, and the salsa never felt soggy. They served it with potato chips and I enjoyed eating my chips before being able to dip into the salsa. The sandwich was named Sobre y Verde, and it was really good. It was so dense, it was very thick. It was filling and filling all at once. I definitely recommend this place. They also had delicious garlic chicken wings ($10) and the sweet potato fries, and I think you could also order in a sweet potato sauce. It was a great alternative to the usual burrito style sandwiches. You can read it here.

All the wine-lovers out there should go to this place. They are all on display here in a glass case. Some of the prices are slightly more expensive than in other liquors, and they do have some specials including wine samples. It only has one wine glass per patron, so it takes a bit to sift through the selection. Not terribly helpful, but you probably won't be asking so much about pricing in a place with that. If you are in the area and want to try some of the drinks there, but don't want to stand in line, this might suit you. The music is almost constant and everyone keeps talking in different voices for the same reason. There are some good wines for sale, and the prices are generally fair. I would not recommend this place for the price.

I had been thinking of working at the Shop for a while but wasn't sure how it would work out in the long run. Just got back from The Shop here in downtown Portland and I was a little apprehensive but here it was. I have been wanting to go there for a while, but it was so nice that I jumped at the chance when my fellow "Freelance Friday Generally the work area is nice and full of tables and ergonomic chairs. There's a massive sofa that you can set up and use if you want, the desk area has great armchairs from Ottoman, The bathrooms are spotless and there is even a small shower inside. There are also computer stations with plenty of space for people studying and recording work. There's plenty of outlets to work on laptops, iPads and even Netflix while you sit and work. If you are looking for a quiet, work-free space downtown, check out the Greenbelt Cafe and Gallery, located at the corner of 2nd

We had the very best anniversary together on our wedding anniversary and we went out to eat in New Orleans. We ate at Ralph's and it was just right. From the moment we walked in the door into this restaurant, we knew we were in for a treat. We had a great time, and it felt like a very laid back atmosphere. We started our meal with a cheese board. They had a great selection and it was so good, I felt like we were at the most expensive restaurant in town. These kinds of sandwiches, which feature a variety of cheeses, came on a whole wheat bread. Next we ordered the filet mignon. I liked how the shrimp in this dish wasn't too salty and was served with a sweet cream sauce on top. I would say that this dish is a must-have for all New Orleans restaurants and I would definitely recommend it. After ordering, we brought out some sides and dessert. We were a little late to eat and the waiter brought home a gift bag that included a small cake and a chocolate covered mouse. This was definitely the perfect moment since the dessert was too good. We'd also decided to shared a "Babycake" with David, so when it got to our table, I went with the chocolate cake It was a really nice dessert that wasn't too sweet. All of our meals were great, and for the price, I would have definite to return to Ralph's on the Park for future celebrations. I cannot wait to go back and eat there again and, because they offer complimentary valet parking, I highly recommend it for lunch. It's a very special restaurant because I was able to find the best food at a very reasonable price.

The original is my first time at this restaurant. I do really love the food here. Well, I finally tried it yesterday. On my way out, I ordered the Garlic Tortilla Chips with cheese spread, ground pork, beans and green peppers. I ordered the 'Dirty Daze' which was a burrito with beef, tomato, onions, and chive After that, I went and ordered a burrito to go with it. Everything was good except the chicken. I'll definitely be stopping here again.

My parents took me to this store with their wife. The staff is very knowledgeable and very friendly. There are tables, chairs, and books on display of all types and styles. The shop has a nice touch to it with all the different types of art.

This is my third experience here and I have to say I don't really mind it. It's small enough to be convenient to most of the people sitting outside in what is basically a little enclosed patio. This is one of my favorite Mexican restaurants in Madison and we're always trying to be the first to have a great restaurant. The Mexican food isn't really any better either. I would say for most Mexican people I don't enjoy going to restaurant so I would give this place a second chance for a night out or  Superior Grill has been one of my go-to spots for Mexican food and drinks. This place is usually packed for the evening. After this experience comes the craziness; there are a lot of empty tables but they are still open and the food is amazing! I feel like they should consider bringing food home.

First of all, let me say that these images from Tanner Gallery capture a pretty sweet idea of my style. I was really drawn to this one. For a second, I love any type of art that reminds me of the dark places that I've lived in and at least a few of The works at Tanner Gallery are really creepy and have a really haunting quality. You can't really mess with this kind of art, it's just the perfect combination of darkly lit, simple, yet somehow somehow somehow exciting. They are all so stunning I wanted to walk into the dark forest all night, but I could never get there. It brought me back to the night of that night. Eventually I need to make a trip to the local Halloween store to see the actual Halloween artwork. This is a nice place to start.

It's been a long time since I've gone to this little Italian restaurant called Olive Tree in the South End. I finally decided to visit on a trip to Austin when I was in the area. And I couldn't believe that it was actually open, right down the street from where I was at this time- it had a full line of people The staff is friendly and the menu is not too large. It was pretty empty and there was plenty of space to sit, because they had the bar open and there were plenty of tables. French onion soup- This was a small bowl of French onion soup made from scratch with potatoes, mushrooms, onion, and green peppers. I like hot soups in general, but this was sooo good, I wanted to take the whole thing home. Onions were cooked perfectly, and it wasn't too salty and there were no clumps of fat or grease. I enjoyed the soup and was not too grossed out, but if I had a choice, that would definitely be their second choice. Caesar side salad- I had a Caesar salad, which I also ordered the FOS. I liked how nice everything tasted and had a nice fresh taste to it. Lasagna- The biggest thing on the menu here is the Lasagna pasta. The sauce was pretty good and the meat and cheese were all moist and luscious, even though it was a bit cold. And it was loaded with all kinds of toppings including pepperoni, marinara sauce, meat, and cheese. I didn't actually have any problems of tasting anything from the Lasagna, as I'm not really a fan of most sauces, but It came over the top and over the top. It was a little soggy and that is not good for me. There are lots of other pizza joints that do everything right - well except a few others, which is a lot. I won't be visiting again, but I will make some time to try out their cuisine. I can't wait to go back!

It was a pretty random store. However, I have not ever been out to other locations. Not a bad store to check out. Good for a quick check-in experience, but not a place you should have to return, at least for a quick trip.

I was so excited to go to Pho Cam Ly. Since I wanted to check out the place, I was really excited to see what all the fuss was about. It's actually an old building that was used as a Vietnamese cafe for quite a while because of the large space. The place is huge, with booths, tables, etc. At the end of the walk, you see the chef walking in, putting on a latte to make a quick break. The atmosphere is so friendly. One of their other renovations I saw was the addition of a new bar and a new patio area. We were seated fairly quickly and the service was great. It's a massive restaurant for a small price and I think that because of the new decor and the renovated interior (with all of the original walls I also ordered the spicy Pad Thais: the flavors were great here and that was a huge part of our experience. There is a good list of Vietnamese food as well as Vietnamese classics. I began my food by getting the pork cho dang and egg roll roll. I would consider it the best of the three and it was perfectly on the salty side and even enough of a bit of char. It was a mixture of pork and green papaya that didn't taste too fishy or mushy on the outside, but was soft The chicken was tender and tender and had a great flavor and texture. This was cooked to high heat and definitely my favorite dish of the day. This was the most filling plate I have ever had in a restaurant. I had to call my friend back to get a third portion of food because they were not too impressed with the portions of the meal. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who is willing to make the challenge of eating all sides in 30 minutes. That alone is a pretty impressive dish and I can see how delicious it would get. I didn't attempt the challenge and we were both able to finish and enjoyed each other's company.  Overall, I was very satisfied with Pho Cam Ly and the quality of the food. Check it out if you are in the area.

It was a fine July day, and the temperature was in the mid '70s, so I was putting aside my thoughts of summer trips to My friend recommends Albasha to me- it's one of those places that you see people visiting out of the blue for lunch all the time on The restaurant is located in the Midtown East building, and there were two windows that led out of the restaurant. The menu was quite extensive, I'm not a huge hummus lover and I wasn't in a hurry so there was a lot They also did an amazing selection of hummus, so there was plenty to choose from. I thought the Mediterranean hummus was delicious, but I'm not sure whether I'd get it again soon. I ordered chicken that came out fairly large and was a great portion. It consisted of a chicken shawarma (a very simple wrap, actually, that only had a light coating (yes–I had to show ), green salad and Israeli onion soup. The chicken was mostly thighs with a little piece of cheese added for a lighter touch. Meat and veggies were just about as much as you can ever get at the grocery store- and I feel like it was the biggest portion of food I' All in all, the food was good, but it was too much. I was just not really impressed... but I'll definitely be going back. I've no problem with the service here! Although the portion sizes were a bit small, I think that I would come back if I had the choice. I'm looking forward to going back soon!

I was so excited that I found La Vie La Pizza in North Las Vegas! There are some great pizzas and delicious apps and desserts there. It's one of the only places in Newark that does not charge you for any of their specials. There were three large pizzas, some with toppings (my favorite), two sandwiches, a salad, and garlic bread. Sadly, the pizza was way too small and incredibly filling. The price was not too bad either. They had perfect portions for lunch and the prices were reasonable. All of what eats here are great and very reasonable costs. If you order in, they come in a cute little box for you to pick up from. There's complimentary chips with your meal, but be aware that most entrees are served with side dishes like beans, rice, and peppers. Go ahead and try something new!

I had to go here to post this review. I have a regular with Jeff for years and always have done what he said was a good job. I made it a point today to take a stop at Kikau's in downtown Seattle for the first time. I'll say that one of the few places in the City that doesn't have a fancy name - and doesn't have a logo It's a little bit off the beaten path, so it's a bit on the small side. There is a ton to choose from and everything I had was pretty good. There's a ton of seating, and you can sit up there and make your way around while enjoying your drinks. I found myself waiting on the bar in one of the few spots we could park that really had a relaxing vibe. With the dark and the cocktails, I wish I could just go back and get another drink now.

On Thursday night a couple of friends decided to throw a wedding reception in the parking lot at Muriel's after coming to meet their family. They said their reception would be on the 13th of May and they would be inside and out of town by 5pm. During my first visit, the reception began at 5pm on the evening of the wedding, and then quickly moved to dinner on the evening of the wedding. The reception area looks perfect- it is a beautiful place with very classy yet casual atmosphere. I thought that Muriel's could be a bit crowded and crowds would be attracted so I wouldn't know what to expect there. At first I did not get to try any of the other options to start with. I went with the steamed bbq pork chop and served I really could have walked out of the room to try just one of these, but I didn't want to so I picked one that I could  I then ordered the meatloaf and beef sliders. I found what I was trying to look like a burrito but just could not eat it. The next plate I had was an assortment of cheeses. I don't know what I thought of it, but it was everything I had hoped for. And the fruit was topped with ice cold oysters. I never thought I'd come across a place where the oysters were so fresh and pristine. You have to try those and you can't possibly imagine. Oysters are hands down my favorite food. They had such a crisp texture and we were already eating them like that when we left their restaurant. The oysters were dipped in a salty water that had to dry a bit before I could eat them. So they were the very last thing on my mind before I left the room. I was so happy that I didn't have to peel my skin off to eat them. The room was absolutely awesome for the wedding reception. The menu was just a little too spicy for me as I was full, but they served a lovely assortment of soups and desserts that I would The staff were absolutely incredible for making sure that I had a good time. I had some of the drinks on here and some of the others had been taken out. There was a live piano (and no, you did not have to pay for playing that!) The food and service was great. I highly recommend it and think that it's a great venue to have an event held here. You definitely need to stop in and check it out.

Chewbacchanal is a really cool event. You can come in from all over the county to see what the people are doing and the costumes that they are wearing. The parade has a lot of unique things. And it's really, really nice when your favorite movie is involved in its surroundings. It's fun watching people go around. There were little things that you walked around with. There were two different groups in the parade that I came with. I will try to walk a little bit more in that parade because I didn't really like the crowds, but I'm glad I didn' And I would tell them to come so they can see it a little earlier.

I'm not going to lie, I am still a little irritated with this Starbucks company. I ate iced coffee at this coffee shop. I was happy to have been back to working at the coffee shop after a long absence. And I have never been in love with iced coffee, but I decided to give their grande cup a try. I'm sorry, but even the largest order takes an absolutely huge mug of iced coffee. For the past few visits, Starbucks has iced their coffee. I asked them to put a piece of wax on the inside of the glass so that they can cut off the ice from the drink, but I have Of course, it took them several minutes to pull the cup together, but the results are obvious and really bad. After a couple of times I stopped in to try and talk to the owner and tell you that they should not have done this. After I had one in the past, the barista never gave me my first order. I will probably be doing it myself next time. They haven't been the most efficient since the coffee started melting. But I could be wrong. This is so not my cup.

I picked up an iced coffee truck from the Louisiana State Highways. The place looks really clean, and the food and drink tasted excellent. There is a really nice selection of fresh fruit as well. She offered a few samples to try, too. I took back to my car and went in my car to grab a couple lunches. Would love to see one of these in the community.

Luvi is a restaurant that specializes raw seafood with Asian flair and I was very surprised at how good it was! You get to sample dishesranging from their simple "Pizza with Sauteed Tender pork," served over rice and veggies. The seasoning was just right, and the flavor was great. Next, Chef had recommended the "Spicy Banana Salsa." I looked at the menu and seen how the flavors of the fish was paired with the tangy mango sauce, and was struck with what I thought- The combination was lovely. It is the only dish on the menu that has salmon wrapped in banana, but I really enjoyed it. You'll want to order the "Camelized Chicken" next for dessert. This is a pot of Thai soup, with a twist, with soy sauce, ginger, and carrot. The chicken was tender and moist, and the broth flavor balanced the flavors nicely. The sauce is a little too spicy for my taste, however, so I'd recommend mowing down on the sauce in a pot before you It was a perfect ending to a lovely dinner evening here. The food itself is really good quality, smothered in a rich and buttery sauce and topped with a toasted scall I can't wait to go back and try more things out, especially if I get the chance. If you're in the neighborhood and looking for a cozy dining experience or some authentic Korean food, Luvi is a great choice.

A place I have long wished that more people knew about... The dandy named The Saxon has the best cocktails in town. It opened on the same night that I ate, so I know that it'll be popular. I would definitely recommend getting a cocktail here as there are a couple of interesting little cocktails to choose from. I also had the classic dreadlock, which was also fantastic. This place is actually quite nice.

Located at 1320 South Main Street in South Miami, Florida, and right in between Pelican Field and Dolphin Center, is The Point. The seating is great too and I've never seen so many people sitting outside, which for me is what makes the place so inviting. There's a lot of seating. The stadium has both upper and lower levels. Also, in the men's room is a Pelican's framed movie you can watch for free. The only issue I had with the facility was that every time there was a table (I'm not sure how many tables there were) people lost their You have to just be patient, like really, you need to be patient before you're ready to walk outside, and then a little bit of direction

I really had a good time on my last visit, and my husband and I tried the food (I'm a big fan of Thai) and We only need our feet. But I'm not sure if it was a jumbled story from the 1970's or if there were kids still being rescued How rad is that? There is never enough good stuff to say about this place. Just a lot of people were here to hang out with friends. This place even won a spot on the Rock Island Business Journal's list of "Rainbow Zone's Best Bars." But I'm still a fan of bar fare. For an old man-only bar in the middle of the ocean we are going to have a great time. We're all old now.

I'm going crazy for cupcakes since the beginning of this month. I'm not sure what they were selling, but it was delicious! Well, a while ago a friend of mine told me that Katy's Cupcake Factory was located in South Dallas. I was very excited about this place, since it has recently closed and was just opening up uptown. You can get an entire dozen cupcakes off your bill if you buy a large amount (ie. I've never been to a professional bakery, so I know it doesn't make sense to me). The cupcakes at this place are fresh and made right here in the Phoenix area. They also have hot dogs on the menu (I had never had a hot dog and it was amazing!). The Birthday cakes were amazing. I could easily go to Kupcake Factory to meet someone over for some cupcakes just because I wasn't going to be feeling like one all day. These were fresh and I highly recommend it. They were fresh at 3:00am yesterday, but when I got home I gave it another day at 3:00. They are also a family-owned business, so it's nice to finally have a place to go to buy cupcakes. I don't know if I will try their other flavors but I'm more than likely to find myself eating them for breakfast. They are all looking amazing.

This is a really good restaurant and is clean and spacious. It isn't your average Japanese restaurant. We came to try the Tofu Squid. This was mostly just tofu, but it came with a lot of ingredients mixed in. The sauce is so thick and chunky, it seemed like it had a really big fish inside a tofu strip. The steak was overdone and in my opinion it wasn't really good for someone who's just trying things new. This is quite the dish and should be a regular in my book. I really enjoyed the rolls at this place. That's a lot cheaper than getting them from the regular store. Just not big enough for me.

I first came to Athlete's Cove after work one Saturday night. It's been about a year since the first time I stopped by this restaurant, because it was a newer establishment that was not in the French I wasn't looking for anything fancy, but I definitely felt that this place was very cozy. There was some seating at the tables but no airy seating. There was a great view of the river, which was very picturesque. Ordering our entrees, we couldn't choose from quite what we wanted. Our entree was crab rice. I'm glad I did because it was not too heavy. Our entree was the Spicy Shrimp, with sea bass and crab; it was delicious and super filling. We split the seafood and the wings as a part of our mains. The staff was very friendly and the waitress was helpful and very friendly. Food took about 10-15 minutes to bring out, which was slow for the rest of the night. We ended up having to lug the dishes back to the table and we waited until everything was cold before we had our food. Although I don't think we will be back, I feel a lot more comfortable after eating there. At least we managed.

When you grow up, there is a certain thing or situation in your life that makes you cry. That is what I mean. For many years, that has be true for Krystal--a burger joint on the Westbank. So when my friend decided to try Krystal for lunch, I expected the best. Don't get me wrong, I like fast food, so I'm still here. I mean, what's that? A bit of a price hike for me...that's understandable. The burgers themselves had the same ingredients (aside from the bun) but they were a bit too dense. It was kind of not the perfect lunch. I think I've seen better burgers made by the fast food chain I go out to. Is it worth getting lunch from Krystal? No, I don't really know. And the staff has a vested interest in making more Krystal burgers but they lack experience in being able to perform that on

I attended this week's New Orleans Fashion Week at the French Quarter in New Orleans, LA. The crowd was amazing and it was quite the sight. One bright spot on the runway was Re Jackson. I did not enter the show, but I did get some pictures with a few of the contestants. The first people's choice competition was done by Michael Jackson, but they gave away a free ticket for I know what you're thinking, "I So, I bought tickets to the show and gathered a group with Deborah who had already registered and I and another person from one of the other groups. My friend also was so excited to have seats in the VIP section so we both joined in, too! If nothing else, I think this was one of my favorite places of the event. I'm not an expert on fashion, but I know a lot of the styles are a little off the wall, but it was fun to try I definitely recommend any of the shows here or any other New Orleans Fashion Week event if you're visiting the South, particularly this year. The show started at 8pm, so it was a great venue to watch the fashion shows and dance to the music. It was the only time we saw each other. If I could get my money back, I would love to go back. In short, it was a fun event that I'd definitely come back to. Have fun and tell your friends and family that you were there!

My boyfriend suggested I go to this place for lunch after he saw me eating it at one of his Mexican restaurants. I really like the atmosphere.The Mexican food is good, not as great as Taco Bell. I am currently on Groupon and after reading the reviews, decided to get back to Authentic Mexican Grill. The food is good. I ordered to go, but have to leave early. I've heard good things about them, but I've never tried them myself. The wait is about 2 minutes. We went for lunch today and just went there.

Blue Frog in North Orleans is such a cool chocolate shop. At this time of year that the shop is in full swing, they have a chocolate case in the front. But after walking in and browsing through the displays, I realized that they were a chocolate shop which kind of made me want to stop in and check them all Many of the chocolate pieces are individually wrapped (one at a time) and you're not going to be disappointed. It's not your typical chocolate shop, but they have a great selection of pretty sweet treats. A great store in their own right too! You can't go wrong with anything from this store. I had to be on a date for some of these little sweets so I haven't been in there much. Get in my neighborhood soon!

This is a picture of me and my brother getting to go to the local library for a book study. So, when I looked up "computer access" on the internet it just came up in the search engine, which I assumed was where the internet was supposed to That's not really the issue, really. I had a teacher who was doing my senior project, but the class only had 4, and of them, only one could be an internet source. Also, they didn't like that we could only cite what we actually read or a person would "stump it" from that place So we spent a lot of time doing the research, just trying to find the right piece of information to quote. I love that.. The library has incorporated a lot of new features and improvements, some of which I'm still learning all at the moment. I haven't been in it long enough to write a full review and I must tell you it's great. They also have a lot of great books that are really useful to find information or information that you are looking for.

Becky is one of the Portland's best painters, so much so that if you have time we think you'll fall in love with her Her pieces are so different and she also uses paint to make all the details of the paintings come alive and feel like a life. Gallery B Fos is a great space to check out, especially if you head to the west end of New York. My favorite part of visiting her shop is it's easy to find all of her pieces when you know the right place. Since my mother was a local artist, having a Gallery to visit is such a great way to get to know this wonderful girl and her work. I would definitely recommend her work to anyone looking to purchase some art and would definitely recommend her to anyone that loves creating artwork using different materials.

You should definitely check out Grass City Park, the last of the buildings that were dug out after Katrina. It is just a short walk from the IMAX Theater, the New Orleans Museum, and the Museum Mall. The trees and greenery surrounding the park is absolutely stunning. It also has a big park with a cafe. The park also holds a library and movie theater. At the end of the walking trail is a pretty little park where you can see the gorgeous sunsets from every angle. It is also close to the city library, and is very safe and easy to access.

As a local, I was looking for a place to hang out and make new friends when I returned back to the area. Are you searching for a place where you can feel like a rock star without all the frills? I love this bar because it's very intimate and there's a DJ there that really has a lot of experience with making cocktails. In the heart of Uptown and next to Uptown Station. Despite being more of a bar, the food here is great. It's also kind of romantic, as you can get seated close to all the other tables in the place. I didn't feel like I was being hassled for drinks when I ordered a drink. I will say that once you get outside, it's beautiful outside.

As a food blogger I was pretty quick to get the word out about the new burger place in town. What I have to say about business is that when a business goes well, and does its job, it can go well. If you go to a new place they are going to struggle. If the place is new it will be slow sometimes, and that is fine, but it will take a little time for things to settle down before you come Yes, they are going to run out of some basic items. I don't know what the menu is like but I am more than happy to give this place a try. But there are going to be a few waits. Yes, they may be having issues and difficulties, but in my eyes that is not a bad thing. At the very least you can expect some slowness and a little hiccups. As they were about to open, I was told how much they were going to invest and how we could get one of their special burgers. Most of the menu is made fresh from local producers, and includes a side of tater tots as well. Besides being the standard beef omelet, they also offer some exotic options. It was definitely a newer, hipper restaurant. The burger they have on the menu is a standard beef burger. Somebody told me the antelope burger is one of the best burgers they've ever had, so I went for it. I also got some ahi tuna too. The burger was cooked to a perfection in the pit! It's not just a regular burger, but is very good. I felt kind of sated on it. My wife said it was really awesome, I was so impressed. It was piled perfectly with cheese, lettuce and tomato. The potato chips were really good as well. And they were delish! They were delicious.I recommend you get a bowl of them, and serve them alongside a burger. They were the perfect portion size with some added seasoning and cheese. There were several items that were a bit expensive, I'm not sure if it was because of the menu or what the place was like but they I will definitely be back.

It's a good thing I was in the area for Christmas when I stopped in the store to check out the new Christmas decor on display. I am actually very wary when I say that, but once I went in I was sold. Whether you are a minimalist or an ultra-glam looker I cannot tell you how much I enjoy this place. They have all the pieces you'd expect from a Nordstrom to be the most expensive, so it sure beat coming here. My first purchase was a pillow. That had a good price tag, but my girlfriend has been wanting this pillow. But it will wait for me in our house. The winter is coming! You can also get the same color as this one. I'll get it in a while.

One of the ways that I like to rate restaurants is by how good the food is. A bit of a condescending tone since they are on Yelp, so they've stopped me from taking up any other real reviews. While the people I know were staring at me and they were all enjoying the food, I was just about to get excited to take a break from my The burritos were huge and the portion sizes are large, and we ordered some more because my husband likes burritos and we I tried the "La Loca Burrito" to start. To be fair, I have had a pretty healthy burrito in the past, including the tacos, but I didn't feel like The sauce could also have been more creamy if I was willing to add some garlic powder. A little bit pricey, but just the food on its own. It tasted like you were in a submarine. I think the burrito was excellent and I will definitely be back.

Lucy Rose, in the Landmark area of Brooklyn! Lucy Rose in the former Post Office Tower is moving to Magazine St.? Lucy Rose is a tiny boutique in the newest boutique section of Magazine St. located right down the street from the post office. Lucy Rose is an amazing women's clothing store that opened at The Bazaar this week. I stopped in and saw it was already well stocked with loads of clothing. They have both men's and women's clothing on display for you to take a look at. The women's accessories are especially cute: fun bags and accessories to match accessories. Oh, and if you see Lucy Rose clothes, be sure to stop by her blog to shop a bit more!

At the end of the day, go and look through the huge fountain. The French Quarter is a place full of musicians who play in a wide variety of styles. Not to mention the food!! The food is great? There is food.It’s fresh, it’s healthy, and it’s affordable. This festival is only open on Fridays from 5-8pm so plan accordingly. And don't forget about the music. For the weekend, there is a food truck selling food from all over the French Quarter!

What a great local event!! For those of you who haven't figured out what that means, here it is. What a concept for a "pocket-chef" festival! I actually thought there was a bit of a difference between the two events, I mean the one in Austin, TX, but hey,  Well, it wasn't too warm but it wasn't too hot, either. It gets packed too for people to have a good time. I'm guessing you're wondering, "WTF??!" There are tons of delicious poboys (I'm pretty sure you get the idea..I'm seriously in love with them)...and Every single po boy vendor is there for a good 25 mins! They have a really good selection of foods like mojo, fried shrimp, chicken, and of course, po boys. Of course, you can choose what kind you want your po boy to be. When you walk in, you will find just about any kind of po boy. It's best to get a few samples of everything...swimming food, burgers, and a poboy. Some of the menu choices at some of the booths are a little bit different and some of them do not have sauce. If you're an oldster like me, they have a really good sauce on the bottom on them, if not, you need to use

The first time I went to this place was for the first time in June. The "The Alehouse" (formerly known as the Bar") is the best bar in the strip, if only because they offer spooky horror I don't think there is a better place to watch live music than in DC - it has an extremely laid back feel to its atmosphere. The crowd is usually about 35 to 40 people. They have a big live kitchen and a large patio section to sit and watch the evening go by!

Thank you Cane's for always being my go to fast food for lunch. It is the only fast food restaurant that I have ever been to the point that I will not ever order another thing from them. I like their breakfasts. I like it served warm and hot! And the best part is: the restaurant itself is always clean and neat. A friend said he has tried all of them but this was the best. As a family, we love the food and service of Cane's.

Originally known as The Pearl's Homestead, The Golden Gem has since become a jewelry and accessory shop in the Central neighborhood near East St. Louis I have found so many old pieces that I fell behind on, but I still treasure them at New Orleans Treasure Chest in New Orleans! The store layout is very much like a small jewelry store, only without the shelves filled with great pieces. A few things have been restored, a lot more looks like they have been owned, a lot more vintage charms and accessories, and besides  It’s almost a little store like a flea-market, but a little bit more of a vintage store. I also enjoyed talking to the owner, Michelle, who was so friendly and listened to my questions about the jewelry. And the conversation turned into actually having some really good conversation, with the end result that I ended up leaving with a few little gems I want to have It was a warm and gentle conversation and I walked out feeling like I had been here for a few hours!

I've been a long time fan of the Orleans Sports & Entertainment store in the north side of Lafayette. I like to get up and do the dishes (weird. Yeah, that's right--$50 for a super-huge, expensive "Licensed" Green Bay Packers team jacket? but come on, I can get a real football sized product for under $40!) So I stop in here occasionally. How easy is it to find something perfect for a woman that would love to have her birthday on a Saturday? And it's especially hard to find the right gift at prices that are low. Not too much..! You won't find any team shirts, jerseys, football signs, football trophies... and their entire stuff is limited time only, so The lady in the store said "I want it". I'm so excited to see what the Saints have in store for us, and I hope that you will visit their website again shortly. I can't wait to get my hands on one of my friend's NFL team jerseys (I got mine for $59.99, but this is my

I'm really picky when it comes to dessert. Joe's in Terrytown, WI is known for donuts. I've been going to Joe's for a few years and just have to say their donuts are perfect to me. They have a lot of varieties of donuts, ranging from plain to chocolate. They give out free donuts after ordering. I also love the chocolate chip cookie holes. They do have fast-casual, but fast-paced, dining options. Well, it's good news for that! I was first introduced to Joe's on a drive through trip to Austin last week, and loved it just as much as ever. I wasn't as far off of my regular fast food joints as my regular friends and I loved the restaurant. I ordered the French Burger. This was just a regular double cheeseburger with an extra side of tomato. I couldn't taste anything else but it was nice and fresh. I also tried the donuts and they were good. My friend, who had just a couple things to prepare, loved the lunch as well. My favorite thing about this place is their coffee and tea.

I've had the chance to try a couple of the El Libre restaurant locations over the past few weeks in the Central District. I was really waiting for another Cuban sandwich place to open up in our neighborhood and have been trying to find a place to go every other weekend. This past weekend was my birthday and I decided to give it a shot. Alright, there's a little more catching up than usual. But the restaurant is packed. I chose the Cubano with their version and it was delicious. The sandwich was big enough to go all day and still warm for lunch. The pork was tender and flavorful. The waffle fries were a definite highlight of the afternoon. I definitely can't wait to come back for dinner tomorrow. They also have a few fried fried dishes and it was great, especially the guac salad. I would recommend this as one of my "must-have" Cubans. The decor was cool, hipster friendly, and the prices are very affordable. This was a great quick lunch for our group of eight. It was still definitely a good place for lunch if you are around. I'm looking forward to it!

I just came across Vietnamese iced coffee and was not at all familiar with it. I finally went in last month to try it in a crowded restaurant called Red House, and I was very pleased, if a little disappointed. I was pleasantly surprised how pretty and comfortable the place was and it was very clean. I had the Vietnamese coffee and a glass of Vietnamese black tea. The place was quite busy on Tuesday but it was an awesome experience. It was a good size and pretty flavorful. We came at the end of the ten minute wait for our pickles so we weren't waiting long. After waiting two minutes for the pickles and the coffee, I noticed that they brought out my cup of coffee before I sat down. I really liked this one as well. The espresso was good and the milk was nice. One of the only things I had issues with was that it was so thick around a bowl that you have a hard time squeezing it The broth was thick and very thick. When I opened it, all I did was put the pho in the bowl and I was like I was in the middle of a big soup bowl. Very easy to handle and satisfies my salty/sweet cravings. This was one of the few times that my pho was not that great. I didn't even care what it tasted like because it did. The coffee was great, but the food was just stale. The soup was very dry and it was completely  bland. They aren't exactly trying to "invent" something that we know already. Maybe they should have tried to make the soup hotter? Maybe they're trying to be too conservative and hesitating? I probably won't get back there in the future because I just know what i will get. It's in the basement but I'm sure it's just for a test run. It should be open a week or so.

One of the best bar in the area. Performing on Friday night was the band Bless the Lord! The room is clean and the bathrooms are great. We were lucky to get in front of their rock band and get a chance to see them perform! Very professional!By far, one of the best clubs downtown!

I had been hearing a lot about the grits at the restaurants around town and decided to give it a try. What really put me off, but I was craving a little something different after a big night of my dinning out, so I decided to try It was really nice that they had an option where you could leave food, or just walk in and order while you wait, which I did. All in all, I'm pretty bad at foodie and not really impressed by this place. This is a very traditional Mexican restaurant with a really nice ambiance, and really helpful staff who was immediately nice. For appetizers, I went with the grits. They said that they are not the best but my husband agreed and said the taste was just right. They were extremely dry when we got home and the last item I ordered was a fish special. It was listed for $24.99... which was the cheapest entree imaginable. I was quite disappointed with the fish. The fish tasted like corn, and the seasoning was not thick enough. The mignonette with steak was ok, but was soggy. I am a bit critical of the texture of your dish because the cream came out of the bowl and then fried up the rice. We emptied out the cups but I would would never order here again. The other dishes were ok, but nothing to get excited about.  Overall, if you have the opportunity to try this place, go. If they get it right, I would have to give it a shot.

Here's the news, I was visiting Las Vegas. When the "regular" restaurant/bar sank, we were ready to eat. I ordered the Red meat burger with egg roll, potato salad and beer that you can just tell that I couldn't stand for that. We did not eat a whole burger, it was all over us and we had to run to get it after all of the burgers were I ordered the Fried egg rolls. You would think that this would have been decent. So far, I can only remember a smidge of a flavor. I just found them a lot poorer tasting than I've had at any other restaurant. The ices were cold and the water tasted like water. The beers were just average, gross and just plain bad. It just means it's a chain.

If you didn't know, it's a Mexican restaurant. I've heard a lot about these guys from family and friends and have been really impressed with them since they opened in 2006. The menu is on the small side with only a few items. We were seated at around 1860 and the server didn't do such a good job of understanding our orders that we ended up being seated the My friend and I ordered the same thing, but in different portions from my favorite restaurant, Felipes Mexican. The food came out in about ten minutes. The chicken was very tasty and it came with a tinge of ranch. The chicken itself was not that great and the fried rice was pretty soggy. I liked the sauce which was served with the taco shells. I don't know what the other items were with the guacamole, so I didn't get to try them. The beans were really good and it was served with guacamole on the side. Unfortunately, the service was also average.

I do not know enough about this place, but when I find a deal on a discontinued or broken item I almost always buy it. I love buying new tvs for less than $10 and in good condition with only a small scratch. I have found me a second hand Polaroid camera that's been sitting in my room for over three years. I know that this is not the first time I have done this, but it is a lot of times I think a new phone can be just as I have also found great deals on a variety of electronics. While you will rarely be able to find anything near the end of the store, you will find rags, buttons, and zippers all for way These thrift stores are one of the best stores in the area and always have a large supply of quality items available for the lowest possible prices. It is a fun place to visit and I am absolutely certain you will find something you can use & enjoy. It's not just clothing, but shoes, electronics, jewelry... you name it.

The "component" of my hair is always style, and I was very impressed with the color I got at Albert Brown today. You can see in the photo that their famous "Old School Hairstyle" is something like that. I've never done this before, so I was really nervous, but even more nervous, because I was pretty sure it going to be pretty complicated. Albert Brown did a great job, and I had such a great time. To her credit, she really took care of finding the right wave to put in my hair and then making it look quite beautiful. I've had less complicated hair styles done. This is a great place to get your hair done, and the staff is super nice. My hair is long, thick and soft, but it looked amazing on me and I think it's so worth it to get it done!

Originally from the Garden District, New Orleans combines the charm of the Garden District, along with the convenience of shopping and dining in downtown New Orleans. I don't understand what people are doing on this blog, but I'm here to share my experience of the Garden District. You could read about the rest of it here, in a day or two. As you walk along those charming streets, you'll notice all the wonderful and unique houses. You know where you think, "That is a part of New Orleans I should live in", but it just never feels right? Be sure to stop by if you're in the area.

Downtown Las Vegas is the only place I would go to if I wanted to see a performance from the likes of The Muppets, The Also very cool because it's located so close to the mall! The bar was really good at both. A great place to get your weekend started. I had a really fun experience going out to dinner here. They have great bars, food trucks and other entertainment. We've been here about once a week and we'll definitely be back in 2 or 3 months' time.

Here is my "go to" parking lot. It's one of the most visited a lot down the river in the city and can be reached by bus. #2- parking is completely free and there are no parking machines. This is a major complaint of mine. I just want to park at the Quarter. It's much easier to walk into the lot than to pay for food or drinks. Besides that there are plenty of numbered spots. I know it isn't the first time parking on this lot, but at least to my luck it isn't the last. It's a nice place. A friend of mine said it was his favorite parking lot.

I was lucky enough to see the New Orleans Pelicans at The Nokia Center on Sunday night. A friend of mine saw the game and was really impressed. There was no one left feeling bored during the game. It was all very exciting! Check out the photo of me at the beginning of the series here.

From what I can tell, this is a very different style of sushi place, than the other ones I have been writing about (for example, Red Hot How do you find Daiwa's? To be honest, I thought that I was being super specific here. If you are heading north on the Metroway, look for the blue "I-95" next to Exit 24 at Exit 2B. Next take a left to turn right on Daiwa Drive and walk about 15 minutes. Go to the end, and you will see a huge Japanese Restaurant and Sushi Bar called "HANA" which also sits on top of a In all probability, once you see the restaurant, you will need to turn right. You'll need to wait until you get in at the post office, and walk up to the front desk. It's a pretty big place. There's a lot to love about this place. I was a bit unsure about what to expecting since I've never tried it, so wasn't too much of a fan of the other All of the restaurants on the Westbank are not really the same, and I always wanted to try something new. I am still very impressed with this place, and I'm not only a fan, but it's pretty good too. I was glad I did. Well I agree, and I'm excited to see what they do here. And on the other side of the restaurant, they have a awesome menu that you should definitely check out. I did get a little confused by the "sushi" word, but since I was so confused about what I had to try, and could only So I'm not just joking, I ate a full tally of rolls. I ordered the Tuna Rolls, and then some of the speciality rolls. I ordered the salmon over ice on a stick bun with lemon and sage. I ordered the prawn roll, and it was the best tuna roll I've tried. I have to say, my wife and I have been very impressed with our experience, and the prices that we pay have really been worth it. They also have a pretty cool sushi bar. They've got some incredibly unique rolls and so is their food. So overall, it was a great experience, and I would definitely make this a regular spot.

Blue Plate sauce is not only the go-to, but the best of all mayos!
