Well, I made such an effort to visit Frazier's Chicken and Mac and Cheese, in San Francisco, so I was happy to choose this place. It wasn't long before you heard the words "spicy" and "original." So I ordered the BBQ Chicken Salad with ranch dressing and spicy chicken. Each piece of chicken can hold a total of 11 ounces from skewer to skewer with no need for the sauce. I ordered from the bar and waited for the food. It was at least 4 hours prior. What I'm looking at is all of these restaurants in the area that are great for some easy dinner in the morning. But, just look at it. With all this meat and pasta and rice, the bill still comes to around $15. I knew my order wouldn't be good, but hey! It was really moist and the flavor of the chicken was outstanding. It was deliciously spiced. But the spice was just the right amount. The sauce was light, sweet and perfect for that "home" flavor. I'm so glad to be back in the neighborhood. I'm so proud of how good that is! You can tell that Frazier's made the mac and cheese to order, but don't be fooled by the name because each bite was an For dinner, there was an Order of Turkey Fried Rice on my plate. It was one of the best things I ate this whole visit and I've definitely become a fan. The service was so great that it wasn't too bad at all - the waitstaff was so friendly. I wish I could keep you on my blog, but for now, I'll just say thank you for that! It's a pretty simple order (ie 14 chicken, 14 mac and cheese and 2 large servings of rice). I'm not so sure whether the other dish was something I really liked or not, but I wouldn't call it "bad" if it weren I'll definitely be returning for more! It's rare to find homemade chicken that you have to spend hours and hours trying to perfect to the point where you could never get it right. This place is a must at least once a year.

I think the biggest complaint I have with The Frog's is that they serve a lot of alcohol. On this list I found the place to pass for good food- The Blue Bird Bar. There is a nice bar in Jefferson Parish that serves the heaviest things we've ever ate. Almost every bar was filled so they decided to sell food so they can sell the alcohol? We found out that the patio is open to smoking. This is like a law enforcement agency that hasn't really given the place any thought and just let it become a regular place. I actually smelled it with a cigarette, so I know that it was just smoke being released off from the exhaust. And that's just the front door to the bar. The place isn't huge, but the space is shady, so if you're coming with a little crowd, you won To top it off, the singer took off his mask after a song and a woman ducked in while she yelled to her boyfriend Hey, there's some things you want to purchase right away. What an gross idea. We'll just keep on going to this place.

I didn't realize why Barracuda closed in Algiers point at the beginning of September. This is where Wendrey and I went for the first time in a week. So we headed over to The Village on Saturday and were glad we did. Usually the one in the French Quarter, it tends to get crowded with other, more tourist-friendly places, but this one opened in a On my way this past weekend, we stopped by to see what the hype was about. David ordered one of their "Seriously" special tacos - the Chicken Taco and a Buffalo Chicken Margarita. The tacos are large, but with a lot of thick sauces in them. The pork taco was my favorite of the three. The chicken taco was great too...the sauce wasn't overly spicy like that stuff. It was actually a bit mushy for my taste, so I ordered another chicken taco. The chicken taco came off easily and I couldn't stop thinking about the chicken taco. And finally, I love their tacos. This place was just as clean as its sister restaurant, so you don't have to worry about the food getting dirty. They are very friendly with all their customers and you can see why the place gets so popular. The owner, Jill, has a great knowledge of the food industry and her staff was so nice. There is also a very nice coffee and tea service, which I've taken to be awesome. The owners are really nice and very helpful, and they also have coupons that can save you at their location.

What is this store called? It's like a big pot of hot air. These guys don't really use that smell that badly so we'll just give it a try for now. I got used to it first. I just thought (and still do) it's really cool that Kirkland's has these perfumes and candles. I don't think that smell can be overstated, but it has a really strong odor to it. I'm not normally a huge fan of fragrances so this was quite fun. My mom got me the cheapest thing you can buy that I can remember at the time, the driest tee shirt you can buy I've always tried to find a nice Korean supermarket in my neighborhood, but I still haven't been to one for that reason. The French Cafe looks really really cool and you can pretty much just tell I was shopping for a French Cafe. The entire store is whirling with creativity on every shelf. The paintings are pretty cool too, especially when you consider that Kirkland's is known for their Cafe de Paris paintings. I am not even a big fan of the stuff here. And I love the fact that it is a non-metro store so you don't have to carry anything with you. I was a bit price sensitive, but it was sleeveless and came with a lot of extra stuff, and at only $8.

Snake and Jake is a dive bar located around the corner from the hotel on the University of Virginia campus. There are a lot of dive bars in the area. I've been to the Brothers 3 bar and Henry's bar. Henry's in the West Side has a really nice crowd. They have beer and wine and a lounge area and a couch. But I can't think of any reasons why I would have wanted to stay here. What I had to remember is as we pulled in, there was a dangling barge in front of us that was going to stop us from It's worth the time. I've been there a few times, but this is one of those dive bars that I cannot say that I have any interest in. It even feels like the sofas are on fire. The sofa is a pretty good place to sit. I'm glad it is but this is a bad bar. Get there early if you can. Somehow, the bathrooms are kind of underwhelming, but that's true of all the locations I've visited. These bathrooms look like a sand castle. Not. Not until the place is closed. My last comment to someone- after sitting down for 8 hours, I don't want to do it. I think this is because of the smoking ban. So they close as soon as everybody is done, so they can get out and party all over again. I don't mind smoking in bathrooms, but that sofa can't. The only solution is a smoke ban. It's a good thing because you can avoid it by taking the smoke with you. I know this place is not exactly a fun place to visit, but I do, because I feel like I'm in my element here. Despite all the negatives, Snake and Jake's should stay open. Go to Bar 213. It's a damn shame that they don't close.

I'm so glad that Deutsche Haus is back in its previous location. This location is temporary and they are planning to move to a place closer to the river, but they were pretty busy. The experience was different than what I had expected because there was really only beer tasting. I tried the red, white and craft pilsner and had a great time learning about the beer that was being made. The beer was a full 33% ABV, and I poured my first beer and then asked for the special sampler plate. As I had not come here to a home brewer's event previous to this one, I was able to watch this event. At first, I thought that the sausage was a little weak, but actually it was quite tasty. The bread was so fresh and stuffed with flavors I didn't even know existed. The beer selection was full of all different brews that worked well and the atmosphere was friendly and relaxed. I know that this place is temporary and not to be missed, especially since German Haus is located in the same development but it is only one block away too. They're not going anywhere. but since it is just a casual hangout I am going to enjoy it anyway. Not only did German-style food come with my beer, my friend had the same type of bratwurst (and hers was amazing too!)

I guess I'm glad that St. Simon's has the better beer selection in the area. Is it just me or is this a very small neighborhood bar by itself? The music is pretty amateurish, some of the bartenders aren't super nice to deal with, and if you want a great We got there about an hour before it was closing out and there were still people from that day to get in but not enough to have fun.

I am excited to write this review because I finally had the opportunity to go to Saffron and try their Indian dishes. The waitress was so friendly and the customer service was top notch. The restaurant is beautiful and it's on the North side of the Mississippi River. I was seated immediately by the owner of saffron, Jim. They got my name listed and came out to take my order. I ordered the Shrimp Paneer and my friends had the garlic chicken. This restaurant was sooo wonderful and I couldn't have asked for a better food experience! One of my dinner companions, had the coconut shrimp, and as she spoke to me, she didn't remember what the name was when I said, My food was delicious, but a huge help getting through the line to the restaurant. The food was great and the coffee was great. This was a great opportunity. I would definitely recommend saffron and definitely look forward to coming back soon. Thanks so much for sharing! The restaurant is featured on the Nola Guide to Indian Food in New Orleans. Visit http://www.saffronsouth.com/ for more information.

I went to a Irish beerpub on the east side of town last night. We were also able to get free Wi-Fi to hook up to our phones. The food options are pretty good (I ordered the Irish cheese soup). No other patrons are there, but I was able to find a great seat near the entrance.

Double Dealer Bar is the perfect place to go to with friends or just to hang out. The doors of Double Dealer open down the stairs at the center of the building and a small stage beckons. The spot is tucked away in an old storage room just off of the front desk. There is a small cafe inside, but the inside feels like a place that you could actually visit just once. Unlike most bar lounges, this place is dark (in the cold winter months), very cool and not to be missed! Taking a short break at the bar will take you through a welcoming scene of old New Orleans and its buildings and you'll start to find yourself As you come to the bar, you will have to walk through a corridor filled with vintage style booths, books and more with the bartender on During the hours (Monday - Friday 10) this bar serves as a great place for drinks between 8pm and 11pm. The bar itself is dark, eerie and a little tense - with a dark, wood-burning bar and gorgeous velvet blind Double Dealer is an upscale bar, well-known on the street, but despite this, it is highly popular among regular patrons. The entire area is lit up at night, with the reflected lights lending a whirring effect to the room as well. Double Dealer serves up a plethora of cocktails, ranging from gin and tonics to an aperitif. I ordered the Mojito, which was made with a lemonade-based liqueur, lemongrass and mint with an apple-based  My only criticism from the experience was the lime juice, which lasted about a minute. This is a great option for someone that doesn't want to be tucked away in the dark. In the end, these are pretty simple bar and dinner menu items with two or three drink pitchers for about the price of two. That's quite impressive to me. When you're ready to party, Double Dealer will make a bang. The atmosphere here is very laid-back and the people here are friendly. You can reserve your drink at Double Dealer by calling (318) 324-1917, and don't forget to ask for a wait manager-

Toups Meatery is here to reign it down again. Meat, meat. We made it to Toups with our friend for dinner and I'm so glad we did! It's also a pretty cool restaurant, because there is an outdoor patio with a fire pit. This is something I have never looked at before and I'm not even quite sure how it all happened, but I can tell you what, it's I chose the slingings to eat, which I've never heard of before, which is essentially a pitcher of Margarit You can get it by the pitcher. If you don't see how to use the pitcher. Oh, the food. It's not something going to be really healthy, but I don't want to have to run around eating something that could easily be contaminated by anything If you are going for lunch, the place is packed! My starter was the meat board. If you do not have a meatery board, you can get a cheese and wine board. That is a menu of all kinds of meats all placed on top of each other. What do you need to know here? It is that kind of a board and it is what you get. I got the ostrich which was smothered in a nice sauce and my boyfriend got the ham. We then ordered the pork brick. Oh, and by the way, the pork brick is one big mouthful of a slab of pork. I'm sure you can tell from their pictures that it is not bad. It is what my wife refers to as a "nonagreeable" piece of pork, which is very strange, and it was the I don't know if I would have been happy with a chicken and rice dish, but I think that may have been the case. No, the pork shoulder beat my hand off. Luckily for me with the pork shoulder my plate was topped off with a little bit of something tasty that I think you can't just let go For dessert we shared the vanilla and bacon grit cake. What is up with that place right now? It was so good. Yep.Would I go back over lunch? Yes. Unfortunately not for lunch. Would I go back to Motley's? Yes. And if you want to eat outside this is a great place. Still, I think all the staff were friendly to our table, who was friendly to our burgers, and made us feel like we were at home.

I've been excited about this place since it opened. I took a look at the menu here and saw a chicken and gravy combo, so I ordered "soul chicken". I was able to get in just in time to pick up a couple of our late lunches, so if you haven't decided Chicken's is on 1130 West Main X 225 East, so if you want to get there early, make sure you're there early The meats is a perfect blend of meaty and tough. I had chicken fingers and beans and rice and fried chicken. They have a sweet tea and milkshakes, too! They're a little pricey, but definitely worth it if you're looking for a good deal on some low-cost food.

I have seen a lot of great reviews, so when it came time to dine while I was in town and I was craving some Chinese food, I I ordered a couple of items from the menu and hit the door with two people. This has been a long, long-repeated visit, so I had to do a little bit of research to get back the lunch time hours Blue Giant is a very spacious restaurant and I feel as though it is about the size of a restaurant. It's a very relaxed setting, with comfortable chairs and lots of hanging art. With plenty of seating, you can relax after a meal, while watching the other diners lick your plates off. The food is very good, a bit like Chinese restaurant-style, and isn't greasy or overly processed. I ordered several things, including some menu items that look like they are coming directly from the kitchen. The menu is very small and so the prices can be pricey, but we paid the price for the good service and quality of the food. The eggrolls are perfectly seasoned, pan fried, and covered with a nice layer of sauce and topped with a generous helping of some Even before it opened I knew I had a winner. It melts in your mouth, and the flavor is all over the place. The eggroll has a nice crunch, and the sauce is rich and creamy. I knew I had to have some and I asked for the dumplings ($3), although I had heard it won't take long for the price to These are so good! I'm sure they'll be soggy once you get a bite out of them, but they're delicious! The biggest dish on the menu is Blue Giant's spicy catfish dish ($14). This dish includes a seasoned cod fillet, black-and-brown sugar snap peas, hot sauce, red and white chi This was really delicious, with the sauce covering everything in this delicious dish. Blue Giant has a great selection of Asian dishes available, while the prices are higher here than I found in many other Chinese restaurants. This place has the perfect fusion of local ingredients and serves a great variety of dishes. There are some nice dishes here, too, which is why I think the restaurant is fairly popular; it's easy to get in at lunch. If you have time to wait around noon, check out the patio for the perfect lunch spot after work.

This place is a treasure and they are getting to be awesome! From novels to classics, Faulkner House bookstore is a wonderful source for all things books. This shop is located in the famous Canal Street in New Orleans. Faulkner House books does everything by hand on every book. Bookcases are lined with books and a little space in the back for the bins. There's a whole ton of books to browse and not you are going to want anything else going on. This place is still being renovated and it has a modern, clean look. There is such a large collection that they have a small space out the back of the store, with a few tables set up for book signings They've become more of a literary hub. You can purchase books from their online store here: https://books.shopaholic.com/. How exciting? You are going to want to drop by this place and check it out today. If you are willing to wait you will be rewarded by some of the books that will be on the shelves. Faulkner House bookshop has become a must in New Orleans for everyone to visit. See you soon!Faulkner House is located at 1421 S. 7th Avenue in South Raleigh, NC.

I have a feeling that since everyone is local, there isn't too many people to go to if you are in a rush. I've been to the restaurant and sat at the bar several times and both times the hostess's personality was friendly but it was The cranberry beer helps tame the alcohol (I did get a kick out of the lemon drop shots, although they are made for You can sit out on the river or just sit around the bar as well.

There's a store called Dreamers, who have a pretty cool print shop in the center of the shop. They have just about everything I want at low prices. I purchased a few of the cards and the kitty in the king cake. There are a variety of designs to choose from, but I would say that I'd rather pick something a little more modern and abstract. I am definitely going to go back again and stop in there if I see something I like. So I'm still here, so I can check their website for more great prints if you visit.

I've always had great experiences with the Coffee Bean Shop, originally located on West Broadway. I know that this is the only place where I get my morning coffee, and that's fine. I was pleasantly surprised, and I made my way over and gave them a try. I was going to take a look at the menu, but I had plans with someone and just thought I'd let them know. There was also a little bar with a little booth, so you can order by the glass pitcher, which was very cool. The coffee I ordered was a Starbucks Coke - I got a Vanilla Iced Caramel Mocha with double whipped cream and a Initially I was really really impressed with the drink. I think my last visit to Gracious Cafe was a while back and I had a little cup of vanilla iced coffee. Also, I don't know if it was the iced coffee being served at the other place, since there was a lot of milk being I'm pretty excited to see what the manager comes up with. It's a cute shop and the employee's are both quite nice and fun. I will probably be back in for lunch or dinner soon, but maybe on a week day. And I was pleasantly surprised to see someone ordering dessert like the pastries I mentioned this morning.

We were in a small town and we really grew up in a small town like this. I was driving along the Old River Boulevard looking for a place to eat, and came upon "Narnia" in that neighborhood! So I finally went this morning to try out their new lunch menu. I ordered the Turkey Steak Roll. The fish was extremely moist and had a nice spiciness to it which we definitely enjoyed. It was definitely something I would love to have again sometime. I just went there again on my birthday and haven't seen anything else available there yet. The service was pretty slow (there is only a server who walks around with a few servers at a time) and the decor was actually pretty cool I would recommend this place to anyone. What a beautiful setting this is and I'm looking forward to seeing what The Coon Club has in store for all of the residents of the area.

Way overpriced. I mean, I can get a $2.50 pitcher of beer for the same price in the local neighborhood for $16 at a dive bar. I can't believe this...I came here for lunch and ate the $16 beers. Your company doesn't have money on the ground. But you're gonna charge me for the same drinks you were gonna charge me for. It's not really dope. Don't rip us off. Who is taking advantage of you? And, if not, say thanks for being the great friend of the Quarter that you are. A tenner would go a long way. And you got me? Seems like it should be $10 for a full-strength beer. The bar here is awesome. There are plenty of free apps and beers in the bar. Try it..if you get it, you may not be disappointed.

In summer you can’t beat the food at this place. I like the place because it opened last August. I have to admit that the food here wasn't quite what I was hoping for, but it was still worth the visit. I was able to grab a seat with a few other people in the same row and it took them a good 5 minutes before I could seat Although I was seated outside in a somewhat sunny area, it seemed like the place was extremely warm. The place was sweltering with customers, but there are plenty of outside patio seats and tables for people to sit out on too! I ordered about 20 minutes as planned, and then we began eating. The Sauerkraut on the side of the burger had a nice little kick. I was very disappointed because of the dressing, it had a ton of dressing on it. I tried the sausage too but it was so dry and icky. I did try half of the bun and did like most buns. Sometimes the bun gets burned and itruins the flavor of the meat too much.  Overall, I think this place is a great little place for lunch; the sauerkraut/sausage combo was excellent. I will definitely be back!

My wife and I were going to the Bistreaux Country Club yesterday and had heard of a new restaurant in our area. This was our first visit to the restaurant and really enjoyed my time there. I got to try their "Nice Chips" while I sipped on a jumbo shot of their sangria and orange/ I was also offered water and some free drinks as well. This place has so many choices, so I could definitely decide what I would like to order. I ordered the Smothered Catfish and my wife chose a side of crawfish with the sauce. As for the fish, I had never had this dish before and it was wonderful, however it did leave something to be desired with the texture of the potatoes. I would definitely go back for it. These dishes are included and they are on the "Express Lunch Menu" from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. on Saturdays For sides that were a little on the heavy side, I tried the BBQ Chicken and Fried Fennel Salad, which was a small side of We are located on the 6th floor of the St. Johns building and it was busy all day. I was glad to hear this and was very pleased I could give him a call again. I had a good idea if something was wrong in my lunch and we were able to have the waitress come back to my table to ensure everything The restaurant is very well-staffed and the staff worked very hard to keep things running smoothly. It was a perfect Friday lunch and I will be back.

I was so impressed with their special rolls. I took my wife and friend here for a nice dinner with our pup. They had a bunch of fresh rolls on display for lunch. We ordered sashimi and roll. We didn't want to be too busy so we decided to try a few things first. There was a great drink selection. I loved how this was made. This was a very small serving and was perfect. We then went with the fresh tuna (it wasn't really fresh, but not bad). I know that there were other restaurants that tasted identical, but this place was quite the difference. Then we ordered the teppanyaki, tempura, and one of their specialty rolls. I wanted to order the Nemo roll, because I liked it more so a little bit salty. Also, I enjoyed the fact that it came in a bag with 2 toppings which is really nice to have a little something healthy and yummy in you The food was really fresh and the prices aren't that expensive. We were so happy when we left and were glad we found this place. I hope this restaurant continues to thrive and grow. If you decide to stop in for a drink, it's worth it to know that there is a good selection of beers on tap and everything There are two open restaurants next door, the one next door to the bar and the one inside and it was pretty empty!

Lakeside Mall in Madison, Wisconsin is one of my favorite malls. The mall is gorgeous. They recently renovated the bathrooms, bathrooms, and shuffleboard court, it's a pretty nice improvement in their appearance. The mall itself is huge. Besides mall walkers, there are 2 major department stores that you can browse while I'm there. All of them are big, and they have a nice selection of clothing, shoes and even a variety of jewelry. There's also a great place for a restaurant/cafe that is a little tiny and still offers food.  definitely check out K.T. B's located in one of the parking garages and there are parking machines placed throughout the mall. The mall has a nice pool and is just a short walk away from Lakeside Park. I wouldn't go anywhere else just for the views.

On a Wednesday, I was on the verge of starving to death. My friend was visiting from out of town so I thought it was a good idea to check out a place close by that I had previously never heard of In order to get some food I walked to Horinoya across from the Plaza Hotel before I walked to work. It was also late because we were already sitting at the restaurant so I wasn't able to enjoy the restaurant while waiting. I had heard great things about this place so I went to check it out. I was very excited to hit up Geisha when we walked in. They had a giant white table in front of seats - not super cozy in the middle of a huge room. The inside was actually pretty spacious on the outside. We ordered a bunch of rolls and sushi. My wife and I both ordered some sushi, we ordered two special rolls, we also had some t-bone sauce which I thought was very delicious. I don't even remember what my mouth was licking out of its mouth that whole time. There wasn't a lot of tuna either, as it was kinda filling and I just wanted to eat more. I still wasn't full, but I wasn't stuffed. I took the picture with my friend. It would be extremely easy to get up and order more, but if you don't care about filling up on the sashimi and rolls It's just not a place I would visit every other time. They have been open a long time and it only snowed there recently.

If I've been in New Orleans for 6 years, I know I don't have the "best" restaurants on the strip. As I normally do, I tend to not write about things that have been going wrong with the restaurant. Looking forward for more Emeril's experience in 2019. It turned out it was one of my best friends too, so I agreed on the idea. At the end, my friend is in love with Emeril's, with me it was a win-win situation. I had a great time dining at Emeril's. The decor was modern, tasteful and classy. A huge variety of food can be found which I knew we would all love. I immediately ordered some food and ordered the corn bread. This set the tone for our meal by introducing us to the full menu. I was given my order of soups and entrees as well as offered some wine recommendations. I had to look up the item on the menu as I didn't know what to order. I ended up ordering a small sized lunch (as I did not want anything small). It was just the right amount of crawfish flourintine, but was not too thick. I was able to share quite a bit of food with my dining companion, and it was all quite great. At this point, I decided to try the famous chicken fried fish since it's the only dish where I see it all. When we sat down, the waiter got us a few sides of the fish which sounded like another favorite. This dish consisted of a thick drumfish that I would have stayed home to cook. It came with a very nice pink-ish crust, which really made the dish quite interesting but was not overpowering. The potatoes were cooked to perfection and the meat had a rich and flavorful feel. The flavor of the fish was incredible and the potatoes were delicious. The side dishes consisted of potato wedges and baked beans, a tidbit of baked carrots and chicken tender with an egg inside. We had a wonderful experience and the food was cooked perfectly. I enjoyed it so much that I couldn't help but tell it was one of the best meals I've ever had. They really got us in the mood for the meal without being too overstimulating.

I finally made it out to Longerman Lake last night. I've just been looking down at a lot of photos of this thing from the past few weeks, as you're probably aware this is the most The park is large enough and it is a quiet place away from any of the noise of the city. It's so pretty and relaxing. This was the first year of the watery tulips.

Cafe Royale caters every party that we have and we had the most amazing occasion. The food was fresh with lots of fresh produce and the chicken was delicious and the fries were very fresh. They didn't overcook any, it was so tender and had a perfect consistency. Our second appetizer was the pasta dish. It wasn't too thick of a pasta, not too thin and perfectly cooked. The fettuccine was cooked to perfection. The ravioli was perfectly cooked and the sauce was oozing with marina sauce that was so delicious I couldn't help but lick it from my The nappa salad was also very good, but we just didn't have time for them, because we were pretty packed. For dessert we got the Banana Cream Pie and I am so happy. I think your waitress was the best part of our meal. Mindy also made up a friendly crowd that had a great time and a relaxing time. She was also very professional in guiding us through the menu and we didn't have any wait times at all. I have no more words to say about Fausto's than "yesterday's food was good"!

The other night I had the pleasure of going to the J.C. New Orleans game at the Dome in Orleans. The first thing I got to experience at the theaters (the Cinema on Canal Place, uhm, movies there). I went to Wok to Go for my birthday when I was in New York City. I've gotten really old at the age of 43, so I can't have too much food left in a bag. To me, it should be consistent with Chinese food that I'm used to and can get easily on my way to work. There have been so many restaurants in the Valley this time I started writing this review. We've been having some late night cravings for sushi! I'm officially on a 200 review streak! It's been a while since I've been to a place with great sushi here, and that one I've always wanted to go to The menu was pretty different from my favorites, but everyone seems to order the same thing, like the Miso, sashimi and rolls. For my friends, it was all about the "wonton" roll. I think it's a good idea (we all know these things aren't tasty... or aren't we? ), but I feel like a lot of miso soups are just missing out because the chunks just come off the soup, like as it is I mean, really? There was also a lot of fresh fish on the tables. It looked pretty cool, was so fun. I just wish we had ordered it at a different time. I didn't like the tamago, the meat in the roll had a chewy texture, and the sweet potato was dry. I love the sauce too. The decor was pretty simple, all white with a very bright color palette. They sounded happy to offer happy hour for $7.99 on Wednesdays. They also played off the little Asian feel they had in this place, which was great. I have to say, I really loved visiting that place.

I don't know about you, but I have always been a fan of the new BrewDog. They didn't actually pour out their beers in our previous review, but at my suggestion, we headed over to the brew pub and had  The place is great, the beer selection is a little low, but the selection is great. I tried their new pale ale, a wheat with a hint of wheat and a dry bitterness. The restaurant is just on the corner from the building. The other beers were a little lighter in their selection and a lot less bitter. The kombucha was also tasty. The beer prices have dropped a bit, but that's normal for any place that's serving beer in glass. What I really enjoyed was the food. Definitely a nice spot for happy hour at that time of year.

When we walked into Barca, we had two separate items on our table. It was a gimmick, and I had already heard of it. I got the chicken and a salad. I decided to order the chicken caesar salad while I was there. The chicken was cooked well and resembled chicken fingers, and the texture was nice and fresh. It had a nice fresh vegetable flavor. I didn't like the mac and cheese. But I didn't think it was the best you can have in this kind of pizza. I really wanted to hate this restaurant. The fried chicken was edible, but for me it wasn't that good. I'll give the place a shot next time around, if it's busy. The restaurant is very friendly, and theambiance is spot on. It was also really quiet.

In the summer, you often get a chance to hit Plato's closet between the Buffalo Exchange and Buffalo Exchange on Mill streets. Here, you see lots of women who had been wearing the same items for years. I had never heard of Plato before. I wasn't sure how many of each item they had, but most of the stuff we saw were the same material. I really like to go to Elfino's Gelato in downtown Madison, Wisconsin. The cookies are excellent! Sucre owes a lot to S.J. and her husband, and so I hope you love their food too!

At Trolley Stop on the corner of 3rd & O Street, there is a small, well spaced bar area with plenty of table A quick look at the decor revealed that this is a somewhat divey, cheap Mexican restaurant. It looks quite run of the mill, and the decor is very 1950s but that doesn't mean that I don't like this place. Because of this, it's really hard to tell where you are in the restaurant, unless you are staring back and forth. The people are friendly, and they are willing to help you find something that you want. While the food was good, we could have stayed for a while and had our fill of the pastry and coffee, but that just wasn't They had the pulled pork sandwich, and I was absolutely drawn to the hush puppies, because they are like chicken wings. I tend to avoid those types of sandwiches these days, due the high cost and the fact that it seems to be so hard to make a simple club. A lot of the sandwiches offered here are the standard hot sandwich style with wing sauce, pepperoni, and a bunch of other cheese. It wasn't like this, but I would say it might be one of the better that I've had in my life. I'd definitely come back for more. It was good so far, that we walked out even though my friend wanted to!

I can't remember the last time I really enjoyed parking in the Downtown Mall. I am currently stuck downtown during the rainy days which makes parking at the O’Connor Center very hard to come by. At the time of this write, it had an average of 508 cars. You should use cash only and be prepared to park close to work or near the library. We went to the flea market in the little old mall in the parking lot.

I actually ate at this restaurant about a month ago, but I have to tell you that I was a little disappointed. I went here on Friday night (the first Wednesday of February) with two other friends. I'm kind of a fan of upscale bar and club areas, so I took my partner and I here last month. However, there wasn't really anything that really stood out about the place, and I was a bit distasteful. It seemed like there was a line of people standing around at the next table. We had an excellent conversation for a few minutes, and when it was time to order, our waiter was friendly. We ordered our drinks at approximately 9 pm, so that there was no wait time for the food to come out. The wine was good, the quality was amazing and the price was very reasonable. For my appetizer, I ordered the jumbo oysters on top of a mashed potato. It was very good. They were just a bit on the salty side, but they tasted so good. They were pretty good, but definitely not worth ordering. We also got the penne pasta. I ordered the roasted soup that is made with onion and tomato, garlic, and Parmesan. It was really good, but I think I would have liked a little more melted cheese. I was surprised that a lot of people thought it was too creamy. We then ordered the beef boudin. I was not impressed. Although I feel it was a little more flavorful, the texture overall was just bad. Lastly, we ordered two sides, which was a Caesar salad and a green bean salad. I'd also definitely look forward to their bread pudding. We had some kind of bread pudding that came out warm but then it was almost completely cooled off, so it was incredibly good and all of the flavors I was extremely impressed by the decor, food taste, and atmosphere here. I also really like the burgers here. I would agree..unless you are a huge fan of seafood and/or fancy cheese. However, with the circumstances that we faced, I feel like they need to work on themselves and get used to their environment. The price could be a little steep for everything that you want to eat, but it's one of the great diners in town.

This was a great find! It wasn't bad at all, but there is also something really interesting going on. I've been eating here for a fairly while. It was the best Pho Bang that I've ever had. It was very good, with just enough spices to satisfy. I could see myself going back to that Pho, but this one's just that good. It's just the same. I think it has an unusual mix of meats, which is really fun for me, as I don’t think I would have had as much meat with There is only ever one order of Pho Bang. They will be busy again, but I really like this one; it's just so much better! We were just sitting and enjoying some pretty good food.

I attended the wedding of Beth and John at Elms Mansion in New Orleans. There was a band on the roof of the building with some beautiful decor throughout. Just a wonderful setting. The inside of the mansion was very nice and all of the decor was really good. I felt like I was here for a different type of experience. At the reception, about 40 people gathered; tables and chairs were placed around the table. The food was delicious and the drinks were very affordable. I didn't mind too much because everything was so lovely to eat and the food was fantastic and theambiance kept us happy to the night. They really do know how to pack the plates. We got many different kinds of chicken, meat dishes, and a lot of salads. It was really good! Also, the desserts were delicious such as chocolatecovered bananas as well as red velvet cake frosted with fresh fruits and white chocolate shavings. What a great way to end the night! Other items available included peach colada, chocolate dip cones and coffee latte. The dancing continued throughout the evening and we enjoyed every moment of it. The decorations and settings were very nice and fit the atmosphere of the event perfectly. Great job, Elms!

I had no idea that there was a vintage store in the neighborhood that was actually trying to be hipster, but judging from their inventory, it appears As a consumer, I'm just very wary. For the record, if you want to sit inside, I would say you should go in with your friends! I stopped at The Dive one night while I was checking out another bar in downtown, Littleton, and decided to check it out. It had a very cool decor with a huge jukebox with a decent selection of songs playing. However, we just spotted them on a street corner, so we decided to head in. In fact, we were a little too rambunctious to get through a couple of drinks without a drink coming out. They were busy with the regular people who were out drinking. We really could've used some more variety in the music, but it was still a good place to sit, drink and browse the shop. We also got to try their new pizza- perfect for the weather.

I was in the business of trying some new cuisine and foodie spots. Not quite in search for a Mexican dish, but I finally found a food truck that served Mexican food. I had heard about this food truck from a friend and since it was located in the South end of my neighborhood, we decided to pop it in to check While a bit confused with the name of the truck I thought, the menu sounded very similar to what you'd get at Taco Tuesday. My favorite one was the pork burrito. It was a lot of food for a $13/person. This was one of the best things I tried that day. I've had better. Then when I tasted my food, I realized I am way more adventurous about going out for my Mexican food to see what I taste it like. It tasted like it was made for them, with the same tortillas and toppings.

Blaze has been in the middle of our Chicago-Crossing area for a couple of weeks and was recommended to us by a good colleague The pizza was amazing and I recommend the pizza crust. I ordered a mini meat pizza (which was great). I opted for the pepperoni-cheese pizza so I could choose from the pizza toppings and added the sauce myself. I also asked for some pepperoni chips on the side while waiting for my pizza and the staff did a good job bringing it out on time. While it was a good, moderately priced pizza place, it's definitely no place for kids age 8 & under, so if you' It's also a great place to go back in if you want to get together with friends and order a few pizzas together as they all So, if you're able to take time out from work (or perhaps after the office) to dine here and they're only open

Last weekend in Northampton, MA, we decided to go to NOLA Smokehouse for lunch and had some great BBQ. I finally got to sample NOLA Smokehouse's pulled pork sandwich. The first time I visited NOLA Smokehouse, I didn't think much of barbecue. But I find myself gaining more and more time for it. I've only tried this place once, and I think that it's one of the best places to get BBQ in Glendale. The place was about a half a mile away so I was really not hoping for good service or anything. It's on the corner of First and Third streets down from my place. It would have been easy to find when driving up to the city- but hey, it was lunch time, and there weren't any other people out So I put off going in just as they closed up the next business day. He did offer some other sandwiches (beerburger and sliders) but I was so excited to try something new. But I was a little nervous, so I waited for a while for something to come out. It was surprisingly quickly! But, the sandwich was incredible. I wasn't sure it would be a good idea to eat it all 'til after the restaurant closed, but then, as I saw If you're in the mood for sauce you can go here and get their red and black sauce, which is the best. It seems a lot like a sandwich I didn't really even eat, even though I had a sandwich-for-two-in- But seriously, it wasn't that messy. I loved putting my own sauce on the other side of the sandwich. While I wasn't huge on barbecue, I definitely enjoyed the BBQ chicken sandwich. I really enjoyed the pulled pork sandwich, and the sauce just added to it. There weren't many people there for lunch, but it was fast and very interesting. I would probably consider this place one of the girls' favorite places on the strip, but I don't think so. So what happened? I really like smoked meat. Maybe I should just become more like them! The folks at NOLA Smokehouse are always friendly and their food is really good!

It was just a short time ago that I discovered LeBlanc's in Gretna. If you've seen videos of their restaurant opening, you know that LeBlanc's is quite a casual establishment. To do so, you don't even need to stop in, you are at the front door and can go to the front of the restaurant. These items are limited only to breakfast and lunch menu items for those who don't like the breakfast food at all. At the moment, we just took orders. Now that I know what I was getting, I ordered my coffee. LeBlanc's is truly a breakfast place that you want that you can order in the privacy of your own room. After we finished breakfast, we decided to take a walk around the restaurant. I was really excited to have a local restaurant open in my new neighborhood. We had a great time with the staff here and got some truly outstanding breakfast. I had a great time with my food! The eggs were delicious. I got about 3 orders, which is a good part of the meals there! The hash browns were just right and the toast was just perfect too! They were excellent, seasoned perfectly and well cooked. My friends and I both really enjoyed our meals and I really felt that I was going to love this place so much! A nice little gem. And they made my experience a little more memorable! It is definitely something worth coming back for.

I am so happy to be sharing a dress I got from La Vie Weddings with you. This is not a dress shop. This place is where I got a great photo session for our wedding planning. One of my bridesmaids in our shoot decided that she wanted a different dress to wear and it would be hard to find one that she liked We figured that a good looking bride should look pretty good and one of those things that makes us happy is that it is designed in a way that The dresses were all so amazing and well priced. We finally found our consultant which was so sweet and so friendly. We were really impressed with how thorough the consultant was. It was the perfect dress, it fit perfectly, and the fabric was exactly what we were looking for. She told me in an emotional voice that if what I wanted was like a dress like this then a better alternative should be found. I loved it so much I couldn't even feel the straps. We immediately put the dress on and it was perfect. This was a pretty quick process. Our wedding day was Saturday and it all went smoothly. Please check out the dresses that you like. This is definitely my go-to place for my styled shoots!

So is Mimi's the best Vietnamese restaurant in Madison? WODDHHH!!! I was so excited to check this place out over lunch today and it was definitely worth the wait. A TON of Vietnamese food is on offer. Situated on the corner of the Westbank and Leith Road, Mimi's is the best place I've seen in the area of Vietnamese I picked B2, which is their signature lunch special. I ordered my lunch and everything I need was ready. The banh mi was a little on the small side and a little runny, but it was good. I wasn't expecting a big banh mi! It wasn't too bad- quite delicious and everything I thought I wanted to order. The bun portion was thin and very tender, with a delicious bite (the bacon is super thin, but not overly so). Me and Tony (the owner) drank the lunch that was delivered and we all went home satisfied! The buns were crisp and even seasoned well. I ate the banh mi right away, since I just finished getting ready. The place offers lunch specials on Saturdays and Sundays. I really enjoyed my bill and I definitely will be back!

I took my parents to Brocato's over the weekend and the experience changed and grew. Brocato's in the Plaza de Cajal is an old Parisian food court and they are good for a quick visit. This place is open all the week as it was when I first came. Brocato's seems to be popular with New Orleans residents. There is a large patio too where you can enjoy a glass of wine from a nearby glass jar. It's a great place to have fun and also get a fill of delicious dessert for yourself or with friends. The gelato has not been tested on animals but people who have had it are very happy with it. If you go after lunch they do a wonderful job preparing your gelato, even though it is an extremely busy place the staff was great. I wouldn't recommend Brocato's to anyone, but we sure do want to bring them back to try one of their gelato flavors.

What would a little more diversity in that part of town do for the restaurant? The place is packed with tourists, and I mean who cares what they look like when they actually look like their "cool"? Upon entering, we were all greeted by a slew of loud, crowd-surfing, bachelorette party enact But how do those of us who go to town on weekend get there? First drink is $2-4, but you see that thing is about 15 minutes long. Is that a $2 tip? I've gone there at least 50 times and can't beat the prices.

This place is in need of serious attention. There are many things about this place that I can't seem to put into words. Inexpensive drinks with a "special something" every 4th night. A second fridge that you never realized was there. A dance floor that looks old. A club which is a ghost town full of high school girls, primarily girls with very little experience. I went because I've never been to a BWDW that had not been rated like THIS and went because it was a really good party

It's a bar but I still feel like it is a bit overrated. It's still a great bar. Today when we visited the place was packed- no complaints, but there was plenty to choose from. This place is so nice- lots of fresh fried seafood and super clean, clean wait staff. It was the first time I had heard of this place and it seems to be a great spot. I also tried the fresh fruit with my oysters, and they were really tasty. I was surprised by the pricing in the menu. Having paid for all of these food things before, the prices at the door was incredibly expensive, so we did not order anything else. They told me that it's $4.45 per person, but I thought $3.49 per person for a small plate didn't make sense. However, the guy who took my order had been at the last spot since the past week and was more than ready to bring me my food. If it was the sub, I think I paid more than $10.  Overall I'd like to give this place a try more often, but I can't say that I were too impressed with the fish. Yes, I'm a Hubig's aficionado! Well, I'm just told that a new McDonald's, but I'm a bit amazed. Just in time!Louie has a Hubig's in St. George's, so be sure to give it a try! If you like iced tea, then this should be your spot. They were the only place where I could get them. If you didn't grow up in New Orleans, you're probably thinking that they were just regular waffles. Hubigs are still available somewhere to pick up in the area, but they are no longer available in the area. There was no way they could be sold in other places since they were so hard to find and they didn't come in smaller than 11x11cm Maybe just for a treat? But they're still pretty damn good. They're amazing!

I really like the food at the El Camino Cafe. I was recently thinking of visiting this place for the first time since I was in Charlotte and the one in Seattle that I've been to at least once, The food was delicious and we had a great time eating all 4 of our apps. They had outdoor seating, tables, and a bar in the back. Then while he was trying to give me this tour of the place, I wanted to do some lunch for myself. I had had great luck with seafood places in the past, but this was a solid place to take a break from all my usual seafood fare. I can't tell you how good the corn and crab bisque was, but I liked the freshness of the corn. I think the flavor was really good and it was a little sweet too. So, I would definitely keep going back and ask the waitress to give me a cup of that to eat with it. The fries were really good, but the bottoms were really hard. The soup came out pretty quick and was also really good. Some of the fries were hard and dry, and I asked for some butter on the bread, which lasted me about 5 minutes. I don't like to eat it on my jeans, but to me it was hard to spread any butter on it. The manager didn't have any. I asked what is a quick butter and she said "the butter you take off the shelf." The menu is very broad and most likely you will be offered a variety of different breads. I could have used more butter, but it wasn't enough. Luckily, they were able to reheat it for us. The Blue Crab is well staffed and the place smells amazing. This place was a bit pricey, but it was worth it. It took us until about 2:30 p.m. on a Friday to get there, and the place was pretty empty around 3 p.m I think that maybe we'll try them again when the weather is closer to comfortable, but until then, I've got to go back there for lunch

Taco Bell is one of those fast food places where you're still trying to get it right. It has a cool, friendly staff that acts like they know the restaurant, so I feel like they've kept up with the times they have been open We came in with a group of two of us and ended up as the only two customers there. We waited for almost 15 minutes to get through the line. They were very friendly and the environment was so nice, we would be back again. Overall, I'd give it five stars, but I really can't see how everyone would rate this place. Whether it's the food or the service, we enjoyed it. The only thing this will change for sure is the decor in here, and if they could improve, I would definitely go here again.

Second Line Brewery is a new addition to the Southside area and they were a bit of a letdown. On a side note- this was my first time at Second Line. There was a lot of activity going on there and even the server offered to sit with us, so that it didn't feel congested. The parking lot is also outside, as is the bathroom. They currently have a menu and some beers being poured. They have a nice selection of beer made on site with their own brewing equipment. However, one thing I'm wondering (and this is my first trip to this location): what does this make their beers drink out of? It makes me question their purpose and value. This place is truly amazing and the service is impeccable. It's a huge portion and you should be able to share. I'd had this at The French Quarter and I'm sure it's similar to my favorite! My favorite thing here is actually the bartender, he was just as friendly as he was at the restaurant. They are delicious. And even better, they're delicious. What a place. After the coffee, que Rico!'s menu offered so many of their classic Cuban dishes, I couldn't help but order more.

On a recent trip to New Orleans, I was a little stoked to check out this place called Cafe B'Faith. When I saw it on Yelp NOLA, I wanted to check it out. After taking a drive through New Orleans on my way to work, I had dinner at Long Chim. Long Chim was introduced to my neighborhood by the owners of Thai restaurant, Siam Thai, who brought a fresh take of Thai street food to downtown New I was not disappointed. I started off my meal by ordering the Sosot Thai with blasted ice. You can order with or without sweetened condensed milk and topped with an egg white. The tea is sweet and refreshing with notes of coffee, vanilla and cream. Next, I tried the Bang Sia, also known as Bang Sia Dumplings. They are soaked in silken paper, using a special recipe, and then simmered in butter, garlic and egg. Unlike some Vietnamese restaurants, Long Chim only uses a light garlic paste, but I like the texture. I ordered the shrimp dumplings with green sauce that gave them a nice spicy kick. I finished with my favorite Thai dish of the day – the Unicorn Noodles. The noodles have a purple hue and are covered in red noodle ribbons made of various veggies, including purple onions, carrots and shrimp. All the flavors blend together for a great flavor experience. For asian restaurants, the variety of sauces is incredibly varied, but that is what really makes this dish unique. The dish makes for a good-sized portion and I found myself able to share it as a starter. The flavor had a kick and was very fresh. You could easily make this dish vegetarian, but they're so flavorful that people aren't at all sure the dish is vegan. I finished off the meal by going for the Tom Yum Soup. Its familiar formula may still appeal to others, but I enjoyed this version more than the other versions I've tried. The mango sticky rice comes served topped with a sweet and sour sauce and sweetened condensed milk. Long Chim has a great selection of tea, juice and snacks for takeout, which is always great. I wish Long Chim well for the next few weeks and will definitely be coming back. We received a special discount to Long Chim and received a complimentary plated breakfast on the first day of service.

I thought I would write a guest review, but there are so many restaurants out there a lot of them just don't seem to do a I went to Tomas Bistro for dinner last night. They were open, and the service was great. For my birthday I decided that I was going on a date night and I took my friend with me. Tom did a wonderful job putting the menu together and was very friendly to us. We ordered the scallops and Catfish and grits- both were pretty impressive because they were both different but with the same texture. What I want for dinner was: a lot of niceness and something that I've never had before. This was followed by the scallops with capers and butter. It was a little strange to say- how the scallops would taste when served with the capers, but they were already very nice. There was absolutely no texture difference. They was very salty and the croutons added a nice crunch to them, while the lemon sauce was really delicious. I had very small bites- nothing too impressive but was incredibly satisfying. The scallops were served atop a hearty teriyaki sauce which was full of white pepper, lemon, brown sugar, salt, This was one of the best pieces of fish I have ever had and I could not believe I was going to put them on a plain plate. A fresh catfish fillet was pan seared over a bed of grits with lemon juice, butter and a nice salty coating I thought they were really well packaged so it was interesting to see how well they were prepared and how fresh they smelled. I also loved the seasoning of the grits and I could definitely recommend it. My favorite part of the meal was the chocolate mousse! I did not have a lot of chocolate cravings this weekend but it was an amazing flavor combination. If you haven't noticed, cocoa powder is on everything so I thought that would be a good addition to the dessert. I can't say enough about the artwork on the walls and the gorgeous, old fashioned style decor of the restaurant. The desserts arrived in a nice glass glass topped with some mini sundried tomatoes and a couple mini chocolate pieces. Also, I love the little mirrors that the wait staff place in the windows where you can see the menu, so you get an idea of what the other I think they even left a little tip at the end of each meal. I would definitely recommend this restaurant.
