There is a praline shop in town called Magnolia. Some of them are small pralines. They also have other things on tap like ice cream, gummy bears, etc. It's fun for kids to pick some up (that's why they do it: they put them in a bag and that's it. The owner was very cheerful and friendly and provided me with a lot of coupons for the store as I purchased a couple items. Their selection is fairly broad and there's a pretty large selection of items. She was quick to find what I was after and help me with the purchases I needed.

The famous Cafe Du Monde is back in downtown Phoenix. If you like French cuisine - and you probably will too - then check it out. Its only difference is that they serve cold coffee (so they don't have microwaves or fridges). Plus they have some delicious salads. There's a coffee mug on the counter to take home with you. It's very friendly and has good atmosphere, though it's kind of dark and dusty, if you ask me. No complaints there!.

This is a post about a little shop I've been meaning to visit all spring/summer. I've visited her store a lot and had the great fortune to be able to shoot a few of her pieces at the last few events that I would go even higher than that! The women's shops usually have a dress at the entrance, but this one has an amazing selection. This is not your typical upscale store.

There is one thing that can change a new restaurant or bar to make itself successful. If it doesn't look too good or you can't stand it, you may not be able to stay to the end. So I was really excited that Baie Rouge had just opened. They had their grand opening on May 23, 2015 with sycophants making a big noise. The decor was very cool and the decor was fun. The menu was quite extensive. There is also a bar area that gets very busy and their music is amazing! I got the Brie Fries which was made of thick cut crisp Swiss cheese with a tangy ranch dressing. I thought the concept of cheese and frites looked nothing like it. But when I found out that this was actually a fancy pants style pizza topped with Brie, I was beyond shocked. They were actually really good French fries with a little bit of a garlic seasoned rubbed on them for some extra kick! I ate it all and thought it was fabulous. It was super salty but they did a great job! I ordered the French onion soup with grits (or cream and garlic), and on it I was a bite. It was a big plate of meatballs, chicken, turkey, chicken salad, and some kind of rice. The bun was completely soggy, but the meat was delish. I love the red and white pizza on my plate. This was a nice mix of everything. For my entree, I ordered the salad and salad dressing. It's seasoned with BBQ sauce and a little pepper. We ordered a pitcher of cold beer too since it was warm outside and it seemed to taste even better. The decor is very romantic and decorated perfectly in order to be classy while being at the beach. I've never had another dining experience that wasn't fantastic. It is super cute in here too.

I have been going to these little treats for years, and I am so pleased with the food, and the shop. They offer their signature sugar cookies, which are the only thing that makes me fall in love with them. I eat it almost every single time I go here and my friends are always asking me about them. I like them, too! They are pretty big portions, but aren't too small! It is always fun to find a different season or the ones with different decorations. The decor is nice if you like art installations!

Hey there!.. I LOVE Ave Pub. My girlfriend and I recently went for a drink at this place. My favorite bars in the Valley are Ave Pub, the Old Fashioned, and The Hazelnut Pub. Even when they are new they look like the best beer you have ever tasted and the best draughts, that you will never forget. The bar manager, Ken, is always so friendly and helpful. That means you have no excuse not to come in to visit. He never loses his drive to come visit with friends of his when he is there. It's super cute out there and the food service is absolutely top notch. The entire restaurant is completely gluten sensitive and the entire staff is very friendly and able to take care of your needs. It's a place I can relax and not get dragged back to my job. I always say that. Yes.. Always. What do you think?

I'm a fan of the local bars, so St. Charles is a pretty great place. How many times can I say that about a place? I thought that the place was too loud or too dirty and I wouldn't go out there. The first time I came here, we wanted to watch the NHL. It was the first time I saw the place and I was so pleased because it's a little older than the rest of the building. So, after my boyfriend and his husband came over, we ate lunch at Cafe Carmel. Later, we visited again, and I was so impressed with the beer selection, and the atmosphere. I was like "Wow, the terrace looks amazing!". And the menu is really big and there's a lot of things to try. The chicken gumbo was amazing! The beer selection is great. We didn't really have anything else to say and because we were already there, we didn't have time to say anything to leave you with. I'm really glad that they offer these outdoor dining options.

My husband and I came in for a meal at the Taqueria Mexican restaurant that is located in the middle of a strip mall in the South of The service was great, we were seated right away and our waitress came by after we left to check in on us. Well, we were still kinda starving and still had our reservations in our heart when we called in ahead of time to get seated. I went for the garlic cheese bread which is a garlic pizza with goat cheese topped with a thin layer of cheese and some onions. The menu consisted of pasta entrees, pizzas and a garlic bread, so I have to take a page out of my grandmother's After a couple of bites, our server brought out our pasta plate and ordered the "Cajun Chicken and Crawfish Steak" as an It was great, I loved the cream, as well as the meats and cheese blend. It's pretty big and I definitely had to dig into a second piece of pasta just to finish it off. There were two small bowls to go with it and for our main course a lot of different kind of pasta to choose from and I thought this was  I also had a side of hot soup and an order of fish tacos. They had a great view of the kitchen, so we could get a little peek at lunchtime and just relax at the table. They must be on schedule, right? I'll say that Olive Branch is cute and all things considered, its a nice place, I would definitely go again just to eat something that'

I have always liked Sushi Kawai, but I think the service can be a little bit oversimplifying. This isn't anything like the Japanese food you'd find in Japan. I have been tempted to go a bit more intense, and I know how to balance I don't prefer Thai. I have had various dishes here. I like this place. The atmosphere is cozy, and the restaurant has an interesting menu. They also have a cool little lounge inside the space, with comfortable seating and a big bar. We had a bar here the other night for a Sunday (a few months back) and I was able to get a couple of drinks. One of the drinks I drank here was the Bloody Mary and I actually did enjoy it. I was impressed with the experience at this place and I could see the whole staff having a lot of fun, and drinking lots of beer. You don't see that a lot of places make you drink, I think this place does just that.

MJ'S is a really cool little store that opened up in 2011 at 411 Louisiana in the French Quarter. It's a little old school in the New Orleans style but it's still a fun little gem. Lots of original items from a variety of New Orleans locations. One would think I would have spent extra money on them but the shop was selling a lot of items that would not be used for a bracelet, such Their jewelry is really cool and they have really good deals when there are few items. I got my bracelet, which is now ready to gift to my brother who is in the shop and wants it now! If you have a large collection of New Orleans flair you can find a thing here.

I went to Pho Thai last weekend. I ordered the Burro-Chickeye Pork dish and ordered it with Thai basil. The pork was perfectly tender and boiled in the egg, which I really enjoyed. It was nice and hot, but I thought it felt a little dry and wet. I wasn't very fond of the noodles and they came out raw. Splendid Pig is a great spot for lunch to spend the day.

This is a bar from that place on Grand Street. Located at the top of a building, the bar is a little on the small side and you can't see it coming into your eyes until There are three other stores in this general area (one in the area of Paris Street & the other in the city of New Orleans) and they all are There was room for about 20 people at that time. So, there you go.

I like this spot a lot. I really like the owner's passion for music. This bar is all about taking the people out on the deck to dance to some music. I would say that everyone was very friendly and it felt like a great place, too. The music was very good and lots of people were dancing until the host's wife started to take steps on the floor. I really enjoyed the music here. I enjoyed the music so much that I would definitely encourage people to stop and eat here as well.

I was so hungover in my post-holiday weekend and when I woke up I headed over to El Gato Negro. I was absolutely delighted! I'm an old hand at Spanish and this was my first time trying to order a burrito. I wanted to get some chicken and turkey burritos. and you can even custom order your own burritos. For dessert I had the fruity guacamole and they had a great sangria. With a bite, I was very excited to see a huge bowl of chips and salsa. I could definitely taste the salty tortilla chips after eating these. I was really looking forward to our burritos. It was huge and so delicious! Even though I am a vegan, this was my first time trying this so I was pretty grossed out. This all made for one of the most flavorful meals I have had in a while. The beef was tender and the pork was perfect. The green onion was very tender and the southwestern taste did not overpower it. It was incredibly thick and had an excellent texture. I have a feeling I will go back here every time I am in the area. I’m definitely going to try the fried green beans and mexican sausage burrito next time!

I have been to numerous downtown Nashville steakhouses in my past years and have often toured the area. This place is Beef Connection and it's located in the center of the beautiful city of Phoenix. Because of this, I've always had a suspicion about going there, for good reason. I decided to try Beef Connection recently when my friend was visiting town. We came and entered the restaurant via a few steps and our server was there for another 5 minutes and then was sent out to seat us. All I have to say is that the quality of the steaks is absolutely fantastic and the staff is friendly! We chose a menu that consisted of four main types of beef; the steak, the potatoes au gratin, the steak au gratin, The portions are massive and the size of the portions is huge too! It was great to find out that the petite filet was available to order. A huge portion of steak with a fantastic amount of tender cut with a good amount of fat. If you eat anything this way you will know how delicious the potatoes au gratin is. A couple pounds of potatoes, the most I've ever had, with an entire serving of potatoes. The potatoes were cooked perfectly and had a perfect texture and just the right amount of cheese to melt that zing- without  drowning it! My father was so impressed when his cheese plate arrived! I had some and my dad had the tandoori chicken on my plate, which was a huge portion of chicken and rice. These were all dishes that I could have been eating at home. We sat in the dining room which provided a beautiful view of the lake with the view being just amazing. We had a good time, we were full once you got in the door, the atmosphere is very relaxing and atmosphere was excellent. The lunch deal was $17 and the lunch special was $27. Luckily our server had already finished the meal so we did nothing special.

The last meal I had in New Orleans at an old sit-down restaurant was this one. The fact that I get to eat here at regular intervals is just not the same as when eat at any other restaurant. You know how much my food preferences have changed, but hey, I'll be a little more careful with my food. That said, it turned out to be a good choice for food and company, but it was a waste of time. My wife and I had been waiting on the waiting list about 5 minutes, so when we finally got in, we were seated right next to the kitchen. Now what? Are you joking about being next to a cook trying to make a meal? She was very nice, but didn't really introduce herself when we picked up our plates. I wasn't sure what it was, but based on how fast I was leaving and not seeing anything on the menu we ordered a burri I thought what I was ordering was a cold burrito that was a little cold to start. She took a bite from the bowl and I noticed that the meat was cold and there wasn't much meat on top. When it came out it was hot, and it was very dry. I did manage to get a few bites of the ranchero, but I still didn't feel much like I cared. Unfortunately, I wasn't happy. As that sounds like a bad thing, I flipped the burrito down to order the other side- the taco. I thought it tasted ok (I know- because it's a burrito, it's not that big of a deal The beans didn't even taste like beans, it was just cold. It was a good place for a quick lunch or quick dinner. It's not the best location, but not only that- but it's extremely loud- so I think it's time to take another ride out

Friday night was my first time experiencing the smokefree atmosphere of Las Vegas! I'm not that impressed with the casino, but for that price, I'm glad it stopped open in 2011. If it gets crowded at the gambling machines and other places you can wait, you can always get food from the fast food line. I ordered a side of pizza and a coke for my daughter, and it came out really fast, with no wait. We ended up eating on the patio over looking the casino. The service was really good too! You never know for sure what you will eat when you visit as a fast food place is definitely not all you get.

I can't believe that this grilled cheese place was opened that young! I'm not sure if I should be dishing it out, but I know that if any one didn't know that, you would be Or did I just get there too late? There are many options, but I ordered the grilled cheese sandwich with salami, ham, and pepperoni. It was the first cheese I have ever heard of, but I am sure you can think of better. The sausage and alligator were cooked into a perfect sausage and cheese mixture and I couldn't even tell you how good it was! It was moist through and tasty on the inside. It was so moist and cheesy because it had a really smooth sauce all over it. We did our takeout with just the potatoes and everything was cooked perfectly with little or no browning. Now for those who are in the mood to try fried chicken and mac and cheese, not to mention the fact that they have beer, beer, beer. I didn't think The Big Cheezy has a better feel for their food then they do, but they do have an atmosphere that works with everyone' And they also have beer and wine!

I have had 3 great experiences with Tire Masters. I was very pleased with their experience and the quality of work they did on my tires. I would not go anywhere else. The repair costs were not expensive and was exactly the opposite of the experience I was having from a similar shop. Also, their service is not bad at all, they are honest and the store looks very clean.

The craft show at the park is always popular with the kids and adults! I'm always curious to see what the vendors have with their wares. One of my personal favorites is the glass necklace made by the local artist Lilo. I am going to show off the cute little black one next time I make a costume. In addition to this, many vendors make small signs with a message, so remember that if you have a purchase that you need to show the business I had to send a picture to a friend via email just to ensure it would be accepted.

I stopped in for lunch a couple times over the past couple of weeks and found this place to be fairly affordable for lunch. Its a great neighborhood lunch spot. I got the salad as well. Not too much that I wasn't able to finish. This restaurant had a lot more flavor than many restaurants.

After shopping with the wonderful girl at Fleurty Go for years, I can't say that I've seen the store get busier. My friend was very excited about the New Orleans themed t shirt that she was going to wear for the Halloween party. I got a great deal on some items that I need for this out of town friend. The selection she offered was so good that I was able to narrow down what I wanted to buy to the last and I ended up leaving some of the items There's also a great shopper event going on that looks like it will blow your mind! I always get great support from these guys and they also have a great online store so I feel that my purchases will be always great.

Pete's Bar & Café is 'Sky’s Best Bar. As I look at everyone and their stuff, I always laugh because "My friend came in here and now we're on Yelp!" It was my first visit to a New York bar and now I have yet to go as there just doesn't seem to be any kind of Yel They have a bar with an outdoor patio outside. What a pleasant place! The place looks so unimposing from downtown. There's no outside signage so if you walk in you know that it's off the beaten path. They used to live in downtown, but they finally found out about this dive about 1 or 2 years ago when they just passed through the neighborhood and we were passing I was pleasantly surprised by the people and music. I came here yesterday for an early night hang out and it was great! The only downfall was that I just happened to be in the bar with other people so I came here at a bit later than usual and we were pretty This place also looks like a club but I thought it was kind of like a night club with a DJ and a few girls talking. The music kept going pretty well. It was really nice and everyone was really nice and made it quite easy for us to get in. One issue was that it came off the menu about 10 minutes after closing, so we asked what the wait time is and was told there would be 45 minutes. Great neighborhood place, can't wait to come back! The bar is just really cool and I definitely recommend going here!

I went to Jeremy Davenport at the Jazzhaus yesterday and loved it. I just couldn't stop talking about it! I remember loving this place! What a club! It's a club, but it's not crazy rockin'. First of all, you know, this place is right across from the Palazzo on the corner. Yes, I'm being really hard on myself, but trust me, you don't have to miss it if you're in it. You should be.I'm not a huge fan of '80s music, but Jeremy Davenport is totally right. Here at the Davenport in Madison, Wisconsin, a place with awesome music. My friend is the owner and I've been to Irvin Mayfield several times, so I know in my head this place is a great addition Everyone is dressed up like they did in the Rat Pack era. Oh, if the wine is good, so are they. The guitarist, Joey DeRio, is rockin'. You'll be lucky to catch him. You know, like Davenport's place where he always runs on the stage and people are not very friendly. Or at least the food isn't bad. Just ask my wife when I have one! Or maybe I'm getting too carried away. Did you want a good, old-fashioned rock and roll night out after the dinner dance and then just dance all night? I just happened to walk by this place and I enjoyed it!

Vacherie is always my choice when looking for a romantic date and I just adore their food. I had the pleasure of visiting Vacherie the other night with a friend and had some great experiences. It is a beautiful, well decorated restaurant that overlooks the Las Vegas Strip. It's perfect for a night of fun- not serious, not necessarily an "eating out" or a "fishing out" situation. It was warm out there, but we were kind ofchilly there. We could take our time and didn't spend too much time looking at dishes. This was a great place to hang out and just sit and enjoy a glass of wine and food. The first dish I was interested in was the gator crawfish topped with cheese and a lemon. The gator bites were cooked perfectly and they were delicious. The gator was fresh and the bites were tasty. They were served with a nice mix of sauces so that our drinks could be easily mixed. I went with the Mediterranean Salad with Tomatoes, Cucumbers, Garlic and Garlic Dressing. It's on top of the salad and I loved it. I loved this salad and the dressing. It didn't overpower my taste buds. At my second round we opted for a shrimp with chicken, vegetables and rice. I have to say, it was one of my FAVORITE parts of my Coolinary experience. I just couldn't get enough of the dish. Shrimp in fat tail-on shrimp, smothered with garlic grits, and served with French bread rounds is my favorite dish from This would be on par with a medium-sized plate at the average restaurant. This was a big portion of the delicious food I was eating- even though it was so huge. They even had some sauce on the side to dip my shrimp in. I could barely eat all of this! There were so many shrimp and grits, I ordered my plate at home and there was only one left for my plate. For my sides I had the pork sandwich. I really liked this as well. It was tender and flavorful and not too salty. So, overall, all of this was perfect! My date also got a special dessert called a graham cracker square - that was to die for. I had a feeling that Vacherie was a great place to go out for fun on Coolinary and I was so happy I did. I am SO jealous- I want to EAT here! We went up one night and it's been a fun experience. I think that's what made Vacherie famous. To end off I had the pork panini with some fresh cranberry sauce in it. I am going to ask them if they have a pork smothered collard greens version. This was my favorite date dinner ever.

I have been passing by El Tijero Cafe on the Westbank for a while. I was expecting a wait while I was there since I am waiting for friends in the area. Oh, and if you get along with the owners, you too can watch them walk the dog. I started on a Wednesday morning to stop by and try one of their "hot breakfasts." It was open, so I wanted to try their famous lunch specials in the basement. I noticed that the menu had lots of Cuban sandwiches on the menu. It was so interesting to see! And this is one of the only places to get a Cuban. Everything was fresh, hot and delicious and there were only 2 people in back of me. I am so glad I did because this sandwich was awesome. It was very tasty and was very fresh, albeit little bit dry. The pickles and cheese were both really fresh and very sweet with no dreaded onion bites. I absolutely adored the grits! They are incredibly fresh, which is a large compliment. I had the best lunch by far today and have a feeling I will be back on campus for lunch after that- they are open until 3 or 4 PM I have been meaning to try the fish tartar at The Green Kitchen for a while and I saw that it was only $6 in April, or almost nothing The prices are great too and my grits were delicious- they were really light and I would definitely get another. I will have to try that again soon! I think this is a cool place to go if you want to try different things outside the Cuban sandwich route. It's a little more laid back then other cafe's I've been to and I definitely look forward to coming back!

I've never heard of this place as having a bad experience before. There is a great DJ and DJ's but I get charged a cover night when they are playing live. It's located in the very heart of Vegas and I really need to check it out! It's great to find somewhere to enjoy nice music even if it's not at the best of times. That night the band was performing and we had the most amazing time. The music is great and they have a few songs that we love. That's just wonderful to be in and I just love it here!

We ate at The Kitchen when we were on our way from LA to NY and we couldn't resist trying some of their Chinese food. So when I found out that the restaurant was open, I waited less than 30 mins in line and was seated right away. They have lunch specials everyday including 2 for $6 so that is way better than the drive-thru food. We ordered Chinese classics including wontons, fried rice, and wontons and wontons. I got the wonton soup and my dining companion got the shrimp fried rice. It was really good. It was actually easier than I thought it would be, there are hardly any noodles in it. The sauce was very nice and I think they used a lot of garlic in the soup. As far as the service is concerned though, it's pretty good comparing to the last restaurant I went to, Le Chien noodle restaurant. They serve tea and coffee and it's not expensive. You can tell they want to help out you and it is really important to them that this place is in a well-downtown setting. They were super busy and it was almost like they had a lot of partying inside. If you are looking to go out and see friends, it's well worth the trip :) They have a great menu too.

This place is amazing! I recently ate here last night with a friend and we had a great experience. The place was a bit busy and we wanted to try the place out. We had a reservation when we came in. It was nice to have a small place to wait, but not one you could hardly feel friendly in. We started with two of their raw oysters. We chose one from the three (I did not have to do my own) and I enjoyed them very much. I'm not a fan of the sweet oysters which have a little cream in them. They were pretty pricey for the serving size and they were great! The sandwich was really big and had a lot of meat, so I got the alligator hash with polenta. We had the hot and hot and spicy chicken wrap which was very well prepared and had lots of tender chicken. To think there are sausage in this is something you can not find any where else. In fact, I tried some of the sandwiches that the waiter had suggested to me and it was decent. I had the meat in a thick layer, like a sandwich I could not cut apart. I could have used a little more meat! We finished our meal with a few beers, and finished out with a glass of white wine and some desserts. The grits itself were a bit too dry, but the breading were delicious and the grits came out very quickly. He even arranged for us to try the restaurant's hot chocolate during our dining time. If you get the chance to speak with the staff, listen to music, have a conversation and chit chat, this is a great place to This was my second time dining there and the first time that I felt comfortable sitting at a place, interacting with other people. I wanted to say that I would give this place 5 stars, but it was definitely better than the reviews they were having. If you want a good meal at a great price, look no further. I plan to come back here, probably for my next date night since the prices are fairly affordable.

I was glad that we went for our photo shoot at this hotel. I was just looking through reviews on the Google maps and this place was right on the beaten path. It's been like this for a long time and is one of my absolute favorite hotels in New Orleans. So I decided to give it a try. There were all these signs up saying that the parking meters are located on the middle of the street. I was looking to park on Poydras because it was less expensive. I was pretty grossed out with this, especially since they actually had parking in the hotel and a parking garage for their vehicles. A lot of people are at the lobby, but there are a lot of people relaxing. The lobby has huge fireplaces, a gorgeous piano, and even a little dance floor. I don't normally really like European places, but the location is fantastic. I also noticed that the bathrooms have little mirrors, where you can see the clock in the room and the doors. I was a little nervous about pressing the elevator button because I was standing on top of it and it was not much easier. The hotel has a large kitchen and coffee bar that we had to take advantage of. It was quite lovely though- the tub was clean, the pillows soft, and the blanket was beautiful. At some point I just had to go in and check out the facilities. There is a shower area, and the room with a tub. The place has a great restaurant if you are interested in fine dining or just a place to enjoy a drink. The area outside that offers pool toys and a snack bar. There are also showers, if you feel the need for them. The only negative was that I feel very uncomfortable in the lobby, which definitely isn't a plus by any stretch of the imagination.

A small Christmas tree in Louisiana, and a tourist attraction in New Orleans? I really wasn't into the cheesy theme park part I was originally going to see. And now I'm thinking, now that I'm a little bit more naive and I've been there once, I mean, It's kinda a simple park, with a few activities. I'm just not that into it. The only thing I didn't understand as I was putting this together was that the entrance to the attraction is actually right next to a frozen lake. The fake snow is a joke. I'm not a big fan of fake trees. If I have to get a fake snow or colored tree to look real I feel really bad, but the quality of fake snows are really chee Just not something I would go for. And then, I can spend my money on things I really love.

But I don't really feel like spending the night here, only due to my birthday weekend. The people inside get really confused with you in there but have little to no problem with you. I love this store. I really love buying hats and other little items from the store. The most gratifying thing they have, however, is that they have a pretty good selection of grocery items. They have always got an amazing stock of chicken. Don't give this place a bad review as the store is not good.

It's really different from what I remember the last time I went in. They don't have the "tall dress" that I was looking for; they do have more casual wear than a traditional dress, but it was However, I think we may have left something for good cause. Probably one of the best vintage stores in town. It isn't just women clothes; it has men's slacks, men's pants, jackets and some accessories. Especially great is the hats. Don't forget to bring money.

Although an old cemetery, it's a nice spot. I was driving up to South Lake, NC and stopped at this cemetery as my drive through wasn't exciting. As a town cemetery, it has a few monuments on the outside. There is no big entrance. I'm not sure what the name "Timberhill Cemetery" means, but I think it's a lot more popular than the other ce I've never been able to cross the little gate, but it's easier to walk through that way. A lot of people at this cemetery will come here to visit in the fall - they're old people and those aren't usually in the grave

As I get older I'm afraid to cross any bridge that's particularly rickety. In one occasion, I made a wrong turn and the rickety structure had to be moved to the right side; I couldn't see It's not a bad bridge. On the other hand, I usually go over on the rare occasions when I drive, and even when it's a lot easier. It's more unstable. On this particular occasion, I hit a bump and ended up bumping both cars onto another road. So there is a minor risk while crossing over the bridge. The construction worker (my friend and I), who works in the carpentry field, helped me get the car out and the truck (the guy who had

I stopped in to see what the hype was, and was happy to have found a small coffee shop by myself. There is plenty of parking, plus it's in the back of the building, so it was easy to get there. The food is good though - several small lunches come out at a time and I could almost get a meal at New Orleans Hamburger and The food was a bit rushed, but everything was good. Not too bad, if you run across the street, especially on weekends.

On our visit over the weekend, we stopped by Alto on the way home from work. Nevertheless, it looked stunning. For example, last night one of my favorite rooftop hang outs was Bar Luis, located over the Palais des Sports and the Ace Hotel. However, one of the new favorite hangouts on the east side is Alto at the corner of 2nd Avenue and Constitution Street in New Orleans. We were going for a drink, and it was already pretty sunset, so there were a lot of people out there. I tried a large martini and thought it was very small. Despite it being late, I was able to get a pretty nice drink here- I just ordered the bartender order a "large" Another drink I ordered was a lemonade from a tall glass! I went back later and took pictures of the view and the cocktails. There was a huge crowd, so it was great to see people standing up and enjoying a cool hang out. All in all, a pretty cool hang out in New Orleans.

I've used Wal Mart in several ways. I've gotten a lot of nice deals here and there's a new Wal Mart that opened so we're pretty up there now. I was quite surprised when I heard about Arnaud's from the sister of someone that had lived in New Orleans. It's hard to find "what's on our menu" like this. As a Frenchman, I love jazz and having a chance to attend a jazz brunch in Louisiana is one of my favorite things to do. I don't know how to describe the atmosphere, but everything was PERFECT. The staff was amazing and I must say that I felt right at home. This isn't jazz brunch when you pay for only one item at the table - just one entree. I thought that was very reasonable as it was a Brunch on a Plate in LA! The first course was the turtle soup au sherry. I had originally not heard of turtle soup, but I was happy to hear this was a regular thing. The soup was perfectly thick and creamy and you could really tell the soup was made with fresh stock (it had to be fresh because all of the sauce needed had I really enjoyed the soup and it really rounded out the dining experience. Then my friend ordered my favorite dish: the gumbo salad. We all like greens and Arnaud's salad was loaded with fresh vegetables. Next was the main course. This is a classic Creole breakfast dish, full of sausage and delicious aioli sauce. This dish is pretty big, so I was pretty grossed out when I heard it was actually on the lunch menu. The sausage was perfectly  tender and everything was seasoned perfectly. After that it was time to hit the dancefloor. My dessert was the bread pudding. I love bread pudding! For brunch, this wasn't a very impressive setup and we were served warm and very soft bread and a glass of coffee. There was a bit of a surprise on this show. We was so glad that Arnaud's had a little dance floor and we had a bottle of their house white sangria. It's a great tradition for the restaurant because there's a really nice group of people here which really makes things special. It was delicious and the drinks were tasty and I definitely had a blast. It was a very festive lunch for all of us and I loved that we took time just to enjoy the food. Arnaud's is a great place to eat and if you are in New Orleans, I highly recommend it. I'm ready to go to bed this morning and look forward to another great brunch.

It's quite a spicy sauce and I'm afraid if they included the spicy mayo in the roll, most people would just think it was The sweet roll was actually very good, but it was a little too sweet for my taste and I was on a diet for a while. All four rolls were small and the only thing I noticed that was a bit bitoversized was the sushi. The crunch dynamite roll also came with a lot of spice and was a little gross, but there were crappy little holes all The ramen was also good. The manager and owners were very communicative and very helpful. Also, I found the employees very nice and even got a free meal.

One can easily describe it exactly, since all I've wanted to say about this place is that I wish I could say that it is actually pretty good. So I had to check this place out, too. I walked into this restaurant from the parking lot a few minutes early. So I left the neighborhood to enjoy a cocktail on my way to dinner in Madison. Headed by a server and bartender, I swung through the bar and found a burger joint. Unfortunately, I wasn't the only one there; there were over 100 people. We were seated right away for dinner. I think it was the restaurant. All of the seafood was in a tray that was spread on the table, so you could make a lunch, lunch and dinner. We also ordered the glass of wine, because it was already 3PM and I was running out of wine in my jacket. I tried the pomme frites, which were seasoned with lemon pepper and garlic powder. They were soggy, and I was so surprised at how quickly they were put together. My date enjoyed the olives, because he has been loving olives around these parts recently. The olives were medium fresh, but seasoned perfectly with olive oil, salt and pepper. The breaded eels with the squid pâté were nice and crisp. It looked like the restaurant was just opened up for some fun, so our waitress told us everything was a special order. I was so happy that my date had the Habanero Oysters. It was perfect, not too salty, too sweet and perfectly flaky. Next I tried the squid pâté. It came with two slices of bread, and there was a lot of bread on it. I was happy to try the eels, because I had heard there's a version of them in the store. Og, this one is like the eels in olive oil, but it's a bit of a weird texture. Just like the pâté. I really enjoyed this. We were able to eat at the bar for a couple of hours to refuel and chow down. It didn't take off and it was amazing! This was a good dinner. This was definitely a great food experience, but it only lasted about ten minutes. At this point she and I were both full, but at that time I was happy with my meal. So I got the pâté for the first time. Next came the steak filets. This place is a very classy place. I wasn't expecting to have fried pickled oysters, but this is why I took it. It was not too saucy, but with a nice flavor and a good amount of seafood. This was definitely my second try at a French restaurant and it definitely won't be my last. My date also asked me what the bread tasted like and I said it was like an old fashioned bread roll- which he got me and t I would probably order more. He was right.. This was perfect.. The food was amazing. I'll have to try this again sometime- I'm afraid I probably won't. It was a great dish and I plan on coming back again one day. In my opinion this place is a little too divey and there isn't enough food around for you to eat and not feel full (which I think my favourites were the cheese, tomatoes, and ranch dressing. I think we was all thinking about this food all evening :) What did I think about the oysters? So after all of this I was left with just a few things to eat. What you do with an egg in a can is not the place to put it. We all ended up having some really amazing time and I really felt like we were in a good place. I can't say enough good things about this place, and if you are looking to explore the South East please give their menu a try. The best part of the meal was the dessert, which was amazing.

At around 1:30 pm, my boyfriend and I decided to check out the La Brea in West Vancouver. There are a few good Mexican restaurants in the area and I was excited to find a few options on a Friday afternoon. I noticed they had fresh-baked tortillas and a lot of vegetables. The burrito I got was just one filling, so I added two additional fillings. The food there was great. It was very tasty and my friends also loved it. It was packed with carrots, green leaves, and lots the sauce on the wrapper was really good. It was not salty, but it also didn't taste like cream cheese. We also ordered a lime wedge burger, which was really good. The burrito was plated to me in less than 5 minutes. If you're looking for a burrito lunch, I suggest La Carreta for lunch. I would recommend this to anybody that loves Mexican food.

In the past I would have stayed at the Hollywood Hotel, the creepy house on E Street, the haunted theater in The Haunted House If a Halloween movie was more your thing, then this is the place to go for "Halloween fun". Over the last three years Ghost Manor has built a house that's completely destroyed and is being renovated. We are regulars and we're really looking forward to it because it's new in the neighborhood! Ghost Manor has some Halloween fun too, with children playing with the house while enjoying the music. It's the perfect haunted house to bring your kid for their first Halloween experience. They even bring the ghosts up to you after you've finished the "show" and can hold you over until at least midnight. The house was really fun and we would definitely come back.

Cheesecake Bistro is a chain of places in the Cheesecake Factory that was just named after their original location. This brand was mentioned on a local cable show and I decided to give it a shot. This is a chain, so you can make a lot of things seem pretty simple, but the restaurant actually is pretty huge! I was super excited to be dining there, because of the speed of service. This is not just in the Charlotte area, but in every mall it's packed. There were several people doing their first order, but the main line isn't bad. The food was good! We went for the catfish bowl- two pieces of fish served with mashed potatoes, green beans, corn and cranberry sauce. My friends and I went with chicken wings and we were extremely surprised by their size. This was a good choice as it just had the fried fish covered and a side of the mashed potatoes and corn. I didn't really think it was enough fish for two people, but there was enough to eat to fill me up. We could have had more and added an additional piece so there was a little more variety in the dinner. I could definitely recommend the fried catfish though- it was my go-to dish when I'm just not feeling the need to go on a The desserts were so good too. I ate the cheesecake with a side of ice cream. What I liked most about this place is that it is very quick and easy to get in/out. On this particular visit, I was extremely hungry as my wife had the white chocolate panini and was thinking of eating the entire thing- though I knew that I'm glad it's a chain and it does not have the high prices and convenient seating that I'm hoping for on other locations.  Overall, we enjoyed the food, service and price!

This is one of the best places to find art in the area. With a great selection of vendors with everything from a huge art display to locally made jewelry, photography, jewelry and more people from around AZ come out You'll love the shop as much as you buy at the shop!

The Bar Affair is in the Casino Tower at the Phoenix Fairgrounds. The only really cool thing about this club is that they have an upscale lounge area where you can relax and talk with customers. Typically people are there late, so you'd best to avoid the casino when you go out to see the gogos. I also came across another casino club in the area called "The Ballroom", where ne-e-cis people who work there are actually permitted

In case you don't know what I'm talking about, it's the Art Gallery at the Northgate in Greenville and what dre The dolls are called "Children of Frankenstein", and they come to you in the form of a small plastic doll. They are huge, extremely life-like puppets that are painted on to wooden models in a variety of colors and have a uniqueness that is so The dolls are on display and are sold for $20 each. This gallery is more like a "Halloween Gallery" rather than a Christmas gallery. There's also a small selection of pictures of famous people and other famous characters that have been created specifically for the gallery. They have a ton of things for different ages and even have a selection of Christmas ornaments, which I thought was a bit odd to There's also a wall mural of The Three Stooges, a great art dimensional piece for the walls that won me over with it'

If you go to the Castro, check out the Cibos. They are located at the corner of 12th and Walnut in a sort of hidden location, so there really isn't anything you don't The decor was so fun and we went during the night on Friday, so I took advantage of that. It took a while to figure out this place after arriving and seeing that there was a really loud DJ playing...and we were already dining on a In all seriousness, this is right in the heart of Mexico. So, I moved onto the dishes. I ordered 2 frog legs and a Cuban sandwiches. After a minute or so wait, we got my sandwich and took it with us to a table nearby. When I finally got home, I looked at the sandwich. The sandwich is called a "cuban" but I don't really know the meaning of everything on the menu- it's a sandwich. I'm a fan of a shredded Cuban. The hot sauce was awesome. The only thing I didn't really love was the music. I was happy with this place and I couldn't help but think of a few points: the food was very good, the wait staff was friendly ( However, I could see this being very popular for the Friday night dance party and I would definitely want to drop by at least once a week. And I'm looking forward to going back soon as the food is great.

The Stairs is a funky new bar in the Old Town building. It is a small wine bar at the time but the decor inside looks like it was done this spring. This restaurant features plenty of music and the interior is really nice for this bar. I enjoyed the happy hour there, which is always good. I figured out who they were and then I was able to take photos to try the bar themselves. Also, this is my first time to see the music from the new place- as always, it's good to see them do something new. Definitely a cool place to hang out.

I spent a little time in Denver today shopping because I'm heading west for the first day of February's skiing season. With these plans, I won't be able to stop at any snow ball stands! I don't have to if you don't say so. First, we went to the SnowCream in downtown Westbrook. This snowball is small enough they aren't like those huge "snowballs" that are a few inches long. The store was clean and their ice was very good. The taste took a while to get over, but it was still quite good. Of course, you have to stop to order, so I settled for a vanilla sundae. It was definitely worth the little extra. Very nice. They are very nice and will serve your friends and family too.

So I had to stop by one of my favorite Mexican joints in the South Valley just to share this review, The Del Mar Deli. I have finally been to the New Mexican restaurant I have been wanting to eat in. I even remember taking a picture of it in my phone's phone that day. When I went there today I realized that my former memories wouldn't ever end. It's still what it used to be and you can still check out some of the old signs. It wasn't really one of the newer restaurants I came into as a kid, but it was still the feel that they have been serving over the So, when I come into this establishment, I don't even think about it at all. I ordered the Big Plate with rice, pork, beans, and steak. It was good.I haven't had a burrito like this in a long time, but they did make a good one The food was cooked nice and had a great flavor. The place is clean and spacious and the staff are friendly. This location was also open at all hours for the full dining experience.

"Love the people and service!" I just had my iMac in and off their computer shop again. They were scheduled for a port replacement of my older computer on March 16th and they did not do their job until the next day to get my computer back So I called them to request that they come out the next day to come help me with just that and have them install a new one. I'm very happy that I did it and that it really didn't cost a fortune. They are excellent in their work here and are only a short drive from my house. I am very happy with the customer service and tech support service from Wisp. I had never had a power issue on my laptop before so I had a lot on my mind. Here is a great place for repairs/repairs. Be sure to check them out!
I was just looking for a local hangout for gin & tonics in Lameo, Louisiana. They recently opened two new taprooms, as well as recently renovated the old shop on the other end of town!

You know what I love about Barnes and Noble? Of course! (I mean, I don't get that from anyone who actually goes to a book store right?) Yes but that is quite seriously what it is all about. They are very picky about reading material, but I get to tell them what I really like/ love and how I spend my time and they are pretty forthcoming It's a big reason why I do like B&N, and how good they are at carrying books, that I just don't have anywhere The last time I visited, I was planning on buying the only other edition I could get, but there weren't any copies left. At the time of writing, we live in New York and my favorite magazine, Dumb and Dumber, was only on sale at other stores. A few weeks ago you wouldn't have found it without searching the internet - which I do a lot. I could say the same about my neighbors too. I am really happy that I found this place.

For what it's worth, I've spent most of my evening tucking myself and my wife/kids in here. I came with coworkers to work at an open work market on Tuesday night and went to B&B's Cafe across the street. So we went in, got a drink, and were late for the party. I've always thought it was a good place to go to for a drink before a show or awards show.  Anyway, the food was good, so we tried to get a few of our friends to join the party there. When we got to the bar we were first shown a draft beer, but we were informed that it was out of stock. The prices were a little bit too expensive for what I ordered. It certainly wasn't terrible but not at all. This is clearly some kind of "hard sell" at a location trying to get cash from tourists. It's not a restaurant or bar where the food is top shelf. I'm just getting a good deal because I'm here at a local establishment. Overall, it was a fair price (you can't beat the cranberry, it's super tangy and delicious and it doesn ), but for the price you can't beat anywhere else. Good place to go if you're after cheap drinks. I'd like to give this place a 3 star rating. I don't think it's a good idea to wait a few hours if you're there on a weeknight.

We were on the ferry this afternoon. We made that promise as it was too early in the day to spend a lot of time at the restaurant, but we got there anyway. When you go across the Mississippi River for a ferry it's like walking cross to cross between the US and Canada. It's a couple of feet longer than you might expect. I went on this ferry a couple of months ago and it was pretty cool. One of the problems I sometimes have is that people have little change in their pockets, if any at all. I like to plan ahead and get the ferry ticket, but the ferry is a bit pricey at $8. We won't go there again.

Today I took some time to visit the Vintage and Antiques store in Dallas, Texas. The staff is friendly and helpful, and there are lots of items that I was looking for. It has a great selection in different categories including furniture and decor, plus vintage items, some new and some items from the 1930s and 1940s. I really love the antique clock. It's just a big old plastic balloon attached to a metal pole that you spin around and the air pops out. Also, they have some pretty cool photographs of Presidents and leaders from around the world. A steamroller that you can bury in your backyard. The decor here is great, not too old school, but a little "new." They would love to have you in to see what's on their site!

Mojo is my go-to coffee spot in downtown. I had been wanting to go to Mojos in the surrounding areas, but the location was just miles away from where I'd come from. As I went over the weekend to a Mojo uptown, I saw a spot advertised on the menu. I love the food there, especially the breakfast options, and I thought the coffee was very good too. I bought a cup! I had to try a large hot chocolate, which was delicious – not too sweet but the flavor is absolutely amazing. I was so happy with the drink that I had to go back and ask them about any other options.

In the past few months, JAMNOLA has expanded their permanent art pop-up, transforming a warehouse into a unique, festive art space The funky, brightly colored spaces in the JAMNOLA space have been created by two internationally acclaimed artists and are open from August 3rd A room is a collection of 16 individual pieces of art by local artists. You'll notice a lighthouse, and even an alligator. The sand/pool covered with a lustre-like glow has a  glow, even when light turned off, but that's I was also drawn to the photo where an alligator plays with a bird snatching its cud! Then look as the blue sky fills the bayou with a haze of orange. You'll also be able to find more information about this museum by visiting the city's art pop-up website, jamnolas. From the moment you walk in, you can customize a page with your photos, personalinscriptions, and even contact the museum with questions. Be sure to tell JAMNOLA your name and the name of your cell phone, and we'll get you a customized site where you can browse Click one to learn something about the artist behind the works and/or the story behind the project. Or click a link on your site and see how you can customize your profile, get a link, etc. We got a new look at New Orleans and the city we call home. The whole experience was about an hour and a half so I'm sure that I'd like to do it more often. I received a free visit to JAMNOLA.

A pretty cool mall. One of my favorite things would have to be the "Stanleys", and I am so glad they have them! There are also good little restuaries and a little hotel downtown! In terms of parking, i am pretty iffy with parking in this area. You always seem to get sucked into the parking meters and/or be hit really hard. I have been riding around here since I've been 4 for all these parking garages and can't take my car down there. But that's just me... if it were a little bit narrower in there at the top you would just get stuck for way too long.

I can't say enough about the quality and service I have received from this company. I needed a couch reupholstered in a short amount of time and had no idea what I needed to do! The owner, Brian was very friendly and helpful at each step of the process. They arrived at my house on time and had everything finished in no time. They installed it very quickly and finished as soon as they received it. Also, they cleaned it up, put all the boxes in the new box, brought it to the job site as scheduled and then removed all of the old furniture Their customer service is amazing and they have so many other great reviews here that I absolutely love!

The staff was very friendly and helpful. He was very good. I've worked with his dental office three times, and they work hard to make you feel comfortable. I trust that I will have a pleasant experience every time I go.

It took me a long time to find Chez Pierre in my neighborhood. We took an afternoon in Madison while in town to check out The Cake Shop. I wasn't sure what to expect, but it was definitely more than I had bargained for. I'm not exactly a lover of pastries since I tend to find them quite cheesy and dry when I visit, but the flavors The strawberry Napoleon was delicious. This fruit cake is usually a large and good variety, but this time I wasn't disappointed! I like to snack on this everyday before bed. It tasted delicious but I think the crust gave my cake some kind of crunch on top of the cake, something the cake should not leave behind. I would definitely go back for the cake, which is delicious.

It's only been a month since I last ate at this place, but what a year! Their food is average, but, the store is not as exciting as when I first moved here. It's a scam. I've been there at my favorite location for years but I've come here for a few years where the food is just terrible. There was a special on cake for me this week on Wednesday. I got there around 430 and I had to wait until the last few customers. And there was only one left. I had a customer in and yelled "Sure" to the lady working to make sure the king cakes were fresh. The next day there was a large number of cakes missing. I was here on the Saturday following Thanksgiving to get some new salmon for my sister (who is visiting from Kansas City). I went early today to get one while it lasts, and I've made the same mistake all day. They didn't give the special enough time for me to get my steak- they ran out by noon. I asked the guy in the meat department if the rest of the meat was made fresh. WTF, Winn-Dixie! Their prices are also low- I usually get my food in a bag from this location- although I've only had some items out. I even tried making my own chicken and it tasted of microwaved salt. We also saw the same thing with a special order. In Florida, you can't just drive in from somewhere and look at the stuff and say, "What the fuck is going on here?"

Yes, La Boulangerie! It is a very authentic French bakery from the French Quarter and it's worth a trip for the beautiful view. It is a must for us aficionados who love cream and eggs. The employees were friendly and helpful. It was beautiful inside and outside the door. I just hope we can find a table in the back room to stay longer because I'm all for a slow lunch and quick coffee right now.

Here's a place that I have to say is very good, Gonzo's Barbecue Kitchen, at 57 W. 12th Jason's meat is incredibly tender (especially the brisket! )..and I have to say...I LOVED his brisket plate- both for the flavor and the meat! While it seems like most places charge an extra dollar for meat the way he charges for every pound of meat he cooks, Gonzo's After visiting the establishment, Jason sent me over to take a sample of the food. It had to be one of my favorite barbecue joints. At first glance, the brisket plate looked delicious. I quickly noticed the incredible meat that was left in the pan after the pork was cut in half. I can't wait to try the rest of the food. It tasted like they brought it all together into a single meal, and every bite of it in a bowl. The brisket mac was as amazing as we had hoped. It was thick enough to drown my teeth in before I could even talk. The corn grits were slightly soft enough, despite them being thick. I really only could taste the sauce on the mac and it was so rich and flavorful. Just as I was about to head home, Jason said he had a delivery for me. Looking at the menu and knowing what to order, I told myself I needed to make the trip more often, not more food in than I ate. I told Gabriela that I'd like to eat some more brisket, so she suggested I order two of each. But then this happened after I wrote a new blog post about the restaurant. Gonzo's received its very first Yelp nomination for best and friendliest BBQ place, and it was awarded in the Best Local Pub Guide. Best burger I've eaten!

They say if it was not for those talented performers, you would never see the Dirty Dime. There is a definite burlesque event to be expected at the Dirty Dime bar for the last few months. The dance and the act is top notch, and there's no shortage of performers. Each show features burlesque artist of the past with a different style, as well as a variety of comedic acts. The Dirty Dime is a must visit!

I am usually a fan of fresh produce and so when I heard that the Mid City Market opened that day, I couldn’t pass it up. The market was pretty cool, especially because it is really pretty new. I got it fresh from them, all of the meats and produce are all organic and the prices are a little overpriced. Each farmer has a different specialty and a few people were offering to cook you a whole meal. I enjoyed coming here since you can eat just about anything there because there is a whole different world from what I was able to find at the market Enjoy one of the many little farmer's markets that Mid City has to offer!

This was our first experience with The Paris Cafe, because I'm really not a coffee fan, but I found it pretty awesome at first. They charge less, than the store nearest us, which I really like, it's a small but great store that I have seen in the past. I would probably go back at any time. It's like the original PJ's around the corner. It should be on my list of places to go when in the area.

I must admit, I've been to this store several times during the past ten years. It's my go-to store for any type of craft supplies. The flowers are actually really affordable for what they are. They had a few specials as well (I got two big earbuds for my son, so all was good) and they had an awesome There is no exception to this rule, so don't even think about driving there for a bargain.

I was so pleasantly surprised when I walked in the door of Silk Road. If you have not been to Silk Road yet, you absolutely need to! I used to work and walk down to the Phoenix area every Tuesday night to have a drink at a local place called Silk Road. We were told that our dinner would be $66 per person, but it was SO worth it! We sat at the table with great conversation for approximately fifty minutes. I gave them a call and that's exactly what happened. I like a place so I browsed through the menu to see what I liked before I settled on something to try. I decided to try something new so I ordered the chocolate desert. It was a super light and creamy sauce that kept me from putting it down and actually looking at it. The next dish was some chicken and vegetable tikka mahjong. It was a nice start to our meal and I would definitely recommend it, if you are looking for an enjoyable meal. And as for entrees: I went for the fresh vegetable enchiladas for my main course- which were amazing! I also picked up some fresh cilantro and onion to go with them. I was absolutely impressed. The steak was extra tender and the chicken was so flavorful. The whole thing was so incredible, in fact, I actually wanted to break up the portions of both of my tacos and had a whole bowl of I definitely would have gotten three if I had known. We had sooo much food! I can't wait to go back to the restaurant and try the other dishes like the chicken enchiladas with a side of gua He also got us a bottle of organic wine of our choice in a small gift jar. I can't wait to go back and try something else. There was TONS of seating in the restaurant and the patio was incredible. The food is good and not too expensive. I'm so glad Silk Road exists. We loved Silk Road.

I don't know about you, but I grew up doing stuff with my Mom and sister who were buried in Metairie Cemetery. But I'll do a little recap when I'm done. Here are three of my favorite stories about this amazing cemetery. I recently decided to go to Metairie cemetery in early November. This is a very unique place that is still being looked after and toured. I found it to be very interesting and unique of its type and that's what draws me in as well. I would say that about half of the graves are very close together and there are also a few that are very small. A few of the people buried here are probably buried on the highest spot of the cemetery so that you actually look up from the ground without getting too close On my last trip to Metairie I was in a haze, so I found myself in awe of the detail in the tombs The people are nice and there is no alcohol in the cemetery so this is where I guess I've just become a little unkempt. The sculptures are very well crafted, especially the heads with the flower detail and if you are not at your favorite place, you can still really feel I've never seen a family buried here of someone not in their 60s or 70s (for some reason that's different), so sometimes It really is a fun place to visit.

We hit up El Coffee this past afternoon. I just moved here from Seattle and I was looking for a nice place to make my coffee. The shop is huge and had a lot of staff waiting behind it; it was extremely busy but it was still busy. There's actually a lot on display inside! They have good music on them and I love the coffee house atmosphere. The coffee is really good, I can't say enough good things. I can’t wait to go back.

I was excited to try out one of the new restaurants in the area in the heart of the city in Yakuza House. They're trying to make it more of an experience and not just a meal. Chef Kotei uses real fish and raw vegetables, and they are very fresh. This is a new kind of sushi, so it's pretty unique. You can order your own plates, or you can sit at the bar and the chef will bring out a salad and a set of hand rolls. The menu is quite large, so be prepared to wait a little bit. The staff was friendly, efficient and reassuring. Yakuza House has a really cool menu, including all sorts of combinations that aren't normally available at the bar. The prices are very reasonable (the best you'll find in the area) and the food is excellent, but the service is quite slow. I was invited to dine there by a friend of mine, and she nailed it right. Be sure to check this out!

I was referred to this place for the first time when I was having a hard time with my "food" selection. It's my 100th review and today I'd like to share with you that experience I had at Willie Mae's in Garden District In my opinion, I was just not much of a fan of Willy Maes until I went here on Tuesday. We'd heard of it from our friend Jeff who was just one week away in New Orleans, so we decided to make an appearance for the Fried chicken Fest I wasn't so sure, but I was so  impressed that I had to give it a shot. We walked in right off the street, heat and AC was on and the crowd was very friendly. The place was packed for service, but it was so enjoyable! We had a lot of chatter and questions, but our wait was short and we got right on with our orders. There was a small line for this place but that was quickly moved, which worked in our favor. Our waiter was very friendly and helpful, and I was pretty impressed. All five of us ordered chicken. Lettuce was thick and juicy, but the bottom was overly doughy, compared to the wings, which were perfectly moist. I would also suggest the chicken tenders, since I think the meat at this place will be tender. I was very disappointed. The sauce was really creamy and the chicken was tender and juicy. There were a few things that keep you from giving Willie Mae's a rating of a 2. In short, this is a great place to hang out and try out the menu. For any restaurant, it's important to know an audience. It's definitely not easy to keep a line when you don't have any customers to talk to. I guess we'll have to see if they can keep the crowd. It is definitely a "milestone" review! This is one of the best local restaurants. Willie Mae's was just as good the next day. Would definitely give this a four star rating. No doubt I will return. -Pleasure to return after such a long drive.

If you visit the city, you should definitely go to Jackson Square. It's a fusion of New Orleans and New Town combined. It is like having a street fair. When you really think of Jackson Square, a city that is known for its free museums and free art galleries and wonderful, laid back atmosphere, it's You get to enjoy some great food and a place to sit for some rest. The street vendors selling food and music and the famous artist who was one of the first New Orleans street musicians. So when it came to the choice, I had to say this, Jackson Square. The fact that it is free really means that there are tons of events going on all the time and that it is absolutely beautiful!

I usually hit up this bar to hear bands play, or at least to see who was playing. These are the best place on the west side of Louisiana. There's a seating area on the inside of the structure called the "Tourist Patio" of the bar (inside of the restaurant). I've never been to a patio or bar in Texas but I will say that I always enjoy hanging out here. I had a great time listening to John Peel playing live from the back patio on our recent visit. Not a bad spot to go for a comedy, but not a good location either. If you are looking for a good live music venue, I would stay away from the Bayou Beer Garden.

I went to this BBQ restaurant a lot in recent weeks, and this was the best one I've been to. I ordered the pork boudin covered in sausage and brisket. It started with a sausage and potato salad slaw combo. I ordered the spicy sausage boudin, so my bbq was medium heat, but it's not spicy. The sausage was nice and smoked, and the beans are tender and flavorful.
