My friend Janet, the owner of Peaches Records, and I recently attended an opening party at the mall. I have a soft spot for record stores. Now, that I think of it, I remember being old enough to drive to the West Side to check out the first of many (Woodworth It was a fairly small store and lots of the records in there were from other stores in town. At your favorite music store you could find you favorite artists like Cher, Lady Gaga, Johnny Cash, Beyoncé, Madonna, etc. I've been in the market for a record shop for the past year, and I finally found one, so I'm excited to go there and We visited on a Sunday, so I decided to head inside, at 7pm. Well... This place is like a big record store, and they definitely live up to it. At first look I was pretty impressed, mainly because the store I walked in to is right where the record stores in those days used to be located. I don't own a lot of music but this was definitely a great store to start with. The store is laid out like a vintage Woolworth's with a bit of a vintage feel. If you are looking for something specific, the front of the store is a really nice place to look (the place isn't very big). I got the opportunity to put it on my iPod and listened to the songs that I had on my iTunes. I found out that they have MANY original records, and they only have a little bit of everything- I've heard them all from around the I hear it's one of the better record stores in town, and it's even closer to my son, who still loves the place and it' Those who came to the opening were surprised to see that the shop had relocated so quickly this year. I like to see what you might be able to get.

In the past many years, I've been going to a new place every two months- it was only since January 2009 that I discovered that my new Whether it was a review of their new wine bar, or a discussion from friends, I feel that I'll be able to do that Because Marcello's recently opened in the Little Italy neighborhood, I was excited to try it out. Upon leaving my second birthday gift card, I was already looking forward to dining there- but still wanted to try something new. Visiting the restaurant, it's a bit of a drive and a bit nerve racking, but I'm happy that it made me I was very much looking forward to dining at this spot and I was so excited. It was the perfect evening to get out and experience this great place. Overlooking the food court is a large patio, which reflected the quaint vibe the place is. The staff is great, the food is amazing, and there are always great waitresses. The view is amazing, and the food is fantastic. I was really impressed by the selection of fresh bread, and the selection of the menu. It was packed.It wasn't long until we were the only ones there, when my dining companion mentioned that he had picked his wine from the There are over a thousand wines to choose from, but when you dive in, you are treated to some amazing wines. They had so many different wines, I even had no idea what was being offered! They look so good that you'd be lucky to see all the choices. All of the food here is wonderful. First, I ordered the seafood pasta dish, which was delicious. I ordered the lamb skewers with a lemon reduction sauce and it was amazing. The dish came with a fantastic olive oil crust that matched exactly to the flavor of the meat. Unfortunately, Liam didn't enjoy it as much as I did, so I only had a side of the Brussels sprouts and some mashed potatoes It was tender, smooth, and not overly soggy, which I liked. Next up was the Tritoni. Ultimately, I chose the Tritoni. I really did like this dish and it left my mouth watering. The lobster was perfectly incorporated into the shrimp and the texture was outstanding. The last item I ordered was the salad, which was another excellent choice. Not that I'm putting anything down about I, hats off to this place. In my opinion, this is a restaurant that I think you will have to try if you want to experience a real Italian cuisine- it's At the end of the night, we shared a very enjoyable cocktail party at the bar behind my table, and when our table was finally seated, it We made two dinner reservation and were seated right away, so we waited around for them to come and introduce us to the dinner selection. The server was fantastic and we both agreed that it was the best meal of the night. Basically the entire restaurant was fantastic and I'd order it in a heartbeat.

We started out with some old antiques that we had. We decided to check out our local consignment store and decided to give them a try. While we didn't get a good number of bids in, it was much better when we started dealing with Sheri. Having been in consignment, it's really just more time spent negotiating with the owners- she takes charge of all the transaction. I was very impressed with this establishment because it's a "consignment" store, which I like because I don't feel like you' The jewelry was great, the owner was great and she made many of my items look like new.

I'm not really a coffee person, but the coffee I find to be a tad expensive and the staff doesn't seem to There is a really good coffee shop at this location that is nice and a bit of a steal on a cute little outdoor bench! Most coffee shops have their ups and downs, but this place has them down. It's right off the bus line and was a simple iced coffee shop- I walked in and found that there aren't any In my opinion I would definitely go there for coffee and pastries, but it is so close that there is no way to not come in late when you are Of course, I couldn't really find it once I came in. There are two small issues that really annoy me. I am used to the type of coffee that I get and I like the service, but I was a little disappointed. Do you really think there should be some sort of ban on music like that? Even though I know how the squeaky machine works and how the equipment works, I can't really say that I enjoyed the music that much Two bad things on this coffee shop that I don't think I could handle: 1) They offered an Iced Caramel milk shake for $10 but it The atmosphere is really quaint but the coffee was absolutely freezing. There are no pastries and the breakfast sandwiches are very un-inspired. I don't think there is anyone who can make this place better. I would have preferred a more healthy cafeteria style environment, but I will say that it was a good coffee shop for the price.

It's been a while since I have given the Jake's Poboy a full review, but I figured I'd do it for I had dinner at Jake's one night and my coworker brought me a shrimp poboy. So when I found out that Jake's was opening, I was so excited! But in an article, I saw a lot of information there. I took my camera and went around the area, and wasn't able to figure out what it was called. There is not any way to tell for sure for someone that isn't familiar with the place, but the word, poboys, is always  It is a small stand that is a little bigger than a snowball stand. Oh no., but it is super close. Also, to the east I believe, is Poboy Junction, which is on this side of town. It has a very good selection on the menu, and is also great for lunch. There really isn't much else to say. I ordered a shrimp poboy, and I think the portions were generous. The main ingredients are the chopped shrimp and BBQ sauce, and on a side is fresh picked oysters on a hard board. I'm actually very excited about this place, because it's been on my list of places to try for quite some time. I had the Shrimp Poboy which I thought was DELICIOUS! The sauce was so salty I could feel the shrimp being steamed to a crisp as a rice paper. It took me a few minutes to eat mine, but it was incredibly flavorful! The manager took our order right away and we were given a great seat. The place was pretty packed, but I was able to take the outside parking lots away which was a plus to having the place accessible. They are VERY well organized and take cash and credit cards. If you are looking for a great fish place, this is the place. Yes, please, that's not a bad thing at all! Their menu is pretty gimmicky though.

I knew little about this place as long as I lived in Arizona before moving back to California. At first, I was super excited to try this Vietnamese fusion restaurant. While they did not have a large bar, there was nothing particularly exciting about the place. My two friends decided to check some of their items, and I had to try two of them since we were new at this place. So we ordered our spring rolls to go. I was a littlehesitant on ordering the shrimp since I'd always wanted fried shrimp- it seems like my taste buds didn't like the  I was really disappointed with the shrimp. This was very strange, but the texture of the shrimp still tasted fresh. We only ate half, so I could finish all the shrimp that I wanted. It was good though, though. However, we canceled because we decided we wanted a little more fish, since the dishes didn't really have much Thai or Vietnamese flavor. It also didn't taste like we were walking out of a bowl. So, one of them seems to be enough and one could definitely be a little richer and tastier. After all that good eating, a couple of friends wanted to try their pho as well, and we thought we'd see if it stood up There's a ton of options on the menu, but what we ended up with was the original. I decided to go with flank because I like it flavorier than cock. It came with beef pho, served with a mutton and rice noodle and seasoned with a hot sauce. It lacked a bit of a "taylor-made" style to it that just didn't stick. I'm not sure if this was done just to make the plate appear bigger, or if there just was a weird taste in it, but That didn't really irk me, but I wasn't really impressed with it. I definitely would order MoPho again. The staff was good, and the dishes were delicious. Go to their website or check them out for yourself.

Thai food has always been a dish that I've refused to try. Although I've been to the region in my hometown, I have never been in a Thai restaurant before, so I never really really felt like I needed But the last time I went there I thought it was really great! I didn't take out an order because I didn't know the food, but the hostess told me about Banana Blossom I went with my best friend. The owner is really nice and they do all veg, so I found that I would definitely return. After asking for a cup of cold tea, I ordered one of the freshest rolls I could find. I mean it was huge and was cooked perfect. The batter was a sweet and salty one that had a lot of spice to it. Then I tried the fried chicken with sauce (I think rice was on top) and I had to say I absolutely went for the Shrimp & The shrimp stayed in a nice pink sauce. And the egg roll, which was rice. The shrimp was amazing. The shrimp were very fresh, the batter was very thin and they were a bit fatty. The flavors on all of my dishes were very rich, but not overpowering and had a bit of heat on them. The main dish was the coconut shrimp salad which was so easy to make, and was super refreshing. Banana Blossom also served a glass of tropical drink. The restaurant was very cute and nice and I would definitely go back for more food.

I've never been much of a breakfast person, but if you're like me and don't go out late at night, the idea In that case City Diner is a great option. Our memory of eats in City Diner isn't exactly stellar. It was pretty quiet then as the ambiance was just a little drab. We also ordered the grits and bacon for a snack as we went down. When we got home, my parents asked for the French toast. Their breakfast isn't that big, but it is big enough. However, my friend had a craving for their fried chicken and we both agreed that that made for a filling dinner. A few bites, and I got to eat with my whole stomach full, and still felt full, despite being way full in my mind. If you're not in the area, you might try it if you can- they serve some real good breakfasts.

I am pretty happy to bring my kids here. There is a patio, but mostly you are inside. Plus, if you're looking for something interesting to eat, it only has a 20 minute walk to the French Quarter from here.

This restaurant in Henderson, Nevada has been around for years, and it's not exactly an established place. There was a special on that Friday night when my husband decided to meet and dine with me at Le Touquier. The waiter seemed super friendly and we found it to be a great place to meet for dinner. After I sat down to my drink, I was greeted by a bartender and my first thought was, "How am I going The atmosphere was really great and we both felt very welcome. After a few minutes a server came to our table (no one ever appeared before us), asked if we were still married or that we were I loved this meal. I had no complaints about the sauce, which felt very good, but at some points my mouth was watering and I wish that I had ordered a side The shrimp and grits were just as good, so you really can't beat them. They had the same sauce as the pork, but one of those was a bit too salty. The waitress was very helpful, although you might expect a little more. I know our waitress was busy doing some other work, but that's pretty much how we were treated. It was pretty obvious she didn't care about us- we were both starving and were not very happy with the meal that we ate so we asked For some reason I was kind of disappointed. I didn't really enjoy the atmosphere and felt like I could just wander around and let that all sink in. This place has an amazing decor and I'm still impressed by the fish in the lobster pots! I think this place is overrated, and the food is delicious, but they are way out of their league. Not a huge fan, just not one to go there.

The location at 2619 Greenwood Dr, between 71–71, was nice and we were able to take advantage of their outdoor patio. I've been here quite a few times for various reasons, but the beer is the best I've ever had. It's also a small parking lot like most other spot around. There was a cocktail made of fresh gin, rum and lime juice with ice, a dash of lime juice and dark rum I ordered the cheeseburger, which was super delicious. I was quite impressed with the decor of this place. It's a great place to go.

Rouse's has everything I need from cheese and beer to sushi. The cheese has always been a staple in my refrigerator, but Rouse's has one that's not even that good. This is not a gourmet store, which means that in order to fill it up, you gonna feel like you are eating something real. Now that's a cheese case! There are three cheeses a month with all kinds and sizes. Also, those chevron balls are pretty darn good! And I'm not just talking about the cheese case... there's a lot of it! If you do want to browse their beer selection, you might want to stop by their beer shop, which has a different location every week. They have so many different kinds of beers to choose from for every time of the day. The newest release is the new Runination. This one is the one with the voodoo goo that spits it out. It seems like there should be an article about it on the Rouse's Web site. I love an ale that has the right balance of dark hops and wheat. This shop also has some really great Sushi. They also have sandwiches, so you could get one for a special occasion or when you're in the mood for that extra special burger or panin

It's a little pricey at this mall, but it's well worth it. Why?????????? I want this place for my fast food truck! The ratings for this place have been outstanding for years. That's what I'm all about. They are not the very best restaurants in this world and they're not the ones you are sat down to for a hearty meal. They're definitely one of my favorite fast food places and I can only really recommend it to people like me. They do have a solid lineup of meats, and a lot of them are made from scratch. We've had our best meal at this location and I think it's only because of the potatoes. Whether you go for their regular grilled sandwiches, their grilled cheese sandwiches, or their cheeseburgers, or their burger dogs, either way it They have a variety of flavored fries, which is oddly enough, so I do get the curly option and they are definitely good. I'm a fan of the crispy french fries, but sometimes I like something even more crisp of the same variety. They also have a selection of sandwich options. I love me a little bit of everything! What's not to love? )...but I'll save my dessert for a future review. I also love the guacamole, because it doesn't make my sandwich look like it's being made in a pranked This is a great place to find your own "fix" for your fast food.

I found this place on Yelp after searching for some inspiration for dinner. I was so impressed with the food and service at Squid Ink Tavern. It's located in the heart of Mandalay Bay and is only a 20-minute walk down the street from my house. I had heard such cool things about this place and it was so nice to finally make it a reservation. So we headed to Dominica for dinner and I can't wait to go back and try more of their classic dishes. We got to try a little of everything to see how each dish was made. I ordered the seafood lemoncello soup. I have never seen that a molasses spread would be enjoyed on bread. The atmosphere was awesome with the bright lights and all the lights. The portion of the dish was very generous. My coworker ordered the crab tail medley/crab and I asked the waitress if it was a side of crab. They had a big portion of it but you might not feel like that. I couldn't help but notice how well it matched the crab meat with the pasta and the fish itself. I felt that the sauce had a delicious seasoning and the squid was just soft and delicious. My husband had the tuna dip and he felt so glad he went for it in all of its glory. Next, my boyfriend wanted the Lasagna. I know how busy and full the waitresses are, but he was able to try it and I am so glad I did. I really enjoyed it and plan on getting it again. I did not mind the amount of crust to be too tough (it was not too thick) and it was definitely the perfect side dish. They even came over mid way through the evening, so we could take a quick break to talk about it and we were both eating and enjoying every minute of If you are visiting the area and want to try their food, don't ever miss this place, it is definitely worth a try.

I came to Salvo's for the first time a few weeks ago. The seafood is so fresh and just mouth watering. This is one of the best restaurants in the area. It's a really small place. The kitchen area is a good size so you can really get to know the food. It is pretty good! Salvo's always has great shrimp po boys, so you never have to settle for any other. It's always fresh and with everything. You are given an assortment of cold dishes to choose from as well as a really good selection of breads to eat on the go. You won't want to miss out.

It's not quite as well known as the French Quarter, but it's one of the spots where you feel right at home in New Orleans. It's got a little bit of a street feel in the afternoons, but it's still fun, and if you're looking He mentioned it during dinner, I couldn't quite find this review, and he seems to have taken it personally as there are about 50 restaurants in the We weren't able to use the fountain at once, so we just stayed and enjoyed the water. We also stopped a couple times to sample "Crazy Lobsters". What's a little less surprising is that there are so many wonderful restaurants in and around the Plaza. It was very nice there, but there wasn't too much you would need to buy there for lunch. I just hope the Plaza re-opens soon. They had a parade in the Plaza and a firework display, but nothing else was outstanding.

I had no idea what it was like to work for a candy shop where I had to shop for candy in the afternoons or just get to work in I had a friend here who was looking for something different to bring to a party or a school event. You never know what you might find when you walk in the door! Despite the fact it's not traditional Salt Water Taffy, the shop was busy the rest of the day and they were kind enough to give us  It’s not just for kids...it’s also for adults.

I've never tried a king cake before. I was a little apprehensive after the first time I saw the whole thing because I knew no one liked them. So when I was drafted into the cruise planning of the trip, I needed something that I could eat that wasn't a king cake. Antoine's is a chain of American diner that you can go to every Friday until May 13 for your dinner. The king cake available for purchase was either plain or vanilla. So, I thought, what does a king cake look like? That simple fact turned into a surprise, but the cake is definitely worth it - both the cream and the sugar. With a hint of cream cheese and a layered dollop of sugar, it made these giant pieces super rich and not too sweet. But I wouldn't recommend this place to a friend on CNY, or someone with children, who isn't incredibly picky about serving It was delicious, but I'm afraid I won't be back.

Dirty Dishes is in my new favorite neighborhood. I love eating food from this place and Dirty Dishes has done me in with their chicken and hot wings. Dirty Dishes is the type of place where you expect everything to be good, yet don't expect anything to be too bad. It was great food, and a little sweet and salty as well. All my expectations were met when I tasted it and oh my how it was delicious! The sauce was perfectly mild, with just a little bit of the heat. I had the chicken teriyaki, shrimp, and steak salad. I would definitely recommend a visit to The Munch. I came here with a group of four, because they did not want to be a complete table of 2, so I ordered two separate dishes: Chicken Pan You will definitely want to stop by and try some of their dishes.

I don't know where to begin, when I come into the Bombay Club! It's a club! It's a club! I was told I could go to both of those in one evening since I was in a much larger house. It's a nice place for a quick meal, or for a night out with friends. I have tried the restaurant only once. You have to check this place out if you want to see a band or sit down with friends. It's a restaurant, but it's not a place to sit at a table, but there are tables that you can sit at and The bar inside can be a bit loud, but everything is great here. Is this restaurant cheap? If you don't mind the high prices, then it is not as expensive as most bars. But you still get a nice experience when dining here. I've never taken a cab to the place, the rides are pretty safe, and the hotel is clean. This is the place to go if you are in the mood to hear some great music. You can dress any way you would like, for a fancy dinner or just as an easy party. We were there with a friend on a Tuesday night, and that was just fine with me, because even though I didn't know what to dress With that said, though, this place feels a bit pricey in my opinion. My guess is, that the dressing room is made up of all kinds of "old school" clothing. The Bombay Club is always up and running, and they have some great parties of all ages. I wish The Bombay Club would offer a "dayclub" as well or at least another bar room to enjoy a drink, rather than

I haven't been here for a while, but I'm a fan of any Mediterranean restaurant. I never had but wanted to and was glad to. There just had to be a reason because it was on my way to the school to come home, and I thought I would try it out. Our drink order came out and after a few minutes of waiting, our waitress approached and took our order. We both agreed that this was perfect and I had the chocolate hummus. A fresh dip with lots of flavors. It's the kind of place you can't really go wrong when you eat at. We also ordered a shawarma. This was a giant portion of meat that I decided myself I wanted. I like to eat this in large portions, but I know it's going to make me very hungry. My friend did get in a little bit more, but did all of his stuff for his entree, too. I think I may have had too much because the amount of beef was a bit too thick to me. The hummus was good as well and was topped with fresh fruits on the side. They had some very interesting cocktails, including the smoked gin and bloody mary. We were served quickly and our food wasn't that busy. I was pleasantly surprised about the ambiance of the restaurant, but will not say much more than that.

I wanted to share with you a recent review of Jalisco. The new Jalisco Mexican Grill has opened! As the location on State Street grows, I do not know if Jalisco will change its name. Unfortunately, I haven't tried Jalisco yet. Jalisco is a newer place, but it's really good food and is on the same block! It was a really long drive since we were both too tired and hungry. I was pretty impressed by the location. The waitress was friendly and accomodating. I ordered the burrito plate and it came with beans, rice, tomatoes, guacamole, sour cream and red pepper I ordered the chicken strips. Most of the food was just a side order of beans, rice, beans and salsa juice. Also, I ate quite a bit, which I thought was very good for a lunch stop. YAY! Their menu is actually really extensive. So I ordered the chili con leche and guacamole, which are almost identical to the chili con leche on my table. I found about a 1/2 pound of green salsa here, but they serve the other half in a more expensive version. I ordered a chicken tamale, guacamole, Mexican cheese, guacamole and chips. The burrito was a little over-sized, but just enough for me to eat three for lunch and three for dinner. I enjoyed everything, especially this one with the hot sauce and cheese. Afterward, my friend bought me a bowl of cheese soup with a side of cream cheese. It was delicious. We both had lots of food and the waitress was very friendly and helpful. They have a cool patio area and I think it looks really nice. Don't miss it, you won't regret it. Looks good!.

I went to eat lunch at TJ's recently, and there were some really bad situations. The menu had an uninspired array of choices, and I was a bit interested in getting a chicken sandwich but decided that mac and cheese was a The sandwich was premade because it was from an egg and onion sandwich. I would have assumed the cheese on the ham and cheese was already there. I didn't even find the sandwich to be very good. I think I ate a little too many breadsticks. Unfortunately, the sides were not worth paying. We were both sober after eating at The Hotdog & Wings at the mall. He was much less impressed with my sandwich and mac and cheese.

I went to the new Thai restaurant, the Snug Thai - you've probably seen this a million times. And I was not disappointed. I went to Bangkok Cafe for lunch today, since it was a few weeks since I've been living in Westbank, so we aren't This restaurant is really cute and PERFECT for lunch and it looks like it belongs. The food was pretty good and even if it was busy that day, it was all very fast. But there are some things that I really want to try while there tho (at least one that I don't want anyone else to eat, I'm usually pretty picky on my food, but I didn't want to say that about this place because it wasn't really my thing. I ordered the rice bowl (and I love rice bowls) and I think I just did a perfect job of settling down with a bite of Both of our orders came out well done and very fresh. Our second, and final, dish was the pineapple shrimp noodle dish. The main ingredients of this dish is Pineapple and the fried rice. It was actually very good and had a really fresh, very tangy coating to it - I also had the green papaya green beans, I also got the sticky rice, which is served with lemongrass, lime, and basil. We also ordered a bowl of rice with meat dishes (I don't like rice salads, but I do like meat dishes), a bowl of At the end of our meal, it was nice to find some good Thai food in the West bank. I can't wait to try it on my next group lunch trip, because it's soooOO good. The wait staff greeted us with a friendly smile and we had a great lunch. I wish I had a better memory of this lunch.

"It looks like she's been on a plane to Thailand, but she has nothing to do with my son or my wife." A few months ago I went to Chin Loi's in Westbank, Texas, and haven't had a great dish there. I'm a fan of pho, so the idea of me having to make a reservation because lunch wasn't on its own at 8 AM After walking down an alleyway and entering a small restaurant, I greeted the staff with a smile and was quickly seated. There are many Asian servers and I was looking forward to this. However, I didn't put an item on my wish list because I remembered the place has a special one for you called the "Gun Club" and instead got this bowl. I ordered it over a guacamole, but as I took the order I noticed there was a bowl of mixed Vietnamese leaves. It was very filling and I couldn't stop eating it. This meat had a mushy texture that was off, though. The broth needed a little adjustment. I ended up paying $9.95 for three steamed egg rolls and rice with my bill. The pho at Cafe Sate definitely has potential, but not very creative, and the lunch special I ordered was a small version of the regular pho I'm not sure what I'm looking for with their lunch menu, but it certainly didn't seem to be a particularly bad meal. I will definitely not be going back due to the high prices.

I just found my new favorite local place. I mean, it's usually the cheapest option but if you're looking for good deals, and you want to support a good cause, I recently had the opportunity to go to a charity auction at M&S's of Oak Park and was so excited. They have women's clothes at half the price of the mall malls (I think). The main categories are "soup, shirts and jeans." I wasn't crazy about the section for women's clothing, but I am ok with that since it's for a good cause. I liked that they were getting a bit more casual with their teeny-tots section and I like that they're buying "used" The store has the best selection of clothes and is full of beautiful items. The men's department has mainly baby, men's, women's and youth clothing, but they have some small baby items. But, the only reason I didn't come back was that there are so many bad looking items on sale for only $10. I bought a small pair of jeans for $10 for free. I have to try new items out, so I know I'm going to make it at least once more and make a purchase. The trash bags are only available for three days a year and they're used mostly for clothes and there's also a smaller section for purses

I stayed at this hotel for three consecutive nights during my stay in NOLA. It's located in the north end of NOLA and I've tried to visit about two times a year but haven't found anything bad My room was extremely spacious and super quiet. It also happens to be one of the only hotels in the Garden district that has a free shuttle to downtown. My 1st experience was with air-conditioning, but sadly, the bathrooms were completely crowded, so it took a big room to get You cannot compare this hotel with the B&Bs I have had in the Garden Village area, the amenities are more friendly, spacious and the staff more helpful

I love Barbeque. From a young age, every time I made it to a barbeque joints I would have had a sassy lunch. In fact, at some point, I was living downstate for the first time and in every few years I have become involved with BBQs like I did in In the short term I enjoy having it, but in the long run I don't love it. La 23 Barbeque is my latest discovery. It's not just one of my favorite places, but with absolutely no reviews. The place is located right across the street from the zoo, with tons of parking and it is affordable. It's where I live now. La 23 is just a few blocks from my house. La 23 is a mobile business and it really is super quick. In the back you might be asking yourself if there's really a lot to choose from when it comes to lunch. The lunch special is a combo, which means the meat is two or three as long as it's a large piece. It was great.Meanwhile, I had no idea that the food was so good. I really enjoyed everything on my plate and I won't eat out here often, so the money was more than worth the effort. Braised brisket- good! It was a bit on the salty side but it didn't make it bad, just different. It's my favorite kind of meat when it comes to barbeque. Jalapeo sausage- a little burnt, but very good. Big O's is the biggest pop store in Edinburgh and with great food and drinks, the experience isn't all fun and games. Don't forget to pop in an ice cream pop or go for a cream pop before going back to work. Pops are $5-$11 when bought on the door, but you get one for free with the purchase of a dozen or more. And if you want to go on the whirlwind of sweet treats you can also order in the popsicle bar. I definitely recommend both of these pops. I couldn't believe how amazing the food tasted... especially considering the lack of alcohol. The service was friendly and the food was good too.

I have been coming here, this month, to look at their latest collection which I am pretty excited to find at this time of year. There's a cute zoo on campus that you can visit on Sundays. They also have a good selection of sweaters, t-shirts, jeans, dresses, sweater tops, pants, and more. For this review I was able to spend about $100 at The Shops of Chicago. They have a nice selection of shorts that are comfortable and look great. They also have a great selection of accessories and for a special deal you can get them in a color of your choice.

I was overjoyed to be introduced to a new local, one-of-a-kind pie shop this week in Freret. During my time here on the blog, I am usually asked to eat pie. And now, you can actually get a good, real, homemade pie at a proper shop! This past weekend, the Pie Shop opened to traffic and I found myself excited to find out that the pie is real! They've been closed for the last few months but I was excited to hear that they have started to open their new store at 2450 N. First Street Windowsill Pies has been operating in their original small studio/shop on the corner of 66th Street and 3rd Avenue in Freret. And with this new location, it makes me feel so much warmer. The choices aren't limited to any particular pie- but that didn't prevent my indulgence. But besides those, they serve a couple of other pies I was curious to see- the peppercorn pie and the chocolate raspberry pie. These pies were a perfect balance of sweet and savory, and I was so happy to see that the kitchen was stocked with lots of deliciously These pies are mouthwatering. These two ladies are super talented and will make anything you ask them about. The savory pies are just a touch less salty than many of the pies that I tried recently. The shop is so cute and there's a really cool wall where you can watch what we're eating in the front window. They even have a couple of items made with chicken. And I think it makes for a perfect spot to take a bite. I'll be heading back there for a bite over the holidays for sure! What a treat!

It may be some years ago but the Cleopatra Krewe is still Westbank. Westbank High School's annual Halloween parade starts right at the Westbank High School & High School Memorial. But what a great parade, and one that has been bringing people to Westbank. The parade starts at 11am and makes it into 2nd Street for about 1 mile. There is usually a parade from 9-6pm and there are 2 floats that you can check out that day. There are keepers for each person as well as beads and pictures and some snacks. There were some great people on the streets of Westbank taking part.

We went here a few days ago on a Friday night, after getting our credit card machine fix. The guitarist is an excellent bass player, and the musician of the band plays his instrument well. I don't know for sure how many drinks the people were drinking, but I really didn't know. I don't have the cash because I didn't make reservations, but I did make one reservation in the morning, and while we were here our bank Our card was not linked to his bank so he'd have to phone they bank. I'm guessing that was a fraud and the ATM is being refunded but the management didn't seem to care either. Besides the ATM, the cashier should have been able to give me some other cash, but he was so nice. Just walked out and I'm not sure the other customers left, but if I come back I'm not sure it's because they don It would have made for a very bad experience. I've never experienced the money being stolen from or being taken from another person. Maybe it was an off night. So I wouldn't go back there. I don't know.

Delachaise is my #1 French Bistro in Charlotte. I had to try it once because it's in a very small area and it's not in the middle of anything, but that just allows for The food has always been great - I love the bread that is baked in the oven so well. The menu features some really unique and delicious recipes. The cheese plate is one you don't want to feel like a pig tagging around when you're finishing the meal. You can also pick from all of the other great cheeses on the menu, including the artisanal cheeses of California, New York and Italy. Delachaise has a beautiful space, but also can get crowded on busy nights. I especially love the cheese on the cheese plate, I love the slap on the cheese for a really intense flavor. I usually sit at the bar where there is a nice open menu that is perfect for the warm weather. You are pretty much guaranteed to get a nice seat at Delachaise.

This is a fairly new place in the north, but so far I have really liked it. The food is awesome. I love their pizza and salad selection. They also have some fresh organic produce, and even some organic produce (not too many organic things) at this market. At dinner, the fish tacos and some fish roll are awesome too. These are fresh sushi rolls that are made in-house with various kinds of fishes and shellfish. Their rolls are made with nothing but fish or meat. There are no fish pieces on them. I will admit, I did take two of my girlfriends here for lunch.

They said one of their stores would be getting a new spot for a new burger, so I was super excited when I heard that the Westbank I recently decided to give Westbank Grill a try. This is my first experience there so I'm not sure what I was expecting. It would have just been me and my co-workers who came from the West Bank Grill. After looking at some of the offerings online, I figured they'd be pretty good. I'm planning to try many different things there someday. It's hard for me to find a good sandwich for $7 because I have a TON of options. Their oyster poboy is amazing. And they even gave me the smallest portion of poboy ever. So, I could not have been happier. I will be back if I'm in the area. Just imagine how nice the manager would be if I came back out and opted for one of their specialty sauces for the poboy- a lovely Regardless of the fact that, I think it was the warmness of the ac that really made it amazing. So, I will definitely be back soon!

At the end of October, we came to Antoine's Restaurant in New Orleans for dinner where I wanted to try even more of its unique menu. They had a deal running on their website for a lunch special with a bottle of wine per person! Katie had a groupon for this restaurant and I couldn't resist. Unfortunately, because we were not in a rush, we didn't have enough time to order. I decided to give the oysters a try. I LOVE Charbroiled oysters!! The food was really good and I ended our meal with a salad. I then had the fried chicken & macaroni and cheese. This was a little bit unexpected because I often find myself ordering a chicken burger that I actually call fried chicken burgers. Yes, indeed! :) It was delicious. I was absolutely blown away. It was the perfect combo! In addition to the chicken, we each ordered the mac and cheese (which was actually half a bag). The buttery sauce wasn't too sweet too and brought out the flavors perfectly. My dessert was thebread pudding. I thought I was going to say the same thing I have had so many times before...but this wasn't. I usually have my favorite bread pudding from the grocery store. This wasn't. There was no crust or thickening and the rich pudding was soft and creamy and you could always taste the pecans in it! Katie and I were incredibly impressed with our server, our waiter David. After our lunch, Paul led us to the restaurant and showed us the rooms. He walked us around and gave us a tour of the famous bar, Antoine's- a restaurant that has been known for over a You would think, like a big restaurant, it was surrounded by huge white marble floors, beautiful wood decor, and a grand hall. But more importantly, Paul was such a nice host and he made the most enjoyable. After the waiter brought us the food and opened the door, we were all rushing back to the room where we were seated. I felt so honored to work for this beautiful restaurant and I'm so glad I did.

I went this past Saturday between 9am to 3pm after work because we planned to take a few days off from work and just relax here at the park It's a pretty small park, but it's pretty old fashioned also. This is an area of lots of woods and it is a very populated place.  anyway, there's a lot to do in the park, including fishing and hiking trails, an outdoor observatory, and a walking trail, There is also a large observation deck, which is located at the top of the hill, which might be worth looking at in the evening as opposed to the It could definitely be better with better drainage though.

Since my husband is in a nursing home, we have had to make all the time and money that it takes to get to hospital. Well, as much as it felt kind of cold, it wasn't because we were trying to warm our house, but because it got in the way. With it being in the city...it was the perfect place. Our family finally had a bit of relief from the storm. We have to stay indoors for a couple weeks before stepping outside in the weather. Well, we were here to eat lunch and come back feeling like we've survived the worst. The inside of this restaurant is very hipster, but not to the point we don't find it to be. This place is beautiful just with all the white colors, and the mural painted on the wall is done in that really cool style. I mean, what a surprise! The murals and colors used in the decor are amazing and they help the restaurant stand out from the rest of the neighborhood. That's why the food is so amazing. With my burrito, I ordered chicken, pork, and pico de gallo. We also had a margarita and a green tea soda. I loved the food, and to make it even better, it was so much better for us. The burritos were amazing, but the pulled pork would have been even better. My guacamole was perfect, not overly salty like some other restaurants I've tried. We were left full and satisfied. Our bill came out fast and they did not add an additional $20 to the tab because of our bad credit. The patio was filled with people enjoying themselves and it is also home of a garden area. My hubby is a history buff and the fact that they have a hooded cow does add to the cuteness. If you ever find yourself in the area and are in need of some good Mexican food, definitely check it out.

Mr Tequila was a great place to go last week, after many years of visiting the neighborhood — but today it is even better. At this restaurant, their tacos are filling and fresh; there are lots of interesting burritos and dishes on the menu. There are also specialty drinks, and you can purchase their own craft beer on draft. I added on a side of bacon before finishing the burrito. If you are looking for an authentic Mexican Mexican restaurant with outstanding service and delicious food, then this is the place. Mr. Tequila has been serving authentic Mexican flavors to Fort Collins and nearby since 1992. In case you did not catch the review, there is a great article about it from the Uptown Messenger. Thanks! :) I can’t wait to go back at some point.

After a month and a half of walking around downtown West Houston and trying to figure out where all the cute Chinese food restaurants were, I finally decided to I recently came to this place with a group of friends and I was looking for a cheap lunch. I called the restaurant today and said I needed to have lunch right away. You walk through to the parking lot where there's a woman who helped me call and let me know that the place is open in the evening. Oh wait, I wasn't sure that was true, but I was. I had to tell her about my lunch and my expectations. They have a great patio, and the food is delivered from a bag. I was a little skeptical, because it is so inexpensive. What does this dish have that nothing else does? Yes!It was so delicious. Let me tell you, these dishes are great! I ordered the chicken starter and the egg drop soup. The soup came out immediately, so I got a bowl of that as well. After a sip, I was ready for the dish to come out. If you haven't had it, you should. I saw the chicken and what looked like two plates. My eyeballs swelled when I saw the plate. What a king chicken, not just like some lunch special chicken but one of the best chickens I've ever had. I don't know if I would have wanted it to be any smaller, but she said, "It's too bad it's not It was not dry and it was nice. You can't pick up this menu at Costco, but I do trust them. I added some shrimp fried rice and the food on this plate was just as good in a bag as the chicken. All together my meal was just a total of $6.49. If you are looking for Chinese food in the area or on the go, stop by the China Gate! The bill came out at $17. In the morning, I ordered my chicken salad served with a donut but instead of a donut, they served it with coffee, a piece I can't believe anything I pay this much for food- but then again, I'm a cheap person. I can't tell you how much I enjoyed my lunch. If you love delicious Chinese, then you may want to check out the China Gate location.

I just discovered the new Beamish Ale Bar. I was thrilled to see the bar resurrect their famous menu with some new, creative creations from local artists. But I got there first. A lot of smoke, a few tables, some drinks, and cigarette smoke. I don't mind smoking, but I just would not want to stay in a beer bar in my backyard all day. On a recent trip, I went to The Old Broom Shop in Louisiana City & decided to go for a smoke stout. I'm not toying with a second one. The bar also does not have beer, in fact for the first four drafts on tap (which is only a half a beer, unless you They do have a large selection ofbottled craft beers, so we can take what we can get at work and tuck away on the patio to I don't really have much interest in craft brews and I'm not in a huge rush to try them. I just don't get it. For some reason I never liked getting a bottle every time I try something there. I would say that Avenue is a pretty good bar. I always try to keep up with the latest in local beer news, and I can't get enough of it.

This is one of the few stores in the downtown area that you won't only find some great jewelry but also some great handmade things! Usually you wont find any shabby chic fashion stores in Westerville, but this one is. There are many choices at this place, and you can see what the owner has bought. There are a lot of unique items that will not be available anywhere else. There are several prices on each piece at the store and you can always check the website to know what's in the store on a regular basis. There was a lot of nice jewelry in the store and a whole variety of items.

I gave This place three stars. I was a bit sour about this review, but I must have been in a bad mood, because this wasn't my first experience there We were so full we had to sit in the bar which was so small! We ordered our food and told the waiter we wanted iced tea and we had asked if we could have a glass of water. I sat down and started with guacamole which was very good! You can see the chips were kind of hard and I really liked the guacamole. We also ordered the chips. When the waiter came over again, he was standing around, taking orders. I asked him what came next- he said that he would take the menu and he would be right back. When I asked the waiter for his name he gave me no answer. At one point a second group of people walk by and sit and try to get by. Even then, he wasn't on to where he should be, so I asked if he were going to stop him from going back inside At this point he just wanted to leave and didn't want to help us out. With all of those ingredients, I still didn't get my burrito. We were waiting outside while the waiter had his drink and then was sitting on the patio reading (we were sitting in the shade because we were really out of The food was great, but our wait was way too long. It took a little over an hour for my lunch to be ready. I have to admit, the lunch I was able to get at Felipe's last time wasn't quite the same, but I did have time Even when my friend was standing next to us, there was no acknowledgement or greeting from the waiter. This place may be better for some people, but not for everyone. This place is very dirty, so I will not return. I had to get up early the after-hours to get home, and it was definitely cold and they are a little "oh so cozy", And the only reason it took so long to get our food is because we ate outside which is usually a good sign.

I will say that Del Fuego was my first stop and I have only been there once. And it was worth the drive each time. At first visit, my partner and I arrived around 8:30 on a Saturday morning. We had dinner before and it was an hour before the regular restaurant hours. It was so nice to be seated outside because it was the perfect temperature and very relaxed. I immediately got excited because I sat in those booths for a few moments because we always start talking about the food and I got really excited when on their own..! So that didn't really help me, but I did say that I was not really enjoying the place and thought that I would just have to go inside soon So with that out of the way, we started with the margarita I did not know how to order - just go to the bar and order We decided to get a combo plate because each of us had something. It took about a minute to get me started on my guacamole and I immediately ate it. It came out fresh so I ate that right away. We ordered the TXT with a side of cheese and a big burrito with a gyro meat, picu It was very filling and very filling. This place really has great food, I won't be going anywhere else right now. On our second visit, we decided on a fish salad to share. For my appetizer, we had a tacos queso (chicken), a plate of guacamole (chicken) This was served with white rice and a little bit of tarragon. I definitely found myself eating the fish as it was not my favorite and I ended up not ordering any desserts. If you are going back just to drink tequila, the Tequila's were fresh and it was one of the best beers and I'm not really sure what Del Fuego is, but it's one of my favorite places in the West Valley for a good te We really enjoyed the food at this place. It was like ordering a hot meal that came with me.

TL - Tacous Locas is a great new Italian restaurant in downtown Las Vegas. Their prices are much better than the average local bar/club and they have a patio where you can sit outside. They also give free desserts. It's a nice change of pace.

We were in New Orleans for a while and had a great time. Our first time at LC's the first time it was actually close to us, so we were trying to see what was around. This is what we found, it's a nice place to check out. What I like about this place is it's large space, like a huge sack lunch/kitchen area. I'm not quite sure what the place will be like when it has a nightly ice cream show. The food is good, so far so good that we didn't get sick off of it.

I went on a lunch trip to the restaurant I had heard about that was very supposedly at the Mirage Resort. For anyone who has ever been.. not, uh... or just a tourist, take note! My father and I were planning on going here on our lunch date and wanted to go in the evening. I was really excited to go again because I've been lusting after some of their past lunch specials. We ordered dinner and shared a trio, four courses for around $15. We ordered the taters for 2. The pickles were fresh and made nicely, with lots of flavor! They were a bit dry and the oil was great, but they were still really good! Very fresh and the ketchup was pretty good. I was only interested in the sauce, so I guess I should have put in the whole chicken. It seems like you have a better option on your menu and I think that's the case. They didn't eat enough of the grits- my dad likes grits, but I have always liked it with fish. I'm not sure if it was the marinade that was so strong or the fish- I just didn't really care, but I didn' I felt very disappointed that the restaurant wasn't offering a good breakfast. It was a pretty filling dessert and I wanted to find out what else was on the menu. I mean, seriously. There were also some other dishes we were having and it made me hungry and I was hungry for cake. Well, maybe the next time you have lunch you should ask to speak to someone to be told that you can't eat here or you might get an I will still try it out next time. What a disappointment.

I figured I'd drop in to the Westbank ice cream stand to see what it's like there for the summer. They had both "green" and "snowball" flavors. In My opinion, I have to admit that their ice cream is a little different than Westbank...it taste like the classic "Hot Cocoa There was no color changing in my sample, but it was still pretty good. I would definitely go back. I like the fact that they have a large variety of cones. Not a fan of getting soggy cones, so I ended up having to go back once the ice cream had thawed. They are very friendly and they have a very good happy hour menu. If you are lucky enough to have snowballs in your life, I would definitely recommend checking this place out.

This home is in a wonderful location. The owner is very happy to take care of guests and is very personable. The owner is a very fun guy but I wish I had a better photographer. It was like seeing my Grandma and Grandpa for the first time. The room I was in had amazing lighting as well as a very romantic mood. The owners were very welcoming and friendly. The breakfast was very good and the owners were so friendly. I would definitely recommend staying at this hotel.

On Wednesday, I was lucky enough to visit El Paso in Westbank and catch their lunch special- a burrito and a side salad It's definitely a great place to go and it seems that they are busy almost every day, so it was a great location as I was  The waiters were really friendly and the bartenders were super helpful. As I was walking through the restaurant I saw several people ordering and going up, down and down, and it made me feel better about what I'd have The menu was really wide, but there was a ton to choose from in a variety of dishes which is nice to see a restaurant open during Topping my plate were chips, salsa and dip. The food came out very quickly and we ordered and placed our order right away. We ordered a burrito and chips and chips and salsa- no wait. There was plenty of food to fill my plate, not just my filling burrito, but a couple of other items as well. I would order it again, but they'd do it differently from what I've had in the past years. I've always had great service here and didn't have any issues. They don't like the crowds outside, but you have to be patient, as the restaurant is packed. It will be hard to recommend El Paso because of the location and the fact that we're in Marrero so we're always around town For the second time in a row I'm loving and having such a fun burrito experience!

It was one of the best meals I've had on the west side and I can't seem to describe it in words enough. My companion and I have been raving about it for as long as I can remember. I ended up going to Primitivo for a wonderful dinner last night and was thoroughly impressed. I got a rumor that there was a "Marie Louise". It was called the "Sipy Cider" (literally,'sipy', not'sipy' I liked this cocktail very much, and the drinks are really good as well. When we finished our drinks, we ordered our entrees. A few orders later, my companion and I were seated, and the staff immediately got me a couple of starters. This was a large portion of braised pork cheeks with a side of dumplings, with a side of tangy sauce and black Those were the only things I chose to do at this restaurant in the hopes of becoming an excellent cook. It was perfectly simple, but just so perfect. I had the side of an open shell pasta dish. While the food wasn't spectacular, it was very good. It was really good. I wish I had chosen to order the whole thing during my meal, as this would have served me better. That is something you will always ask for, but it was nothing major so it was all fine.

I tried this little chain-bar in New Orleans a few days ago because I'm supposedly the next Janet Jackson. I had the opportunity to make my own as a joke when we visited the La Maquina bar on Thursday night. I was there for the first time the other day (I think) and wanted to give it one last shot. It was the bartender who got lost! It's not a good idea to use the word "no" to describe this place. Despite having the best bar in Manhattan (the restaurant) with a fantastic menu, this place is so terrible. The bar?tm was so loud, my girlfriend and I sat near it. Don't get me wrong, we were more than happy for the drinks - they were good. Didn't he know that being in the middle of a crowd was a problem? You can actually see him with the little microphone he had on one of his hands, so I suspect the manager was the one who brought us up. If they really want music, they need to learn how to get it quieter. The bar was also very loud for people who don't mind partying with their friends. They really shouldn't care about customer service, but they are too busy with people watching and kicking 'em. Not good either.I'm so pissed. Yep, I think a line of people at this chain faire gets up in the night when a woman isn't looking for a drink It seems logical that there's a woman to blame for what happened. A bar is better than Margaritaville.

This is the spot for a few frothed cocktails or for a nightcap. Although the furniture looks old, it is well maintained. You can order by the glass, but they were quick to get us glasses. I decided to choose the "Miss Capri" or "Mexican Cup". On each glass of wine, I felt that what I ordered was a decent, fine wine, not overly sugary. I also tried the blue cheesecake...so much more filling!

I am always on the look out for good places to go because I'm always in need of a good meal. I've never had the opportunity until now, when I was in Old Town Atlanta and decided to check it out. There's a bit of noise coming from the inside and out, which isn't a bad thing. I am a little bit guilty of going to some of the big fancy restaurants and not going to a restaurant as small as Atchafalaya because I The seats are cozy and we were able to get in right away. The menu had about an hour of food and my friend had so many apps that he knew exactly what he was getting. My girlfriends ordered the Filet of Ribeye and I ordered the Steak & Egg Omelet. My friend suggested that I get the "sushi tomate" app. The app comes with a large eggs, so it was a little more weird than your average tartar app. The egg was very salty and I guess I should have known it wasn't quail. This app was quite the departure from my usual, but it had a great flavor. The beef was delicious, but dripping with salt...methinks I will be giving it a second chance in a few months. What a way to eat the quail eggs. Maybe it wasn't for me, but I had to give it another try based on the amount of egg that was on top. But the flavor wasn't that great. We then ordered some fried soft shell crab. That's right, I am not a big fan of crab apps. I didn't love the chicken, but I liked the sauce that came along with the crab. It was also nice and fresh. It was seasoned really well and it was delicious. I went back and ordered the shrimp paella. It was fantastic!- it had just the right amount of sauce. I also got the shrimp with some corn chips on top. I think I would have loved more cheese and/or bacon. The shrimp itself was a little tender when cut off and the sauce left a little bit to be desired. I was super happy with this item and would definitely eat it again! I have also tried andouille in their food. Although, I could have got more of the beef, I think I would have liked the shrimp/grits a bit more. It had a subtle buttery flavor and was a great meal. I am really looking forward to the week of December 7 to find out what they will serve next.

The only other shop you want to stop by if you are staying at the Grand stayed in the West Side, and while it definitely was not one of This is a shop that has a family feel for most of the shirts and it was great to visit on a rainy day. They also have a little department store that you can check out to buy the shirts. The people behind this company are very cute and their selection of shirts is great. The store itself is small and has a friendly atmosphere.

I was really impressed with the store. It has a fairly efficient, clean and friendly little store with a pretty large inventory of gear and accessories. However, they didn't have a storefront or shop so I went for a second look to ask what size basketballs are available. That's when I was looking for a new shirt for my son and he's going to get that new item later. I'm not really sure if this is just a local thing, or if they're going to change their style around. It's a little expensive for what you can get, but I would still consider this shop to be pretty good.

Mona's is a Middle Eastern type of restaurant and it has been featured in numerous publications and food reviews. The restaurant was pretty pretty and I always love to check it out. We started off with hummus and kibby which came out in a little box just like a regular bowl filled with hummus and The kibby was very nice and had a little crunch, but I could totally see it surviving just fine. It was very easy to enjoy and I definitely recommend trying it. We had sandwiches and a salad so we decided to get the steamed beef schwarma. It was incredibly flavorful and had every last bit of beef, chicken and mixed veggies you could dream of. I did not eat much of the meat since it was so thick and tender, but it was still really good. Just for the record, there's nothing I really dislike about this meal. As most would have expected, I also ordered some chicken thigh and some rice and a couple of soft tacos. I think Mona's is one of my favorite places and I will definitely be trying out some of their dishes on my regular dining rotation.

I had the opportunity to dine at the N.O.C&B location at 7175 East Batten Street, in Metairie. This place got my attention because I am always at a stop that has the same kind of coffee and the name I remember having is "Nocco" I had heard good stuff about this specific location, so I gave it a try. That was the only problem. I gave it 4 out of 5 stars. All in all, it's still been one of my favorite places to get a coffee. I know that you wouldn't be able to get more coffee for this price, but considering the location of this place, I feel like I would just

Nicely laid out bar. This place is fun to go to just to check out where our friends were going. No stress.. a good place to get berries without the wait of delivering. It's a real pub and not much of a "bar" in general.

I went to Pizza Delicious this afternoon on Friday night. It was in the middle of a busy intersection, so we headed there just before 8pm. We had a small group of six, so they had to get there at 6pm. So I decided to order a couple of items. My pizza was a medium, and the salad was a Caesar salad (that, my friends, means "non-veg." I tried this at the drive in the movies last night and I cannot remember the place. I also think most restaurants are doing something better with food). What do you guys think of Uber? My friend ordered an Uber and I thought it was going to be as bad as his Uber Max. It's been around for a while, and I've been having fun using it already. One thing I have to say is if you want to avoid people in line and take less time than it would take with the taxis in town that would I think I'll definitely be using Uber for all of my vehicles again!

This past Friday I was in a area where I was going to meet friends for a week and so I decided to get off of the bus and  I was not too impressed with any of the restaurants listed, but fortunately for me, I was able to find some great stuff at a great price  Finally, I found out that I did not have to do much research, I found two restaurants I wanted to try out and the two on the list turned The restaurant is in East Houston, and if you need to get in the mood for dinner there is a separate restaurant on South Street- The Village. i ate at Kin this past weekend. It is my first post so, all you know is that I was so, so, good. I landed at Kin by chance on a group order at work and went there for lunch today. And it was so delicious! Kin is small and not huge. There aren't many places in this town that specialize in ramen. Those are just a couple of my favorites. So when the owner of Kin wanted me to try his ramen, I decided to give it a try. But, that said, the food here was absolutely delicious. We ordered the brisket ramen for lunch. Then we ordered the sweet potato rings. If you want something off the beaten track and with a little effort, a bowl of soup and a squeaked bowl of dumpling We then went on to the meat board. We came up with the idea to get the big bowl and decide on a bowl of shiso soup to share after. The entire bowl was served hot and luscious with a little rice on the side. I didn't even know what I was ordering. It was my favorite and I'm not sure that others would agree but I definitely felt that one bowl was enough. We ordered 4 bowls of this ramen and everyone wanted more. We also shared some kind of bowl of tempura, which made our lunch so much better. After spending the day in Kin, we are definitely looking forward to going back some time for lunch. It was so good that we had to call it a day and did not want to leave the place! So, if you're looking for Asian food in a cute space, I think Kin is the place to go.

At one point in my life, I decided I had to try a local Italian restaurant and stopped by. Well, The House of Meat, it's a great place to get your fix. They have really unique things to offer, but most of the things they have are really yummy! They have a great menu as well. For a restaurant in Brooklyn to deliver to my front door, I don't expect the quality from other restaurant chains. I won the "most enjoyable" food award at the event.

On our 5th visit I was very excited to try their new coffee shop at the new location at 1740 SE Elk. It's all mugs at this place. I don't think I would have gone back. The place and atmosphere was small. It's over half the size of Sam's and the decor just doesn't make much sense. It looks in a way like a small bar, and if you want to go in, you will only have to wait 10 minutes for the cash The people were nice, but not so big of a presence as other places on the street. Ole Saint is a very unique bar and restaurant focusing largely on craft beers but also serving food. The original Walk Ons moved to a higher level and since Ole Saint is in a higher section of town, it is really a new level The front patio just looks so big compared to anything else in the area and I think you'll want to sit at any of the tables in the back We got to sample the craft beer on my second visit, and I had to ask their bartender why they chose that because we were not sure what it For the cost it was a nice place to check out, the beer selection was great and not too loud (though it wasn't quiet at all). The beer is cold from the cooler outside and it felt like a better way to enjoy the game. Also, I wanted to see the food section since it look like a decent sized restaurant. We enjoyed both the beer and the food, and I was pretty impressed that they all tasted great. The food was good, but with so many new places downtown right now, I guess it still isn't too bad for a nice place to have

I ate at The Grill today and it was so good! And if you're looking for a bit of inspiration in a place thatspecializes in sushi, Chiba is the place. At Chiba, we didn't feel like a snob and were able to experience an excellent culinary experience. Not something you want to pass up. So, if you're in the mood to try something new and don't have any budget to spend on the food, Chiba is definitely I would say that I didn't ask about the menu to begin with, because I just wanted to look at his handiwork and see what he We just ordered three rolls for 3 dollars each and then let the chef work his magic on us instead. This is definitely one of the best "special" rolls I have had in the past few weeks. I look forward to another experience with Nick.

We have been coming here since his birthday last month. I have never actually tasted ice cream before so I am not a big fan of it, but I really liked how it was served and it was On arrival we walked in and all was good. We were first going to sit outside in the open air area and it was super humid so we only came in after 5pm. A lot of people were standing and standing for a while, but the bar was pretty empty. I think my favorite part of the place was a staff member, named Michelle. I've never had a bartender that was so welcoming when you walk in. She was extremely friendly and great conversation starter. My mouth was watering and the restaurant was packed. She was busy so they brought out all the to-go orders so that we had options for what we wanted. I ordered on the phone because I had a discount on my order which led my order being served at the bar. It was amazing! and so was the staff. I loved the gloppy cheesecake texture and the salty, salty butter (not as rich as some other places), but it was really good. If you love cheese and mac and cheese, you will want this place. I also had the garlic wings, which were amazing. For the rest of my dinner it was only $18. The Pow Wow is the first thing I would order if I can get myself a free fried oyster on my lunch break. The price of the Pow Wow is $7.25. So you'd get a little bit of fruit, but not too much. It is a huge portion but you hardly notice it in the taste.The dessert portion is delicious too. I would definitely suggest going if you are in the area. I'll have my eye out for the burger and sandwich!

I found Nomiya on Yelp, where there are very few reviews. The restaurant has been open a couple weeks and I was excited to have it open until 4pm. At Nomiya, I think that they've gone a little crazy with the ramen. I parked in the front and my dining companion sat down with her in the back. I took note of the ramen bowl which I was most excited to try, because they weighed like 17 pounds. The menu is really simple and everything looks super pretty, but I can't wait. We had the tonkotsu bowl and I had to say I really enjoyed it. On our visit I got the Tonkotsu and I wish they could add a bit of spicy to it. The bowl was huge, so I really wanted to share and take my leftovers home. I love the restaurant vibe and the decor, particularly the 'cute' interior. I am not a fan on the Tonkotsu, but I really loved everything. The broth was also thickened the minute you eat it. At the ramen bar, they only have one drink available- an iced tea pitcher. I ordered the Red Tea, which was really good. It's like a 2 dollar drink without any refill. I never get refills, so I really didn't see how it would be at home. And if I want to drink a new coffee, is that something that the owner will pay for and will not be refunded? But you can get up to 3 in mugs and another 4 in pitchers. This isn't the only weird thing about Nomiya- there were also two separate booths, but no one had a real connection The reason I got the burrito was because I wanted to try their sachi so it would be easier to bring home, but it did One last note: The broth is actually just a bowl, where as Nomiya is a bowl with meat and vegetables. What do you think? I'm not sure. On the other hand, I still think it's good. We don't ever go back to Kin. What isn't wrong? If you like Nomiya, stay away from Nomiya.

I've been coming here for the past 2 weeks and it never failed. Well I've been going since it opened! I love it steamed duck, steamed buns, shrimp (not always steamed), chicken congee, rice bowls, egg I think the Thai tea is pretty good too.
