I first came to CPTC for a 10 min facial that I can't remember the name of. It's a place that's only open weekends but they have really good specials for it. At the front of the salon I heard the name of the owner. She showed to me how to get my facial and told me all about what it all entailed. She made her way into the room and was wearing a little mask. We ended the facial with some more dermabrasion followed by a cream facial mask. She pressed lots of cream between my face and my neck and also massaged my arms and legs with different massage strokes to see which one was better. Then she put all of them down, placed a lot of warm towels around my face and massaged it on. When it came time to apply the mask, it felt like I was in a cold, whirlpool. I'm not one to be too serious- I'm sure you can feel the heating involved, but it seriously makes my jaw hurt much less. She then used some cool gel to seal in the product and a ton of foam to slather my face with. She massaged my neck, jaw, jaw line, and underarms before the next part. After the facial, Sunny gave me a new to go bracelet. I just wish you could offer this to your entire staff.

I will definitely be going back to Shoes of New Orleans anytime I'm in Jackson. I visited this store because there are a lot of stores of the kind in Little Rock and it wasn't much different than another store. I always enjoy this store too. They have some funky designs with a great little font. They had some really cute options and I ended up getting a pair of shoes for my daughter's Halloween party. I'll also be looking at a pair of their leather platform sneakers.

Saigon Noodle House in Latrobe, North Carolina, is back and I'm excited to say that there is actually a location now. Until recently I went by this restaurant for lunch and it was a really good location. A few weeks back I stopped by Saigon Noodle House to check-out their pho. Despite the fact that we were the only customers, we ordered a wide variety of items. I ordered the egg spring rolls and pho. I think it has to be said that we were the only parties on the lunch hour, so it's a nice spot to go if you have There are two bowls. The spring rolls come with a side of mayonnaise and are a little thick in consistency. The flavor was really great and the rice was just right. They were really thin to my taste. My friends and I enjoyed it, and I think that the taste of the pho sauce was very good. But my husband got the thin noodle bowl which had a little more of an earthy flavor. It was quite mild for the season but the flavors were still pretty nice. It was pretty tasty, but it felt a bit underdone. The pho was very flavorful and it was full of vegetables and fresh ingredients. If you have any tips about this place and would like to contribute, I've put a note on Facebook as i'll add them when

Are You In A Hurry? I sure couldn't believe it. I'm a weirdo! However, this food truck was very nice and very tasty. The patty was chewy and a little soggy as well. The jerk chicken had the biggest hit of the week and was quite tasty. So, I guess that was the reason for slapping on the sauce?

I was kind of tempted to stop here by myself for lunch one day, but decided that seeing that there was a great menu (which I love), Upon walking in, I knew that this place was not just going to be a great place for the Vietnamese community. Yes, it is just like the one at the previous Vietnamese place, but on a much larger scale. There were lots of people getting dressed up and out there waiting to order. We both were eager to try the brew, but we each ordered the traditional Thai Iced Tea - which consisted of tea, salt, lime I was glad I ordered as the coffee was so sweet. I used a little bit of sweetener to give it a little kick to it. The flavor was very rich and well balanced with a bit of salty kick and some bitterness. We also went down the bar to try some Vietnamese food. I ordered the spring rolls for $2.50 (#20 on the menu). After a few bites we were both impressed! The egg roll was served with some kind of noodle stir fry on the side and was loaded with vermicelli. We added water to the eggs to make it fluffier. I love their fish sauce in anything and even though its really light, it still had a slight smokey taste. Two of us ordered the Mongolian beef and one ordered the pork spring rolls. They were also served with vermicelli noodles and served with a little bit of sauce. We ate all of the chicken, which was delicious too; it had a kick and had a nice consistency. Thankfully the spring roll were fresh and the sauce made it so tasty. I opted for a pork dish with rice. The chicken was tender and had a good flavor although it was cooked a little hot. As we were leaving, we saw a large bowl of pho. I've had the pho at a few Vietnamese restaurants for the cheaper quality and taste, and this one I was sold on for more than $30. The broth was SO sooo good. It was big enough for me and my dining companion to eat all of the bowl. I could have eaten 2 bowls of pho, so that was hard to come by with a few meals this weekend. It was very heavy, but the broth was really flavorful. My second bowl was also excellent: it was like a plate of Thai food, but it was actually a great bowl- I would definitely return for this I felt like eating a fresh bowl of rice that day. The pho was also made perfectly: not too thick or too soft, and not fried in any way. I can't wait to get it back again! I didn't know what the rest of the items were, but I really like those so much that I went to see the show, and it was great I probably would have minded not getting too much of any meat over the top since I found that I did not quite like the texture of the meat at all The only thing I couldn't get was the chicken. So really, I am not mentioning this place to a friend, but I did try some of the dishes and I cannot say enough about them: delicious This is definitely a place where you have to go before you go if you want to experience the original. My friend would have preferred a little less rice and the broth could have been more thick.

I did not make reservations for this meal. Not only were there an amazing amount of people in there, but there were also so many other people who were dining so there was a decent traffic situation. They had an incredible view of the Super Bowl, so we had to order on the go. My first order was the chicken wings and the cheeseburger with pickled vegetables. They were served in a hot box with all sorts of toppings and I loved them! Next, we tried our first burger. Besides being a very big burger, I also got a side of rice. The burger was awesome. It didn't taste too old school, and it packed a punch! In the words of my mother she said it was great! I also ordered the deluxe hot sauce, which was delicious too. The French fries were a little too salty, but the overall experience was great. The cheese sauce was really good, it had chunks of buttery cheese, which I love and I enjoyed it very much. YUM!, love, love! For dessert they had a giant vanilla cake with chocolate icing and fresh berries. I would also say, we should have just ordered the cheeseburger! It would also be fun to go to a sporting event, as well.

Everyonce in a while I just want to checkout a new breakfast place. I usually get two eggs over easy, bread and grits and bacon every morning, usually with a side order of something else. I was asked if I would recommend Coulis for breakfast. It was good: two eggs over easy (slightly undercooked), toast, grits and bacon. I wanted something to eat while I was in New Orleans. I first started looking out for El Libre a few years ago when I was in New Orleans. They are located outside of the Jazz District in North New Orleans and are open late Monday through Friday at weekends. I always look for something with an easy to digest breakfast. They did it right. Not bad for the amount of eggs. The eggs were hard and overdone and I couldn't finish my meal. They are in a beautiful setting and we got close enough that it was kind of awkward but it is not impossible to walk and the restaurant is a short It was a great breakfast- I just don't think I will be going back anytime soon. The only down side- it is too pricey and I know you won't be saying I didn't pay too much.

This restaurant was recommended to me by a friend. The people here are amazing. It's topped with marinated tomatoes and Basil, garlic, and the wonderful sauce added to it to make it unique, a mouthwatering blend It's great to learn that, if I wanted a jar of a soup that I could make at home, you could get 5  It is the one for me...and I had it twice. A jar is about 3 oz. or so. I don't care what your foodies say, you have to try it. I am coming again soon...for sure.

Had a luncheon there the other day. Our favorite breakfast items are the breakfast burrito and mac n cheese. I like to have a breakfast lunch and have a cheeseburger every morning. I think it's a bit overpriced, but it gives you a quick bite to eat. Also, the service is also top notch. The price is reasonable and its pretty snobby, but it's worth it.

This evening was our first meal at Kebab in Portland. The one I tried to try at Lavate was this little bit inside Lavate Bakery, which opened in February and opened in March. The bar at Kebab has a little bit of a divey feel, but it does feel pretty homey and family friendly. All that is required is to order your food, which consists of four sandwiches, two hummus and half of a bechamel sauce or salad We ordered a plate of Belgian fries and we were incredibly pleased with them. We each got a small sprinkling of their Mediterranean dressing. The portabello was the next item and it was absolutely amazing. Definitely worth getting. Well... I didn't think so. I'll be honest, I wasn't sure which it was, but it was a portabello mushroom vegetable sandwich. I was a little confused with the amount of cheese and vegan dressing in the sandwich, but you can't fault them for not putting that in, I had to take notes so I had some of the ingredients on hand and just ordered it with some parmesan cheese as well! I was told it recalled the "creamed" stuffing in chicken pot pie, but I couldn't stop eating this and thinking about it. It didn't overpower the dish and the mushrooms didn't get too salty or rubbery! After finishing up my meal, I went pick up the sandwiches to go. I definitely recommend this place. I also opted for the Mediterranean salad which was awesome. If you're looking for some Mediterranean food with a little bit of something else on the menu, you simply can't go wrong with Kebab. For now, I'm just going to have to keep it in mind during myupcoming trip to Los Angeles.

Oh, I need to go back. I've had about 5 bites of the burger and I've never been so impressed. Their burgers are the best ever, they don't taste like anything else. There was just a little smoke left over that was so delicious to bite into that I didn't think it was an accident. Just like we've had at times before. The sauce's delicious. At this location, the flavor of the meat is perfect and the burger is cooked perfectly. It was so good that I didn't think it might be the burger itself. Yes that was the case. While this wasn't really the goal (I was expecting a big cheeseburger like many of the other reviews), I would definitely order it again and recommend My second cheeseburger was even better! The burger was really good. I'd definitely come back!

The food was pretty good but the bathrooms aren't in great shape, but there's another place there that's a bit more affordable. We went because it was just right and the owners were really fun people. I really enjoyed getting to do some drinking in this place. For our group the DJ was really chilly and played what was being played for a few hours. We ordered a beer and two hotdogs and bbq's. A must try! - $2 for the tix plus one drink.

The hotel is very clean and the staff very friendly. There is an area with a lot of parking, notably a lot of them under shade, as well as some under overpasses and some There's also a nice park to play on, with good food. I was glad I wasn't the only one who missed the show on air.

Craig has bodypainting skills you will see all over Pennsylvania. Craig has been creating beautiful, unique body paintings for many years and has exhibited and hosted numerous body painting contests. We see Craig doing different types of animal bodypaints on different people from big kids to kids to adults and on the face and body. I know Craig, he truly is a artist. I had an epic day with my boyfriend today. My boyfriend & I were in town and wanted some quick quick food for dinner. There were so many options on campus that we could have gone and ate something quick or go out for dinner. While eating at Grasson's, we found Copper Monkey. I ordered the wrap based on what I was imagining and had to take them, that is it! So I went in and ordered a medium cheeseburger with onions and potato. I ordered one and it came with two plates of which one I got extra pieces for free! I ate my take home lunch from there and was not disappointed. This place is close to my apartment and I strongly recommend it. This review just so happens to be their first review on Yelp.

For the next reason I need to post more about here: Super Walgreens has been undergoing alot of changes. I've been wanting to stop by this little pharmacy and I finally did so today. They have crawfish at Perino's on Main St. at around 5-7pm daily, so I decided to check this place out this If your parents are in the area, be sure to stop and see Perino's. They also have a selection of items to choose from. The food is pretty standard, the prices are pretty high, but I didn't really mind spending money here. The crawfish tasted good, but there was a few issues with it. There was a couple of cuts of meat on each one so they didn't seem too salty or fat-free. I just wasn't at all convinced crawfish is bad for you. I definitely would recommend the crawfish!

When I go to Popeye's in Detroit I have to go through the drive through first and then park out the way before making a purchase. Why????Rarely? The staff always is trying to cheat me out of money. I hope so!? I can almost always get a piece of chicken wing, though, I'm pretty sure I won't get it again. This is a small, fun place to hang out. I have a soft spot in my heart for bars that are all burlesque nights! You got to try it! Been here twice but will probably go back. This is my third stay here and I'm pretty impressed by it. I stayed for 3 nights. A nice little kitchen with a microwave, coffee maker, a fridge, and a couple of dishes. I went to M&P last week for lunch and had good things to say about it. They also have other dishes I would recommend, such as the chocolate milkshakes and they can be served lunch or dinner! On the other hand, the waffle fries weren't very good either. They were so delicious that even when you ordered my original order, I was going to order the heirloom chicken and truffle fries, but I couldn't On the other hand, there was a lot of food selection and that's the reason why a place like this doesn't come up. In 2011, we went to another new cafe in my neighborhood called the Levee in Downtown. I was a little bit nervous, but the fact that we were at such an attractive location didn't stop me from giving it a chance. I ordered the fish sandwich and pasta salad. The sandwiches are good and definitely filling. I'm not too good at arguing, but it wasn't that bad so it's not a bad place. The place was casual which I liked. That's why it's getting so many reviews. The parking lot was plenty. We parked our car in the garage, but our meal didn't take very long to show up. It was a great lunch in a great place with nice tables and a decent price. And I love how it's an easy walk.

I recently visited the new H & M at The Grove, and I got to look at their knitted clothes. I mean..? In this season I see lots of winter dresses. These are all hot trend now. After all the times I have used Urban Outfitters where I want what my budget demands, I was in need of a new place to get my stuff. This is where a little trashy is perfect- it has something a little extra. For all of the great Vietnamese restaurants I've been going to recently I was expecting to be disappointed. This place is in Pho. It was a small storefront in the middle of downtown, not full of restaurants but was full of little shops. This was my second visit to Ba Chi and it was the first time I had been for dinner. I had their fried rice. They were fantastic..my friend loved them too, and ordered the ribs. I then ordered the Pho with a side of Thai Basil sauce. It was excellent..but a little pricey. The sauce was simply a huge bowl of the most tender beef ever. I went with a side of steamed broccoli and it was great to have the same flavor. Once I got my Pho done, they poured a bowl of warm Thai hot sauce on top so I tasted it before taking the first sip This place is way pricey. It's usually cheaper at neighborhood Thai restaurants, but it's better than having to drive around and try to make your lunch at a Vietnamese restaurant. I think that's because most restaurants tend to get a bit of a tip if you take advantage of their discount. When getting home I was very sad to find that one of the food items had dropped. His mother said no (!) ), which was a bit weird because he was a bit picky as well. It was a generous gesture. Check out all the great food and cool atmosphere at Ba Chi. Make sure you come by the parking lot! Buy. Love.Love.

I had the PJ's one time, and there's still a bit of a smell. I would not say that I will be returning there. I did like the fried calamari, but I was also disappointed about the orange/pink sauce added to their sauce. At the bar a few different items are on rotation and then it's just a nice spot to relax and chat while you wait for your coffee. I feel like it's my best option for a quick breakfast. There are probably a few places, but this one is so cool that I'll have to tell my friends about doing some business there!

The last couple of months I have been working on finding a restaurant in the neighborhood, but I never seemed to let that get in the way of something good I phoned them and waited for the right day. We had lunch there twice a week on a weekday and the food was always fresh and delicious. And then they gave me an invite. My hopes were shattered this past week when I came into the place. Turkey and the Wolf located at 105 Main Street in San Antonio, Texas is offering lunch and dinner. The sandwiches here are absolutely amazing. Turkey and the Wolf is super fast and the food came out pretty fast. I knew I was going to pay high prices for whatever I got, but for $4.99, that was the best deal on the block. It was absolutely perfect. I like all the flavors of the ham on the roll and the cheese on top of the sandwich was also so delicious. It's one of those sandwiches you can make before you eat a whole meal and you immediately start to love it. The two sandwiches I had are also delicious, just like my ham but with a side of sweet potatoes. There is a whole section of sandwiches, and a menu of soups and salads that you can get your hands on. The portions of the sandwiches were a little small but was more than enough to feed me. There's definitely an option to order off the menu. There are even little extras such as two large buns. Some places do not offer those. When I tried that they offered no bag, so I had to think twice.

We went to a luncheon of the Chicagoland Foodie at the Grand Canal Plaza recently. I was really hungry when I went and there were lots of other customers but we really didn't have a lot of wait time. We left a short bit before our server left and stayed right as he finished his next customer. They had a great selection of pastries, sandwiches, and salads. My GF ordered a burger. It was everything that I wanted, no disappointment at all. It was a quick bite of food to get in there on a wonderful Saturday afternoon, where people were all outside enjoying the sun and the atmosphere. They have a nice indoor patio area with indoor and outdoor seating. A nice place to try and sit down and eat a bite of pizza. This is a wonderful place to stop and get a bite!

The Gambit is the biggest daily newspaper in Louisiana. I went to the Gambit with my father-in-law in the days it existed, and he loved it. The place was beautiful and I was really surprised by how clean it was. The food is great and everyone here is always helping. The spices on the floor are great. Great selection of organic produce, mostly frozen organic vegetables.

What a dream this shop is! I recently decided to stop by Jeans, Belles, and Fragments for a visit to see what you can buy. A small boutique offering a great selection of vintage clothing. Vintage is not confined to a certain gender - they have all the styles that can be found for everyone, ranging from dresses, skirts, Although the owner has a wide range of items to choose from, I would recommend keeping an eye out - she has some of my favorites on offer. There isn't a lot of floral clothing but I do appreciate the floral ones since I am a pretty girl. There were also a few itty bitty pieces that caught my attention, especially for my birthday, which are a bit more expensive than I thought Just if you were a bit pressed for time to wait, there was a selection of designer pieces to be seen. However, there were so many beautiful vintage pieces in and around the store, I thought it was such a rare find to come across somewhere in the area. It looks like it could be new and still look nice. It will be great to take on more holiday-goals than I tend to wear! She is a beautiful person and I definitely recommend stopping by!

I was invited to Sushi Brothers by a friend of mine when I was in the area. I'm talking about Sushi Brothers, with some review from my sister. I don't have any new sushi places listed to review right now, but I don't. In fact, I had heard about them from my friend, who was eating here for lunch the other day. I have to try everything new! I was excited, because I love seafood and I had a lot of sushi in my back yard. That's alright, just a little different for me. The dynamite roll and cucumber roll are both just crunchable rolls. These aren't special rolls, either. After they were mostly gone, we had the black and gold roll. It had shrimp, crab meat, cream cheese and fish pieces surrounded by a lot of salmon, cream cheese and fish in between. I love how all the cream cheese was tucked in between fish and avocado. The fish was really fresh! The rolls here, are cooked perfectly, you get a cheesy texture, and if you're not a fan of yellow or The rest of the rolls are very good. If I lived in Detroit, I'd definitely come back for some of the things I've been missing.

I was here last night for the final stop on my tour through North Raleigh. I'm not sure if it's the food, the price, the service but everything else was fantastic! There was an extensive selection of salads, a salad bar, and a small selection of a la carte items. Parking in this area is pretty tricky. Many people park here by the road and only a handful of people pull in to the lot. There are no extra parking spaces for the parking meters (with the exception). I highly recommend their soup, but be prepared to spend a few dollars on parking.

I went to Silicious on a Friday, around noon for lunch. I had the whole meal, and my friend wanted to try it before saying he'd rather eat there. We had started off with some chips on the bar, but after that, we just wanted lunch, so we ordered a pizza. But I found it way over seasoned. The pasta, was hard, like white pasta. I had asked for chicken on top but it was cold and cold like a cucumber. The sauce was a mix of olive oil and lemon, or something. The crust of the pasta was not good. So when I came home late-night and realized I was starving, I was thinking I would take it for dinner and eat the leftovers...the Yes..it would probably be difficult to resist. But...I'll probably eat them this morning. I couldn't eat even one of them...that's the only good thing. I am not a big fan of Italian restaurants unless they get their sauce right, so I can't give feedback. If I want something real, I would probably get their other menu items. My Dad recommended the coffee shop right across the street from my house. I'd definitely come back.

The Studio is a crafty/craft shopping store in East Aurora, I always love to hit up there for some great finds or crafts. They offer embroidery, crafts and home décor for all budgets. You can easily make a beautiful gift or just a decoration. I really like the beach bag department for beach clothes and beach bags for weddings. The embroidery is always so beautiful on everything from summer clothes to towels! I think that they are doing many fun designs. All of their fabrics have high quality dyes and dyes that come in colors and patterns to suit your preference. This little little hole in the wall is a great place to go to do crafty things or just to pick up some supplies.

The Halal Guys opened up on December 14th with no sign of a crowd, and it was incredibly quiet. That's right; The Halal Guys is here! I've been on the hunt for Halal places for a while, but not much has been out of restaurants- either it isn't local I've been wanting to try this place for years, it looks pretty awesome and the menu is pretty extensive. I'm not sure we'll be back for the latter, but you know, I wanted to try the new one. The restaurant is super friendly and open. I ordered a chitta (turkey breast) to go. They have a lot of options, but for those that don't want to do a lot of the heavy lifting and just want to try some snacks I have been trying to get my shawarma fix since I went to Turkey Club last week, but this was something I didn't have around to try I went with chicken, which was pretty good since there were two of them, but the gyro had the most flavor and was more than enough The portion is probably about 1 cup of chicken and 2 oz (taylor's brand) of gyro. It wasn't as good as the other locally owned shawarma places I've tried. It's a really little space and they do a lot of their dishes by hand, so I feel like they have a lot of flexibility. Not the Halal Guys, but The Halal Guys seems like a good place to find Middle Eastern food, if only because I can't go I will definitely be back!

I have to say, Black Penny is a must-go if you are near Nashville. Located in the middle of the night just steps away from the Saenger Theater, you can sit at the bar at the bar and enjoy a good It has a nice dark cozy atmosphere and a great beer list. Black Penny is well worth the trip to the Grand Central Market. On a recent Sunday, my brother and I stopped by this bar. We were trying out some local pubs on the North Rampart market and saw Black Penny. The best part of staying at this hotel and going out in the evening was getting to sample some of the best food we could find. The bartenders were friendly and there was a huge selection of draft beer- definitely not a tourist venue. They have something for everyone in the Pittsburgh suburbs that is both diverse and amazing. It was a good size bar and I couldn't wait till I got home to try it. They rated all of their brews at 3.7 out of 5 and when I was finished  sampling, I asked for it to be served  They have a selection of craft beers that are a little skewed in the sour beer world (like Red Harvest Beer and Golden Once we arrived back home, we had dinner at a great local bar that just opened- The Green House in the center of the restaurant. We made a lot of friends. My friend and I thought the atmosphere was great, even if we were a bit tired. This is a perfect spot for enjoying a nice beer while reading a book, watching a movie or just relaxing. I would definitely recommend this spot to others because it's one of my favorite places to drink and drink beers in Charlotte.

The food here was fantastic. I had always lived in a very small area, but my parents let me move to San Francisco after moving here, so I was a bit nervous to One of my favorite restaurants in the city is Lilette, or simply Lilette, which is really a "casual" place, but also highly recommended I was not really sure what I was going to order, but I thought it would be fine. I had only been to Lilette in December of this year without even seeing the place. I did not try there before, but was just so pleasantly surprised. Lilette is a great place to hit up after work or a quick bite at that bar in the hotel. They have an open layout with a large bar area and a nice cozy seating area. It has a very casual feel, which is perfect for a date night. Lilette has an extensive cocktail menu. We went for dinner and I had the same friend and I had the same choices. My initial libation was the mushroom omelet in blueberry wasabi butter, cheese, tomatoes and mayo. The white truffle was marinated a bit in a sweet wine so that it could thicken and had a great crunch. I couldn't help but put the dish in my favorites list which is exactly what I did. For dinner we ordered a nice selection of steak, the oven-roasted duck. This was one of the best steaks I've had in a very long time and I feel a big thanks to the wait staff for helping me My side dishes included the sautéed mushrooms and sautéed black beans. For dessert I ordered the chocolate and walnut pie. I was more or less surprised by the prices and the size of the portions I got. I have to admit that this was the best dessert I've had in years.

I was moving in a while and I was preparing for the move. It took a day of planning to move my house around from North Carolina over to Ohio. I go to Juans every Wednesday night on Monday afternoons and always go for the burritos. It's on Magazine St. but it's on a side street, not the top floor. I can't remember the last time I went back to this location. The staff seems to have taken over, which is an added bonus for me as I have yet to order and I found some great happy hour specials in the I ordered my usual burrito. As I said, it was good and the burrito was the perfect size, so it had me thinking of other places in Chicago and New York I It was huge- about 16 inches in length- but the thing I really liked was the rice which was cooked quickly, so it was all pretty filling. I was a little let down about this, but the burrito was still excellent. I would have rather gotten their beef tacos, the tamale soup and the chips and salsa. I wanted to post this last month (a post I thought would be long overdue) to tell you about that amazing food experience I had! This was my friend's birthday and I wanted to give this place a try. There is alot of stuff to say about this one but it is the best taqueria that I've ever had. It is very busy with the two servers at this location. This time around we had the fish and chips with an amazing tomato sauce and the chicken was delivered from the same area that I ate last week. The service was on point and we were able to get our orders in without a wait. At $13 plus tax, this chicken was really moist and tender. If this is your first time in the restaurant, it looks like they have very good calamari! The chicken had a slightly crispy exterior and the wings were delicious. But, despite being a little small, I'll say that I was still able to finish all three pieces. The breading was tasty, the chicken was very moist and didn't crumble. I was on Yelp to find another restaurant that had awesome review. The name alone speaks for itself - its atmosphere is both peaceful and welcoming and the servers are always very knowledgeable and sweet about what they do. The interior smells good and all the food that was served was delicious. We ordered the Italian Flatbread, which came with a choice of two pasta dishes and my dining companion chose the "Road to Vienna" plate The cheese on top was perfectly seasoned and the dish did not overpower the pasta which was a nice touch. Then we got some fish, served with fried green beans and fresh avocado. I think this was more than just a simple plate with some potatoes and peas. Gautreau's has a lovely menu and a very laid backambiance. There you go, the new LaGuardia in Montclair. What a great review! We were cruising through West End, New Orleans when we saw the sign for La Taverna on the corner of 12th and Grand. Now, we heard that they were open and we went through several staff members. It's not a busy place, but there is still a bar that has a live band humming along from time to time. I ordered the Cuban sandwiches, which were super flavorful, if you ask me, and they were all very good. When I went to the register, the cashier asked, "What about the Cuban?" We had a weekend in Vegas going on a date and were looking for a place to eat. After we had the food for dinner (a meal we had planned on enjoying for lunch), we walked by. But once we pulled in to the parking lot a couple of patrons were looking at us excitedly. We decided on a table on the patio because it's great weather. The restaurant was clean, clean and friendly. At this time it was already 9pm, so a bit early, but that didn't detract from the experience. The flavor was incredibly good and you couldn't help but enjoy the sweet and salty sauce. After that they had marrow and onions on an egg roll. I knew this meal had to be good as the bread was fresh and soft to the touch. The marrow bones were almost like meat but was a little bit sweeter. I can't wait to try their burger. I ordered the filet mignon with a roasted garlic sauce. The white and green beans were so soggy. The sucotash also had a great amount of flavor from the fish. The fish itself was excellent. I also enjoyed the fried catfish which was fish and vegetables with a little kick of cream. There was so much goodness to all the different dishes. I had my heart set on the potato. We had about 5 visits to Rue 127 and it was only when they took care of our dinner that we realized all the great things about this place. They don't charge for their dinner, but it's quite pricey since it is a nice place with great service. There's not much else a couple of blocks away, and just a short stroll gives me the opportunity to have a very great meal there.

Funrock'n is a great idea if you want to find really cool and unique gifts. I am always looking for places to get stuff for fun. They are so huge in the brick and mortar store so you can walk in and walk around, even though you are in a completely different area. It's a very small store and they are small because they don't have many racks to browse through. I love the "Spin-Along-The-Screen" thing, and the funky vinyl toys. I love the cute little hats made from a variety of colors and styles. There are also wonderful gifts, and a wonderful selection of hand made ornaments they can make and sell. The magnets I mentioned can be ordered online, in time for Christmas.

I really like this bar in the historic hotel called the Orleans. I really liked it. The place was pretty quiet. For the first time in years, I ordered a large oyster po boy. The oysters were perfectly sized, a little rubbery, they were moist and tasty and the bread was nice and soft. This place always does a great job of combining the stale crusty French bread with the tasty seafood filling. When I hear a po boy (or even a sandwich) without bread on it, my mouth instantly salivates. This is a place I've found that provides lots of healthy fillings. Sometimes on a fish po boy its not a great experience if the bread is tough and the seafood in it is too salty. It was an absolute winner here! The food and service were great. Their foot long stuffed crab sandwich was pretty nice, maybe just a bit too rich. I've been to other po boy places and it's really nice to have a new place on the Westbank. There are other seafood sandwiches for sale on the menu. The portions on the menu are really big. I definitely recommend this place. Don't forget, they have dessert too!

With the recent opening of Le Delat Vietnamese at 108 West Jefferson. I was really excited to have discovered Le Delat and its incredible pho & banh mi. Le Delat opened in April and I think it's a pretty cool place. The place was all clean so it's looking great right now. The place is full of tables and despite being a Vietnam restaurant, the space is big. I haven't seen anything like this before and it looks like they plan on adding lots of different flavors to this place. There is also really great seating there, especially the bar area so you can easily enjoy a drink while you wait, even if you're alone in The staff was very friendly and the location is perfect for my favorite Vietnamese joint, Banh mi. This is something to do with how the ingredients are prepared here, which is also really cool because most of the restaurants around Melinda/NJ just lack I like to get my eggs in large buns and they were so much better than I expected. They were delicious, rich and packed with shrimp. I'll say that my food resembles my mom's egg rolls (at least the egg rolls she prepared at home) and I had a I then took away the egg rolls and went for the huge bowl of pho. The pho was great and I loved their broth. I loved the way it looked and had a good taste. It was a huge amount for the price and had plenty of beef. This place was a great place to stop in for lunch or dinner. I'm pleased that they have a great range of Thai and Vietnamese dishes, which is a welcomed addition! I was a little wary of the restaurant just in general because the staff isn't as friendly as other Vietnamese restaurants in town, but it turned So I highly recommend Le Delat for those of you who are looking for great food and good service.

I had not heard of the place before. It was late, so we had to park near the door. The price was about $10 and I paid about $8.50. Some people were waiting there, but my friend and I were already seating down here, and so the line was pretty long. Even though there is a sign saying that you can choose your seats and start enjoying your meal by around 6pm, our wait seemed pretty long. She arrived right on time! So, we made it out to the restaurant, found a table, and ordered our dinner. The food was amazing, right down to the banh mi and the sautéed vegetables. There is not a lot of seating there, but the staff was really friendly. What a great lunch, right! I opted for a banh mi and a bowl of Pho. My friend ordered the mixed pot and then told me they were on its way. I think the way they made this food is very special. The banh mi was full of Vietnamese veggies, soy sauce, chicken, beef, and Vietnamese herbs. The portions were a great size, because it came to us in an ounce. I went back for seconds, just so that I could eat more of the Pho. The owner was very understanding of my situation and offered to take a picture of me. I was super impressed. In my opinion, Namese is a really good restaurant.

Still, I'd definitely go to this place for lunch again. It's definitely one of my favorite restaurants in AZ.

I came across this place on our way to the hospital, and I was a bit surprised at the location. I had a really good time there and a couple friends saw me there. I went there for lunch at noon on a Saturday, and it was absolutely delicious. I was super excited though, because they don't even have any name. Almost all of the signs in the restaurant now are old fashioned and dated. The rest of the restaurant is very modern and they have a little bar with a lot of TVs. I was a little confused about what the menu was before I came in. At Visko's you can get hot dogs (my friend was eating mys too, but he loves it here! I thought this was a great way to try and save money!) I like that little thing that brings extra flavor to my lunch. I decided to try out their taquitos, because I wanted to try something I had never tried before. You can also get a margarita and a side of something else. I also ordered the chilaquiles. I enjoyed the cheese and the sauce. They were very soft too, and the cheese is just the right amount. The tequila sauce was just enough to give them some flavor but not too much. The margarita was my favorite of the day. The taquitos were loaded with so much beef and the guacamole wasn't all that thick. They were fresh, and had an overall good taste to them. The salsa and chips were tasty, and I was pleased with my taquitos, as well as the margarita. No complaint here.. They have a really fun music night on the weekends, and it is a must get! !!

After driving so far to try this place, I finally ended up on the street. It opens on the west side of the strip. And how lucky is my hubby who has been here for over 10 years for lunch? It was only Tuesday morning, but we were excited to go! My friend and I had been trying to get there for a while and couldn't get there for lunch, so we decided to try it out. I ordered the fried plantains with the shrimp, with a side of charred pork cutlets and a fried fish. I also ordered the Amarillo guacamole. The dishes were just perfect and so fast. The Mofongo was a huge, delicious filling and the waitress was so nice. I can't believe I had all the money I want to spend on lunch. The fried plantains were very crisp and tender, but they had a real burn in them. Just delicious, in a kind way. Did you love it too? Yes, yes, that I had. All of this is so delicious! I definitely wish I had even more to share! I was just so impressed with the owner and the service. We just decided to have half my lunch and went with two other people (but I was looking to try more. ); however, it was so good that we decided to come back here again tonight. There was a woman at our table eating what I could of the mofongo, and then a man asked me if I was still in They were delicious, so I'll be back for sure. I would love to have a bit of it next time I'm here, but it's really the size that I'm going to try. If the patio is anything like it looks and it's busy, you definitely won't miss it again as you wait for your food. I came to Sutsumi in Northfield today to try their sushi. I am going to write about the experience I had. You know, the ones I had only at my favorite sushi place. I went to this place because I was looking to find a really good place on the Westbank to do lunch. The place is very cheap, a little old school but very new. So I knew what to expect and was a little surprised. The counter top is covered with "bananarama". And they don't have any salt and pepper. I know it's a "sushi" place, but there is absolutely no paper cup. It's not the "medium thickness" soy sauce that a lot of places offer. I'm not joking, but the other thing that makes this place different is the menu does not ask for the items that you want. Yes, it is kind of like a school cafeteria. I was looking forward to going there, and glad I did. The waiter took the order and brought the sashimi before I did. The waiter took a moment to think about how I wanted my food cut in 3 pieces: 1 piece of tuna, 2 pieces of salmon, 2 I didn't specify, but I could just talk to the manager about how much rice I wanted. So I settled on the 4 piece box. If I'm feeling hungry, then I didn't even try the philly and tuna. However, the service was very good. The salmon sashimi was super fresh and the tuna roll was just average. It didn't cost a lot either. They also offered to bring in extra rolls, which was much appreciated. My only gripe is that it's all "tiny" and you can't actually see the quality of the food. I think it would be a good choice for a quick lunch, if only they had a whole menu of sashimi. I will, however, continue to look for another place that has good sashimi and serves cheap sushi.

I know I said I would be a little bit on the early side. Just say that, I would like to be able to describe this hotel. At what I was told I think this was the best hotel in New Orleans. I was all about the Jamaican Room. I was all about the dinners. I was all about the restaurants. I was all about the luxury of the rooms. I was lucky to grab a suite in the Silver Whistle over the weekend and it was fantastic. To make it even more special, you have to get your room key before you check- in. Unlike some places where you have a card, you have to get someone over to get you rooms. When I checked in I was very antsy because it was almost 1am and I had no idea where I was going. So when you are checking in there is no pressure to buy anything from the hotel. A real luxury queen size bed that I actually actually fell asleep to the next day. In the room at the bottom of the hall, the "housekeeping" tells you how to get to the bathroom. I have to say I never felt like I was in an airport. The staff is really warm and welcoming and the restaurant is very cute. If you love good cocktails, the Bayou Bar is the place. In the evenings head downstairs to Hot Tin for a drink and bite to eat. Or just head up to Silver Whistles, where you can drink your way through a list of all the old school cocktails right on the roof of Or if you are in the mood for wine and spirits, the Caribbean Room will have just what you are looking for. In town?... why not. You can go to a few of the other places around the hotel for dining. In terms of the bar scene the Silver Whistle is still the place to chill, but then again who can argue with a bar like that? The hotel is not really for everyone and it could be used as a sleepover hotel or a romantic getaway. The Silver Whistle and Hot Tin are both pretty great, but if you are looking to take a night in the city then I suggest

My little slice of Heaven has always loved Steamed Chicken with Carrots (the one on your left ) by the way! They have a few different items. They offer their own signature menu and are available for any event. I ordered it for two because I was in a bind on both the BBQ chicken and the sliders. The bread is soft enough to put a nice little patty on it, but a little bit thick and thick enough to slide the chicken in! The chicken itself is very tender with a great seasoning. It's just  Yum! The cheese and pickles are hot and moist, notggy and salty. They also have some kind of hot sauce on the truck to sweeten up the dish. Also, try the ketchup- it's super sweet and they even have great ketchup, which is a plus! There were many more reasons to come in!

Last week on my way home I hit up a drive through to this place that I've never heard of prior to this review, and I was very I actually thought that this place was pretty pricey, but it is definitely worth it. I asked if they had a good happy hour menu that I could see myself ordering, and since this was a new place, I thought I could After reading reviews, and the fact that I had a free lunch, I ordered an onion rings sub. I chose the option of ordering two which seemed to be a good move since you can't take home more than one of any meal. The meatloaf was really good and I could easily eat them all! Very hearty and savory, and so much more than I thought it was going to be. The potatoes in the sides are a great idea and were so delicious! I really enjoyed the hot tea they served with my meatloaf and the mashed potatoes and gravy was perfect against the cold and crisp outside. I had to admit I started my meal with a cup of nice old, hot tea. Since I could have easily shared it with my daughter, I would definitely recommend this place to anyone in the Bay Area. They are very clean and the food looks good too! Thanks so much, Bounce Bar!

In fact, it was one of those evenings when I came home from a wild night in Vegas, and on my way in to work I realised Buffa's was on my list of places to go on a Thursday night, so I was happy when I found that the bar and restaurant were This is a really cool place to eat and this one is a bit more cozy. I really enjoyed the atmosphere in the place - a bar area with a bunch of TVs and big screens and a really nice view of the We ended up dining around the bar area and trying some of the different dishes that they have. I thought that I might like to order a sandwich, but it wasn't until I went home and saw our friend that I actually found a sandwich I picked the Turkey Breast Steak and Garlic Panini Sandwich. The sandwich is huge so I did not notice how thick it was before I ordered my food. My friend ordered a burger that looked like a turkey burger. We ended up giving the sandwich away and the sandwich was really good. It was super flavorful and they let us order additional sides. I am going to go back and visit them to see what they look like next. The location of Buffa's is super convenient. The bartender seemed to take a super nice care of us while we were there, especially because they were busy. I'm definitely going back to check out the food!

I keep coming across it on my street every day so I thought hey, let's see what the local music scene is like. Known as the Balcony, a lot of musicians have performed here. I've not had to go to it in a while, but it never misses out on a show. I had a fantastic time at the Balcony on New Year's Day. They were called The Bluebirds and they were playing a little different kind of music. The man kept the crowd going and singing every song they got into. It was really cool to listen to this kind of music. It's not the first time I've seen an interesting band playing here but this is one of the most regularly at the place. This is the spot for all your next party plans and I certainly recommend it to friends.

I recently visited Home Depot to find out what sort of lights were in stock for a new home that I am planning to build. Home Depot's products are really expensive, though. I browsed through their shelves, and the selection I found there really surprised me; I'll be heading back to get more stuff soon. I was really excited to see that they have LED lights for the outdoor areas of my house. It's easy to pick right up items at a nice, small convenience mall. The sales department is friendly and knowledgeable about it all.

Stop by the Art Decatur Historical Society and check out this store. My friend, Issa, found this place on Craigslist and I was so excited to stop it! The gypsy lady here is very nice and kind of takes a very interesting approach to finding what she wants. There are vintage, vintage clothes, things that are old, vintage books, old toys, furniture, paintings, wallpaper and even a few antique beds. Also, they have a photo box with a set of photographs hanging on the wall. This type of thing is a little creepy but it's something that is definitely worth exploring and going into. Also, they have vintage old photographs of people in the 1930's/40's. There are also a lot of old vintage records that I wouldn't mind looking through. With the vintage clothing, these treasures are quite easy to find and I thought the prices were great. I'm going to order the gold medal necklace for me now since I love it! Stop by and save some money on your holiday shopping and don't forget to give the historic vintage shop a call!

I had a crazy day and headed out to Dicks Sports. Well, I finally did. On the right hand side of our neighborhood is a Dick's Sports Market. They even have jerseys for the girls of Little Rock, and even a brand new (to me) football team and a new youth soccer club. They even have a pretty huge selection of athletic merchandise. This place is also huge, with just about everything, and they have an indoor/outdoor shop, which is good if you have kids (short And they carry everything you could need if you're ever in the area. They have both adult and kids size basketball shoes for the guys and girls who are playing basketball. Dick's Sports is a true sports supply store, which is why this is the most important sports outlet to me.

This place is very small. There's both a front and back part. The food is great and the staff is super friendly and welcoming. The food was really good, and the patio is beautiful for the summer. All in all, a good eat in for a few hours in the evening. If you are in the area and want to check it out, I would recommend driving to Westbank.

I was super excited when I saw someone open a Häagen-Dazs on the westbank. This place is like a dream come true. I have been talking to those three people about wanting to open a restaurant in this area and, y'all, I'm sure that they will So we just stopped by on our way home and discovered it had two weeks to go. I was headed down to check out this new place, as well as eat at The Kitchen before the shop even opened. But we ended up ordering from there after driving for some time. We made it out of the mall and passed a few guys who had been there before you were even passing them. It looks almost like a bar- it's crowded. Their options are a mix of flavors like vanilla, strawberry and pralines, and they have a huge selection, including vanilla, strawberries, chocolate and It came with some kind of chocolate marmalade, and we had to eat all the ice cream. That would be vanilla, chocolate, and chocolate milk- all of my kids love them, or maybe not. They have some flavors that have so much to them, you could feel like you're there in paradise. And just to entice you to visit, here's what it's all about! I ordered the "caramel topping" and it was like a giant bowl of this sugary sticky caramel. They are also a hot fudge and caramel kinda shop, (one of my favorite ice cream places). I had it served hot to me courtesy of a cute kid named Mr. Fudge. So hot. Not hot enough for the waffle cone, not hot enough for the banana split cup thing. Also they have a mini-cake- and I don't know what it is but that's it. The vanilla also was just... really good, with flavor and texture. To be fair, I wasn't a huge fan of most Häagen-Dazs, so I was a bit excited to finally The most beautiful thing about Häagen-Dazs, is their quality. And I know I'll need to do a proper review.

This is a great way to go to or from the mall. There are 2 levels, two of which provide access to Mid City and the second level makes for a much more convenient ride into the Downtown area. The bus system in the city is pretty dependable. It provides a quick and reliable mode of transportation for some of the South's most famous destinations, such as Madison Square Garden, where you can hop on Just make sure that you walk a little extra to your destination, and do it in one of the shorter lines. If you make a long journey, it's worth it and worth a stop.

I took a look at the ferry ride out to the French Quarter of Algiers, and I can't believe I didn't realize it was It's been a week of being in Algeria and I am loving it! It was about 2 hours long. I used to go down to the French Quarter, but due to the massive amount of cyclists who can never get past the traffic, it was almost crazy to Afterwards, we continued out and we stopped at the French Quarter. I didn't think of it until a few weeks ago and I didn't believe anyone would take it on the other side, but then I saw It's a fun way to get around in the outskirts of France. Not to mention the amazing view and the huge port.

My friend brought a friend over this evening to try the Po Boy's restaurant on S. 16th St. which is down the street from me. I had dinner and went to lunch at the Chinatown in Greensboro on Tuesday. I went to check it out because I had heard good things about it online and then I was so excited when I found out that they were actually taking orders. It was so nice to see that their menu was very extensive. At this time their menu was not posted in good taste so I would have to get that out before I ordered a po boy. It was excellent.It was large and tender, but so delicious. I cant wait to go back. We ate it just before we left and didn't mind it at all! I would have preferred a little more sauce but I really appreciate the bread that the po boy is on. The waitress was friendly as well.

I would definitely go again. A lot of places in Phoenix I've been to have a worse experience than this place, because they give you beer. I think the price is really reasonable for a Breaux Mart. Luckily, I didn't need to go in with any really special requirements. There are a lot of craft breweries in the area that have awesome beer selections. They also had some great Mexican "Flavored" beer. I finally tried the "Korbelly" that is a huge hit on tap. It's hard to find this beery, especially since it's probably hard to find in Kentucky. The parking is pretty good. There was also an outdoor beer patio, and this place is very much an urban-chic vibe.

This is exactly what I hoped for! A very nice, open environment. With a large fan and an excellent sound system, this is definitely the best concert I have seen here in years! And it was absolutely amazing! Also when our ticket was ready, we had an even bigger table available with many more seats or a bar behind them. All in all, I would definitely recommend The Joy to any fan of Ben Folds.

This place is cool and has a unique way of cleaning your car in a very gentle manner. This is not just another basic car wash. The "snakes" ain't the most slick-cleaning thing on the planet, but I'm sure you want What I loved was the fact that they were able to cut your tires and clean out any loose sludge. The prices are pretty cheap. The most expensive is for $299, while the most affordable is $15-$30/hour. They're usually about a 15-minute wait to make sure you have a spot so if you call your car in the morning, it might

The PJ's on 7th is next to the Rio, where I work. It is a chain restaurant, and is one of the two locations for the chain at this location. A lot of the places I needed jingled while I was at work and only the PJ's in Tunica or Dunlap had j I had a glass of wine with my meal, and liked it. However, the staff did not offer the drinks on ice. I used the cashier to make a cash withdrawal, and the clerk rang me up to give me a receipt for my purchase. I can't wait to go back, but for a few reasons, I'd rather go to the other location in town.

This was our first time into This Was Bugtown, and I was totally excited! It’s a fairly easy place to get to, if you want to take the family. Well, as soon as we walked in, I was taken aback by the large building (as seen above), and the large numbers of insects The bugs were quite large for the price, but they were extremely friendly about it. There is a lot of hands-on exhibits and hands-on activities that you can do with kids, plus some interactive areas. At our time of visit (after school on a Sunday, for work), there are about 25 different species of insects on display. It's definitely a day spent in the woods. This place is definitely worth it for kids.

I am really excited when someone brings a huge crowd like they did at the 2017 St. Lawrence County Homecoming Parade. The crowd was awesome, and at the end of the day it was about the same size as the city. The parade begins around 11:00 am at the church across the street and goes all the way up to the corner of South 3rd Street and First Avenue, and I had a great time.

The place is pretty decent. This location isn't in the heart of the city but it's within a nice walking distance. There are so many good Mexican places around town that I don't feel like spending that much time driving in and out of town to get there. I don't know, maybe it would be a nice change of pace from downtown. I guess one could say, the location is all right, even if there aren't any real options and it makes it rather confusing trying to get At least everyone knew where the nearest subway stop was, rather than walking in. At least, in my experience, it's far from an inconvenient place to eat. I think, compared to other places out in Michigan, the menu is quite extensive, and varies with the season. I would say, however, that the menu is rather limited. I would definitely be willing to drive elsewhere for it, but it's not too far from downtown.

All to say, I was in awe with my experiences at Dmacs. I am writing this in reference to my recent burger experience there and the music they play. I had a fantastic time listening to some of Louisiana's best musicians and I highly recommend this place for anyone who loves great food, great people and great I was in town to celebrate family and friends and when my wife went into town to celebrate her second birthday (in February), she was full of ri And since the event was in March, we were offered a dinner deal. The coupon was a mystery, so I figured if I would go back, it would only mean that they offered me a $25 off menu item He did say that the Yelp event must not be repeated. We stood there waiting for Dmac to approach us. I had had to rethink my burger order and now Dmac's seems to be one of the places I most definitely frequent when I decide to Although we had been in need of a fast food lunch (to avoid the hassle of traveling to nearby locations), we couldn't get that and we had Normally when I go to a new place, my mouth does a little bit of a flex and I am quick to give the experience another It looks and feels like a beef burger, but it is actually a fish burger too. Just not enough to warrant all the cheese. So, I settled on an extra large order, but I'd definitely be back for some more! After my burger (see photo) I proceeded to have some wings. And to top things off they topped it off with a really funky cheesy mustard. They have a full bar and two very entertaining dancers on the weekend with them, so my vote is up. In order to complete our meal we sat in the kitchen and enjoyed the live music as well. As soon as I got up to the counter, the DJ referred me to "Run Down the Road" where the entire place fill with the funky The Jeff Davis Project is an all female blues and soul band. They are an entire ensemble of very talented blues musicians who come to acoustic stations and playing along with a soundtrack of vintage movies. There is a large jazz section as well as the classic house music. The food was just brilliant and by the time we left, we were full in one piece. We left Dmac's with a full stomach and a belly ache. I enjoyed the burgers, the jam sandwiches, the drinks, the live music and the great staff. OH and just in time for this special edition of New Orleans food and drink posts, I'm in the process of putting together 4 more dishes from I was so glad we went along. They even gave us the "free" bag of chips. I enjoyed our meal so much that I had to make it back for dinner to try another dish. I can't wait for our next visit! Well done Mr. DMac! I wouldn't hesitate in a heartbeat to recommend Dmac's for your next big party. As far as service goes I never had a bad experience there. I can't wait to visit again at least a few times before that happens! And we ended up coming back to the Dmac's again.

During my stay in New York the vibe was very French. This is a very well run bed and breakfast with fantastic location and a lovely atmosphere. The rooms are simple, comfortable and with TV's. The owner is very friendly and does an amazing job with making you feel at home. The house has a very nice balcony with a nice view of the street out the window. The house is huge and feels like a lot of space. One of the best things about staying at this place is that there is also an outside shower. If you are staying at this beautiful house you can take in some of the best views and views in town and then then head to the nearby beaches to relax in I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting the city. The price is super reasonable and the rooms are beautiful and the bathroom is very updated.

And I'm not talking about the cheap and cheerful food at Pizzeria Pepsi... this is it. Mystic pizza is a great place to eat when you're not in the mood for a restaurant. You can find everything here ;) and they also have a really cool drink menu. I've always been a fan of the mushroom pizza. I used to go to this place all the time when I lived right around there. I can eat it! We can't wait to get back there to try the pizza on our own. It was soooo good that it inspired me to make a chicken salad next time. You can ask for lunch or dinner. Not a great place for a quick lunch with friends or a few girls before work. They are really nice and they help keep the restaurant clean and so much better than the others in the area.

A great cigar bar in the heart of downtown Milwaukee. Great for social drinks. A great place to go with families and friends. I went with my wife and our 14 year old son because I was the only one there. Thought this place was a good spot for a light Thursday cigar hee! This is a great place to check out. I got a Cuban cigar from the patio. Unfortunately, while the indoors are pretty clean to look at, inside the cigar bar is just about as small. However, I wouldn't recommend it over a restaurant.

"Journeying to the store, it's time for barbecue" is the phrase I like best and have been hearing for some time. There is a huge variation of this in LA that doesn't happen in my area, so I have to just stick with BBQ, which comes along with I was looking for a bar where I could drink some beer while we ate, and after a few minutes of sitting down, we walked inside The restaurant is fairly small and relatively empty. I ordered a sloppy joe, which was very good. We got the Cuban and went for it. The cutlet was a nice dry rub with just a few onions rubbed on top. I had a hot sandwich with onions, lettuce, and peppers. I absolutely love the barbecue sauce, which was a good mix of onion and garlic powder. But it doesn't really even match up in price. It would be best to have the meal outside (and I can guarantee the food will be blah). Why three stars?– Why three? Most of the food is not worth the wait. The seating is too comfortable, and it's really loud. This place also has a beer tent that has table tennis/basketball players playing music on the side of it. If you can avoid the noise and smoke, this is a good place to eat.

Since our move to the Bay Area there were many people that wanted to bring in a lunch, but I had a busy schedule for the day and then This is the place for dinner and lunch at the newest and best lunch spot in the town of Tokyo, Tokyo. But it was worth it as it was so much good food. The poke bowls are made with fresh fish, which is what I really love. I had the King Loa bowl and my boyfriend got the Panko salad bowl. I selected the King Loa bowl because it's so delicious and you can mix it up yourself! I ordered my bowl with a variety of fish: fish with an oil (fish with the skin on), salmon cooked on the grill, raw praw This was more than the amount of food that most restaurants serve, but it was an amazing bowl and my husband wanted the same dish- so he opted It was a lot of food, at least for my palette! I couldn't seem to eat only one bowl in two hours, however because there was a lot of fish in my original bowl, I made room There were so many flavors which I think is a great deal at this price point. The staff was friendly and didn't mind waiting in line and I left full and satisfied. There are also some healthy options including salads and omit. The bowls are made to reuse but it took to long to clean my bowl from the debris that I did not waste. They made me really upset because now I know that I will never see this place again. The prices of the bowls are pretty reasonable, but if you look at the amount of waste that they throw into the trash and the money it takes to It would be really easy to make a bowl out of wood and make it a pretty decent lunch bowl. I love plastic.. and what can I say, I'm a "sleep in the plastic" kind of gal. It's like they brought me their water pitcher for no charge and even brought me my bowl to eat with- I can't believe I didn' :D There would be no need for plastic in the future. They don't have any plastic waste to wash away and they are still sustainable. I'm definitely coming back for lunches, but I'm going on a mission to make some changes for the future.

On my way to work this week, I came across a new place Izzo's. I think it's definitely worth going for when it comes to Mexican. I think paying $11 per person with that many fixings probably would be too much. The food is great, just isn't great quality. I do like that they have a bit of an "on-the-go" feeling to the place, and that it's easy to pop in I got a message about it right when I arrived. And I also can get there early too, and I can pick up my food just before the other patrons, so if you go in they can come So far I haven't had any issues with the food (I've ordered online and called ahead and asked for a table for two), but Don't you love that? I love this place!

At first, I felt stoked about this place, but the gimmicky feel made me feel bad that I had to write a First, they have a DJ out on the main bar. This is a great place to get your karaoke on if you have time for it. The second thing is that they serve really good meat, which means it's pretty good quality meat when you call it a burger. You can get any kind of meat for that price. Also, they have all kinds of cheap beers. They also serve a small menu of frozen yogurt for $6, which is really great for a quick get-together. You even get to try karaoke on Thursdays too! And I can't blame the service if people keep forgetting to clean the tables, too.

In the past I have visited the restaurant Slater & Company and they have both been beautiful to look at. For some reason, I walked in. It was my first time and it was a lot of fun. Everything looks so gorgeous and it is definitely worth a visit. I wanted to take pictures of my meal and I was looking for the perfect photo, so I asked with my photographer if we could take photos in the church I felt very welcome and comfortable. The waitress was very friendly, and my favorite part of the meal was the charred eggplant. A bit of a let down, but I'm so glad this place is still open. I love the idea of a martini in a glass when the drinks are made with a blend of fruits & flavors. For my starter, I got the rabbit rillette with duck fat rillette and fig jam. For my salad, I got the grilled chicken (I'm not a meat person but since it was  Grilled chicken, it was super It had a nice texture to it and was just the right amount of rabbit. The biscuit was so rich and buttery and it was delicious right from the start. I opted for the Grilled Halibut with Turkey, Onion Soup and Onion Popcorn. The fish was tender, the eggplant was roasted perfectly and the salsa was sweet. The fish was not really cooked, but the texture was very good, almost like a boneless fish. The flavor is so different from most of the fish I've had in a while. The chicken was perfectly done, the sauce it came with was very mild, but gave the restaurant a very rich, flavorful. The vegetarian dish was actually pretty good; the eggplant was so fresh enough that I didn't hate it. The service was slow, but not in a bad way. I will definitely go back!

This is one of my favourite bars in the casino. We were playing here after work, and while we were there, the restaurant was very overcrowded, so it took a while to get a table. We saw the guy, our waiter, and decided to stop in. We waited in line for pretty long until a server approached. Then right after ordering we got a huge bill- our glasses were never called back. The bartender made mistakes like she didn't pour her beer in the proper glass a couple of times, but she made up for it and that Our first order was a hotdog and chicken wings. It was the kind of thing that you buy a couple of times a year in a drive-thru-- if your local grocery It was very good and we ended up eating 4 of them. We got our appetizer, which was just a beetroot salad. So I went to check out the other apps, and I was totally bummed when the bartender took the iced tea from the mug Luckily, we found her right away and she came up to ask us again. I went in with a small group and paid $5, but there was way too much food to consider. We paid and left, and we will probably go back next time. If it's just a few seats in the bar, it won't be a problem.

Frosty's was one of the first places I stopped for lunch before attending the New Orleans Fashion Week! I must have heard of Frosty's on a friend recommendation from their website. I am so happy to say that Frosty's Pho is here! Ice coffee served with a cup of hot soup. At first you have to ask for a menu because the small wait room makes it more of a cafe atmosphere. It is very clean and the menu is huge. I got the pork pho and it was delicious! It was served with a bowl of greens (which were good because I'm vegetarian) along with 2 pieces of chicken, one green leaf and  The other items on the menu are soups, wrap and salads. Iced tea with ice and cream also came in a cute little cup. We will be back, I highly recommend this place.

What makes this place so great? I love coming to Winston's to grab a few drinks with some friends (or just as a place to sit and chat). It is just so cozy and that is what makes a great bar. It's a lot closer to home, you know the rest of that area outside of the hotel is going to be a hotdog bar / While everyone else is walking away, they sit down at the bar and talk about their night together and we all know we will be together when that time comes in The music there is really good and the crowd here is very friendly. Winston's has a small outdoor patio where you can enjoy the sounds of fishing and boats or just just sit out and have a drink. It's one of those spots that you just really love to stop in and enjoy a drink while sitting on the couch.

My boyfriend recommended Oxalis to me recently and I had to try it out. It has been really easy to find, because it's so popular since the first time they opened in New York. As you can see I was pretty excited to get there for some'me' time with some friends. Everyone was sofriendly and it was the perfect place to get dressed up for a date or just to relax. That means you can have all three courses of our meal in one sitting and there's no need to wait for a table to fill, so we got While I have some favorites, including the pork shoulder, mushrooms, radish, and bone marrow and bread, you can get anything on their menu Of course, the bone marrow was so wonderful that the restaurant was even more amazing. pomme frites were not as delicious as the bone marrow but the bread was really tender and moist. And then we moved on to the rillettes. I had a tiny piece of anchovies and the only way I could describe it was, "omg- these were THILLES The rillettes were incredibly tender and the sauce that they came with was definitely something I would love to try! I really wanted to buy a tray of these, just so I could have one of everything. We took out our food from the buffet and got some apps as well...which included a burger and two side apps. This was truly amazing. On the menu there is also an amazing cheeseburger with sauce! It didn't pack as much flavor, but I did like it. For dessert, we got the lemon cake. You got to see the cute little barrel, the cheesecake and the cake. I loved the contrast between the sweet cakes and the bourbon. The barrel cake was delish too. It was paired with a cup of chocolate ice cream and was a delicacy for dessert. I love this place! Thank you so much!!!

I've been to the Red Rice, where I used to work. I came with my friends to Vietnamese & Co. I was told by some people this place is pretty good, so we stopped in. Food was great.. The rolls are very special, because they take up like the center of the wrapper and come with a layer of hot and fresh spring roll filling. I love spring rolls, especially at Vietnamese restaurants. they were made out of frozen Vietnamese shrimp, which isn't usually the case. The sauce was really good. The sauce was actually sweet, with a little bit of garlic. The brisket and eye round steak was really juicy and the sauce was great. When I started the pho dish, I was really impressed by the size of the bowl and how big it was. The pho was a little blah for the restaurant, but the pho was actually really good, so maybe I will make it again. The wait was pretty quick. Overall, overall, pretty good. Would definitely recommend. They have great beer selection and it looks to be an awesome place.
This complex is a great shopping center. It has great stores, but at times the space screams older storefronts or dated stores. There is also a movie theater. Also have a great library inside.

I think that this is the closest Mediterranean restaurant on the East Side- it is really that good. I like this place because its all of clean, but very friendly. I had the catered salad with grape leaves and lemon, it was really good. They were not only moist and tender but also topped with hummus, aioli sauce, and pesto that was also very good. Next was the beef tenderloin topped with hummus, garlic and oil. A little of everything, including the hummus (I didn't buy in bulk, so I tried it out because I needed it last minute) and The beef was cooked well and the rice was very tasty. Their hummus is a little smooth and a bit bit thick. They even gave us extra wine which was so awesome! We also got a great pitcher of wine which will set you back a little more after the main dish. I must add that this restaurant opened as a deli out of a convenience store- I mean, really- this is on a corner of 2 They came to our hotel and also made our rooms just right, we had a shower in the tub, and I love when a restaurant makes those extra Cleo was recommended by my co-worker and they would definitely recommend him and his staff!

The gallery was very fun and very cool. I really liked the gallery in the Bella Vista shopping center. I'm glad I took a trip out to North Carolina to visit this gallery. Great experience!I'll be back.

Gretna has a really fun city to explore too. This is a small town, one of my favorite places in the U.S. The river views, history, and oldtown feel are a big draw to this neighborhood of the city. There are a good number of shops, bars, grocery stores, restaurants and more to be found downtown Gretna. Especially in the summer, when it is still covered in ivy and all that, but you can still see beautiful trees in the winter right in There is a really cool farmer's market in Old Gretna. They have pretty good food and the prices are really affordable. Gretna also hosts the annual Riverfront music festival every second weekend. This is one of the coolest things about Gretna. There is also an annual summer festival that is held in early July. There is often a crowd of about 50 or so people here and the weather could not be better for it. So, there is really a lot of things to do in Old Gretna. You can check out all the things that Gretna has to offer here.

I found Blue Tomato at the Blue Tomato Cafe outside of our office in Lincoln, NE. It's a small restaurant and doesn't really offer much beyond what is already shown on the menu. Not everyone wanted to go.
