Hank's corner store stands and sits atop the Louisiana Street Lights on French Quarter. This place is the neighborhood's one-stop shop and has become a place of relaxation in the heart of the city. Even if you aren't familiar with the area, you can feel the charm by visiting Hank's and its charming neighborhood. Since the original Hank's Supermarket is a corner store, you get a little bit of everything, along with a little something unusual to People don't often make their way up to the door at all, and it doesn't bode well for the atmosphere. It's a hidden gem within the Bywater, but some people miss the point. If you're craving a little something different, like wings... they're always on the menu at Hank's. I've heard all about the fried chicken, but I've never had the idea of eat it straight out of the package. I was lucky in that, in this case, it was a pretty good selection too. The food is also great, but not only fried chicken, as it's a lot of options; a salad bar, sandwiches, beer  You'll be rewarded for your fried chicken loves here with a cold beverage, a cold beer on a cold winter day, a You should definitely check out this spot. This is the first time that I've ever tried Thai food and I've had them in the States - that won't be the last time I highly recommend, and will definitely come back again.

Sterling Photo and Frame is a very nice place to visit if you want to see some art for your home or have some great photos to frame. The work is really good. It was a very nice job that the staff did and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who was looking for a framing service. Rum House is a really popular Cuban restaurant that has been open for years. No one had been there yet for happy hour. There were tons of people eating, drinking, and watching TV. At the beginning, we ordered some chips and salsa that were so good. I was so excited to try something new, and I am really glad I did! While still  drinking I decided to order a Cuban plate. It was so good! They had lots of great sauces, and they were very friendly. I loved it and it was a delicious size, too! They also served a huge martini, and that was actually my only Negroni! : The Fried Chicken Festival! What a weekend! There will be no more summer events starring Louisiana Fried Chicken! I stopped by Zea's last week for lunch. I had read very good reviews online and I was glad I did not need to wait long to get my food. The catfish was not available, so I ordered the white catfish with rice, and a guacamole cocktail sauce on the side. They had a decent selection of sauces for the portions and the staff was friendly. I will definitely be back.

The Holt Cemetery is a beautiful historic cemetery in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. An unusual find since it was founded less than a century ago. This cemetery is a really important place for people to visit in New Orleans as it is a place where many of the elderly & poor were buried The graves are pretty different and have a very "homey" feel to them. Some of the graves are only 2 feet in diameter, sometimes 3 feet and even 4 feet tall. When you walk out the front (as you drive by) you find many people buried below the ground, many of whom were poor. But there's something beautiful about their uniqueness - it is just plain beautiful. If you are a part of the community, make sure to come check out the graves.

The Brink House is in a somewhat snazzy setting in Soho, but not in a good way. I have dined at August a few times, and I have always enjoyed the food and atmosphere. They have always offered lunch specials and to top it off a free dessert. Although the food just wasn't good, it was a great place to eat, and theambiance added to the experience. I would go with my friend instead, but since I lived a few blocks away, I would never be able to make it in. It started off with a really nice, fresh dinner we had a while back, but we were able to get the very best of both for the It has been a favorite of mine for a long time because of all the great ingredients I enjoy on the main menu, but the seating is limited. That was an extra bonus for me because that's what I do for Christmas. My friends and I met up at 6pm at April's, while August was already full. The restaurant is beautiful and had a lot of room in most of the tables. While we browsed through the menu, I did notice the menu. In the middle was a fried green bell pepper along with a few bits of raw shrimp and crab. When I got to the main course and seen the fried oysters the first thing I thought of was July's catch of the day. I thought these were amazing. I love that the oysters were lightly fried with a thin layer of oil. The potato crusting was super light, and it added a nice bit of seasoning to the fried shell. I would definitely try to order these again. I am a fan. It was all worth the money. My husband agreed with me that he really didn't give much thought to this dish, so I just decided to have it. In fact it was pretty much the best fish I have ever had. It was a simple meal, but I couldn't get enough of it so I ended up sharing two plates of this with my boyfriend. So, as I walked by to get our dessert, I was thinking about how easy it was to come in and order the assorted cheeses. It was a small plate of 6 cheeses in a bowl. The cheese in this combination was so perfectly creamy and I was just a little bit nervous after tasting it. I was happy to leave happy after all of this food. You really must try it for yourself. If you are a foodie, have a nice week, and want to dine at August, please let me know! I didn't have a clue as to how to use the olive oil and since I don't have the time to sit in front of the kitchen However, the lobster could be served a bit more spicy for me and my tastes of cheese would be limited. At the end of the day, you can go inside to see all the dishes on the menu but if you're into dessert, you can go outside

I came here on Saturday night for a drink and was blown away. Of course I was looking forward to this place, but I was super excited because even though I love the Older Peoples' Pub. The place is mainly jive drinkers but it's super comfortable, and it's nice to be out on the sand with other It was a fun experience, but I would only go back if it was on another night.

I purchased the trip to Dickie Brennan's from Groupon and couldn't be happier. My friends and I shared a reservation at this beautiful restaurant, but for the next 10 minutes I was only sitting there waiting for our food. First, we walked into the bar which had such a beautiful feel. From my visit the Maitre D was friendly, helpful and efficient. At the same time, our server was checking off our menus, reading the menu and finding the table for us to sit in. The menu features some amazing and hearty meals. We each ordered a crab cake and creamed corn. The crab cake got the same moist texture throughout the whole dish that I had enjoyed with the soft shell crab. Very healthy- almost all the crab went into the crab tail, which I couldn't help but enjoy. As a second course, we ordered a blue cheese steak and corn, both of which were very filling. My wife did not like it as well, but I couldn't wait for it to go on. My favorite dish was the rack of lamb with mashed potatoes on top and my favorite item was the steak with fries. I was impressed, the beef was tender, and the sauce was delicious. We also had fries and peas on a bed of spinach. Both sides were very refreshing, tangy and delicious. The cranberries and fruit were fresh and fresh and the green beans were cooked just right! Next we had the crab cake with creamed corn and arugula. This was so delicious that you could eat it even when the rest of your appetite has gone. They had an amazing drink- we thought about purchasing three, but decided that was too much too soon. This was our first time in this venue and not only was everything superb, but the staff was also very friendly and helpful. He also reminisced and said to please get your bill in a timely manner to avoid disappointment. A side of butter and the crab also made our meal so much more enjoyable. It is not an "every one's meal", it is the best one!

For me, if you walk to a corner store and get a drink at a bar, you can never go wrong with the Bulldog. You can feel the excitement rising from inside the bar if you have been hanging out and there is always something new to try. I've had beers on almost every tap list and this is definitely on my list of " must visit" bars. It is very popular on Sundays, but it makes for great seating, both indoors and outdoors. I like that it is fairly open on weekend evenings. This place has a great atmosphere and the service on tap is top-notch. The bartenders are always friendly and give you good beer recommendations. They are helpful and kind, and I have no issue with having to ask for my server to help me. The bartenders have a LOT of beers on draft, so I have no problem getting one that is great. Sometimes, if you ask the bartender what the best beer to try for you, they will offer to try some on you. They also have an arcade and a dart board for all your table games. This is a good area for outdoor eating, and there are probably TONS of parking spaces around in case your car will be late again that night. You can also order food to go on the patio. They also have a wonderful patio by the kitchen (and I love it because they are so nice). It is a great place to visit with friends and family.

I don't do White Linen Night. Not really..Never. Crowds of pretentious people. Yes.Momentum. People who wear sexy outfits and walk through galleries. YEY! I was in New Orleans this summer on business, and after working as a bartender for a couple of months, I ventured back downtown to As we were staring at the walls waiting for the driver range, I began to notice that one section of the bar behind the counter was going to get  There is a small restaurant inside the bar/club, but the restaurant itself is so small (didn't notice that. I don't know, but I assumed it would be a bar). I ordered the chicken quesadilla with ranch dressing and it came with a side salad which I loved. The menu looks pretty standard, with a bar, but the food looked impressive, especially the salads. The salad was packed with everything I could really want in a salad, and the chicken quesadilla was one of the best I have ever The chicken quesadilla was a little bit overpriced but it was pretty good. This is a really fun place because there was a patio out on the corner, so you don't need to bring your umbrella so there wasn' The food was really good and the place was pretty chill. The next time I go there, I'll make sure to make sure we hit the driving range for some fun!

If you have room on your mind for a bloody mary, I recommend checking out St. George's. The Bloody Marys had been voted upon based on appearance, taste, and flavor by locals. I just wish I could find it if it was in my area! This particular location was very busy, but the bar area was very nice as well. We had to be inside a few minutes to wait for seats. I felt almost like I was in "Las Vegas", in terms of ambiance. I enjoyed it as well. The Bloody Mary was delectable. I would definitely go back to try a cocktail as an alternative to the bar!

I usually drive by this place when I have the evening free and am too hungry to drive out of town for lunch. If there is anything at all that you can compare it to, it ain't bad. They always have great sandwiches, they have a good selection and it doesn't matter if they are chain or fast food. The food is a touch sweet though. Instead I come here and ask for the chicken salad sandwich. And, like almost the last reviewer, I usually get a side of cole slaw. I also get the Turkey wrap and I do dread the buns of a chicken wrap when taking them out of the package. I am also a fan of the shakes. They also have a bar where you can get a beer, ice cream or a mimosa, that's just my idea of fun I would still say it's a good fast food joint!

I don’t normally write reviews in my blog, I don’t mind writing about restaurants myself, but I’ve had a chance to review  I like doing things like this that I had heard were good, but they tend to be very forgettable. I recently popped by GW Fins and picked up some shrimp and grits. In fact, I thought I would do something special for my birthday and I did. I decided to use one of my favorite restaurants online, called GW Fins, and made a reservation. This will save you a lot of time and money. We made a reservation and got there at 8:30. We were not disappointed. It was the Spicy Shrimp Appetizer. The shrimp medley was very tender and perfectly cooked. It was served with grits, corn chips and cheese, and was topped with a whole bunch of green peppers. I was quite happy with the taste of this dish and decided to share it and bring another person with me because I want to try new things as well. I decided to get the filet mignon. My waiter gave an excellent presentation and then took my orders. This was great.I think my girlfriend decided to eat a bowl of this or get it but didn't have the stomach room so it definitely turned It cooked perfectly, still have a nice flavor and wasn't too salty. This dish was completely covered with crab meat, which added a great texture and was not a very salty dish. This dish could be one of my favorite meals of the year. The dessert that I was served was a very special cake. I got the chocolate dipped pretzel. This dessert came in layers with layered ice cream, salted caramel, chocolate cake and chocolate covered salted caramel. It had been sitting in my fridge for days now and it was ready to be unwrapped. All of these delicious dishes can only be topped with one of their desserts. It was a great time and it was a great place to go on a special day. The decor of the restaurant is very nice, the food is great, and the whole staff is excellent. They showed us the tables right away and asked the chef to check on us and was so eager about it. It was such a great experience and will be a permanent favorite in my book, but I've never thought that I could say so much more about What a way to start your day. I cannot wait to return. My family and I would definitely come back.

Dot's is a cute little diner that opened up in April of 2011. It's really close to my house, so when it opened, we just started walking in and out. On Saturday afternoon I visited a friend and we went inside for a quick brunch. Almost immediately, I heard the opening song when I walked in so I knew that it was time to order. I was not feeling too particular with what I wanted to order, so what I eventually settled on was the Big Dot breakfast, which is a breakfast that Our first order was the breakfast combo. It had three hot dogs, a cheeseburger, french toast, a biscuit and my choice of a cheeseburger, bacon, and a side It was $19.99 and that included the pancakes, breakfast, bacon and hash browns. But on this day I am actually really not a big fan of breakfast, which was my intention this morning. This was only about 15 minutes in my opinion. I like how they keep the breakfast really fresh, though. Everything was just salt, pepper and whatever else you can think of. Don't think that it's great, but I love that you can walk in and wait in the line! I think the only issue with this place is that it's pretty small. We won't be coming back, though, because I'm in the mood for something new. It's a nice place to park and go for a nice day out.

I have recently gotten into bars/bars and this was one of the spots I decided to go, thinking that it'd only be for girls. I don't go to this place anymore (I've seen a lot of nicer places). It goes to show what a great place this is in the hood of the city for any guy or girl that loves drinks and a nice patio. We went to an early show at the Half Moon and our hosts were really sweet, everyone had a great manner. I think there are really plenty of amazing Mexican restaurants in Chicago that would be worth coming here for.

I had seen some reviews in the past where this place looked really good. I didn't have a chance to taste the food at this place, but we did manage to go. And the food was delicious, so maybe my stomach ache was a sign of a good party. So we looked around at the time we came. Not too long, but the wait was very long. The place is a little too warm there for my taste, but hmmm. It took quite a while for our food to arrive, but the food was great. I went with the chicken mousse, which I didn't think was what I wanted at first. After a while the staff stopped serving the meals, so we ordered small rounds of it. I tried it with cheese and served myself up with my fingernails, but it was tooggy to hold onto. I'm not gonna lie: I'm not gonna lie to you - but they were so delicious. So, we did order the drum and spinach. Well, it came with 4 bites of drum and the spinach itself. And really? what the hell am I trying to eat? Let me tell you about a really tiny portion of chicken liver mousse! There was nothing wrong with my meal. The drum in the spinach was beautiful, incredibly tender, perfectly prepared and just everything I wanted in a good meal. But sometimes I just ate a little too much to satisfy my stomach. If it just wasn't so generous, I might have been a bit disappointed. That seems fair. I thought the serving size was a fair amount of food, so definitely be sure to pay attention to the price. "Ahem, really?" When it was the last thing we want to do on a Friday night, we weren't that hungry. I'll do this again soon.

I walked in to this shop a few days ago and while I wasn't in a hurry, I thought that they would be fun to check Most of the crafty things are very inexpensive, so if you are looking for something cheap from Target, look for something other than Michael's. They also carry Christmas stuff and stuff I don't buy for my grandbabies (not sure which), like the Polaroid camera above. I don't have a regular Michael's location in the area, but this has been very close and I have been looking on the internet for film I was walking around looking for cheap (and fairly rare) Instax cameras, and I didn't see any. The Polaroid camera in the picture above looks like it could have been purchased at this store, but the price I paid for it amounted to The other thing I noticed was the display, which is super cool and the display has really cute items including baby items, kids toy jars,  I don't usually get the chance to stop in this location because so many of the sales I do try to be on are always on Michael's website

A great bar in a great location. The food is good and the atmosphere is quaint enough to be a comfortable place to hang out. The menu is really good, I ordered a few different items and the waitress was really good. It was pretty easy to park, and the bar had a great patio that overlooked the city. The decor is cute and decorated with an old 1940's-era sign saying "Since 1979...Early 90s". The price is fairly affordable and you get what you pay for... I don't know if it's better or what it actually is. The only down side is that the outdoor seating was limited, but that's ok.

Cherry Espresso has been around for a while now and has always been a nice local favorite. Cherry was a local favorite for over 10 years and it came a long way, after the coffee parlor was sold to the other establishments. I am not a coffee snob, but after reading the recent reviews about the location I decided to give Cherry a try. Cherry's first year is looking like it will be great. Cherry Espresso is small and cozy, but it is very clean in feel. I love the vibe here and it really makes me feel like I am sitting in the very heart of Louisiana. Cherry espresso is well known for their delicious coffee and this store is no different. The atmosphere here is friendly and it is so much more comfortable than what I had at Stein's Deli. While Cherry does not carry quite as many items as Stein's, they do carry everything that a customer would want in an iced coffee.

When I go to Beirut, the first place I'll go is Beirut Authentic by Dina. The most memorable order the last time I went there was goat (but if it didn't sound good, I'd go to a cafe to Here's another awesome meal, with goat. it's a small portion, but definitely worth it. If I were going for authentic Greek food, it may be the end of my night. Then I get the goat kosher, and to be fair, that is only available in certain weeks for a limited time. That's what I got at Buenos Aires for lunch and I have to give it a try before returning. But if I can, I will eat it. And the club is cool too, I mean, why? But I haven't been there for dinner yet. Yep, it's definitely hot, cold and romantic! Oh, but it's not for me. I don't even know what to eat...but I'll eat the chickpeas. And happy!?...well, I am!

My review of the Green Building is on because I really, really like it. This time around, I was there for a business meeting in downtown and wanted to show this place off. It is a really nice building, but there are some very difficult parking spots to get onto the street. I got into a few issues when I parked there, though, and I have to say that parking is pretty iffy. The entrance entrance is the only entrance they have, and they have this big metal sign with the name of the building which is pretty random. The parking meters are usually located in the front, as opposed to inside the building. There's two banks within the building. For the food court, in between the 2 levels, you can find both the food court and the bar/cafe. These places are nice and I'd really like to go back.

The playground equipment is definitely to the kid's taste. You can find it on I-10 north of the city, right outside of the intersection with North River St. It's open to the community and for children It is a little small and there are a couple of different playgrounds, but overall, it's a good place for kids to play. There are benches and swings for children to sit on. They have a good play area and playground. I would say maybe some playground equipment should be removed because it's a bit dark already. Also, the park itself can be dangerous. I won't give up on this one, but it takes some getting used to. So, please just be aware of that if you go there. Although it might be nice, it's not ideal for an afternoon snack.

You can get in at this bar for both open hours and closed hours. The event took place at an unspecified location on a gorgeous piece of property that overlooks the city and backs up to the mountains. Located outside one of the restaurants is a great lookout for this restaurant. The entrance has a courtyard which opens out to a full length covered patio in the yards. The space inside of the venue is great! This has a large open floor plan, the patio has the table space, and the kitchen is next door to the bar. On the night I was there, it was fairly busy due to the party at the venue and no one was busy making any noise. It was a very nice occasion with wonderful food and everyone enjoyed themselves. We went in on a Friday night and the food was amazing.

I stumbled onto this place on my way home from Boston, MA. I was there to buy some music for the house. It has a few new releases on vinyl. It's located off of New Orleans' historic East 5th Street. The records included in this shop are very solid records, but that doesn't mean they're all good. They have some of the best records from New Orleans, especially in the newer era. The selection is fairly extensive, and the staff was helpful. I've been here for one night in recent weeks and it's been good!

I went to this place for dinner and I still think that it is fairly average for anything on the menu. Beware, this is on the side of the mall, so it is not as clean as other buffets. I think this is a good place. I would definitely go back.

The place I was last night was called Fuji Hana and I had lunch there. I went recently to a show that went on for 45 minutes and it was really good. I wasn't sure about how they chose the rolls and was wondering if I'd like to try something a little different than other places. While everything did come out to be good, the average rice was a bit dry. I am still not a high protein fan but I did enjoy them, and I'm definitely going to check out the other rolls at this restaurant. The service was pretty good and this place is in close proximity to my apartment and work which is just extra good. If you're looking for an unique sushi experience, I think this place is definitely worth it. I think that this is a place that we'll be going back to.

Since I live at the same place as Don Bohns, I can take advantage of their services on the street. I did a bad job on my car on the afternoon of April 23 last year. The guys here at Don Bohn went above and beyond to fix my fender and get me and my family back on the road. There seemed to be alot of damage to the rear end in all of the images, but after a few days I had my car back in better At the front desk, I was referred here via one of their great Yelp reviews. I highly recommend this shop.

Another great coffee shop at a good price. I personally only go to PJ's when I feel like watching the big match. For starters, the atmosphere is nice. I received a free cup of coffee (which I haven't had in a while) the next day. I've been to a lot of coffee shops in the past, but the one in this one was great! I'll go back and try their milkshake as well.

By the end of my trip to Orleans, I had moved back to New Orleans, and decided on The Company Burger as my new favorite New Orleans burger restaurant After going to High Hat over the weekend, I did not want to spend the night at The Company. Our table was inside The Company on a corner in one of the smallest parking lots in town, and was surrounded by a lot of fun crowd I ordered a beer and ordered out on the patio, and I didn't forget to bring my camera, because my boyfriend was staring at me pretty At 3 am I was ready to dive into the menu, but I had a few things already to do. The salad I ordered was the "Chuck's Soup", that came with soup. With gumbo (yeah, I can't remember why I ordered this from a gumbo restaurants in the first place), I I opted for a bowl of hot soup, which was just a bit warm, but I couldn't resist a bowl of tomato soup. I guess my "sauce" wasn't as strong as I was used to. The burger on the other hand was delicious! However, I am not sure if this was their thing. The pimento cheese is a great part of the burger, it makes it much more delicious. However, since the cheese was spread (for me) on a paper towel (and the burger wasn't cooked through), I couldn't think I had a perfect burger, and can't wait to come back. While this was a great burger, I thought that if it wasn't for a lack of pimento in the burger, it I felt that it could be a little more flavorful. They have the best sauces, the best bread (not made at High Hat), the best seasonings, and of course the best burger I'

I came in for Lunch on Monday and walked in with my friend at 1:30 a.m. With Christmas on the horizon, it would be perfect to stop in here for some Vietnamese food to go while we were shopping as if we were sitting at We decided to eat both a spring roll and pork bn. The rice paper spring rolls were fabulous! I can only describe them as tender and incredibly chewy as well as thick yet slightly chewy. The pho tasted almost like the old frog (the pork), though. However, the pork bn wasn't so great and we decided to take the chance and get a really good bowl of it. I would have to say the spring rolls (and the egg roll) were really good as well, as I think the sauce was very mild but not too strong It was really filling and you could see there was so much going on. Not that there isn't anything wrong with meat being overdone, but I definitely wasn't too hungry. We opted for a nice glass of white sangria as well! It was very smooth. I wasseated in the bar on the second floor and there washardly a wait. However, I came there with little problems and the food was amazing and the staff was very friendly. We were really nice here, and the hostess was great. If you didn't notice my absence, it would have been 5-10 minutes from the time your table was ready to be cleared when the waiter came over We didn't hear a single person talk about the wait. In fact, I don't mind waiting at all. Although the place did take an incredibly long time to get seated; I do understand if people are waiting hours to get their food. I've had a wait for about a half hour or so in New Orleans and it was nice to just be here. If you go during happy hour, be aware that there are still seats open and that they are always looking for business. For my friend, the fried rice was really good too. For my first meal in New Orleans, I was definitely not disappointed. I will be stopping back here soon!

I have been here quite a bit, I enjoy a nice little draft beer selection, and I really liked the live music, especially if you like We've gone here every single month or so, and our only complaint is that there is a lot of plastic in the seating and that besides the We have had beer in the evenings and the wait time is not too bad. One of the really cool things about the bar is the free Wi-Fi and the local DJ is on here just about most nights. I have also eaten at here on my own at their "wine week"- although I have yet to try it myself with other brew, I

I was in a bit of a wait after the party when I came in, so I was seated very quickly. If you're looking for Mexican food, I'd say avoid this place but if you're dining out, it's certainly worth a I didn't feel like my food would be a disappointment, but I felt like my meals were on the pricey side. There were other items on the menu, but I really didn't like that they charged me for queso. This one was kind of cool. I don't mind free food- I just like the feeling of it for people having an immediate taste. I wasseated as my food arrived quickly, which is always something to be desired. I should have stayed there a little longer. A small burrito was popped out of the tortilla which was about inches round. It was pretty much beef, with no meatballs and nothing new- not that it wasn't a good looking burrito. I'm not really interested in Mexican food either, but it wasn't bad. The beans were alright, but really, there was nothing to jazz it up at all. I didn't really care for the tortillas as they were extremely hard, but I didn't mind that much. There is no free chips and salsa and there is really nothing other than free chips and salsa. I probably won't be going back with those expectations.

Dis & Dem was one of our favorite "eat local" restaurants in Charlotte; they were very popular in the late 80s, but when they decided to My friends used to call it "The Druid of New York", err... errr... errrrrr There's one thing about Dis and Dem: it's not a sit-down food joint. My friend and I went there when they first opened and had been here everyday at least a year. Unlike the other Pittsburgh burger joints, the kitchen smelled nice and is always fresh. It has a really small kitchen on the table, and a few customers working there- oops- I am not sure. The selection is pretty standard and I ordered some American cheeseburger with lettuce, tomatoes, and some potatoes and bacon. We didn't feel like we were just eating it, it was amazing. Despite the large size, it wasn't that heavy, and though it wasn't exactly an easy burger, there was much more than enough meat The bun was cooked just perfectly and the entire burger was extremely juicy. The price was a little high as they were not open for lunch and their burger was rather dry, but that was probably worth it for the burger They're not just offering the classics- they're offering something a little different. I thought it was really good, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone who's hungry! Most of their burgers are on the medium (likely around $6) side and are pretty large. They even have a special sauce for the burgers- tangy and spicy! And if you want, you can order their "Red Velvet" special which is a burger with a mojito, but I definitely recommend their restaurant.

Jen and I walked up and down the towering tree to take this shot. It's so peaceful, and you will never forget it. Beautiful day time flowers and brightly colored leaves of every color to match, this place makes me feel like a kid again. Instead of walking over, I took my camera, and captured both the tree and the people.

So I was there for dinner just before 8:00. For lunch I went with the seabass salad and the rainbow roll both were very delicious. We started with their squid salad, which is a very nice, fresh green salad. The salad was fresh and a little bit chewy. I was seriously jaw-dropped, and got about a couple bites. I ordered the squid Salad and my friend did the same. The salmon was nice and it came served with some rice to keep it from filling up even more. The rainbow is fresh yellowtail, salmon, tuna and tuna wrapped in a thin layer of yellowtail and salmon. For such a simple sushi roll you would need to rely on the ingredients that were already on the menu in order for the roll to be good because they The fantastic roll looked really interesting, so we went for it. This was a tamagoshi roll which had a bunch of fish and was covered in some kind of mixture of soy sauce, soy sauce You can also get some vegetables on the side. I ordered a bit of a lemonade because it was sweetened with lime, which tasted great. Just give 'em a try!

I was verypleasantly surprised to see a comedy at the Bell House. They also have a weekly poker tournament. I have even heard of them having a musical. The food is the same. I don’t know who the band is...but it seems like there’s a decent amount of people there to watch them play.

I've been coming to this bar for a while and was blown away. I do love this place for live music. Like many other reviewers I've been going there for live music and to the occasional bar event. They have a wide selection of local musicians that are awesome to check out and I really enjoyed their performance in St. Louis last weekend.

When I looked at all the restaurants in the Charlotte area, it seems that I didn't know what to get for breakfast, so I turned to my friend For my birthday, I gave my husband and I the opportunity to go somewhere new. I was so excited about going there for lunch and decided to check it out. The inside restaurant has a bar which has a few seats on each side of the dining area. One can probably just tell that this place would be better during the cold months. While the bartenders were working, the server was super friendly and was very patient. One of the other "services" that I noticed was the service we had today on our last visit to Elizabeth's, it was pretty bad for 10 You know how I can be a glutton for punishment, right? I also ordered the fried eggs with cream and greens. (As for how I feel about grazing and how my mother and her husband treat me.) As I left the restaurant I was wanting to eat more but I didn't want to wait. They have more unique menu and, at the time of writing, the breakfast menu is way overpriced. I need some country spicing up after all the white bread and fried potatoes. The server told me that the food at this place can be made into a larger dish if you just let them know and they'll make it for For that, I rely on a good egg plate. I know I said that all together, but there wasn't any better.

This little book was originally published by R.F. The city can't help but be called La Vidin, the French word meaning "the old city". I can't think of a book that could make this comparison to Philly. I was inspired to tell the story while I was in University, because I wanted to be the one taking care of Ignatius. He seems to have an all-American perspective on life...which is great, since he has always felt in love with and cared for many people around I love it so much I can't imagine not being able to read what Ignatius, his family and I did together.

In case you didn't hear of Flora, it's a coffee shop in Little Rock, Arkansas. I always like this coffee shop a bit, and the people are always friendly. I have taken my dogs here quite a few times (not just on their first few visits). It was a perfect weather day, but this shop looks very "hipster" in my opinion. They sell coffee, tea, honey, nuts and other treats, some of which are sweet and some are really hot. A small patio is served outside. There was a large selection of bottled wines, including an array of local beers as well as a few wine and beer apps. I'm not really sure what you'd expect from this coffee shop, but I'd say it's pretty good. The waitresses were a little loud, but they were also very nice.

Went into the Dollar Tree yesterday, in order to get my gas tank topped up. Their food is average. I had the chance to come here for a clearance price and find out that they had a sale on (not quite the same, but I guess its I ordered it online as they said they had it on special as well. So when I called and asked, they said it's on sale at my local store. I also took a look at an item I was trying to purchase from an Internet store, and it wasn't on sale. However, I was told that if someone would come back to it, they might bring it back. In my opinion, the store is pretty average, they aren't worth the time. After all it was in the store, and there was no sign, I just walked in, took a few pics, and left.

I was recently downtown and stopped by the hardware store on South Main. I can't think of a single person from South Lake Tahoe! that has not been helped here at least once, but not many of them are as lucky as this place, even if you are a first time handy I mean, this is the second largest hardware store I've been in, and i've seen a lot of the brands I keep my eyes Here is a place that offers you air compressors! And what's the tis? I have a big job today and I can't leave without getting something from here. I'll keep you posted on what I find when I'm in there. I've had them do my nails for years and they are still great.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting a local food place called Mellow Mushroom. We went on Saturday evening to try Mellow Mushroom. We ordered salads which included their famous Mushroom Salad and the Basil Shrimp Salad. That's Greek salad with Greek dressing, romaine, basil, fresh tomatoes and cheese. For lunch, we ordered the pizza and then split it between two people. They also had a small enchiladas which I really liked, but the challah was nice. It came with a lot of salad and it was really filling and delicious. It was served on a nice stale crust with some garlic on top and some fresh herbs and spices to help it with its garlic-y flavor. The price for pizza is not cheap, but it was better than expected, but less than you'd find in a pizza place.  Overall, this was a great meal and the prices were reasonable. It's hard to get a good server to say a lot about a place, especially if they've gotten us off our feet

I don't recommend this place. Don't try that. Nothing to get excited about. I was walking in and this was one of the few places that wasn't packed of people, and I was starving. Now, I have to agree. This is the most luxurious vintage store in New York City that I have come across in years. I cannot believe that there is a shop in Pittsburgh that is as awesome as this store. I am not sure where Jay lived but with his house in Paradise Valley and a charming antiques store, his daughter would be the very first You walk up the huge driveway and into a brightly decorated department center specializing in fashions that would look at home on a 1920's I did find some pretty interesting items though. The vintage clothes are all so original and unique that I am sure it would only get more beautiful with each purchase. But the shop can be a little bit crowded. I'm sure this was because the items were being retired by their original owner. I was pleasantly surprised that I ended up shopping here and that we managed to find a small black dress (as opposed to a large one) Don't let the high prices fool you; if you go, have a little fun.

We were passing through the New Orleans Art Center on our way over to Louisiana and we came upon this little nook. Ashley's is a small Asian restaurant with about ten tables and it is located in the North end of downtown Orlando at 254 West Main Street. The menu is quite decent because I think that if you like Vietnamese food, you will love Ashley's. They also have fish and chips, which I don't really know why they had such low ratings like they did. There are several different items to choose from including: ice cream and cream, chicken, pork, beef and even some fried rice. One dish that I tried is Thai beef noodle soup. After ordering it, I felt that they overdo it on the flavorings. I can only imagine how much the Thai sauce would have had a better flavour than the beef broth. Although the serving size was really small for something ranging from chicken to beef, it seemed like a whole lot more than that. I mean, how can you go wrong with a table cloth that is clean? I could tell that the cloth on the table was a little damp. This was very clearly out of place. If you don't mind the look of the cloth on the floor, then I would say they need to be changed. The drinks were decent though too, except for a lemonade that I could have easily made myself. The place is clean and friendly enough, but I don't think anything else really needs to be improved.

I have no idea what is in store for me in the coming year with my food. Not only is this an absolutely gorgeous restaurant, but they also have incredible service and prices. All of the food was excellent. It was a nice change of pace, and the wait staff made me feel at home. As we left the restaurant, we had a chance to look over the wine list. Coffee shops around the Atlanta area have become pretty dead lately, but Cafe Maspero is still one of the few places that I always frequent when it comes to You don't get the same service and the food is just kinda icky. I'm a patient at Eyestone  optometrists. They never see me wear them and they're just like, "Is that bad?" I know the fact that I'm the last one in my family to ever wear contacts, but in the past I did wear prescription glasses for a small I have yet to visit a healthcare office without a prescription, just by chance, since I don't have any medical insurance. I'd really love to be able to get my vision in better shape, and I'd like to think my vision will improve over time. The Dr. O'Brien is very nice and personable as well. He's not one of his staff's younger gentlemen, and his staff are nicer than the other three physicians.

This was my third time having a snowball at The Snow Queen I enjoyed it very much. Great flavor and a satisfying treat to break up the meal. Just perfect!.I could eat them for days. I will be back again soon. Would recommend..I eat at many places in phoenix but am always a fan of mango snoballs.

The store was super clean with lots of room to browse. Previously a shoe repair shop. It's a very eclectic space - it has two floors, two floors have a variety of furniture. No sign anywhere that said, "opens Monday - Thursday" which was unexpected. They have some really unique pieces. I wasn't expecting an interesting and eclectic shop. Good selection of table tops too. The furniture is nice for those who are just starting their furniture and/or looking for a small section. They gave out free shirts for the first 3 hours and then you just get a free t shirt and a drink. I think it's good to have a little furniture to help keep things organized.

I've used this place for a while because I'm always in need of good food but I've found some really great items. They have vegetarian/vegan/vegan options for everyone, menu options for everyone on your table. They have something for everyone all the time here. It's open up to 9:30am Monday- Friday. All meals are served here and as a bonus you'll get free drinks and iced tea, which is always a bonus. The wait is only 20 minutes and it's not far from downtown. For some reason this location takes the lunch hour... so I take advantage. I didn't try the brunch items on my first visit, but they are all good and quite tasty. I definitely would recommend watching their menu on TV to make menu choices, otherwise I would just go for whatever I was in the mood for. For lunch, you can find them at 320 East 6th street!

Last year's St. Louis Cityquarter was great to say the least. I've never seen such a great gathering of fellow book lovers. I was aghast at the first day of the festival when we were told you didn't have to wear deodorant. The events were awesome, especially the weekend of the dinner and drinks at The Hotel, and of the dinner at the bar. I had fun meeting your friends and enjoying all of the great food and drink. The time spent trying to get back to where I was at in Paris (and in other countries) What more could you ask for?

I remember eating here during peak lunch time on weekends in 2005 in Phoenix! It is always delicious, but we have found that the portion sizes have gotten too small. It's so beautiful on the weekends. They have a large menu with items that aren't always standard. We were so excited to dine here. We all liked our bites. Also, while I can see that they have a hard time serving children or children in a family that wants a hot breakfast, you definitely want the

You have to be a tea drinking type to enjoy this store. Yes!? And not only a truck; they also sell their iced tea in a tiny box like I was reading about. So I was around town recently in search of good iced tea and was glad to see the truck had the location. I love iced tea and was so excited I took 2 trips today. They served some really scrumptious coffees and hot teas. I got a green tea drink and it was quite good. At the truck they also have some hot options. I just wish there was an option for hot tea like for a green tea, one of my favorite. The granola was a great addition to their menu which is all sorts of cereals, fruits, nuts and granola. I was really excited because they were the only coffee cart selling me one of those "I like the flavor of this kind" items. Plus, if you get yourself a hot cup of tea, you get an icecream scone! They sell all kinds of tea, including iced, so you'll always have something for yourself if you're looking for a unique shop

Your pre-K menu was always great. My kids loved a salad, and a good sub. But you went downhill. I love to sip wine at Wine Bar. So I had a chance to sample 4 brews from the new National in Las Vegas. It turns out that some of these samples tasted amazing and I've been a loyal customer for a long time. I thought the samples were interesting - great selection of tapas and other items; crowded wine and food areas; casual dining. PERIOD.

This is our 4th time going to a place from this chain. It's a little more laid back with a slightly older crowd than some of the others. The decor is a little pricey for what you get in total but is a pretty nice one. A lot of options for lunch and snacks I was able to try. This location is in the old part of the building that sits at the intersection of SR 9 and Park Blvd. And the bathrooms – this is a plus. The staff is always friendly and does a great job! I had a reservation for luncheon and the place was already full. It gets really crowded on days where I'm eating or playing hockey so just keep that in mind when you get there. And please don't park in an outside parking lot. I don't really mind if you come here but I do eat at the cafe when I go out at work.

I just visited this new place where the owners have the latest iteration of the vintage bar concept. The other name was Perestroika at Prague, where the owners lived prior to the bar closing. They're still trying to get a good deal for the vodka, but in the meantime, it's a good place to hang out. Hence the name. The old ceiling lighting is gone and no new tables or chairs are being used, but it's still a pretty cool place to hang out with friends. The bar is much larger than it used to be. But we have a great rum bar right downtown that is not just a place to go without a shot - one that’s always I especially love the green tea rum rhum. If I could score two of my friends one of those I would be happy with it.

I love music festivals and I absolutely love music festivals. People there are always friendly and we always love to meet new people. The last time I went, I were asked to sit onstage for three hours. Not to mention the food was awesome.

My first experience with the fast food at Costco was on a Tuesday morning when I was at work. But it IS still nicer than back in the old days. I have never thought about eating there, however I think I will keep going over to the Walgreens because they have good breakfast options there. We have a family that is using it for breakfast and lunch and they're really happy with it but my husband gets disappointed in their food every single time Also, I have never been a big fan of the hot-dog stand. Be aware that there are a lot of students there and you may be turned away because you're not sure any of them are ordering some of their food

Until Wednesday of this past week, The Located Place in FQ did a Saturday Free Market. Everybody was so nice. I was astonished at how large the selection that day and how prices were so reasonable. A few clothes were bought at 50 Cents each. Some shops are still releasing a few things that were in stock; they're just running them at a price they normally would. There was a ton of clothes with some fun accessories for all ages. It's just a store selling second hand. The owners are friendly and their store is an attractive space to browse.

I drove through the crowd at the St. Louis Truck on Thursday (Aug 2) to get the lunch hour specials. The line of trucks was long and the place was packed with people. I ordered the crawfish and mac-n-cheese pie and my friend ordered the fried green beans and mac-n-che This wasn't the largest pie I've ever had, but it was just as delicious as I remembered. Mac-n-cheese was excellent, and was also a pretty big portion too. I wasn't a huge fan of the crawfish but overall the food was good. I did have the crawfish, but its been a while since I've had any. He's been out of business since 2011. After this past weekend, they haven't had him make an appearance in the area since around November. Don't feel bad if you find him but it would be a good idea to make it your goal that you try to catch him and enjoy both

Not the best restaurant in Downtown Charleston but its convenient to a couple of places and a quick burger/lunch stop. I've spent the past ten years eating at JM's at our house, and I was very pleased with the one today. The only thing I could taste inside was the breaded chicken being prepared with blue cheese. A fantastic flavor, nay, nastier. A big hit both times.

Although I did enjoy it all, this was a difficult night because my friend had to take his night off after work. Unfortunately there was NO place to eat for a long time. I was lucky. I went to my friend's restaurant in St. Louis where they ran a security thing for their patrons. Their last food day was September 3rd and they were able to seat my friend and I. I walked in with a bad cold and it was nice and warm and I was seated at a table. The food was just right. He started with the fried pork chop, charbroiled mushrooms and sour cream chicken. He liked the gumbo also. The place is clean, and they have fresh produce. This is the type of place I'd like to have as a part of my visit. I want to eat there every Saturday.

This Saturday night, I was able to take a stroll through the King Cake Kids' Parade, as a part of this past Saturday Night's I had seen the pirates and pirate girls dancing on the field, having a big party with each other. Then I saw people taking pictures of them and people watching them. Of course, the juggling of the giant sharks jumping around and doing tricks with each other. Another favorite moment was when the kids were wearing pink sleeveless shirt hula hooping hooping in the street Then the children had kids who danced like they were in Star Wars all day while the adults were dancing like they were in the movie! It's always fun to ride in.

I have enjoyed every time I have been. I like this place. So the food was good but the service was average. There was some good conversation, but most of the food was just kinda hit-or-miss. We love the space, atmosphere and decor.

Great Mexican food with great prices. A huge choice of craft beers and well-made local pastries. They also have a lot of fresh air in their store, which I enjoy. I came to get some food before the hurricane hit and my family was getting ready to go home but to find that a pair of employees was outside while the There has been one employee who wore his mask while taking a wait for his boarding of a school bus. It's pretty iffy who's wearing it now (but I think that's usually where it is best), and as of yesterday, my They have a variety of delicious local food.

It's so fun to frequent the French Quarter restaurant FQ in Times Square Park. Well worth a visit. And if you like sweets, they offer a nice selection. On busy evenings when the restaurant is still open, the food was very good. The potato chips were very greasy and had such a good crisp in the middle. I ordered a second side of shrimp with the salad, which I thought would have been too small. They also have a selection of HH cocktails. I also had the French toast which was not really bad. Also I ordered the peach, banana and pecan fronds and both were delicious, with some nice additions. I had no trouble, and all the girls and staff were very kind and very polite. Thank you FQ for giving me a great time!!

Usually it would be a hassle to go to the Grand Parade in Chicago over Memorial Day weekend because it will just take the day to close down and walk I can see how it's an important and popular event for the city, however, the parades in this area (Copenhagen, Orleans, I finally went!. It was a blast! It was such an awesome night, that I actually felt like an Indiana Jones fan. The people were so vibrant and bright, having the crowds sing, dance to and cheer on them all (and they were even wearing costumes!!). For me, one of the funniest parts of the parade was seeing people dressed up as animals and being able to vote on which had the best costume I can't wait to see more on the Chewbaccus blog!

The hotel/club in Boston was amazing. I had a great stay at the Holiday Inn, Westvale and it really is the Best in Vegas! I'm always a fan of hotels in the downtown area because of their architecture and great location at the end of an otherwise busy street in the neighborhood. In our area, it sounded like there might be something that we didn't think to do but I was really excited to check it out. The wine was at a nice low-end price for what I paid with about $6.50 from the bartender and was served all glass with  for $33 (more than what usually goes on the regular menu) with a salad or dinner. The bartenders were very friendly and nice. The food and drinks were great. I would probably say a couple of apps but I don't think it will be my favorite bar bar in Portland. I liked the place very much and I'd return to this place and try it again. Very cool! X.

Love it!Loving this little shop. Big selection of casual clothes and some great deals on some really good basics. I liked the reversible Ts that were on offer! I have to say for if you are in a group go there, they have a "tankless mini", an oversized coat, and Generally great stores I have been to. I saw the Saints T for only $1.99 and found some decent prices as well.

Shop is old and it is very dark. This is a busy store but the prices are better than I remember them being. There is no other way to shop here than to drive. There are plenty of books from high street and independent companies that are hard to find, and they are all priced in the high school/university price range. On one particular trip, a customer paid $23 for two books and one basket of food for an extra $4. You can't see anything from behind the doors. I don't think the store is going to stand the test of time, but at a small price to be honest.

A friend of mine went to HNOC for lunch the night before and it was a beautiful day outside (and hors d'oeuvre I love living in Montreal and it is a good place to spend the day but sometimes not the best time to be outside. Then I remembered Bellegarde. There are three menu items, but I went with the Beet Salad. I paired that with the delicious pizza. It was a lot of salad but it was delish. All of the fresh salads are a great size and the price was surprisingly reasonable. A large breakfast was also offered, perfect after work or afternoon break. It was a delicious meal, but there are lots of great places to eat and drink where you can get a quick lunch.

My favorite landmark in New Orleans is a tree. One I didn't think twice about on a trip by bike. This is the tallest tree on the planet, with the top being at the top of the tallest tower in the United States. It's a little large but not much taller than that of the Great oak in this picture. While at this time the two were in town, the trees have fallen to the ground making way for some newer trees. This stands by itself and is the only tree in this park left.

This place is as close to home as it can get. I had the calamari (same thing as above). What about my mom's pasta and peas - I made it myself when I were about 10. Their hunky ribs are so full of flavor and tender - and their French breads are so incredibly buttery and tangy I also had their mashed Brussels sprouts... seriously the best mashed Brussels sprouts I've had anywhere. I have found it to be really good with a few additional ingredients with the wine being an extra shot! I'd say I've been to this restaurant a few times, but never in person. I had the iced tea with a scoop of their famous chocolate cake that was so blah. For those of you that aren't familiar with the space, everything is a little different. Our waitress, Isaac, was so nice, very friendly, and professional. This place is very well owned too. You get a beautiful view of the street AND you can take advantage of the drinks, as well! !...!Heading back to the strip and catching the "Lady on the Strip" bus.

I was super stoked to come back home to check out Rouse's. But that was like an afternoon nap as I was getting ready. It was not even a quick visit. At the time of my visits, it was already pretty busy. It's an extreme mall shopping center, with small aisles, and a rather huge checkout line along the edges. One can walk through a shelf without any trouble. The same way.The store is small. The aisles have random shelves and crates that you didn't even notice existed, then there were random displays that I couldn't figure out why It takes 30+ minutes to walk to the checkout for each order. No matter where you are, you'll have to wait for your time. Can I just get my credit card machine to charge my card and enter my GC? But the GC would not scan it. You've been told to use a CC- which is why the cashier didn't tell me. How could I run out of gas in a place like this? Unfortunately my last line of customers was in line to the left and it took a few minutes past 9pm. This store is not a rush, but it kept me in the middle of a long line and then out of the checkout area. I had a good laugh, but not particularly happy. Oh and I did not expect to be able to keep going once this experience happens. I was trying to get to the register but it was too late... my computer was gone. So I sat in line, staring up at other customers who kept wandering in the waiting lobby waiting in line after another customer so that she can I get it.. I won't be back. It was bad. I won't return.

There's a small but very cool, fun, and diverse merch shop with a limited offering. They do now carry brick and mortar and local design merchandise. Nola's small store has a lot of stuff for the fanatics to choose from. It’s run all by them and they have many t shirts, but mainly from their New Orleans based label, The New Orleans Band. So what are these new clothes they're in about? A good, large selection of clothing items and accessories. I think the only negative was that the store did not have a lot of space or the cash registers needed to know how I wanted the money to come We were surrounded by tons of people in this shop and it was a really cute shop.

So I hit up the Food Truck Market today. At the front of the store they said "hey, we'll stop by! Market?!!??? and... not pop up? food?--and... There's a tea shop next door." GOING TO THE FAR POP UP AND THE ONE UP EASTER DAY COULD NO LAME BE WITHOUT A I had mango-passion fruit juice and honey. I decided an herbal tea was a great choice because of its combination of chai, black coffee, and fennel sprigs For the meal, they also offered a wide variety of scones. This scone was so light, and had the sweetest of cranberries. It was a little dense. It was good I believe and very filling. If they would have done me a favor, they would have made me want that chocolate more! So I decided to head home to get some rest while I was still at the parade. We didn't have enough space! Obviously I'm not a fan of crowd pleasing markets for the food. It was a great experience even though I was only there for a short time. But, it was so worth it!

Came here for brunch on Friday and was extremely impressed. I took a friend to The Big Breakfast today for brunch. It was a Sunday morning and the place was a lot of people so the seating was very comfy. Some of my friends had the blueberry and egg pancake and I had the dutch baby pancake and egg. I know it's a pretty pricey menu and we decided to share some of the dishes we saw. I was with 3 friends who were hungry at this time and we ordered a few dishes. She also loved the apple cranberry & jam! I had the butternut squash flatbread as a side. When they started cooking the grits, the crust was missing and everything was soggy. For the egg dish, it was pretty good, with a nice coating of hollandaise but it seemed to be a little under cooked. For my crab cakes, the hollandaise was on the edge of the egg instead of right on top of it and we had a large shell  For the grits, the pan seared onions were very thick and lacked that perfect amount of texture but remained warm. Also the salmon plate would have benefitted from a bit more flavoring. I also asked them for some kind of sauce for the salmon which we asked them for. Another thing is that their happy hour special is only $10. One commenter mentioned the price tag was way too high and I think it will be hard to find a good Sunday brunch place.  honestly I have no idea what was wrong with this restaurant but I felt the food is still good, but you end up paying the premium price there. Unfortunately, I wish they had been better about their happy hour options as I find it to be a little difficult when we're in a crowd and Service also wasn't great.

I went to The Delilah with my parents last night (March 28th). It's one of those restaurants that you can sit down and eat as little as you want, but the menu is fairly standard. Food was great..it was a little underwhelming compared to other restaurants in town. The waitress was so kind and friendly despite the restaurant-like atmosphere. I was pretty impressed with the shrimp. They sent me a large plate of shrimp which I loved but could have maybe gone with something stronger. I ate most to none of it. I really like the taste of that cole slaw. She also had the grilled fish, which was flavorful and tender, but really small. The fish was pretty good though and there was no sign of any trouble. The food was delicious! There's a waitress on duty and the server was quiet. It was a bit frustrating because there was no server at that time. I would say that a little staff training is needed to improve. They are a bitchilly compared to most restaurants and I'd recommend bringing layers. This would probably be another one of our dishes to go back for if it was cold outside.

Our last night in town was at this bar and it was fun. This one came really close to mine, but no biggie. The food selection is good and it is fairly unique. Just be aware that there is no live music this week from 6:30-8:30pm - but the sound system is still working and there are a few However, it is somewhat of a wait in line so I will probably not be back. I was thinking about getting a plate but got to try other options. Not to mention the bar and music. Luckily, the sports bar has plenty of tables inside and outside. A few of my friends were at the tournament so if you like sport activities I would go with you as the event was pretty popular with local boys. On a recent visit, our son was on a team that had a basketball game so there was a soccer game going on. The waitress acted like she was doing more than welcome!

When looking for a mushy friendly environment, Sienna was happy with the littlest people. We have a new dog-only day at the lake every Tuesday. We've got several dog parks, so a little search will help you find one that best suits your furry friend. I had to do a lot of training so I could show her to people about levee training.

The first thing to hit me in this new little spot was that it was a quick lunch and there was a good enough variety. I knew my friend would enjoy the food and I had not had a chance to try the food at a restaurant before but I was impressed with one of The menu is a bunch of different things and the lunch items have enough variety to keep you full. Some of the items are very seasonal. The menu seems to be a bit different than the one I had but the food was decent. The fried catfish was good...I went for the catfish which has a light sweet sauce but the sauce wasn't overpowering like the My wife really liked the potato but wanted more vegetables or something sweeter. Their cabbage was fresh and went well with the chicken. Then I did the chicken with ranch dressing and then the seafood. I was concerned about the portion size of the shrimp because it was tiny. And for the price that we pay, I could have gotten the same type of food. Not too bad..I think my shrimp were a bit tougher. The chicken was mostly just enough to feed the adults and I probably should have ordered something else...I had a lot left. The place has a good beer selection also...I would definitely go back.

We went to the Sushi Bar on Friday night for dinner with two of our best friends. It was a surprise, but in a good way... They added a special meal for X-mas on Thursday evening. The decor is very modern and the decor was very clean. It's so good you can't say enough about it! There were only 4 seats on the small Japanese bar table and even then there was at least one table where people were seated. We had a late lunch at this restaurant and all our orders for the dinner came out 20 minutes late- the restaurant is open 24 hours a day. When we got there the ambiance was beautiful, but the waitress, with the other two people who were there at the very same time, didn't The sashimi was awesome and the rice was flavorful. The all were great and our server was very nice. We ended up sharing the smashed cucumbers since we only had a couple pieces and there was more food than us. The drinks were also great. The beer was awesome, though a little weak. The rest of us ordered half a dessert, but the server said there was not room for one, only half of them. A lot of stuff on the menu is made from different raw fish and sushi is so delicious. Overall it was a great time.

I thought that was way overpriced food. My husband had an egg salad pizza with a few of my favorite toppings. Everything was exactly as described tbh. The sauce was light so that the pizza was soft on the inside.

Just went to see the Chicago show on Friday night. And there's no better way to have dinner out than with tacos. There were no seats at the bar and only some people. and not nearly as big as you might think. La Casita was fun to be around and I had a cool time sharing a few drinks with our friends. The tacos were pretty good. They were prepared really quickly. And that was the only thing I could remember. On a scale of 1-10, I gave them a 3.5! All it seemed like was filling up with meat and cheese and just felt not much filling to me. I did like the drink and my friends did great with their cocktail order and tequila shots...their Mexican menu was a lot of fun I'd come back but just for the drink. And this is what we're saying to you: if you have questions about the food at La Casita, ask them!

Looks nice will you come back? It's such a small town in an almost deserted area. Ok... I'll give it another try for a change and let you know what I think. I was with my friends for lunch after work, walked out of the restaurant early (during a high school football game). There were lines but it felt like they were really late. There were no reservations... however, if the restaurant is on the expensive side it would be worth it. While we were there a nice room with a fireplace was nearby. They offered to let us enter the lobby and we refused. We didn't feel like they had a room... they really sat across the hall from each other and had people who had their back to me The atmosphere at the restaurant was... not super inviting. The waiter asked us if we wanted the burger, cheeseburger or onion rings. Don't look at the menu without looking under the table. They didn't have the drinks ready so we just ate a salad. We both enjoyed the pastas. The gumbo was really good, but I could have had more gloppy joes. I also had a salad (with a hollandaise sauce) which was a little oily. I got the fish. My friends had the shrimp poboy and my two and a half friends had the mussels and fish on the side. They liked it.but wanted a little more sauce on the gumbo. I would say they offered more sauce, some extra meat, the shrimp and the gnocchi. It's been under a year and still a nice restaurant.

I've been so impressed by this grocery store. During the holidays they offer special wine tastings. The store is beautiful and bright, which is always a great plus. I don't know how we are going to find that here.

I have done the bulk order through the website for the past two years and never have a problem getting products. They are the go-to place when shipping items that I need, and the place is great for a shipping quote for bulk items. The products are great, the selection of items is great and the prices are really reasonable. The staff is friendly enough and helpful and it is always nice to know that they can help when I am doing business with them on a regular basis. Several other stores on campus are nicer but I will go elsewhere.

I did not have a bad experience...my friends and I went in and sat down in a quiet space where the music was playing. I had purchased a meal online months ago and was excited to try a place like this, but they were just plain wrong. I was just seated along with a fellow lady whose name was the same as mystique and had her to take care of us the rest of Because the pizza they made was a little tasteless I just sent it back and they said it was good. We were pretty much trying to get out of there but they seemed to ramble and don't seem to notice. There was some bad odors in the bathrooms which was not cool. I had the Hawaiian pizza, and the meat was so tender that I couldn't even eat that piece of pizza because of it. There is a reason that my review of the chain did not hit 1 star. Food-wise, I would rather go to a different restaurant. It was a lot of fun having people try to figure out the clue we were being given. Maybe next time..

You can’t beat the price of food here. A regulars only shop for fish, shellfish, meat, etc. They have a very high percentage of kosher options compared to some of the other independent supermarkets. Most of their food is good, but they carry some really good food products (mainly meat). Their produce section has many choices for home grown and organic. I've often been a fan of the Deli with real meat, not just prepackaged, as I've found that this shop doesn' They have a separate section for coffee and ice cream. It has a good selection of local cheese and the guys there are great at sourcing a wide selection. They also have some deli food on offer to be purchased for take-out.

I used to frequent this place but I have not been in ages because of the fact that I love bubbles and relaxing. I decided to check out the The Spa at Easton. There are tons of people in the spa, some by appointment and some by drive through, including two waiting rooms. I decided that I wanted to be out on a leash. You can purchase the whole bottle in the main spa. ), I was escorted to the massage room. Then was escorted down the hallway to my appointment and finally a great masseuse was on her way. It was definitely time to move things from one area to another for a more relaxing experience. I called out the name of my therapist, and she said someone called her Ava and that the name was E. The spa front desk manager was very friendly and helpful when I called the spa to check with her for the remainder of my appointment. I really appreciate the extra time I was given and how she took the time to really listen to what I wanted and was in the moment. In the next room, the therapist was very kind and we decided to walk outside to the carwash and it was so fast! Thanks to the guys at Xscape Spa, I feel like I have a really relaxing spa day. There are a couple spaces reserved for patients and patrons. I left a great experience.

I love Saigon Street Chow. I was raving about their fried squid with chile paste. It's really nice to take them there for breakfast. The server is always very upbeat and smiley. Good service & selection. There's even an outdoor seating area which is extremely nice.

We had a really great experience at this Vintage-y store. I had such a great time and the dress was super cute! The dress itself is really cute, I haven't seen one so perfect in other shops but this one I saw that was super cute. I ended up with the perfect gown that wasn't too big in order to fit perfectly into my head.

Service, location, and food were both good. Even though I paid for a glass of wine, when asked how much it was for, no one gave me the price. One of my favorite things about New Orleans is this variety on our street- vendors. And right now, we're headed to a place out there called Phyllis' Pie & Creamery. He's got pie in every flavour, makes thepies. The key lime and peach pie was super good. In my opinion the key lime was fantastic and the peach was my favorite. The peach pie was a bit plain as well with a tiny bit of peach pie filling. If you haven't had the NOLA Pie Guy, he has opened stores around New Orleans and throughout New York, as well. During the afternoon, our friends and I checked out "The Blue Crab Mango" in my area, and decided to eat somewhere that didn' It did get cool again but the energy still wasn't great and we finally had to stop at Kanno. The food was good (somehow not all) but overall it wasn't as fresh as Kanno and I wish they would have just kept it as fresh We used a coupon on Groupon to get here and I was kind of incensed the room had no water-proofing. If you're looking for something besides crawfish & pickled okra, the okra and spicy crawfish would However, you get less to choose from because the menu has a handful of choices.
