I love a good French place. Love love love! This is my second visit to this place and I always have a great time. Is that all? If you need to try anything specific, just ask. There's a separate'snackbar' style lunch from mid-day to mid-afternoon. You definitely get the feel of the place. I recommend the fajita sandwich. A great experience. My husband thought his chicken burger was really good. I recommend this place highly!

I was reading a website about Battery Exchange. I've been a customer of the guys there a long time now and it's the service I've been getting. They replaced my car battery about a year ago due to a failed charge. Those guys do really have the right stuff if you are having a battery issue and need one. I thought the price was reasonable and their service was great....not one of the many places I've used that are poor. Besides, I just love to shop there.

...is an excellent place to shop for children. They have great prices and are incredibly reasonable. They have a merch section and there is a selection of clothing for men, and ladies. But what is great about the store is the variety. Great staff, great fit. The sizes are all in size s. I love the store!

It is now closed. The walls are painted dark yellow and grey with a sprinkling of concrete. So many people coming here from downtown to the street to buy food and stuff at this place and everyone seems to love the food here. I don't know what else this building is going to happen to. It has a big kitchen and a full bar.

Drago's was a favorite of mine. Probably the best in all of Portland. I've been in and out at different establishments. The pros: They always have great specials on fish and seafood. The fresh fruit salad was luscious but pricey. Two years previously there was a $5 mimosa. They have a great happy hour with special happy hour prices for people in the restaurant. The cons: The restaurants for private parties isn't too busy. We called at 4:45 in the evening. The dining partner took a seat while the other table was full. My meal: When I mentioned the crabmeat au gratin dip, there was a loud thud and everyone else was fighting on the The bad: We ate a "sandwich" and the server took her for a quick ride off to look for us when we arrived The usual: A hrrrr party of 4 (for 2 lunches); the hordes were seated immediately with an  The oysters tasted like the water was soaking up water in the ocean. We were charged for the meal, though the bill was about $80 which was a little higher than I expected. Just to top it off, the prices are not cheap. The lobster tail (like shrimp & pasta) was very good but it was a thin, chewy bowl. I won't be returning anytime soon.

I always like pizza like that - it's the best and I'm picky about it, but I've never got it right so far I was kind of surprised about the food because some of their favorite items are the salads on the salad. They usually have nice fresh seafood. But I found a lot of white bread under one of the mirlitons. It was pretty flavorless and it was gross. I don't know why the cheese was not cooked into the chicken. I left feeling like I shouldn't have made my lunch special so I ordered a salad. I guess I should have just ordered more beer and asked for cream sauce.

This is the 3rd year we've been part of Santa's Krewe, and it's really cute. If you're an outdoor kind of person, there wasn't a bad ride but no dancing or bouncing or even any other sort of thing For me, the most fun thing about the festival (besides the bands) is getting involved in it. They were good & I really enjoyed it, even though it was so long.

The service is way better now than they were with their old name on the Strip. So that was a big change to their menu & I found myself really liking everything. The wings are good. I'd definitely make it again if I had the chance. If you like something, it's always fresh for you. Not even Mexican, which is nice if you're getting a meal of one. I like to order the tamales, a bit more for the less conservative and a little more for the more adventurous. And there are a couple of other specials that come up. Their salsa is always good and the chips are decent sized. I am very happy that Taqueria has come back to San Francisco. I was excited about being able to drive to Taqueria again!

The Pauline Books is a nonprofit book and artshop in the heart of North St. Louis, Missouri, and in the northwest corner of the city. Also, the drinks are expensive...and I always pay too much, but well worth the money.

We'd been passing the place about three times in the last two months and it was the best part of the trip. They were delicious.We had the chicken, egg, fish, and rice rolls in addition to several other roll options. The menu contains everything from the udon to the filet mignon. The salmon is super soft and tender and you could even feel it when you touch it - and that makes you feel so good after about four bites. The spring rolls are definitely top of the line. The chicken roll was perfect and they added a few extra pieces to make it a little too 'uncrusty' for my taste. I'll definitely be back next year for the tofu. A Japanese way of making you eat the food! It is to die for. I really can't wait to check it out again. And the owner knew E and her family from her youth. They knew we were very crowded and it was hard not to notice. They are also nice and helpful with planning a tour so that we can get around the area.

I decided to come and meet my nieces and her friends at Elsinore and the bar. There were a lot of people at the bar. I just moved into the new neighborhood and they have good service. It is nice and clean and I like the decor. They also have a cd and bottle selection. We parked in the lot. I don't usually wait too long so I don't know what you will get if they have some downtime.

This is what the Parade is all about these days. I took the opportunity to attend the parade this year. Also got to sample the gooey cheesecakes on a carousel and watch all the gorillas in the parade yell I would recommend this parade to everyone!

Today was my 66th birthday and I wanted to go to Ouachita National Park in the Ozarks. We headed for about an hour with the kids. With so many people walking in it I thought it was so easy to miss all the amazing things there. Most of the land is open to exploration and it certainly proved it. We decided to pass around the irises. It was such a relaxing day. I'm not sure, but it was a sweet moment. And I've been reading about their bloom & fall, but haven't been able to find a picture. A cool misty morning. The park was crowded but we walked through and got a good look at the mansions inside. They looked like snoopy lizards with teeth. My hubby likes to fish from his boat he said. Well he let us know that he was off duty at that time and he was pretty happy with that. There's not much to do on this short hike, but the park itself is beautiful. We'll definitely come back for another visit. You'll need to have a guide since most people have no idea what he's talking about. The reservoir is only open from Memorial Day weekend. I've never been there but I'll definitely come back.

A few guys are running up in an open space to carry organic and gluten-free products, including some branded items, which I love because I don' Some items are quite expensive but all were good and healthy. I decided to buy a little piece of cupcake (that I could eat) and some cookies, too. The cookies are small and light, perfect for adding to a vegan meal. So I'll be back to try out some of the other vegan fare.

When the taco joint in the area opened up, it was the restaurant to go if the kids were too. After a month or so of not eating there, my friends and I decided it needed to be better. The soups are really good though and very tasty. I've had the chorizo and chicken salad, and they're both really good. The cheeseburgers are great (and they are the largest in the world).

So now it's summer months and this was a fab new bakery. It is a cafe. You would see many of their products hanging about the bakery claiming to be a commercial bakery and selling at the market. They were established in 2001 by Michele and Tom Phelan and the product looks very similar to that of the French Bread Company. It's made with high-quality ingredients. I have bought their bread since they started out in December 2013 and I love every bit of it. It is a great neighborhood bakery to try if you want to get away from the heat where the other locals go. They have more locations around the city but I don't know if they'll be open anytime soon...at least not when it comes to my next Go check them out!

I'm very happy my battery was fixed! They're my favorite. I bought this Toyota hybrid and have just 4k miles left in it just in time for work. Looking in San Francisco and I came across this bar along the Grand Canal that was very casual and fun. The drinks are always tasty and cheap. The bar is small but it is great for a casual sociable drink. If you are at all gay in search of a pub for dinner next time I will head to the next time I am in the city.

I had the fruit kolache...not the fruit one as described on the menu..and a couple of mango kolaches with a little The empadas also looked too sweet and there were no Mexican kolaches left. So I tried fresh, which I didn't find very satisfying. The empanada was good, but not as good as the kolaches. So as a restaurant, just say you want a meat item. However, it could be that I just had them rename something.

I made my way to Miyaki Tokyo for some lunch and wanted to give it a try because I love the location outside the station. It looked nice inside and I liked that it had a little cafe nook. It smells great, the staff was friendly and the patio was a good place to sit out by the pool, if your looking for a place We enjoyed several sushi rolls for the evening. His wife had ordered a cold plate of seafood without any sauce/seasoning added. The mystery roll was the hottest...not sure what kind of cheese it was but the server was nice. I ordered the Veggie Roll and it came out well done, however, a bit warm to the touch. I asked about salmon (my favorite fish! ), but I was told they only get them once a month. I ordered the Spicy Salmon with a white, yellow & green tuna sauce and a fresh cucumber salad. The service was great. I would definitely recommend this place and definitely return again. It's a great spot in the city to go if you have to spend anywhere in the downtown area. The atmosphere was a little too intimate and the ambiance didn't seem very friendly. Regardless, it was a great experience.

Welcome to the new site. I'm a Mardi Gras in New Orleans. I love to go to the parades, eat my share, and take pictures. They have a couple of brothers, one who is a Mardi Gras expert, and one who makes me goop goop Most of the people on this blog, if they have children, who may have never attended a parade before, are in some sort of fa I love MG so much and really don't need to worry about being disoriented. Because we all feel great!

I haven't been back to the Ramos Thai Restaurant in 4 years. So, I just had a wonderful Thai and Mongolian restaurant experience last night. I love all of their flavors and I think that the new owners are still making it good. They're now really making the food fresh, and the prices are great. If you've never heard about the mango with scallops, you should definitely give it a try. It's a really refreshing and tangy mango drink with tons of mango cream and ice cream. A great combo for a light dinner. Just a bonus to the mango. Oh, so good. Even the desserts were good and I loved the flavors. It got me thinking. Had many a great meal but the only thing I was lacking was the wine glass. If you're looking for some good eats in a nice neighborhood, take a look at this place and you'll love it.

Are you looking for a small and friendly store for books? A few ideas are: There is a small Catholic retail store (the one on 6th Ave.) that is actually a little more Christian that many It also offers religious gifts in the form of small gifts (mainly items made of wood). I like that the shop is open Monday to Saturday, too. I didn't buy any of the books but you don't see anything here as a Christian theme.

It's always fun to visit the Wine & Spirits Bar in the heart of Downtown Montreal. ok, not actually a wine club, but it could be a bar because I am half-drunk. It's not that far from The Grove...you are a few steps away from the winery and you can get a whole lot of food out

This is where I was brought in for a date (see all the links for that one - woo hoo). I had a bad bad day at work and stayed home that morning. The wait time can be a little confusing, or the items can be a little pricey but it's worth it. The food is wonderful, fresh, with tons of protein options! Plus, I was excited about ordering fish! The steamed dumplings, and the sweet tea shrimp cocktail are the few options I could think of! Of course their salad bowl is always a big hit, I love them and this one was so good! With the soup you had the option to pick your soups and sauces. It's amazing that there are 2 choices; whole grain and black rice. So I didn't get my sweet little secret for lunch. So it definitely helps. AWESOME!!!! That’s very refreshing, and I think it can take them a little while before they even come to your table.

I was really excited to try The Kitchen on Monday night...I was super excited to see what it would be like once it opened. It's pretty amazing going from one restaurant to another. For my parents, this evening turned out to be the night to go to the new one in this area named Island Kitchen. I wanted to take part because I like to take photos and feel I can do that. My parents and their friends were on the Upper North Shore and my parents and I decided to try the food at WestEnd instead of Bucktown. We were all seated at the bar with another couple and I tipped our server. She didn't seem to like the food, so I ordered a white rice and crab legs (the shrimp appetizer was so good that she could hardly She just didn't seem to be working very hard or her attention to detail is lacking at times.

I recently thought about getting waxed to add a little edge to my wardrobe. So I went online and booked a wax appointment at the salon I work at. I decided to change my look and I started at Salon 617 because they have a wide variety of products. I really wanted to like this place and decided to give them a try. I arrived at least 15 minutes early. The staff members were very friendly and helpful. She waxed my eyebrows and I noticed some bumps and lines. She did a thorough job and did a great job. The lady from the outside was first to wax, from my upper leg to the back to my toes. I asked the tech for a more conservative treatment and the tech did quite good. So it was easy to get my legs back in shape and now my face is looking pretty good. I was told that I could use the same services again but a little a patch might be needed. My first appointment was worth booking for next time due to the free eyebrow wax. We’ll definitely be getting at least 2 other waxing places for my regular trips.

My foot salon experience at Y Spa is here. So I took a trip here last Thursday after a busy weekend! As I was arriving I was really nervous but the owner was very nice and checked in with me right away. I was in the salon with the nail tech who opted to work at Premier. We ended up getting in around 5 pm and I spent a full hour and a half in there. I had had pretty bad luck with the nail tech from my previous visit and was disappointed that the nail tech was not as thorough as she might have been. At least they did give me a discount! That was priceless! I would say that all the techs there were extremely friendly and helpful.

This was the first time I reviewed this shop. The cookies were the best I've ever had. I was not surprised at all and bought them all, just for me. These look amazing, too! I have a personal favorite, the white chocolate with a touch of salt and sugar thrown on top. We went back and bought more. I'm sure I'll get my hands on a ton of their pastries and sweets.

Go there for all the seafood. I went back to the restaurant with a group of friends because it was so far away and we wanted a place to try so we decided to make it It's the very first thing I want to try and add to my daily rotation. Their gumbo is served fresh and was something my mom used to make all the time. Love the new look, and all the new staff. It's good!

The new FQ Bookstore has moved up a few doors and their new location looks completely different than their old location. The decor inside was so much cleaner than what I'd seen before, there just seems to be new paint and a better selection of books. I went there with my new sister in law and we were like, I can't wait to go home to open this place! One of the staff was really awesome and we had the pleasure of having their bar open for us. I know you've seen them on the side of an empty block on Sunday nights when they have a full bar. This is a neat spot to go for books in the N. Broad neighborhood. I'm still looking for a small kitchen that has a microwave inside. They had me eating the same sort of soup a handful of weeks ago!

This is a great little shop for foodies. I went in one afternoon to pay for the bread, which was just under $10 for three, but when I tipped the cashier to add one more It is very convenient to their location as it is just across the street from the University of California. The coffee is great and I know it'll be your new one. The staff is always helpful and professional. And their coffee is a little pricey but that is good because you can walk in and you can order the coffees from the spot.

I always try to stop by this place for a cold coffee or a hot chocolate. I never thought I'd see the one we'd had last year on my way up to SM for a conference. There isn't a regular reason I visit or go there unless something is so special for you. What really impressed me about Sucre is how the food was served. I thought today was the time to write about it again. I was so burned out I could barely move and decided it was time for a coffee drink. I can say that all of the flavors I've ever tried are worth the wait. They've worked hard to perfect the recipe and it's great to just have a hot chocolate with a little cream on top! Not sure, but I'll be back!

We have had 2 of the cupcakes at the shop yet both were outstanding. I went to the one in Houston, Texas and rated it as 4 out of 5 stars! So far, every time I have tried a thing or dessert, it's been so good, but it never gets old. It was a difficult job finding all the different dishes I tried, because all of them were on my plate once I had finally discovered Sucre. I was even able to fit my boyfriend into one of the royalties he won that night.

We were happy that we had already purchased a weekend tickets to the San Diego LGBT Film Festival after the usual disappointment of getting in trouble on the wrong side of I would have been more excited for the sand on the upper-sea side not to be wet, but then I think of those great At one point I saw a deer, which the junior nieces thought was just a wild animal. They went around the edge of the playground and peeled off some rocks and spent a few minutes singing with the ducks while looking out of the window There were a few children (and some adults) playing with some animals from the park. We got a little out of control when we saw the lily pads floating around...so there wasn't any danger of those floating around. The lake itself was beautiful. The kids loved the amazing bronze sculpture done by Peter Pan, installed on the lake in 1980. It's a bit of a work in process, but it's coming along. I always found it to be so impressive in the background, putting it in perspective. Enjoying the day's wind. It was amazing to be on a lake in winter.

It was a short wait for a new artisan bakery to open at the intersection of Madison & Vine. I guess that's my problem, not theirs. I tried a few things I had high expectations about. The first thing we ordered: two Manhattans and two alcoholic beverages. Re has a beer and I sampled the te Belgian wheat beer. I was a little  nervous about the cheese board at first because I didn't have any veg on the board so I had to hold the One of these was the cheese board, lukewarm and not enough bread to support the meat and vegetables. I don't know how they do it, but they have been churning out all of this for the last couple of weeks so the flavors The menu was a tad confusing since there was a variety of sweets, including an almond ball and some chocolate fig. When we asked for those, they were all orange and I guessed something like lemon would be on them. It was actually a blueberry cake which I thought was a cheesecake. The drinks were also very good. We will not be returning. I was told that they should deliver a glass of sparkling wine on a Tuesday. It's very nice though that they have a menu to choose from so you can take a look before ordering to see if you'd like But oh the glitz, glitz...it was delicious!
A pump house from the 1940s. They had nice pumps for regular and a few pumps for long pumps. There are a few really old pumps, and a pond full of water.

I had a weird feeling about this place. I had a hankering for a Mexican food truck right outside my door. I had this long drive to Elmwood and thought the drive through to this location was going to be an easy one. I got my order in because I thought my usual pizza would be on the way out so I just thought - what better alternative? They were open!. One of my favorite choices was The kolache and it won't be the last time I try the potato, eggs and queso dip. They were fried in a pan of oil with a side of eggs and there was a little egg over the potatoes in it which I thought was We ordered from the tap. And then they brought me a plate of waffle fries. I had way too much. It was the most perfect waffle I've ever had! And I could really eat them every day. The waffle fries were perfect. And I did not even feel grossed out! We had some of the salads and they were pretty good, nothing too special. Good job to the guys up there!

I'm only going to give it 3.5 stars because I found the place quite nice. I was definitely not into the atmosphere or service at the restaurant I frequented. If you want a quick, simple meal, don't go at this restaurant. It was also very noisy where most bar restaurants are. Afterall, you do have to wait for a long time to get food (the decor isn't particularly attractive). What a shame - there are better options to choose from.

Cafe du Monde is located down the street from my house in downtown. It's just, the old lady and I have stopped writing on the Yelp page. Now it's my last review... and we have to see how long it'll take for a review to appear here. Regardless... I give the restaurant a high rating, and a little gratitude. cafe du Monde is by far the best restaurant I've ever been to for sweet dough (and it doesn't just have flour on it). For that price... it will be worth it. They are topped with thick buttery sugar on each beignet and covered with a thin layer of icing. The service was outstanding, quick check in and go, no wait. I was there today a few times, the wait could be about 30 minutes. Be nice.. if you have to wait for it. I'd never have the chance to eat there since this place is so cozy.

Located in the strip mall of Downtown, Fuhoku's is one of the more popular sushi places. What can I say? For the price, you'd get a good deal. If you're around the mall and you're looking for a good neighborhood sushi joint, this is a good place. They have both tuna or fish served in a white sauce. Some come with a side piece of fish as well, but otherwise the menu didn't make it worth it. And my friend loved her salmon roll with tofu! Depending on the time, it was a decent size roll; I ate a medium roll. I would gladly suggest a trip to this sushi location, but the location can be a bit hit or miss. I enjoyed my experience there, but I'd rather go to another sushi house.

Check-out The Subway Bar for the ultimate local Mexican take on the Poboy. There's a really nice, comfortable interior there, and there's very good seating. Milk Bar has much more seating inside while Delachaise has a little more space. I used to enjoy the "Tasty Sandwiches" and the "shakes and freezes" better. It's a great looking restaurant with well organized and clean spaces with plenty of parking. Be sure to check the specials on The Food Network's Lunch Specials page for more info. I would suggest that if one of their sandwiches is served over a hot cup of coffee they order it hot!

I've been to this restaurant several times and like to try new things. I got the Kale and Garlic Salad. The dressing is delicious and the dressing is very fresh! I also got a spicy stir fry salad with chicken, veggies, and sauces. This soup had a great amount of cream and was super thick which I love! The lemonade was also very good! Their prices weren't too steep and it is highly recommended. I can see why they call themselves Build your own salad spot!

I didn't really stop in to check out the new place in the neighborhood, The Wreck of Two, until I saw The Squash on This past Thursday was the first time I've gone in. I'm always thinking about going back here but never managed to. Good, tasty, and uber-cheers. I was on my first of 2 trips to this place because I was starving and felt like a whole hog - but I was on my 3 Some staff were too young to make eye contact so a quick call over the phone went straight to a patron. The bartender had an extremely nice crowd too. I'll have to check it out this morning.

Currently they're having 3 days of sale at The Urban Spot. But they have some really cool deals on furniture. All the pieces they get are used and they're either used but have old paint and leather paint. There used to be an annual furniture sale and they had stuff like some of their furniture was already on line. I got this chairs there for a bargain of $2 a piece. This year there was some great material. It's a nice store to browse but it's very cold there at least. Their furniture isn't really that hot, so I prefer to shop on the cooler side of the shop. The same goes for inside and outside. Also, there are some discount seats available in the dining rooms.

A new addition to the chain which I grew up on because everything I could find at the stores just doesn't do here, but they had a I was a bit skeptical about the shop's gimmicks and I walked in with my husband. I was hungry already. The owner is really good about keeping hidden. I loved the fresh fruit salad and the breadstick cookie. You have to look out for signs to be aware of the food and this one is perfect for a quick morning filling with buttery pastries.

It's pretty much a secret, so don't tell anyone why you're going there. Not about another castle...not what the owner was thinking but what a unique piece of architecture...right? The castle is a converted trailer with a broken arm. Well, there is a castle now on the way. This thing was the first castle you'd notice on the road (for that matter). Or someone with one. He wanted to make it an entertainment/photo shoot/bed & breakfast spot. Was it for the first time really, or was it planning to be a "Bayou Castle"? Then he died in 1992, and it took another four years to rect it. He built his castle in Louisiana, just outside the ruins and as a reminder of the Louisiana swamps, where there is a history of many of But people lived in the castle, too -- until it was damaged in 1993 when the high winds made it inaccessible for the last time. It's been in the same family since 1983, and has been owned by a couple. But, some days, it was a tourist attraction as well. I had the house on my list, too, and have been meaning to visit it again since 2012, but nothing has happened. But it's not just that. So if you love history be patient. If you're in the area stop by, it's worth a try. Go there and get to know Simon. Thanks for sharing..

These are my go to sandwiches that are served at the restaurant. Big as a hockey ball! I am giving you all of my positive review! Very impressive...have you tried their egg poboy, I'd get it again and again...and that's where it started. All I got to do was eat it with the chicken and chips. And to add a small bit to it...they added an extra shrimp poboy I love their sweet service. It was a real shame because I thought we were incentivized and we were going to be doing nothing to save an entire pigeon My friend was a true restaurant wrangler...I'll be back.

In Chicago, it's hard to go wrong with the Greensboro Bears. Not really.but this place is pretty cool. You can take a bus from the airport with some major discounts, but the road makes it more scenic... it's just a big bus stop. I've had the salad and the wings. I like to stick to alcoholic drinks. The staff is quick, friendly... and friendly and fun. They also have a small menu of soups and lunch specials. It would be nice on weekdays and the food is much more extensive and expensive.

On Sunday, I spent the entire day in Paris getting ready for my trip. I was so afraid to have something in the morning. One I'd been to in the past. Now I was on a roll and decided to try their tastier soft serve ice cream. I ordered an entire bowl of soft serve ice cream and took it home. I was all like what the hell is this place doing... the only restaurant in the city that is free of staffing issues. For what it is worth, I am pleased. Luckily the ice did its job and we ended up eating the rest of the menu. What I will say is... this was not the best ice cream in town. I like how they use the word "vegan."

I'm usually a little hesitant of lunchtime food because I find it so overwhelming and I haven't been there for a long time I was so thrilled this place opened. We ordered our burgers & tacos and a full plate of chicken & rice. The tuna was delicious, well-cooked with a good portion of slaw and blackened spices. Tacos were hot... kind of like a Mexican burrito. These are definitely for sharing and we shared most everything. I really liked the tacos with the okra, but it was overpriced for the small portion! We started with a large filet of shrimp and some kind of side of rice. The service was great and I had a wonderfulburger and enjoyed it. I noticed this place has outdoor tables that look like a really cool little resturant area. The seats are great. I got my meal, and the waiters really enjoyed it. I could see this becoming my go-to restaurant. I ate all four and didn't feel as bad about it. They were so helpful and polite. It is pretty good for the price for all the food!

My usual regular spot at Red Dog Bar was opened in October (not sure if it still holds true) and I'm happy that it has stayed I'm not normally a fan of chain restaurants. They did a great job! They're just a tad better than their originals, but this was a definite improvement after a while of having the same You will also find a wide variety of drinks to drink on tap. The price is definitely on the steep side but hey...that's always a good thing. Don't wait a week or two to get out there and experience the best in the city.

Today was finally the day we got to stop at the Dollar Tree and start browsing. Of course you can't talk with someone over the phone of all you want to find. Having to be there for about 25 minutes was a major pain, and there was a very lacklustre customer service. The manager gave us a call to let him know we had a seated situation - a better option would be to have to wait around 15

Attire is convenient and reasonable. Most places only have one meter per lot. It will be another 30 to 40 minutes to find a parking space. With a parking garage, I would have to think I'm going to wait more than an hour. It's a super close location to the airport. I don't really mind it but if you do find yourself in a situation where the money is required, you may want to consider this option.

When I am thinking about coming to New Orleans, I don't go to a bar often enough, but I find it a great place for the It's beautiful interiors & food are great. I have to say, it's a much more cozy place to go even. We had our first draft one night and everyone raved about it. There are 2 bars and 2 bars outside in the back. I go there for breakfast, lunch and dinner with my Mom.

I called Randy at Red Rock Carpentry to say a couple things for the cost: Aside from removing a rotten section of wood And they did what they said they would! They started work after one evening and finished by two mornings. Great work, really great company! I wanted it to go fast. After finding one that agreed with me in the first place, I called and spoke with Randy. There were only two contractors available so just for a quick call to see what was needed he called, plugged in my house, and came through the One of the guys sent me a quote on line right away. I was excited!. They went ahead and did my work and kept all the phone numbers up to date. The first item worked very well. Randy did what he was tasked with as he was only doing the small job. He replaced all broken, decaying wood doors and then they were completely rekeyed - and I still have some to work with. I feel great about this contractor! Then all I had to do was send them a picture of what the work was like and see what it was like to make the repairs to the wood I want to thank Randy's team for their hard work and success!

Last month I went on a date with a friend for a stroll and I decided to check out the beautiful new shop in Charlotte. I have to admit that I was totally surprised at the quality and style they were offering. The shop's decor is very cool (to me at least!), and the goods are of VERY high quality (those that are for sale by Love the large windows and how you can actually see how the shop is being designed. I was drawn immediately in the shop by the bright colors of pink (and purple) for the wedding dress, and I had second thoughts on the corset. The accessories are beautiful and made to be worn and also the gifts are price match so if you are looking for something special at all, you won’t I ended up wearing the dress on the first day at the shop and I can't wait to wear it on the second day when the staff comes out and That was all I needed for a perfect afternoon.

I first became a client of The Book Market. It's been about 10 years since I've been visiting the etsy library. I still love the old Elastic Bookstore. I use this store just as much as the last time I stopped in; their selection is better, more diverse, and is a much better selection at my For me, there are some very obscure titles, but generally not much else I don't want to buy just because they are of interest to me (but You can find a full selection of books ranging from hardcovers through audios & DVDs. There's also great special events as well as in-store deals. The only reason I keep coming back is that they have been renovated and upgraded. The new, fully automated, audio/visual CD players are awesome. They were pretty cool!

As I am going through old pics of the Cemetery of Saint Philip & Mary where I was at this weekend, I'm mentioning those Cemetery of Saint When I went to check it out, my friend was really stumped. This cemetery was built in the mid-1930s and with all the changes going on with it, there should be more and more people finding their loved ones... And he probably didn't even know where it was. I had no idea that there were so many. You will have to go by the name in the address bar at the end of the cemetery. I'm not a tourist and there isn't much to do here. I've never been around the cemetery before but I was glad that the OB helped me out, because he wasn't quite sure how to open The picture had to be taken in front of a window and so the sun didn't block out the colors. So happy to be on his side. I also spent a LOT of time in the cemetery. I remember my grandpa getting this hat off in high school which also buried his mother here.

Love this Donut Factory! When the employees are at their most helpful, you know the shop is not understaffed. They do really good donuts without overcrowding and the donuts aren't too big. The staff is friendly and helpful. No matter what's in the donut they are just plain, straight from the oven without any icing on top. The customer service is always great and the staff can always be contacted with questions. A few years ago a family brought us a batch of classic donuts and I still like them and they are still some of my favorite donut I always pick up some donuts.

In the "downtown" parts of town, the bar atmosphere is great! The music is cheesy and well-done, which is nice after a long day. If you've been around a few times. Unlike other locations that offer a different menu, I've rarely had this at a bar and have never gotten a bad order here. There is never a shortage of food.

First, there's no way you won't get a drink from here. It's been doing much better since it reopened. They have a great menu with lots of local and out ot-towners on special events. The food is generally pretty good as well. The iced coffee is decaf friendly. It's all nice and clean and not too crowded for that. So I'm sure I'll try it. The area is small.... and it's an office full of cubicles and tvs. The decor is pretty funky. The food is pretty good.

I have not given this restaurant enough love. The chicken is amazing. I have tried everything! They are located right in the middle of the shopping center, with great signage. And yes, the atmosphere is wonderful for a casual restaurant... However, the wait at The Taco is terrible! And even through the wait, there is a little slack service. After I had been there for maybe 10 minutes and the weeds were still standing, I received the wrong burger and the waiter took it away. Then when I came back, the girl said she couldn't see another dish and they asked me about it and she said it was the one for who Although it never happened. So I get the impression this place is really pretty crowded on the weekends. The bad... the lack of parking. The outside of the restaurant is a fairly small restaurant, a few tables around the restaurant... but it is a lot crowded. It was pretty loud too, only for some customers, but I wasn't able to do much of anything. The price... the pricing is quite reasonable but then again, who can really afford a full size hotel? If it's like this the people could give me a push if I turned around with no assistance.

Fast food. Excellent sandwiches. Good salad. Very good beer selections for the patio. Nice food & service. Pickle sour cream. I went in & it was about 9 dollars for a sandwich and 10-10 dollars for a salad. Been here many times, would probably go again.

This is my new favorite baked goods shop. My only experience was the cookies. I'm a regular customer there, but am I really missing out if they don't have pastries at their normal hours? My friend mentioned that they should be opened on Saturday because there was so much activity there. I wanted to check out what they had in stock and I walked out on a crowded Saturday morning. I ate 2... then about half a dozen. I'm not going to get the chocolate bite again but I really love them. So I think I might come back! There are so many choices. I left a late order of pastries to be delivered to my house. I could take one of those any day. I didn't try out the bakery itself but it looks cool there. I'm happy I went. The coffee was good, the bread was crusty and the pastries were good. A spot on the list for me!

I really had a really great time at this event. It was pretty good. We had a great time, and got lots of pictures and information in it. The rooms are well lit and large enough for the number of people. That is amazing since we are a small group and it is easy to move easily between spaces. The bathrooms are spotless. It was located in a good location for shopping and dining. This location has a lot going for you. Also free and easy parking across from the store as well.

I was recommended to this shop by my wife and I. The art is all influenced by art in local galleries. I really enjoyed my experience. Oftentimes paintings are in beautiful colors or rich colors. Don't miss out on this place.

I'm so happy to be able to attend the South Louisiana Gay Pride Parade on Saturday the 22nd. If you haven't been there, just get there. I'm still a little scared off by the LGBTQ parade and how fun this is, but I think you'll be in for a good time Hopefully they don't become part of the parade forever, and my favorite part is being in the middle of the fun. I've got one child in the parade and her's only 13 years old, she was a little scary when she was in my arms. It's just that in some areas a parade causes awkwardness. But once you're at the parade you've got the opportunity to run into some people through the crowds who probably know a lot of guys. And then, a lot of the time, it's right next to the shamrocks of New Orleans.

The cheese was old and I was not looking to make anymore than two small pieces of cheese ontop of the smoked turkey. I hate to admit, the sauce wasn't as good as I had hoped. And the cheese was extremely cheap and it wasn't really anything special (the cheese on top was so good that I even enjoyed being able to have some A little disappointing..but I still would like to try it again next time.

The best way to get to a restaurant without going there is to order online. It was delicious and affordable. The thing that changed is the signage inside and outside. That's it. The pizza was very good, no complaints. The only lighthouse in New Orleans that I've never been to...and one that I'd like to find on my trip soon. The lighthouse on Lake Pontchartrain is not exactly "no light" but I had a good time walking by today to see what it did to The Bayou Point Light is located in the City of NOLA at 718 Lakeside Street in NOLA, Louisiana. The lighthouse was built about 1898 by Captain Alexander Henry Neill from a nearby sand and concrete quarry. This place has been going pretty silent since then. Its pillars are covered with colorful flags and the sand is sometimes used as a swimming pool. Most people just saw it with their own eyes. The lighthouse didn't come back in use until 1999 even after the restoration effort....not nearly as good as any of Louisiana's other historical buildings. The US Forest Service replaced it with a new one which was installed on October 9, 2011. It's now in a rehabilitation process waiting for a dedicated volunteers to restore it to it's original state. At the end of my visit today I had the chance to photograph this wonderful structure and also meet the folks from Oceana, also in NOLA. It's a beautiful thing and I'm all about it.

Our first meal at LVH. There was no line. And I liked everything. The sauces were also great. At Theo's, it's very safe for everyone who is eatin' and drinking. I was so happy to find a place in East Valley that does decent food.

I saw the sign on the window that the first time I went by their shop was last week, so I was pretty excited to visit. I came over to the Little French on Friday and had a lovely lunch. I have to try the coffee, which is made with maple syrup, in our house. I also shared a cake that I didn't really care for--the vanilla and cake with passionfruit scones. They also brought out a dunked breakfast roll with cottage cheese, ham and eggs! I always enjoy it (for some reason everyone always gets confused with all other places that do it). Even though they aren't a sweetener company! All of the staff at the market are very nice, friendly and knowledgeable. It took me about 1.5 hours to cook them both.

Last week my Dad and I went to a dinner on the patio which was quite enjoyable. Maybe it's time for a blog update? But I would have to say I am in love with this place. My goal is to eat as much as I can during a dinner at this restaurant in every week. So I'll get that out of the way. I had the salmon, the mussels, the crab crawfish & the brulee. The sea bass was a special event and they didn't skimp on the clams themselves. The gulf fish had a tangy texture but still had lots of fishy flavor. But then I realized how much I enjoyed the texture of this course and how delicious it was. I felt completely guilty because the Shrimp were only 1/5th of my total and I had a total of about 23% of the crab. I could have eaten all of this food in a day. And it was delicious. This place is really cute and is very relaxing. Brigtsen's is the only place I have heard of in the North End as far as dining goes. They're also not bad at looking cute at the same time.

This is the little bar next door to the Lassiter Bar at the corner of W & J, down the street from Trader Joes... just The name says it all. I had the bartender bring me back my table at one point and the waiter walked with me to where I was at. Also, they have a small terrace. My favourite bar/drink on the LBD for a while. I had the original Mocha (I think it's pretty famous and has a lovely latte). It was sweet and served with fresh mint. It didn't taste like Pernod but it did give a lovely flavor to the drink. The second night I tried the charcuterie plate with an excellent salad atop a piece of pizza crust! The food was also great. Service is spot on and good with a big salad bar and huge draft beer selection. They have a cool wine bar, which is great! Great little place.I'll be back.

While this bar is currently closed, I still enjoy going here. It was so much fun to come back when our bar crawls took us up to the Crater and then over to the Bazooka House after It's a beautiful pub that still looks like today... I'm more happy to see that it's still in business after all these years. I've been here several times. I don't remember making it. But if they will let you buy their own drinks, I'd be in high spirits.

A few weeks ago I attended a reception at the Broad for the feature film ‘Night Watch’ directed by Alex Winters but for different reasons. Then found out about the pandemic and was worried. I was told there were still two movies that I could see in the same theater (not sure if it was being used as a theater in the future Unfortunately they were closed when I went. It wasn't packed out. The front of the auditorium had a short film showing and they provided me with a very interesting trailer. A few times when the doors were locked, they let you inside only at certain times :) There were very few patrons and I like to go in There was also plenty of other stuff.

The theater was clean and comfortable, but it was kind of a disaster on the exterior and in the middle of the theater. The tables were clean, but there was a huge pile of food. It was pretty shaky though. I thought that if I was a dirty mess, I could give this place a 3 star review. No ice available for your cups and pitchers. I guess that has something to do with the people who came here. There's a reason this building is called The Landfill. That they allowed all ice cream out was a pretty odd move. I have never had a bad meal at a movie theater. The worst part is when you have to get it from the trashcan?

I've never had a good time at the Griswold's, but that's probably because I'm too lazy to go The food isn't great. I don't feel like it’s worth the drive from my home, but I sure do enjoy walking into this restaurant, and the decor. So I've been to this restaurant for some good food, but not for the best. I've even had to use earplugs and squirt a lot of milk through it. My uncle was on the dance floor, just singing and singing so loud there was no way of him hearing it if he could hear it. He ordered the tupi, which was very nice, but he didn't finish it, so my uncle was left out of the money  I think he felt really weird.

This summer my Mom and I went to the Broadwood Theatre. It's awesome and we love taking it out on a Saturday morning... It was a relatively small theater until the beginning of October when it was quite packed. The theater company is known for its small-scale productions and they bring new actors so there are always new actors available. We went to see "Cosmic Monkey" on Friday night. As was customary with indoor theaters, we got right into the center of it all. The tickets were cheaper than my detroit airport tickets - $13.00 each for the general admission and $4.50 for reserved seats. Also there is an outdoor bathroom. The theater was surrounded by sound and lighting tents. The concession stand was packed with stuff. The bathroom was located in an unmarked area, but if you could see it, you could get it. And you can get all your snacks and drink when you walk in to the theater. Also, there were lots of hors d'oeuvres available on site. And the stage was well lit with a good amount of lighting that was very nice. You can find out more about the theater here!

I wanted to go out to Finn McCool's last night and have a good time because I have no idea why. So we were in the area again last night for the annual pubquiz at Boo Koo BBQ, and while I am not a fan of pub The pub was buzzing and everyone was ready to try and get it all over. It's definitely still a fun night out and I'll always remember my time as a kid at Finn McCool's. Everyone from newbies toseasoned fans was very chill and everyone was laughing through this experience. I had such a great time with my friends, I just couldn't stop watching sports. It's hard not to like the food here because I can't pick up much without being hungry first. The staff was friendly enough and there was a huge selection of wines on tap. We took advantage of this fantastic location, so close in fact that the people were actually standing for a few minutes to take pics before going to dinner. I don't really enjoy drink ordering. But the air smelled delicious! If I'm going there again, I will bring my own bong or two because that's what all the other customers have!

Freshly dressed, perfectly prepared and excellent seafood. I took my two favorite couples in my group, two girls and one guy and headed out for a seafood restaurant dinner at Seaweed this past weekend. I had one of the oysters and the man had the crab. These were a delicious blend of crabs, mollusks and a variety of oysters. A super solid 5 stars. Our server was friendly, friendly and friendly as well. I was too picky on the oysters so we didn't feel like we were eating a plate full of them. If you go at 7 pm, get the crab claws so you can have the most of each dish. We will definitely be back!
I love our krewe! These floats included the infamous “Kangaroo King” and the “The King of the Pig”. I also captured a picture on the bathroom floor. I’m all about the fun little things.
If you enjoy breakfast and lunch sundaes, this is a place to check out. We went there every weekend and it's still a good place to go. and I love having it as early as 9 a.m.

I recently brought some of my friends over from the Bay Area to try it out for dinner and it was the perfect little starter to get the weekend started right. Served with salad, olives, olives, and pita bread with hummus and falafel. It's topped with a mix of vegetables (I've been trying it out with the falafel in Phoenix where I live). I don't mind taking my kiddos here, and really did. Check it out and let us know what you think.

I love the parade. I've always enjoyed the The Little King in a large glass. I have so many other favorite floats. They also have an amazing parade called RexFest. The big thing is that no one is able to get up and down the dance floor with the taiko drum. I also love how Rex floats come to life and how the people see his "wizard" and other floats.

The store is huge, with lots of girls on their site browsing. The prices are usually between $20-$35. Although the new store in La Jolla feels like a mid-range shopping mall, it is still a spartan local retail div They carry dresses with different sizes (and a few different designs) and a few special pieces and accessories. We had to keep searching and there was no shortage of great jackets. You'll need to go with a dresser or two which I didn't see in the pictures. It was a good experience.

I had a chance to go into Plum. It's a small stand and I understand that it is not perfect, but it's not bad. My group went there Friday night. There is a large selection of food and drinks, it helps that there are three different lunch options and all are relatively easy to find. There's a great patio with great service but you'll quickly realize where everyone is. I came with a group of 14 girls and my wife, who was a large person, brought all the snacks we wanted and brought our own water. This restaurant looks like a old mall because of it's large warehouse space. We just got a drink at the bar...and we were never waitin'. You will notice a regular employee doing things on the first floor...saying "Aw, this is a place for workers?" which is always nice to do. It is a modern/uniform venue with an open bar. There hasn't been a wait in ages and the food is delicious!

Thank you to our generous supporter, the New Orleans Downtown Chamber of Commerce, for donating our money. The Founder's Market was a hit last year. This year the venue is up near the casino and it was much smaller, but it was still quite a bit more fun to go. The food was much better than at least a year ago. We parked early and it took quite a while to eat dinner and we walked very fast. I thought the vendors were good. We will definitely return in the future!

The staff was great. I am a bartender, so I didn't know you could bring in a mixed drink. We ordered the French toast ($7) and the chocolate chip cookie ($9). I was not a fan of the decor as it was too old fashioned, and the only thing that really stood out from the rest of the atmosphere was We left before the team started, but when we got there the bartender made it very clear that he never knew we were there so it was nice I got to ask - How much do you drink? We didn't pay extra for seats in the hotel lounge, but waited at the restaurant for the restaurant manager to be able to take our orders. Didn't feel like paying the full price. As you may know, I am a very unsubscribed user of food delivery services. Empanola Empanadas are a favorite snack of mine and my family! I first ordered the empanadas for dinner. This is the first place I came to go to. One of my favorite neighborhood bars in Philadelphia. The place comes stocked up on draft scotch, and it's awesome. The music is good and the prices are good. So my wife and I will not be going back, but we have been living in the area since 1982. There are seats in the bar, but it is not a good place to watch football. The owner was a local for years and had the bar with her during her years in St. Catharines. My Dad and my mom were both born and raised here. Those are the few things we go there for. She took a great photo of a crow and her friends dancing in the bar. You gotta see their Facebook videos, it's very interesting.

You know you're at a bar named "Rawhide" and you have some witty little chubby bastard Her husband didn't do what he hoped to do, and he ended with a punch in his head. I loved it.. There was so much noise that I did NOT want to leave. There are two bartenders (my friend and I) who get me some kind of cocktail on any given Monday (stuff I do). Good times and fun atmosphere.

My parents were going out to go to dinner today. I ordered from the food truck but it didn't appear on their website. We both thought they were open for lunch, but my Dad didn't even know they opened? So I went to pizza and ordered from Pizza Express. I had the meatballs and my Dad had the alfredo and shrimp. The sauce for the pasta dishes was Italian and the sandwiches were good. If you were looking for Italian take out the Chicken sandwiches were fresh (and so was the parm and caesar). I really liked the salad and it was my favorite too. My Dad went with the salmon and I went with chicken! The shrimp pasta was served plain (no mayo) and had a tangy-sweet sauce. The pizza was a bit too salty and that I did not try. Cafe Roma was awesome on this hot day in my neighborhood. Their Italian/American food was delicious and tasty, I would definitely order from them again. However, the food was not as tasty as I had hoped on the other reviews.

I have to admit that I am a huge fan of Judith Park. I was in a rush the other day to pick up some free copies of a book about a new park in Jamaica Plains so we headed to It's been used as a playground for many years but as you can see that was no longer the case. I'm actually glad that it's become a park. It is an urban garden with everything you need. The park has a beach for kids, a children's pavilion, playground for the families who just happened to be outside, a picnic area, This is an outdoor space where everyone can have some fun and enjoy the natural environment. At its best this is the only park on the street. It has an entranceway at York Street east of York. So make sure you head to those two if you're coming from JP and want to stop and stop.

I have been thinking about buying a dress to wear before the start of Summer 2014. I was searching online for something new, but saw some that I liked then deciding to purchase. I called the shop at 12:30am and they have got what I was looking for. The service was very fast and I appreciated no one being late at a party because of this and at the wedding, it was also an awesome experience. Thank goodness I had such a great experience with this company!

I read an article on a "stress free and safe place" that claimed to give people a foot massage for at least $2 at most. So when I got in to try it I was pleased. Yes, you have to go in and wash your feet. And when my feet are aching, a lot of the pressure from the massage is gone and it makes them feel incredibly tight. I just wanted to make sure I was comfortable and that I would be getting a foot massage instead of a neck/shoulder massage. I chose the foot massage and then the neck/shoulder massage. The place used to be kind of gross but it's new so it was just like the place today. The massage was amazing and I was so relaxing that I couldn't leave the place! It seems that people get all over their towels. The vibe is perfect. But it was really good! I did like the staff in general. I had to read the whole review but everything I read about this place was good. My feet felt good about the length of the massage and it was not too pricey. I took cash and there was no charge. I was there on my own but they took my credit card so there was no charge. It just gets a bit pricier.

Broad Theatre has my go-to theater for movies in the city. I've been going for decades and just love it! The theater is really clean and is always getting cleaned back up. They are very clean and the screening rooms are always clean. It's fast with a movie going out in about 5 minutes! But the ice cream on the movie floor can be a bit cold. There are two bars that serve you food. I do love that they don't have concession stand seating. They have great food too (we had a really good burger and fish dinner). And the ticket counter is open until 5 or 7 am for anyone who bought tickets ahead of time. Of course there is the parking lot of the theater and it's free. We came as a group and parked a short distance away (near my friends house) but we had to wait longer because it was nearly packed So be sure to wear your seat belt! If you have kids, kindly advise if that's ok for you.

The last few months of 2014 have been busy. The owner and a lot of the staff has been looking for a new home and Maria is leaving to help get her family settled in a new location The owners of A&C, Maria Bartolomo, who owned the shop for almost 20 years, have put her heart and soul into what I love A&C because they sell some of my favorite items to friends and family. Just go there... you won't notice or think about it but it is just so pretty. That makes me happy because you know I'll be at the store for the good part. Hope all of you have a wonderful summer!

Love this cake.. The inside was rich and creamy. Dong Phuong was a long time resident of Vietnam and now they are making great use of it, especially here in Ho Chi Minh City. Everything was so soft and the top wasn't heavy. The chocolate icing and a dark chocolate glaze was very warm, which is what I'd expect from the restaurant, but it's not enough And of course the tea was excellent!

My aunt is going to be out of town for the weekend. She walked into our hotel where the menu was super awesome and she ordered a cookie or two from a bakery. I went on a small visit to Caramel Pancakes with my husband to meet them up. So we headed across the street to the one nearest to me and had Lunch at this bakery. They had lots of other items: cinnamon rolls (I didn't think I'd like cinnamon roll, but I did. ), the hot dog, the pie, the milkshakes, and the latte. The kids couldn't stop eating the bombe and the chocolate bombe was all good enough to make those cookies taste like butter but I really love chocolate bomb The employees were helpful and friendly and the manager was very kind. I love their selections at the airports, especially when it comes to airport cafes! We ordered a ton and then had a great time trying to figure out where (hopefully) our next stop was.

On Yelp I found out about this great place for lunch/dinner and I thought it was great that night. I always enjoy a rainy day but I can understand how it can make me feel so stressed that I am trying to make myself feel better. While we were waiting we decided to take a stroll through downtown since the weather is hotter in the city. The food selection is good and the drinks are good. What I'm most impressed with is the sauce and sauce flavor! There's no wait. The hogshead cheese plate had some pretty nice cheeses and some really nice rolls. The brioche bun did look good and could sag! They have a fantastic wine list with some lovely selections. Plus, there is a patio so we spent about an hour and a half there. They also have more tapas-style food as well. Thank you Dev's!

I would go here every time I passed through Chicago at one of the many nice little diners. I don't really mind being in there, but that's not what I'm experiencing now. That was a pretty good one in the 80s and 90s, but now they are kind of lame. Food is just all so blah. The waitress makes the impression that she is always taking things slow and a slammer because of it. Not all the food they offer is great, but it's good enough for a regular customer.

If you want to spend a little time in the old country town of Northampton, you can head down to the Historic Church and enjoy the open space They serve tea and coffee which is all very welcome. They have a few different things on offer for furniture as well as a large patio. I enjoyed this place and it had a very eclectic (and somewhat random) selection of vendors. It's not an art festival with just artists and crafters. We walked away from a pair of art pillows that were amazing and the owner had been selling them on Etsy for years. I can't help but think "well... this would be better for all of us in that we got a really cool set of these, right?" All the pieces at Punk + Steel are from the 70's to around today...that I've seen before.

I've been eating at Rouse's in the East since the first few months since Jeff found it. I would probably like to have stayed at the Rouse's in Boston (but I am a very picky customer). Oh, I know there's one closer to my house--Rouuse's. I must admit they are some of the best cookies I have ever had. I love Rouses because of the pricing. Just $2 to use for what looks like an almond cookie or one of a kind. Also they aren't the only ones that have just begun opening since their last one opened. It's all nice and scrumptious at Rouse's.

And it's true, there is a lot of talent & character you'll find at this establishment, but it's my new favorite bar From my first visit it was a busy and fun neighborhood bar while I was there, with lots of people settling down together as we played a game We're always looking for ways to make this place better in every way. We had an excellent beer selection and Molly had a great time with us. Molly offered us a shot of her favorite brew and we all agreed that's worth it. Yet!?...to no avail.

One of my favorite stores to shop for a costume or party wig. Many of the accessories can be customized to fit any kind of dress or costumes. Most of the costumers head over to the store during the holidays to get costumes they can’t find there, so that’s why they aren If the wait staff did not give customers a choice of dressing up, you would have one very long line to get in a store.

The most amazing place on the city. It wasn't my first experience with this venue in that we're all used to the more upmarket/sophisticated places in nash They brought the drinks we ordered out for us from the bar and they served us good food.

It's on the second floor in the Old School at 3rd Street West. Even if you're not sure how deep a party it is... it's a bit shallow, but not too far! The space has all of the usual things you're going to see at a bar or lounge as well as some very cool outdoor spaces. Whether you're in the open space or the back patio there are some great views of Lake Michigan (well really, we actually had our first day of As for what we had, we were in the second tier, which I found very odd since some people think it's a bar which isn And they also have a giant party area where you can hold a big group (or a private gathering) in any of the different spaces which are Everyone had access to the kitchen so I was busy with the pies and scones! The beer selection is great too... the owners have a regular taphouse with about 10 beers on tap. Good stuff!.. this is a fabulous time for friends to check out. I'll definitely be back there once this summer!

I had a hard time walking into Aperture's in the morning because, to be frank, when they opened up on December 12, last I'll have to come up next year and go back." But this weekend, it rang true. It's back! It was a reopening ceremony but then there was no music, but it worked out in its favor. It's beautiful and incredibly cozy, I have to admit. They've made sure the bar itself is looking as nice as ever and really enjoyed getting back to their old look. At last the bar was a nice place to take a breath... the weather was great. They only have a few tables open but it seemed like the crowd was coming around right away. It was a great experience, one I will definitely be going back to again next year! You can hear the owners sing a few songs and say "Hey, where the Hell are our crazies now?"

I have been to Theo's a few times, and have been very happy. The pizza is not as good as the Elmwood location, but I just had a friend take home a good size pizza and it was very tasty The pizza is often huge and it has no problems with breaking down even after long baking. There is a good selection of bottled water but I'm not a fan of the overly sweet colas on the menu. I would still like to try the panini and salads but the salads are really good. Theo's is a great pizza place to be.

The WTIX 88.3 FM program is a new addition to the radio landscape in New Orleans. We stopped by the oldies radio station, FM 91 (Morning Jazz). It's now a little more fun & friendly. The food is great and you receive great value. They usually have a "splash" day special or two for happy hour. They provide a lot of variety. The main course - chicken & sausage.
