I guess it's easier to find your favorite tv sitcoms (I'm still trying and I hope not to find your "go to They also have one of the most awesome old-timey vinyl albums that I've ever seen: Ozzy Osbourne, the remastered versions A good spot if you're after a late-night grab or a little splurge on a lunch for the kids. It's like the old neighborhood record store... no sign of Peaches... just the old Woolworths logo. I am going for the 3 CDs and also my favorite reissue of the Bliss-O'-The-Briss album

There were rumors as recently as last week that 90.7 WZX was moving away and getting new headquarters. I mean, I had no idea that WWOZ was still there. WWOZ is still just an old school old school radio station. Many of the former DJs (including my friend & son-in-law Joey) are still hanging around after retiring. Having been in the business (and with my own radio) for the past twenty years, the DJs have seen a lot of turnover and departures The only thing that is different is the selection of music on some days that is not on the other. I love the Saturday morning show (and later in the week the DJ on the 88.9 morning show). There are a few classic R&B/Sugar House CDs (the old 78's), a bunch of remastered 1980 And if you're in a spot where you're sure to get something good from one of these shows, remember that you'll get  I'm always impressed.
I've found a great new site and are using it to get the supplies this week. I also love Gator t's, I've got some of their other t's in the works. Great looking print, too.

We had some friends visiting from Portland and one of our dinners was for two! There were over a dozen different restaurants in the neighborhood. This place popped up a few times when we were just wandering the city. It's not exactly located on the Strip but there is a nice patio on the back of the hotel for seating with a nice view of the area They were incredibly friendly, really tucked away and easy to hang out with. As a group we had 10 people. We only ate one or three of the dishes, so each one was unique. I liked everything we had. I got my skewers to try the wings in a wrap and was so impressed with what I got! We tried the French flat carved tofu and had to cut into small pieces because the char and skin couldn't be kept. When my friends got their entrees, they loved it as well! That was all our food and beverages. It's a pretty small but fresh glass. They are all really friendly and we even did our own shopping!
I always enjoyed going to this store! These days, I've been here a few times while driving a few hundred miles to get a book for my daughter. They're the ones that take care of us from there.

The newer layout is more comfortable and easier to navigate through. My keypad was wiped down with a microfiber cloth and there are multiple passwords across the front. The store is clean, except the windows. Generally, it is a pretty decent store compared to other stores. I believe the stores in the area are all closed due to the pandemic. No sign of an EMA.

I love my visit to this office. The office is completely clean and feels more like the office in Paris. The office is clean and the staff are very friendly. The staff is always friendly and helpful--especially at the front desk--and the doctor is very extroverted and down-to-e I think it's important for doctors to ask me what my concerns or concerns are and what the best skin care regimens are for me. And then there's the doctor, who's nice and nice and nice all over. They do a great job with their patients and always recommend their best products.

I have been working on a new car for about a year now, so I've been pretty fortunate in the rain and lack of traffic. I did not need to wait for several hours to figure out if anyone would show up. I put the tires in my truck and jumped into the driveway. My driver was so rushed he called as soon as he could and he was in a bit of a hurry because it was raining All I had to do was sit in my car and my helper was there to get me out and fix it. Until the jack detachs and comes off I have to start over from the top. Thank you pop-a-lock.

My friends and I stopped by IKEA for the first time in a while. I know.. they have been closed for 4 years now but one day on the weekend I had to sit in with a group of 15 for lunch to We were pretty hungry so we opted to go outside. The atmosphere was welcoming and cozy. I don't know the names of some of the items on their menu but the combos from the menus and dishes that I tried were pretty good. We started with the Thai Beef. I wasn't too impressed! It didn't bother me at all and if you like that it's even better with grits because it's a combination of One side of the taco was so salty that my partner had to ask for an order of the onion rings, because I didn't want them. It was a hot day but it was still really nice to sit outside with a view. We've had good food and I always enjoy their benedict, but I think my issue was with the noise. I actually turned in my phone because I was sitting near the windows and it was so loud. There wasn't enough room to sit in the booths or even sit at the table. So ambiance was great. I also did not enjoy the view.

Looks like the whole store at the right is dirty. The one in North San Jose, California isn't bad enough but the store is too small and the food selection and prices can't be beat at It is very loud and people don't speak English.

This one in Downtown Atlanta is quite good. It's been reborn this time around and it's a great new place. I've always enjoyed that type of cafe. The coffee was quite a bit stronger than I've had in Edinburgh for quite some time. The food is great. The architecture is interesting. It's a well lighted neighborhood and on a very pleasant evening I could have walked to the park or browsed the gift shops. It's just so refreshing to walk into a cozy place that's not a caryatid cafe. I enjoy this little coffee shop.

I love the theater and have been to the mall a lot, but on a recent visit I thought it needed some work. The last time was in 2007. There were only 2 seats still available so they resorted to putting me in just the front row w/o seats. So I went anyway with a friend. I understand that the theater is newer and has a whole new facade but when we arrived there was a complete remodeled lobby. The theatre seats had seats that were broken, cracked, broken, or worn out...I can only imagine their painters used duct tape to keep the seats But even by today’s standards it could use a makeover. The movie has come out but the theater itself still doesn't feel like what it had before. Its a good stop to buy a movie but unless you are in a hurry you are not likely to choose this location.

Big Fisherman is a little off the beaten path with the local seafood stores in the Bay City area. When I ordered my first seafood from this store, one of the managers said there is so much that no one is aware of. He is as friendly as he is informative and explains exactly what he sells. After I ordered the crab cake, I asked for some Louisiana pickles, fried chicken fingers that I would make into a big bowl. They also have very delicious ice cream, ham bone, oysters and much more. I made sure I knew what was going on. A huge thumbs up and enjoy.

This stuff is pretty cheesy. But I did stop by while we were over the weekend and took some items away. These are some of the biggest in the building. If I'm feeling particularly naive, I'll venture over here.

I had the Shrimp boil and the Green Salad. I must admit, I liked the bar here. The menu is wonderful and the drink selection is very good. I've had the shrimp boil, fish. The steak is tender, but the fish is overdone - overseasoned. The ice cream was good. I've had better. The decor is very stylish and pretty good ambiance. The bar is gorgeous, the lights go off pretty often, and the place is clean and dark. I had a chance to meet the owners at the bar today and they were a little friendly. Service is good..

It was a busy and windy Saturday and finally had enough time to go to the library. At this point I believe one of my favorite libraries in Florida is the New Mexico State Library. It is overrun by the library and has been a permanent collection for only over 5 years now because the town is so weak that they were forced to take I know my kids like getting books, but sometimes it is a little too cozy. But the home was an old mansion and most of the inventory (including the books) have been donated. It is famous also for the sign reading "The City of Love and Freedom" on each floor. The home has the most unique art work that I have seen in a library. Today I went and toured the collection for myself. I didn't go too far out to look at it, but I must say it was great walking around putting it up for the summer!

I think they're nice and cozy. And some of the drinks were a little overpriced. I guess they need to put some of the alcohol right on the glass when they're ready to drink? I ended up buying me a drink at a different place or taking it to another party. They do have a huge selection of taverns. Don't go, but give them a shot.

I arrived before 7pm and there was plenty of seating available. My order is now ready. The food was tasty the same day with no weird splatters. A delivery driver brought me all the food for free. There were no staff wearing masks at all. The dish I ordered is chicken rice with beef, corn and green cabbage. It was good. But the coffee they serve smelt burnt and burnt. I would say it’s at least as good as it’s supposed to be.
I had to get some of these shirt items and we were able to get a few last week. Love the store.. Thanks for a great find.

They were the source for our plant sale. We got a great sized selection of plants. Had their roasted chicken salad and it was very good. There was plenty of parking and it had a good crowd! I will definitely be back.
Every year, I find myself in the Santa Cruz Museum of Art. I love this kind of thing!! Also here is more of the parade on the parade route.

So yesterday was a good day. I finally got a chance to check my truck's transmission fluid levels. In a very short amount of time. And so I went. A friend recommended this but I ended up with a discount for myself. First of all... I said I was a non-specified passenger. The car was driving a little rough. And they told me it takes about 12 - 15 minutes to get that done (I'm doing 17 because there were 3 people on the scene) and They didn't take long at all to come back and tell me the problems with my car, they checked and changed the oil and put new air filter over It took them a few minutes to explain everything. Hope them all get good service now though. So beware of it!

The next day we were invited into the new Tasting Room in the corner of 2nd and 13th. I'm very upset with the decision to go the other direction in 2021 but hoped that it would be a good one. After a friendly introduction he coached us on the best drinks and we were given a menu to sample. After that we were served an awesome drink list to try. The burgers were cooked perfectly and tasted amazing!! I was able to get a good rate (not the same as it once was) for the window repair for our kitchen, which took me about 4 I enjoyed my meal. I highly recommend!.

For the main event, the special wings were DELICIOUS. So that means that there are loads of options to choose from. I went with some shrimp and shrimp with spring roll. They both tasted amazing with the shrimp and tofu and if I could rate them higher I'd go with them. I tried & sampled the fried crab cake. The meat and the sauce were both very unique and I could not describe the taste of the crab better. The rice was a bit under-done because it sounded more like a meal than a bowl that consisted of some kind of  After that I got to sample the rice bowls too. I enjoyed it with some rice and a few sprinklings of brown sugar (my go-to pick for this dish) and the broth I thought it was better than it looks and I was amazed by the amount of meat on top of the rice. I liked the spicy flavors of the broth and the sour heat that was there with it and not overpowering. I liked the sangria that they served with it, too. Service was wonderful and we had a great time. There were also a good number of beers available which you can order them with. The drink menu features a variety of cocktails, and they offered a great selection of craft beers. This place is really a great place where you can be relaxed and enjoy your food. I would still recommend checking out this new venue.

The place is great. Had a lovely restaurant experience while taking in this beautiful restaurant. I was trying out the French baguette. Chicken wings with bacon and tomato-originate chutney. Not to mention the salad. We ordered the cheese and wine selections that come with the breakfast sandwich. Everything is so fresh and the ingredients taste so good...I am so glad I made the move back uptown! The drinks are a little expensive, but worth it! This is a new restaurant. Best place to get good, simple food in town at reasonable prices!

Had a great dinner with Anita and her mother-in-law on a Wednesday night for Mothers day while the kids were there. I would definitely recommend it with some reservations as the place is pretty small and isn't as busy as some other seafood restaurants. We had a glass of sake and a drink. We were served in a little bit which is a bonus where seating is limited. We also ordered a gin martini; the drink was good with a nice flavorful drink with it. The rolls were great with the cucumber salad being a favorite. You can buy it for a dollar off at a place like Teriyaki and they have a really good selection - although it won't The guacamole was nice and it had good flavor, but it could have been a little creamier but I really like the taste. I ordered an order of edamame since it is the only thing I eat on Friday night. I've heard good things about the edamame since being in Japan. I didn't get really into it because I thought the meat was too salty or too rich; I ended up with more veggies and cream cheese and the For our total bill, we ate about $40 with drinks between $28 and $33, which was really great.

I got my car back from a Shell station in the middle of the week. But I'm happy! A few weeks ago after I was to have my tag replaced (which was a good thing) it finally came around to my inspection appointment and the line for I was in desperate need of a new tag. I was  nervous the guy driving her in the car sat in front of an open truck so I turned off the backlight, opened my trunk and I was a guest, the driver helped me put on my coat as the inspector followed me around... just like they do on a school trip! I did really well! I got it and I got to pick up my new tag. My car turned over. So I got my brake tag (for $2), my brake plate, my new ID tag, and of course my dick's tag! Check out a sticker. Now I can drive and feel comfortable.

I've only been here once or twice, but it seems the restaurant is doing a really good job here. After getting my coffee and my lunch, I wasn't sure how they had everything. I was a little wary...trying to make my mind up what kind of dish/cup they should serve and not get a gagging I would definitely say...it was a little rough to get my order in. The service had some issues with not being friendly, but other than that, the staff was friendly & welcoming. It was fast lunch and very busy (never have to wait that long either). If this was a normal restaurant, I will never again go there. I'm going to start working up ideas to get the kitchen and bar staff involved with the management team and I'll post those down here!

I was adamantly checking in on Yelp to make sure the show was still on! I like this little spot. Very happy with my experience. Love the mini quiche. This is at a low point in their store. It was a nice night though and I would definitely come back again. They're very friendly, very reasonable prices and fast service. It was fun to look around since it was so quiet. They are always very friendly and helpful because they have a great atmosphere and an awesome kitchen.

Mom's grandmother had made a special dinner for us to celebrate the holiday and she had asked the family for a whole trout. She was really forgetful about getting him the supplies. But Mom said she would cook one of her own and wanted it pre-made in advance. I found it in the bag at the market. A waitress spotted my little squishy kitty and took over. The shop was busy. No cooking needed.Once I set my order they took the fish away. No one was eating or drinking. It was like a little game of "wine and ham" vs. the fish. I got home with the baked trout and a bowl of hot greens. They took care of stuff the night before.

I had great breakfast at the Sprouts at Westside. Having a reserved area means you can make the reservation at 5pm so that you just need to head to a table when you arrive to save on We decided to try it for breakfast and the food was so good! I had the pumpkin and banana breakfast. A little salty but a little good but certainly not the best egg toast ever. It was also great for the early bird specialties I mention previously. We also had the egg whites which had a sweet egg white yolk and a little bit of lemon juice to add a little zing to mine The service was amazing and they were very friendly and provided us with a full bar that featured a bit of a selection of drinks, such as lemon people enjoying breakfast as well and some really delicious lunch specials and a large selection of teas and cookies. I'm kind of sad with all the gluten in a biscuit, it was very healthy but not as tasty as the usual. There was a couple of vegetarian meals that were also vegan as well. I probably would have gotten there earlier but that was the weekend after the wedding which is what it was for. What a little gem!

I was on a very low-key eating train so I had to stop in for some dinner yesterday. We ate here on a weekday and it was lovely. We started with garlic chowder with kale, tangy ranchero, and green peppers. They also had a healthy selection of wraps, sandwiches and their take on the fried food which I could have adapted very well to my personal taste I went a pretty dark wine side of things and we ordered a white sangria and a dark sangria. It was delicious and it tasted so fresh. We ended our meal with a delicious pizza, served with a fried egg, a few slices of garlic, scallions and lots of The main course of the lunch consisted of steak, roasted and plated burgers & cheese plate. We finished our meals with our swag of fresh scones, a ginormous sandwhich and our very own personal Our server was a bit rough on us too.... she was the opposite of a bartender...she was not overbearing, didn And they had an amazing cocktail list as well! So this was not only a stellar lunch, it was great food. So much to love.

Love this place - great for lunch and a great spot to go late on Sunday lunch. Had to check it out! You get a lot of fillings. I was unable to finish it all because the hummus was VERY thick and it was so flavorful! Love how they smudge the hummus on top of everything. They were open until 9th so try to find a seat when you get home! And since we were there, their falafels were super crispy (it had been 10 minutes since I was in, and I have to say still very I don't think it'll happen until after we'd gotten back home. What a great concept!

This was quite an epic visit. I went in early on my first visit and they told me I had to sign up. So I went in. Very fast.. very friendly staff. I went with two drops and I was done. In the end, I was pleased with the outcome. The staff did not look busy and made sure to tell me when I was done.

There's something for everyone in Brown park. There's a lot of fun things to do, especially at night (including the Marquis of Marigny)...and it's  It's a nice spot for some exercise. The park is pretty safe, and one of the areas I likens to The Park at City Hall is much more peaceful and quiet. The only park in New Orleans that is so close to the barrio is Boulud Garden (near Levee), which is  Beware of the locals (there are also a few non-friendly businesses there that don't help you but feel free to ask).

The clubhouse was beautiful and so was the food! There are a few complaints however when I arrived I was still greeted by several people sitting on the steps and being called to come in, but I The clubhouse offers a lot of opportunities for relaxation and some of the amenities offered to the members are outstanding. I would highly recommend this place!

After a weekend trip to Italy, I found myself back out on Saturday night to go eat at Apothecary. After leaving I ordered the "couldn't finish my salad" which was delicious but just a bit salty. As always the service and portions are below average. The ricotta is kinda burnt, and on top of that my ricotta was too chewy and hard. This place is a burger shack with old school charm.
Great food & good service. I've lived there and loved it. Pretty good tapas. Awesome.. good enchilada. My advice is to go for half of the entrees.

My family had a recent convention and decided to try this place out. We arrived as parking is very difficult to find. Some sort of chain-themed vibe here. Points for having great patio seating. I've had better. Great patio seating and beautiful views. I ordered the bbq chicken. Other than that everything was good. A good selection of salads and lots of options for sandwich options. I have no complaints.

I've ate here many times when the bartenders are super slow- they seem more dedicated to selling liquor than to serving people. Nice atmosphere, very nice staff, great beer taps and good drinks. A lot of waiters can't handle all of the orders at once, so I'm not sure if there's a real kitchen, The bar is awesome too.

I have been loving crabmeat au gratin since the 1970s. What a classic--my boyfriend and I had it several times over the summer and I absolutely fell in love with it. After seeing it at several places, I was wary of this place and didn't want to get my teeth twee. But I think the bartender at this place made a great version of it. It's served with some nice thinly sliced lemons, served with the classic, sour cream sauce (I subbed this for  One word of advice, he was right. :) Y'know, I tried the entire crabmeat au gratin, only the calamari and cheese was not bad at Not to mention, it's an excellent price. Even good for sore taste buds.

This was our first time to this new location. This was a good experience. The chicken was cooked just right and well done. The poboy was about $4 and the shrimp was just a couple of dollars. They also have a nice outdoor patio which is perfect for summertime. I ordered the peach, coconut and raspberry tea. I would definitely go back.

At the time of this review my friend and I were visiting New Jersey from our work in Boston. I don't know which of our daughters would choose the wings, but they did a good job and enjoyed them as well. The mashed potatoes were great, the pulled pork sandwich was good but a little dry on the outside and the fried shrimp over the bottom was good, The steakhouse looks nice. I went ahead with some shrimp that weren't anything special, I'd say, but they tasted good. The bread was good, good, but a little on the dry side. I was pleased, but didn't mind the wait. I ate a couple of them last week and still loved them. We all had the pan-cakes with a side of bacon and salad and the chips and salsa were surprisingly flavorful and if you ask me I had the garlic mashed potatoes...it was so good and a great variety. Nice place for a quick bite in the evening! I think I would like to try some of them. They are near HBA but the restaurant isn't a lot of fun because of the number of servers and the noise level. This was my first experience and I'll definitely come back for an even bigger meal next time. The menu was incredibly large and I was expecting more than my husband eats.

I'm so loving a new vegan/vegan restaurant; Meal Kits. I've been to the one at the corner of Northgate and McKinney for some time. They have some really unique dishes that I'd love to try on the menu. On the left you can see your dog. I guess there are too many options in the city. I think the owner is from the Philippines or so. The lunch dogs are ok. Diva Dawg delivers on-the spot... I'm definitely in line to go back soon.

It's been a while since we were able to do the night off in a nightclub, but the weather was a bitchilly so Not too bad of a night at a bar but seriously too bad for the weather. As I was in bed I thought, let's go to this... I had a good, happy hour w/ friends! The only cool wine I ate was the 'Voyage to 'Velvet Gold' with apricot and red I didn't really mind though since they had a great cheese course & they were playing their second game. And when the machine was operating, I decided to make a move to get me a few more glasses of wine and a few (mostly) So at least it wasn't overlycrowded or anything. It was fun getting back to work on Monday morning.
This place is great for family dines with the whole family but have a bit of a heavy stomach. The food is OK, but not enough to fill a large group of friends. Oh, and don't bring the whole meal.

The parade is a pretty neat one. Its parade is organized by the San Francisco Chapter of The San Francisco American Legion (www.flaqrc.org) They are one of Pygmalion paraded at the St. John's Festival on August 14th, 2011. It is a great event to go to when the weather is good. It's hard to decide if this has anything to do with the weather.

It was raining by the time I arrived, I was trying not to watch more than 10 people go to the front of the parade. It was a bit crowded and I got lost a lot. Good parade..The bands were a nice assortment of the old school musicians that don't feel the need to do the kids their due justice if You get to see a lot of their floats as well, so even these weren't a fad. I was so hoping I would be able to sing along on the floats but I was so astonished to see the rest of the parade We had to get up early to see it...we were both wearing raincoats and wore some long sleeves. So, back off again.

This is the area that is near the South Fork of the ICW. It's near the village of Tulane. It's just a very big park with many miles of trails and beautiful buildings. They also have the "The River of the Soul" tour. This is a nice and clean park that you can do quite a bit of damage when you visit.

I just found out that Gentilly Munch has a website where you can get free coupons. My friends got married near the restaurant and were really happy when she asked me to join them for dinner on Saturday night. I ate here once and enjoyed the food. It also included some other traditional Italian dishes like chicken skewers and fish dishes. The food was great. I got my fill of this dish; chicken wings, fried oysters, and salad. We also had a few cocktails (non-alcoholic) but we didn't like the selection and couldn't stay to eat. The noise level was very loud and I was tired when it was supposed to be quiet.

The place was pretty uninspired. I am used to restaurants being open 24 hours so I thought I would have some kind of freedom when I ate. I got to use a lot of that room: the bathroom, the kitchen, and dining room. So we went for the burgers so I knew what they were. Probably just as good as the next few places we went to though. I'm not going back.

We had a happy hour here a few times before our last visit to the city. I'm not going to say much as the food was sub par. What do I really like about the atmosphere there? I can't really say much about the food but it was decent and the price wasn't bad. That was all the really needed energy for some things to go right.

My wife and I went to Nirvana today. I finally decided to try the new location for dinner, but the restaurant itself is an absolute mess. We ordered a soup dish from a menu and it was tasty. The Chat papri we took home was mushy and gross. It was soggy and I couldn't finish it properly. And then, i was all ready for the saag paneer which was re-shaved and thrown into the bowl

I have to say that I really liked the food at the Greens. The meat selection is good and the sandwiches are nice. I loved the beef wraps and the fried calamari. They have one big thing though... they serve beer...fri-tauii. We came in looking for a delicious vegetarian lunch (I should also be trying that but, I love their chicken). The chicken kilo was good, but I didn't think it was quite enough protein to satiate my craving for chicken. My husband had a wrap with meat & veggies, salad, and chips.

Like most of the hotel rooms, this is an expensive place to stay. They are open until 11pm Friday through Sunday nights and open until 10pm on Mondays. I was pleasantly surprised to see just how nice the ambiance is and how they keep the drinks well-appreciated. The wine, by then, was about double my usual choice, a lovely smidge of Pinot Noir. The music choice (I heard a few jazz songs) is a bit on the over-wrought side but all is good with very nice lighting. The atmosphere is warm and the wine glass is glass. I will certainly try to visit this place every time I come to Montreal because of the beautiful architecture, the excellent service, and the delicious wine.

One of the most reviewed places on Yelp & Yelp.com, Sun Ray's is not the best in the city, but it I always love Sun Ray because my brother & i.e. was pretty much right & I was probably just joking...but it's the type of restaurant that I've hung around my whole life And because it gets hungry & gets hungry...it's Sun Ray's specialties. It's also a cool atmosphere to go to, but you do need to be prepared for everyone to have some sort of bad attitude towards the food. It also had a great atmosphere which is what I enjoy. I never thought I'd want to eat there because I find it to be an almost perfect combination of flavors. I think at one point it became a bit of a battle between me and my brother over the pizza. And I would love to hear what you think of the cocktails. If any of you are thinking of going to this restaurant, I suggest doing a double take, you know one that does not require you eating outside or sitting The parking lot is spotless. Now you read that correctly, there is no parking and that this is bad for business. There are parking lots and there are parking lots everywhere in Chicago...so do yourself a favor if you think parking spaces could be made more secure. All I could think about was having my son run, and then driving away as he chases a rat before a truck approaches. I could have been hit by a passing car, not sure, but there wasn't a whole lot of time. And of course it did, I just could not handle that sort of situation.

The food for the last time this week wasn't great; I really wanted to like my food a little more. But today's was pretty bad aww! or the fact that I had never ordered the scallops with grapefruit or radish sprouts before and did not have any expectations about what was on the The soup was cold and the meats were tasteless. (I am not sure what the beef came from or what kind it was. It's pretty much pork & fish - and, in my opinion, it isn't even that cheap). Second problem was my dish was all fried fish. I thought the shrimp and arugula salad were pretty good (you can't really go wrong with a ratatouille salad; it uh..I'm sure the locals actually have no idea what it is...to make a dish with it?). It's like there aren't enough new dishes to make it interesting. Despite his complaints, I'd still go back here.

I can't get over how cool this store is. The store used to be in a little building off of Route 73 & South Market Street. It's a great website where you can search by price tags. This is a good one. Usually, they'll make a deal on the price of a piece, but sometimes they'll have a big hole in the price. One item I saw in the store was a gorgeous chair that was only $25,000 at the time. I can see me purchasing another one as soon as I'm in the area. We went to a vintage mall of 80s chrome, leather, and wooden chairs and only seen some 1960s black & cream chairs there, so the When they got the new furniture in, it was really great.) I also bought an old vintage Lucite chair from here a week ago, which is an amazing find. But I think you could easily find a nice 80s reproduction for around $600.

I was here on a Friday afternoon, so I decided to dine a couple of times. I ordered the healthier selection because I was not feeling my best and my wife was in the mood for a cup. He was so happy, he walked in saying, "we love our crabs at Jaegers". It wasn't all bad, but I'm thinking this would have been better if it had come with a little more variety. And the crabs were fresh and  juicy, no frozen ones.

I'm not sure what everyone else thinks of the new location. It was a great seafood restaurant, and a great place for lunch. I liked the seating and the fact that when I went in there, you could vete and drink, with water available. This was fine until Katrina and when Jaeger's opened in Clearview on Sunday, I didn't mind ordering from the drive- So it would have been a nice change to go there, but the food was rather unimpressive and the service was also really subpar. With the price of the food, I was a little nervous.

The menu, atmosphere and atmosphere of Sonic Superstore are way too much like other Sonics. I have one near me in Dallas that is closed at the moment, since it just gets packed with people in the middle of the day. It's a 'taste' type of thing to do. How can a fast food place take so long? If you ever decide - get some real McDonald's, that's what you get.

I was very happy with this store and with my experience there! I went in this week because I had some really heavy storage projects going on and I needed to paint some board for a new job. I live just across the street from the shop and was looking for a quick and dirty job since I will be working around Christmas time. One other positive thing I have to say about their service was that they don't use a spray gun. I also received free paint samples so it was more than happy and I did not have to pay for my product. The interior room is pretty aweful. SW was a great place to stop in for some light work. I'm putting up some signs for the shop on the side of the street and they have some identifying cards on the sign. They were just good!

I went to a Taco Bell location in St. Charles for dinner on Friday, July 10th. They did well to accommodate me and my daughter, we just like going to one. It's a bit pricey for the amount you get but they can be really good. We just missed the food service area so they aren't so efficient with the server. The bar/drinks were decent. The food is hot. With a place of this caliber, they are the only place in town that serves fried shrimp. There are many hot items to choose from and we did split some of them and it was very good. The service was always prompt and pleasant. What more could you ask for...

I was looking for a good local restaurant that had good food for my senior family. I came upon Cosa Bella as a result of a Yelp search. My mother was a fan of the French onion soup and I enjoyed my mom's chicken enchiladas as well. We ordered a variety of plates including two sandwiches. My Mom had the fish and chips so it didn't get cold orggy and our son even had a few bites. We both had the pork & beef burrito on both sandwiches, it was served with a nice brown or black plate of veggies. My brother had the fried chicken and I had a fried duck. We spent more than half of the meal talking about the great menu and we're here for an awesome lunch. The ambiance of the restaurant was very similar to a bar in a restaurant and we could all sit together and talk about what we were eating. We would definitely visit again if we need something affordable.

I went to Fancy Dresses in the mid late 2000's but was introduced to the store by one of my coworkers. The store has been around since that time, but it's very different than most large closets - at least not for me. The store is small and kinda ghetto... Most of the clothes look amazing but take a while to explore. Those in my thirties and thirties would just like to go, but I don't. If you're a girl with less energy than I am, it's always a chore. What I like about this store are the accessories...the prices are really reasonable and you can use them for other areas of your wardrobe. There is a good way to get around the store but I think it could be better. In my book, I got most of my gifts there the last two years.

Nikki Salon and Clinics is in the GNO area, just off Lapalco. I've had some facials here and my husband has had massages (not to mention other spa services!) I have finally found her at Scent of Summer and I have yet to be disappointed with her skills. The name is all caps! and there is a lot more to see there to make your visit more informative. She did my massage in a little bit of privacy and didn't feel rushed. I am not a huge fan of the infusions and Nikki was very educated on the difference between their products. She is quite professional and professional as well as a friendly personality. The new location has a very modern feeling to it...which makes your experience even more enjoyable. The salon is close to restaurants in the restaurant area, and easy to get to for the gondola ride from the parking lot. I had a great time and the services were great and she did agreat job. I will certainly return.

Sadly, the new HH in the West Side has yet to launch. I've definitely been there a few times over its history and always enjoyed the drinks and their atmosphere. Just saw this place this past Saturday and had a great time. It's a good pub/club location with some really good local beers and several fine, light food options. The space was extremely warm, a bit cool when it was still warmer than the outdoor event. At the event I sampled their California Pale ale (which they made from Pale Ale I think), which I found to be wonderful. I think I like a lot of the places I've come to since this one was open at the time. It is a comfortable cozy space with a nice lounge area in front of the doors. I'll certainly be back. In the end, a great place.

Since I started going to McKenzie's on New Years eve, I've tried to stop by all three of their locations in the area If you have not, there is no reason to be! It's not like you're stealing cupcakes from anyone else... It's a small cafe on 5th street, which means the only I got me 2 cupcakes. Don't worry. I was impressed.I've ordered cupcakes at other places that lack that kind of service. Order online and a smile will make everything better. There are a few different cupcake flavors available, so you'll find something for every taste and every mood. I ordered two cupcakes, both of which were chocolate. Yummy! It also has a choice of cake, but they had sweet potato and a vanilla in that variety. What a contrast between the strawberry and the chocolate. That was about 3 months ago and I had a craving for sweet potatoes! These cupcakes are light and airy. So overall, it's an awesome place to go whether you're a fan of McKenzie's or not.
Superb coffee, perfect location and staff! You can also use the wooden ladders if you wish.

I am very excited to review this store! It was a great choice for the day. The store is fairly large and as the name states, the shop is quite large and quite clean. Thanks to the people at the store, they were really helpful and didn't let the firemen touch me. I would recommend this to anyone.

I thought what a great experience these guys were having last night. I found a place nearby at the Columns: The Square Garden. Sometime before that a friend shared an update on their Facebook page. I got to try it out on Friday in the middle of the day. Here at the old Stoned Horse Tavern we had a ten-minute wait for the bar to open. The interior has gone through some major renovations. The interior of the building has had a total makeover over the years. The entire restaurant is still under renovation. The front room was incredibly clean, bright and comfortable with several old fashioned paintings. So the rooms have the usual decor that you would expect (and get a bit more) done to them. The menu doesn't include the usual traditional burgers/lunchbox specials and is a bit different from their previous offerings. The bar is also fairly well lit which is perfect to stay tucked away when the patio doors open up. A few items like the new bar/patio area have already started receiving reviews. I'm guessing maybe a couple of drinks/burgers next time instead of just drinks.

I enjoy the Venetian Casino--most of the restaurants are pretty expensive and expensive parking--disappointingly. I like the idea of going to the auction house to have lunch, it has a nice relaxed atmosphere. The ambiance is great and the service top notch. My friends always want me to try something new. The booths have nice clean bathrooms. They all have different pricing and you can try their selection but also compare how many different snacks you could eat. Very modern seating.The wait staff is very friendly and the food is incredibly delicious. I highly recommend this place.

I was hungry for biscuits when I got up early after work. Not to mention I was hungry because I had had almost no breakfast in a while. I found Cafe Pando. Check out their menu on yelp. Blue line is a really good breakfast spot around this neighborhood. Served with a side of pickled vegetables (no meat). It's an under-$25 order so it's angie rated a "d" for its size so you can't put it I was so hungry that I had to take one bite of every meal. The biscuit had a very savory Jam on top but I decided something was missing so I substituted the bread for the cornflakes just to make it  So I eat at their bar and sat outside to watch the game. Not much trouble for breakfast if you look very far away from your car.

A great venue for large weddings. The reception was at the end of the building which was great because it was a dark and crowded space. The aisle area and dance floor were nice and there were plenty of places to park the vehicle. It was very nice to see my brother and his sweetheart and it felt so nice to finally see me again. Food was good but a little bit too fast in the past as the wedding was on a Saturday so it definitely served a different purpose. For the most part the food was overly rich with little to no flavor. Although there were plenty of food choices I did think the bar area might have been bigger. I am so glad I had a chance to partake in a few bites of the sweet pastries as they were the center of the party. The venue is relatively quiet but I would say that they are really a "snappy spot" on the North side of the North Shore. The venue is on the outside of the shopping center but it is a great place for the reception. Defiantly check this one out.

The bar at Bob's Steakhouse is probably the first restaurant in New York to open under the name of "Bar Bob's", meaning that it So when the owners and staff of Leap into the kitchen to talk, I had to make the long drive to drop by for some dinner and drinks. When I made the trip to visit we were able to eat before being seated. On first go, we tried the rumbasade and ice cream. I could only finish my drink so I took a rest and made a couple of scones the same day. And then I decided to go for some brunch. We took advantage of being at the front of the restaurant to get a quick glance at the brunch options. It was a little crowded as some of our group had arrived already - I wasn't sure they had a wait/sold out date My guests loved their choice and we all ordered a few so we could try the other items. We were all thoroughly hooked on the cocktails though - the lime vodka and triple sec was delicious! I wish they opened at 4:45 the next day. I really like these guys all around. There is a small stage for live music. Happy Brunch..from K!

Most of the younger people feel comfortable in this place. When they arrive (with their own cars), they feel like you're traveling in a city with a very old world feel. You can park anywhere you like, it's even free up front. It’s always packed and it’s always fun.

I have to stop by 12 Mile lately! The bar has been getting awesome!! I'm glad I went again... and I haven't been able to stop by for drinks since. At the right time I noticed something new and I was excited! And the food is always at a great price. The drink was amazing, fresh and hot. The service there as of today is super friendly. The beer is good too. When the manager came by just to tell me that they had moved he said that it was still open. Also, everyone in our group was very nice and had a great time. I didn’t have a drink, only a few days later, but now I know. I have yet to try the tacos but I'll be back soon.

The Bar at the Sears on Broadway in Charlotte, NC is a "go to" location in Charlotte for gameday cocktails and other fine dining. The bar is decorated like a Saints Bar in the way that the old stadium is. It's a fairly small section but usually there's about 30 regulars here. Maybe another group of people were there? The bar/patio has also been open to the public during games. There's always some wait. There is plenty of room and there are a lot of tables so I'd be interested in having a full bar at night time. It usually costs around $5 to get inside if you're not a client or are just passing through. The place is great, and the atmosphere is great, too. It's definitely not what it used to be. It's certainly worth the trip over here.

Feel a little crazy in the NFL? You've come to the right place! It's about a fifteen minute drive from my house. My fav: Nike's, Nike's, Nike's. There's usually a very strong discount if you buy from them. It's a great spot for Saints fans and also a great little shopping stop, too!

Great rooms and bathroom.... Good food for a free happy hour. Don't hesitate to call ahead. There are a ton of people in there. If you have a good swim cape and cover yourself with a shirt (I would get it for my last day with us), then that is  Things I like: * hot shower/tub * hum/melody music * pool table/chairs * beach chairs * hot glass of wine. * nice pool..

In the past few years I've been to different eats since I can remember. It turns out they are from a huge chain of local coffee restaurants, but on their own. I was really hoping to find out much more about this great new coffee shop. Regardless, I've had better coffees here in the past two years. My mother and I got tea and I thought it tasted just like tea when made with a lid. My husband got a sarong and it was way too hot. I know they do. I thought that their coffee was a little high end but it was hot and it went down really quickly so figured it was good. The food was ok. I ordered the breakfast sandwich, which was very good but soggy texture like ice water. There wasn't much to choose from either. My husband ordered an omelet and it got burned and we were pretty grossed out.

I've been to plenty of stores that carry good quality clothes on good prices. The only mistake I made was shopping at two shops with identical prices (the store nearest me is about 15 minutes away, and the ones on the other hand are I went to Prime Donna today (as if the location wasn't just a little far from our house) and it was a very nice One major issue is the prices. It was a beautiful place in a less busy location but if you arrive too early you will have a hard time finding a place to  Unfortunately, one of the dresses I went in was in a plus-size. This was my first visit. Still, the prices are reasonable compared to the other stores around here.

It's a bit snotty. I'd be afraid of going there because I just did not see anyone smoking. So we walked in only to find that there was one very good alcoholic drink on tap--the red drink has the orange colour of a pe It's the second smoke I have come across in a while and I got a nose ache. The food is very similar to some other chain taverns and it's a nice place. There is a food court in the back that you can use all day long, but the food isn't very good. However it's a little pricey and the tv only has a few shows a day instead of every day. They're in the ceiling area, but the seat is more than a foot apart.
Oh..where are you? I am not making this up. I think I've had my fill. It's where you find cool books, puzzles, and memorabilia. You get to go and buy all the stuff you wanted for $1.00.

I contacted this place from one of my friends and I went to the nearby 'Kid's Diner' on a trip to Las Great food and service. I would have given this place 5 stars for the poached eggs but it was good. Their waitresses were super nice though. I couldn't understand who was serving them on their plate...they were ordering eggs. It turned into a bit of a slapdown during a long wait. On our way out the menu was not all the toppings you normally know or order (spicy cranberry juice, fresh fennel The drink came with an iced tea float that could only be drank from the side or right in front of you (like the one  They had a lot of really strong alcohols that night and were just really sick. Love this place!The service was friendly(as long as everyone else was happy) & it wasn't crowded.

I'm from San Francisco so I'm looking at this as a random stop! There are also two indoor play areas in this building. I like that there's a museum about music, and a museum about wine that's actually open to the public. I haven't seen the show since the late 80s, but it was impressive.

3 stars at this restaurant on the strip! It was good, just not as good as I had hoped. That is just my taste but I must say...it was all very good! As a foodie, this place is amazing. Of course, that's all and all were delicious. I ordered the burger with coleslaw and slaw and it was PERFECT! My favorite place to eat in Chicago because I love the atmosphere!

Today I visited the New York store at Nordstrom! They had the best gift I ever saw. And then that was all I could think about. I bought something in my little corner of the store, so I didn't end up looking for anything else- I was more willing to check out the whole This shop is really impressive!
The food was good. Great place and if you are looking for a French restaurant, this is it. There is a nice view of the Saint Charles River. This is not near the French Quarter, but it's close.

I was about to go to the local Home Depot for the day but I ran off when the door was left open I thought. If you want to get the wheels of a car you must go to this place. We only ended up going for a few hours before our meeting. I parked right outside and walked around until I found out there were only eight chairs left. There were so many wheelchairs there so we decided to move in. I didn't go to the end and asked about the warranty so it came with a few warranty options (be it service contract or warranty) to make I put it back together so that I could transport it with the kids to the parades. Then I went onto the next building in the parking lot with the other couple.

We had breakfast at Bistro B1 yesterday with a friend of mine. I'm not a foodie... And it was a pretty small menu; I was thinking about an egg sandwich. I gave it three out of five stars, because that was all that was available for breakfast. I think there are better breakfast options at the Blue Bird, such as the breakfast sandwiches, which are quite good and the food is very decent. The food came out okay then.

I know we've been here a little while -- I grew up going here and have found the kitchen to be spot on. They're very nice and kind, and I've never gotten angry with the server if I think about a menu item I've requested These are just to be honest. It's a great gyro so it's not to be missed. My least favorite item is their salad... they taste like swizzle sauce. If you're driving down the road, I recommend parking at the Bazaar on The Road. It is quick and cheap in price but I don't get why this place seems so average among Vietnamese and American places. This is definitely one of my personal favorite Filipino restaurants.
In addition to giving great performances during the weekdays. Fun place to sit down with friends and sip some beer.

I had not heard about tis thr place and I'm glad I did not, there had to b ye! Service was excellent and the food was solid. A keeper..not bad at all. The food is fantastic as well. I would recommend, although, please be aware that the ice cream is sold out! Parking is free, but unless you're a millionaire you won't see a car in there.

The Sushroom at The Artisan has been on our list of places to eat as part of the NY/NJ food scene. We went on a Thursday night during the summer in December and the restaurant had full service. They have an extensive menu. It's very clean and has a good selection of specialty rolls. At least it tasted good. I definitely can't remember the items I ordered, but I'm not sure. I would go back or re-order it....this one. Besides the food, really was amazing. I was a bit disappointed with the service and I think that was because the sushi quality is way too bad. Great place to go with a date.

This looks like really good tapas! Our room is in the same building as the one they have at the New Orleans Marriott. The restaurant was cozy and very clean. At lunchtime there was free coffee on the tables and there are great places for you to sit during lunch. I got to have some of the mac-n-cheese. It was a great lunch for a group of 15 coworkers. Great portions for lunch but you can see that it was filled quickly as we got up around 11 which was good because we were fasting and not feeling particularly hungry The service was very good although we got a little irritated by the waitress. The atmosphere was spot on. Good food, good service, cool environment!

My girlfriend and I had dinner here today. I had no idea what the restaurants are doing to all of the restaurants around and didn't think to come here for dinner since we went for dinner last week We are pretty regulars but have been coming to Pho Orchid for a year and the place has been good so far this year. I only had vegetarian pho and was told it's not a vegetarian item. We had the hot pot steamed dish of king fish, fried rice and shrimp. What they didn't offer was the pho without the vegetables, so I never ordered the pho without it either. So, it kind of turned out that all of my dinner dishes were vegan. A couple of rolls came with eggrolls on the side. She said it was also good with chicken as well.

This is by no means my first review of San Bernardino...I had a little bit of a hard time at first since I was in college I actually came here to learn. And I am all over UMBC. I've largely enjoyed the Chapel...it kind of has a feel like any other Catholic church I've visited, but its not as impressive as I don't know the music for the halls but if there was a big audience please let me know. The stained glass is not very well organized but that's just me of course. The theater is pretty open as far as the theater itself, which I think is pretty cool. And the people are really friendly.

My review was based on my first visit here. They had a decent selection of stuff. In other words the stuff looks a little dark, but that happens when buying from a shop. You can definitely find what you need, but I don't see any clearance items. The clothes are fairly priced though I'd probably have to wait in line and go back in the shop if I ever wanted the item back. Just remember, if you don't have time to go out there you may want to go to the Dollar Tree that is only an hour away. For whatever reason I keep returning here and it's always free.

One good thing.. No matter how much you drive, a quick tank test and the good price is worth every cent. I think it is priced fairly well (less than one buck for the liter of gas, two ft of tank, and a can of Although it does get crowded. The service. Sometimes it's not friendly and in some cases it's not even in my price range. And, to make things worse, one of the pumps has no warning light. The best thing about this place is how easy it is to get in the parking lot.

stayed for dinner Tuesday night and had a grand time. Overall, excellent service. For me the pasta was good & the pizza was perfect. It was so good that my husband kept making excuses to go back and try more of 'em all. I guess he thinks it weird to make a dessert that isn't even a dessert? Would have loved more signage for the entrance.

The food selection is VERY large and very good. The breakfast is good (albeit not for the hungry) and in the morning, you can enjoy breakfast and the scenery outside. There is an old Victorian style library, which is great for a short break after exploring the downtown area. It’s still in the process of being renovated and I have heard about more renovations that are about to happen.

I know this is a long post. First, I called up Joe's Footwear located in San Antonio. I have never had more fun at a boot store than this one in Washington, D.C. Joe's wife (or brother, etc. Who has been there a long time?) is super-pretty and knowledgeable. Her staff is also fantastic. I'm always looking for people to get some professional services at shops.

At the recent food festival that took place at the deli on the same street as the park, I got four donuts. The glazed ones are perfect! It's an awesome business to work for. I brought a guy to Freret in May. He was asked to go to the meat counter if he needed to pay for the plate, because the place in the back was already full. My son and I had an agreeable conversation, and the staff took the food, gave some suggestions and the meal was ready. But he didn't want to let it go unpaid.

I came up through this great food blog and was a bit peckish. Had heard that there were a couple of local pizza places down there so I called them. So, I had to check out his restaurant with some high profile friends to get a good piece of shrimp pizza. It was to die for! I wasn't sure it was fishy-like, or fatty, but it couldn't have been. I had a glass of gin and bourbon at the restaurant and was welcomed with a smile by the server. It was a perfect place for a casual evening drink and she brought out the newest additions to the bar to my table. I really thought about drinking a few more drinks than the guy recommended! I enjoyed my drink a generous enough to fit just one of the old-fashioneds. I am never quite sure what I thought during this very long wait, so I ended up with a pizza. And the pizza and drinks are only $2.25! I think we'll be making an impromptu trip on next year's trip to New Orleans because this is some of the best fish here

I do love this spot. It's not your typical jewelry store where you can find some cheap bling that would be worth a few good Dollars to a college student just Is that a real thing? The shop itself is a small shop ruled by a guy who sells 'New Orleans' inspired ornaments. He was a complete believer that he knew better than anyone, to always use the right tools in a good job. I'd love to hear more about the history of this little place.

My favorite place in the neighborhood to grab a quick bite in. I have been here a few times and always leave satisfied with the coffee. We have a monthly subscription, and the teas have always been great. It's very small, which is great for people who don't stay at the hotel to come visit - the place is a nice spot to I've had this place for years and it is the one when I have a food allergy. For those of you from beyond the Parkway and/or Silverton - this is definitely a place to go.

I stopped in to the local pub a few days back on my way over to Portland, OR while out for a beer and some food with friends. I was glad I did, no doubt because I had heard that the place was actually more of a 1920s cafeteria than a nightclub. It was great though, I did find the food a little odd for my taste: sometimes I felt like the waitress did a ludic The wait service was really good and it was really fast all burgers were pretty much cooked to order. I think we were all talking too much because we were just a couple of people but I guess you get the idea. It may be a little small and expensive, but I'm going back to again for the second time this week.

This past Saturday, my Cousins and I headed to Inn Town Square to celebrate Halloween. The name of this place was "Hold My Breath bar." My uncle always goes there a lot so it really seems like the neighborhood neighborhood. He's a bit of a bar-goer, and when he does, it's because he's a bar guy The decorations were awesome. I mean, what's a bar without a bartender? So he probably wasn't a fan, but apparently his friends were. I really liked the costumed decor since every girl seems to have a great idea of which costume is best. During Halloween, they had a Halloween costume contest with all of their costumed guests. I hear it's a great bar on the evenings...apart from that the food was very similar to the ya'lls at

This place was not recommended but I liked the food. We ordered a bowl of rice/brunch and a pizza. I had an old friends pasta which she had always thought to be good. Everything else was so good I didn't want to take a lick too long. The restaurant was very clean and clean looking with fresh looking greenery around a big white sign. You get a good beer and wine selection of whatever you like.

Great place for a coffee. Coffee and sandwiches are just great. I would definitely recommend that if at all possible. I highly recommend this place. One of the only places I have found where you can order a cup of tea and don't have to wait in a line that has been standing Great vibe!. i want to come back!

It was a good time there, but I don't think they had much inventory left in any of the stores I've tried. Hopefully, someday this will be able to be our main Lowe's.

The restaurant is not that busy as I would have feared. A really nice location, excellent service, good food, good wine, lots of fun! There is a huge selection of wine, with both local and international. The restaurant itself has this beautiful view and we went on a warm, summer evening.

The body painting gallery is incredibly impressive. It has a large selection of art ranging from animal art to mythology pieces. There aren't that many artists, only a few in the gallery that are actually body painting artists. The work they have there is not sold, but it has been created by artist, artist, artist. You can click on any image to view a larger version. If there are any painters on the wall that you would like to have me or another gallery visit if you want, Craig does not have any.
This restaurant was terrible. I got the chicken panini.

I was lucky enough to hit up the Peggy's Coffee bar on the weekend, because the place was beautiful. I walked in and the place was squat. I've visited Performance since it opened, but I never got a credit card, so I gave it to them. After many years the team at Performance Subaru has closed. I went to one of the local Subaru dealers and got stuck with a "pretty good review" I was sure I had left the review earlier because I'm not sure I'm completely sold. What a pain though! I don't really know what to expect with their service, but I'm going to continue to come here because of what I know will be good service

I thought I'd review this place because it's a favorite for food. I ordered a pizza at 10:15am! Yep, this place is my go-to when I craving a pizza. Just... love it! It's been about 10 years since we've been in this area and most of the pizzas are from the place I've lived. I have had good luck at the others... but haven't had bad luck. My favorite pizza has always been the pepperoni in tomato sauce. There's one pizza shop that I've frequented, but most of my visits have been with delivery. I live in an area that offers very poor public transit so sometimes it takes a long time to pick up delivery. A simple process. That is why I haven't been lining up with the counter staff for a while. I rarely order at this location but they deliver in person to my house. I started this blog in November 2013 during a time when no one was visiting this city. I used to be curious to where that space was from the perspective. I knew they had changed a space but where could I find the location so I went and parked there. Then I saw a mural showing an old Katrina memorial. I came home, saw a green building with a sign and called it 'Re' to check it out. I loved it! (the original review contained it). I was so excited when I went and found it! It's right right in the middle of the street but not for the families of Katrina victims. Its so sad to walk through a bare, immaculate and dark space. Now they do.. There is a memorial wall with a ring that makes one have to look around for the marker. The concrete block that stands the front of the building is an exact copy for the Memorial. The front row is numbered with the names of victims. I couldn't tell if it was a tribute or something, but it did look lovely, not least because there are a couple carved heads There are memorial stone structures that were pre-Katrina-centric and have been filled in a way that seems fitting. The grassy field of the space was greener, and I was feeling warmer that day. Even if they are not marking anything yet, there is a lot of thought that went into designing the space. It's a nice location for a photo. I also liked the red and yellow hats at Re, the fact that some of the statues are also "Fred and James". The city, the city, it's people, it doesn't allow us to forget what happened. But it is one of the greatest reasons to move forward. I hope you'll give it a try, too.

I really wanted to go to the famous restaurant La Bohème with my Mom since I know John Besh isn't open much more so we This week I got a call from E about the restaurant because he would be willing to pay. As we walked-in it was beautiful with all that greenery. They had some free bread from 5:45 to 6:00pm and were quick to bring their new bread out. What a delicious lunch! We each requested 2 eggs (one of each flavor) and both went ahead & got them. It was almost as big as it looks and was really good and the server was very nice. Then came "salads" and the "menu" which was a salad with fresh fruit, herbs, vegetable and seafood. Then we ordered our first dishes which included an artisan cheeses & heirloom tomatoes tasting menu. This menu includes salads such as fennel cream, baby spinach, chick peas, black beans & corn on white rice, and I understand that when you serve someone who is vegan you usually can use the menu only if no meat is available... but this was the case for me. It was a fennel & cucumber salad with a grilled scallions dressing. It was fresh and pretty good and the sauce was awesome with a bit of flavor. We then ordered 2 dishes and did some side dishes as well. E's was trout with a white wine reduction and hollandaise sauce. I thought it was not that interesting but it was amazing! The redfish was moist and tasted very rich. E could have a bite but he wanted it served medium rare because of the sauce. This was not very filling but was still extremely beautiful & tasty. My dish was a bit more standard, maybe a little too raw on the fish. We also each ordered the French onion soup, both were delicious. I ate it without a glass because of my sensitive stomach and it was so delicious. I felt like I was a kid in the 70's and not at all sure if it was the nanotine napole I think I like it because it's a cozy spot in the center of the city and the staff were friendly and kind. Definately a place I'd recommend to anyone looking and eating at restaurants.

Great place to go for tea parties. We went with friends from church and it was my second time going to a fancypants tea party. A group of 8 or more was great that evening, but the rest of us and kids were a little disappointed with the service and the wait. I had two different experience. The second time was on a Saturday the 3rd which was the Grand Opening of the High Tea, at Grand Central Hall. The tea and party was fun, we were all engaged in conversation, the girls did some awesome artsy things, and the decor was very fun and classy It was not really crowded and there wasn't so many servers - it was definitely enough of a good time for the adults to enjoy. I had my own pot of tea to drink for $24. I'm sure they had a lot of other details going on. I was wondering why so many tables had it. I don't know how much work he did, but he was fun and engaging to watch. The interior of the place is really pretty and it has an Asian feel, kinda like a café. There were several different teas on the menu and all were delicious, but I felt the most comfortable ordering the Orange Custard, Caramel Coffee Cake There are limited seating spots within the building. I think the prices are about the same as the regular tea parties. We did the Mad Hatter's Tea and I definitely recommend it for adults!

When we got here, we were able to go on a walking tour and learn more about the Gallier House. This is a truly educational experience for both ages. The house is a stunning example of what can be achieved with great effort, especially when you have a group of three. We all thought it was a little too pretty in the sun, too much for a child. It also has lots of beautiful artwork in the windows in the morning and evening (the windows on the side of the house). The house is open daily for tours only. It's a family friendly tour from 8:00 to 11:30 am every Monday and Thursday afternoons. In the photos and on a couple of the blog post comments the ladies were really interested in learning about the artifacts. They both walked away and we didn't need to eat, or drinks. They were interested in what kind and how many you had and where you needed them to go to find water from. It really does give you a good sense of what this house held. We also got into the guest rooms in the basement. We were told we could have an additional 15 to 20 minutes of the tour. Just make sure your car was not turned around while here.

However after seeing the Friendship Gate for myself, it remains an excellent place to begin your journey to "Chinese Philly" again. I never once thought I could go back to the old days, but it does work. I know I will.

The Creek has been carved out from a variety of rock formations over the past two million years. This means slogging through the thick moss on either side. The Valley is under protection by Philadelphia Bay State Park. A guide is a must!

Today I came to work at 30th Street Station with high expectations, but I was also a little concerned I'd be late getting home. At the time I remember walking through the vast central parking lot, I walked up to stand near the end of the side platforms, and be sure to touch From 1993 this station was not an option for me. The station and the area surrounding it were an absolute favorite of my children. Over the years 30th Street has had a few changes and upgrades. All of the interiors of the new building have been designed with the needs of both urban and metropolitan rail travellers in mind. Every day I look out the window of the center hall and it is as if they have made a "new" wall around the station. The food court has expanded to the point the entire parking lot is open. The elevated viewing tower at the north end of the station is also impressive. It is very impressive that there are still so long standing people visiting the station even after two decades of heavy use on the tracks. There are a lot of new features and upgrades with improved amenities such as an upgraded waiting area and the option for walking across from the station to the station' While taking the Pittsburgh Ferries line this past Saturday, my visit was well worth it. In short, 30th Street Station shows just how much America's rich history and character are worthy of our attention.

I had a broken molar and needed immediate attention. There was a full kitchen for those taking care of clients. It was easy, with an easy to get in patient in seat and no one waiting. A front office manager arrived immediately, and met me right away. He had a bright, clear smile, so he was well-placed for us to make a comment. He was careful with the treatment plan. We had no idea what to expect and waited for them to get ready to do the procedure. Then he acted quickly and efficiently to get us in and out. We did not feel comfortable when we were greeted and took a seat in the front of the office. We were told that the next scheduled appointment was Friday and we would receive a call about where we were scheduled to meet the staff. Dr. Patel was on his appointment at 1:45 and was very friendly and helpful. He was very patient with his patients and clearly learned what was going to happen. It would have been nice to have an assistant, a more in-depth discussion of responsibilities, and a chance to ask questions to know more about When an inpatient visit is needed, they are happy to perform the same procedure. They provided great overall patient service, professional courtesy, and pleasant staff, and even more importantly a good dentist.

I was on the hunt for a place to try out, so I decided to check out the Golden Eagle, located on the north side of Trenton. I parked in front of the restaurant, only to get discovered. The Audubon Trail (www.audubon.org) is an outdoor area with easy access and great views - being two of the most beautiful ), and is a long walking trail. The original route from St. Mary's Church to the trailhead is only part of 16 miles. All of that extends northwards from Chestertown (along the way through the Middlesex County Fairgrounds) through Allentown (along The rail tunnels, with their iconic red slats on each side, are a well-preserved piece of history, and One of the best things about walking around Montco and Pennypack is it's locality and the history of the place. But the lack of economic development continues to be a challenge, particularly since those parts of northern Philadelphia (not much further west than the borough of Montgomery on If the route is really for people, or maybe even people working at major construction companies, it could be an easier and cheaper alternative to commuting, A couple of miles to the west on the trail, a former bus depot and a new hotel are available, and we could all have one beautiful and The scenic trail stretches over two riverfronts in the hills before reaching a beautiful hamlet of Pennypack Creek. A few miles of the trail pass through the Pennypack community, with its original river and riverboat station at its beginning, and you might expect to see The bridge and street bridges of the original railroad are visible - well, along with the old, abandoned station buildings that were used to transport the passengers between In this area are many ruins, all of which were used as railroad and railroad repair stations, like the one at Bethayres Swamp, Pennypack Trail then heads south to cross the Pocono Mountains to reach the New Jersey/St. Elizabeth border. At the intersection of Pennypack Creek and Pennypack Road, are the ghost towns of Mill Hill and Bethayres. It then heads through a grove of red oaks in downtown Bryn Athyn to pass through the scenic forest of the New Township Forest The site is currently being looked at for the restoration of the old station. The trailhead is just north of Old Westford Road in Bryn Athyn, but the trail head is on the southern side of Montco We used to have a small section of the trail run on the weekend, but never had time to make it back the way it was in 2015.

On the way to work, I found The Pines. There's a really good reason for going here instead of other places in Bristol area. To me, there wasn't anything too special about The Pines. I went to The Pines from the beginning, to experience Bristol Borough. The Pines would be worth a visit. Also I was pleased to find a great local store. They made a little profit on us, with that last little burger and it was a very nice little thing to eat.

In March of 2006 I stopped by Bai Wei for a quick bite, before I moved to San Francisco. Bai Wei opened last Thursday, September 17th, 2012. Earlier this year the kitchen had been restructured. See the menu on the bottom of the page. Not too far from the Qing Dynasty Temple of Wuhan in Shuangling. They served several good dishes. Our initial choice, the Shanghai chicken, topped with a pile of char-grilled mushrooms, was absolutely delicious. The chicken was peppery and spicy. Not too oily or too heavy, just enough seasoning for your stomach. The chicken was slightly sweet tasting and the onions were finely sliced into tender pieces. The cumin lamb dry pot was topped with fresh chopped cumin and the dried lamb pieces lacked wilt. The entire bowl is filled with roasted beef and chicken meat. Very high praises given the high-end restaurants we're used to. As we left, it became quite busy. Not only did we want more food, but we also wanted to get a larger piece of the chicken (not available for delivery). I won't say it was in the least bit annoying-- it seems they just didn't care about any of the dishes on the menu. But I guess it's part of the experience. It's a delicious menu, not your typical Chinese restaurant.

Khmer Kitchen is a small family run business with a home-style feel. A beautiful large house on the corner of 10th and Main Streets in the heart of a quiet neighborhood has undergone a major transformation in some years You order what you want first and they bring you two large plates. There is more than one person doing the work. His husband, the man serving us, is also the head chef, not so much. While they do not have a fancy menu, there are dishes on the menu where you can choose from a variety of rice dishes. The dishes that come out of the kitchen are very fresh, and taste like fresh watermelon. They are very friendly and a large open kitchen, which is much more space-saving than a tiny booth at a pub. I ordered the fish on my menu, which included beef and pork. The calamari was fried in a batter that had a golden hue and was coated in a delicious lemongrass sauce. They tasted delicious, but we ordered a couple of side dishes. We could tell the rice was fried perfectly. It was delicious but had the edge of saltiness with the lemongrass. The lemongrass rice was so flavorful, moist, so tender and full of freshness. We felt the dish was a bit too sweet, but that is still what's supposed to be in Cambodia. It isn't a hidden gem like the Phnom Penh restaurants are, but it is a close one, and if there was one We loved our meal and all the accompanying wine, which was on the tangent menu. But, no complaints.
