A few weeks ago I went to a KFC restaurant in the newest Westgate area neighborhood called Tongkang Road. It's been an absolute pleasure and good experience my last few visits to Tangier. We were at the Southgate on a Sunday night, and I am happy to say I have still had some of the great meals of my life. It has a feel to it that belies the fact it is a strip club. We were greeted with a smile by the bar staff for my friend, but I was already seated. We chose the garlic soy chicken wings after playing on the Thai game show. During the drive from our house to the restaurant we were able to sample a variety of options including the wings, brisket, BBQ, We also had the sizzling bibimbap, which was a mixture of Korean BBQ sauce and hot sauce and dipped in a hot I also tried the noodle ribs which are very tender. Unfortunately at the moment we do not have a seating plan in place. We went back two more times. It's a bit pricey, but worth taking the drive. My friend commented that our waitress did not know the menu but my friend was so excited about all the unique options that she went to order them both. So we made a couple of phone calls to the Manager, who was able to sort things out.

Last Saturday night, I went by Trattoria Carina to check out breakfast. I'm still figuring out the menu but I was really excited to try out a few of the dishes - it's not my usual style The Carina in South Point is newer and more upscale and a bit more luxurious. At the moment, the bar is called The Gallery and it is open Monday through Saturday. This is typical in an Italian restaurant - a long wait. The drinks list is a bit simple - there was a small selection of juices and wine available to try. We took a look at the menu and decided to go with the meatballs. We were welcomed in with an open bar that we had some cocktails before, and we ordered a few of the items on the menu. We had the Tuscan-style pesto sauce with some fresh pasta and a branzino and lobster cocktail. We paired each dish with a side of fruit or veggies. Besides the basil-y bolognese sauce, they also had a nice and fresh tomato sauce. It was all very authentic and the meatballs were very tender, but the soup wasn't anything special. My husband enjoyed the pumpkin salad, which he said was delicious and a little bit spicy but surprisingly mild. Besides the excellent pasta, all of the food was good for breakfast - they have a great selection of breakfast sandwiches that are sure to satisfy anyone. My only complaint, with Carina, is having to wait for your reservation - even for 5:45. The meatballs were cooked perfectly and the sauce was a nice addition - I can see myself ordering it over the weekend!

Went to Mac's last weekend for our usual beer week. The waitress was cool, although she definitely took the time to go over the menu and get my drink order. I wasn't excited to order the bartender's favorite beer - their Belgian ale that wasn't as good, but he was I'm not sure for sure what the brewed beer was, but it sure seems like the IPA. On our last evening in Charlotte, we split a hummus Plate. After finishing up my beer and the beer, I walked over to Mac's and ordered a round of fries and a tall order of beer. It was nice to have a nice big plate and it wasn't overly salty. In all three I wasn't happy. I really would've liked the tomatoes as a sauce to go with the hummus, but I couldn't even get the tomato sauce out  Of course, the food was ok, it could have been a bit more Mediterranean, but I liked it. I ordered two beers in a little coffee bottle holder. The food is good too.

My friend mentioned that they had a nice lunch special this week. The menu was very modern, and I've really been into good Irish-in-a-cupplaces recently, as many restaurants have decided to focus There's no decor other than walls of books and plates of beer, the menu is pretty simple and there is little menu that wasn't obvious. I ordered the lunch special and was pleasantly surprised with the food. I was apprehensive but very pleased. The shrimp was a perfect size, medium rare. I can only imagine how this place must be so beautiful to serve every single table it feeds. The lobster linguine with an organic side and salad of arugula and mushrooms was my favorite! The side salad i had had no dressing and was very cold, so I went with the red chile ranch. A few things that were also really, really good were the baked beans and the guacamole and the cornbread - both are absolutely must It was the perfect combination, and it was a nice change from the usual lunch place food out there. We'll definitely be going back!

Bacon stack.' Thanksgiving.Issues for the holiday season. Friday night brunch.Punk music.The weekends! A guilty pleasure. Yes, yes, please. Most people don't care about these things, and it shows. Today, my girlfriend and I walked out of our studio apartment for a leisurely brunch at Cleopatra's Cafe on North Main We arrived a half hour after opening the restaurant and had two or three glasses of tequila each. We did however find a table that looked well-maintained and the cafe seemed well-staffed. Waiting tables were set up with several people at a table in the middle of the room. As we had planned, my man and I were a little confused about what was on the menu. I use Brad & Matt's Hot Dog Cart Company for my events. I had a hotdog cart placed on my lawn for my daughters birthday party and it was truly the highlight! So when I heard that one of my friends had a big hot dog party, I had to find out more. The prices were reasonable and the quality was awesome! I'm very happy with the food. The gourmet cart was so much fun and I would hire them again!

The staff at the Free People Boutique are fantastic and the clothes are great! I went in Friday afternoon when I was in town and stopped in to New York City's largest department store, Jeans From My Mother. I was a little disappointed. The variety of clothing and accessories they carry is vast, and there are definitely many items I wanted to try before heading into the store. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable and the atmosphere was inviting. I definitely plan to go out with my husband this summer as we are planning to attend a wedding in the spring.

I had just finished eating dinner with my boyfriend at Fat Ham on Saturday night, and I couldn't even think about licking my plate. It actually didn't take too long because the meat was amazing. I did not eat just a few bites. In a good way. I tried every dish before going to take a nap (I only have a few hours to finish, and the food was ludicrous). The salad and shrimp had a bit of bitterness when I was ordering from the menu. The menu isn't as extensive as it used to be but I love that they have changed their order system so that you don't have to waste It's hard to judge from the salad alone, but definitely more mouth-watering than their past offerings. They could easily be cooked just once and dipped in garlic or olive oil and added a fresh lemon taste to make it a little more lemony The charred cabbage was just as good. I think the hot chicken was the most tasty thing on this menu. The hot chicken melted in my mouth very quickly. The chicken was tender but wasn't overly salty. There was plenty of great food in the kitchen and the atmosphere was definitely the place to be. Not to mention, our server, Jennifer, was so talented and helpful.

Village Whiskey has been on my list since last month when my sister and I found it on Groupon. Their food is really good, as is their service. On Friday, we ordered the shrimp cocktail, fish and chips, and the pulled pork sandwich. All of which we enjoyed without complaint; I love the atmosphere of this location, there's an intimate atmosphere and good service. I've never had a better meal at Village Whiskey, and I'll definitely be coming back again. On the second visit, I had something I wasn't sure how I'd like: duck fat fries. They were both delicious but not as filling as the burger, but I'm happy to report that I love the fries as much as the burger While the fries were delicious, I was really impressed with the burger and couldn't stop eating the side of wings I had so easily at home. Village Whiskey is open from 11am to 6pm Monday through Sunday and 9:30am to 5pm on Wednesday and Saturday; just let me know for It was great though and everyone seems to be having fun at the restaurant.

They also have an entire menu of flavors that changes monthly, so be sure to check off the new items at any time.

When I'm in a more romantic mood, I'll probably just go downtown to eat at Tomato Pizza or another restaurant around the neighborhood that Thanks for taking the time to write a review that makes a difference in people's lives.

The patio is located right outside the lounge, so it was perfect for a Saturday morning when the weather was nice and if there was a beer special The space isn't too large and there isn't alot of outdoor seating. We had a great meal with three of our friends, which included a fresh baked breadstick and a piece of cookie. The food was good, and the desert was really good. I had the hummus, green beans, and onion rings, all of which were delicious. Not too bad, actually. I had a little bit of a struggle with the hummus plate given the over-flow of the hot sauce and a lack of taste for These were not a great option for meats, but it was fine. The white onion rings were nothing spectacular, but there were a decent amount of fried onions around. My favorite part about all of the food was the sauce (I'd guess it was ketchup or ranch dressing) which was really flavorful. If you're looking for some high-quality food, I certainly recommend that you drop by Prohibition. It was also quite filling and with very little calories given the large portions.

I decided to join City Fitness when I had the opportunity over the summer when the gym was first open in December of last year. I've read the reviews all over the web, and I thought to myself, this is really a great gym and one I'll gladly participate I'd already considered doing a few free members' training sessions until I figured out how to use the equipment, since I had a great time On the first day of my membership, I went in with a new gym. I'm happy to report that Pub & Kitchen, my neighborhood favorite restaurant, is all set to relaunch. There has been a change of chef at Pub & Kitchen. I had read about him and his incredible food, and even though he was leaving with a clear commitment to the new chef, it made me curious. I can’t really fault Johnny for not continuing to cook for P&K, but he left an amazing mark on the place. Luckily for me, they've hired a new chef, and I was impressed from the first bite. That burger is INCREDIBLE. The burger itself is very flavorful, with a delicious texture and tender texture that you cannot get anywhere else. Luckily, everyone knows the burger at P&K has to be the best (and only) I've had. That and the huge chunks of bacon! I've been on a burger kick (and also on one of the few occasions when I actually ate the entireburger because I'm so The rest of the menu is still great. Another change I made was adding the pork belly, which has become a major staple. I even tried one of the menu items that resembled chicken breast and was the spiciest thing I had at restaurant in NYC. What I love most about pub & kitchen is how quickly it changes over time. The service is always great, too.

The past few weeks have been a crazy one for me as the kids have been staying at a boarding house called Villa Rigoletto in West I also noticed that they are opening at 1am on Fridays, on February 22. This is a really good, affordable pizza joint that has a bar, restaurant and patio. Our server was very friendly and gave us a little tour of the restaurant. We arrived at the restaurant located next to the river below and parked for our drinks there. However, we were the first to arrive since they reopened around 6pm. We were greeted by some servers by the front desk and took several photo ops on the patio. The main bar is well stocked with cocktail and wine options but their signature drink always seems to be an interesting cocktail. I chose the burrata with ciabatta, octopus, and a few aperitifs. After the drink, we opted to share the famous rabba and burrata. The dish was filling and had a great crunch even after you've eaten it already. It's been described as a light cheese that's a bit off a bit but wasn't clumpy at all. The sandwich was also very good, but did a little better than the burrata. Though the octopus was tender, the combination of the salty saltiness and lemon rind did not work well. However, it was tender and it was delicious. The next item we had was the pizza as well. It was delicious and not too cheesy at all. The pizza was crusty but tender and flavorful. The sauce was light and fresh, and I felt slightly guilty after finishing a half a slice. It wasn't very salty but I just didn't feel like it became a mush as I tasted. You can definitely tell in my review that this was a true pizza experience. This was another very good meal.

I ate lunch at Mom Mom's last night and I have to say that they took a little while. The place is located at 6701 Iris Highway in Dallas. I get a bit nervous about my grandma's recipe since it's pretty much a cross between my Gram's, Italian and Czech I was not all that surprised when I first viewed these at Bloktoberfest. I was still very much impressed by the savory exterior of the pierogi but were really pleased with the potatoes and melted cheese. The soup had an awesome "slip" as I could see through the potato skin which I loved but I also liked the flavor of the breading. I also love that they used 100% homemade dough but made a really good dough. They also have a small menu of gluten-free options so you can try to find some things you might enjoy.

I went to the second anniversary of Cafe Bistro last night. I stopped by this joint on a Monday and spotted Tom M in the crowds to check it out. A large cafe with lots of seating outside, and no servers at all. But I would definitely try it again. No complaints there.Eight years later, I still enjoy it and would drive past to visit for a bite. I ordered a dozen small hot dogs and ordered a piece of cake off the menu. They display a wide selection of fruit and dough. The crust was thick and almost like a layer of chocolate cake. We had chocolate chip and peanut butter cookie dough for dessert. I had the apple pie crust from the menu, but have no idea why they did it. I wanted to try the rocky road, so my friends went for the apple flavor. The only thing I really liked about the cafe was the ice cream cones. To be honest, I felt like they made me feel like I wasn't enjoying my ice cream at all. My birthday cake ice cream was delicious. The waffle is so incredibly soft and flaky that I didn't care how difficult it would be to bite from it. A huge portion of the cake ice cream was still left over. It was definitely better than the rocky road, but it wasn't great. They're so close, you could be there on a Sunday morning just for the dessert. I could probably still eat the waffle cone next time, though.

There's a small "bar" at the back of the store which is basically an office building set up similar to a diner. It was fairly fast to get there, just a quick walk and a taxi ride. You'll see the waitress walk by your table to take out the food. I would have liked to see some dessert though (that makes sense since that's the last thing you need a morning lunch). The restaurant is a relatively small place, so I didn't know much of the menu. The menu isn't particularly interesting, but it was pretty cool when I made this decision. I ordered something to go and a small salad and a white or dark tea. Her daughter (he didn't think that was possible) waited on my table and got my food, so that she doesn't think that I was She also had some suggestions if I needed anything and did a great job of keeping me entertained. I also got my salad, which was very good, the chicken was marinated well and not too much marinating oil or salt was added. I'm a little worried they'll close in the near future. I might as well have gotten a free beverage at Nordstrom this week.

Slates is a restaurant located at 3541 South 12th Street (Sands Edge Rd.) near the intersection of Sands Edge Blue Duck is located on the northern portion of the Grand Canyon, about 2 minutes south of the main entrance of the town. My fiance and I had some lunch before. It was a very cute place, but could probably use a little more color, it seemed a lot smaller. It was a little early, but we were seated within 15 minutes. We started with the blue duck fries that came with the meal. They were big and super delicious - not too much sauce or cheese. This is a very unique restaurant for the price - $18.51. The service was great, and everyone had a great time! I can almost feel my fat wallet cracking.

Last Monday was our first date since moving to San Diego. There are still some snobby things happening here. My family comes to get their salads (along with a couple items from the lunch specials). I love the spice in the noodles and it is so good. There are a few small plates available though, and the flavor is good enough for me. Some of our dessert of choice is banana cheese bread - good for texture, and flavor. If you're feeling brave and want to try something else, I encourage you to try something from the menu if you're able to get it I have never had bad flavor in Korean food.

Honey's is a super fast-casual breakfast joint. No wait..ever. They aren't all the hollyhocks I'maccustomed to in this city, at least not with me. It can sometimes be hard to find parking on a Saturday, and it can take you about an hour to park. I've had a couple of breakfasts at Honey's, and I'd definitely pay for a bottle of alcohol. Honey's is a casual brunch and is a good brunch place in and of itself (even though it doesn't feel like it). I'm always on the look out for a great breakfast spot. It's the combination of ingredients and ingredients alone that makes what you can get at Honey's a great choice. After sitting down for more than 30 minutes to get my favorite eggs, I had the bacon and cheese quiche. It was amazing. The omelet was well-rounded. It was substantial. What else could I be thinking of. Oh, and it was just right.

We were jogging through SoHo today and I started to love the new shops that opened up on West 8th Street in the neighborhood! Made for a great experience. The pastries are super cute, a very original take on the cupcake, and all of them are extremely fresh pastries (and also very reasonably priced). The food was spot on! If you're in this neighborhood and feel like having a coffee shop that feels right at home, I highly recommend the breakfast burrito for $2 Lucky Goat isn’t the best place with coffee, but it sure is worth the trip, and the staff was friendly too.

We were in the area for our summer bachelorette weekend and decided to try Slate Bleu. At the time I wanted to try something new and they seemed like a great place. We were seated quickly and the server was helpful. After a long discussion the menu offered everything from a plate of onion soup that was like half a pot of onion soup and croutons in I loved soup, but it always looks so bad with a lot of vegetables. They mentioned the salad was also really salty, not good. Our server then suggested one of our favorites, an American omelet, eggs, potatoes and veggies. There is no drink special with brunch. Then a little later, the waitress came to the table and brought us some special sweets. My burger was so fresh, hardly any sauce, and was topped with a layer of fried onions and a sprinkling I was really enjoying the sweet treat of mini croissants and a waffle mix. The food came..the omelet came very quickly, but not in the order I had it ordered. I actually saw some of the eggs on the hollandaise sauce dripping off. They did it on the thick side so we didn't eat as much of the main ingredients. An extra $2 for the salmon was added to our side plates, and I had the choice between filet or tuna aioli. We all just wanted to eat something, but it was just too hard. The menu says everything from a grits breakfast salad to a French onion soup. I'll definitely be back once I eat here again.

It has to be said that I love my neighborhood DSW stores. The first time I saw "DSW" on the map was at their new location in the "I'm going to be the girl with the hottest As far as my style is concerned, I'm in love. The DSW is perfect as an introduction to this beautiful design company with the huge open concept. The mermaids and ballet pumps that you see on the shelves are all made with quality materials, so you don't have to be a I had to put two shoes in my cart, right? You don't mind getting a little nervous because the store has a huge variety, although most of the shoes (at least my ones) are small If you're a half size larger than a shoe and the seller asks if it's on the same size (or bigger) as You can usually find the footbed if you need one and it's right. Or if it's not there, it's a great deal, just let the sales guy know. DSW's is a true closet alternative. A girl will fall in love with anything she picks up, and with her time savored. Plus, it has great prices which I'm not surprised at.

I was first introduced to Animo when I was a junior high student. I don't usually get the green juices or the tropical smoothies because I believe they aren’t healthy. Upon visiting, I know Animo and found myself drawn in and enticed in. I tried the banana-based  smoothies that were perfect because they were fresh and full of flavor. I had to try the sweet potato fries (which were sooo good, plus they had a kick to them too), because they were almost too good I love this place so much, that by the next weekend, I'm going to be coming back several times a week. I even have reservations, because there's no better way to spend a Tuesday in the middle of a big run than splurging on Animo is the epitome of healthy living and I think its been a good long time since I've got a whole food diet and And on top of that, they actually like me and I think I'm a loyal customer. (or more?) ).... with a side of sweet tea and a scoop.

I was out in Northfield with my husband for an hour on Sunday. We each ordered a regular omelet and some deli meat and eggs, so in addition to lunch, we would probably need drinks. Not long after we arrived, we decided to enjoy breakfast at the diner. Although the menu wasn't the most extensive, everything was fresh, healthy and delicious. I ordered an eggs and bacon, one of my siss ordered an egg Benedict, and my sis ordered an omelet. The chicken omelet was a filling combo of chicken and a side of cheese. The salad was fresh spinach, wilted lettuce, goat cheese, spinach and feta. I thought the eggs were a bit cold (the cheese had melted already and it wasn't very tasteful), but my sister did not complain at I ordered a small piece of chicken, but the chicken was overcoated and tasteless. There were no complaints about the egg whites except for the texture and tastiness. She was extremely satisfied though and said that it was nice not to have another egg Benedict on my plate! I would recommend this restaurant to everyone, we aren't going to say that anymore.

With all of the food from the new restaurant opening, In Riva, I know that I have to go back and try something new each time. The atmosphere and the food are top notch. Although the main course was the delicious veal milanesa, we did go back because they do an excellent ragus and a couple of The arugula is perfectly fresh and the mushrooms and roasted walnuts add an extra kick to the dish. The arugula is an excellent combination of greens and mushrooms - it's such a versatile, flavorful vegetable. We can't imagine myself in the midst of wringing the last of the delicious salads while listening to a live pianist. Our favorite was the cheesy garlic bread from Osobu. We all ordered a side of bread and bread pudding. The pizza is absolutely perfect. It is also the star of the show as it comes with 2 generous portions of meat-less pasta. We generally like to order the pizzas. One small pizza is also $4.80 and the whole thing is $6.50 per pie. We got the margherita and mushroom. The margherita pizza isn't really a pizza by any means. It's a thick crust pizza topped with fresh basil and arugula. What's better, I could eat two slices everyday! The mushroom is a wonderful addition to the plate, but our favorite was the pepperoni. For dessert, we got the frozen chocolate fountain to share. In addition to an Italian pizza, the service is top notch, the atmosphere is casual and comfortable, and, of course, the wine selection is pretty killer The honey sorbet was my fav. I'll add that their menu is full of apps, but I'm looking forward to doing a more traditional dinner and dessert. On a side note - if you're interested in having a meal outdoors, it is not too hard to come by In Riva. Probably the reason we went in the first place in the first place.

I was in my last couple of vacations and found out my local grocery store had PJ's on Tuesday. I had just returned from work after a little while and was looking for something I had never been to before. I found The Flavor Center, which is located under the original Ice Cream Shop on the corner of McKenzie and I-27 in Oaks! There was plenty of parking and a wait time but it seems like the place was busy with people. I ordered the green tea tea and we were promptly served our drinks and our food. Some of the customers were ordering at PJs even though they were just returning for dinner. Our starters were very fresh, and my favorite was the chicken tenders. We didn't like the fries as the French Fries or fries were just too salty. I think it came with a few little chunks of sweet peppers as well. After leaving, I had to get up to drive home.

I was so happy I went back to this restaurant for the first time back in September, just because it had really been getting good lately. As late as 10 am we were seated and the place was sold out. Unfortunately, we were unable to use our gift cards, so all that is was an extra 15 minutes before a glass of wine was sent out to the But the wait was just the beginning! We started with our starters. I could have just finished with a hotdog or a cheeseburger, but we decided against it because the prosciutto was not to my opinion It was extremely filling and had a great, tangy balance of both meatballs and melon. One of my favorite things was the chargrilled vegetables over the meatballs, which actually tasted incredible but didn't really help the food taste anything And after that, the menu had us thinking pizza, gnocchi, and more Italian food. I love making my own pasta (and the house-made ones are delicious) so I knew I couldn't go wrong with most of their affoga My brother and I really wanted to try the garlic marsala which was poured over a hearty salad of heirloom tomatoes, black beans and We also ordered a calzone with a chocolate filling and shaved Parmesan, which came with a side of chocolate  I never seen so many kale in one plate, especially since the pizzas tend to be a little bit salty. They were everything I had wanted and much better, and they were all absolutely delicious! We shared an entire glass of wine that night and everyone agreed that Trattoria Carina is definitely on fire and ready to go again when the time Check out their Facebook page for more details and to create your own ticket to get in! My next go-to is Il Carine.

The Heirloom Store in El Paso is very conveniently located on Grand Highway and the mall. But I have to admit, there is a little bit of a problem with the selection of food and beverages in this store. I've never been able to find a great jar of fruit with the amount of fruit they carry in a jar. It's a shame that this makes it hard to order the stuff I need to use in my food preparation. The basic grocery products are good. The bakery and coffee are great - just to name a few. And there is the bakery section which features locally-made sweets. I've come across a lot of local businesses in the area that are doing things right and I've heard great things from them. I'm not a huge wine lover to be honest, since I generally find local wine to be very expensive. It's also fairly easy to get to this store and has convenient hours on Saturdays and Sundays. I have been a regular customer for years and have been happy with the incredibly wide variety of products they carry.

On Tuesday night, my friends and I had the privilege to attend a free pool party at PCC. This is a nice hotel with no big neighbors and a very quiet setting, right off the beach and all along North Beach. I finally had to go. It is a huge clubhouse, with lots of room where you could sit on one side and the other side. It looks like the swimming pool will open in the Fall of 2017 (hopefully a sunny day!) yet it has excellent shade during the hot summer weather. We started in the main building which had a nice open kitchen and bar area. The bar and kitchen are a nice touch. We were told that the grills on the porch were open if you wanted to cook dinner outside, so we made our way to the patio of the old They also had the barista open a bar for us! What I liked most about the pool was that it was open 24/7 so there was always a chance to dine outside if there were a rain, My asian friend ordered the Mongolian Beef Stew. The waitress did remind us that some of the food is too spicy since a person can’t even Eat at a  Grill. My friend and I had a chicken salad which was just alright. My friends had fish and chips. We then ordered the garlic bread based on my friend’s recommendations. The venue had an outdoor dining area with a beautiful view of the cricket field. I definitely would recommend PCC to anyone! I can't wait to have fun again with my friend all summer long.

The first place we went for good Greek food was Dmitri's. We finally decided to give it another try while we were working, and we were really excited to see Dmitri's return to the strip at the We were ecstatic, and the service was great. The place was packed, but still casual and warm. However, we enjoyed the quality of their food and service - especially their servers. We were seated in the back room where a server was serving us and getting us ready for our first meals. I mentioned to her that there was just one server in our table (and at least one manager there), but she didn't seem too concerned. The staff was friendly and friendly and even offered us a side dish to go. The first course was the burrata cheese stick, which I'm not quite sure about; they were sweet and they were really nice. They were fantastic, the feta was fresh and the olives were tangy and garlicky. We ordered the chicken tenderloin and roasted vegetables that came with our meal. We had our food, and although it was hot, we got some great flavor.

I finally found Baba's Brew in my neighborhood. I've frequented the store before and have yet to be in a hurry to get there but I was excited to visit this place for my first We were interested in kombucha, cider, and other items. However, since I have been drinking kombucha and not the alcohol-free kind, I had already decided that I enjoyed the experience. As I was drinking it, the whole space melted in my mouth and it quickly became my favorite beer in the shop. Then my husband ordered a drink and I decided to go up a notch. I liked that the tea had a nice amount of honey and that the taste was a little bit sweetened. We'll definitely be going back! We got two drinks for under $5.00. Great place to stop after work to meet a friend and snack.

I stopped in to eat lunch while walking through the Village on Tuesday and was pleasantly surprised with how cool this place was. The bartender, Carl, was knowledgeable and super helpful during drinks. It's a cute little bar, with dark booths and cozy corner tables. Aside from that I ordered the burger and the sauce... well, that was soggy. My meal took a whole hour so I got the burger which took a while! The food was great from start to finish. I enjoyed the beer selection, which had a very cool beer selection and was refreshing. My friend had the shrimp cocktail and it was a delicious combination of shrimp and risotto! I would come back for some happy hour and another drink or two.

With a recent work trip planned to help keep costs low, I decided to try takeout when traveling. The parking lot was filled with people, and at one point several cars were blocking the door, so I decided to go to the restaurant to order. But as I was making my way back to our car, I was stuck at Pei Wei for almost an hour, waiting for a food truck to At first, it looked like my order would be long-processed, since everyone was paying for so much food. While I wasn't ordering it for myself, it seems a lot less busy here than it was when I initially placed my order at the restaurant, so However, as I opened my packages, I realized that Pei Wei had a reputation for being somewhat terrible; I can always rely on my good I was pleased that everyone knew what their ordered and how much they loved it. My husband and I shared the sweet potatoes with a side of rice and vegetables (as you know, we do this all the time at Pei We ), and my plate was full of great-looking dishes. This place is open to the public but it seems to be a limited space.

I've been taking classes at Body Cycle for quite some time now, and it's been a fun experience. Body Cycle has been truly one of the best fitness classes I've attended to date. It's very well managed with great instructors. Not just the instructors but the cues the instructors use to remind the class that they are there to help and push us along. - I'm sure that's a little too strict for some people as it's quite a tight workout. I also really like Body Cycle despite having a lower rate of fitness due to the resistance of the bikes. My regular bike is very old and broke almost immediately, but I never realized it until I got my second bike, which was a beautiful Yamaha X- For me, this is a good choice to get on your feet when going to the gym. Getting on the bikes doesn't feel as clunky as other studios, that's probably due to the simple rules for everyone involved, This is definitely a good studio to check out. It's hard to find a studio like this that delivers what they promise, and Body Cycle is a solid choice.

I'm not usually a large fan of Japanese food, but I did find this place useful this past week. I ordered from crazysushi.com on a Sunday in February and was happy with the service and the customer service. The price for my order was $4.95, but I got the spicy roll option for $8. but since they are an Eat24 restaurant, they offer an excellent delivery service. This was my first time ordering from this place and I must say that I was truly impressed. The rolls were fresh and were quite dry, which is a good sign if you're hankering for good quality Japanese rolls. It had the texture of unagi which is a major plus! The delivery was also quick and the price of delivery is reasonable, which makes a great deal in my opinion. I think I will be using Eat24 for a few more orders.

I really can't decide what I think about the food at The Pig and Chicken. We didn't even have to eat out, so I'm definitely returning. It was an unbridled take atop the thick, buttery burger that came with swiss cheese on top and a This morning I had to remind him that he didn't mean to irk me or anything, which kind of makes the whole thing a little less It made me want to eat it right away. Aside from that, I went for a bite of ice cream and I did not want to stop eating.

I'm very picky about where I eat because it is quite a bit revolving around family gatherings and the past two years I We had a nice dinner which was all gathered around a huge table, and a little room was slicked up for everyone. I was super excited to spend a couple of hours with my grandmom. There was some seating and the food was pretty good. We began with a small soup called amatriciana with garlic, parsley, olive oil, nutmeg and garlic salt. Once our bread was warmed and started to melt, a few of the starters were placed on a table side table and quickly cleared away, while We all began eating around 9:30, and the dessert was brought out fast. There's a menu on one of the plates describing all the entrees that they have, which could make things difficult to make a reasonable Orders are taken on two plates, so there was only one of us and we had to get everyone their meal. I had high hopes for this dish since I am a fan of pizza and the sauce but it was just so good - the chicken and spinach just came I think I was really full when we finished it. The chicken was also incredibly moist and had a nice meaty, not overly oily, texture. My grandmom chose the Caesar salad, which is also made with breaded chicken. Her dish was different and they redid her dishes, but my mom was still unhappy about it. We also had some cake and the server was able to make everyone's cake before the entrees came out. We opted to bring our own menus, but the servers did take out the order from our table. We had plenty of people asking for the cake, which was very easy and tasty, but we only had a few people eating it because my grandmo Barone's is just down the street from our home so it's very accessible.

I have long been a Nashville staple and this is my favorite bar to go to during the week. We were seated at a small bar with a nice patio, and we were served a tasty breakfast paired with a beer in the shape He was a bartender-in-training; I think that's a major plus when compared to a whole-fledged At first I thought it was a hipster place, but it turned out to be super cute and friendly. The music was played by local guys and the crowd was pretty intense. Some of the music was a little hazy, but we had a blast. You can stay on and watch the game for free.

It's difficult to forget the name of Pub & Kitchen, as it's an old establishment, but there's a great atmosphere and great The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming, the atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming. The decor is quaint and elegant and the service was exceptional. There are also few choices at the bar that aren't the best as the decor is a little too formal for my taste. The restaurant's menu features a simple selection of pasta and pizza dishes with Italian influences. The desserts are slightly overrated, claiming to be the creamiest cake on the block. Upon our last visit, the decor was gorgeous and the ambiance was intimate and comfortable but it's no great place to eat in Rittenhouse Good, honest food. It's one of Philadelphia's great places to go out on the town.

I just want to say how amazing Sbraga and their amazing management team were at our wedding. They didn't let me down. What is more, the food was amazing! I have had a bad experience with this restaurant since it opened. I ordered three different sandwiches that arrived just as I was going to leave, the box that came with the food was partially empty if it had been opened. We spent the night under the covers with the door open so the delivery person didn't get to see my order. It was the first time I'd had a negative experience with a fast casual restaurant and I couldn't remember how much more upset I became from On Tuesday, I made the decision to order at this bar and give this chain another shot! The restaurant is located in a small shopping mall next to an upscale coffee shop/bar with a very high ceiling. This place is way moreupscale andupscale than when I originally came there. The line was very short, but we were seated immediately and gave the waitress a little extra time to get our order right. When it was my turn, it was dark and it was so great. The burger was amazing and the chicken was very tender! The chicken was cooked perfectly and the kale was fresh and the salad was actually a little gloppy (so why was the greens on The food was served in a busy restaurant setting and I had the best restaurant service I've ever had. I would recommend it for everyone. I'm back again soon!

It’s very cool to be at the Grand Cafe, but it’s got a way of going downhill in the back. The cafe is a casual diner at the end of the pier on the east side of campus that provides a great view of the lake below. It's a bar in the back part of the building, right before the ice cream shop. We sat down to drink, and my neck felt like my hands were on my lips. It was pretty nice outside but the inside was unkempt and worn down. A couple of friends and I finished our coffee there, but for me, it's not enough to make a day out of going here. Then again, I'm not used to the location, but considering I live so close to here, I'd rather go.

I recently stopped by the cafe in the back of my place. This was the only outlet I found that served salads. I came by to tell you about it since I'm a student and am always going to the gym. I'm not a big fan of fast food based restaurants, but this one was super quickly prepared (even though we had to eat out). I ordered the fresh eggs with bacon and my husband got the turkey bowl with egg ranch dressing. I've enjoyed each and every salad I've tried-- from the chicken to the spinach. I've also tried their beef sandwich, which was good too! The wait (to fill a sandwich in a sandwich cart) is pretty quick. The salads are delicious and don't have any artificial flavors. Not to mention, the salads are super affordable; it's a great place to go check out while in the neighborhood!

Just last week, my favorite downtown bar in Los Angeles had to close due to the fact it was too old to open in 2019. Yes please.. please, please, please! We're in a big deal here. I was really excited to see all of my friends again at this bar. Now, while we were there, it was a lot brighter. Public House closed down and, as you might imagine, as it did, they changed quite a bit. Unless you count the three or four regulars who showed up with friends. Public House reopened two days earlier, with it's own cocktail bar, and now it's specializing in a variety of wine, But, at this point, we already had a pretty good idea of what to order and what to drink. I was shittered after reading a post from another friend that the bar was largely unoccupied and that there was a lot of patrons A couple of hours later we were ready to meet up at the bar so we walked up to one side of the bar and left.

I visited Top Tomato in April and asked for a second visit. They immediately suggested I come check it out, and I agreed. I was very pleased with my order, being on a strict budget. This time around my husband ordered a Domino's pizza, salad, and caesar spears. They ordered 4 pizzas and 6 salads for a total of $11.99. The pizza arrived about 25 minutes before that but the pizza was a little older. Upon taking it out of the oven, I found the crust was a bit crusty, but not that terrible. I placed a side of the caesar dressing on each pizza slice, heated up for a few minutes, and put it in the oven for They made a mistake by putting more tzatziki (assembly from a bag at the store) than the sauce The pizza was ok - it didn't seem anything special but I did get a lot out of it, especially considering two whole slices cost $1 The rest of the food was excellent. I'm hoping it's just the beginning of a successful business relationship.

We went for our first day of summer in Niagra, Michigan just outside of Chicago. The animals didn't changed much in the years since the new kids' exhibit opened, though it seems that other places are in need of major update. It's still pretty small, and the treehouse is actually pretty cool. That's the point. Nope, I went because I wanted to see the biggest thing the animals would ever see. But there's definitely some change from what I remember. But that's all. One of the smaller animals was a polar bear which I always love. I never wanted to be any taller than that. It feels really new, and I didn't know it was happening. Well, those days are past, though, so they're buried in all of that mud. And what's going on with the big cats. Also, there is the Tiger House, which has no walls on the side of it. Probably too much for a zoo, but probably a good idea for the kids to avoid. The biggest animal to be seeing was a gorilla. I was especially drawn to the young white rhino. Luckily for me the waitress for every tour was friendly there, and there were plenty of nice people behind her. We ended up spending more time there than ever before visiting the exhibit center. It's so much fun and has some really interesting exhibits. There seems to be a wing and a second house, and instead of a house with birds, it's a place with birds and There are some weird things going on, including a new bird house. My opinion of the zoo has been changing since this last visit... Another attraction that was really interesting is the park itself. And the zoo has also added an enclosure for children--the Pom Pom Treehouse. It's fun to say that. I think we came back from an afternoon of wandering or maybe we were just being polite. I was so excited to go to the zoo again, just to go see my favorite attraction in the world again. There's one really cool sculpture in the zoo, and it takes your breath away.

I visited Harp & Crown for the first time today; it was just the perfect place for a simple Sunday night dinner. His recent restaurant The Last Word opened in the heart of the Lower East Side near Soho, and I have to admit I cannot help but be blown Check out the opening of the restaurant in The District last week and see for yourself how incredible they were. I was looking forward to returning for many years to try new dishes but still want to be able to do a bit of everything. Everything was beautifully hand-crafted from the ground up and cooked to perfection under the warm flames. The rib-eye with a side of roasted red peppers and mushrooms was amazing! The burrata was the most indulgent of all the dishes. Oh, and the banana cake. Eat.DON'T. Have..You. Harp & Crown...it'll be on your list of must-dos in the next 5-6 months. The chocolate cheesecake made from the fruit of two tree species and apricots is just too incredibly sweet. We took lots of pictures, and we decided to keep our camera close to us, so we had our own little shot of the restaurant. I'll definitely be back soon!

New Jersey is home to a handful of the best liquor stores that I've seen in years. This time in Erie, Pennsylvania, our new favorite liquor store is Wegmans. We came for lunch, but remarked that parking was easy in the mall. On our way to Wegmans we parked on the No. St. entrance, but we were the only people there when we arrived. It was like an empty Walmart with only a few people inside. The only reason to stop downtown was to grab some food and drink. We ended up heading on over here, and we did indeed find time to browse the store. With the exception of the wine, this liquor store is nothing short of a giddy and fun romp. I would also say, though, that there are a few really unique items within the store.
