The pizzas are always solid, but the sauce is always a little too thin, and everything kind of takes away from the quality of the crusts. We've had pizza every Saturday that was just perfect from start to finish. There's a nice thick layer of cheese on the top, but the spinach filling isn't as good as normal. Each of the offerings includes starters ranging from sweet-veggie dips to light gyros, and we tried several of my favorites. For lunch you definitely want to order one of the gyros. The olives and the olive oil are mixed with the greens and served on a toasted Turkish roll. A couple side items with guava sauce that's perfect for dippers, and an fried pizza that's packed with fresh ingredients is the best A few pieces of pita is enough for a mini Greek meal. The hummus is a delectable combination of hummus, couscous, feta, pickled red onions, and  The skewers are light brown, a bit sweet after all that cooking, and still delicious. My boyfriend was very excited by the chicken gyros which had a nice, firm skin and also the toppings of roasted peppers and onions It's also an excellent eat-in option if you're just looking for a quick bite-size meal. The best thing at Opa is how well they have taken traditional Greek and Mediterranean flavors to classic cocktails. The baklava and pizza are delicious, but I've only had the gyros. Philadelphia Flower sent me flowers for my engagement ceremony this afternoon. It's by Philadelphia Flower! Did you know that Philadelphia Flower delivery service does not have a Yelp rating? I've been meaning to try deli out for a few times but I never have the funds for it. We were headed back from our Friday class and we passed by the deli because I had plans for lunch. Just recently Reminiscence moved into a new building, so this concept was pretty much a new addition to the scene. I was happy to be introduced to this place last night and made some recommendations. Whilst waiting for the food, I was thinking about getting a glass of wine and ordering a few things. To start of with, we took a seat next to the bar with Vince and ordered a bevy of beer and pizza. Eventually, he told me that they really only serve beer and wine but wouldn't carry any particular type of wine (though he had great customer He suggested I get a single wine glass and that would be fine for me to take home to rehydrate with just a little bit of wine. It definitely wasn't anything to write home about- the wine was good and the tapas at chardonnay were great. We then had a lot of fun sampling the menu. I tried the chicken fried pickles and they sounded very good. I wasn't sure how these would taste but they were all good! These were radish, pickled vegetables, Brussels sprouts (the best..! hotness with just enough of a kick!), onions and pickles. I liked how easy these were to make. Upon entering Otis & Pickles I wasn't entirely sure what to expect since there wasn't a lot to see or do. I'll definitely be back!

Real Food delivered to my home when I opted for something healthy (and delicious!) Like many restaurants in the centre of Melbourne, this is my go to place for lunch. The selection is very good, the prices are well-cheap and they are very fresh. The salad and sides options are pretty standard, with only about 10 to 15 options for a full week of healthy food (as opposed to 15 per year Don't want anything on the plate? Maybe something like chicken and mushroom, but I doubt you'll find them here. I had this kale and mushroom side and salmon breast with rice. It was perfect for me. What's really nice about this order, that the food ships the same thing to the door, is that you never have to take a separate order. It definitely was what you'd expect for delivery - pretty full. The salmon was just the right consistency, but some sides had been cooked. It was cooked perfectly and even with a tiny hole in the middle for the cheese. It came out pretty slowly however and I was glad that it was fairly clean, and my sandwich had a good texture. I'd definitely order a meal from this delivery service again.

This was my husband's first visit to the Theatre at Sixth Street, while I was visiting family from Florida. All in all, The Met was a fun experience but seats were very tight, especially if you're not used to being in a packed theatre It was extremely warm outside and my husband and I sat on the second level loge with plenty of fans and jackets. The review forTheDandelion is in full swing. Well, the decor was really bad. That's pretty cool. It was not a bad thing, as I found that if you don't like dog photos, you're not going to like the place. Regardless, I liked how they'd arranged us into the seating--squawking while we waited, putting on dresses, and After checking out the other area of the Dandelion, I was a little puzzled that I didn't specifically mention the names of the beer selection We all went to the breakfast menu, which we really liked so I gave it a shot. I ordered a cold brew to drink. So even though the pitcher was overcrowded so I couldn't get it over, the beer was very cold. But when I opened my first shot, it was very cool. My second half pint was a perfect beer, with a nice crisp exterior and a nice mild taste throughout. It was very mild, but wasn't particularly tasty. Did or did not receive a special brew that day, but that's my style, and I couldn't give the cold brew Still, it was a pretty tasteful pour. After my beer, our waiter suggested that we order fish and chips. The fish came with potatoes on a bed of brown fat, so that made the bites really flavorful and tender. Overall, food was pretty good (though I had to stop and take a swig of water off of my drinks every so often to be able Somewhat strangely, my main entree actually tasted even better than my fish and chips, so I decided to try a burger and drinks. Pure Fare is a popular lunch stop in the neighborhood between the Park Avenue and Wentworth Street shopping mall in Minneapolis. There are so many options for every taste: chicken, turkey and more. They're fresh and easy to make. Many of my favorite sandwiches here are served with no butter, no salt, or bread. The cheeseburger with anchovies and green peppers and the pizza with kale, garlic and mozzarella are just a few of the salads It's also a great place to pick up a cup of their baked goods. The menus are updated quite frequently, which means that you can pick and choose what you want just a few months in advance. You can order from the breakfast menu, and be sure to stop by one of the coffee shops as well!

I went to Fado as a teenager when my local bar was closed. But I was happy to know that my local pub - Fado's - was just right in the area. Brio Happy Hour (formerly known as Drogheda) is a upscale Italian restaurant located in the Jerzy area, outside of New The patio is large, with almost two large tables, a bar, and a large outdoor section. This place just screams breakfast. It's on the east side and offers plenty of space and seating. I've been putting off purchasing a new barre workout to start my summer, but I've been really trying to get into more of my regular I found Taser Barre (Tuck). Our friend and I had dinner last night at Effie's. At the time it was just called Effie's, and I was pretty excited to go. The place is bright red with lots of bright blue lights. I was extremely hungry at the time so I went back for a couple of bites in the car. After a few more cups of rice, we went back to get dessert/cupcakes. Two choices, baklava and baklava scones. The desserts were very good and were just the perfect amount to fill each of us. However, our first dessert seemed to be more of a gimmick than a real treat. I'll be back.

I decided to try the menu after my friend Alex suggested it. It was a nice, relaxed lunch on a Saturday afternoon in downtown Portland. The inside of this little restaurant has a modern feel, with a white tile finish, but with plenty of natural wood. There was lots of room on the front wall to maneuver, and the front entrance was the only place you could see the cashier. The menu has a lot of options. At the front of the store is a menu which contains a large menu of lunch choices. My lunch was topped with a couple of salads and a vegan frittata. Alex ordered a turkey salad with apples, pecans and a side of lemon butter frittata. The quinoa salad had a nice balance of spices, including pepperoni, tomatoes and cucumbers. The healthy taste was rich, yet the dressing was well seasoned and flavorful. They also had cheese curd tarts, which were just as delicious. I had guacamole while Alex had the hot pepper chicken sandwich. It's definitely something we'll be doing a lot more of. I particularly enjoyed the roasted corn mix and the flavor was consistent throughout each dish. I think I'll be back for lunch tomorrow!

Rittenhouse Square Park isn't a place for relaxing or spending quality time with friends. As a runner, I went to Sweat by the Lake this past summer. If I had decided to purchase one a year with a lot of extras, I probably would have opted for a yearly membership. But, as I go to workouts after work and on the weekends, I feel that this gym has the best membership I've found. This facility offers very comfortable exercise stations. The gym is very spacious. The only negative is that each area has its own "bar" area with a set of numbered machines, but that can be fixed with a phone The machines that are used there are a lot of heavy weights weight that aren't as light or strong as the ones you're used to This is definitely more convenient than finding an office in a different city. I've never experienced a workout to be worse than working out here because of the views and good weather. The only minor issue I've encountered with this gym is that during classes, there is no timer on either the rowing machine or the weight machine. We often run at about 40mph during the day and 45mph as a jog in the evening, so the machine never seems to be at the But since the club is not very big compared to the competition, I find it easy to fit in. I'd do my runs with another location, but I don't feel as comfortable there.

Mama's Yoga is a local, wonderful place in St. Louis, Missouri, that I've always wanted to visit. If you've not had a chance to stop by, definitely try it out. I walked in and was immediately greeted with a warm, inviting ambiance. The inside staff has been super friendly on the phone in case you have questions, and their Facebook page is also well maintained. While it's still fairly warm, the lighting is very dim. I love ordering lunch through the Deland Sandwich Bar when I find an open table. I would definitely recommend this place to people as the food and the service are excellent. I'll probably make it back.

And then I met my sister at Piza Mexican Grill. I just got my very first ever bowling victory. The only down side, though, was how I didn't hit a strike. My ego still can't bear the thought of taking a 100-ball game of bowling for some good reason. It is not impossible if you work really hard. They were so full of scallops that it was impossible to feel guilty about their lack of mushrooms on them. I didn't quite get that flavor, but when I got a flavorful scallop and the flavor matched it, I knew I had found a So delicious!, and so easy! Then we moved to seafood. I was also hoping for a bit more fishy flavor, since one of the items that came out to me was striped bass, but the salmon I It was either too rich or too simple for my liking. The portions of soup were surprisingly large and it was all very confusing. I had a bite of the fish and a couple of seconds of the mushrooms. All of these ingredients combined were just as wonderful. After our fish dishes, we moved on to desserts. They were all spectacular. The atmosphere was pretty awesome, too: there's tons of outdoor seating with a lovely courtyard to enjoy sitting on. It was the first place I would go if I weren't already a regular - so I didn't expect anything out of it. We had a wonderful time and we'll definitely be back. I will definitely be back again!

I was thinking this past Saturday night that there is one Italian restaurant downtown that I want to check out, though I don't do much dining out in Montreal We came to the lovely Aristocrap, where I usually go once a month. While Le Virtu was less busy than I anticipated, there were only a few tables open at the moment and it seemed as if the place was packed. But after we entered one of the many small tables, we almost felt like we were sitting in a small hotel room with no view of traffic. The restaurant has a beautiful menu that gives you an indication of what to order for first course and dessert. We also had a few starters to sample, all very interesting. I was surprisingly excited by the pomegranate basil and a hint of melon; it was light and clean, almost slightly reminiscent It was incredibly delicate and not overly heavy, although the richness of all the ingredients still worked well. Our next course was the pan-fried ravioli with the meats and vegetables, and a pan-fried cheese fondue for the dessert. I knew the meat was tender enough and the rich sauce really had all the flavor of the meat, but not the seasoning. Thankfully, though, the pasta is rich (seven kinds of sauce) and very tender, with a nice crusty texture to it. It was delicious in spite of the lack of sauce. We finished with wine and a glass of Pinot Grigio. The desserts were also quite delicious. It should not be a secret that Le Virtu has been my favorite Italian restaurant for several years now.

The only cool thing to look at was the kids collection, which you'd pay a premium for that, but it was pretty pricey. I'll definitely be back soon! The sundered hot chocolate tasted really good, especially the mint flavoured one.

The sports section at the Eagles is in good standing, because the food is high graded and the deli is very popular. The first time we went it was with some friends after a lunch date, and we found the place to be very enjoyable. A fresh, flavorful, big, strong hoagie of meat and cheese. We were greeted by a trio of servers. The service made our lunch time at Sarcone's more enjoyable. We were greeted with a warm welcome as well as delicious sandwiches, even those cheesy-creamy-medium-sized ones They said it would take them about 45 minutes to make (dinner!). but the restaurant is full of their signatures, but that didn't stop us from getting some food. I had a cup of the delicious Buffalo cream cheese and was in love with the flavorful combo of buttery mascarpone, cheese and hot And that really means a good piece of prime rib (along with the crusty prosciutto) and a bowl of warm, thin I'm hoping the lunch crowd will enjoy this version of the classic Hoagie.

I recently found a great little shop named "Nerlin" (or something like that) in a super cool home improvement project in the West The stores are pretty tiny, with limited access to merchandise, and they often were packed with tattered clothes and accessories. It's not cheap, but sometimes you need to be willing to spend a little extra on small things to get what you want. There were some things that were just beautiful and unique, or really good quality. The staff is warm and personable, and makes me want to shop there more often. My favorite aspect about the store was the free samples, it means they probably even have Christmas giftcards from the store! I'd definitely pick Open House in the future, only I haven't decided how to spend my annual Christmas gift giving.

Earlier today, I was in Ambler (with my boyfriend) to meet with him about my beer. The food and drink were good (though service was pretty slow). The bar was full, and the servers were friendly. The atmosphere is pretty similar to that of the lounge where we were at. Upon arriving at the bar, we decided on several styles of alcoholic drinks and ordered them. I started with a light and bright IPA called the Affichage which was a big hit. I was looking for one for the Winter but this was the only cider that was available. My boyfriend ordered the Fiso, which was a light, mildly hopped cider, featuring a bitter taste on the bottom portion. I didn't like it but decided that the Cider would be an excellent companion to the meatloaf. It was dry and light with a bright and fruity flavour. It had a mild spiciness, but this style had plenty of fresh hops. The Last Bar, a brew from the American Craft Brewing Co., was so good! We had a glass of Pimms and ordered some food. I chose to have the steak dinner. We loved the steak and the potato salad was also delicious. I won't be returning to Forest & Main much in the short-term, but I will be back at that time, I am sure. I'm never too impressed with my dining experiences in Minnesota - I can't believe Ambler has the best restaurants in Washington DC. If you love meaty, salty foods, this place is for you! After all, their atmosphere is very comfortable and intimate.

Now, we've both made it to the gym; we've done a couple of short runs before. And what I love about Sweat on Walnut is that it's a little different than the other three gyms in my area. It's difficult for me to find a spot in a machine to work at because the floors are too warm, and the facilities are just plain ugly I've also run at the gym during bad weather days, often as a pre-workout walk-around due to the cold air. Now that I've got my free month with City Fitness, I feel like I'm ready to give up the gym. And I'm ok with it.

We are so excited for Kite & Key. From the looks of it, it's a bar with a really cool atmosphere. First, we went with a pizza and ordered the Chicken Wings. The wings were super tender after being cooked and our first bite. However, compared to restaurants in the Lower East Side, this one was rather mellow. On the way back home, we also finished off the wings and was a little bit full by then at the bar. The b-sides were also pretty good - the pulled pork sliders (which you can also get with a side salad) were good, We ordered up to four beers out of three options available, causing the cab service to slow down a little bit. Kite & Key provides a nice indoor/outdoor scene with their patio and its comfortable bar seating.

While I've had two great experiences at Los Taquitos de Puebla through an open door policy, I have never actually seen the menu. No hubby lloyol. I stayed in Cuernavaca on a date night and happened to come across this place online - it's called Los Taquito I had my boyfriend give me a sample of one at the beginning of this week. So naturally we were both ordering different kinds of dinner. We decided on chicken tacos because I'm a huge fan of chicken and tortillas. A phone call came - the restaurant had placed a large order, and the phone line was too busy. Then my friend hung up and told the rest of us with the same message: "No, we don't want to go to a Ta We thought, now that we really know who it was, we're going to try to stay away from taco delivery. We quickly left a message, and once at the counter, we asked about the wait time. It was simple, fast, and hassle-free. The caller kept calling and kept dialing, and on Friday they got on the way! He brought out a box of two tiny tacos al pastor, and he brought three small box of chips and beans. But then we realized that they were just... nothing. So much for my expectations. And of course, the food was terrible. That isn't how I typically eat it either. I think that the delivery guy had some kind of a problem navigating the truck with the food, so his delivery truck was stuck on the wrong floor. The other mistake they made was my boyfriend's boyfriend's order for chicken tortillas for dinner. And here is the bottom line: If you were at a Mexican restaurant, you'd be ok with the tacos. That time, his tacos were ready to eat, and it wasn't long before I was all starving. We're so glad he did; they're hot, crispy and completely delicious. It was amazing how quickly the sauce got cold, but it was tasty, and I had a lot of room for a little more peanuts. Still, I'd hate to be the newbie on the roll this way. I'm not going back. In fact, I don't like it.

Good food; bad service. I tried this place to eat a meal for dinner at 12:45. The waitress (as usual) was just as nice as anyone I have come across, as well as the waiter that we had... but he The service was subpar though; I would not recommend this to anyone else. It was a great little restaurant with a clean feel to it, with all the tables in the back where we sat. It seems like a lot of places I know about but can't remember a lot, including the one on Yelp. The churros were amazing. The two churros were pretty good. These were both really great, but the Nutella-filled was the best. There were two waitresses with us, the nice one and the mean one. The mean server started her job and we were laughably offended that she had to do so. Went into the kitchen and saw three very large shrimp still being served (the other tables around us were also served this dish), which made our laughing. The mean woman then did her thing... she picked up the plates while giving me a loud, agressive yell. I know she can't really read menus as well as she can, but she thought she would tell us. At this point I wouldn't recommend this place even if you were looking for a great value on fried shrimp.

I was using Walgreens for my most recent prescriptions and I have to say I have been very dissatisfied with the store. The staff there was extremely helpful and helpful. I have been very pleased with the pharmacy on 18th & South! I was able to get the prescription I needed and had a wonderful experience. I'm excited to be one of the few people that has become familiar with the CVS.

I was at Nordstrom on Saturday for the latest sale, and when I walked in, I instantly felt excited about what I was going to see. (The store is a bit smaller than I was expecting!).

On a recent trip, I decided to stop by McMahan's, with the hope that it would be a great place to eat After making a reservation, my friends and I met up to hang out for the evening at the Happy hour in the bar. The drink prices were affordable (for the price) and the selection of food looked very good. On my way out of the bar, I  noticed the $1.99 wings with fries being served for one in the restaurant, but they were only $2.99, I could not seem to resist ordering a cheeseburger with bacon, because that's what the menu was about, and that's what is always available This would have been $3.50 with two sides. As my friends arrived, we started placing orders. As people began arriving, we ordered to order. For two of us, the cheeseburger was very tasty, but one of my friends was not too eager to eat. The fries were very fresh and not overly-crunchy, which I like. I was pleased with my potato balls and the mussels, but both I would have put the potatoes in the microwave. The steamed clams were delicious and well prepared. Although these items were probably the best item on the menu, they were not the only good items on the menu. At this time of year, these little-known McBreaks locations generally do not have many negative reviews, but this one was really great. So I will definitely be back for dinner.

At the time of my lunch, I ordered Chinese food from The Chicken House, since none of the restaurants that I frequent, but I wanted to keep it open The order was ready for pickup when I called 767-838-1928 (or 767-838-4628). The delivery time for my order was 9:30, and the food arrived in 20 minutes. This was my first go around of this restaurant and I think their food quality is good. I would have to admit they were pretty slow, but it was well-organized, the delivery was perfect (though I felt my order wasn't ready for I definitely want to go back to try the wonton soup and then try a little of the spicy garlic sauce in the soup.

I am currently visiting the Midwest and wanted to keep in touch with my friends in the east. We walked into the new location, a quaint yet casual bar on the Upper Freedom District, at 10pm. The manager at The Lazy Dog's Bistro (which they also have an open bar at and you can always check out their Sunday afternoon happy hour special We were the only patrons at that time, but the server was really quick and friendly to us, and we got there shortly after the restaurant opened (in ), and the service was spectacular. One mister, Yvonne, was working in St. Louis during a recent trip and was in the neighborhood that I frequent so I asked her The staff is polite and friendly and the location was perfect for shopping, dining and nightclubs, but not for tequila and wine. My birthday was a day of my choosing where I had the opportunity to experience the Italian fare at the Hotel Arco in Las Vegas. The restaurant was very busy, and my table arrived at least 30 minutes early. I'm not exactly sure what kind of food this was - I love guacamole, my beggar has been working here for Meat and veggies are all fresh and fresh, and the servings were relatively large and tasty. The lunch selections on our table included pesto pasta with tomatoes, bread crumbs and cheese, which was served with a pile of homemade bread. This was the first calamari I've had in a while. In true californian fashion, the fish was also seasoned well. After calamari and bread, we decided on a seafood dish: the calamari agnolotti, a thick cut of You may have noticed by looking at the picture, I was not dressed up for the event. It was also topped with two pieces of pepperoni, which was sweet, flavorful and thick. They were perfectly tasty and paired perfectly with the pasta. We also had an Italian pizza in our group which was mostly pizza and meatballs with an enormous amount of pesto sauce and meatballs. My partner agreed, but did not notice how fatty the ziti was. You'd think that the Ziti would be fine if you ordered real Italian noodles. And then a few hours later, we left feeling less than satisfied, despite the delicious pasta and fabulous service. The only thing I would suggest is to try the calamari more often because I am a huge fan of the fish. There were also some tables that were only half full; I think we ate too many at dinner to avoid the crowd.

I knew how popular Kiki's was, but I've been a littlehesitant to try it out. While the decor was gorgeous, the food offerings were not too impressed. If you're the kind of person who likes spicy food, this is a great place to pick up a take-out lunch or midweek I ordered a burrito bowl. It didn't require a lot of toppings, but it had the texture of a warm breakfast burrito you'd find in your The sauce was thick and salty enough to hold my interest, but didn't leave my gut wanting to go back for more. This place is not to be missed.

The location is beautiful, and I really like that, they have such a large menu with over fifty wines available which means you can get a variety of The wine selection is extensive and some of it is very good - a great spot to watch the game with friends or even to have a few glasses I've had the peasant wings with an old-fashioned cheese board, which was delicious (but really wasn't a very strong first After that, we enjoyed some great cheeses. At a loss to describe it...I was so pleased with the food; the meats were tender, sauce-less, and flavorful despite being For a place that specializes in Italian food, you can see it coming!

I've been to Philly's Feast for the Arts every year since 2005. This event has become more and more like the "Powell's Festival" of the Roman Catholic Church in America each year with 300 people attending from all When the event started at 6:30pm, there were only about 200 invitees. I thought in my head what other cities could do to add the "I'm going to marry in Paris" vibe to the event. The first part of the night was more than easy. We even were able to get into a mini dress rehearsal before the dinner started when a girl invited everyone to get out of the dress, and everyone People all made the same commitment to do just that. The food was really great. We are all super excited to serve up a delicious dessert, of course. As the sun set at the end of the first night, we had the feeling that this was the real thing. Later on, I could smell the fresh spring cleaning fresh baked goods coming from the kitchen. During dinner the swans flew into from the West Chester area and walked us along the fountain to the entrance to the restaurant. A fire engine filled the air and the dancers came into play, clapping and celebrating. We were all giddy and we'd all been out dancing, eating, etc. As long as the DJ kept the music going, I was sure everyone was having a great time at this fantastic celebration of the city on the East Side. And we can give each other the gift of fellowship, friends, delicious food, and a city that is so much better than that. It's something I've never seen before; it's something I've never seen during a regular event in Philly. And thank you, Philly, for sharing this wonderful experience with us.

This is such an amazing place for lunch. I had had my eyes opened about this place for quite some time and it was only when it started to make my day that I became a regular for dinner The hotel had a beautiful looking restaurant at the back of the hotel, though it was too dark to actually sit there for dinner, or the tables had dim It was already dark and a bit early on a cold, yuletide night, so I was pleasantly surprised at how quickly we One of the main reasons I went to the club was for the food. Located east of the XS, the Hard Rock is a bar/lounge place that has been around since the mid-1980s This time around my friends and I went here because they were playing a late night game on the Internet and it was a nice change. We were all seated at our table at the bar and we got to play some games on-screen. Of course, I did find the music a little too loud as it was kind of a tad on the loud side for our group. We went during happy hours and the bar itself was good. I saw some locals eating in the nearby restaurants that were more than sufficient for the night, and even some were eating a good meal after their game was There were also several servers who didn't have to worry about standing in line for their tables or ringing up the check, although they are there for They also offered me the choice between broasted chicken wraps, queso, and potato salad, which was my choice.

Because this is summer and it's hot outside of Chicago, going inside the Memphis Taproom on the campus of the University of Chicago is a little dangerous I love the pub and the bar and I'll often spend time over the holidays there. Memphis Taproom offers burgers (with great burgers and beer!) ), super delicious tapas (including a few I've never tried) or hot dogs?. I don't know why people are so afraid of the heat, but when the beer is around 6am, it's not too bad. I've always liked Hot Dogs. Great brews, good, fresh food. The grilled dog was very flavorful, but I'm not even sure about the potato in it.

Noble is my favorite spot in this part of town. That's not to say it's too drab, although you can definitely tell the staff are pretty friendly and warm-hearted. Free People has had some of the best deals of all time in San Bruno. I recently joined their loyalty program and, as of November, I've had two-thirds of my purchases there to-date. She also offered to find a great deal on my favorite clothing, so I didn't feel stingy. When I do, I just browse. A really cool venue to go with your event downtown. A great place for a bachelorette event, and one of our most recent bachelorette parties, too. This was a great venue with great food and service. While the venue is relatively small, the space was great for a group of 80 or more people. The spaces were filled with lots of gathered tables and wine bar decor, especially during the dinner hour. The staff was very friendly, organized, and helpful.

So I’ve been trying this salad at Aiken and it’s just a solid choice. It was a good experience (a bit expensive but still worth it for my favorite salad in town). It came with chicken, veggies and a soup which came to the table and served with a side of Greek salad. Other than the salad, I also ordered the Chicken, Zucchini and Fried Mushroom Pizza for two, both great choices. I would definitely eat here again!

I was very excited about going to Llama Tooth. It's in a really small space with few tables and only one bar inside. The bartenders were not that friendly and rushed to our table after a long wait. Because of the heat, this place wasn't particularly comfortable, or even ideal, if even slightly enjoyable. My first experience with the boutique was really pleasant and refreshing. The first one cost me six dollars, and the second one was only fifty. There was a huge selection of the best dresses, skirts, pants, shorts, and even a set of shoes that I didn't want There are tons of coupons available for things like shoes and bags, and if you want to save money, you can score deals on things that you're I was lucky that I managed to meet the owner and the manager. The reception was just as memorable as the wedding reception itself. That's what Jack's Firehouse is all about - a place to escape the city and have a good time together despite the distance The main room, the small private wedding area, was used for the ceremony which took place in a really nice area that faced south, where all the tables The bar area was split between the bar, the bar and tables and the reception space was split between the bar and tables. It was truly fun to watch all the guests as they frolic in the open bar before the evening began with a cocktails party. It was still very early on the wedding morning but there remained plenty of room to have a few drinks ready in advance at the bar. One of the highlight of the evening was a live band serving a diverse selection of tunes if you wanted to mix and match. The main course was a cocktail reception (which was held in the outdoor space above) that started at 11:30. The food was also fresh and hot which was an impressive thing. I know it sounds simple, but being able to move through the room and see everyone else dancing was one of my favorite parts of the night. I was impressed, however, that everyone was eating all the food right away and all the people were so hungry and thirsty that it only took a couple The food was very filling and the service was great - I was blown away by the level of care and detail that went into the event. We really enjoyed it and everyone agreed to book again for a similar event soon.

I have always thought that there is something relaxing about the restaurant at a dinner. While I love the exterior design of the restaurant, my favorite part: the interior. Not only is The Greenhouse a beautiful place, but it also has the most beautiful views from inside and out. While the decor still feel fresh and clean, the decor is fresh and fresh clean and the garden itself is mellow. After a night of hiking through the woods, we opted to have dinner at Oaxaca. Inviting a cold, but still refreshing meal for me. We then moved on to the main courses. I was tempted by the stuffed Brussels sprouts with blueberry mayonnaise and red capsicum, but I opted to have one. This is a very interesting combination of cream cheeses and other delicious cheeses, although I would definitely recommend that you try the various flavors on the plate. My second dish was a mixed salad of Romaine lettuce and dressing with blue cheese. The combination seemed to work perfectly. The lobster salad also proved a little too salty and not exactly up to my taste. But then, the flavor was so flavorful I almost felt like I was walking near a bowl of deliciousness. I loved the soft, buttery scallops and I ended up feeling rather full. The duck was cooked perfectly, and was the only thing I couldn't finish. I can only say that the gnocchi was a little dry, but I definitely had the most fun eating this dish. I think it's a nice combination of fish and pasta.

I love Chinese food with this one. Fortunately when I was walking around the city, I come across Xi'an Sizzling Woks on my way home from a date I've been to Xi'an a few times, but I was really not sure what I wanted. It was such a pleasure to visit The Bourbon Blue! This was my first time dining at this restaurant, and I am glad I did. After the hostess checked us in, the servers arrived to chat with all of us - and the waitress is clearly aware of the amount of Very professional!.The hostess was very pleasant. To add to our experience, the whole time we were there all of us got to say hello and take our food break, which made them really popular with the Next time I'm out in the area I'll definitely be back.

In October, our boyfriend and I sat down to try this new Mexican restaurant by looking around the neighborhood and being impressed with one of its nearby tables. When he mentions "Tixote Mexican" in Spanish, I never imagined it to have such a name. On our second Friday night there, I was in the mood to check It out myself and decided to give it one last go. This restaurant - a small quaint little bistro full of tiny, hand-crafted plates - is set in an up-and-coming neighborhood All the seating was topped with black, white and red tiled brick columns, which had a glistening, jumbo pool below them The patio had an excellent selection of meatless nachos, ribs and tacos. The next morning, to commemorate the occasion, we ordered a burrito and some chips. I wasn't particularly impressed by the tacos. I was sorely disappointed when we got the latter - it was a bit too much on the salty side. The fish tacos were made of thinly sliced and grilled whole fish and finished with an olive oil based sauce. We ordered the Nacho Bites as well, and they arrived fast to go. I'm not often a big foodie, so even though I probably would have liked the salad, it would have been better with a light At $10 for a pitcher, we walked out with $16 tabulations, but for the food and value we got a nice meal. We took the stairs to the back patio where the bartenders had a little bit of a wait, but the food was excellent.

We went out recently after playing basketball and were starving. This bday is a special treat for me. All I knew about it was that it was based in Westchester County and they delivered to our house. I'm glad she was able to get a few more shrimp and grits that she enjoys. It's always good to try new restaurants and I was just drooling over the hot chicken. I loved the spice he was served with and the overall taste was nice and hot. When you cut into the chicken I was immediately warmed to the spice level and I liked it just fine. The staff there were friendly, the place was clean, and the service was great - I'm very happy I found this place. You will most likely be in the morning! I've known Finizio's for a long time, and I am pretty glad that I finally did. I can't believe the reviews. It was my birthday, so naturally I came in for a late dinner at Fond. We had a great time, catching up on some recent favorites and taking a few pics together. There was enough parking and it was perfect for a late date. The breads were delicious, but my favorite was the brioche bread. There were several small items, including a light salmon skewer with anchovies and couscous, a savory dip with Our waitress, Lee, provided us with some fresh herbs and fresh olives, which was just perfect for a fresh and crisp lunch. The starters ranged from tuna tartare to escargot. The escargot was a delight to the eye. I couldn't even make my eyes fall off it. The ribeye was filled with a hearty blend of pan-fried fish with a rich sautéed onion soup. In the video below, Lee describes it perfectly: "Though I'm not the most vegan person, this dish is one I adore." It was an amazing dish! The risotto was so creamy and comforting, but still kept the fish from being overly salty. The garlic scapes, perfectly paired with the rich flavor of the butternut squash, served with roasted garlic really took the risot It's just as good as the fish. It was definitely one of my favorite dishes. It was rich without being too salty or too sweet too. After getting seated, we headed to the bar and ate while our waitress brought our drinks. And you get to try the chocolate cake (obtained from The Chocolatiers). It was so rich in texture and flavor it's beyond belief we had to share. Fond is a great restaurant to get up a bit late, because the bar is open later. The rest of my food choices were spot on and the staff was friendly and helpful. This experience is certainly worth it. Enjoy it today!-Jason K.

My trip to Nashville was a budget vacation, and I wasn't looking for a big hotel. I did have a limited budget for my stay and wanted to find something that provided a great option, and surprisingly, the hotel offered everything we wanted We found a great deal at Hyatt Place and stayed in their Double Queen room. I had a couple of questions about my room, and the front desk staff was always helpful and quick to respond. I can live with the bed (and the fact that it's two different styles from the single bed) but the lack of a television in the room The elevator in our room was very quiet. The window in our room is the largest I have ever seen, and is the most efficient way to view the night-time skyline. The privacy bar provides free Wi-Fi, a TV, and plenty of outlets, but also has a small desk. It looks like a stained glass window or something, but this room didn't have it. Service was excellent.. and the breakfast is a nice perk. There is also a big bar, offering a selection of alcoholic beverages, and a full bar menu - which are all pretty big plus. It's actually really easy to get your room ready early in the morning. Unfortunately, when my two sister made the move to pick up tickets on the plane back home, the service was slow. We could see that it was unorganized, and we knew the floor was covered in dust. The sign actually did go up during the night in time for the late breakfast, so at time of check in, our room was on the second floor. I called down and asked about it, but I did not hear a response from anyone. We did not make it in until early Wednesday afternoon, which was at 10:15 p.m. the night before, and we had our car at We called again to cancel and were told a room cleaning visit would be scheduled in the afternoon on the second night of our stay. I ended up calling the hotel and asking if they had the cleaning services, but when they appeared, the room was completely empty. A few days later I realize the "lost" purse was in my room - I was so frightened this night I walked out of My poor mom, who was ill, managed to come to the hotel early to drop me off, and by the time she got there she had gone back We were just going to be walking around town, and there was a plethora of shopping nearby, but I was already here on another trip. While being home and preparing the night before, I was able to find me a carryall that was a bit heavy, but very affordable! I'm happy I had that one on hand to help me and make it easy for me to carry on my weekend at the new hotel. This one was no fun. My sister bought the rest of the night, and we are so lucky. My last trip was back to NC, and I had been looking forward to having my bags cleaned. It was very frustrating! I was so glad to get it back, it was exactly what I needed.

It was a beautiful Friday and I had a treat for my grandfather. We were given a cupcake with buttercream frosting, and my grandpa didn't have the time to cook or prepare it. That's when the party started. We went to my grandfather's mom's apartment so she could pick out what kind of frosting to try. It was very different than the cake they had ordered, and with a sundried flower petal in the frosting. After all this, what's all this weird, thick frosting, right? My grandfather thought he was purchasing a chocolate chip cake with buttercream frosting. It tasted like a run of the mill cake that was dipped in buttercream. On top of my dwindling experience the next day, I ordered from Flying Monkey who also makes cupcakes. My grandparents always love the butter cakes they make. They have good flavors and are surprisingly dense for most cupcakes.

BAH!!? I'm in the mood for the simplest of food and you know it's pretty good. It's supposedly a quick and easy bagel shop but, alas, it's not as good as FT. I just wish I had time for them everyday, as my husband and I are into having all our breakfast lunches and dinners made in-house from Then there are the prices, but the atmosphere and service are surprisingly good. A lot of people were already half way through their bagel, so I was waiting for a table to be made. That made me think I'd be right. I did notice that a couple of other people were ordering the LF option, and I expected that would mean that all of the bagel stuff were not The cash register took a second look at the lining of my bag, and they no longer offered butter. This bagel was sold out. It was actually a box. ($5 for the cheese, $6 for the bagels). The place has a woodfire grill that sits out and over it, and you can actually sit with your friends to eat and drink. Anyway, I wasn't a huge fan of the place, but I did like the food. It tasted very different from my usual bagels of the day, which were actually way more fresh. I don't think the bagel was too bad. If you're looking for a good Bagel place, you'd be better off just crabbing in the parking lot. I can say that I waspleasantly surprised by the bagel. I ended up ordering a second bagel. I can get a bagel from here anytime, so I'll have to check out Spread next time I want a bagel. cream cheese, cheese sauce, and sauce mix. It's all going to be a case of catching up with old friends, so I'm not surprised to see that Spread was so overp For some people, breadbags will always be "the thing". But if you have a budget of about $10-$13 a month, maybe I'll give this a try.

After running all day, I had coffee on my way to work. I found Buxit House which is a small family owned coffee shop on the corner of Staples and North Ave.The coffee was great and Gryphon Cafe is in a really dark building, but after looking around it was a really cool space. The coffee was good and I enjoyed my drink but it was rather sour and didn't satisfy my acidic taste buds. It was kind of warm in there and had that taste of milk, so that could have be some issues. Over the past few months, I've tried a great lunch at Suarez-Tapeote. Definitely check this place out if you ever happen to be in the area. Some of the items are offered with hot or cold drinks, but it took us a good half hour to get a drink. We had the pasta salad and a couple of Mediterranean salads by the time we arrived. It was surprisingly filling, as well as fresh, with a little kick of something green when I ordered myself. We also ordered the soup. I also ordered the chocolate mocha and it was delicious and very filling and also didn’t feel too sweet on me. There is also a wine fridge in the entrance.

I've been having rumblings about a vegan sushi joint since I've lived in Phoenix for 6 weeks now, but to be fair, I called Zento before dinner, and waited about 20 minutes to call. The voicemail I received was absolutely excellent, with beautiful pictures of my girlfriend and I in the waiting area. The waitress was great, too. With that information in hand, we could leave in the dark, but to my surprise, we made it a little earlier than planned and sat down The only gregarious person at our table was a couple of men. restaurant.s.l. At least the server was friendly and cheerful even without the restaurant's noise problems. There were more tables available, but since the restaurant is a BYO it required the two of us to be in separate rooms. Food arrived quickly. We ordered four rolls with all the ingredients in hand. Her recommendations were not enough, and I was not disappointed beyond the edamame. This is a very easy dish to eat because you can just peel the skin off and eat the shell, and the taste is a subtle, There's a good line-up of rolls to choose from. I was curious to sample the tuna rolls, but was a little sceptical. The tuna was absolutely amazing. I had to take a bite back because the fish — which also represented some of the tastiest fish I've had in years  You feel as if you are in the middle of the Ocean; the fatty tuna was absolutely delicious. I wish I had ordered a higher-cost roll of each fish, but I'll be back. The fish was fresh and all the ingredients were fresh and tasting great. There was never a moment when I thought "it's a fish roll"), but the rest of the rolls were fantastic. If you're looking for an authentic fresh fish restaurant in La Jolla, there's simply no better than Zento.

We had a couple of events to attend and we decided to go out as if, instead of going to the gym, to get a meal away I have a few things to say about it since it's been absolutely packed (and not bad for being at the end of the strip!) a nonprofit group whofocuses on cancer awareness and provides care for children and teenagers. Minar Palace on Snelling was on my radar for months. I really can't get over the delivery quality and affordable pricing. It's the chicken tikka rice bowl that I've been enjoying for the past couple of months. I can't really say that the chicken is anything special, but it's super tender and almost chewy. I love the combination of chicken, rice and garlic with a bit of spices. The curry is sweet and garlicy, not too salty and not too spicy. It's so good! Minar Palace also has a side of the grilled garlic naan on the side, which is the stuff's version of a garlic It's the perfect snack without the guilt I get from taking my teeth off. It's also the same price as the other Indian restaurants in the neighbourhood but their Chicken tikka masala is a bit more expensive. They don't have it yet, but it's something I definitely want to. You need more than a chicken entree and rice to give you the experience you're after. And I don't want extra chicken tikka masala or tawar or the like, so that would be a huge bummer

Just the other night I tried to go for brunch at The Eggs, but was turned away. It was definitely a crowd pleaser, and the food was really good. Unfortunately, we didn't get to sit on the bar because there were others in the restaurant waiting around. The menu looked great with a mix of good tasting dishes like eggs in an orange skin, the eggs with a southwestern sauce, and the scr We went for a Bloody Mary and two dishes - eggs and bacon. The Hot Tea was great, but the donuts were kind of a letdown. This being my first time dining at a restaurant in a year, these donuts were extremely dry and too sweet inside. I was excited that I could have a Bloody Mary, but the Bloody Marys we ordered at the bar would have left me full. We ordered the eggs, but the brunch special didn't include them. We ordered the eggs (I opted to share) with my friend, and the eggs were just a little too runny. They both went out by 9:30. There was a bit of a texture difference between the biscuits and gravy with short rib, but that's what killed me. The food itself  wasn't bad, but I'd suggest ordering before you come in if you're looking for something good to eat. Although it was pretty good, I'm not sure I'd return.

Since April, I've been bringing some good friends out to downtown Phoenix for dinner, and it's been really fun. This was the first restaurant I had been to since I moved here back in March. The portabella in a roasted garlic-and-arugula puff pastry came with tender fresh tomato chunks served under a thin Arugula was roasted, nutty and tangy, with a lot of garlic, and it was incredibly enticing The portabella was tender, and the arugula was a little bit mushy. The portabella was a little crunchy but very tender (no way could I have ever done that anywhere else). I couldn't stop eating the wrap, my partner still insisted on eating two... but that one looks amazing. I would take every opportunity to point out the fact that one of the items offered was a roasted artichokes. It was served with a lot of greens, but the artichoke definitely kept it extra green, so I was a little skeptical. All of us were immediately seated and opted for a bowl or two of roasted artichoke, dipped tangy-sweet You can really taste the basil and parmesan throughout. There were some lovely cutlets on it, but no one was very keen on the carving part of that thing. So you don't have to eat whole garlic aioli. While the leaves were soft, just before you reach the pit, the whole leaf started to become a little tough. From there, I had the roasted portabella and arugula, the roasted portabella and arugula There's a big sign outside of the bar that says they are a  Gluten Free restaurant and they are converting to gluten free flour. Oh my, what a great meal! To finish off a very good night, I finished off a cup of java. On a side note, I actually had thier pasta, which went great with the burgers or salad. It was delicious and I would definitely order the short rib ragu again! I highly recommend this place. And if you’re hungry for carbs, you can always add a little bit of egg, since the place is so close to my house. I ate quite a bit, but wasn't sure how much. I don't know if I'll be back in the area, but I'm loving this place! We started by sharing a glass of water, then took a couple of bites of tilapia to help with my swishing. I think everyone loved the food!

The lunch menu was pretty extensive from sandwiches, salads, and bagged sandwiches to mini hotdogs and burgers at the bar. The smoked scallop salad was also delicious, and slather on the chicken. The food at Cafe Chismosa is incredibly fresh, healthy, and so delicious. For brunch, I had the Cuban-inspired mimosa topped with the traditional Jamaican coffee.

My favorite drink at The Industry is the cola d'angostura, which is a very rich, chocolatey drink that is sure to impress The music too, is top notch. They have a variety of options, including salads, wraps and sandwiches. For instance, I like the fried calamari and the Thai pho, so it's never been a bad idea to order some of At my request, the waitress suggested that I get a martini but did not come out with one. The espresso is always fresh and flavorful. And the staff at Stuhl was really nice. Overall, this is a great place to get your fix in downtown. I'll definitely be back and this is definitely a good one.

We went after work on Tuesday afternoon, on a whim, because we saw a special event on the strip. The restaurant was pretty empty. When we arrived, the food and service was largely the same. A DJ played a song after about 30 minutes with a few people still eating and dancing, and I didn't wait long. As we sat, the waitress came by and took our order, while we were still waiting for the table. The waitress came out shortly after me to serve our beverages. We were not there for more than a few minutes before the restaurant started to fill up. The decor was stunning and the menu was very well-rounded. We started off with the steak salad. The pancetta was cooked well. The dressing was really thick and had an intense flavor. For my second course, I ordered a medium chicken burrito (as I was the only one still in the restaurant) and a Mediterranean I got the boneless rack of steak with onions and a boneless boneless mignon with a rub of olive oil and garlic. I would definitely choose this course on every visit to Lo Bianco. A really strong bite was delivered by the fatty beef short rib. A nice side dish of mashed potatoes served with some sauce was delicious. While I didn't finish it, my girlfriends enjoyed a searing of clams with steamed clams. While I would like the garlic mayo to be a little less soggy, it worked perfectly with the rice, which tasted like it was cooked all One of my friends ordered the lamb medallions with chicken liver and a side of guacamole. This was a nice dessert, but the portions were so small I would not try this restaurant again. The owner is extremely friendly and took great care of us. With some rest, and some sprites of wine and hors d'oeuvres and desserts, I could not wait to go

I was able to see a line out the door for my friend's birthday dinner at Cork. I was there on Tuesday night and my friends came for dinner with me, which I found great since it was about the bar and the party. The room was very clean and the staff was friendly. The drinks we ordered included a limeade and fruit, and in addition one other drink. I ordered one of the cocktails and got the special of the night-- an orange drink with a sour cream sauce. The waiter was cool and so was our waitress. At the bar, the food was good but the ambiance was a little tucked back into the bar. The beer was good, but some were just too weak for my taste. The pub has a great mix of craft and craft imports, and mostly German and German beers. All the drinks are available on tap with no additional cost. Just don't be fooled by the $18 bottle of red wine that we ordered. I particularly liked the pesto sauce that complemented the dish. And the pizza itself was very flavorful, even though the crust was just kind of cold.

My favorites are the Barrow Beer (I've had three times, and the first time in a while) and the brewery itself. After a month and half of keeping things simple, I finally got the chance to sample some beers when they had a free festival that month. I was initially excited to taste my favorite brew there by Paul MacDonald and the awesome food. One of the best features is that there is a food court so you can sample some of Fergie's venison, Irish style, and other After putting the kitchen back in service, I was a little concerned about not having a full kitchen in our pub, but I think that's I loved the fact that there weren't any cheese-dipped pieces either, but that was part of the experience.

I couldn't be happier! This place is delicious! I've heard about you a few times in the past, but never thought of ordering from you! And here I was... yep... on a Sat afternoon. I called to place an order, but in the end I didn't feel like waiting. I said I was open now and she told me that Zoe's Kitchen had a whole line of Mediterranean food. I'm a fan of everything about Mediterranean food (except pizza! it's not easy). That sounds a lot like Pizza! They were incredibly speedy in shipping everything over quickly. I arrived at Zoe's Kitchen around midday and waited to pay until the food came. I had no idea what the dishes were made of so that's why I didn't get all of the pictures of my dinner, since most of the I went back to eat a few minutes later and couldn't get the rice pilaf up. While the whole dinner took only about thirty minutes to cook, it was very slow. I wasn't a fan of my choice of rice pilaf when I ordered, but this chicken skewer was delicious and the rice pila And I can't wait to visit Zoe's Kitchen so I can order a few more dishes and watch the new season of Game of Thrones! I love Mediterranean food.

For the last 10 years, I've been going to 11th Street Auto Repair for the service of my Ford Focus. My car started to blow cold air, which I had to turn it off. When I got back home, I found that the heater reservoir had an electrical issue, requiring a new heater and blower fan. It was a simple fix, but for what it was, my heater wasn't performing the way I was hoping, and I had to replace the radiator So from there, the process of replacing the catalytic converter is a rather simple process: you take your car to see a mechanic, explain your All in all, I must give 11th Street a 2.

Just for the record, we were in Town Square late the night before our party had arrived. We were so excited to eat at Birra that we figured we'd take time out of our life and treat myself to dinner. We called the restaurant and they said that they would seat us within twenty minutes. We sat on a table with four other people and were seated a few minutes before the open kitchen so we didn't have to wait We were given a nice, relaxed experience atop a warm, inviting bar, but I'm sure we were told that the wait for the On closer inspection, the meatballs had already been prepared and our plate had been brought around to us already. She did have a little extra room for us to sit. When we left, my wife called to see if we were taking the kids home for the night and that was also great. Well done Birra. Our server suggested that our second glass had half a carafe and we then went ahead to get a third one.

The best'meat house' in the Bay Area. It's a hole in the wall dive and the food is pretty good, but the bathrooms are teeming, and the restaurant sometimes I like it better than PB & cheese's in Boston, it has a thick crust, very strong flavor, and is a lot of

All I know about Tria Taproom is people walk into, order in, walk down to a table of a few people with their friends and have We had some free time to browse around and the friendly bartenders and servers were very helpful and friendly. The Tap Room drink (which is also called a "Bowl") was interesting. It had a nice kick and was served in a glass with a bit of water. My friend had the Greek salad and I was impressed with how good the meal was. We shared a plate of ham and bacon sandwich with cranberry sauce and a side of fried onion rings. I also ordered the hummus wrap from my friend and it was so delicious. I had a little extra olive oil and a bit of blue cheese atop it for a kick. And for dessert, I had the hot and cold tart with gin. The only problem I had with this place was the parking.

Honeygrow has been my favorite Vietnamese establishment in town, so I was excited to try something different today. I had just missed it when they opened (as a new location opened) and I wasn't expecting much of a change. The waiter had all of the ingredients listed on his plate: peppers, onions, and red coconut Curry. I got the pansang kuo go (rice, veggies, broth, and chicken), and added crispy onions with a bit of a kick There were many people eating at my table, and most ordered their own portions to take home. But by the time my order reached me it felt like everything was already in the same bowl. Just like before, I was very disappointed with the end result of the meal. The curry itself was pretty good, with a bit of heat from the coconut sauce. I would probably order a drink on its own next time. I'm not sure why I was a little disappointed, but it's nothing I would consider getting myself again.

Ah!, aww, baby! It's not only one of my favorites - it's also one of my favorite restaurants in Los Angeles, and the one I've stayed One of the many wonderful restaurants located in the city, this establishment is actually located in the province of Sichuan. Yes, that's right. Chinese food.Sichuan is not the place to be and is not where I want to go. It's all about pure experience. This place's not a fast food joint. The flavor can be overwhelming, and the menu may be overwhelming (like most Chinese restaurants), so enjoy if you're a fan of the food they Besides fresh, authentic and delicious food, Han Dynasty has a crazy selection of specialty items as well. Han Dynasty always accommodates people who have been there before, rather than trying to please them. They also can help with the confusion. Han Dynasty is the closest thing I have to a Michelin-starred restaurant. This year, we had dinner in the main dining area without any kids. Next, a man walks through the door, presumably to have a bite of fried rice. Neither my boyfriend nor I realize that someone on my dime was calling! We laugh at him so quickly that we both notice. Then the fried rice comes, in his own delicious, sticky fried rice, with a huge amount of rice, and a chee To be fair - he's more understanding than we are...and so are we. I didn't want to gouge my eyes or beg for more fried rice, so I just enjoyed the little girl's meal. Don't be put off by the name — we took our orders very seriously.

My friends from New Orleans introduced me to Sugar Bar, a fun new place to go for beauty treatments and services! The staff is extremely friendly and there's a big open lounge at the front of the salon that is great for casual social meets. Compared to other hair salons, I believe they have a much better working atmosphere and more people to take care of me. They have very reasonable prices, I had a great experience and would definitely return! After looking for a few options I was definitely greeted with a large wait- time. The aesthetics are beautiful, the skin felt soft, and I felt that my face felt like I had a smooth wax. I got my hair done on my nails which was the best part because my nails felt so smooth and they look like it is going to stay that way for  Overall, it was a wonderful experience and I'm looking forward to regular salon service every two months. And the prices are absolutely low! I will definitely be going back soon. I'd highly recommend Sugar Bar Salon to anyone who is looking for a new salon or hasn't done so yet!

My last visit at 4 Sisters took a little too long - I got there around 2pm and was seated in the private room right away. As the doors shook in the breeze in front of me (in my own way! ), I ended up in the parking lot for a quick brow removal. I was armed with a phone, so I called ahead. The salon employees were friendly, and didn't mind my getting a simple mani job and a pedi done quick and clean. For the price of the appointment, I'm sure they'll look great even after 30 minutes at 4 Sisters.

At first, I didn't realize the city had an actual grocery store--we are on a shopping spree (and even a grocery shopping There are so many, and I'm in love with one or two in particular: Fishtown's Supermarket on the corner of Main & Le Riverwinds doesn't seem to be a chain grocery, and the quality from their produce is excellent. It's a true produce stand with a huge produce counter located on the first floor. From cheeseballs, to a great fresh pizza, to some great cookies for Mother's Day and a nice selection of chocolate chip, chocolate chip Our experience was a pleasant one. We'll definitely be returning!

My friends and I were dining out in Madison for our anniversary so we made the brave decision to try this restaurant, as I've never had very good Italian I was a worry at first, too, because I know Olive Garden is a BYO. However, we happened to have a group of seven at our house and we thought what the deal was: take that restaurant at the Ritz, go to It was very friendly but not that I was worried, because they were all friendly and made our order with an air of professionalism. I decided to start with the roasted chicken salad (on the side). It is actually a really wonderful item. This appetizer was the perfect ending to our meal. The rest of our meals were all fantastic! After choking on some hot wings, I opted for egg pasta with a side of tomato sauce and a thick pasta. My first courses were the prawn pasta with sweet potato, mushrooms, bacon, mushrooms, green pepper and feta cheese. The rest of my group had the same pasta and had to eat it. It was amazing. Our server was so kind and brought our wine list, which was full of wonderful Italian wines by local artists and some great specialty drinks. We could have shared the chicken, although my boyfriend had one of the vegan pizzas, which was made with pecans and blue cheese. The cake itself was also served with an awesome sauce made with garlic salt and hot sauce. Our server was prompt and professional at what is a very pricey restaurant - especially in the middle of the night. That's not to say the food was bad or that the server was wrong. We had to go upstairs because the elevator was very dark and we ended up looking at the wall dividing the restaurant from the rest of the restaurant. In this day and age, what looked like it could be a nice cafe, restaurant or bar is more of a shabby do, and Will have to update my expectations of this place, or they'll all be the same.

The Italian style Tavern at the end of our block is what you would expect from a McAndrews and I love it! We went here on a Friday night, Saturday, and it was very busy and we got seated right away. The restaurant itself is pretty modern, with a somewhat upscale feel to it. A few of the booths were empty as the restaurant itself wasn't busy! We opted to do a tasting menu and I was very pleased with the dishes we had. The starters were incredible--the Mediterranean dish with beets, salted caramel dressing, and olives--that was rich in protein The beets were good (a little under medium) and the beet salad was good too. It was flavorful, fresh, and a bit salty, but overall it worked well. If anyone of you out there loves Mediterranean food, I highly recommend it! I would definitely also recommend the polenta dip. We decided to order one of his specials. I had the Tomato Solita dish - a dish with meaty sauce, tomatoes, and basil. My salad was a bit on the smaller side but not too bad. The chicken carpaccio was another favorite of mine but not as tender. I even got a glass of pinot Noir, the wine from a winery that makes a great aperitivo, and I loved in one bowl and half of the chocolate praline ice cream with a scoop of cheesecake in a second bowl. We all loved them. The meat is served in its natural state, and the food's made with a bit of everything other than the most traditional Italian ingredients. All in all, I'm glad Modo Mio is coming back!

I walked into this shop after the mall closed. Just as good as I expected, even if a little on the pricey side. I spent a lot of time browsing because I only had a small budget. I even found two dresses! I am very happy with my purchase (I know I’m probably not the only one). Paperdolls is so nice--we all agreed it was a great place to shop! The shop closed at 5 PM but I was able to stop in to see if my purchase was still on the store. The prices and the selection, even if it was small, was priceless and I would be willing to return to this store!

I came across Snap at the YMCA earlier this month; I usually am a little hesitant about ordering at a restaurant outside of Central Park These are my favorite options when it comes to healthy meal options: They have all the staples you can make at home using simple ingredients or just add in  The food is very high quality and very filling, if you like protein packed meals. I think I'll be coming back as they have a very good selection on special events, too. This is an outstanding store for bulk food shopping, so far, on the outskirts of Newburyport, and they are running great deals at the time The service was so pleasant that I had to stop in to ask for a second helping. Snap has a Facebook page and offers daily deals so you don't have to shop on the weekends; I've been happy with the daily deals,

I love to shop in the downtown area, so Pop's was a pretty close option. I came here during the winter months during the summer because of being near my parents' house. I was seated right after the cashier came to my table (as a result of the staff being not friendly). I asked for a second glass and they brought me out a second glass which was hot and cold! Not the best way to go about it. However, on our visit to Pop's, I would say the staff was the worst and were not very friendly. I don't plan on coming back to the D-BAR in the future either because D-BAR's bar wasn't open on June My son goes to Monk's and drinks here every weekend. But the service is a little slow because it's socrowded and we all have different times. But you can expect a good quality burger (not even close), a great beer selection, and awesome ambiance. It's not too bad. There's no atmosphere that invites conversation, as if the bar itself is at a very high level. They are very cheap on the burgers and the cheese. ?...and then receives one of these drab looking burgers with a handful of drab looking ingredients on their side? I'm not too picky on the food, but that's probably what the people who aren't lining up to try the food are Don't waste your money on this place.

Wrong word to say. With what I was expecting to be a really nice beer party, in the spirit of Independence Day we went to the Beer City, the official beer drinking destination But this time it was a definite no-no. I expected the atmosphere to be so party-like and not too dark. It turned out, it was packed! The outside bar was really packed, as were the inside bar. This was the first time the place was crowded enough to be dangerous. For some reason, the place wasn't open, so we were really late arriving. I found two places with fire exits that had little water, and then I remembered the front bar. Once inside, we all noticed a pile on the wall that we didn't see coming as our food was pouring out. As I looked at the table and saw the draught beer spilling out of it, I started to laugh. Everybody had no idea we were inside one of the "dinner-party clubs" because all the guys were drinking nonstop. The beer we were offered in the back bar was cheap but just barely enough to fill my cup. After coming back to the front bar, we were waited on. When the manager came along and asked to speak with me, only to find out that the last person standing behind the bar was a real guy who probably died By the end of the night, we were all getting sick, and I was pretty sure all of us were sick to death. During the night at Mad River, I came home with a small bottle of crappy beer that I had spent way too much on. I would rather eat with a menu made of old-fashioned beer and chicken.

Franklin Fountain is located near the bottom of the park. The waitresses are always extremely nice and friendly and the prices are so affordable. We were so enchanted by the ice cream here, I'm guessing that it was just a fluke. Its taste blew me away but its texture was also unforgettable. Besides an ice cream, they have different desserts like hot chocolate, apple cobbler, graham cracker, and chocolate chip cake. I can't imagine going to any other ice cream shop this summer. I'm so lucky to have been able to find this little gem and I hope others will try it soon.

New Wave has a bar and sports bar. Located next to the movie theater located in town. Although the menu doesn't come with any specials, beers are typically priced well for their price. The food was good, but not great. The beer was consistent with the other bars we heard, although overall I think we were a little disappointed. It wasn't too bad. The bartenders were friendly and helpful.

I went to the coffee bar in the heart of the city for some coffee and a meeting. The atmosphere was very relaxed, and for the most part, the coffee was served hot, but it was a little cold at the bar. It was made with excellent coffee beans and served with a light sauce of orange zest. I'd recommend this restaurant as a great place for a coffee in the city. It would be hard to find any nicer space, but I guess I would recommend bringing a book or something to read rather than a coffee,

At work, I always look forward to visiting McMillan's. During my second year of university, I was given the opportunity to work for McMillan's. The wait is often a few hours, but they're worth the wait. These donuts, they assure me, are so creamy that they make me want to kill them. When I got to a Dunkin' Donuts branch in Myers Park, I had my first taste of the cream donut; it's When my neighbor, who's also a lover of donuts, opened the box and handed me the cream donut, I had to take  I was so excited. Oh the decadence of the donut in my mouth.

The weather in a recent post on "The Best Restaurant Restaurants in New Jersey" turned into wet and breezy as I walked across the patio It's been a long time since I was last at your gorgeous downtown spot, and so we decided to try your food today! I love this place so much because it's located outside the mall in Center City, across from a mall that is the heart of all South Jersey. We had the last table available at 5pm, so it wasn't that busy around  5:30. It's a great night time spot, even though I couldn't feel the heat in my head. But their happy hour specials were just delicious, and you get 2 of any number of fish and chips for $20 each. Plus, you get free chips and salsa for every drink with your order and at no extra charge. The food was fabulous! I opted for one of their huge, seafood-filled, clam-slaw salads; it was huge and huge. The clams were delish, the Caesar a little watery but incredibly delicious, and the rice was very delicious and fresh. I really don't like restaurants that charge more money because it seems like they have a sense of fun. I'll be back soon!

Good food at a great price. At their bar, they sell a few craft beers and some wines for a few dollars and for most of the time you have to sit at the Nick's is a bar-bar/deli in a small restaurant fronting the corner of Walnut Avenue and 76th Street. Despite our initial nerves, we were quickly welcomed by a friendly server who promptly ushered us to our table. The bartender then informed us that they don't have a ticket to purchase drinks if you've been there before or you don't The sandwiches are delicious and I can't even start with the ranch and fried chicken. We started with a couple of cold drafts and each ordered a pair of beef sandwiches that had lots of tasty seasoning and just the right blend of The fries were delicious as well and so were the milkshakes. At the end of the afternoon, a friendly but somewhat unfeigned bartender led us to a table and helped us order, making It was a great night out with guys and girls.

I was really surprised with the price of my entree at Spice 28. That's a new way to try food out that's probably not going to be very successful (the food delivery system seems to be way under- It's a little hard to beat such a deal since the other deli we ate at that day came and had a delivery. I also got a free bottle of Thai tea when I ordered food for delivery. As for the food, it was nice for what it was: food for eating out, for a reasonable price. I'm also wondering if the prices at the restaurant are lower than some other restaurants, or are it just me? I feel that an additional tip with meal was not needed even though there wasn't any. I mean, I can usually get anything really good for like $22 for a plate at the nearby chinese restaurant in the Merion shopping center The food at the restaurant was good, and most of the dishes were very good. Do you like them better? I feel like the dry pepper chicken could use a little more heat. My dan dan noodles were fine though not so great. Generally speaking, I liked the dan dan noodles. There was a very heavy amount of food, which I think is a little hard to stomach. I was really enjoying every bite of the food. My next dish may not be as good but it's close, and I don't think I'll have it again. And I definitely recommend if you're around East Philadelphia.

If you're in the area, you'll probably be aware of The Ritz. First one I visited back in the day it wasn't as popular, but not until now I discovered that the theater is good! I love that there is so many different movies playing at the theater, and it's great that the theater is relocating. It's still a bit out of date, and I don't love it. What a wonderful place to work. It went ashore on Thursday for a minor check-up, and I was very impressed with both the repair department and the tech, Frank.
