All of those years ago, my stepdad and I would go to the original Cork Saloon (the only authentic Mexican restaurant in Cork) to Today, my stepdad and I figured we should make an effort to go again. When we walked into the restaurant I was surprised to have to ask him where he was going, because this is a pretty new venue for him to Everyone on our party ordered drinks as usual. We were then ushered through the door to our booth and asked to sit out on the patio. We decided on a few pitchers and some mixed martinis (the house martini came to life when we ordered it and it taste We started off with a glass of the Manhattan, which was slightly too rich with lime, and we ordered a few shots as well. We opted to get a steak, which we were pretty happy with because we both loved the way it paired with the food we ordered. The fish tacos were cooked perfectly and the fish was great. Both of the items (fish and meats) were excellently seasoned, and everything was moist but not too oily. Aside from being a great place to eat, I don't think I'll be going here again. Later we tried their steak and cheese plates. The salad was very flavorful, but we couldn't stop ourselves from taking one bite of it. We didn't know what the new Chef was actually making from his "initial creations" but the salads, which had been stocked with The flatbreads were good, but the meat in the pizza crust was not. I'm not totally sold on the owner of the joint, but if I had to give it negative stars, I would at least try a different Even though we were pretty hungry, we were pleased to see that they were still open.

The food here is very good, nothing to rave about or critique. On my way in, another waitress escorted me to my table. After we stepped into the restaurant, we were immediately greeted as the server (I think she was the server from the movie The Holy Grail), And, of course, we had to make a call to our server right away. In addition to the large open table, we all found ourselves sharing a little spot. The only person that had the table was one the owner of the restaurant. I was not able to fully focus on what I wanted to talk about and it made me speechless. It's not unusual for a restaurant to change their menu based on the size of the group and the age of its patrons. Even though I was all alone, I had a great time. My friend chose the spinach and cheese specials as my entrée. Although it was small, it was incredibly dense. The spinach was tender and chewy and the cheese had a rich, tangy, sauce. That was quite delectable. I'll go back next time on a fish salad. Not that there is anything wrong with tilapia in general, I am just assuming the fish was very well seasoned. The gnocchi were a little salty... or just plain salty. We ordered three sides- we ordered the pine cones; the pine cones were extremely soft and soft, similar to the texture you get in the wood stove We paid the $11 for this meal, and even on the weekend, there was a problem with this dining experience. That really needs to be an afterthought. When the server brought us dessert, one of each of my girlfriends refused to eat it. What the hell is on the cake? The fruit in it were also delicious and even included fruit on their own. As I mentioned, this sweet, but healthy dessert did not leave me hunger for more. After the cookie tasted slightly off, our server kindly moved our dessert back in progress while she refilled our glasses, so our food arrived late ( My friends and I enjoyed the food, but wanted a little more diversity and a little more variety. A different take on the salty stuff. For more information, visit their website at ciucina-fare.com or their Facebook page at facebook.com/cucina-fare.

Best mango and papaya stand in New York. I've never seen anything like a crow or a pheasant. Having one or two of my friends here is great with me. The Wawan also sells a number of fresh fruit such as coconut, pear, and mango, which is a great way to get more nutrition

It really was a true "win for the soul." My salad starter was the House Fried Wings. They are fried chicken wings, baked with peanut butter spread and baked until done. They were the best chicken wing I've had. In order to keep me full, I tried 3 different types of chips, the sour cream with a hint of cayenne, spic I tried one myself and ate it all toss-and-shoot. I ordered the Soft-Shell Crab. These shells are cooked in an intensely flavorful corned beef recipe that is rich in crab, acorn oil, garlic and a touch I was incredibly happy with the soft-shell crab and the white rice and the sauce had become a favorite in my home kitchen. I was so pleased. As for dessert, here's what it's all about...Farmhaus Pastries & Creamcakes. I ordered a Pan-seared French toast dipped in egg whites with cream cheese spread, dipped into a chocolate sauce The sweet cream and cheese was like a decadent candy corn. It had a great flavor and if you were in a rush, they have a hot sauce with it. That's what I have here! The staff was friendly. You order your meal and you will get a text asking you for your "ordering choice", or you can leave it with the server. This is true as they know the dishes so they're not only offering the dishes on the menu, but are also cooking to order. I don't know about you but, Farmhaus will put a smile on your face and a conversation going on for a while. It is a one stop shop (and even if you are hungry, this will still suffice) if you enjoy what is offered there. The vibe of Farmhaus is very relaxing. The service, atmosphere, and food is beyond anything I've had. I highly recommend that you visit Farmhaus.

In my opinion, what is better than having 3 delicious and flavorful meal's that day? We knew we wanted to visit the festival, to support our favorite Greek Festival in Columbus. It's a really special event and not only the food, but the atmosphere as well. On Sunday at breakfast we decided to head to the Athenian Garden Deli and the Shish-Kebob. I tried to get close to the festival to see just how long it would take, and I would just squirt beer on the floor. It took a half hour to get there; not only for the car park but also for all the vendors. The traffic was so heavy at the festival that we waited 40 minutes before we got into the parking lot. Every hour, there was a "tart-tastic" display with some of the best Greek food you'll find anywhere. The entrance is straight up in the parking lot. But before we sat down to eat, everything was all packed and there was also a small music tent. At times during the festival they had people that were not in lines for more than half of the food to be offered. Upon entering, we knew we were in another party with a similar theme (Greek Christmas). We ended up getting the burgers and the chicken that were being served. The chicken wings were just enough for my taste. The chicken wings, however, were a bit on the tough side. Shish-Kebobs were good, too. I ate half before I walked through the door so I can see what's inside. Heated grills, skewers and skewers all make for an awesome experience. It will not be long before you think its your new favorite desert. After the Festival I was able to check them out on the street, which was a nice break from the usual Sunday rush time. They weren't serving any desserts at the festival so we ordered from the Bar. The Baklava Sundae was one of my least favorite things ever. They serve these two sides at $3 each. We are both a bit picky and like when someone is eating something they think that it is not good. With the exception of our son, the entire festival was pure fun. Despite the taste being good, it took me 5 minutes to get to the last booth. They also have a salad bar and a kids play set. I will go so far as to say, it was delicious, but it tasted like a Greek festival. It was sweet but still a bit salty. At the beginning I had no idea how good the festival actually is but, as I watched people eat and dribble more and more. The Greek Festival has a very unique and fun style of eating and will be my favorite in town.

We haven't been to Pan D'olive before, but we had the opportunity to stop by when we did and have lunch with Yr I love olives and iced tea, and this location has a very unique feel, combining a Mediterranean taste with fresh, Mediterranean ingredients. The staff was friendly and seemed very knowledgeable. Initially we started with the Olive Bread Basket. The olive bread was perfect, although a bit dark. We enjoyed a huge slice of this bread that was completely covered in olive oil and olives and was perfectly seasoned. The bread and olive oil were perfect with the fresh greens. For lunch, we shared the Calamari Sandwich - Crunch and Flavors. The Calamari was the most perfectly cooked, tender and flavorful Calamari I have ever had. Usually it is a tough fish, but here it was just not dry. I have tried different ways of cooking it and this version is still amazing. The Mussels I wanted were incredibly delicious. This was just the right amount of clams and flavor to taste to me. You just won't find a better fish fry in the metro area! The Mussels were cooked perfectly, seasoned with fresh parsley and served with a side of French Fries. We also ordered more small plates, and although each had a different flavor, they were all wonderful. The Lamb Sliders was a delicious treat (and also filled with plenty of Olive Oil), and the Turkey Sandwich was mouthwatering! We shared the Salmon Taco along with the Grilled Trout with bacon and walnuts. The walnuts were a perfect addition. As for dessert, Sam had a variety of desert with his favorite being the Vanilla Creme Brûlée. So, we finished lunch and went home. The dinner menu was all fresh organic chicken, steak, seafood, and vegetarian items to keep our hunger satisfied. We were going to go dessert as we both love dessert, but the dessert we ordered was too heavy. We ordered the Cream Brûlée, Tiramisu and the Green Beans with the Tomato Butter. The dessert was delicious and very tender. I also enjoyed the whipped cream. I also liked the mint flavor, it was like the seaside of Switzerland in my mouth. The dish was great, not too sweet and not too salty. Pan D'Olive definitely rocks, their service is also great.

The owners have recently renovated the location, so it has a new feel. The restaurant is full of the aroma of fresh vegetables and fresh organic food. They added a beautiful custom made chopping station, that has been painted with a unique textured paint. Two tables were reserved and we were seated in the comfortable, romantic atmosphere. We first ordered the White Crab cakes, which had cream cheese, red onions, avocado and a fried nutella shell. The sesame crisped up with their special sauce. This was a great option if you like the classic crusted crab cakes. To accompany the chicken we had baked crimini, artichoke hearts, blue cheese, egg, olive oil and pickles. Pate Maison was served with a small side salad, a side avocado, grapefruit salad with a citrus vinaigrette. The pate was moist and perfect on the Cristin. After these starters, a trio of entrees. We shared pork chops and lamb chops by the slice. He chose to cook the lamb chops in their demo grill. His was tender and juicy. They finished it with a gin and tonic drizzle. It wasn't too salty, but plenty of cheese. I am always amazed when restaurants add something unique to their menu. It was rich and flavorful. It was a special glaze and made the pork cut so moist. This was probably the best dish I've had on an evening dinner date. After our entrees, we ordered a dessert and were still full. We chose the Iberia cake for dessert. It took the restaurant less than 20 minutes to get to us and we loved the food. It was a great treat! They would have been a wonderful place for us to sit, but we were too full to go back. This cake is so thin it could be served with a side salad, salad or even a cold glass of their homemade lemonade. Brad loved the flavor and the texture of the cake. Great atmosphere, great food and fantastic restaurant. They also have gluten free options.

I suggest dining in the kitchen. I always check with them to see which dishes they have on offer-and which ones I've missed. Five Star has a great beer selection, also. But I've never ordered their Dad's Cheeseburger, you know what I'm talking about. I've gotten a great response to this burger and I was really surprised, as I've always been a guy that gets "d I'm still a bit confused... I got the burger medium and it was just fantastic! I can't believe it, I was just blown away over there. They are so easy to get hold of, and will make you feel like "you have to order it." The burger is thick and juicy, but it's the cheese and the bun that makes the burger stand out. That is exactly what I ordered and after he did my food to my satisfaction, all he did was ask how much sauce I wanted. The ingredients in the burgers are also all natural, and a good source of vegetables, beans and fruit. The burger is so buttery and has a very good cheese coating. It's a lotta sauce-like! I love the flavors and the burger is delicious. I will continue to have this meal every time I visit Kirkwood and even recommend this to friends of mine and those that love me.

I've been visiting Grafton for many years now, and this location represents a special place to me. I grew up in the area where the Piasa Bird was painted and I always was fascinated by the bird. In the early 2000s swaths of Alton Highway were painted with this painting of the Piasa Bird. The original painted spot on the Piasa Bird was a stone house near the current location. The Blackfish has quite the following and I think there is one in Saint Louis that most people associate with its name alone. We also have to visit the Galleria to see some of the other restaurants and to take a bite to eat. The decor is old school, as is the layout of the restaurant, including the tables. After dining at the restaurant today for lunch, I felt the restaurant was a bit slow at first. The restaurant was quite busy at first. Unfortunately we were seated on the back floor, for an issue the server's server went to the first table and did not return until about 2:30PM I asked the waiter if it would be ok to take a sip of our tea because we needed to come back and have a drink The server returned and asked us to sit down so she could get our tea. This was a first for us all at lunch and it was slow even though we were seated right on time. We were pleased to find that the servers had tasted the food. We decided to try the Calamari Benedict, with a delicious greens sauce, which had a lot of sauce, but also had the flavors of It was super crisp with just the right amount of pepper. Our Calamari was tender, and delicious. At the same time, our server brought us the stir fry and our Vegetarian Sandwich. We ordered the Stir Fry with chicken and was extremely pleased, the sides were fresh and not too salty. We added a few veggies on top or as an added option. I didn't ask about the garlic, although the waitress did ask and the menu states it should be added to the vegetables. Most dishes can be cooked in one big pot, but that's not what this place makes it. It was just plain and delicious. Our lunch entrees ended with Haddock and fries. This was an excellent lunch and the service had just as good. I had a very nice time at BlackFinn. This is one dish you can definitely find yourself ordering again or bringing to a special event.

The Tap Room is located in West Chester County, with a twist. In terms of my friend's birthday dinner I'm not really surprised they were there. I wanted to head over to The Tap Room in Dekalb. We ordered from a waitress to sit down by ourselves. I waited for a table, armed with her reservation book, as I knew that her guests would be arriving early. I sat at the far bar which is a bit quaint, but it is the only place outside of the strip where you can get high  The crowd was not everyone at the Ladue location. I am not a regular at a bar, I was expecting a wait. We opted for a happy hour menu and ordered a glass of an iced tea. I decided that I wanted to take a seat before the party started. A host, at the front of the line, waited patiently. We then asked the waiter to do a "Cheers" form for us. They all were good. Once her choices were made she was asked to if she was a fan of Lester's, for the same reason I was asked. I ended up going with a Spicy Beef Pounder. I ordered the Fried Pickles on White Buffalo Bread. We were ready to order and when we finished we were prompted to wait for our plates and then they arrived at 2pm to fill the plate, we asked I did enjoy the chips and fries. I thought the onion rings were very good. I liked the chicken wings and the pulled pork. They didn't have the sweet sauce as the pretzels had been to the Ladue location. The fries were a bit chewy and cold like many may have expected from an Indian restaurant. We all ordered food and split sides. As I was reading the menu I asked if there were any specials or items I had in mind for each dish. I think for me that dish is better than the Pulled pork sandwich I ordered last night. For me it was a chicken sandwich. I'm not as ecstatic about the sides as the sandwiches are, but it still wasn't a bad meal. This Lester's location makes good wings, with a little sauce on them as well. Lemon pepper is my favorite seasoning. I always eat an extra-crispy wings and it took me almost a minute before they were done. This is a restaurant that has a wide variety of options. There are two options - a large sized chicken or a half sized one. The chicken was thick, juicy and the fried onions were a good combination with the wings. The wings were perfectly done and seasoned just right for both of us. All in all, we all enjoyed our dining experience. I also ordered the seasoned steak, an extra-crisp steak. Their wings are $2.95 an order. My friends all loved the wings that topped my sandwich as well. These were the kind of fishy fingers I would want on my mouth on a vacation. Also they offer their wings in a two inch sauce and ketchup. I feel so much better about the less-party atmosphere. That is not the case with The Tap Room. Well, let's see what the future holds.

Having friends live in St. Louis makes it tough, to get them to take me downtown to a place that serves burgers. I was so excited because only the Clayton location is serving the St. Louis area. I called them, and had a good conversation, but they only took about an hour to open. On Tuesday, I did not try again, and decided to treat myself. At 11:30am, I was told they were open and they were full. I was looking for my little sister-in-law with a large hat and a t-shirt, so when I arrived, there were What had me interested in this place is the view. They took approximately 20 minutes to arrive and then I took a moment to order my Ice Tea. We had our orders placed right at the front of the restaurant, it was very much a waiting area without a bar area. We wanted burgers and decided to order lunch. I asked the server for water and he brought it in a glass jar. The wait for our burgers, but I would say it was about 90 minutes (as opposed to 90 minutes at the Clayton location). But we won't need to visit at an outdoor setting for all that this place has to offer. The Bison burger arrived. It was a nice change from the "Mild to medium" burger I usually order. This burger was prepared well after waiting 35 minutes for an order. What a surprise, the bacon was served atop our burger. I was also excited to see that they have CUPs of Ketchup. They are pretty good, but they are smaller than their Clayton location and it wasn't the best. One can of Diet Coke can be used to sweeten a cup of beer. Service is nice, with a smile and a few laughs. All our food items were very good, and very good prices. It's a friendly little place and I really look forward to another time.

The Bellwether is always an exciting place and you do not want to miss out. They serve a Scallop Soba, and for it's price, you could not find a better scallop soup on the Strip. Scallops are always a very popular dish at Italian restaurants, so the staff at The Bellwether had a lot of creativity with this dish and It was light, rich and had a bit of a kick. They also have, scallops, oysters & rice flour fried on top of cheesed spinach. They serve them tad dry fried so don't worry about frying the oysters too much it doesn't taste as fresh. The fried oysters are fried using a hot marinade made from the oil used to seared the Atlantic sea bass fillet. This is definitely a place to go, especially if you love seafood. What a great way to start a meal with great food. A great lunch special is an Alaskan Salmon and Mac 'n' Cheese with a side of their amazing homemade tomato soup with rice flour and a Their lemon tart!(Peach tart!), I ordered 2 on the day. On weekends, the Bellwether serves a great dinner specials on Saturday nights. All you need to do is go with friends and the bartenders are super friendly. If you fall in love with the seafood and a romantic dinner - then check out The Bellwether. Their food is so delicious you could never go wrong with even one bite. I think so!? If I would only go then maybe I might even go back. They're open weekdays from 3 - 8 PM.

A few weeks ago, The Blue Duck opened in Oakwood. It opened last week in Manchester and I was excited to see how it lived up to my expectations. It really is a family friendly venue with some very nice bartenders. I thought the food and the service were both good. The first thing I noticed was that this place is a little small but a place to hang out. My beer of choice consisted of a draft beer with a citrus top, a white beer with a lime top, and cold beer. I chose the chilled because I prefer a stronger beer. I started the meal with some pralines (I wasn't a heavy drinker so I only had 1.2 oz) and the  They are Brussel Sprouts and are served with a side of cream and a garlic sauce called Sauteed Brussels Sprouts I love bourbon, but this did not hit my sweet spot. I want more and more and more. I got another drink and was a bit disappointed. I poured my beer and decided to stop at the menu. I could eat my favorite burger, the Hamburger, or my favorite cheeseburger, the Sauerkraut and Horseradish. Should I try a shrimp cocktail? Or a more common dish, their "hot" chicken? At first I wanted to try the burger, but after checking out the specials, I decided on the Smoked Fried Hot Chicken. The Smoked Fried Hot Chicken tasted like a classic Hot Chicken - not a "hot" chicken. They were soft on the inside, cooked just perfectly, and have a little kick. I was very delighted to eat these. I was surprised to find the entire chicken on my plate. After that, all I could think about, was the Sea Scallops. The wings are so hot that it hits my grill and my fingers. That was the best milkshake I have ever had. Theambiance is definitely modern. In fact, no one looks, but I wouldn't imagine I would in another restaurant. For me, I don't think they are over-the-top with the decor. If I try their hot chicken and salmon, I hope I will come back! A couple of months ago saw the opening of an indoor pool at the Blue Duck, but they aren't doing a lot of things, so we As well the neighborhood and surrounding areas, I am looking forward to dining at The Blue Duck for their daily lunch menu. I can't wait to try to get my hands on their menu! I bet I will be returning to The Blue Duck very soon. I'll definitely be back.

When I first drove down to Rock Hill in Spring, I visited the new Katie's. Over the past few years, we have been frequent visitors to this fine, but new, location in Rock Hill. I'll admit, it's small, but well worth it. And not only that, but they have this awesome deal, all lunch hours. The menu is very simple that's one why I've been going back. I chose a spinach salad, which has a very light dressing. It was a naive selection of roasted and fried artichokes, romaine lettuce, crock pot potatoes, and I love the taste of artichokes and the fresh herbs. It's served with a side of fried olives that I also ate and love. My second dish is a little more basic, but I think it's excellent as well as easy to take home. I ordered the Fish & Seafood sandwich. It's a delicious combination of a soft bun topped with ranch. This dish is actually called the Spicy Chicken Panini, so I don't even need a description of it. This sandwich was so good, I finished the sandwich with my favorite burger. So if you're in the neighborhood, this may be a spot to check out. My only other complaint was the two large windows on the upper level. As the movie show moved away and it was getting time to show, they could still feel a little crowded to be there. I think the food is good and service is top notch.  Overall, Katie's is awesome, well served, and price is reasonable. All the way from Cleveland, OH. I'll be back for dinner.

Olio has been open to the public since they opened in 2006 as a small but cozy bar & restaurant. In that two years, I have only been able to come back and give its current status a second look. The menu has gotten more "Americanized", they did not serve freshest ingredients, even when the fish they use still has that natural fishes flavor After all, it's really a bar/dining/party restaurant and there is definitely something going on here. They have a very nice selection of cocktails that is still tasty & unique. Some of their old friends and family are still there and I'm still happy to be there and enjoy their fine beverages. I agree with most of what I've said on this review about Olio. Ian also recommends the hummus bowl and the garlic edamame rolls. Olio's first dinner for me, was their salad (a salad that takes 2 minutes to get out of the refrigerator and not even three minutes once, The hummus has a special combination of wheat wheat flour mixed with a strong salty flavor. But, I'm also raving about the infamous 'Tons of Turkeys' eggs are the must order, because I couldn' This is not the most expensive egg salad that I've had, but that can only be found at Costco with a little work. It's a light and refreshing addition to the salad. You have to try it. In order to order, I must order from the special menu that can only be purchased at the bar, where the bartenders are waiting for you. They bring it to you by hand. Their servers even ask to sit it with the other table for you. You can still see the servers walk on by, but not as friendly as they are always, when you go in. There is more spiciness and charm than ever at Olio, which is what can be expected from someone in the industry. I could never live without such a dining experience.

Rockwell Brewing Company (Purple) is a great place to hang out. It's located at 106-109 Vandeventer Ave. Rockwell is a popular spot around town for families since it's just next to They have a great beer selection and their food is great. The beer here is excellent. In my humble opinion it's one of the best beers in the area. It has a nice dark stout flavor to it. I made sure that I could get my hands on one to go, and when I arrived I had no clue what I was going to get. I could probably get the same result with a whiskey. The patio is a great way to get outside and watch the games during the weekend. Rockwell offers a small amount of beers and most are available in glass or on draft. Both the BBQ meats and the fish are great and the portions are good. What you get here is a great burger, super tender burger and a delicious sauce. The fries are delicious, not tooggy like at most fast food joints, just enough to give you a bit of crunch. Lastly, their ice cream's are really good. After seeing my friend's friend's upcoming bachelor party at a friend's house, I would highly recommend stopping by. They offer UYE and Friday Fish specials and they have a great wine list. They are very laid back. They have a good selection of bar snacks and soft drinks. I think they are trying to make this a place where everyone can feel at home, so that's why I can't go back, unless A+!Britain's Best craft beer! - Always!You'll like it!

We had the Chicken Soto and Porchetta Panino. The Nachos were not a hit, was not as good though. We only ordered the pork. So the portions left me hungry. We then moved on to the dessert. They were right so I parked and drove to pick up my cheesecake. The cheesecake turned out to be a "fake", it had a burnt center, and a blah cheesecake. I think if the pumpkin wasn't in it the cheesecake would be ruined. The waiter was nice and friendly, we really enjoyed dining at the restaurant. I just finished eating a glass of sangria, which I had not ordered, and it was still delicious.

This past weekend I had lunch at Red Fish Kitchen. We got a little blown away by the lunch menu with a mix of salads and healthy meals. This place rocks!. I have to say that the whole evening we spent walking the restaurant, I was full. The Asparagus Salad was scrumptious and delicious. It was light and tasty with a little crunch. The Asparagus Salad was the perfect choice for someone who is on a low calorie diet. It is a full size salad with a thick cucumber and tomato dressing. A small was perfect for lunch; I actually enjoyed it more than my boyfriend, who actually had no idea what a Block Salad was. It was arugula, red bell peppers, roasted sunflower seeds, mixed greens and a tossed in a balsa The dressing was sweet and subtle, and it served as a perfect complement to the cheese. Despite our two entrees, everything about our lunch was perfect. The BF and I both tipped ourselves on the huge block burger. The Block Burger is a double cut of a 16 oz. burger with fresh grilled cheese, onions, guacamole and ground beef. It was the most amazing burger I have been to in a long time. It was all hearty and it also came with a huge helping of cheese. Aside from that, we ordered a slice of dessert as well. The best part of our lunch was the mac n - cheese which definitely had a cheesey feel. The cake was moist and full of flavor. The whole thing had an amazing flavor and the cheesy breading added the perfect texture and softness that I was looking for. What we both loved was the naughty but delicious sweet potato fries. If you are looking for healthy and comfort food, The Block is one of your options! You can definitely tell by these 2 items of food we both enjoyed The Block and would definitely recommend it. You have so much going on, and all of the flavors that go into creating one dish make you hungry. My husband and I have spent more than 20 years in the food industry, but this place is way superior to any other we have been to. The Block also has an awesome wine list. You can't go wrong. The Block has really opened up some new places to stay and if I wanted a good meal all day, I would do it. It will probably change the way I see food and service in the restaurant business, for sure. The Block has always provided me with wonderful food and I will be back from my first visit...never again.

It is a nice change from other burger joints, when I got my fix of the bfast bar at Grand Central in Seattle. The food here is amazing at a reasonable price. Their patio is gorgeous as always, their cocktails and food are amazing. They have a beautiful setup, all around. I would recommend going every once in a while to take in the food and cocktails. This was my first time at TBD and my first time trying the Dirty Martini, which I had heard was so good. I would recommend the Caramel White Wine and the Whiskey Rye. The staff is fun and helpful, always willing to help with drinks. They have a great atmosphere that makes you feel like you were there on a Wednesday evening. This location wasn't too busy and there were only about 20 customers. We have been going to BYOB since we were younger and we took advantage of the breakfast specials. The menu is fairly good and the steak and grits were good, though not stellar. We decided to just sit at the bar and have milk and doughnuts. The meat was good. A nice bonus when it come to this breakfast is I really enjoyed the sausage milk crazy. The sandwich was good, but overpowered by the sausage. I usually enjoy a nice cracker with my meal, but I found the chocolate chip cookie to be too sweet. So the biscuits weren't crispy and the cheese was softened. It could've easily been fried the day before and didn't have the crisp texture required for a healthy breakfast. We asked for a second side order of Bacon and biscuits which I ordered as well. We would definitely come back again.

It happened again, this is the second time in a row I have not given this place 3 Stars for my chicken, beef & shrimp. One Star to the good ol' Lone Grizzly. I'm not sure what happened to the previous review from this one, so I haven't been able to comment on this experience yet. I've been dining here for years and have a 13.5 Star rating. It was not too tough, it tasted a little different than I would expect. However, I would not recommend this type of meal. I decided to try it with a side of sides and it was not good, the juice was bad and the meat just tasted like sour cream I could not finish it. The lady next to me (for what ever purpose) told me that if I wanted to try the food, just ask for a second time (if That's really insulting and a bit mean but this is the only reason I did it the first time. Well, that's ok, as long as I get to meet some of the other employees here. I'll update the article if I see it. The only other reason I gave 5 Stars was having the best drinks on the planet. A lot of things in life are judged by how the store front looks and the quality of the ingredients that come in the store. In addition, the book by our front door is more likely to be a good book and the one we read will get a better review a second One of my favorite stores on my list was Epic Pizza. It's hard to find a place to go like this, because it was too far away from where I would be at right now. I've visited Epic twice, first and first time a month, and the past couple of days I have been told that they have moved away. On Tuesday and Wednesday night we hit up Epic Pizza to see if it was worth the wait. We stopped at Epic before going on to ITAP which is the next door. We was a little ahead of time (the restaurant was still open when I arrived a long time ago and I found out about EPAS from  We got in and ate pizza and chips, and were also treated to a cold bowl of soup. Besides, pizza isn't their thing. As we were outside we decided on the Epic and the Wood Fired Wings. I thought the pizza was really good, a wood fired pizza. After I ordered a pizza, one of the guys I work with, told me that it was the best pizza he has ever had. Their delivery system is very simple and efficient. What we could not resist was this whole pie and cheese, topped only with cheese. A real plus point is that ITAP is right next door. Epic Pizza is a great place to go for fast, fresh wings and a great pizza to go with it. My biggest complaint was that the pizza was a bit tougher than I would think. However, I won't order wings from Epic ever again. Eat there..it will not disappoint. If you feel like you are not getting that satisfying pizza, then go to EPAS who is located next door that delivers your food every Wednesday.

I was looking around for a new place for lunch. I ordered from Four Muddy Paws this past Sunday. The store was busy, but the staff was friendly. I was blown away. The staff at Square One is great and has a nice atmosphere. 1.Attentive 1. 2.Full Service. Nice and clean atmosphere 3. Food choices are creative and tasty 4. Food was good.. This was an excellent quality food, and well prepared. There are also an assortment of t-shirts/mugs and a great selection of beers. !!What I liked most about these guys: 5.

As we rounded the corner we came to Piccione Pastry. Every Wednesday evening my wife and I had to get a box of Piccione Pastry and dessert. Our sweets were not only perfectly fresh, but they were rich in flavor and flavorful too. Piccione Pastry was one of my favorite places to go for sweet treats! For our Cannoli, we both ordered the Cannoli. I don't want to give it any more credit though, I was very impressed. I can tell you about this. From there we both ate their Ricotta. This was seriously one of the best cheesecakes I've had in a long time. The cheesecake was divine, I have never had something so delicious. We all decided to save room for the other items. Even his is definitely an improvement over the old man's and I would really rate this on a scale of 2-10. The taste is very rich and we did feel some of the texture in the cake. It was the perfect end to a wonderful week at Piccione Pastry. I also got a glass of pink wine to try and help finish it all off. It was served with a light vanilla sauce before being topped with a fresh Strawberry Jam. Despite not being able to try the full set of items, I can truly say that they were all wonderful treats. I was definitely pleased with how delicious everything was and I will come back next year to try the Cannoli again.

This is the first time I have ever visited Goody Goody Diner, but I can say I always enjoy my breakfast here, just down the street from That's the best chicken fried breakfast I've tasted since I was a kid. Every time I get the chicken, they're fried from the inside out, tender, juicy, topped with waffles, but I do my This is all fried chicken (or shrimp) wrapped in a warm waffle bread. This place is small but the food and the server is not bad. The food is always made fresh just a few hours after your order. So is the decor. I know she has received little training, but i had a very good feeling about the service here. They have the perfect atmosphere, they have a ice cream parlor, and this place is right in the middle of downtown, so I can walk back The food is always delicious, but we've rarely had any major issues eating here. It is not a chain, so just make sure you have someone that can help you plan your next meal. I can't wait to return.

We have had lunch at Goody Goody several times in the past. It's a lowlight on a quiet Sunday morning. We called for reservations at 720-423-5835. There are two versions of the chicken and waffles, but the one I got comes with two eggs, a waffle, hot sauce and pickled I had decided on a large plate of Chicken and Waffles and the grits and had had them previously. The haveh browns were served on a large sheet and were very tasty. All of the meat and waffles were cooked to perfection, and the chicken was tender. We were both very impressed. They have a large menu of dishes, but haven't been too long. All in all, this diner made us feel at home and it did to all of us. Great find!''

I've gone to Potbelly for lunch or dinner after we heard about the new location. Potbelly is not the typical Subway, but they are the best. We went yesterday to get a sandwich from Potbelly in San Antonio, Texas. We did not need to wait that long but they said they were going to take about 90 minutes. They started to bring it out in about 20 minutes. That's why I had to ask if they could serve me in 3 minutes or less. So while I am not swayed by this, I can expect a very good sandwich here. We got a burger with double cheese and fruit. The Italian sandwich had a great thin crust and had a bit of BBQ sauce. Just like Subway, they have no dressing or sauce. A great fast lunch from Potbelly. This place is one of my favorite fast lunch places and they have one really good food truck. The staff is very friendly and they really care about their customers. I would love to get their lunch specials for lunch everyday. The french fries are not soggy (try to get the potato salad with it).

I always love Bogarts BBQ. I'm a big fan of barbecue but when it comes to pastrami, I truly believe it should be an item that is cooked to perfection. Bogarts grill is very close to my home. They take time to let you know what you're getting when you drive in, so you can order the right dish for your party or even party you' Aside from the ribs I've always had fresh pastrami and the pastrami wrap that is always their bestselling meat. The first thing you notice when you walk in, it smells of fresh baked beans. I love the side dish that is baked Beans. In addition to the steak, they have a full selection of sides that are great too such as MacNab and pickle spears. They do an amazing job of roasting the brisket as well, but the baked Beans have me sold. The cole slaw here is especially good. This is a recipe that has been around a long time to me. As a kid, I thought this was great because our neighborhood BBQ joints had such great recipes. The sauce had so many dressing ingredients it was soggy and tasteless. I know I'm a bit old school, but I sure am old school good and I'm happy with what I've picked up. Bogarts has a wide selection of classic American fare - including those in the middle of my list. I'm almost always greeted warmly by the associates who serve you. Not sure I need to wait to get on the same flight home again. The price is reasonable and the food is good. Sometimes things can be sold out, but I'm grateful for their customer service. I can't go here enough!

I had an absolute amazing experience with Heritage Veterinary Hospital for my pets. The owners of this small veterinary office take care of their patients. The modern waiting room has wonderful new furniture, better meds and treats. The first time I came in to visit, their service lasted for 4 hours. They are a great and welcoming place. They have kept me coming back since my last visit. Their clinic is clean, spacious, and comfortable. I'm not only giving this clinic 5 stars, but I'm writing this blog because I want to tell you that you will not believe the experience you

I picked up a few things from The Porch in The Plains for my sister's bday. I have received lots of gifts at this store and the recipients were very pleased with what you found. I love the store and I like the products and I like not having to pay for shipping. When we were stopped, we didn't realize they even were at the store. I came across a great selection of gifts for the more creative ladies and I found that their selection on the women's side was pretty good too. These are made by local businesses and offer fun and original items. I picked up a little of everything. If you like it a little sour then there is a cool Fleur de Lis tattoo that is in an unusual shape. A piece for a fellow business owner would also be perfect. I did not find the selection of vases to be in your usual Flor de Lis style, but the variety I did find definitely is what impressed me the The Venetian glass is a must have and I bought a small one just because I know I will take it home. I had been on the fence about going to Biggie's before reading their review. What do you think? I love rib joints so much that I've had them at other restaurants and in the drivetime I wanted to check them out. I had to go early, I had to wait about half an hour to get a seat. The patio was very empty and there was not very many customers. What? And what is that about ribs? The restaurant was packed so we were asked if would be good for two hours. And it was..well I think you get my point. She was quite nice, even though it was a Saturday and I was trying to get to work. She also kindly brought me a portion of a slab of BBQ from an order I had made in advance. But then the waitress came and took one of the rib pieces and then offered it up as carryout. I could not believe how great service was! The ribs were fantastic, but the sauce was not so great. I could only finish one plate off myself, all though I knew I wanted to order another for Brad. Some of the sauce that I asked to keep in the fridge and use in the microwave after eating was in there but it was pretty good. Aside from the ribs and sauce, the rest of the foods were great. There was not a lot of sauce crammed on it, which meant the ribs had plenty of meat and tasted extremely good. I ordered the Baked Potatoes and they were incredibly good also. If you are looking for a place to go to eat in a more comfortable environment then Biggie's is your place and the food just didn I only ate half but I think it was worth it. I loved it.. The whole family was raving about the ribs. Not an early night again now though.

I have had two breakfasts at Spencer's Diner, a true gem I have been loving since I first visited. I have been a regular since 2011 and I can vouch for this. There is just something here that makes your morning perfect! I ordered the breakfast combo, which is a good idea because they serve theirs all season at all hours of the day. For breakfast here in San Diego, you need to have them make the side of scrambled eggs dry and microwaveable. A favorite with me is the "Cheeseburger" which is almost like a sausageburger served with breakfast potatoes. I have also tried the beef burger, a burger that is covered in red beans and white peppers. If you are looking for a more salty breakfast, Spencer's offers a Slinger (chili, eggs, pepper and hash brown I also eat a Slinger and Slammer each weekend. My favorite have been the Slammer and I usually take mine with me. I normally think of this kind of breakfast as a "meal for two", but here it is a great meal and one of my favorite breakfast items Spencer's Grill has a great little diner that is always filled with customers and regulars. The diner is full of locals, but also has a big gathering area. I remember the first time I visited, I was the only person in the entire building that didn't take a turn at any of the table. From my perspective, I have always come so far despite the wait staff bringing me my dish twice. Spencer’s Grill is located inside the old Dunkin Donuts, so is a great place to stop for a good meal, or take out There isn't anything like this for breakfast.

Thanking you to all for your hard work on opening day. You guys have done a great job with your menu as well as your food service. I was able to catch your grand opening party on Tuesday. This place was the best it had been to date! After all, you have the food service! I know this is a great place to have a dinner party and was beyond excited to try all that Salt + Smoke has to offer. With the grand opening taking place at 2:00pm on May 14, I was still in the mood to enjoy myself and the vibe of the day was amazing. There were a lot of people making noise to welcome people to the restaurant. I could say everyone brought their best and the whole experience was amazing. I would recommend Salt + Smoke to anyone that is looking to give the city its very own new cocktail bar for the first time. I ordered the Brut Manhattan made with their dark chocolate syrup (which is also a secret ingredient on the menu). I had the Manhattan made with vanilla cream. In this drink, you're served classic rye and a creamy Manhattan, which I love. It was made with a great bourbon and it'll taste awesome with any of their bourbon and cream based cocktails. My second cocktail is a hot tater tots to go and is a combo of pickles and mayo. I have heard that fried ham is bad for health, as well as pickled plants. However, one thing I don't like is the idea of the Pickles being fried only because they just sit around forever and do not cook. I could have tried the sandwich without the pickles, and still ended up being very satisfied and satisfied with it. They were good, but the pickles had a good amount of flavor. The breading is made with flaxseeds and is blended with the pickle cream and mayo. They were just so sweet. I also ordered the Fried Bacon with Lemon and Blue Cheese, and the Oven Fired Red Vinaigrette. When you say Old Fashioned, you're not making a regular Old Fashioned, but here's the proof. This was by far my second perfect drink. This cocktail is so well taken care of. It was not only delicious but really smooth and tasteful. I ordered two.I have a problem with that word, but they had an awesome cocktail. I would only be a fan of the classic Old Fashioned if I wasn't already a lover of this cocktail. And no, I don't mean the salty salt and pepper shaker in my head? One of my favorite things about this place is that they are an open kitchen. I'd recommend avoiding the Manhattan or Old Fashioned if you go to Salt + Smoke. If you've stayed in my hood long enough to know that I don't want to stop back, it was a real treat to be I had a great time, had lots of conversation and was very satisfied with my experience here. The food was great too, although I'm sure it's just as good on the inside as on the outside. I am going to make sure to save room for my next cocktails. They do serve alcohol, but I can only say that these are awesome. I didn't even have to leave. I can say I will definitely come back to Salt + Smoke. Loved it, love it, love it. A great bar that has it all. The food that I ordered was delicious, incredibly seasoned and fresh. The flavors are wonderful, however I'm very disappointed about the fish dish. I was definitely one to hit the fridge early and watch the New Year's Eve lighting show. I can definitely recommend this place as more of a bar joint where people are willing to give things a try rather than leaving the place empty with a It could be that the ingredients would not be consistent. I had it with the fried pickle as a side and a slice for dessert. We are in love here.

I am happy to announce that I received a coupon for my last visit in Vegas, and it was for Mamma Mia's buffet. In fact, it was super garlicly. I haven't tried the entire menu with anything of the meat or dessert options. I was going to give it a try. There was a buffet - one I rarely see. It sure sounds interesting. For those who don't know, they have a large portion of vegetarian dishes. They had two vegetarian options on our visit: a grilled veggies platter and pizza plate. You can add a side of pizza (a regular pizza), chicken wings, an a la carte menu, salad, dessert and more (see menu below Most of the offerings were made-to-order. The Italians were also excellent. The rest of the dishes were very good - everything I could taste smelled of fresh tomatoes and basil. Their bread is also very good, but sometimes the salad dressings are a little bit too salty. Food was ok, but at $12.00 a plate for me, I found it to be a little pricey for a buffet. On Friday, the restaurant came out to the party with a very enthusiastic crowd behind the restaurant - which has been a long time since the last time I was with a crowd of the "typical crowd" they seemed to be known for. And, for the record, the waitress was the star of the day (as stated by the other diners). Overall, it was a decent lunch buffet. But still, I don't think they can convince me to eat there again. You would never know if I had tried Mamma Mia before. But it would not surprise me if I were to sample what they had to offer. If not, I will never go back.

This restaurant is close to my home but is located a little further from it. It's very easy to walk through from the North Grand entrance. I would definitely come back. The chicken & waffles were super delicious!

I can't believe that Half & Half is closed on Monday. Half & Half is closed on Monday. Only open for the first two meals of the day. Half & Half is one of my go-to breakfast and lunch joints in the Bay Area. When I'm feeling peckish for something to eat I can easily go for their breakfast items or their lunch items. One is better at a very early hour and the other is a more filling time between breakfast and a late lunchtime meal. I usually order an omelette (which I like because it is a breakfast dish versus an omelet) and the omelet is my My favorite breakfast is the Cafe Ricotta Omelet. It was actually quite good. The omelet was served with a house made egg, avocado, and spinach cheese. Some additional veggies are added for a more filling omelet, but even with a little extra, this is still a good omelet I also enjoyed their bacon on the side of the omelet. This omelet was topped with Swiss cheese, maple syrup and a maple bacon-topped omelet. We shared this dish, which they think is so good. I cannot wait to try the jalapeo burger. This one is not only so delicious, but it is also so healthy. Now that I know a little bit more about jalapeos, I can finally add them to my burger. I love the combination of onion and jalapeo on the burger. This wasn't what I expected and made for a good day. Half & Half is located at the corner of 12th & South in downtown Miami. If you're dining alone, half of the rooms are closed at lunch and there is no lunch. The bar is my favorite place to eat lunch or breakfast. If you want to sit down for a drink, they offer a happy hour from 6-8 pm, and after this time, they are still open for It would take 5 minutes just to get an order up, but it's worth it. I am sure you will love it.

The cheesesteak at Patti's sandwich bar is always topped with provolone, arugula and garlic. But, you mainly get what you want. The sandwiches at PS are always fresh and the fresh cut fries (they're also gluten free if you're vegan) are delicious. PS is one of the best sub shops in Pittsburgh. Friend or foe, it is as good as any but it's a "must". This is a crowd favorite and if you're really adventurous you can order the pizza crust for your sandwich. On top of your sandwich, PS will give you a large order of fries (eggs) and a frosted lemonade. It's about 40 calories and has a wholelot of protein. PS is right in my neighborhood and I have been coming here every week for dinner. They are so easy to make. PS has an amazing bar area where you can eat whatever you want and drink, in your own ramen. If you're looking for a place to take the kids, PS is a very friendly and fun place for kids.

Frailey's is a popular Karaoke venue for friends, family and groups who love singing to great music. All staff are excellent. She did not allow me to be in the crowd before we sang our songs. She also shows off her awesome collection of great CDs for everyone to enjoy. I've always liked to sing with my own group and Mitch Miller's vocals made for a great sing along to his original song "D For sure, Frailey's has a songbook tucked away in the bathroom, which is a nice touch to me. The karaoke crowd was very nice, and I enjoyed every word of all the songs at Frailey's. The price of the beer at Frailey's was also very competitive, I'll admit that I bought more than one drink. I had the courage to ask for a "silver draft" draft beer that cost five dollars on Monday. I have never heard that before. I got my drink poured before I left and topped up before heading home. The crowd was kind. Some people were doing a good job. They ain't tough. They also seemed to be having a hard time getting out of their shirts. On the flip side, I just don't think the girls are that into their karaoke. I'd recommend it to anyone!

I don't frequent a local location, but this one is a quick and easy drive to work on a Saturday morning. It was always a commute to my car as I drove down the street to work. There's so much I love about the Maplewood location, like the location's drive-thru, the coffee served, and all the cool It really helps!. Every Tuesday at my husbands birthday party I order a doughnut hole with the "Hollow" in the center. If I'm having a sweet breakfast, I want a chocolate panini. There is also a breakfast sandwiches (always with bacon) out to go. With no sweetener, they are loaded with the freshest ingredients. My family is regulars that have lived here since the original opening, and they love them too. The convenience is definitely worth it. The janitor service is beyond good. I hope they stay there until 5 AM each day.

The Holiday Bakeshop is a place to find all the stuff you need to get ready for the holidays. A wonderful family owned and operated store. If you are like me, don't look for the Christmas jars that go out the window, this is your store. It is also a great place to browse, because they are always adding new items to their shelves. This has to be one of my favorite places in town to buy my own spice. I know I will have a lot of uses for them! One of my favorite spices was the one I picked up at the dollar store. I bought a red chili pepper hot sauce, it is called the "Skinny Sun" flavor. It is my all time favorite sauce to drink or make your own hot sauce!

It seems like the shopping at The Porch is about to take an important turn. My wife's & my family's Christmases here are always a favorite. You know, so much about a person's personality and why they want something, but I still enjoy shopping at The Porch! This is a store whose products are made locally. I think it's fun to put together some cute personalized Santa treats. We always have great sales because it is a great local business. And for the record, I had found this gift while looking on yelp, so it's a good way to get a feel I think you will enjoy your selection of art, jewelry, clothing and more. PERFECT! I was in my late 60's and needed an experience that was fast, easy and palatable. After a pleasant breakfast from my SO, We walked into the restaurant and were greeted by a busy young bartender. There was a long line of guests. They did have that full front of the house presence as you could read on their Facebook page. We asked to sit at the counter and was greeted by a young Mexican male who seemed very knowledgeable about the menu. Host: We don't have a reservation. Me: There is no time but what do you want? Host: You really? Host: We don't have a table and we don't want to be called out just because you're a private guest. Host: Not yet! Your only guest is the old man. The cab driver who had collected my meal was not available so we left. The manager walked out with an attitude and said he would be in touch. He explained that your kitchen was being prepared for the official launch of your new food truck, but the restaurant had not opened yet. According to Manager, it is a private party. What?!!!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!!? The manager was so nice and sweet, but the attitude that followed got me offended. Thank you manager...but then he added and dated my credit card to the account. After all, this was a party of friends that you had opened in February. You should have given us more time to check out other options that aren't being offered. I hope he also learns to be more patient and understanding.

A must-try dessert for any chocolate lover is their brownie bites. I always try to eat on a stick. One was delicious while other were way much smaller. These don't just fit in your pockets. They are big on streusel topping and have a big, sweet crust. The cinnamon rolls are plated out with two options, the inner center and the outer core. I've enjoyed an edge piece as though it were chocolate ice cream. The crust is a light and airy bread topped with sweetened cinnamon and your choice of sauce. You can also order their famous Hot Biscuits, with extra sausage. The biscuits are very nice and thick with salty and meaty flavor and a crisp crunch. I would have a second piece as well if I were a full-on Cinnamon Roll Lady. If you visit by yourself, make sure and try the French Toast and their Bacon Chips. Their employees are friendly and will work with you to find the right dishes for you.

The Kirkwood Food Market is awesome. I love Soulard's market more than Kirkwood. The jams, honey and cheeses were fresh, but the corn on the cob was tasteless. I also have the good luck of sharing some of his home grown, tasty produce with my son. He was so excited to find a local honey in the jar. I also picked up eggs from a local restaurant with fresh fish and an excellent salad from some of the neighborhood's finest restaurants. We did have a good amount of fun, checking out all the products and samples. They have many wonderful pies, such as the apple pie and the grape pie. And the produce was around $6 for the whole market. I am hoping to be able to buy one of these decorations that I will sell this summer. Kirkwood also sells a lot of products that other markets do not, so you have to try your best to get the right selection on sale. The produce was great, especially the organic peaches that I picked up at the produce stand. I will definitely check next time I am in the area. The market is open 9 am - 5 pm daily until Labor Day weekend. I am sure that there are many more farmers markets and markets in the area.

I had the biscuits and gravy at General Grain Kitchen from my first visit back in 2014. My friend had it and I was so glad that we did. I don't know why at one time my brothers and I had a big lunch group there. There are a few things that I know are good but that I am not definite on that are a must try. Having found it to be very good, we have always decided to pay another visit to try something new. Our last visit was on Sunday afternoon after work where we opted and ordered 3 things each. I had the biscuits and gravy and I would say that the biscuits and gravy from GGD was one of the most memorable experiences we had. And the best part about the B&G is that for each chicken item you get, you will get a slice of bread. The perfect way to end a morning for a family or to have a little someone to share with. Having reviewed B&G at GGD before, I could not think of a better way to start my new post. The chicken was perfect, tender and flavorful.

Six Mile Bridge is a new local brewery and is located at the intersection of North Broadway and West 9th Street. This is a nice neighborhood craft brewer in the Heights. These brews are bold and taste like home-brew for you all to enjoy. The beer is so smooth, you can almost see the brewing process in your hand. The tavern is spacious (all seats are numbered) and offers a variety of craft beers, which are all perfectly brewed. My favorite of the day was the Irish Stout with chocolate fudge. I had their Coffee and Chocolate Stout with Chocolate Chips which was delicious. The Irish Stout is not only a great IPA, but the flavor it offers is a perfect combination of roasted malts and bitterness I had the drink in two sizes...a small for me, but huge for my husband. Their Red Ale was a mix of citrus fruits with a hint of honey. I enjoyed the Bavarian Hefeweizen the most, its very mild with a complex taste of caramel and honey. They also have a nice selection of sweets such as their honey churro. There are 12 beers available, ranging from regular brews to those made with natural hop flavorings. The only complaint for a beer bar in the Heights, is the food that you purchase. Their menu is full of fresh sandwiches. So, you're not likely to be able to order a dish. You will not be disappointed! Don't be fooled by the label and their high pricing, SMB is worth it. Also, don't forget to stop by their new wine bar. Definitely a must stop place for any fan of the craft beer scene.

This was the best BBQ in my neighborhood and what a surprise. They were running the Specialty Meat Market, and was offering me an unheard of sandwhich. Ian took me up on his offer during lunch and gave me a pork cut and two sides. It is absolutely mouth watering and so worth the drive. I opted for the regular one, that was my only complaint about the lunch. I was impressed with the fresh roasted beans served with my pork steak. They did offer both, but I did not try the pork. I liked their red wine slaw, great for those who like their "flavor". I was very pleased with the BBQ sauce that I had on this meat. The BEAST has a solid selection of BBQ sauces on the menu. The "Carolina Style" is smooth, sweet, and very tasty. The Thai, was a bit spicy. I liked the smokey flavor, not enough heat to drown the flavor from under the meat. Steven was knowledgeable about their sauces and was so friendly. The "Firebird" was an unusual & flavorful BBQ sauce. I recommend their Habanero. I have to admit this was the last BBQ sauce I tried. I was expecting just the right amount of heat, but that has been met so far. This was a good lunch on the river. I don't enjoy all of the wait time, but I enjoy getting my bill and can make the arrangements in my mind. At the bar, you can also order and sit and talk to the staff all about your experience. This is a place that seems to be open for lunch and dinner seven days a week, but it also serves dinner three days a week. It's amazing how good they are. Why: Dinner!, Dinner with the Boys, and STL 100. I have to admit I am a fan of their menu and the prices.

Do you know what a large chicken breast is? I do. Check out Johnny's Hamburger House in Pittsburgh. For those of you who are familiar with Pat's then you know that they hit the mark with their fried chicken. Do you love large breasts? The chicken is cooked perfectly and it is actually rather juicy that is. Their chicken is ingenious - Pat's was one of the earliest restaurants in the city. Their wings are soggy, but you don't care because they taste just as good. These wings and chicken are really good too! I know there are people on the west side of the city who don't believe it is possible by todays standards, but I am adamant The bar is very lively and the food serves up an authentic Irish atmosphere. They're the perfect accompaniment to your meal at Pat's. Pat's makes you feel very welcomed and welcome, they are very honest with their table service and food. The food is always fresh and their prices are very affordable.

The pizza & garlic chicken wings were awesome. They had great wings and fries. Their wings were well seasoned, tender, and sweet. The sauce was really good. They had the perfect amount of sauce and how the sauce is poured was great. We are excited to use this service for our team to share and try and find some of their better wings next time.

I had the pleasure of dining and watching the chef work on their menu during breakfast Monday, a Sunday. I had been so excited to find this place after I read all the reviews on Yelp. I was first to check it out and was so impressed with the decor and menu. It started with my BF ordering a Buffalo Chicken sandwich. A Cuban sandwich with sides and a Broccoli Cheese Soup were the main offerings. This was the first time in recent history that a soup would be on the menu. It has a perfect balance between the ham and the cheese. The soup was very good, minus the parmesan and the pickle seasoning. The soup was hearty and filled with great protein. If you are looking for a big lunch, try a Mac-n-Cheese wrap. The Mac-n-Cheese was perfectly creamy and delicious. The sides were served in a layered salad. The sauce needed a little extra creaminess to make it really taste like it was made from scratch. It was like watching a fish run by in a river. The side salads are all very fresh and you can even taste the dressing. Oh how they don't offer ranch dressing like in most restaurants. We even joked she wanted to try putting grapefruits on the side salad. We shared a glass of wine for the evening and to think the atmosphere was beautiful was a surprising surprise. The waitress was so sweet and friendly, you'll have to take that for granted if you want to return for another bowl or salad. They'll take your order and make sure you're getting exactly what you want. Each one was very willing to help, and often would provide suggestions on what we liked. They are incredibly nice, knowledgeable, affable and friendly to those who come to this establishment. We told the worker we wanted to take this place as a family and she was so friendly and always kept on top of what was happening. They are very busy in the summer but that does not get in the way. We will definitely be back. What a difference. We are planning to go another time for lunch, but in the near future I will make the drive to enjoy the place. You may see the workers, but it is hard to do the dishes without them. A++++ from me. A great place to go.

This place is amazing! Aya Sofia is just beyond magical. My evening with Aya Sofia began with a great dinner that I was not expecting, but had in my list of things to eat. Having friends around is a blessing, the service, food and atmosphere was above par. We started with the "sirl drinks" where you could buy a bottle of gin and ask the server to make "special drinks for It was amazing and so "weird". Those were both fantastic martini's and I had to share one with one of my friends. We then had a "Favorite" starter, Aya Sofia's "Small Plates," consists of a traditional This was simply wonderful as it was so light and delicious. Aisha's Kalamar Tava is so delicious I couldn't possibly eat all of it, but it was delicious. On the next Small Hot Plate, we were excited to taste the "Turkish tak" made with sour cream and pist We ordered several and each wine was delicious and we finished our dinner with a cocktail glass every time. This was followed by two of their "Male" dishes. I have never had such a wonderful lamb chop. I do have a slight opinion about this dish, and the kabobs, but I will make a quick post about them all. Jason R said it is a must tried, but I did not even want to finish it. Our desserts were also amazing, our Banana Pudding (a soft, dense mixture made from mangoes, honey, and black currants We would have been too full to order more of the dishes, to top all of our dinner, so we just left with a couple of those two dishes My husband, Dorothy, and I have friends in Turkey and we all enjoyed a beautiful Turkish dinner here.

From my first trip to Spencer's, I can tell that they are one of the best Mexican restaurants in the area. I first came here after getting laid back during my move to Atlanta. I have been coming here for years for breakfast on Sundays and haven't stopped. There is a good burger on the menu, but the one on my lunch menu that I find my favorite is the Grilled Cheeseburger. It's a true breakfast burger, what I like about it. Whether it be from a car, from a truck, or from a hot dog cart. I believe I've been able to get a goodburger somewhere else like a D&J or The Original Diner. The cheese was very soft yet rich. I also enjoyed three of the four eggs that came with it. Our main course had to be the egg omelettes. They are so moist I could eat one for breakfast every day. I think the place was just restocked recently. They are not too thick and are tasty and filling like the ones at Carl's Drive In. And they are absolutely delicious. The fries they serve as a side were excellent too. We ordered the "Pale Whip". It is truly as good as what you get at Carls and McDonalds. When I see you at Spencer's, you will always feel welcomed. I work in this service industry and I never need an "introduction." We have had our favorite wait staff at Spencer's for a long time now (recently) and will continue to recommend them.

If you're into pizza, then the Wing Zone might be for you. This place has chicken wings. The Wing Zone makes me want to eat and drive south for wings. I always eat at Papa Johns, or even the drive in movie theaters where their wings are served. They come in a dozen sizes, and I'm not a fan of the smaller wings. It is also a good value. There are two pricing options; Family & Party Packs. The wings are just ok. They offer the boneless and bone-in wings. And they also have a slit and a pocket. If you don't like chicken, you won't like the boneless wings. Some of the ones I was happy with were the Buffalo Buffalo's and the Buffalo Hot Shot. They are delicious, so you will love them even if you don't like Buffalo. The Garlic Parm flavor was very good, it just wasn't as hot as I'd like. The seasoned pickles are very good. The Bacon wrapped wings are on par with Taco Bells. They aren't too bad, but again have to be expensive. I've had better! The wings aren’t bad, you probably expect a more greasy, over cooked texture when eating wings, but, just plop the chicken The wings are good because of the amount of cooking. If someone asks to pick up, they probably do since the truck works a small radius. If you're in the area, I'd recommend this place.

I took my wife to WC after a long day. You can always come across a good WC by entering the bar / patio area. A few seconds later, you see a server coming over from my car, you wonder if the car has just seen about 25 foot waves in a The burger was pretty good at $2.99 for a burger & onion rings.

I made a special stop in IHOP today. This one is closer to the strip, but still nice and quick. At first, I didn't think I'd like IHOP because of their $5.99 Breakfast Breakfast Menu. This is my first time at a new location. It didn't take me long to see why I love this chain so much. They have a little drive for lunch or dinner and are very open all day. However, sometime in the near future, IHOP will be coming back to my neighborhood. It was a great time at IHOP and I just wish they were still around, they have the same menu as the old Fazoli's I was able to purchase a large breakfast plate consisting of a Buffalo Chicken Sandwich with Sausage, Broccoli, Mushroom, On I couldn't be more happy with this omelet. I tried the burger and I am a big meat lover. The Eggs were cooked perfectly and tasted great. These were very good and you have to try their regular ones and like they remind me of them from my childhood. This wasn't what happens, but it wasn't too bad when it came to taste. I thought these were quite delicious. For the price, I expected more for the same price. I thought for the $12.99 breakfast, that's what I was getting. I would and you never know. It takes about two minutes to get down to the table and the decor is a nice change. (LOL)...and I love their cinnamon sugar ice cream!!

My SO and I discovered Taco Bell on the corner of South 1st Ave and 5th St. We got there for lunch after doing all of our TB is owned by Pizza Hut of Boston and is also part of Pizza Huts of New York. One of my favorite restaurants in San Antonio is Taco Bell Taco Bell South. This means that when you order from Pizza Hut at TB you can get your favorite pizza for as little as $1. So I had the opportunity to test out the soaps that are offered at Maven. I recently took the plunge into my first soap-free shower and was very surprised about the results. This is an interesting trend in Charlotte - that of the low end pizza delivery. With all our new pizza houses opening up, the trend has turned from a traditional white pizza back to a new white pizza. My husband and I hit up Pizza Hut for lunch with Mark P. and his wife. I have had a great time here in Chicago. I know its located on a busy street and have been to Spiro's multiple times. It is like a new Gyro with some specials. Yes, it was good, although the service was a little short, at least the server was nice. The interior was quaint with two dining halls. What can you say about these good, friendly and efficient employees? We were seated promptly at the end of the formal dining room as the people just took another order of Saganaki. We started with a pizza of the traditional Greek dish, Kassen and topped with a fresh pita bread. Of course, if you have taken a bite of our wonderful Saganaki. This time we ordered the Saganaki with Pita, Salad and Ghetto Bread. The fried cheese had a mild Greek taste, but it was seasoned perfectly! I ordered the Gyro Meatballs. I ordered the baklava. It will satisfy the meat lovers on your menu. The side dishes included a large salad, cheese bread, thinly sliced potatoes, and a chicken breast with yam, tuna and pros The presentation was outstanding, her thighs were so tender and just the thing to top a Salad or Sandwich. The Gyro and Panera options were also very adequate, but I do wish they would give me option to choose something. I ordered the Gyro Paneeri, Lamb, Tzatsiki sauce, Ham, Red Pepper, YELLOW DUE, The Gyro was prepared using a fresh chicken breast that was mashed together with a meat blend as a topping. I enjoyed both my Gyro sandwiches and was glad we had extra. I recommend the Gyro Sandwich to everyone I know. We started our lunch off with a Greek Salad, which was very good too. I would definitely eat again at Spiro's.

I've been to this store a few times and have been very satisfied every time. I was taken to this stores so many times that I stopped in every day to pick up their products. On our way out of the diner, we stopped at the Peking Bicycle Shop, had a little walk around, came across CD's Happy

This was my first time dining at Mimi's Food Truck. I went on an Event Friday, August 16th, 2017, towards the Breast Cancer Battle, with a group of 5 ladies to have lunch with MM. After a wonderful meal at Greenbelt, the two of us were able to eat at Firehouse Bistro on the way home. It was super fresh. The container for our mac salad is large enough for two people. After the pie was covered, it had a very clean looking presentation. But, their pie was easy to open. I love the combination of flavors as this is my favorite dish when I am with a group, but not just with me. I need more. I was asked what flavor is my favorite and I opted for the creamy slaw flavor. I've recently been bringing my daughter in with a good friend and we've had a great time at this little diner - as You have to order in advance, so you know the food will be good. There is no question about it, there are a few restaurants that look older than the rest. Upon my last visit to UB's, I was glad we decided to try it again. Uncle Bill's was built in 1948 on the corner of First West Ave and Virginia Ave, in one of the most historic areas of the country. Then my friend was talking to a man at our table about his wife's divorce. The lady was polite, didn't mind asking questions, her mannerisms were very professional and she was a gentleman. My husband decided to have breakfast and we did the same, ordering the Steak atop a breakfast sandwich and biscuits. In addition to breakfast food there is hash browns, but it was a different kind than the ones you'll find at most fast food restaurants. We also ordered a small piece of fruit and a couple of hot dogs and were not disappointed. It was a hearty breakfast with a thick and rich gravy and a strong breakfast biscuit. I went back for more and will have to wait until we get back home before I will try it again. I wouldn't recommend UB's to anyone, but if you're looking for a great breakfast in downtown Minneapolis it's a

So, this week is seafood month and it's Grilled Swordfish. I did not make that mistake! Bogarts in St. Louis is incredibly good. We went to Bogarts today for lunch, with my friends. Bogarts Barbershop has a full bar, a grill and is open for lunch. Since having moved here from the bay county, I am quite familiar with Bogart Smokehouse and their ribs. However, I live in the county so if the city's BBQ has to be good enough, I would rather be in Dalie's County. There have been times when I've made a pit stop for my favorite Smokehouse (the one we always go to for pastrami on Tuesday There's just one stop in town, Dalie's Smokehouse, in the corner of Main Street & Hummingbird Road (St I had to go to Dalie's because it looked like a great choice for a Wednesday afternoon lunch. And so began our week long visit. Almost 5:45 a.m. when I stepped from my car to get in line, it was hot in August, not the usual 30 I was a little nervous, but it all went very well.
