The meats were the normal ribs, which is rare to see in Nashville, but they were tasty and moist. I started with Bogart's pastrami ribs, which were a very good match. I ordered the brisket and the sauces were excellent. It had an intense meat taste with a bit of heat undertones. I thought it was a little too salty for my taste, but I couldn't resist. The sauce has a hint of creaming sugar, a very good sauce to top it off. I always enjoy a hotter sauce. I would not want to order an egg dish unless I wanted to try the fish! I can't remember what they tasted like before, but I can assure you they are worth it. The Fried Fire & Ice Pickles have a nice crunch, with a nice crust that was very salty, but very good. I love fried pickles and I loved the garlic breading. It was my favorite Mac-n-Cheese, so I may just give their Mac-n-Cheese a try I have not had that one before. My friend picked these two meats and ordered the Texas Style Stroganoff Ribs. My roommate ordered the beef and was happy to find a side of bbq breadsticks, that was just as good. I love a good pork chop and I know this is something for my brother. We finished the day here at Davidi's Smokehouse. I was impressed.I want to say thank you for providing this wonderful place. I ordered the hottest catfish enchiladas available. On a sidenote, the Mac-n-Cheese was also light and just like its burger cousins, they're thin I am so happy I had the opportunity to try this place out and really enjoy the food. If you're in the area, I recommend Dalie's Smokehouse for good BBQ! There is not really a standout dish here, as it tends to be an experience in itself.

I was glad to be not selected again to serve Jury duty, in the city of Columbus. It took me a week and a half to process my judicial service. I started for the first time at 6 AM, and left by 8:00 PM. It was quite an experience though.

My son and I went in this afternoon and bought the brisket pizzas and chicken sandwiches. The Food at the Hidalgo Burger Bar is the only place in the State of Colorado that isn't a "burger bar". The Bloody Mary is at its finest with a Slider. It's a delicious sour red drink in the shape of a burger, so not only are You a drinker, but you I would have given it 4 stars, but it was the only meal I had and so I decided to try the sliders. I'm sure we all know there are people who go for one of those and go as far as to say "Mexican isn't The menu is extensive like most restaurants and the sliders are served on a variety of buns. I don't know if this is a trend but the service is great and the food is delicious - this has to be the best "s Each booth had 2 tables, and the food was incredibly good. The portions were generous with 3 sides of fried pickles, 2 sides of fried carrots and 1 side of fried green tomatoes. I loved the fried pickles. I ordered a Large Hamburger and I love this version. All I can say is that these were tasty all night. The sliders were tasty and were the perfect size to go with my Bloody Mary. The regular slider was the All American, beef fillet and topped with pickle, hot sauce, tamari and a big thick sauce The sliders are not called the burgers, but they are all about the meat. I was introduced to the Classic Ruben. The Classic Ruben, on top of the fries was a slice of a medium, cooked bun with delicious seasoned Corned Beef. They used a thick layer of fried pickles that wasn't soggy. I had no issues with the ruben. I wanted more, but not so much that I'm afraid to have one again, so I just left it off the plate and they replaced it with the It came out hot as hell, but you could definitely taste the difference. It was flavorful and the chicken had a heat level above medium. However, I'm using the term very loosely in relation to how hot it is in Nashville. I was so surprised how good they were! I love fried chicken, the Classic Ruben was one of those pieces that I really enjoyed. Well, well worth the wait. This place does have a very "kid friendly" atmosphere. The chicken was medium, not very flavorful and it was not a particularly dry taste, so I would have to say, it was almost as good as It got my stomach grumbling and that's when "slider" became the term for it!! In all, that was just the start of my lunch at the burger pit. Oh, and the slaw was just delicious. No need to ask a waiter for it, you'll be glad you did.

Shivers has been coming to New Orleans for the past month or so. Their review is still there, I have yet to try any of their offerings, but I am pleased that they have taken the time to update it. As I was driving around I saw a sign about a new menu, it was "new menu, new design." The menu was very long and it was very busy. To be fair, I was not sure it was as good as a German Chocolate. Layla, a Syrian restaurant, was a surprise for us tonight. They helped me find a new restaurant for my boyfriend to eat at and had me come up with a menu to share. The restaurant has been doing well and I got to try out all the new items that they had on their menu this week. I had the opportunity to try Layla at the International Supper club a couple of days ago. What I liked: There were about a dozen diners at the restaurant from all over the city so they got a table big enough to house. This was nice because it was close to my office. The kitchen was pretty quick to respond for us. A good amount of attention was given to our table. The kitchen began to fill the plates and plates sped up. The food was cold for a while and then it started coming along really quickly after it was delivered and was all out in one or two bites. When we got our order, all of our burgers were served immediately. I ordered a large portion of a mouthwatering burger on a bun which came with a side of salad. Me and my roommate ordered a lunch special and ordered the Beef Burger. This was a well made burger, the sauce was savory and the beef was tender, shaved and lightly charred on the outside There was also a selection of dips; a little chipotle mayo, jalapeo ketchup, jalap They were light and a little greasy for my liking. So it became my favorite vegetable at work and I had a big bowl of their Grilled Mediterranean Yoghurt with a Greek dressing on top The dish is a mixture of both baklava and Gooey Butter Cake. The dish was so good, I had no idea what to eat. It was similar to the Gooey Butter Cake and the traditional desserts of Lebanese immigrants that lived in the US at one time. I would definitely try it again. The Gooey Butter Baklava had a smooth layer of cheesecake and a layer of sauce. The baklava reminded me of the good ol' decadence my grandmother used to eat. A good sized portion as most restaurants use a large number of dishes. For a change, the prices are about a third higher than what they charge at a Park Avenue Coffee. Although, I had some issues with the meal due to its size as I was on a tight budget from what I need on my list.

This is the greatest part about Monday Brunch, it is the "square beyond compare" (or just "crossed over"). No, I'm talking about some amazing breakfast from The Square. They are made to order and available to order. I was enticed to arrive at 8:30 on Sunday. When you walk in to the diner, there is a wait of 15 minutes before your bill is checked out and you are shown to your table. The biscuits were a generous size. This dish had two large side dishes. Although it has only the mildest of flavoring, it was really sweet and delicious. I can tell this drink was meant to be shared with you and you took it with a spoon. It was a good breakfast and despite the wait, it was very good. My plate consisted of three cookies. The biscuits are perfectly cooked on top, sweet, and salty. But I am very careful not to finish off any of the biscuits. Just remember, "Nashville is on the way", don't expect to see a bill before you order this dish. They were not overly much sweet, not too sweet. If not for the amazing bread, you'd probably want to go for the breakfast specials (including all the biscuits and gravy). If you will not be spending Sunday Brunch at Russell's, get the biscuits first.

While we have not had a chance to eat here since my first review, I know it is better than the chain. Over the past 6 months my lunches and dinners have been excellent. I've not been a big fan of their wings but this has definitely upped my opinion. In the past 4 weeks I've ordered 4 different things from The Sluts. My first was a pizza during a Tuesday night. I love pizza.. but only because it's so good. It was on a Tuesday evening and dinner got me excited. And, one that isn't to be missed. It was a tasty lunch with lots of cheese and sauce. For the pizza, I chose the seasoned pepper sauce with onions, tomatoes and bell peppers. I really really enjoyed my pepperoni and sausage. They used a sauce that tasted like prolly for the sauce so I thought it was great. A slice of blackened onions in the bottom, but they tasted quite good. I ordered a chicken Caesar salad, and a small piece of BBQ chicken. Both were great. You order in a box and are guaranteed to get a delicious rib rack. The ribs were a little on the dry side but they were still delicious since it didn't have the usual juiciness on most collar They are not tough and are really flavorful. The Caesar salad was a welcome addition to our evening meal. I didn't notice howggy it was, so I tried to get it off before I even took it home. So why did it taste like it had been baked? Normally that would be perfect as well then. I still don't know if they have the pizza sauce you get at Puff Daddy's across the street or the white French grit If you don't want to go all out and order a burger, you can get wings, a beer drink, beer shakes,  I had read about their food selections on a Yelp post and was excited. It was a short lunch and we didn't need to wait for too long for our food. You may see two burgers on a hot plate, but they don't say anything about it since we didn't ask any questions. There were four of us here, but I decided to have the burger. I'm not sure if the cheese would have mattered. I can't get over the flavor and texture, just not the cheese. This was the first time I experienced this issue with PB&J, so I'm not sure if that is because it's a new It's quite a bit more expensive but still tasty. I think it's more often than not "too spicy". I also love their happy hour on Sundays.

I am a huge lover of dive delis, so it was with some huge regret that I took the plunge and found, The Riptide Don't you ever think of a deli on Main Street? RDPYC is located at 111 Seaview Parkway on the east side of Charlotte. They are friendly, open minded and affordable - just like your old dive bar. I was told that the only issue we had was the server. Her name was, Susan & we were served in about 5 minutes. The food was flavorful and a nice mix of fresh (unsalted butter with a little bit of sour cream) and processed/ I started off the lunch by getting the, Dive Bar Salad. This was a small salad with arugula and a couple of other veggies that I had come prepared. Sometimes it's served with a dressing. This a pretty good choice for me. For sandwiches, the deli has 4 choices ranging from a variety of fresh fruits, vegetables and meats. It looked good, but I had wanted a bit more than half. The sandwich, is a very large, albeit thin, sandwich, with lots of toppings. One small thing I liked about this deli sandwich is it's jumbo chopped pickles with a few grilled meats and a lot The sandwich consisted of a great mix of meats, cheese and vegetables. Overall, I rate this as "By Far". Although the waitstaff is helpful, everything was delicious - but just as good as my favorite dive bar. Yes, I recommend this deli! I'll update it with photos. I will definitely go back.

What did you think of this store? I purchased dog food for my sweet boy, a 14 month old pitbull. Dogfood Mart is a top notch store at everything they do. Last Saturday (for the week after the New Year I checked in and I was told that the Fox has the largest library and is the best theater in New York Well it seemed it was my only check in. I've been hearing a lot about Randolfi's in their recent Yelp reviews. How wrong? Unfortunately, nothing could put them in the top 100. Did Ian really think that the food was worthy of the rank of #11? Yes, and it's a bit overrated by the way. Not worth #13.? Who knows? But I went there to eat with some friends. A great restaurant and I decided to try it out for dinner. My waiter was amazing, he checked your beer and wine and helped you get the right bartender. What I immediately wanted to order was something different and I had never seen an Orkney Brown Ale in the city before. I ordered an Old Fashioned, a cocktail that they called the "French-Sandwich". That was around 8pm and the bar was packed with the locals. Because the bartender asked me what dish I wanted for my meal I selected the Pappardelle. One of my favorite apps from the menu were the heirloom tomatoes and fresh red onion salad. The flavor was light and fresh with a bite of cherry. This was a fantastic salad. The dressing was very fresh and was quite tangy. I then had my signature Italian dish, the White Bolognese Pasta. The pasta was well prepared, a little salty, and the bolognese sauce was really good. I have to say this soup is soincredibly good. If I were to compare this to "nasal sauce" with an Italian sauce, then I would say more salt than I like. I ordered a small portion and loved the egg yolk. I also went with the arugula as an appetizer. Although it had a bit of acidity, it was still a delicious meal. Next, I had the Brussel sprouts. In response to Ian's recommendation, I had the Banana Cream Cheese Pie. The flavors were rich, but I love the contrast with the flavor of the berries. It was too creamy looking to be edible, but the dessert was pretty gross. My gastronomy experience in St Louis was great because of a great and positive vibe that was provided by Lt. This dessert was way better than the others. I hope I'm never in the St. Louis area again just to try this one. Not bad for a chain restaurant. This is where I will find my next Italian visit, if not ever, but should I have to visit? The menu looked so different so I had to switch dishes. I was happy to find that the place is well equipped to accommodate gluten intolerant diners. I have no idea how many times I have ordered the Spinach Salad, but I feel that it's not the best of the 2 or 3 " This was a refreshing change of pace and it was just that simple. It was the best I have had in a long time. I think it needs to be a little bigger and have more toppings due to the asian flavor.

Circus Margarita at Aventura Park has a theme of the circus world and they have three rings. The first ring is a Latin dance show, a margarita bar, and an impromptu Mexican food court for the adults I was able to try everything at Taco Circus', "circus" at the Grand Opening event. It was amazing to view the show, but I wasn't too impressed with the food. In other words, they are a fresh, and well prepared Margaritas. My Margarita was a fantastic glass--so big and rich in flavor! I may pick up the recipe for a better way to make Margaritas in the future. Both are well rounded, but I like the Mexican one because it isn't the jigsaw type of Margarita. I enjoyed the queso blanco dipping sauce. The queso is thick when you dip it into your Margarita. There were large chunks of cheese that helped with the texture of the sauce. I was surprised by the salt on them. They were delicious. - I will be back - I know I am going to order another Margarita. If you want a different take on Texas Mexican food head back to the restaurant's new concept, the Skirt Steak and Cheese. I can't emphasize enough how large this is. This can be ordered with up to 3 people and you get 12 - inch tortillas that are approximately 2" -3" thick. I liked it because the steak was tender, but not too tough. Also they serve a variety of Mexican beers. If you haven't visited, I would recommend going and checking out their new location. The place also has an old fashioned style seating area with a beautiful mural on the back wall of the bar area. I am still looking forward to having the Taco Jungle to experience before rushing off to bed. I definitely would.Learn more about the restaurant by visiting here. It's amazing.

How I feel: I have to say I prefer my healthy foods. When I am craving a dessert for dessert and I have lost a few toes I decided small size is the perfect thing to do. I love to eat eat but I am not very good at balancing myself between calories and sugar. I just can't handle a giant slab of sugary custard. When I left St. Clair last summer, I went to Ted's. I just moved to Godfrey and a little places like Andy's aren't really my thing. I'm not going to lie, I didn't care for Ted. They all were talking about how the new custard stand will be located closer to Ted. They had told me that their custard would be closer to Andy but that I could buy the quality custard there. I could not believe they are so near me and so close to Godfrey. To be honest it's almost 2 miles from me, but it's so close to me. I have only been in their store 6 days but I already love it. All of their treats are incredible. However, that is not the only specialty treat. I love the little sweet treat inside the custard, they have many flavors. Most of their drinks/sandwiches are delicious, and even the Chocolate Cupcakes and Chocolate Milk Tea do not come up on my list. I love the staff here. The customer service is top notch and the staff are nice and nice. The store is clean and well decorated. They are the closest store I will ever go to. If you like to taste some of the great custard you will want to come back soon. Who knows, probably more. But I'll definitely be back.

My good friend Mac got us seated at their new location on National Cheeseburger Day. This past weekend, Mac's was celebrating the Grand Opening. Mac Bartolomeo announced in his burger blog that they opened a new location on Broadway between Broadway Avenue and South Main Street. Great cheeseburgers by some of the best minds in Charlotte. A big change in the appearance of this restaurant has been the selection of burgers, which are incredibly fresh and different. The beer list was great for the Grand Opening weekend. There are actually four ovens in the grill. I didn't have to wait. We were lucky to have time to wait. You can just sit out on the patio and enjoy a great, homemade smashburger for $6.99. The staff was very nice and had a great time. I had to order my favorite burger... the Lumberjack. The burger was a classic. It's a standard burger. This burger is incredibly simple to make, with only the most basic ingredients. On the side of my burger I liked the jumbo sweet potato fries too. Toppings may have changed, but they're still great burgers. It was easy to find with the large sign on the back wall, and they gave away a free copy of their new beer flyer. They were able to deliver them while my husband was eating, which was a nice touch. On the same note, order your burritos right away. We had a great time. - Yes, I'm a burger addict. I'm with you! Make it worth your while!

When I visited St Louis this past weekend, I had a short stint on the Historic Trail to look around the city. At the Bellefontaine Cemetery, there is a tour available that begins one hour before a visit, starting at 11 am and ending at 3 pm All of the grave markers are about 4 feet tall. The entry fee was $4.95 for a booklet. The tour is a free experience. There was an optional grave marker tour, which was awesome. I can understand why this place is famous and not all of the people on there are American. They also have some grave marker prices for $3, but you won't find out for sure unless you see some of the names in the book. The only thing the booklet doesn't show you are other people's grave markers along the route. You also will get a look at the hard work and dedication of those who fought and the sacrifice that was made to help them get there. Our tour took a total of three days. I've seen the same thing going on over the years in other cemeteries for sure. I will try to pay attention to what others do and make sure I see some of the historical figures. Not only can you get insights on the lives of those who've been buried, but they can also teach you a little bit about your own family If you find yourself buried in any of these cemeteries, stop by and read the little booklet that offers you insight into the people buried there. There is a lot of variety and the cemetery is very clean.

The manager was very friendly and introduced me to the Banana Milk shake. The portions are huge and I think I was able to put a full order in to fit a single person. My husband shared a banana shake and my partner just finished his breakfast.

For those of you that don't know Costco is the largest grocery store in the world. The prices, the quality of the food and the variety in their shop are second to none. Costco is one of our staple stores because of the large selection of meats that are made on site. There's a large selection of organic fruits and vegetables, so there's not even one supermarket that I frequent. The electronics section is an easy hit and they have a ton of tech and electronics products at amazing low prices. I've been going there a couple times and it is amazing. Whether you are looking for jeans and a t-shirt, or a designer clothing item, Costco has it. There are a few specials for the holidays. The prices are pretty low too, and you can save money.

I've been printing on the internet for quite some time now, but The Ink Spot, has the best customer service, compared to all the I have used them multiple times and have been in many different situations where, I need some custom printed items. Everything I've done and been done there, I have been completely satisfied. Their cards are beautiful and they print by the quarter page. They are super fast allowing you to get right to the print right away. Their price is so affordable that the end results are well worth the money. Everything is done at a timely manner and I highly recommend this company. I give them 5 stars. Yes, I will! It's a great place that you can drop in if you are in the area.

What was right in their parking lot? The answer is Fields Foods. I stopped in at FF this morning for lunch and decided not to go to both. I'll be able to have an FF lunch for the next day. I love Whole Foods, but they aren't my go to on any of my lunches. I visited FF last week and it was just as good as I expected. The store was opened earlier this week and was very busy and I'm looking forward to eating at FF at lunch on Saturdays versus my "work I ordered a plate of Fresh Orzo Salad, a Plate of Kale Salad and a Plate of Green Bean Salad. The Oats were fresh and the Pork was moist. The Pork tenderloin is prepared with salt and pepper, and also has a garlic powder. At lunchtime I was browsing the dessert section with my colleagues. And what a treat; we scooted over a few other aisles to take those sweet treats. As one co-worker explains, “Let us take some food off our plate!” I got so excited to get to go into the store and Some people at work may not be used to the feeling of buying treats from the dollar store, but these cupcakes were very good. The grocery store is not yet open, although it is already well planned and prepared. Those treats were great. The store is open to walk-ins.

The Seattle Island Pike Brewing Crew holds an upscale event called "Side-of-the-Pie" at their Brewing facility. There were about 30 people at the meeting, with each one celebrating in a different way. Many people started drinking at our party, because the beer was so good that the kids had to ask for more. We all said "Y" to the "spirit of Christmas" and a nice "we're all together" sign as we left. My cousins were all ready with a beer and we all spent a good amount of time together enjoying beer. In this photos, we walked in for the pretzels and a beer of our choice. My cousin got a Bavarian Pie and they both looked good. This was followed by a Large Hot Dog Bar with Hamburger and Fresh Fruit Fleas, and finally the Chicken Fleas. Frog Legs were delicious, but the waitress was kind of aggressive when she told me she froze them so that I wouldn't be  I think they should have been bigger. They were probably a little more flavorful. The Chili also had many delicious spices and flavor. Besides that great trio, we had a few more dishes to share. I must say that the Mussels was excellent. They come out of the shell very quickly and the broth itself is good, it made me think about how I could have just made them to go on a I could order them every day and they are definitely worth a visit. They aren't a huge order and the server was great, it was just to satisfy that need. The prices were reasonable enough, and all the beers were awesome. The atmosphere was fantastic, everyone was really friendly and chatted away.

Jimmy, thank you so much!!! We went to Jimmy's for Sunday brunch with Brad and Jillian. We were there Saturday night for the second time, and decided on "Jimmys" for brunch. Even though I'm more of a meat food lover than a wine and spirits lover, I still love to eat good food. This was a good restaurant, but definitely worth going to if you are looking for a relaxing and beautiful place to eat. The windows bring out the warm light which was perfect. A large piano played the harp as we waited for our entrees. You could also hear the music while they played "News and World Music". One of the highlights of our meal was an old favorite Bloody Mary. They had no complaints! They offered a variety of mimosas on their sangria menu too. The Bellini went great with our Bloody Mary. All of them were great. I ordered one of each chicken dish (salmon, chicken breast, Brussels sprouts and creamed spinach). Both were made to order and were a great addition to our plate. They were also the best meal we've had in a long time. Our entrees varied depending on the type of Benedict we were ordering. I enjoyed the Spinach Artichoke Benedict. The spinach was cooked through with just the right amount of cheese and garlic. The bacon was thin and the cheese was buttery. We are still having such great breakfast. There was a delicious selection of dessert. Jimmy you deserve a long stay, you rock and I hope to see you here again soon. You have my business.

I was very impressed with Peking Lake. I went on a casual park day on a sunny spring evening and it was perfect for a picnic. The playhouse and picnic areas have clean umbrellas and benches. I had some friends come in and enjoy a warm afternoon while we were waiting. Great park at a great price. The parking was clean with not only plenty of space, but lots of space to spread out and park. If you have kids then the park is perfect for a game of pick-up Soccer or baseball and a picnic. The dog park is on the same block from the park, and it is very close. If needed, I would highly recommend this park. Please take a couple of minutes to stop by the park, say hello and say Hi.

I had the pleasure of going to Straub's last week. The meat counter was a major asset to my health. Straub's is a great meat counter. It is definitely worth the drive. Straub's is also the only meat counter in the CWE that does not use antibiotics, and you always need good reason to love them. The preparation section is very extensive, I would highly recommend both the deli section and the prepared foods section. Straub's deli is among my favorite items and the deli has a wonderful selection of prepared foods. I like every day products here, I always have them out. And they have a wide variety of produce. They have a great selection of frozen fruits and vegetables, and vegetables from their gardens. Over the years I have been thrilled with their products. I stopped by to pick up some kale and was amazed and pleased but this is not a glitzy deli. I'm always asking for recommendations and never leave unanswered. Their fresh fruits are a must stop and I've been known to try and eat some out with my father. The employees are always friendly and the building has a great feel. Straub's has had a "BBQ" at several locations in the CWE, but their BBQ will always be the center of all events They also have a very large Sunday brunch. Been to Straub's and know what is in there.

We had breakfast at SWD this morning. SWD's own George O. immediately sent me to their website to order their new SWD Sausage Patties. George O. was very excited and the rest is history. This is a dish we will definitely be ordering often. They are like that nip and tuck between the biscuits and gravy and make for a great breakfast side dish. I didn't know SWD had made their own pork sausage in place of the cheaper brand pork sausage I have been used to from grocers. I will be ordering their "Girlfriend's Special" on Saturday. At SWD they have added a new dish on their menu called Grits on Fire. According to George O. I was very disappointed because I like grits. Grits on Fire is a must have with my pho day. The overall flavor of this dish was a bit soggy, but then that is what you expect when you pay this much for a food truck. They were also proud to share that they were the owner of the "Hot Dog House" in Casco Bay. You won't disappointed!

I went to the Texas Johansen's in Oklahoma City Tuesday morning. Today's shopping trip turned out a little different. So it's only right that Taco Tuesday opened its new store this morning. I was pleasantly surprised. While the produce department is still huge, for a $6 dollar order I was able to get a 2 lb. apple is only $2.20. A huge selection of honey crisp apples for $8.99. I love to find a good deal like this so it's always a good thing. And for the same price a bag of berries for $10. Most of the shelves are open and bright-colored. It's nice to finally be able to go into a great neighborhood grocer. My kids still go there for their shopping. TJ is a real win for shoppers looking for a big, fresh produce and wine stores.

I went to a bar in Waterloo that didn't get crowded. I was seated in a booth. I must admit I was at the restaurant two days before my birthday, but maybe I'm not that lucky. No wait for our drinks, we made it in 15 minutes. We both had burgers, which we thought was really nice. My co-worker suggested the martini. It was the first drink we decided to try so I don't have much experience drinking vodka. My friends had some drinks at our table, two drinks on a round of drinks and a smaller bottle of Vodka (the bottle was a I ended up asking my friend to try the Margarita, she seemed impressed by it. Meatball sandwich was great, I had two pieces, one with hummus and the other was a pepperoni and cheeseburger. We then started the food. They all came with soup, salad, burger and cheese, I choose the Szechwan, I thought they were ok. The wings were great, the chicken was moist and flavorful, and the toppings were just salty enough. The Loaded Fries was really good, i don't remember how flavorful they were. The Nachos were not worth the money, they were soggy, but I don't mind the fillings being well-done. Our waitress had the most fun, she made drinks with us as we moved to see the menu. She was able to handle our group and was very helpful in the evening. Also I learned this place was really busy because our table had been taken back and it was not clear, so I left when I saw a bartender That's where the great part comes in. There was no crowd, and I enjoyed my lunch. I'll definitely return to try other lunch items in the future.

On Tuesday, the 4th of August I did all kinda thing. My oldest friend, her best friend, and three other ladies decided that it would be fun for us to meet up to celebrate her birthday. So, we were excited to go and check out the Yelp reviews. I walked in like usual, had some drinks, and received a few tapas. It was like ordering a glass or two from your favorite restaurant at home! The staff was very welcoming. They gave us a little taste of all of their drinks and let us pick based on their recommendations. I ended up getting the Wine Pairings and was impressed. I felt like I was buying at Basso, but it was an awesome bar. At Basso, I always make my friends feel welcome, they want to keep the conversation going. Basso is a laid back place. It makes it a lot of fun to be in here and chat about other things. On the patio you have a big table to watch the game on and the music is great. I can't tell you how many times I stopped here to enjoy an iced coffee, beers at the bar or check in. The pizzas are made on the premises and everything looks amazing. I won't go into details because these were everything I wanted. These are the original and it was so good. For dessert, we ordered the Black Cauliflower. These were great as well. They also had an awesome roasted cornbread as well!

Shoe Warehouse is an amazing shoe store. Cole Haan is an excellent store for shoes and boots. All of my favorite Cole Haan women's shoes and boots. They make some very beautiful boots and I love the wedge style. It is always clean and has that Cole Haan feel. You can get them here and it's not expensive! Most lace shops only sell shoe lace, and if you buy lace you almost always have to make one extra thread so that you can finish your Cole Haan always ships the laces to me as he says it is their "in fact, we sell shoe laces". So if you want to get your shoes ready for the weather, you can choose from all of the colors with laces or you can pick a color I would always shop here when I was little because most of their shoes are so cute, you will also have a hard time finding a decent pair of I have a pair of their "Rebecca" slippers that I'd like to find a resole so I don't have Besides, its like reading any woman's books. I am currently in the process of getting these shoes to go. I walked into a pair of the "Lion" because I was looking for something a little more formal for my day of business. I love the colors, the shape, the width, the style. I highly recommend this store.

Thanks to Town & Country on 10th Avenue for having such a great shopping experience. Each of their stores is unique and delicious. There are many similarities. It is larger than the Brentwood Whole Foods. The selection is wonderful and the staff is knowledgeable and courteous. It is the most beautiful store. It's a good place to start out, but also entice me to stop. The stores are large. The food selection at this store is fantastic. You get to feel the good feeling as you walk into this store every time you walk in. It's a good place to shop to enjoy the freshness paired well with the flavor. With the TV in the kitchen, I am constantly looking for something to eat while shopping. I am not a big wine drinker but I can say that they are of the highest quality. There's a good amount of employees who have a variety of jobs at Town & Country but each has a little something special to offer. I had to come back and ask more questions while buying some of the products just to pick up where I left off. They've even told me something I may not have considered ordering before. I always shop here.

It was a busy week for me after work on the week, but hey I'd be working on the weekend before tomorrow and the opening of King The Diner is located in the chess board area. This new bar and snack area opened at the end of March with happy hour specials. They also offer chicken and waffles on lunch Tuesdays and Thursdays. Their breakfast offered four choices. I had the Chicken Stuffed Breakfast Quesadilla for breakfast. These were excellent.Their prices are great and the quality is great too. The omelette itself was really very flavorful and it really surprised me the texture it had. It took only a few minutes, even though they were half off but it wasn't too long before they brought out the biscuits and gravy. I had the sweet pickle, cheese and chorizo. The biscuit was not tooggy and luscious and with the cheese, we had plenty of gravy. My only complaint is that the biscuits weren't a big enough quantity so I could only eat a handful. Also on the menu is the "Burrito". The blue cheese & tomato is a perfect combination with a side of bacon and the burger can be used with all the toppings or with the That one, but the Turkey, Cactus and Cheddar Sandwich is my next favorite. The breakfast is on Tuesdays, but have you heard about their Sunday Specials? I also know I will be having the turkey salad this winter since it's been a long time since I've had the holiday before.

I came to Anna's in June 2012 in search of the basics for my home. - If there even was any reason that I would have chosen to buy this place, it was because of Anna's. They have some beautiful home decor. Anna has a very extensive collection of linens all at very reasonable prices (as high as $18 per day). Anna's is a very small store. Some of the brands are from the US, and you will have to search. I also visited and was turned off by the prices. There was no a large selection of home decor, the only items are quilts, rugs, and decor. However, they do have Egyptian cotton bedding sets, but you can buy additional matching pillowcases out of an additional $20 a piece. I did see they offered a couple of different size sheets in a variety of weights. Very strange.. But they are there to improve a small space. The woman helping me with the purchase really did help me. They also have a small gift shop for gift giving. She does not sell home furniture, and she does not speak perfect English, but that is why she is there. They were very knowledgeable about the products available & what is out of stock, which I was not aware of. Anna's should be a must shop and I would recommend it to everyone.

On my last visit a friend and I were in San Antonio, and stopped by Cantina Laredo, since it was Clayton Restaurant Week weekend To celebrate this month's CRW, I was so excited to try out Casa Rita Mexican Grill, one of the many restaurants taking advantage of it At the end of the week my CRW friends were invited to dinner at this restaurant, as you can read in the reviews. It was a great selection, but I did want to keep it on my radar. A great place to be. Food was great and the salsa was delicious. I thought it was a great deal, because we were only 3pm. I love the spicy salsa, it is so refreshing. For dinner we ordered a Shrimp Guacamole soup filled with shrimp, marinara sauce, and a side of chips along with  I ordered a large Queso and asked them to split it. I ordered a small and ended up with just over 1 cup. Just like me, I like a good meal with two sides, so I wouldn't want to eat too much. I ordered the Chicken Tacos. They were crisp inside and they were hot. The Nachos were delicious, lots of tortillas. I also ordered the Salmon tacos with a side of shrimp fajitas, I didn't really like the shrimp, but they My other meal choice was the Pork with Torte de Chile and Lime Rice. I didn't enjoy it very much, my husband likes it a lot. I won't be ordering it again, because the rice wasn't that good. I'll be back again soon. After the Salmon dish, I ordered the Nachos. The Chunky, sweet Chipolas made of grilled chicken, red onions with ranch sauce & dipped in chocolate and strawberry sauce. I'm so glad it was served in an extra egg shell. I'm not sure if it had anything to do with the mango, but it tasted great. This was a great experience from beginning to end. All food was delicious and the drinks were fantastic. This was the second time I was here, so the second time I might return. Let us know in the comments. I think they're really good.

Thank you so much for sharing your experience with us. This post is a quick update, but you need to understand costco!!! I can't believe it's been almost three years since I have been a customer of Costco. In fact, my family gets a lot of gas from Costco, which makes driving to Costco way easier. It is also the only place I get my oil changed at. My second thing I want to see is their liquor section. I like getting a good beer at a fair price and going out to drinks on a date night. And the prices are not that different at all. We have yet again enjoyed our first bottles of both brands! We go here every holiday season, just to stock up on everything we will need! Costco has good frozen yogurt. I absolutely love Costco meat section. I always go for pork tenderloin puffs with extra bacon, which save me a few dollars. They also have good meats that sell for about $5 on the shelves. I have also been here many times, just shopping there, just to try new things. Using Costco, I save money on my groceries. We do a lot of purchasing at Target, Target, Wal Mart and even Bed Bath & Beyond. Costco offers multiple selections and has always been the best deal at the store. The whole place always looks cleaned up especially when I walk in. Most of their prices are pretty good. They also clean everything up very well, so it's a great place to go every day. It is definitely a store that we will be checking out again.

I hosted my two day Moulin conference at the new Chouteau restaurant located on the campus of Southern Illinois University. I must say Moulin handled the event with style and professionalism, just like they treat their employees. Because of the room's large size, the space was extremely narrow for the entire conference - one or two tables would easily be filled with attendees. While you might have seen the word "acoustics" in a few of the images shared on Twitter and I'm not sure what else it The air conditioning was very efficient and the sound from the speakers throughout the room was crystal clear and so relaxing. The conference took place in a beautiful location with beautiful views of downtown Montreal and the Quebec City area. The first day's food was delicious as everyone was given a chance to sample the sandwich options at Moulin. It was an enjoyable lunch to share and everyone had great food. The wraps were always great for lunchtime. For dinner the attendees ate the salads provided by Moulin. Despite being under 50 with half the menu not being as filling, I opted for a Salad Bar. There were also a variety of hot dish options. All these wonderful dining experiences made for a memorable meal and the conference that followed. The venue itself was nice and the price is less than ideal, but would I go again? We'll be back.

One of our favorite buildings in downtown STL, The Soldiers Memorial was built in 1910 and never opened to the public. After seeing a picture of this place I knew I had to stop to see it. The Soldiers Memorial (St. Louis Soldiers Memorial) was only a stop on my trip to central Missouri, but I got to see it. The Soldiers Memorial is actually a war memorial; it is a replica of an actual war memorial; and it is filled with medals and items that This is one of the best museums I've seen. My mistake..I will admit it took me some time to figure out where to go. Today I had a good time visiting.

Stinger's and Grill, located in downtown Cahokia and a quick drive from the mall, was a perfect place for my friends I have been to Stinger's about four times on friends birthdays and family get togethers. I walked into Stinger's on Saturday because I was planning a birthday party for my friend, Tom, who was getting married in a week At the party we had a party size to be shared between two to three people. Stinger's was just down the road with a few doors, from the shopping center and down the road from the University of Pittsburgh. You do get a buffet for your birthday and other events. The buffet consisted of a variety of bread, salads, pizzas and salads, with a lot of choices. I must mention the salad was made with tomato, fresh mozzarella, olive oil and a large fresh green salad. Mostaccioli was a simple crusty pizza like you eat at your neighborhood pizza place or you make it yourself. It didn't need much salt and pepper and you could add anything to it to customize it. I ordered the pizza, which consisted of a thin cheese pizza. I had the tomato crust (I love the thin crust), pepperoni, and basil. We went together, but it was the pizza that really caught my attention, being perfect. The menu is small, but there were several quality items to choose from. The food was good, the service was excellent and I would plan on returning to this spot for lunch next time. Stinger's Is A Must Visit for anyone in the Cahokia area. Well, you should too.

I frequent this stores at least once a week. I still enjoy their selections and food. I usually stop in either evening, during the week, or on the weekends to meet my friends, shop for specials or try new restaurants. I like the selection of produce, salads and other healthy items there. As an aside, with all the new products, I am not sure why I haven't updated the reviews or gotten more information. The produce is always a bargain, which is a plus because when I am on a diet, there is a pretty good choice of fresh produce There is a nice selection of beer selection in a small freezer. I would also say, the hot bar is quite nice! I highly recommend Fields Foods. I can't recommend Fields enough. Yes and the staff is always helpful. I definitely will!More restaurants a day?

The vets here are real, and genuinely care for your pet's health. The office is small, which gives most of the patients plenty of room to adjust to the different surroundings. They truly care for their pets. All the equipment is in-house and not used outside. The staff is very nice and helpful. They have one of the best receptionists I have ever dealt with. They are helpful and polite. The staff is friendly and all the techs are very experienced. I had multiple issues and they did a thorough exam and a detailed examination of her. The staff is friendly, and not just for the big dogs. This place is a quick service. This means they really get busy. When the vet asks if it's ok to schedule your appointment, they give you the date and time and then you know, the next slot When: January 22, 2019 Why: GOD chose this doctor for his dog. Yes..I do! Hope to one day.

I've been a fan since my college days. The theme of the event was "Trust Me, Your Life IS My Life." We're a part of the Meals On Wheels program, which is an incredible charity and a great cause. This was my final stop during my night in Cincinnati. If you're in the Phoenix area, get out and support the program at Planter's House today. Luckily, Paula and I had the chance to meet for dinner. Love a good cocktail, so we ordered a few. This was one of my favorite cocktails of the evening and I was so happy to get the taste of the Slope instead of the regular Margarita. That rye flavor was good, but not enough to make the Slope an Outstanding cocktail. I was so glad our friends gathered and we went into meal mode with a couple of salads. First of all I was told that Strawberry Salad served with a sweet mayo, was only $4. The Salad was like a good slaw-to- salad salad. It was made with their fresh strawberries and was topped with the Greek dressing to give it a sweeter flavor. I didn't get the cucumbers, but the berries were delicious. I have to admit the salad was quite different than typical Mediterranean based dressings. The texture had great texture and I always like to get fresh fruit from my plants when I get around. Afterwards, Max and I ordered another cocktail. It's an interesting cocktail because there were two distinct drinks. It's a drink that's also made from fresh strawberries. I used up some of my free samples since my last stop and it was nice to take advantage. I'm impressed with the cocktail drinks here. After ten+ hours of the night and two martinis, I was leaving planter's house full and not only full of delicious food, What not to love? What: Drinks at Planter's House? The prices are decent and the service is great.

The chicken breast we ordered is simply a winner in my book. Their chicken wing is an amazing treat. The chicken is coated with breadcrumbs while inside it is cooked to perfection through a slow frying process. This chicken comes with a side of rice or a side of kale. They know the way to do it. The potatoes were seasoned well with salt and pepper, even the blemishes on the sides were a touch sweet. The gravy is so rich and there are no side dishes to cut, that I could pass on. The biscuit and gravy was a little overcooking, and then we had the green beans, which were awesome! I had the whole chicken and it was truly as good as it looks on the outside. The ribs were not as tough as a rack, but they were still tender. One of the ribs I enjoyed was covered up in gravy and so rich. The ribs were sliced very thinly, so they could be cut as quickly as desired. I haven't been to the Piccadilly in a while, but I have been to one of the other nearby restaurants and had  We got 3 onion rings for an extra $1. The onion rings were delicious and seasoned perfectly. If people had a choice they would be fried until they were just a bit crisp to the touch. We decided to share a couple glasses of red wine, but just to be safe, we didn't really drink it before. The OD ordered the Man-n-Cheese, which was what I call "man-n-cheese". They have been baking these kind of cheeses recently at Piccadilly and I'm really impressed. The mac and cheese was very tasty and the sides were perfect. I would not bring it back down there to eat, but I should. It was pretty busy at lunchtime, at least by our usual hour, but we were treated like we were neighbors. Of course I wasn't the only one that wanted to eat there. They even took the opportunity to introduce to us the owner of the restaurant. Her name is Jane and she had gone to The Landady one day when there was NO restaurant. My friend, who lives on the corner, told us, "I guess the whole town will finally come. This was the best dinner I have ever had.

My previous review for this location is in the July issue of Ease of Living. I've yet to experience the burgers that Billy G's Kirkwood provides. I went to Billy G's while I was shopping in Kirkwood last weekend. If you have not traveled yet, keep in mind that the burgers here are from the same deli and they are better than Joey's. I'm really happy I took a chance out in Kirkwood. There was a few tables in the front and a big open space at the back, so it was just comfortable for lunch and dinner. The coffee was great, the brew was made to order, and the patio setting was perfect. My main food came out of the kitchen in about 30 minutes. They made my burger fresh, was perfect in every way, was incredibly easy to order, and was the perfect amount of meat, cheese and sauce. I didn't have any sauce to give it, you'd think that a burger could get too heavy but it wasn't. The food was so good and just right for my diet. It was good enough for me to order the whole thing to go, a meal that I would definitely make at home. I'll be back to try the burgers on their next menu next time I'm in the area.

My daughter had her first Stein Mart and I went to her last one in Rock Hill. But a couple days ago I noticed that they moved to the South Carolina location in Spartanburg. Initially, I was hesitant because the store was located at the outlet mall, but now, once I've visited, I enjoy it. I can be assured that you will end up shopping with a great experience, and not just a bunch of things you can use up and then throw out I've spotted shirts from Michael Kors, Disney clothing, and The American Eagle's shirt selection. You may even notice all the discount clothes were on sale here. This particular store may do this only a bit, but it is worth checking out. I am never disappointed, I will definitely be returning to Stein Mart to purchase some of my closet items. For example, if you are looking for a nice mug or a nice cup, I definitely wouldn't head to the outlet mall. As a newbie, the cost is not that great and, I think they are made of crystal that is quite beautiful. So, if you are a wine drinker and enjoy a nice glass of wine, try a few with you next visit. I wish there was a Stein Mart in the area I would go to more often to browse what they have in stock, or find items I have forgotten.

We found Byrd & Barrel on my walk on the West Coast after moving to Phoenix. I used to think that fried chicken was just a big deal. Although, I could easily agree. With any luck I might be the last. So much so that since we love all things fried chicken, we decided to eat here, while walking around the neighborhood. On the first night of my birthday last week, we went out at byrd & barrel and decided to visit. I was invited by my husband to celebrate my birthday. We arrived at the restaurant at 11:45 pm on a Tuesday. It was a great lunch we had at this restaurant. The bar is nice and the wine list is good. We ordered the Fried Chicken Skins and the South Side Poutine. The Fried Chicken Skins were actually a bad batch. Like any other fried chicken Skins, they didn't have any original flavor and they were a bit sweet, too much milk and too much cheese So let's order the South Side Poutine. It was delicious with the southern seasoning. I love that these are served in a small dish with a side of onion mashed potatoes. I was so pleased to try all the dishes that I ordered myself. We also ordered some fun craft cocktails. I ordered the Driskill Red Rum. The drink had some amazing flavor. No one would guess that my cocktail had been topped with any substance that could be thrown about in the kitchen if it was left unseasoned. We all love specialty cocktails and that was the key to a wonderful lunch! So good!... a very solid bar! As an appetizer we ordered the wings and chicken strips.
