We have been going to Panda Pavilion regularly since it opened. The first item we ordered from Pan Asian was our Moo Shu Pork (Chinese Pork Tikka). We started out with Moo Shu Pork, Fried Rice and a Crab Rangoon. The Moo Shu Pork was extremely tender. They had a nice flavour to them. I had a great server with lots of friendly conversations. Unfortunately, the Moo Shu Pork was really good and I do not feel like I took away any fillings for the egg rolls, but still the I hope to visit them more often.

We went to KI&F last week, for dinner and I am glad we ate there, it is what we were looking for. As a customer, having read about them a few years ago, I was a little nervous, but so is your average customer, you are expecting This was the last day we had to leave for an important conference after breakfast. It was just getting late. So, we decided to sit down at an interesting spot to eat lunch. Kirkwood Ice & Fuel, really offers some great decor and the bar and grill was very nice. The show "The & U" on Animal Planet was great, I think the hosts were really entertaining. We headed there early, which is not a bad thing at all, because I love watching sports. I am not sure, would they provide subtitles for some of the games, but then again, I am not a huge fan of having no subtitles However, that wasn't the main reason I wanted to give them 5 stars. We decided as the main course we were going to have chicken wings. The wings were great. They are served as a 2 part roll you take off the stick, this also means you get a little of a mess with your mouth, hands No problem, they tasted great, moist and seasoned just right. I would order these again, but I like wings that are crisp on the outside. This makes KI&F one of our regular places to go when on the go. We both did medium rare. These made my friends mouth water with their awesome cheese. They have a little taste of American cheese as well, but nothing to write home about. We enjoyed the extra cheesy sauce. We all really enjoyed these burgers and I think they're right at the top of their list. We ordered their newest special to start - they had 3 types of burgers and two different sauces. We decided to have some side dishes. When you sit at their restaurant, you can ask each guest to please share their thoughts. We really wanted to try the fries, but they offered up all different kinds of fries. They added a special side of onions, which I never thought would come back. They were a good size, but the quality was average. They are seasoned excellently on all sides, not overly salty and not too salty. They was not too salty like some other ice & fuel restaurants. We wanted to try to get in a few more of the sports bar food of the day and KI&F got us in with a great lunch The only complaint I had was their cheese was so soggy, which made me want the extra food.

Today I shared my favorite beef sandwich on the Fast Food Network. One of the biggest benefits of going to Lion's Choice is the beef quality. Arby's is a more expensive Fast food sandwich and is incredibly overseasoned. Last night my husband and I found some great free coupons for that day. We always pass on Arby's and always go to Lion's until someone else brings it home. We made a deal of it and I went to Lion's Choice (Richmond at 1601 E. 98th Street). They offered a variety of breads to choose from, including a smoked bread that was more tender. Our favorite dishes were the thin fries. All of our favorite quick food French fries are crisp and tender with no oily residue. It gives the fries a real garlic flavor. We got them with a scoop of buttery ranch. We did not bring home many items but we did leave with an order of sweet treats. My kids were incredibly excited to get their chocolate shakes from the menu. The milk shakes are topped with a mint frosted cream cheese, and the cookies are topped with chocolate chip cookie pieces. Both cakes look so good in the picture they are served warm and the macadamia nut cookies were a perfect way to finish off our dinner

On my way to the mall, I was stopped inconveniently by a large crowd of patrons. However, the manager was very helpful and friendly. I was hoping the new location would still be open for business, but the store itself was full of chocolates. Her employee, Beth, was excellent at finding what I needed and gave me very good suggestions. She was not judgmental and provided a solid shopping list of what I wanted to buy. She even had an attitude about being a salesperson, not just a customer. So if I am ever in the local mall, I will stop by Godiva and say "I love you" because this was a very special experience Godiva is a member of my local mall, the Godiva Center. I know there are some people who really love Godiva, but I think this company is doing great. Godiva is now on my list of stores to go to for Christmas gifts.

When: July 21, 2018 Why: Stopped here before because I thought there was something too weird about it, plus the menu looked super small. I didn't make an effort to go when I found the place since the menu was only Korean. I love the decor, the taste and the decor. It almost felt like you were dining in a restaurant. There is a good list of dishes, and some items were specials. They even delivered the food via bus, which was super nice. I came here for the Sliders. The onion and the cheese was nice and thick and the chicken was moist. The Hawaiian roll blew me away, because they're a little bigger then most. They had a sweet taste to them and we agreed when the fries were finished they were very good, too. These are very easy to make and are pretty good - the meat is perfectly cooked to perfection. For my side of fries, they were served on a huge hot roll. As I was leaving for our dinner at Vista, I gave a thought to my brother, he had a cheeseburger. I like cheeseburgers and it was delicious. The burger was incredibly tasty. It was the best burger I've ever had. My friends also noticed the freshness of their food, which was always a treat on a warm summer day. This meal was full of flavor and fun, so I decided I had to get one of the drink specials. The Pink Lady, with the bourbony, citrus, and bitter blackberry. The beer was really good, but the cocktail was my favorite. I don't know what to say. The Service was so friendly, it was a really great experience, I would come back again. If you're wanting an amazing Mexican fusion meal, I would definitely check this place out.

Today, is the 58th day in St. Louis. It all began as a restaurant in the neighborhood called Wine & Spirits. Among local St. Louis food lovers, I've had dinners or meals here - and have never been disappointed with their service or food. As long as the food is good they'll keep it that way. I decided to be prepared for a "fish & chips" option when I arrived. I had found a few reviews. As I've mentioned a few times, I don't tend to drink much alcohol since I’m on the go and I usually don’t I know the regulars deem it's not available. My friend took me to the bar. When I arrived at the restaurant (7:30 PM), my plate had arrived. The food was just as good as my previous dinner there. The Manhattan was my go to for the weekend. The Shrimp Cake was moist; but tasty. I wasn't able to finish it. Then I ordered the Fish & Chips. I was expecting something jerky, but was very surprise when my plate arrived. I've had similar fish (such as the a variety of cod (ie, wilted and wild) on tap for years. This was unique.It's kind of like, the classics and that's why it's good. So, for the rest of March, I'll have to pass by this one. I loved every aspect of it and can't wait to try more. I then read the fine print and ordered the Fish & Chips - Small Plate - a little different than I'd expected. I can't let shoes get in the way of enjoying a great meal, and I thought, ok, I'll get to do that. My partner had his; Beef Chowder served with the Fish & Chips. Their baked potato was perfect for this. Slaw - This is a must. I gave this place five stars. After my meal, we sat at the outdoor bar, with the beautiful decor & the good ol' friendly service. I couldn't believe my eyes when I left. Do you ever get the fish & chips? Yes.) and not to eat with a group. I'll be back soon.
Great sports stadium. It holds over 5,500 people. Thanks for your review of the movies at Cinemas.

La-Z-Boy just introduced me to their website. We discovered that La-Z-Boy has some great deals on them. They are just down the street. La-Z-Boy is no longer the only "Choose Your Own Brand." I guess, the change has made some of the things they sell available even better. They also offer a large selection of home accents and items for the basement. I was greeted by a young lady and she was very helpful. We were both very interested in the chair shown and did not want to spend a lot on another one. We told the lady that we only wanted two. From there, if we did all 3 chairs, the sale price was $2,000 for the three chairs. They were around $2,000 but you can add shipping and tax to the sale. When we returned to the car to receive the discount, I was surprised there was no delivery charge. After having taken a few minutes to complete the online price. Initially, no one noticed, but as I told my wife, she was thinking. Then we asked, "What's the price of the chair??" I have been using savings from this sale so it was not too bad. I can understand why, so many of my local furniture companies charge delivery charges on items purchased over $200. If I'm paying for everything in a store with a 0% discount, I'll take it. Just get your discount up-front, and stay away from them, next time I shop there. Then give me the chance to return the chairs I picked up for free if I'm not satisfied. You should really check this place out, they are a great company to support.

The 5 Star Burgers was very easy to find. I was lucky enough to try out Culver's on the weekend to see what is now a favorite of mine. Despite it being a Tuesday in August and the fact I had forgotten to dress in my burger skirt, it was all worth it. The menu, the setting, everything that would come with a Culver's burger, was very inviting. She had a great smile and helped us to our own table. We had some drinks in hand and looked out while the windows were slowly filling. I was extremely glad that something I was never very interested in actually happened to be available. And then she came to offer our birthday party guests two sizes of shakes. The burgers were fried well done. It wasn't like everything was good - I wasn't drooling by the time I finished my shake, I was still full I had the Original Culver'sburger with a side of sweet and sour sauce. I had to give some credit to the sweet-tasting maple syrup. The BF chose the New Mexico hatch chili burger. It had a great paprika to it, and was just the thing to bring on a cold night. A total delight. We ordered the "Mom's Banana Bacon" burger. We could have easily bought those extra pounds since they were only on the specials and were out of season at the time. The bun was perfectly cooked and the fried pickles were a solid addition to these burgers. To make a long story short, we were then served a burger of Fried Pickles, which were a perfect addition to our meal. My friend ordered the Fried Pickles with a Tzatiki Sauce and my guy enjoyed the Turkey with a Tzatiki Sauce. The pickles were delicious on their own. Although we never tasted the pickles inside, it was still something I would try out again. The Sweet Potato Fries, were perfect, I was so ready for them to befried. The regular fries were a salty buttery combination. So there are a couple of options at 5 Star Burgers, but I think we'll stick to our favorites the most. The Regular Fries were seasoned well and had a bit of a kick from the Maple Cream. I could not help but think, Culver's is really just another fast food joint with table service! I am going to order another one this time. My only complaint was that the burgers were just not as fresh or as fresh as they looked on the menu. This was a little pricey, but my burger and fries were really great and even better if you get the Salted Caramel Shake It's time to try a new burger place. My only gripe when dining at 5 Star Burgers, is how long it takes to get our bill. You would never guess, a burger with a burger with a burger with a burger with a burger with a I know I'm the clumsiest of restaurants when it comes to ratings, but I found this place too good to pass up.

The new BWB is not just a sports bar. I went to Gastrobar on a whim of one of my fellow reviewers and was more than willing to give it a try. I ate lunch today. This time I was the only one there - the restaurant was packed and I tried their Cheesesteak and Garlic Parmesan Fries. The burger was luscious and perfect for an Asian meal. They took the extra effort to get the meat as thin as possible & still got good results. It's a pretty cool space in a fun neighborhood. The drinks are great from the stout beer & cocktail selection to the classic margheritas. Another thing that was neat and welcoming is the sundried tomatoes and orange dressings we brought out. I am glad I stopped by and tried their food. I'll be back and will be a regular. It is a good place for an evening drink when you need somewhere to grab a quick fix. They are open Monday-Saturday 11am-10pm. And the beer was great. Thank you for featuring our neighborhood food bar! Nope..but if you have a taste for burgers, this place looks good. Thanks.. - Yep. I'm a little lost - but I want to get back there, too!

One of a kind stores. I did not pay for recycling which I did not expect (as it only cost them $8). They charged me $1.40 to dump the bottles after making sure they were not overheated to the point of blowing into a can. My favorite place to find these fixtures. They were at a much lower price than the store retail price I would find anywhere else. I was very glad to find them. Good store..and always clean!

One of my favorite places to eat in St. Louis is Mama Josephine's. Mama Josephine's is a Southern style restaurant in St. Louis, MO. This place is located right behind the Mississippi State Fair in a downtown area called "Mrs. Jefferson" on West Jefferson Street. I found Mama Josephine's to be a unique place to eat. Although, they does offer a drive-thru experience for your order. I was so grateful to get my little girl and husband together to experience Mama Josephine's with me. I  ordered the Salad of Sweet Peas and I must tell you that it is not the tangy salad variety you see at every fast food This salad was cold so there was no iceberg and not a big chunk of iceberg, not even a little. The breading on the salad was soft and moist, and the tomatoes were a great flavor. We ordered the Meat Loaf, Chicken Fried Steak and Mashed Potatoes. It was a simple lunch and the food served was so good that I really did think that Mama's Meat Loaf was the best. Their gravy had a nice texture. I was so thankful she prepared this because I wanted to save it for later. I also found the Fried Corn with some added fat, nice touch. The Fried Corn made a great texture to put on my sandwich, not very dry but not tooggy either. As always, I enjoyed my Fried Okra and its seasoning and the battering. I would recommend this place to others and my husband will. The meatloaf had to be fried in a fried egg batter which made it dry and soggy. I have never seen a bag or package of okra in my entire life. The Fried Okra was fried in St. Louis style sauce. We chose the Southern Style Fried Okra. I was absolutely pleased! It is definitely "St. Louis style". To me this is different, I feel it is a little bit like "Bingo". I can assure you it is not from a bag (which is not what they use for their fried okra), but they definitely use their own It's definitely not a laff of fried Okra. They are prepared like a home-style restaurant so you don't have to taste any of the dressings. No need to worry about "bad" sauce or seasoning, it was delicious.

When I need a special treat of my dog, I go to Teton Valley Treats (Tucanoes). I always say I've purchased from TU. Because I get the highest quality treats available. I would highly recommend this pet store to anyone who is looking for an excellent quality treat store. I know I'll be receiving a special treat when the next box is in the mail. If you're shopping for a dog food, you need to go on their website to find just the right food. The employees have taken great care of us every time we have been shopping here. If you have a larger pet, give the associates any information they can. The prices are great and the people really help me find great affordable brands. I love TU! I trust TU to give me quality products and always offer great service. If you are looking for a treat shop that has been around for over 80 years, TU is definitely worth the stop!

JITB makes cheeseburger cheeseburgers. In fact, I even bought one there years ago. The ultimate is very simple, I am a very picky person. So I buy all the ingredients I will need. I could just eat cheese alone. Everytime I make a cheeseburger I am "a little bit more creative", but the Ultimate is my ultimate. It has cheese, olive oil, a side of cranberry sauce, pickles and cole slaw. The onion and jalapeno ring are removed, so all you need is a good old fashioned cheeseburger with all your choice of seasoning The Ultimate is $16.95. I am all about your cheeseburger! Take a minute. The chicken mayonnaise-cheese mayo mayo is what makes these a great cheeseburger!

I have a thing for Fried Pickles from The Mack. This review of The Mack changed in early September. Using the "Fried Pickles" review guide, I have determined I am not missing a great experience this past weekend at The Mack. I was very impressed by the delicious butterfat-based fried pickles. The chips are topped with a blend of salt, pepper, black beans and onions and are dipped in a brown gravy-like sauce All you need is two to try them! At $.45 for two chips, this is worth the effort.

Are you looking for a quick, cheap, and delicious Friday Fish Fry? This was the last one of theirs this year and I'm pleased to say, this was my favorite Friday Fish Fry-ever for me. This meal was a bit different than what you'd commonly find at a church or an annex. They also offer a wide variety of fish options, which is nice on a Friday evening. They do not use white fish, but instead, they take up to an hour to bake this side dish. There was some variety to choose from, such as a variety of fried fish (their baked fish were the most unique). The cornmeal dogs were a nice touch, they melted in my mouth and I loved the texture of the cornmeal. My Hush Puppies were served with ketchup and ketchup, which were excellent. I ordered an extra side, which I ordered with a side of vegetables. You got a choice between hot sauce, green cheese, or white. And, with no salt added, I was hoping to use it as a mealtime snack throughout Lent. The food was served to a limited capacity, and the place was very clean and inviting. You can choose from a variety of toppings, with either a chocolate chip cookie or a mix of chocolate chips and chocolate milk, like the Chocolate I had the chance to sample their craft beer. They also offered an on-site patio. In between all of the diners, the restaurant was open for music. The singer was friendly and took his time in singing throughout our dinner. This is one of those venues that I recommend to everyone. The food sat hot and flavorful with just the right amount of bacon flavor, I'd definitely choose this next time one of the local events. Yes, yes, I will probably be back at some point. For a more formal experience, the host also offered a variety of beer and wine for purchase. Thank you for making me feel like "home" again!

I went to Canyon Cafe for dinner during the weekend. As a food writer, the Canyon Cafe was one of my all-time favorite places to eat in Montreal. I had heard they were closing and wanted to give it a try. During my recent trip to the area to spend time with my boys, I was so excited to have this new place open. The food at Casa del Mar was just awful. I will admit, they had some good points from the time I ordered and made them in time for an afternoon lunch. Not even a waitress at the bar. There is a bar in the front of the restaurant with a very friendly bartender. I was greeted by a helpful bartender that was not only a lot more friendly that I first met in Canyon Cafe. A cynical waitress tried to excuse me while I got more comfortable. The food and beverage here was less than stellar and I will say that I will never go back. I ordered extra chips and salsa because I was hungry. The bartender, who was talking to one of the employees, waited several minutes before my tacos arrived. The bartender asked if I wanted to hang out and was very welcoming to me. After waiting 25 minutes with no one paying attention to me, I simply asked the bartender why her wait was so long. I got my Margarita and it took at least another 20-40 minutes before the tacos were brought out to my table, which would be a My Mexican taco seemed to get the correct taco. Some of the tacos were bad. Blackened Fish: Unsuccessful, tasteless and over cooked. Blackened is a different fish. The Spicy Beef: Not bad, but the sauce was not very flavorful. I did not appreciate Casa del Mar for any reason. I asked the bartender for another taco and he said no. They had the heaviest tequilas that I have ever tasted. If you read the previous review, you know that Canyon Cafe was always my favorite place to eat and I have to agree with that. I know it is a way off and that is why I did not return. As far as bad service goes, I don't think they deserve the worst of it. Casa del Mori may offer some good value in the store, but the food and service is the same or better. I have had a lot better experience at Canyon Cafe, but I am not going back. I'll be sure to report to Canyon Cafe about the service we received.

It looks like CCCC is back in the news. If you didn't know already, Ted Drew's chocolate bar at Chippewa Eye Centre was on the same block as the famous Chippew There was a store located in the mall next door that I found when I walked by. I was invited to go to that store one Saturday, and was so happy I went. What a surprise! They are very sweet, flavorful with a great selection of truffles. I ordered the Georgia Peach, Red Velvet Cake and Kentucky chocolate. Georgia Peach tasted like its' name sake, wilted milk and red velvet. Red Velvet Cake was sweet and smooth like a vanilla cake. I got the pumpkin truffles. I ate them and it was delicious. I really enjoyed the vanilla and butterscotch flavor. Although they were very sweet, they were delicious as well. Sometime I will look at each one and think "O what a wonderful treat". The other store I stopped at was the Cocoa Coat and Coat Factory. They also had some interesting products in the store, which were all very different and unique. Some were girl molds, and some were made for dogs. A must order.I can't believe this was only $36.

I must tell you - I was so impressed with the battery counter at Batteries Plus in Creve Coeur. After all their names make no sense to me. As a little girl, I never saw a Chargers Plus store. There was a special sale at the store as well since I needed to get a AA battery for my new RC helicopter. I figured, why would I miss it? The parking lot was full of people and I felt like I was in the middle of a swarm of ants (and a giant mouse) A store steward came out with a cartload of battery. I said batteries, with a few words for AA's, one for each battery. The clerk seemed friendly, explains the layout, and helps me order the batteries I need. When I sat near the counter, after I pulled out my package, he pointed to a box that I had picked up two years ago. He then took my credit card. I looked around the store and they have all the batteries I needed. The store also has a great selection of batteries and i think there is probably a more complete selection of spare batteries than i can recall. They also sell batteries and light bulbs, it seems like the more you go in and out, the better prices you'll find. As I was walking out, I noticed the sign reading "Batteries Plus" by "Deals". This means that you save money and help the environment at the same time. I just had to pick up my batteries as they were so easy to come by. You should definitely hit this store.

My last visit to this location was on Memorial Day. I still can't believe how bad this McDonald's really is. I think the staff at this McDonald's is the worst they could have been. The Manager said I should get a bag when there is a long wait! I have always had good food at this McDonald's and have always enjoyed the food, but I will have to find a better location to visit next time I have just stopped by each time I feel like this place could really improve. However, the cashier at this location always tries to get you where you want in line, and does not really care if you get inside or outside I find the people here are always friendly and helpful. When I am getting out of my car and waiting for my food, sometimes the parking lot is almost completely empty. It is really the first thing I need to do on my way in from a friend's house, it takes a long time to order because I The McDonald's in Hampton, is a great one, all you need to do if you are on a budget. It's to me the least important part of dining out is the food. Why don't they offer the food in the drive-thru?

As we walked up the stairs into the restaurant, I was a little confused as to what we had just walked in to. We started with chips. I always know when we have chips and salsa when we go around downtown. The salsa is very good too. The first is a lime based salsa and it was perfect. I was very pleased with them. The Nachos started with a simple, slightly thick tortilla which served them up like some old Mexico nachos. Unlike much of the rest of the menu, they didn't come with any refried beans inside just like a lot of the rest of the I could hardly finish the fries, so I got the tequila-crusted nachos (we are the ones that make food) This was one of my favorite lunches of my entire visit. I think everyone else at our table had the beef brisket but I enjoyed all their tacos. The Burrito consisted of an enormous, filling fried corn tortilla topped with beef brisket, fresh roasted corn with  It was very tasty and had just the right amount of sauce. This is the Mexican style burrito. And it is only $8 per burrito, which includes a side with either an order of chorizo and a side of any of the At the time I was a little reluctant to ask because I was pretty new to tacos, so I was very eager to try different items on the Most of the meat and beans were seasoned with just the right amount of black pepper, jalapeos, sour cream, lime juice The menu was not too bad, with a few choices. The SO also ordered a plate of tacos that included everything from the roasted tomato sauce to the house made salsa. The Burrito was also very large so I couldn't finish it without taking a sip of some salsa to bring me down. He enjoyed them all. Just saying..I'll have to ask my husband. I also enjoyed the corn and cheese topped burritos too. There is always something new to try! And for those of you who will be planning your next big lunch, be sure to have a place close to you. I haven't been to the new one yet. I like the Mexican cheese, beans and salsa. His wife added everything in their lunch specials.

If your looking for meaty, tasteful meats in a fast and easy tavern, this is the place for you. Very tender swiss cheese to dip fries. The side of celery sticks is the best part (and it does take a little getting used to). I've had two in the last few years and have never gotten sick from it!

This was my first visit to the American Donut Company, (which is located in Soulard). This update makes all the difference. If anyone has had a bad experience at a John Donut they were not great, but definitely worth the try. After two months I finally decided that I wanted to go back. The Apple Fritter was just alright to me. The chocolate long john tastes very similar to a long John, but the flavor may be less intense, the texture might have been different than a regular It's a nice restaurant, but I would not go back to John Donut Co. It is a nice donut shop in Soulard, The chocolate shaped donuts were quite good. I was a bit surprised to find that John Donut Co did not offer the traditional Apple Fritter as I expected. Just like I've said before the owner, Don was nice. I'm not going to tell you that is how the donuts are served, but it is still a fun way to go. For the past 12 years I have been a regular customer, and I would never skip this restaurant - the staffs are always friendly. I would recommend this place to anyone who might want a sweet treat. I'm not sure if I'll ever move back to the city again, but I can say I'll probably take this up.

!!!! I know you have seen this happen and for some reason I decided to eat KFC. I had to pay the restaurant because I was out of town to go to this KFC spot. I am usually just not too big on Korean Food because it can always be a bit more expensive that time of year. In one case I went to the mall because I was craving something fast, and I finally found the store. Here is a review of my chicken dish. The chicken pieces were very tough and dry. The problem with this recipe is that there is no texture. As I had decided to eat them, my burger tasted like a cheap, generic burger. Not terrible, but quite revolting. This meal was just not worth the money I paid. The sauce we ordered was really watering out! I would say you're better off going in to a McDonalds or other fast food chain after dinner at a restaurant. KFC has a good flavor and I have to say I really like the chicken. The food was good though there could be more variety in the menu. The food is fine and for those who love the Original Recipe I would suggest bringing a coupon.

I've visited this place quite a bit. The food here is similar to the stuff I've found in Cuernavaca, such as cheese y griddled onions, chicken wings It's a bit of a challenge getting everything to know just which food is which. I'm even more jealous of the Mexican products. I can't tell you how many different items I see here in a day. My experiences are most appreciated. At Carniceria, you can get fresh chicken, beef, yuca, pork, fish, and many more wonderful Mexican items. Carniceria offers many fresh items and is so spacious! After shopping, just remember you bought the food on E. Cherokee. There are two lines to exit.

The Manager was pleasant to say the least. I recently stopped by. This would have been a 6 Star business as I had to find good reasons why not book it on my list, which I always do. The pros: burgers are good and reasonable. I would rather go out of my way for a good burger. Dislikes: The prices were higher than in Chipotle or TUMC. Not much variety of toppings, which is a concern. No sauce.Pale. Worst Service - A waiter kept pushing me on the back bench. It made me feel like I was paying for quality food that was not worth paying $$ up. Do you really want you to be called a "dog"? I'm not a regular at this spot but a few years back I was happy to pay a visit at Pepsi Park at Red I ordered a medium sized burger and it was a small bun without any sauce. They will bring you your order, if your the only person here you are going to waste time. I was seated at the bar with more seating. This place is only a 2 or 3 star place for me.

Filomena's has been a place I've frequented since I was 10 years old, during my last visit to Glendale. I usually love the Italian cuisine and am drawn here as often as I can. They make their own sauces, sauces, dressings, pizzas and some more. The only complaint I’ve had on their menu is that the guacamole seems to be a tad bit cold (I I decided to eat a piece of Filet of Crab, as I was always a huge fan of squid in an ome The pasta was very thick and tasty. It tasted so good that I just can't let it go! The steak was incredibly tender and the sauce was delicious. They also have a selection of a variety of soups, salads, and sandwiches to choose from. This was only my second visit to Filomena's. I highly recommend Filomena's. You should definitely check it out at any other Filipino restaurant as it is delicious.

I actually love the Sweet potato Biscuit as much as I do the Eggs Benedict. I love the added crunch of the tomato juice and the chili glazed on the chicken. This was simply the best chicken biscuit sandwich I have ever had and I wouldn't even say that it was a sandwich on a biscuit. A great lunch!. Yes.I would recommend it. For dessert, I must have the Red Chili Glazed Fried Chicken with Pineapple Citrus Slaw.

Very disappointed with the management at Kroenke. The store is just basic, with no charms or customer service. I really got dissappointed with the amount that was being stocked at the counter because you don't see everything before you start shopping. My son was going to be there from 8-11 and I just wanted to get everything he wanted off the floor. I walked through the store when it opened, and the merchandising is very cool. Many of the departments are small, so they had to keep track of them. Another issue I had with this store was the customer service. I figured that this would be a cheap location and I had good cash before I left. The store has always been very helpful to me. At the end of the day, I don't care about a specific product because they tend to have items that are limited and priced higher in the mall I know that they are only available in my local grocery store. If it was up to them, then I would have stayed away from the store for good. Walmart, however, has many things similar to Kroenke, but don't make the items available on the store. This store needs to be a little more creative in their design and service because it is very clean in most cases and looks great inside. You can eat and drink outside the store too, too. My only complaint is that on a daily basis I get a message that they don't accept any large credit cards at this location.

Propaganda is a bar at 550 Franklin Avenue just west of the Boulevard Market in the Cherokee District in Downtown Atlanta. What to expect at Propaganda! 1) Beer & wine by the glass & cocktails/drinks by the glass bar with wine bar & cocktails by the glass menu. 2) The staff are friendly and helpful. I just took advantage of the free shots and I sat down and enjoyed everything for a good couple of hours and took in the live entertainment. I saw a few singers (or dancers) just before the music began, that were a bit shy and not comfortable with the crowd. They all sang beautifully, but they never had lines. Are you a cocktail lover? Love a good Manhattan? Intoxicology is a small space with only two open tables. We had a taste of the Black Bull Distillery as we approached the shop. All of the liquor is produced by several local small independent farms. I decided to try the Bacardi, because you know these drinks need a little kick to get the kicks! There were a few items I had forgotten to order. Along with those items, Intoxicology also carries books about history and cocktails. I found this book for a price of $8. It's a small pocket-sized book with a nice black cover. It was an accurate and interesting look at the history of this fantastical drink. The Manhattan...what are you waiting for? We'll see.

The SO and I walked into the city on a Monday afternoon. This Friday we wanted to go back to a regular dinner spot we have been to for the past couple days. The Hill has its own unique style, and it is easily one of our favorite spots in town. We had a little conversation about what was on our lunch list, and I said, we would do lunch there. It took the SO some time to find out what was going on behind the doors and found their bocce court. We all felt welcome and waited in the nicer atmosphere with the smell of cigar smoke. Our food was great as you can see in the photo below. The SO and I shared the spicy hot wings with two friends. I get them all the time and love the hot, spicy wings or a baked version and they aren't the least bit seasoned they can be They look like chicken wings and it seems like they have been coated to a crisp. A few of their dishes were very interesting and the food was just what I've been looking for. I thought the Grouper sandwich was just about the best he's ever had there. My SO had a Hamburg Burger and I thought these were a match made in heaven. The fries were perfectly crisp, not tooggy or fried. They have a sweet potato taste with a buttery breading and seasonings, including a generous amount of ricotta cheese. I love the beef sandwich to which they added French Fries. It is also a great variety and offers different options for an additional charge such as meat, cheese, onions and beans. This place is worth making a stop for since it is right in the mix of all of the better restaurants in Downtown. For a meal of half they went with French Fries. I would recommend the French fry. They also have a daily happy hour from 11:30am to 3pm - it's all for a great price. The atmosphere was just what I would want. They were able to accommodate our requests and we loved it. I love their service and I'll always be loyal to Milo's. What a place to eat!

I've never tried any Vegetarian pizza in the past. I had never met a pizzeoli (or any other pizza restaurant) who served up a menu featuring vegetarian options. I'm not exactly a "Vegetarian". I love pizza but I'm definitely less choosy about what I put on it. I ordered one of the unique vegan pizzas that night to see if I was able to try something new. If you are looking for pizza without meat or sauce, you're going to probably find it somewhere else. As the pizza arrived, I wasn't too nervous, just pinning it on the pizzas & the fact that it came with an order of I wanted to be frank - I did. This pizza was cooked fresh on the fire, with the sauce being Béchamel, mozzarella, garlic and roasted brussel sprouts on top. I could eat that every day. It was a very very good pizza. So ISC met a few of their friends and discovered that the restaurant offers Brussel Sprouts pizza. Just when we were about to call it quits, our server got a call to see where the pizzas were. Ian convinced me to give it a try. This one was very good, I got a slice sized piece. The inside of the dough was so smooth, dense and full of brussel Sprouts that the crust was almost hard to come by... I was It is a thick crust - so thin, it wasn't too thin on the pizza. The pizza would be perfect for a group dinner and the brussel Sprouts portion was not too bad either. We said: "Yeah!" I'm always so impressed with the staff and the food. Those of you who may already know this, he took care of us all. I truly appreciate the service he provided. We'll do it with Kevin!

Founded in 1989 7 Star Sandwich Factory is located in South Side. I absolutely love 5 Star. I can't eat another burger, especially an amazing one! The Lamb Burger is a small burger with ground beef and a mix of meat and sauces. A thin layer of tzatziki is added on top. I tried the burger on my first bite and could not have made better or stronger choices. My husband and I were at 5, and decided to hit up 5 Star again this morning. We gave the Beefburgers a try and really liked them. They seemed quite tasty and fresh. The lamb was awesome with the tzatziki. We had a few appetizers and lunch. We also tried some milkshakes, one of them was very good. They were plated with good ingredients inside the rings and tasted a bit "cheesy." They have many different shakes, each with something different. The salted caramel was extremely good and it took me back to my favorite ice cream shop. I loved it, but I didn't drink it because I don't like the sweet part, but I will give the Strawberry Shake a try The lunches were excellent and I have a feeling that 5 Star is going to be around for a while. A really good place.

My second visit to Casio's Restaurant Week 2017 was to their newest establishment, Crooked Rock. I was in the area on Clayton Restaurant Week and had the opportunity to dine with everyone and enjoy all things CRW. I chose to go based on the restaurant's regular menu. A portion of the menu was gluten free, with only a small serving of raw meats and proteins. This is how a fast food Chinese restaurant makes it. I'll update this with more details as I get to try more. On arrival to CR, the chef was very nice that I wasn't paying to pay to sit at the bar. The chairs were awesome, with their comfortable leather cover to lounge in on, and the seats on the stools were just the right size! All the tables were clean. I felt that they offered me choices on the menu, but I knew from the first bite that I had to get it. This is definitely my favorite desert. If you are a fan of banana shaped desserts, you need to try this. The Fish Taco was an excellent sized, perfectly cooked fish. This was a great foodie foodie dish. I then tried their Brussels Sprouts. It was a delicious, full-bodied dish. PERFECT! Just let me know! (and not a bad thing.) This entry was posted in Chinese & Thai and tagged crab rangoon, Crab. Great lunch time specials, that I will be frequenting. Since my husband is a fan of crostini, or even just the regular menu, I also ordered one of their Chicken Lasagna It was served fast, just the way I love it. The place is super convenient, very busy, but they do it for you. A delicious dinner for me.

I always like to make a visit to a new place when it is on my travel agenda. I had not been to Las Palmas long enough, to really try out their food. It was the last day of school so I was trying to get out for a day to see some friends. After driving by the restaurant several times, I decided to give it a shot. I was impressed by the flavors that they served. I enjoyed their bowl of chips. I was impressed by their Margaritas. They served you an apple cola with a lime wedge. I didn't expect much of a flavor from the Margarita. I will definitely definitely return. Las Palmas had a burrito and chicken taco. I had the burrito and it was a huge burrito. The beef burrito I had was seasoned well and it was moist. I did put it on my diet and despite having a large portion, I don't think I will need to add this to my menu again until I would like to give the chicken taco a chance, to see if I like it. I have been served theirs over the years and it was never a huge disappointment. Las Palmas does a great job of making sure that everything is put together beautifully. I was surprised for it was rice. The lime sauce was light and not too thick. It blew my mind when mixed with the beans. Their re-fried beans were great as well. They had a lot of beans in the middle that was seasoned and tender. It was still nice eating beans, but for $13.00 that is a difference in dollars for a plate of food. Las Palmas provided outstanding service. One server looked nice and friendly and was always looking for him. I would definitely make a trip to Las Palmas anytime. He was a nice guy who kept the place running and it didn't feel busy. Its a nice addition to any dining experience and my son is getting allot more excited to go to the Mexican restaurants in the neighborhood.

Mack’s is one of my favorite downtown restaurants, and oftentimes I can’t resist stopping by and ordering a burger. A friend of mine, Jack of All Trades, kindly sent me a tip about their new location at the corner of 11th and South and  They offered my family the best burger of their lives, with an oversized chickenburger on the side and (4) cheese in the burger. We know what makes a burger perfect? Four Cheese Burger?. This is the perfect size burger for lunch or dinner. I also got a side of Fried Rice, a simple, buttery salad and an extra side of chips. In addition to that, they added some fresh greens, onion rings and a tasty chipotle mayo patty that was topped with The sandwiches are thin and delicious and the sweet potato fries are to-die for. I also had a Bloody Mary and a garlic butter toast. Look for more review soon.

The Bigelo Family has been hosting their Beer Dinners once a month at their restaurant. Bigelo's also has a lot of Beer Dinners on Tuesdays where you can choose to beseated at the bar. There are 2 different dinners a year; one is the monthly dinner, and the other is an evening where a food pairing is suggested. Many locals and visitors are always treated well. This time we attended the Bigelo's version of the Sunday, 3/23/13 Beer Dinner. This is an original, one of a kind event. Food: Steak Mergez Sliders with pulled pork ragout and a creamy yogurt slaw. Baby Back Ribs with baby bokashi sauce served in an Asian Style Stainless Steel container. I had to try this out. The ribs were tender and moist and so easy to eat. The chicken dishes were a perfect combination with the beer and the food. After tasting all the food, I wasn't a big fan of the beer. Food: The chicken parmesan is excellent. It was so good! Bigelo's is located in Old Market on Main St. We had a great dinner this time around. They give you a taste for what you will eat with your dinners. People attend them all year round as well. You can also purchase tickets for the event in advance, it is available for just $62. Bigelo's has one more Beer Dinner coming up Friday, August 1st at 5:00 pm. You won't regret it!

A perfect place to celebrate. There are no better things to visit than Dive Bar. My first go at this pop-up show was at Crush and Crunchy this past Sunday. I'm so glad I came to this store. I haven't ever been to one yet. This store is a true "crafter center". I highly recommend this place. The staff is extremely friendly and knowledgeable. The owner and staff are so friendly and friendly but you get the best experience. What else can I say?

After a long night on my way back from the office, I needed something to hang out with Steven. My schedule had gotten so busy I didn't feel like going out for dinner and drinks. I'm still with them though. It's Siri's party at Anthonino's Taverna. And so she was a bit late. I had to hurl out the doors while Siri and her assistant did their best to get our table. They had a large party and the servers had a great time with us. We ordered our entree. My SO ordered the Basili, a goat cheese wrap with arugula, olives, arugula dressing and pesto Another delicious dish was the Ribeye, with a side of pasta. We had the Mediterranean Salad with artichoke hearts, red pepper, romaine, and spinach. The cheese tasted fresh, but I didn't think that was what was required. I've been to just about every location in the city for the last few years and was excited to discover some new ones. I've been there often and they have been great. Since they already have 2 locations in the mall, this place had plenty of seating available for dinner and it was a good experience. And for coffee, I had a Grande Cinnabon which was just in time because I had made a mistake and bought it at KFC. It was a good day and the service was top notch. I love cinnamon buns and Cinnabon's. This is a great place to get a great meal at a reasonable price. The best Mexican food in Charlotte. The dishes aren't too expensive, with some dishes costing $$$$. The French Toast is simply delicious. The sides are also excellent, I really had to hit the table and order a couple of sauces to jazz up the meal. They have a dessert bar to top of your food. The service is great and the restaurant is very nice.

Intoxicology is one of my top picks when buying gifts for my new clients for the holidays. I've been going there for 2 years now and I always love it. I get the tequila, the rye, the ice cream and many more. Most likely you will be able to find a variety of whiskies and bourbons in this place. Its the perfect place for getting those first drink ideas started and a great place to add a unique accent or a unique combination to any cocktail. I'm so glad I decided to give this B & B a try. I had four people host my wedding at the Alton Cracker Factory and we had to have multiple suites to accommodate all of the guests. A truly unique room that was incredibly clean. A fireplace surrounded by a wall of doors in the upper floor was so cozy, a nice place to retire to on a warm day. At the reception, our guests had an amazing reception and the decor was perfect. This suite is very a comfortable sleeper room with a sleeper sofa and a full size sleeper sofa. The penthouse is also equipped with a washer and dryer and a generator. The front porch was huge and the covered back porch is great for grilling, picnicking and cooking. This was my favorite location for our day with my bride. It worked with a kitchen in the upper unit, not too difficult to prepare food for a large event. The penthouse and B & B are only a short drive from the heart of town, where everything is on the very walkable/bikeable Great job and MANy thanks for all your help. This is the sort of rental that I would like to do again. Thank You The Alton Cracker Factory For Having Me At your Wedding! Thanks for making it possible.

Laurie's has been a great shoe store for me for 8 years now. This past Saturday I had my very first pair of women's shoes made at Laurie's. I visited this store at about 3 in the morning and was approached by another lady. Laurie's is the best shoes shop I have seen, no complaints. When I walked in, I was blown away. If you need shoes, this is the place to go. So much so that I have had to reapply for a brand new pair of shoes every week. I've just recently noticed how a pair of Suede sandals I bought at Laurie's last summer has a Velcro strap around the heel You'd think this is a good thing! Their selection is excellent too!

I worked Cinco De Mayo and needed tacos for lunch. One of my favorite restaurants to go to when on vacation in Los Angeles. That's all I had, but as I was headed toward my restaurant to get some to-go Mexican for lunch when I saw the "To-Go I ordered a Margarita, which was topped with a nice mix of sour mix with a little lemon or lime juice. It was not at all like the one ordered at the bar, but I still had a drink waiting. The chips were fresh, hot salsa and my favorite pepper chipotle slaw. Upon driving home from Soulard I decided, without hesitation, to order some Mexican food. It is easy to navigate the menu by clicking on the images to the right. The Portobello's had an amazing blend of peppers, sauce, and smoke that really added to what was already mellow tasting. My husband ordered a Margarita as well. I love that Soulard is so easy to find and order on their website. That is when I found out they were on the go. My order was made and placed in minutes. The wait was almost nothing at all. If you are looking for a great Mexican fast food restaurant, with lots of choices, I highly suggest you give Soulard a try. The atmosphere at Soulard is casual and comfortable. The food was just as delicious and the price as well. Is this the best deli in the area for the Pandemic? You bet I will! Can I go back, please?

What is great about this little city, is I can get there by my GPS. MTJ is within walking distance of where I live...yes, right next door to home. The first one had been replaced with a remodeled MTJ a few years ago but due to that tavern.com, The Soulard location resembles my old one in Towne, however, it's opened last week (Wednesday). I have been coming to one of my favorite Taco Joints, Soulard Taco Joint since the late 90's and I continue to enjoy it. No questions were asked but we got our fills. Although I'm not familiar with the decor, it's a good looking place. We also had to try the Mission Paloma, it's the most delicious Margarita I've ever had. During my last visit the server made sure my first drink is the Mission Paloma. I tried the Black Pepper Mule and was blown away. There were 3-4 other margaritas I had that were also excellent. My new waiter was a bit out of place, but he was friendly and we made a great use of our time. It was a great little night and we really thought the food was great. Also the patio is awesome.

This is a nice bar, a little more comfortable than the others on the east side. I've been here because I think of it as a pub. Well, not like other clubs. I've been there three times. The wings are excellent! They are hot and delicious. The wings are nice and cooked through, but would not recommend. The side of Chip Twisters, that are served regular, are my go-to. The burgers are average, with a 50/50 on most orders. I don't have the crab. I love Crab and this one was hard. The 50/50 Burger is good though. I have also found the Chip Twister to be something between a regular burger and a regular sandwich. Is that what they are calling an egg on top of a burger? The standard potato is regular. I would still say that Lemmons is a good place to drink. They are very good. The drinks are very affordable. The Blueberry is a mixed wine, limeade and sour mix, which is not too sweet and has the right balance of acidity and I'd say I'd try these. It's sweet and refreshing. The first time, I eat at lunch time and the second time, I dine at dinner time. The server and bartenders had good manners and were friendly. The only problem I had is if I looked someone in the eye, she had the attitude of if I opened her mouth, she would be nice. She seemed to think she was friendly and didn't really make a difference. They didn't really care and went home with 2 drinks without complaint. That will continue until the bartender becomes friendly with more mature servers. I think so..

This store surprised me. They have a really good selection of fruit and veggies with great price-. I also like the selection of salsa. The chicken is good and so can the frozen salads. They also have a low cost brand of dried fruit to make a variety of snacks such as fruit cups, trays, and pans. I've been to several of MTJ's on the west side of Nashville, usually with chips & salsa. They make me the #1 Taco EVER and I'm not being too hard on them! This wasn't what I had expected.It was huge! I ended up taking half home. The Margarita I ordered with my burrito hit the spot. The Margarita was delicious, but I was pretty grossed out. There is no pre-mixed Margaritas here. Unlike other Margaritas in their price range which are pre-mixed, it's not pre-measured and it makes for  There isn't much left on here, so be creative. I also ordered the Chips & Salsa. I like the extra breadings to be able to put a little more variety into those little tortillas. Not even close.The chips and salsa are huge, just the thickness of a small piece of cheese. Then I tried their empanadas. The filling was delicous but would be too salty to me. Not the seasoned chips or salsa though. My next dish was Banana Mushroom Tacos. It's made with Tex-Mex and green beans, soy sauce, tamarind pickle, a sour cream, tomato The burrito had so much flavor to it that I knew this was the burrito for sure. I ended up buying the burrito as a go-to at MTJ for lunch. It could feed a man. I will be back in town. I was really full. At the end of the meal, I got one of their suggestions. I tried one of them, the Sangria Margarita. My girlfriends told me how hot it was. The peppers are so awesome at spicy levels, I cant even wait for spring to get here again. I sat down to this Margarita and had me mouth watering with a mouth full of it. That’s right, it happened. That was the only reason I went back. I guess I'll have to try it out. The tequila was fresh as always, the Margarita was amazing, and the Mexican food looked and tasted fantastic. With an added dash of Texas heat in the Margarita. So, I will definitely be back to eat here after some time.
