We really appreciate all the extra little "thank you's" the staff bring to the store. I really appreciate that the store has this level of customer service at all times. Why: For the kids at Ho Ho. Yes, I will. I would just stick to this one.

I love Vietnamese food and decided to give Vacherie a try. Just before closing the doors, they had a really cool little garden area. I didn’t actually want to go for dinner at a restaurant and had never visited the food court in the past. I declined the reservation. I did not want to take a break for dinner because I am feeling full and a little tired. What: Dinner.. This particular restaurant is closed and I would not think the food/service are too good for the space at the restaurant.

The Rack store we visited downtown at The Galleria was a good addition to their mall. The location near where I live had no larger than 8 stores as they are larger than those stores. The NK is more crowded, but not ascrowded. This NR was similar to the Nordstrom Rack on the Galleria, which was large at the same time. My one problem with the large NR is the selection. The only items that I could find would be a Polo Shirt for my son. If you had to take my word for it, I would not suggest you shop here. I tried many different styles. I would stay away there. The store had a good selection.

General Candy Corporation is one of my favorite online companies for our Target needs. I first learned about GCC about 6 years ago when I came across a video of GCC on SNBC. They are truly worth a visit. It's also in my neighborhood, and it is not just a chain; it's in the heart of the neighborhood, in a small shopping The store is the only one that does not have ads in the malls, but I truly did feel like a kid in a candy shop. The first time I visited GCC, my first impression of the location was, "well here it is a little better than what you usually get in  It had the words, "Should you want a new hand made candy? Candy with peanut butter? Or a salty-sweet candy? Or do you want to have your candy wrapped in foil? I told you that candy candies are great." And you will see a mix of chocolates, ice cream, frozen candy and more. It is also a great location - I used to pick out my Halloween candy up at our local Salvation Army. They also carry a great lineup of bars by the pound, nut and cookie. This is a candy warehouse that's not your average wholesaler. They don't have a large gift shop, but you do have the option of buying them on a numbered gift card. -Melinda B.

That's right, not long ago I made my way on my way to CBC. I stopped by this store after we were finishing work on Friday night. I had walked by and thought it was a really small store but just walked in later on. The place is perfect. I had never had the opportunity to shop there, but I had always wanted to come. They also have a small bar which is perfect after dinner when everyone has friends in town. My first visit to CBC, was a wonderful experience. It was my favorite beer of the day, Barrelhouse. The best part is that I can have a case of Orabelle right away. The first visit here was easy. They did it all with great attention to detail and excellent customer service. For the price, I know I will be back and I hope you love it too!

scott and joe, we purchased the brand new jcpenney.com in August and wanted to try the store. The only thing that really made me unhappy is the lack of inventory. It was bad enough that I bought two pieces for $380. I understand that the sale is only for a weekend but why not re-open with the great prices at a Sunday store with the same atmosphere and I know you can shop anywhere but there's a long line at this store.

Vinnie's Bistro & Pub was opened in 2011. After seeing their "Beef Gyro's" I saw a "Gyro in the Gardens" sign for it (not very Vinnie's opened back in December of 2008 and was the owner for the past two years. Vinnie was a very friendly server. We sat down to watch him prepare and review all of his sandwiches. There were a number of customers in line for sandwiches. My partner and I ordered a large Gyro (colossal and tzatziki) and each got his choice of a We both ordered a large bowl of the traditional Gyro and that is a great size. This was so much more filling than the traditional Gyro. The bread is  crusty and the vegetables are crisp and delicious. The Colossal paired well with a salad, and the Gyro was a great lunch option for those looking to take in the sights Upon returning to the table, I opened up Vinnie's Kitchen and I immediately saw the potatoes. They're a really simple potato dish- they're filled with a light paprika mixed with a little bit of oil and  I thought they were delicious. This shop is small and I love it. The atmosphere was perfect, it was light and airy with a spacious patio. Just like the neighborhood. It is a large space with a lot of tables and chairs, and a few tables set up for the patio. So I am definitely a fan of Vinnie's Sandwich Shop.

From the moment I placed my registration to the time our server arrived on time, she was a champion. She was informative and friendly. She was great with our group, she was a pleasure to talk to. I would recommend her. That was a pleasant change from the expected. Most things were delicious. I started off with a salad called the Pan-Asian Salad. It was a thinly sliced tomato salad laced with thinly sliced red peppers, feta cheese, and olive oil. It was served with a simple dressing of ranch dressing, garlic and olive oil and a drizzle of olive oil. This Salad is perfect for eating alone in the company of dinner. One of the better salads I've had. The first was Lamb Lippers with Mint Glaze. Then I ordered the Smashed Taters. It has just the right amount of lemon, mint and Cabrales. I ended my meal with the Taconos Andalucianos. The appetizer had an onion rings with a bacon wrapped cheese filling. I was so pleasantly surprised and it is indeed easy to eat bacon wrapped dates. So, I would love if it had bacon instead. This is one of the taters I prefer but my husband couldn't stop eating him. They also have a variety of wine including the standard sangria and a glass of red. In fact, I really enjoyed the Old Fashioned. After dinner we found the staff pleasant, helpful and polite. Don't like the way the restaurant smelled. Not a bad slogan to include on a menu but I have to be honest...I don't really think the cuisine is very good for a Yes, very much. For the price I'd go a step higher.

We wanted to try a new breakfast place here, so we stopped by the Del Frisco Diner to try Slawwich's. I had the Steak and eggs from Eggodile and my wife had the Eggs from the Country Store. Just walked up, the parking lot was full of cars and that was a real drag. We had the Bacon and Cheese Pancakes. The Eggs weren't great either and both were over cooked. The Eggs Benedict (Mexican) were good too, but the eggs did not come out too well. The pancakes were pretty good, but the coffee was only okay. The staff was super slow to come to the table. Also, the waitress was nice. But that is just one taste, and it had the potential.

Porters is back and they are now open. I decided to give you a visit the other night with my SO to try out their "special dinners." Porters does have a very unique menu (I had never tried one before, but my mother had and she liked it too). We were in Chicago recently, so I enjoyed the opportunity to enjoy the freshness of the restaurant and the chicken. This is a good amount. They include a side of garlic bread and they include a side of black eyed peas. They were really good and I'd definitely get one if I could. We finished out the meal with a bottle of Okra, and some fried livers. The size of her piece was about 1/2 the size of mine. Of course, it is one of those things I do not ever buy, and there are many that are made and sold. But not too bad. With all of their delicious chicken, the only other restaurant that I'd consider making chicken, is Bob's Hot Pockets. The pork is delicious and the Okra added a nice contrast to the chicken.

I'm pretty frustrated with Nordstrom Rack in St. Louis. One of these things is doing your grocery shopping at Nordstrom Rack. I can't really remember how I stopped in for Nordstrom's sale today. The clothes aren't too bad...mostly. It is a bit overpriced for men and not worth it. It has crappy pictures, but looks to be in the "advanced" category.

What: Toasted Carnitas on Westheimer. Not so bad for me. Luckily the only place that had the "review" was TC BBQ. It's a hidden jewel near the river side, with a perfect view of Lake Louise and all other downtown dining options. We have all heard good things about this restaurant. If you're looking for an average meal, don't look. Ian ranked it 22 on his 100 list. And I say this with all sincerity. I'm going to put it into context for what I normally do, and say, I love the food. What?!??! It absolutely is. It is loaded with a rich flavor with just enough spice to make you glad you didn't throw it all on top of each other It does provide a good taste to my mouth, but it really does not need to be a "must to order" for me. I also try their fried chicken, beef & chicken with macadamia nut crust. It can't be wrong, they offer a nice variety of meats by choice. We do use it with beer, but we have had their sauces (my husband doesn't have the time for that) - I have never left If you have the chance to try anything else that's not on the same menu, you should. The place is a bit loud to get to but that is OK. The restaurant is well staffed, clean, open to the outside the night of the dinner, that's always a plus. I know there could be no better selection in the area than the Caramel Bananas. These have been my go-tos for many years. One last thing to say, If you're looking for a great restaurant, this is one you have to do. What year: 2016.14. The food here is so much better and I could have a few seconds of fun with my friends and family at the bar playing music.

My husband and I have been regulars for brunch at Lola's and were not disappointed. I waited long enough and was happy with my experience. It's not to be missed. The ice is thick, cold and makes the Bloody Marys that much more distinctive. The Bloody Marys paired perfectly with each of the entrees. In fact, our 3 hour flight home from St. Louis was actually just over 12 hours. Our first entree was the Salmon Omelet with eggs. The portion was substantial and the potatoes tasted absolutely perfect. Great for sharing..the portions were large enough to share. I will be returning for the salmon Benedict. We opted to try the Creole Sautee which came out to $6.95 for two people (I wouldn't pay that much)  This was so moist and it had the perfect amount of spices, we could have been eating this for hours. Creole is one of my favorite foods. And we also ordered a side of Cajun Shrimp. Our fourth and final entree was the Sleek Pie. So fresh and so flavorful. Although the restaurant was just very cozy there was no complaints. I am very happy we found this place. We really enjoyed eating there. Also happy Father's Day! Thank you Lola's!!!

TOPH's Crab Cake Benedict is my best yet. So the good news is I have my wish! To my surprise, TOPH is now offering the Crab Cake Benedict as a regular on their menu. Yes, I was so excited to have this treat made our menu in time for my next visit to this restaurant. We were not sure what it would be and I had decided the Benedict would go for their breakfast menu. Just let my brain get it wrong. My dish arrived in the middle of my meal, along with the Bacon Fritters. I will always be a fan of the crab cakes Benedict or crab cakes and eggs Benedict. My breakfast was filled with deliciously fresh crab. The Crab Cake was made to order and was delicious. They were packed with tender pieces of crab and incredibly fresh. The meat didn't have that "scramble" smell that I've always liked and added lots of flavor, the flavor wasn't  Having ate at TOPH many times, it's hard to not like this dish. The server Jessica was so pleasant and had the opportunity to take a few moments with the diners and explain the many things I love about TOPH. You can't go wrong with the staff or food at THEM! She is always on top of the latest, greatest trends.

I love Trader Joe's! I have used many of their products and I have always appreciated all their customer service. Still the most confusing cashier there, but she definitely doesn't get me into the same products as others. You must enjoy Walgreens too!

One of the best pizzas I've had, I ate here with some friends. The night before I attended an open mic, some friends said they were coming to talk about baseball and the food specials. There was some smoke, the television is on one of the largest screen in the bar as well as there are tables at the bar, one of the bart That is about the best thing I can say about a bar. The atmosphere was not great, everyone moved around and the bartender was loud. This is a little more family friendly bar with a very good staff, including Brad. I was blown away by the Stallion Sandwich. If you can remember, you may recall the one from Costco, this one consists of 2 pieces of chicken, but the top and bottom are made of You can use their special bread and their sauces, they use the housemade sauces. This dish also comes with Italian Salad on a side. There was a lil bit of grease around the edges and I noticed that it was soggy. When their "Stallion" is a good portion of meat it does good. On my way home I looked under the menu and checked out their "Wings". After reading about their wings, I was looking for a good wing. chicken wings with chicken, arugula, Swiss cheese and a ranch sauce. These wings were the bomb. After reading the reviews, I thought they were good. The wings were served on aluminum foil and they were actually good. They were not very sweet, but I think they were delicious. I asked about ordering pizza, they said they did not order pizza. I was so excited - 20 minutes, it was so fast. A few of us had the whole pizza because we were fans of pizza but my friend insisted that we should have a "kiss n' I knew the pizza would be great, not the taste of any other pizza I had but I also knew I wanted some hot wings. Both were excellent.. What impressed me most about the food was their patio area and how large, clean and cozy it was. The beer wasn't all that great, but it was good. I did not really enjoy the pizza and the beer, mostly due to the slow simmering of the Italian Beef.

I just visited one of the locations near my home (Café Cafe-Lodge-Berkeley). I'm looking for the CBC in the Stamford Square location but it didn't open but wait to get there. While CBC is more than just a bar/sale, my experience with the store is impressive. I got this beer on a free tap when the store opened and it was just $4 (as I was at the time). I am not sure what it was or what was inside. But I have found this beer on the shelves of many major breweries. I am looking for a beer that isn't too dark. This location makes it easy when we are out here in the City. CBC is just right. I paired it with some kind of cured meat which just brought out my taste buds. The beer was pretty sweet, though. The food selection is exceptional and the drinks are great. The bartenders are friendly and knowledgeable. I love the store! I'd go back for a more lager, but the taste is so different. So, it's just my first order. What: To give it a try. Yes!.Will I come back? I could be on their way in a moment.

There is no other smoking meat establishment in the St. Louis area. On Wednesday, we went for lunch. I was recently there for lunch and one of the best portions I've had in the past few years. One of the things that really made the Deviled Eggs feel like home, is the fact that my Mom made them. It was just the perfect mix of eggs, salt and pepper. This year, we both had her version. The eggs are fried and covered with ranch, then topped with a delicious coating of sour cream (I like to add some Tabasco The Cheddar cheese mix was a great addition. The fried pickles were on a roll, with a thin layer of fried pickle in the middle and a smear of After all, cheese and Deviled Eggs are a meal in and of itself so how can you not love Fried Pickles? However, these guys topped mine off perfectly. I even got to get to try the cheese of my favorite place in South Texas. The food came to an awesome conclusion with our dinners. They gave a choice of a Brisket and a Baby Back Rib, but when you try them out you're going to love this The flavors are good. Our main course consisted of Brisket and 1/2 rack of Baby Back Ribs. It was served with lots of olive oil and butter. My Sweet Bestie was delicious because it contains no cream cheese, just a mix of sweet and sour seasonings. We then had our meats. They're perfectly seasoned with a dipped fat rub, with a touch of barbecue sauce. There was a little sauce that complemented the ribs, but I did not notice the breading and it was not stingy, t All of the ribs were very tender and pheasant meat. Not to mention they serve a great salad for lunch or dinner. They also had a variety of beers on tap including: Draft, French, Corona and a nice refreshing cider. My Sweet Bestie was definitely my favorite sauce here. Not too much meat in lunch, but I still don't mind. The Brisket was one of the best, I've ever had. They were moist and flavorful. This will be my first visit with Salt + Smoke and I'll be back. I think everyone loves a good ribs in this day and age, and S+S's, has the bone in ribs that will They were tender and flavorful and our lunch was so good we went home and made some hot dogs and fries for dinner too. And then all those sides combined, it really was one of my best lunches ever. If you're in the St Louis area and can't wait to see S+S back to the loop in The Loop, then make your way over What I'm most amazed by, though, is the quality of the marinade the ribs are cooked in. The sides offered me a few ideas when I was out of town at some point during that day. It definitely wasn't the biggest selection of meat here, but I had plenty to take home with me. They came just as delicious as the ribs.

Located in the old building of the old location, this location has been completely renovated. A new cafeteria was created. At times, it looks like this new Taco Bell is the "old Taco Bell". As with many Taco Bell locations here, the food at Taco Bell is unreal and really good. There are a few things I was in the mood for but, overall, nothing particularly impressive. The staff is friendly, the drinks are cheap and the service is really good. I was the server for both of my partners, and I'm pretty sure I sat next to a few other guys. You cannot really ask a cashier to assist you, if you can ask to wait for your order, which is a bit more frustrating. I ended up getting my beans submerged in a bowl of guacamole and the flavor was flavorless, not cooked all the way. They were just a lukewarm taste to the outside of the tortilla. The coffee was average, too, with no color. I have to say, I felt like I was eating a cheap, low quality burrito. Hopefully their food will improve in future though.

I had the opportunity to sit at SNR for lunch today, and I would of gone for lunch, because my friend is always on the go. I loved their beer on the pitcher that was served with my dinner. The Margarita had many types of flavor including jalapeno, orange, hot pepper and mint. I went on to get a plate of ribs, which were a bit under cooked but oh-so good. The chips were not bad, they were light on the seasoning and were fresh. We also ordered the Ribs, which included our usual barbecue sauce and BBQ sauce. We ordered the medium bone-in ribs, which got all cooked and tasted extremely good. They were thick and had a nice sauce. It tasted good and it was thick enough to easily handle. As for the tacos/fries, we chose the Cachete, Carnitas and Chipotle. The chicken was very tasty. The Chorizo was just as salty as the chicken, but not as spicy. We ordered the tangy Cole Slaw and the Mac-n-Cheese, along with the Mac-n-Chees Cole Slaw was quite good, it was very thick, made of chicken and steak, and tangy and tasty. I also liked the cheese on the MnC, it was slightly tangy and cheesy. I will definitely check out the more expensive items that are also on the table from time to time just to see what everyone's favorite is. I also went a little bit slow in the restaurant, it kept my appetite full because of the busy restaurant hours. The parking lot was a little tricky, it used to get packed pretty fast. The menu has something for everyone ranging from Mexican to Mexican style wings. Also you may notice some of the signs and signs are on their menu.

At first I was pretty impressed by the concept of this restaurant, not wanting to waste anymore time learning about the place. It's not just a restaurant. I will say that the service was good, but I don't think I would recommend  eating here. If you would go here and try something else, please do yourself a favor by trying something else at the same price. They need to take the money, and change their marketing to be more honest. They are just starting a new venture and it is very difficult launching a business at this point. My wife requested wet aged beef, but what was delivered was dry aged pork. I don't think they were wet aged it. Although it looks nice on the menu, the quality of the food was a bad sign. I really don't know a word about that, but it is really a huge let down in this case. The meat was actually tender and the sides were pretty good. I found the pulled pork to be not as good. While the sides were good I would be surprised at how many sauces they offered. Thankfully their sauces were made in house. I'll leave that out of it because all I got were a small bit of flavor and little butter. The pulled pork was more textured, a little tougher and had a higher fat content. The Garlic Chips with Honey and Salt was a little too much salty, but still very nice to eat and would only be one I would The pulled pork was very flavorful and the pulled chicken was not to be missed. The Mac & Cheese was solid. I was hoping the Bacon Jam and Tomato Fries would be good. I liked the chips, but there is still a gap between the chips and the meat. Though their meat and sauce is very good I feel like their menu and service is way overpriced for what they bring out. The drinks are refreshing, even as they are pricey at around $26. But the rest of the menu is very similar. They also serve their own drinks and I am still eating their sweet and tangy mocha latte, but the texture is very grainy, too Maybe they can come up with a better concept next time. Easily the worst lunch experience I have had in a long time.

Our family went here after eating at our local deli. The rice is flavorful, with the flavor of a delicious soup. The cole slaw is crisp, greenish and the green clotted cream sauce is great. The chicken is cut exactly as shown on the menu. Our box dinners were prepared to be vegetarian. Porters serves fresh baked bread at 2:30pm, for extra charge. There are a few niggles though. Heard it in a movie. I would still go back.

Addiction is located in the French Quarter section of New Orleans, Louisiana. This quaint spot is located in the French Quarter at 415 East Louisiana Avenue. The dark wood and concrete walls make the place very feel good. It is small with just five tables and they give you a great spot to sit down to enjoy a cup of coffee. The glass table behind the counter is a welcoming place, with a perfect vibe. When you arrive you are welcomed to a cozy sitting space and a wide variety of sweet beverages. I was greeted by a lovely woman with a menu with what I was looking for. The drinks were ordered in categories, sorted by price. The menu consisted of six options;: Cold, Iced, Iced Press, Iced Caramel, Iced French Creme, Iced On a Tuesday in the French Quarter, Addiction was open. I tried both and thought I was in for a treat. It was really good. Their price is reasonable and not all the beverages are advertised correctly. I have to say, it was absolutely delicious. I recommend Addiction if you ever find yourself in New Orleans.. No doubt..the coffee lovers!

I would choose to make 2 more stars for these cupcakes. Each of them had great flavor and were very moist. However, I have to give a small disclaimer. There were a few dry spots in the cupcakes, but it was about the only problem I had. And, let me tell you; they have all melted into the bottom of your mouth, and the cake icing was as moist as they could While the Pumpkin Spice was probably one of my favorite cupcakes. After making these, I am looking forward to seeing how they work out, because I'll give them a star if I can make them work!

This Taco Bell is in the heart of the city and can be found on Main Street and in between the stores. When I walked in, I thought I was at Macy's or even on a high speed train. I actually did like the food, it was delicious, but I thought it was a little too small. It has a fresh Mexican menu that you can enjoy with chips, fresh salad, dips, chips and beans. The tacos were pretty good and the service was excellent. I will admit it to be a slightly smaller market for the price of your favorite TB. Food quality was outstanding in addition to being healthy and tasty. The counter employee did a great job in explaining to me how much I should pay and was very helpful. She went above and beyond that by greeting my kids and serving some good food. I am a loyal customer of theirs. My friend came in for lunch and I had a conversation with her that will last. The ad in this restaurant was: Is this a Taco Bell? I will be honest and add that I am a bit of a slumberer. It is because Taco Bell has been in business for generations and many others have followed. If I was in a bad bind, this location would be my go to stop, I always have and you never know what I might be watching down

Happy Easter!.This is a little sweet gift from Santa. I finally got to see and visit the Italian Market on The Hill. I didn't notice it until I went to the grocery store near the post office. I didn't think anything of it until the last Saturday of August when I went on my way to the store to pick up food. The sign was posted that I was on their way to work so I figured I'd give it a shot. My friend and I went on Thursday to check out DiGregorio's. I was blown away by the selection of fresh fruits and vegetables. The grocery checkout line was huge, I couldn't believe I had the chance to try every aisle. They also have a large selection of meats. I never seem to get that stocked up so much in a market. They have a large bar counter complete with Italian cheeses and wine. I mean, just look at that delicious meat! I decided to try the linguine alfredo on a ciabatta and enjoyed the entire experience. I was so excited when I opened it so I could actually find my anchovies. These anchovies are like shellfish in an eggless shell. I couldn't believe it when I saw the selection. I also loved how it was decorated inside of the shop. We were greeted by beautiful Italian ladies who were extremely caring and helpful. Their produce options that you would expect to find in a local store are so great they make you think that you had just arrived at an upscale Italian restaurant At the end of the day, no one ever asked if you want help, I did that because I felt like they were like family. They have the biggest selection of cheeses, dill and garlic sauces in the Metroplex. I have to run to give this little place a chance to show everyone that they are a little different from our usual big chain grocers.

You get a piece of fish for almost $10! I went here yesterday, after a long wait. They also sell catfish, so we walked in and saw the catfish. On the way to the table, I tried the Cod and was disappointed. We were the only ones there. In my opinion Porters does better with the Catfish. I ordered our main course, a steak. It is the first time I have ordered chicken tenders and I was really pleased. It had a nice mix of vegetables and mashed potatoes. They aren't cheap, but have a good taste to them.

This is my second review on The Mud House on Main. The Mud House has been a regular stop for me and my dining partner. One of my dining partners gets the Benedict to start the day with and one of mine gets the Bacon. In the meantime, it is still a great breakfast spot to enjoy with a friendly and talented staff. My favorite menu item is the Eggs Benedict, it is delicious, not too much mayo and a good blend of vegetables, I usually get two plates This is an egg, ranch cheese, southwestern pulled pork and chocolate cake that's fried in a tortilla topped with a Mexican style I always get the classic breakfast. There are no egg dishes, just a choice of egg, biscuits and gravy with toast and a side salad. I've also had some of their breakfast burgers, and love them. My dining partner ordered the St. Louis classic too. We decided to order the Pan-Sonoran Fried Eggs from The Mud House. It is a dish that I've ordered a couple times already, but when I saw this on the menu today, I was very impressed. I never would have thought this dish could be a hit, not only because I had never tried it before, but because I am looking to expand my breakfast But with a side salad and a side of bacon, this is one for the cook book. We felt the potato was mashed with just enough seasoning to make it crisp. The potatoes did have a little crunch to them, but the flavor left many of us wanting more. We also felt the potatoes were way tooggy or chewy. I could not taste the potatoes, and ordered another dish later, but the food definitely stood out from this dish. The chicken dish wasn't too bad, I think it was my favorite dish overall. My partner's bacon was very tender and tender when it arrived. And my bacon was a little more chewy and dry at the edges, this makes my bacon very slightly chewier, but it was still in my mouth One of their bacon was "fresh", rather than thawed and ready to serve. We both agreed it was slightly underseasoned. I love the atmosphere at The Mud House and how we were greeted with a smile. However, this was not the first time we were confronted with this, so to be honest, it seemed to not be a problem, so we The price is not bad for breakfast.

Best of 8 Stars! The improvements since the opening of this Rack. I really enjoyed the selections. The only cons I would say would be that most of their items have a minimum purchase of $42. That was great especially when having 2 boys. The price of the basics is great. I will admit that it was my first attempt at shopping from them, and I know the difference it made. The staff were great about helping me choose items I wanted or wanted or wanted to try. Their emails were often helpful and often timely. They also have an on-line Yelp page - which has been very helpful in getting my rating up. One big problem, as I find them to be of no benefit to me overall, is how the price compares to my daily grocery purchases. This was the second time that I've purchased items from NR and it's been one year. I will also be honest with you, they have a few issues with the selection. But all things considered, everything is better than I could have hoped for. The employees are excellent and the prices are extremely reasonable.

Sunday Brunch at Steak Ranch is one of those rare occasions. I decided to come for Brunch, not only was it just an extra day but it was the Sunday Brunch at their Bar. I'm putting this on my list of places that I've been to on my breaks. This is a venue I enjoy, so, I decided to review the brunch menu. All good things have an expiration date. On the drive from the airport to the airport, there were people. People were eating right away as there were about 30 people in line. As I walked in, I was welcomed by a woman selling chocolates and hot chocolates. There were about 3 ppl of people all enjoying brunch, and the bar kept the crowd entertained. I was excited to find out that I was able to order a Bloody's without spending a lot ($10). I'm not in a rush, and it was my first visit there and I was excited to try them out. You get three drinks for $13. I always order a mimosa for my guests though, since they tend to be more conservative in their drinking choices. I was asked for the Margarita and asked to choose Salted or Salted rim. Their Bloody Marys are made with the freshest ingredients you could find. It did not taste that bad, it was very smooth. I don't drink a lot of alcohol, so, at my age a Bloody is not too bad for me. The menu at the bar consists of many of the dishes we would make in the restaurant for dine in supper time. Our trip to Texas has been a week long. It's a small restaurant called The Brickhouse in Kirkwood, Texas. The Ribs are great, they fall off the bone. They served 2 of the 5 Ribs, only once. We both rated them 4.5 stars out of 5. Ribs were very tender and they came out just right. The sauce served with it was not as thick as I would want. They were out of a lot of the rest of the meat so I did not have to ask. They had a lot of meat, but it's hard to taste when it's over. For the price, I would have liked it a little more tender and moist, but it was not something I noticed was available, so I did not It was quite dry, fried and tough. I thought it was an odd choice to not go for the extra ranch on this side. I was willing to spend up for a really good meal. We would be back!

Well, I do not shop at Barnes & Noble only because it's a great place to get books. My favourite is "Untitled". Look for the book jackets in the back of the book. They also had a library of books that are in the basements, there's a nice nook for kids you can look at.

All employees are very friendly and helpful. So glad you stopped by.

If you're looking for a great place to eat a BBQ meal, I am fairly certain you're going to have one when you are S+S has not. During our meal at S+S, we had 5 other people eating with us. If you're a fan of BBQ, or maybe a fan of BBQ-ers, this could be a bit of a problem. The atmosphere was lively but no music to speak about as they served up beer and sang calypso. Tonight we went for lunch and I ordered the pulled pork. The wings were excellent as always and came in a big package with half order sides. They were so huge they just ate two wings per person and we left because it was just too much food for us (we're just over 40 so I ordered the Smokey Brisket on bread bun. It also gave my sandwich that "creamy" texture that I always enjoy. My meal also came with their new fork tender brisket. They have fork tender brisket,smoked medium brisket and lean and burnt ends. For me, the burnt option is the one option that just does not taste good. My husband and I order the lean and burnt ends and he loves it. However, last night I was very disappointed in the brisket. The chicken was soggy and the cheese was too sweet. I wasn't sure if the saltiness was due to the cooking or the fat, but it wasn't. I felt drowsy and if I should ever have had this experience, I'd go back. I have to order the fat brisket now because my little buddy who was a fan of S+S, he will come back there next It just so happened, my roommate ordered the fat end of his brisket. The baked beans were tasty, cheesy and salty. My friend agreed when he put the plate on the counter, "I always make sure I get that little cut inside the brisket that helps me Lastly for dessert, they brought out a small dozen ice creams. I had to share it with someone as I was too full and had to order again. After finishing my dinner, we decided to go to a friend's house to see the new movie The House of the Rising Sun. That and the slam dunks made me want to be at my desk at work. Overall, I'd give them a 4 and only if they could get the taste right. But I've never had such an experience from the restaurant and it's always on my list to try it again. I must try that next time." They are the best at their job."

I'm not always the biggest fan of Nordstrom's, but this was different. You don't know how good the new JCPenny in the area is and she was more than pleased to come in and get a pair I'm glad she did. She has already attended the Kentucky Derby for the first time, so I suggested she dress up as the "Lady Queen". The one and only Fast Eddie's location in Grafton is actually a beer garden. It's located in the back of a bar in East Grafton near the Bon Air Market and the downtown hotels. In the middle of the river, at the back is a small movie theater for movie convention. The drinks are ice cold and tasted like they were from a tap. This is an arcade-style venue with a large selection of games, billiards, shuffle board, and darts. If the waitress doesn't do that, then you have to try your luck to get someone who does. I'll let you have at it. At the bar, you order from the grill counter and have to wait for the food to come out. Because fast Eddie's doesn't have the same menu, you may wonder what you have to do, to get there. The place is clean, with an open floor plan, but you can get a lot of good looks at people. We were excited to be arriving at fast Eddie's, which was the first time we had ever had a "date". Fast Eddie's is a casual dive bar with a great view of downtown, so it was a great spot to go for a date, When we received our first bottle of Coors Light, we hopped down into the bar and chatted with our hostess, Norma We like Flo, but she just never really got into the storyline of the show. She made a couple of cute faces while it took us 45 minutes to get our food. The waitress said that we had half a piece of tenderloin. The Big Elwood does have a smoky flavor, but I did not feel like it was overly spicy. It tasted like a brisket-like treat and they were nice, not sour. The chips were fried, although the chips were dry and tasted like they were rolled up into a ball. Other dishes that we sampled include the best burgers from any fast food restaurant I have ever eaten. burger with a side of potato wedges. The fries are not asggy as you might expect, but as you expect from clams. The prices are too reasonable for the quality of both the beers and the fries. The burgers are a bit dry, but the fries were moist and had a good consistency, not hard to eat at. I think it is the best place as far as pubs go in terms of getting drunk.

I had an excellent breakfast at Jax Cafe this past weekend and it's a mystery where should I take my attention. Am I a fan of the Jax Cafe and think they should just be a regular place of breakfast? Very good for my Walgreens needs. The store is in a very high end building and it's great to have Walgreens in the area. This Walgreen is making a difference. They were amazing at helping me get my needed items out and get me out in no time.

Porter's is an excellent spot for casual dining, with good beer and wine selection. Sometimes just eating a piece of fried chicken is the only calorie free side I want to eat. That is the order that I order every time, especially since they do a huge amount of wing-on-wing-hot wing chicken at their I always prefer the bigger and the better. Since it is a special meal we usually order the boneless meat chicken. If we order only legs, there are two legs in the box. Porter's doesn't offer a "special" menu, but you do get a lot of great options. One of our favorite sides is Porter's amazing Okra. Porter's has a "extra" side special for meat lovers. We've never ordered them from here and always enjoy each other's sides. The sauce they are served with is a little on the salty side and the bread is a little too soft to get enough protein. Also, I try to keep the Okra fresh in the back seat because they can be hard to find in the grocery store. After spending the night in the car, I think it is a solid purchase and I'm not going back. The fact that I had a side of this food just makes this one of my favorite meals of any meal. As with any drive in establishment, parking can be a major problem. Apollonia is an upscale, contemporary Greek restaurant in Long Island City, where I have always found great food. Apollonia is a Greek restaurant located on Gravois Street in the northeast. I eat low-carb, I'm just looking for some extra nutrition. It was really tastey, although somewhat spiffy. I had to ask our server for more Gyro meat since we had just come back from the Greek Sea, so I had to ask if we could It was delicious, I did not have problems with it, it was surprisingly good. The salad was very fresh, the leaf lettuce and the cucumber was vibrant green, the olives added a nice Mediterranean flavor. I had to eat a small quantity. I love that it is just a salad and they make a good dressing as well! There are three parking lots front and back of the restaurant. They are one of the few restaurants offering gluten-free options that are open late at night. With the fast pace of the restaurant we were not able to find a booth. They would only take an hour for a first timer. They do not have a happy hour, I can only assume that there are a handful of seats available and not a lot of tables.

I do like it when the drinks taste good, as this was a hot day, so a hot tea taste can be very strange, so I did Chicken Wings - Hot - It's an American version of the Hot Wings that is topped with hot sauce and cheese. Caesar Salad - Iceberg lettuce, romaine lettuce, blue cheese, fresh tomato, Crumbled Homemade Croutons and a Sp It did have a nice cheese flavor but it not as strong on the romaine lettuce as a regular Caesar, however, I like this much better It was not the best salad I've had and felt a bit too large for my taste buds. However, I was quite disappointed that this chicken was not sliced through completely. Reminded of a Buffalo Chicken Salad you can buy in a grocery store. But the rest of the ingredients felt cheap like the food at your average grocery store. The romaine was very good - not too wilted and thin and not tooggy. The side of dressing was too sweet for my taste, but the cheese was nice and crumbled. The ranch dressing was pretty good quality, but tasted a bit too thick for my taste. Margherita Pizza – They placed the pizza with a thin pizza crust on the bottom. The pizza was soft, thick and delicious, with the crust being nice and chewy like a pizza crust. It was a delicious pizza and the ingredients did exactly what they said they would. Our pizza was not good, it's kind of similar to a "white" pizza however, they did use fresh cheese. They had an option to have their pizza iced with a strawberry lemonade, which really annoys me. They did give the pizza a bit of crust from their thin crust, but it did not give any real texture. The sauce I ordered was a good sauce, and was very flavorful and easy to taste with my palette. On the side of the pizza, there was no crusty bread and the crust was just soft, a bit of crunch and not very crispy. I was rather disappointed because there wasn't anything great to do with the food, the flavor was not flavorful nor enjoyable. If you are a fan of the pizza but are not interested in the wings, then it is a good option.

After working at TopH for quite some time and hearing about their outstanding pancakes, first, I had to try them. My Manhattan had everything we could have wished for. In the end that's good for me. This was not an issue. For lunch we got an order of the; Mussels Sauvignon. The meal, was pretty delicious. We had two a half of each, but the bread was a bit tooggy and we were wishing for more. The restaurant had a nice little buffet with two separate seafood fried buffets. It was served with tater tots and scallions, and deep fried with French fries on the side. I love Carolina style burgers. This was a little on the sweet side but definitely not bad. The burger was delicious and I had the remaining mussel in it, as well. My friend ordered the Oyster Oysters with garlic mayo breading. It consisted of a half pound fried chicken tenderloin, served with a small side salad. The pulled pork did have a bit of flavor to it that lacked a nice, crisp exterior. So in short, if you're looking for delicious smoked meat and some cool drinks then Southtown Pub is your place. They also have a Turkey that is really light in the sauce and it wasn't a big difference, I mean it still tasted good. I'm not sure what they really mean by "baked foods." The cake was good. That is not what had me envious of what I had at SP. There was no flavor in the pudding and the ice cream was soggy. It could have easily been served cold than it is served warm. This was a good food to try out. If you plan on visiting SP we would recommend the wings, the side and/or dessert for all three.

We have had a couple of late birthdays recently and we are always looking for family run places, especially those with great food that are under theradar It was very interesting to see what they had going on. I am glad that the coupon in the Entertainment Book, "Best of St Louis", came in handy. The gal at the counter welcomed us with a big smile and smile. I think I will have another try soon to try the place as it seems to be a lot of fun. She was not only courteous but was also friendly and went above and beyond to make sure that we had a pleasant experience. I am not sure what the deal was but my husband found it exciting. His stomach is for some things, and my stomach is not for others. This was not the typical sandwich he had on his fathers side, they gave him a meat sandwich. It was perfectly done and he found out we actually ordered it with cheese and we didn't order an onion. Then he was curious, about how the fry was... the batter was a little thin, but was fine. However these were not nearly as good as how I have had them in a few years. He didn't recommend them. I can hardly believe we even stopped by a place on this block. The menu is varied, but I liked our choice, and did not mind the portion and the taste. It was a good choice for a lunch on the hill, which isn't really the best place to eat and then go to a One of the best Italian restaurants that I have ever had! We spent a total of $36 for lunch, dinner and dessert.

I met 3 wive friends and had lunch at the mall. Very nice service and really good food. I ordered the Red Lion Turkey Sandwiches! Just ok, but not the best. Another favorite was the burger - you don’t find a better burger for $8 at any of the chain restaurants in Montreal. The burger was very tender and it was very juicy! The food is pretty decent for lunch. My friend had the Sweet Potato soup, it was quite unique to this particular establishment. It really is very full for one person (somehow).

Spare No Rib has moved again. I have seen the new place twice, both times during my stay at the original location. Spare No Rib had a very cool little restaurant, but they moved to Jefferson, where they had a really tight space to call their own. The new location is a tiny restaurant and has a very nice bar area with several small tables. They have their own little patio which is open on the 3rd Friday of the month. It is not like the original Spare No Rib location; there is no noise, lights, dance floor etc. On Monday and Tuesday, the restaurant offers Mexican-style enchiladas and their "Housemade BBQ" is always fresh and hot. With the new location, Spare No Rib has re-energized their style and is now up with their newest menu. They have made it possible for me to try a small portion of everything as well. The queso dip was spot on. I have always been a fan of the Chipotle chili recipe which makes a great sauce for the pulled pork sandwich but I always make a  The Chorizo-Queso Dip is made with thickly fried tortilla chips, hot salsa and chorizo. It is a meaty, tender dip full of chorizo and a great blend of sweet cream cheese with a zing of salt and pepper You can substitute thechorizo for real chorizo and they are really good here as well. I felt a sense of fullness in my mouth as my pork sizzled tangily as I bit into it. The Chorizo-Queso Dip is so thick its almost as if you were slathered with heavy sauce. The fries were so good, the flavor had so much to it. You can get any number of sauced and topped fries here including hot, sauced and ranch. If you are so inclined, the House Cut Fries come with a huge batch of chips. These chips are extremely salty. The salsa is just as fresh and the serving is just right. I absolutely love this salsa as well. Their salsas are thick and cheesy, and they are not overly spicy. Each chips offers a different sauce and is not the same as the one you buy at a local grocery store, you must do a bit of research I know you have it on your radar to look for a new location and look at a new place to take your kids, but I wouldn't My pulled pork sandwich was a little rare with the smoked pork, but it was perfectly cooked and that is why I ordered it. I would always order more chips as a way to warm up since those are in season now. I also ordered a Pulled Pork Sandwich with Coleslaw from the newly opened Spare No Rib. I got the pulled pork and chorizo. I ordered a chicken pot pie and the whole thing was so good. I opted for their pulled Pork sandwiches with a side of a side of pickles. It is the perfect place for a night out with friends or just to enjoy a drink and conversation. I was so glad I did as the sauces tasted so good.

What is the one word I could use to describe this one-of-a-kind biscuit?? I am not a die-hard Hardee's fan but I am impressed at the design of the Biscuits. I always like this biscuit to start the morning and thought it looked a bit fancy. I thought it would be sweet. The sausage was way too tender and dry. I have had several of these and I was disappointed by the biscuit. The biscuit was a bit stale with no apparent flavor. However, I am satisfied to learn that I can get an egg and bacon breakfast at any Hardee's. I'm a regular here in Chicago and would love to return the favor to this location. It is a very easy trip to the mall, but I would rather have my breakfast delivered. There are other biscuits to choose from if I want a more unique twist on my usual breakfast biscuit.

I just had a quick lunch at Blaze. The first time I reviewed Blaze I got a pizza which didn't taste as great as it went out of the oven, didn't do the I went in for an early lunch and was rushed to the table, had to take orders on the spot and took a bite after to refuel I'm glad I discovered Blaze. They come with a simple dough and a lot of topping options. I even ordered black olives for a special pepper. Blaze also has a great variety of pizzas to choose from. The Hot Link pizza is made with red sauce, blue cheese, and jalapeos and is topped with chicken, bacon, kale And my favorite, the hot sauce was super sharp. I couldn't stop eating the hot link. You just have to get it if you want to eat it quick. Regardless of you ate it first or later, this pizza is not to be missed. There isn't a lot of selection on the menu. I ordered something special and was really impressed with the orange juice. I bought it when they were in town and have been drinking it the last few weeks. I never had to wait for a drink and I always got home early. You can tell they enjoy their jobs and enjoy the food. Will Blaze pizza be open later at lunch? They have won 1 of my awards, and also a promotion. It’s a good pizza restaurant I believe because you get the best food and service and it’s fast.

I like to help a small business in the process. There are too many good things for me to purchase, so I decided to make the switch to drop my things off. I don't normally "drop" donating from church, but this year is no different. It takes you about 5 minutes to make the drive from Washington, DC, back to the city center. Just keep going until you reach the drop off area. You'll then have one of the managers help you unload your items. At that point, you've covered everything you need. Now sign and date all documents you bring with you. That's it. I came back a third time as well bringing the cash and a bag of change for my daughter. Great place to drop off your donations! Yep, I will! I will be making a new friend because of the wonderful people at this place.

I recently had my new glasses made and inspected by SEE Eyewear. SEE Eyewear is a friendly friendly place to find a good pair of frames. As long as we got in touch with a representative she let me know how much my prescription would be and that I could get a discount. It is true that I don't have insurance but I did have Groupon for the cost we paid to have my lenses and contacts replaced. The price was reasonable and very affordable. I would not hesitate to return to SEE for glasses. They were the best I have ever seen.

CS has been wonderful to me. As soon as I enter the door, I is struck by the size, variety and how unique and amazing the displays really are. There is a lot of room to expand, but they always maintain the top quality and they do it for a fair price. I have bought all their items from them. After moving into my new home, I purchased a deal rack at a flea market. I was so stoked that I bought all the things and got the rack for a great bargain. But they just charged me a $14+ rental fee. Thank you CS for all you do.

GCC Candy Supply is a candy warehouse on the corners of the corner of 62nd and 7th. This is a one stop candy store and you'll be glad you did. GCC is the best granola bar, mint and chocolate chip store in the STL area and for any occasion. I don't remember when I was younger but, I love to stock up for Halloween. You are probably referred to to someone on social media in life, and they ask you “What is your favorite restaurant in St. Pat's?", I would respond with "My favorite college and university." I would have to say, The Jimmy's on 3rd St. Louis. They are my second favorite restaurant in St. Louis after the Bellagio, and I'm still in love with the food. I come here every month for a quick dinner, and it is one of my go to places. They love creating the ultimate in St Louis styled food. In fact, they have everything I want. One of my most favorite appetizers, a garlic dip with a shrimp taco. Each is wonderful and the drink is a perfect drink by itself, served with a choice of fresh bread, chips, a salad or a dip I have also ordered a Chicken Salad Plate with fresh kale, olives, red onion and fresh basil, the only items not on their salad We order them every week and I have to say they are both worth the visit. Bistro Steak, has been a favorite for me for over a year and a half now and I still get it every time I visit. The Diver Scallops are skewered perfectly with fresh, jumbo shrimp and served topped with a thin slice of crab and also sea The fried scallop shells are delicious and I think the dish itself is just as delicious. The Jimmy Burger is a massiveburger, with many ways to add a twist to it, including a different meat. I highly recommend this burger. You may want to check out the specialties of their dinner menus. The Cioppino offers a wonderful blend of spices, seasonings and veggies that is topped with a fresh basil sauce. I like to serve this with the house made coleslaw. It is seriously one of my favorite things of the week! Recently, they have moved to a larger space that allows for more room for an additional dining room. There are 2 main desserts that you could order and each one is the creamiest and most delectable. For an ice cream/cream lava cake you could not go wrong. Both were absolutely stellar from start to finish. The Crème Brûlée Crepe Cake is a giant and decadent dessert in the classic French cream topped crepe. This cake is made with two different white chocolate chips and then topped with a little bit of lemon tart, and an assortment of different things. Not to mention I can seriously see how this cake would taste if it's cooked in a pan. After visiting the restaurant a few times now, I now know why. The atmosphere is romantic and I loved every moment that I was inside. I'm going to have to give it a try. It is not only the first time that I have enjoyed a cake, but I always leave full and in love with the experience that I am having while eating Each bite is a delight because the breading is rich, the batter is delicate, the rice is tender, and the sauce is rich. Their beer is awesome too, I always have the Cask Ale.

I was fortunate enough that we were able to eat at Monsoon on our way to a meeting with ISC in Saskatoon I'm an Asian-American, so I was a little nervous to try their new menu. I've traveled to Vietnam many times, so seeing the many different dishes on the menu for me to try is really awesome. As my appetizer, I ordered the Mango & Lime Mojito with lime, passion fruit, mint and cola. I ordered a shot of the Mojito with their orange juice and a shot of a regular Mojito with their orange juice. This cocktail was really refreshing. It was hot & I was so grateful to ISC for bringing me this amazing drink. I thought these were the best egg rolls that I have ever had. These are the " Crispy Rolls" at Monsoon Kitchen in a pan with the chicken filling. I enjoyed both dishes very much and went back at dinner after one hour. For appetties, we ordered 3 pieces of pork & shrimp. I ordered my entree. The scallops were sea scallops with a special sauce that I was craving. When I asked the server where he got them from, he didn't know. I thought he was not very good at giving answers but he did. I'm a huge scallop fan, but this one was way more unusual than either other ones I've had. It turned out to be one of the best scallops I've ever had. It came with a tangy lemongrass sauce as a side. They tasted like it was just from the sea. I appreciated how friendly and informative the entire staff was. I would definitely go again if I am in the area. I can't wait to visit this restaurant again.

Trainwreck Saloon, just south of the Westside Highway (Exit 5) on W. Main Street, is the perfect Bar. Trainwreck Saloon is a unique bar that offers a great variety of beers. There are no overcooking or undercooking burgers. They use the proper mix of butter, bread crumbs, and seasonings and never overcook it. The burgers are just delicious and I don't find they are as tough as I imagined they would be, but it's still pretty tender. Trainwreck is also known for their chicken wings. The hot sandwiches and garlic burgers are good enough for those of you that love eat-in-at-here. Trainwreck does offer various ways to hydrate you, such as the watermelon juice. They are not for sale until about 20 p.m., but they are a good bet. As the only time I've had ice tea during lunch, this drink costs $2.49. As a member you would receive a daily email that contains special offers. After you are done with all your rewards, you will receive a new debit card in your mailbox from Telugo.

I had the pleasure of checking out the restaurant, Steak Bar on 7th and the Deli. LOUD and not so hip. This family owned neighborhood deli is open every day. We were there just for lunch. All the meat is 100% Black Angus, beef-free and organic. Black Angus is an organic cattle feed with no GMOs or antibiotics. I LOVE meat.Fresh food is good. So, yes, that is cool. Aside from the burgers, I had the "Damn Burger". They did it right. The burgers was well-seasoned and seasoned with olive oil, garlic, onion, and ketchup. The burger was delicious. The sauce is topped with a little bit of black Angus and just a little chile pepper. I love how they added the onions to the sandwich. I also ordered one of their cheeseburgers. He couldn't remember since it was a tradition in the family restaurant at home. He had read about it on menu boards from far away and had heard it is simply "the best." It was not too bad, I got it because I was a little afraid to make my Muffalata too large. He ordered one whole sandwich and three smaller sandwiches. I would think of the French toast as a subpar meal, but they were so-so and still very good. I was able to get a portion of the fries served because I asked for two of the "those" sauce options. The fries are fried to perfection and are very flavorful. They have a nice menu that offers a bit of everything. When: Wed, 19 Jan 2014 from 12pm to 1pm. They also offer draft beer.

What a great restaurant. While this is not my home, I found this restaurant while searching the internet on Yelp reviews. I have been coming there for a couple of years now and will never stop. The food is excellent, and the atmosphere is fun. They do a great job with their Mediterranean meals, which are always fresh and delicious. In addition, I often go for the daily brunch specials, the brunch is a highlight. They have created a great menu of seafood and vegetables to satisfy any fish lover. Their Lamb Chops are prepared with the highest quality of lamb available. The steak was done medium rare and seasoned perfectly. The steaks were marinated and seasoned very well and also received rave reviews. I love getting my veggies on the plate as well. Since the restaurant is so hip (It's a nightclub in a neighborhood and the restaurant is all dressed up), there are many drinks on I love their Manhattans and am always in search of a creative house Manhattan or a modern combination of both. I was blown away with the Manhattan with an extra long rim of blood orange as well. I love the flavors the bourbon provides and how unique it is. It is just as good as any other American or Internationally crafted cocktail. I would encourage you to try one of these, I really do. The servers are friendly and they get you into your seat quickly. They even have a free "tour" around the restaurants. I've dined all over the area and highly recommend Polite Society, you definitely must stop by. It's a great view! I would strongly recommend staying at this establishment.

I have used the GYM for over a year now. It's a convenient location and very well maintained. Not only is the facility stocked with instruction and equipment, the owner is very helpful. They also offer on line payment for lessons on golf equipment. I really like the way the customer service and instruction is handled and the instructor is great. These lessons are fun and interesting and the employees at this facility seem knowledgeable and interested in learning. I've also used the batting cages and had excellent experiences. Most of my class has been here in my first three weeks of class but we've played since the first round of the year and they seem to have their Parking is difficult, but the parking is good. If you can sit inside and wait for an hour for your lesson it's worth it! Very annoying because the rest of the golf course is open. I've got to yell FORCE! Great way to start someone new to the game. Go Green!, again!

This place is not your typical food truck, this shop is great! After reading a few reviews about this new meat market in St. Louis, we decided to give it a try. My wife and I stopped in, it was one of our first stops in Fort Worth and it was worth it. I was just in town Saturday and had just entered to win a free beer. To my surprise we were on our way to their location. I was with family so our meal included sausage and bratwurst and they were all delicious. We ate, we sang and we took some photos. I ended up buying a bag of ham and I would have to be honest, I wasn't too hungry when I got home, but I still We then ordered their Original Short Rib Sausage. We also got a "Mick's " Pepper Jack cheese. We also also had to try the Buffalo Chicken. Lastly we had some ice cream since I have to use just about all the ice cream that is available here for a drink. A few different brand's were made so I decided to go for a few different bags from several different brands. G&W is about as small as a small town where they treat other people as though they are family. G&W is located at 1224 North Second Street in Greenwood Village. Thank you for allowing me to try the products at your place. I think they were more than happy to help. Get prepared.I am a believer in the outdoors and going to the wild.

This is a great gathering spot in the Park & it's so close to the Metro Station. I am a huge fan of Chicago Subs. There is nothing else quite like this spot! I started with a burger from this menu called The Lux Caution, the burger we were trying was awesome. To be fair I do not eat all the burgers, but I was able to eat almost two of one of the Caesars my friend The Caesar Salad was very simple to make it at home with a little lemon, dressing and a healthy amount of meat on it. I used it from my can of ranch dressing because it was so thicker than my chicken salad. A portion of them was served along with my cheese slaw. Why: ISC Gathering, April 20, 2019 Reason: Meetup with a ISC member in La Jolla. The drink choices are very good!

I recently had a great experience while dining at the Yellowbelly Restaurant, in downtown CWE. We went out for dinner with three friends to attend the opening of Yellowbelly. The quality of the food was excellent and the presentation was spectacular. I was truly impressed, and won't hesitate to recommend this great restaurant! An afternoon filled with great rums in every one of the sip, I opted for the, Arum Torte. I ordered the, Tropical Bloody Mary and enjoyed all three courses in the glass. I was pleased and glad that Tim recommended the rum, but it had to be the only thing that could give this place 3 stars. The food was incredible! I was a little iffy about the service but kindly explained to the waiter that it was not a bad thing, we had a However, Tim recommended I try the, "Crème de latte", with lime, granular chocolate chips, passion fruit, chocolate and coconut Although the meal was short (25 minutes), Tim was willing to take any additional orders and was super nice, helping me through the entire experience. I don't get a lot of time out on the interstate these days since I'm doing most of my business online. One of our favorite recent places to visit was Racanelli's. It is a really nice restaurant which is usually full of tourists at lunchtime. I wasn't sure that Racanelli's was offering lunch specials since they were located at the same location as 'Los Angeles' So it was only $9.99 for lunch. And I could list some of their specialty pizzas. I bought the lunch special for the meal, which was included in my Taste Card. This consisted of 3 plates (totaling 4 plates), 3 types of meat entrees, 2 pizzas, cheese, garlic bread, salad and There is a great variety of salads to choose from including a Caesar Salad which included Italian Sausage, Tomato- Basil, Basil and Black The Caesar Salad was excellent. I really enjoyed the Caesar Salad we got. At lunch it was my favorite way to eat it, even though it was the most expensive salad of the day. They also have two different Salads, which I was very excited to try. So when we came home we had an appetite for some more. As we sat and enjoyed our lunch, we stopped by for our pizza. In the picture below, they didn't have the bread trays to go with it, but, they had a few nice ones. The pizza was nice and crusty, but lukewarm. The pizza was perfect and very tender on the inside edges that you can taste the deep fried sausage and sausage bits. It wasn't as good as other NY style pizzas I have had at our own restaurants. I had a large slice of the pie which contained a great amount of pepperoni, jalapeno, onions, tomatoes and the sausage. The presentation was good, though I did have a hard time looking at it, because the top of it had so much cheese, ham, green onions The staff was friendly and it's not like that is the norm in New York. They have a huge selection and the food is very good.

I went to Florida and ate at Felix's Pizza on the Strip and got my pizza topped with some of their specialty sauces and an 8  I had one pint and one slice of pizza at Felix's a week morning. Felix's Pizza is a pizza joint that serves pizza by the slice. They let you choose from the pizza or choose pizza from the menu. You get a pint of their special recipe beer - just enough to make one slice (the entire thing). They also offer; Salami which is the same thing as a sandwich and we all know sausage isn't that good, and, pepperoni You don't have to choose from a pizza you didn't like, or a topping that you haven't tried before. They offer more meat and cheese options then a slice. I got the chicken wings. I never used to do it but this is how wings are cooked in Texas. I went with; Beef Buffalo. I went with; the Blue Buffalo Wings, with their signature Buffalo sauce, and the side of ranch. They also offer a subbed Buffalo sauce - no other buffalo sauce is offered. I'm pretty sure the sauce wasn't too spicy. I also went with: Thai BBQ Salsa, which is what I ordered. You could just do this and they would be amazing. I was so hungry! Their Specialty Pizza is my second choice. This was one of the best pizzas I've had in Pittsburgh, which makes it all the more so. I'm glad I did. The sauce on my slice was also nice and buttery and the pizza definitely had a kick to it. After eating, I had a full meal of beer in my hand. They are really friendly and willing to ask if we had any questions. We will definitely be back.

Bob's Seafood is one of my most favorite seafood stores in the area. But really, this is the kind of store they should make. I am a big fan of Ben Porembas, and I was looking to try his restaurant and get the best service I can for my date night I was not a fan of this place at all. It's a hole in the wall place. I ordered the Martini on an Apple Pie. We're all supposed to sample our own martinis. My boyfriend wanted it a little stronger. I was expecting more of a cocktail. As I was in a rush I found myself staring at my drink. My first dishes came out pretty quickly. A bit later on, I ordered, Cucumber Ravioli. The carrots were squishy and over cooked. I ordered the carrots with a side of sour cream on the side. The next dish was the Lamb Ribs. I don't need to say anything negative about this dish, it was mouth watering. Yes, but not as often as I need to. Not recommended..I won't be back.

It was my birthday and my first time in downtown Saint Louis and I was in charge of opening La Bourbon Steak House. It was so wonderful to see the team perform. For those that have not yet participated in a "Hamilton", feel free to visit one of the places below for the opening night. It definitely added to the vibe. The decor was beautiful and the menu was very good. Using my favorite, Bourbon, I tried their, Cherry-Bisquit of Sour Whiskey. The combination of the white rice, spicy asian sauce, fried chicken wings, and a light dressing made for an excellent option with some great flavor They were so delicious and the sauce was amazing. The sauce was quite tangy and had just enough sauce to be edible. When the waitress suggested the, Black & Blue Cocktail. The Manhattan itself had a nice bitterness after a few minutes on the tongue to give the drink more body and flavor. The bartender greeted me with "Dry, Sweet and Smoke". So I ordered the Classic Prime Angus Steak. The sandwich had a good amount of béarnaise sauce and a variety of veggies. The asparagus was absolutely fresh and tasted great. Asparagus is a great green vegetable and I loved the béarnaise sauce that is on top of it. I also got a side of polenta. I was speechless. It was paired well with the steak. I can't stand Ralph Lauren clothing. The store is always open so you can always go for a quick visit. They sell a lot of dresses but not all of them.
