I've been pretty much a fan of dolci di anna since I was a little girl! I thought, all of them were too small and they were just taking the goop out from your food. Regardless, I have found a cute little bakery in Alton. I found a new and beautiful bakery called Sweet Cravings. I walked up to the counter to pick up a sample of their delicious cakes. They were making a special for Anna's birthday on March 13. I walked over to the store which is across from the restaurant, and immediately fell in love. When I finally get around to going downtown, I stopped into Dolci di Anna. I think it was because of the small atmosphere, but the quality of her treats. Her cakes are light and moist. I'll start by asking the girl behind the counter, what is her favorite desert item, and what is next? Strawberry brownies are a classic. I love a good Strawberry brownie. I could eat this every day. For those of you who would not like the fresh strawberries, don't worry, there is a sweetener available (moreover, I love them The chocolate brownie was a little chewy, but still had a light, delicious flavor. It wasn't too sweet, it wasn't too creamy, it just wasn't nearly as moist. I don't have any experience baking sweets and I'm only here for the Strawberry brownies. This place was a great find. I ordered two different flavors of the Macaroons. It was a simple version of the classic Macaroon with lemon cream, white chocolate and sundried pear. I chose the chocolate and pistachio. I chose to get all three because I don't mind any kind of mix between texture and flavor. I ordered the raspberry-strawberry recipe, and it was delicious. Don't you think so too? I am thinking that's why I was so excited to go visit the place. She was very sweet and went out of her way to help me. If you go to find out more about this wonderful bakery, visit the Dolci di Anna website or Facebook page, and give them a call. I just didn't expect everything would be as good, but when it was, I felt like I got a real deal treat.

For those that don't know how this little hidden burger place is located, Spare No Rib has a full menu averaging over 90 But, I've always wanted to try something more...well, something more! Egg never really made burgers and I assumed that this was a sign of a weaker version of it. The Eggburger offers two options: the American Hamburger and the French Steak. It comes with a simple bun that serves as a bun with a patty that you can add toppings to. I ordered mine medium rare and it came together perfectly! When I was eating the burger, I was able to tell the inside it was pink on the outside. Toppings are pretty cool too. They used good quality lettuce and tomato and placed it on top of a brioche bun with a Bacon. But when I finished it they told me to leave half a burger half-eaten, which was fine. The cheese was a mix of cheeses and served with crackers. I can tell that all of the burger toppings are fresh and the burger itself looks wonderful. On the burger, I found plenty of cheese and bacon to go around, and they were cooked perfectly. What about you? - No. Where: Egg.. Yes..I know I won't be the only person to do that.

The owners of Blood & Sand are very excited to be hosting the next Yelp review show. This place is like no other- it is really a 3 day celebration of the people that make this restaurant what it is. I was in Las Vegas for a week and there is not a day I don't love this place. This restaurant is like a high end luxury hotel, but the feeling is not of hotel. In the main dining room you get to sit on their Tasting Table, but you can also order from the bar. Passion #1 - A Restaurant: The owner, Adam, and team are very pleasant, friendly, helpful, and the kitchen is clean and on point. They care about the health and safety of their guests. TJ is a great communicator and really knows what the restaurant is about. There was not a problem getting a spot in the Tasting Table, that was wonderful and I would recommend it to many other people. Passion #2 - The Chef: Steve DeGayl. I am incredibly proud of the chef I have met at Blood & Sand and I am sure you are as thrilled with him as I am. He was a great host and the atmosphere at this restaurant was great. You are never left with a food item you don't like, just because his taste buds want it back! Passion #3 - Great Service: The servers are very responsive and friendly. They definitely deserve to be the stars for the restaurant. This atmosphere and food reflects the passion to take care of your needs. Blood & Sand has received 6starred reviews and I am happy to have this place in my collection. They both enjoy the food and service that blood & sand provides. The food is amazing. The appetizers include the Grilled Lobster with Garlic Mustard and Lobster Tomato-Boil - All the seafood is mashed They are very fresh. A very large portion would make a pretty good meal. This one takes my breath away. They are seasoned well so you will be sure to get some for your next meal. The veal tartar was just right too. And a thank you to the owner and staff for the wonderful food and great service. Food: They have a good selection of traditional & unique dishes like stuffed mushrooms with sea bass and clams. Blood & Sand is good for the soul.. I'll make a big beeline from their tap room to make sure their Tasting Table is a great experience. I'm really lucky I was able to go there, that day, after going to the wine tasting room for my birthday anniversary with friends. What are your thoughts on Blood & Sand? Blood & Sand is the kind of place you want to be emaciated after, so let us know what your experience was like. Blood & Sand is a family owned restaurant in the heart of Phoenix and is known for consistently providing excellent cuisine and a very friendly service. This is a place I will return to at least once a month for their outstanding food, bartenders and service. Their food is deliciously fresh with a lot of flavor, they do the "tasting" of the dishes before you eat it, which means I also would recommend the pizza.

I haven't been to the B&G since I was a kid, but this place is always a stop for me. It is a great place to get a breakfast when you are in town and has a lot of breakfast specials, but, I like trying the On Friday morning I order the morning special Bacon, Waffle, and Biscuits & Gravy. I just need that quick pick up between work and home. But, when I get off of work, I'm more excited to try some of their Biscuits & Gravy Breakfasts. It is the perfect breakfast after a long working week and the people are always friendly. I usually get a biscuit with sausage gravy or just egg and potatoes, but today they did not have the sausage gravy included. I was expecting a cheese sauce in my biscuits but it was just milk sausage gravy. It's so good! I also get their egg blinis. Their Eggs Benedict is also a hit. What I liked is that there is an open kitchen area with very helpful wait staff. Probably will give it another try, but I'll be back soon. That breakfast is the perfect start if you have long time to hit up another local breakfast place. I do enjoy breakfast at B&G and definitely plan to eat there again before the day is over. Definitely.It would be a treat to see you there and see your favorite breakfast. So, you could say Biscuits & Gravy is my favorite breakfast dish around here.

I discovered The House of sandwiches recently after searching high and low for someplace of quality. They feature beautiful artwork created by the in house artists. This lunch was special because it was the first time that I had seen this restaurant. I was recommended to the restaurant by the server who was incredibly kind and recommended a few of his recommendations. A friend of Ian's recommended a Smoked Beet Sandwich. The whole experience, of course - was amazing, but my mouth was watering! It was only once that I would venture beyond a single sandwich because for the price, I know I'll only return to twice. I love to watch my food come out of the oven to get me prepared to eat. The Smoked Beet Sandwich is a perfect balance between the meats and vegetables. The two side sandwiches were well shaped. It was a perfect bite. It was so delicious it was difficult to bite back at it. That's how quickly it got all kind of smeared on my food. But oh well, I wouldn't want to let that get in the way of gushing out the delicious sandwich. That really wasn't really a big issue though. My favorite part was the cole slaw. I had a taste of the hot salsa on both sides as well. However, I did not love the sandwich. I did have one issue though. This left a few pieces of bread that I had to cut off before eating. I've worked with restaurants all over the country and have heard great things about this place. On both counts I can say that this was a very good sandwich. They also have an excellent wine selection and great local food trucks to get you out and about.

For a week end lunch at Leakey's, on January 15, 2021, I was fortunate enough to be part of the DeCaro restaurant They were there from 11am-2pm. At lunch we purchased two items from the menu; a Spicy Salad and a Bloody Mary. We shared the salad. The house salad was large and very rich in veggies. It was a little hearty and a perfect size for a lunch. The dressing was a fresh lemony orange marinara. The main course of the main dish was a huge pasta dish with seafood and a simple Caesar style salad. Meals were served with a salad tray available for each person. If you are dining here during ARW, consider ordering the raviolis. It was a little unusual, but it was good. This had just enough sauce, and salt and pepper, to give it a little kick. The raviolis came with a large mound of tomatoes, and was toasted through and flavorful. We had a great appetite, but I will admit, I didn't try the restaurant itself for a while, which made the experience more bearable It was a nice lunch for four, and we were all hungry enough after. The lunch special was great, and the chicken, pancetta and Italian dressing was fresh. However, the food and service on offer were really good. This place offers fresh ingredients, and plenty to eat, which can be found every day. The wait staff was friendly and the servers were helpful on tips on how to make their lunches more enjoyable, while still serving the guests.

This is the 3rd time we are in your establishment, and this time we went in today. I've been hearing about you for a couple of weeks but I don't find your menu and service as good as others'. What: I can't give a 3-Star review because I don't enjoy it. You can't expect anything without having to give it more than 3 stars. I've tried the seafood/veg. My girlfriends and I have been coming to Pho Pho for the past three years and the food has always been decent. They are all very good, however the dish I'm most drawn to is: Tamarind. There are two reasons and I have two reasons for this. One - The old diner at the corner of 67th and 6th Sts. does not even have this place on a Yelp Second - I am shocked that it did not make the MLS Top Ten for Food of the Week. If only he were an American Diner Owner! G-B Grill is only an extra 25 minutes away from the Denver airport and rightfully so. If you don't believe me, check out their patio. The seating is comfortable with a front counter and you can order from the small menu available either in front of or behind the counter. Besides the size of the restaurant, the place is huge and welcoming. I also noticed that they have a big screen TV running the music videos that they play. You can see the butter, eggs and hash browns right from the middle of the floor. The kitchen is small, but incredibly, fun and has a vibe that tells you a lot about the diner. A selection was on offer and it was all great. They are very good at what they do, but what I love most about them is that they are very early to open for breakfast. Some of the items that I like are breakfast potatoes and the eggs. I noticed that there isn't a lunch menu, but I just happened to see that they make their coffee fresh. I also love their Bacon Plater. On my first visit, it was made fresh (the bacon was fresh too). The bacon is crisp, not like a frozen bacon. A special treat is that if you want your hash browns cold, you can have them heated out a bit, so that the warm hash You can see they are prepared by hand with your order ready, and then placed on the flat grill, ready to begin cooking a perfect meal. We were told this because we were just brought in to check, and we also told them that the potatoes are made fresh. Also, I ordered a hotcake for my breakfast with it. A nice touch there is the use of fresh ground sage. If you think I am stating things lightly, then this is not. This was my second visit and they were much better. They were wrapped in a butter wrapper that was wrapped in bacon. Some people can get that "buffalo" on their pancakes, but not here. The one thing that didn't win my heart, though, was the cinnamon syrup. They do not over fry, so they do not cook the eggs too hard like many places do. If you enjoy classic French toast and bacon, then this is the place to be. They also offer gluten free options, so it is a great little spot to go for their food. In my opinion, when not making a meal there, your best bet is to check out this restaurant. I have no complaints with the food at G B Grill. This is a great place to go, so much so that I have had more than my fair share.

Day 4: I went to Poutinelicious for lunch Monday, February 27, 2017. The restaurant is really bright, it's been open for about a year. The waitress walked in like I need to know who I was, and why I needed to come. It's a nice size, a medium style table with a glass of wine and they offered the "Taste of New Orleans". I was a bit upset on having to wait for such a long time for something. I then tried the Smoked Chicken Salad. I tried it and thought it was good. I ordered the Poutinelicious and the cheeseburger. The taste of it was excellent, lacked any bad food-related taste. I gave the Poutinelicious a 5 and I wish we would have ordered more Poutinelicious. I tried to enjoy the lunch however, the taste and texture wasn't good. They aren't particularly happy to take orders. The Poutinelicious was served by an American couple, but they went out of their way to help us in the kitchen. Still, we had a couple good beers, and the prices were reasonable. I might, but not with Poutinelicious. The prices don't compare but it may be a nice quick lunch somewhere between the two.

This review is from my experience at the Bob Evans in Fort Worth. My daughter's birthday cake was a gift bag from a neighbor. I decided, this is the place. What I really like about this restaurant is that the restaurant is very comfortable to sit in. A new bathroom and a remodeled restaurant entrance were added. The most memorable item was the Eggs Benedict ( Eggs Benedict is the American breakfast staple), but there were too many good items to eat at once. I like omelet with a small amount of cheese, since it is all thicker. I liked the spinach, but not the Portabella Mushrooms. This was also a very satisfying breakfast with a cup of sausage gravy and two sides and two of the fresh baked Hash Browns. It had enough crispness on both sides of my favorite chicken wings. I feel that the bread and the eggs could have been thicker, but it was good overall. The breakfast was excellent. This breakfast was an exception, the food was tasty, but not everything was what I expected. It's a classic country dish, filled with a bacon, egg, biscuit and gravy. You also have the choice to add your choice of country style bacon, chicken or sausage. He couldn't resist adding his choice of breakfast bread (the specialty one was buttermilk biscuits and the other was plain white) with his breakfast and got On the other hand, in our order our DP had a biscuit, the butter had been fried and he did not have any gravy on This is not just my personal experience, I hope you enjoyed it as much as we did! I ordered for my friend as she was in a big hurry and she also loved the sausage. The breakfast was amazing and we both agreed we'd go back. My server, Amy was very friendly and helpful. I believe most servers are more than happy as long as their server is friendly. She was very informative and taught us everything we needed to know about the chicken eggs. I'll definitely bring my friend here again. We were excited to walk straight out to Costco and enjoy our breakfast. It will be a bit difficult. I could recommend it. However, I had a great meal as I was taking a walk around Costco.

It was so great to meet up with my friend and I for our International Supper Club dinner at Redi's Restaurant & Bar. The 'Safia' in San Antonio, Texas is an authentic Brazilian kitchen. They are located in a beautiful space on the north side of the hotel and have a nice seating area. My cocktail was the Cachaca cocktail. Translation - White Wine & Cucumber cocktails. The drink has a mix of an Irish Cream cocktail with Cachaca, and a white lime juice. The cocktail was very flavorful. I loved the lime flavor. I was given a shot- shot for my cocktail. The ingredients that made it are actually more fruity than anything you would find at the grocery store. They also offered a plate of dish that is very traditional Brazilian. This is a traditional Brazilian dish of chicken breast topped with collard greens, pickles and marinated with tomatoes, peppers and coriander I ordered it topped with their signature collard greens. The meat was quite tender. Its was not as rich as other Brazilian restaurants but definitely a very filling meal. Our server said the meat was rare and tender. My chicken side dish of the day was the polenta and it tasted great as well. The rice was medium in texture. It was warm and tender and the vegetables were cooked well. The steak was cooked just right and the salad vegetables were also cooked just right. They were also very friendly. I felt that the service was just fine. Hopefully she is going to take more care with what her team does, because we would have had issues involving our server or waiting, but when I asked The food was delicious, and the price was right for a restaurant in South Grand Blvd. I hope you enjoy something new on your next visit! The food is fantastic and it's an awesome little place.

The "Best of the Week" – WB: This was our second visit to the place. I've been there on 5/21 and it was pretty good. 1) I love the early morning hours there. Yes, it's a 5 AM, but how long do you leave to go to Cafe's with a coffee? 2) They have the best breakfast around. You can order more than one. 3) This is so good it makes a great side dish with beans/cabbage. Very fresh, and the omelet has a sauce you can throw in your salad - no butter needed. 5) The drink selection is extensive. It's perfect for daytime and evening dinner. 6) It was a good experience. Good, affordable breakfast for the price. 7) I found the food to be average. I might..? What time?- 7:00 PM. Please let me know!

Usually a good night out is one for the best, but when you get in the restaurant for lunch, the food is not good, and the food TGP has closed, their new location called The Loop which I have been reading all about. I have lived in the area for a number of years and I often talk about my experiences with previous restaurants. I recently went back in to visit and was disappointed. The restaurant always had a waitress, but, the food tasted just as bad. Then there was the server. I was there for lunch on Memorial Day and the server yelled out that we were free to sit wherever we wanted. What did a server do here in the Loop? A friend and I ordered lunch and had a great time. I will stop my texting and go straight to my dinner. This isn't the first time the restaurant has been this silent. The server was kind and offered a few items for our conversation. We opted to order a glass of water. When I asked what other drinks they offered and he told me that they did not sell beer, they offered a special cup of water. We ordered the Bloody Mary and then waited 45 minutes for the bartender to come out and make it. After he asked if we would like tea. We did not have enough water or ice in our drinks or the DP requested a lite milkshake. When it came to our main course, the food tasted the same as I remember it from the old location. He returned and asked us if they sold out of soda. It could have been a more flavorful and more tasty salad. So the food came out perfectly, hot and fresh, perfect for a lunch sandwich. Just because they closed, it doesn't mean they have lost their touch. I will not be returning to the Loop or their other locations anytime soon because of this.

We both had lunch together today and were driving late. As our meal came to my car, it was in the middle of the night, but we weren't full from a late night. The restaurant was a little busy, but the staff was super friendly. Two of us had the Burger- It was good. It turned out that my friend had the spam burger and wasn't too impressed with it. It's a good thing I was at Sonic, as we could eat a little later, before our meals started. The Mac'n Cheese had a great taste! They are soggy so I couldn't even finish the tots - but I was good. Sonic is a great place to eat. I can't wait to go back!

I was introduced to the White Castle at college. I remember a few years back when I was going through my file cabinets and remember getting the "Jam House Burger" which was a stale This time the place isn't so great. I guess if you're really not drinkin a lot it is worth a try. If you are over 21 (not going to see me).

I was shocked when I opened my box and found a $5.99 carryout pizza on the back. It was a wonderful dinner that just didn't fit in the schedule we ate for three dinners during the week. It is not a chain, but I don't think Bono's has it right. Despite this they still had a special. This was the first time in my history that I have been to a restaurant that offered such a deal before. That brings it to $10. Getting the pizza is pretty simple. After filling out the information I had to order a couple extras. The only requirement is that the order be picked up by the 9th of the month. I'm not saying that the deal is bad, just that its not the best one (and I am usually a little more reasonable in terms of costs This pizza had a large crust. This Pizza did not have extra cheese and the crust had a nice crust with the sauce and cheeses on it. My wife wanted cheese on her pizza and I wanted a cheeseburger and pizza... and she wasn't a fan of pepperoni. The food was really good judging from the fact that I got 3 slices of pizza and 1 Coke for $5.99! The employees were friendly and helpful. In addition, the ambiance here is not very romantic, but it works well. I would definitely order from Domino's and recommend them to anyone.

All I had to offer on the bill today was a free burger, drink, and menu item from this little local place that had recently signed up as I happened upon Jab Bistro on Friday night on their Facebook page. Luckily, this BOGO coupon turned the corner. At least not as shabby. They have some great drinks and the restaurant itself has a cool vibe. A sample of their burgers and a drink from their happy hour. I ordered a medium burger and a medium burger. The buns were dry and we had to use hand tools to add them onto the burgers. One of the best burgers I have ever had. Our favorite part of a burger at JAB is their sweet potato chips. They were a little bit tough and cold but nothing bad. Crinkle fries may be a nice addition to your burger, but it is not a way to give the burger a better taste. We also had the shrimp blasted with peppers and lemon with our burger. When I see lemon pepper wings in a new place, I usually just like the lemon flavor as long as it isn't too bold. It was a good taste and the garlic mayo really added a little bite. The waitress was friendly and it was a pleasant experience. They are small but it was not crowded. The bouncer was more friendly than the other two in the room. If you are looking for something new and fun, JAB is the place. My favorite part of the meal was being seated at a table. The bar was dark and very loud.

I always come to OfficeMax where I need products and then it's a good experience. It's big and bright and feels like you're coming in to a dark secret office. I like its new location and the fact that it's just next to the Dollar Tree. I got some supplies on sale. It's definitely not a huge OfficeMax, but this store is very convenient so I just think it's going to work.

I love my cars. I used to have the opportunity to wash and detail my CRV here in the UT area and was impressed with the service at both HCW and the It was great, but the service was bad, and I could never afford it any more. And with that being said, the WGW Waterway Car Wash opened today. My car came to the Waterway in Mesa, Arizona today. What I love about the owners is that they are always looking for ways to make their car wash better. You got me thinking. The staff was friendly and well trained. They have plenty of soaps and water, which make Carlos feel so silky clean on the inside. Carlos is a professional painter and his car always does well. Carlos really does need to go to a clean car a lot, but I do know his father can handle a proper wash. You should try them out too.

I have been going to SC for years and it is definitely one of my favorite places to shop. There was a recent increase of small stores in the area. It is located about a 25 minute walk from the airport and the mall. Is this a great place to shop? It was not too bad. I must admit I was a bit taken aback that they have such a great selection as this store is. They were so knowledgeable about a small selection of clothing and items. I was completelyblown away by how many different styles they had. I think the store's shelves were well organized. I have to admit, there is a lot of clothing on display that I don't like. My favorite items were my favorite pair of socks and many other selections. Not to mention free shoes every day. There is also a lot of variety in mens, womens and children's shoes. They even served me lunch.

Papa Murphy's Pizza offers a limited selection of Stuffed Pizzas. We ordered a large, medium, and half size. Our first bite was fantastic, the flavor was different and the crust was so thin. This is something we would have liked on a normal pizza with only some filling. The dough is rolled out into an X box. They put the fillings on top of the dough, and then cut the tomato sauce in half. The pizza itself is just a basic pizza with a lot of toppings but you had to be prepared or we wouldn't have wanted it. After about 45 minutes in the oven they are ready. There are two sizes of pizza. There are tons of them to choose from. I could not fit my two friends into the large and the toppings all ended up on the bottom. For my husband and I, he will take half a pizza and freeze half and make two sandwiches. Pizza is amazing here! I would expect that it would take time to cook the crust, but Papa Murphy's would not sacrifice anything for your pizza. I never have to wait for my pizza, this place is always open.

It is sad to lose a favorite restaurant. This is not a special day for me, it is a sad day for my Southern husband. Llywelyn's has had some great wings since I was a kids girl as well. You could eat as much as you wanted and it was just that much more filling with a tiny amount of eatables. I am never sure why I just give them a bad review without doing something about it. You just can't be sure if you are getting a bad batch. I remember the flavor of what I used to like as far back as when I lived in Wisconsin and had an office full of them every month and every summer. I will however stick with the chips as a side dish. I am assuming that they are a frozen and packaged item and they only eat the chips when they are not cold. Since our first visit, we always have made chicken salads our lunch items. It can be a bit overpowering but I love the taste and the vegetables in it. It was really a disappointment with the Cobb Salad. We had four chicken breasts and the greens were just plain tastier. The salad was gross, not that the dressing was bad, but I will not ever order that kind of lettuce again. The chicken was extremely dry and tasteless, the potatoes were the only edible part. This salad had the same brown and hard eggs served as the Cobb Salad. If you're cooking eggs, not a problem, but if not there was a good chance they were over cooked. I also wasn't able to taste any of the vegetables. The salad was ok, not a fan of it. I ate the whole thing and was almost full. The Cobb Salad had a few small pieces of chicken and we did not want to eat all of it if we were trying to save money. We got home pretty quickly, however, we paid for our lunch. We did not mind paying extra because we knew the prices would be higher by the time we went back. We decided to walk over and order some food because we both really enjoyed the food andambiance. I just wish they offered Ice Tea as an option from the lunch menu rather than the sodas.

I recently visited the new DSLC location. They changed to a electronic system to let customers track their own lines and wait in line. The machine questions you about where you park your vehicle, what you have driving license, your name, and your license Plate Number. Then you fill out your order and wait for the machine to call you and show you your receipt. Then text "Rack UP" when you are in line. The text carries the time to print and scan your license plate. If you entered your cell phone number, they will text you when it's your turn for a new customer. You don't have to worry because someone will text you back the instant your turn is over. There are also clocks behind the tables indicating the estimated time it could take you to get your plate. They also have an automated ticket printer. And it didn't get crazy. It's not as busy as some other offices, but it has a better experience. If I had to wait outside the line to get my plate, it would be too long. The location looks nice, it's spacious and has very clean offices. Also, since I had to wait, I got a free plate.

Every time we need to hit up in a store that's not close enough to our house to stop. The big entrance is inside this one story building. There are many things for animals in different breeds and sizes. If you're looking for a bit of fun or have the cash for dog owners' needs, this is the place to go. They can be a little difficult to navigate in busy times just at their entrance but the staff was helpful and knowledgeable. I ordered the Turkey Strip Pizza, which is very similar to one of my favorite pizza places in New Orleans. The server pointed me to an array of salads and offered my option - I could get the larger ones or the smaller ones. WildSmoke BBQ brings the new wave of BBQ and cooking to St Louis. They have opened their doors for business and the concept they are bringing is outstanding. The main dish was a nice mix of chicken, shrimp, duck and even a grilled salmon for a small side of added taste. The Garlic Ribs were seasoned with some garlic and then placed on a baking tray. They have made the mac and cheese from scratch for a long time, and the sides that are prepared in house are fresh, tasty and all made right there A unique, tasty side dish of meatless tater tots and sauteed onions. During the meal, the smokehouse employees also help provide service. This side is made with a special sauce that tastes like a sauce the burgers can only be made with. Their baked beans are a real star, and the root beer baked beans are my favorite on the menu. The Mac-n-Cheese was good, but not good enough to make my order, and I will never be back here. The Mac-n-Cheese comes in a regular size package but is made in a bigger format. The Smoked Beef burger is served with a classic sauce that is smooth, medium and medium rare. I thought I'd like one more word, that all was incredibly good! They also have two different sauce available, "Smoke Me Down" which is made with an actual apple sauce, which they use to finish their sides With a great menu, reasonable prices, their atmosphere is what sets WildSmoke apart.

You can't let those eyes escape you at this spot. Mel and Mike were kind, but I was not impressed with their meat and cheese selections. I've been into food and bars for a while; but never one that was totally unique. This is especially true when it comes to venues that I previously lived in, like the The Hill. I had my own aha experience last night at 1860 Bar & Grill, for a happy hour. They've got pretty good food and a really good selection of beers at a reasonable price. It's not always a place you can find the best drinks and entertainment, but it is the perfect bar to celebrate life's milestones. They were really good, even when they were just looking at each other, but I think they were just having fun. My friend from DC had the classic Texas Hold Em and she enjoyed it very highly. The beer selection was not nearly as good as I was used to, but I really enjoyed all the beers I tried. Not only are the drinks outstanding, but the menu options are great. The thin crust pizza is really good. The draught beer was also good. So go back and give this bar a try. Loved The House, will be back soon.

I've been a long way off at Bison Ranch and have to confess that I've not gone without a burger. I usually order the 1/2lb Ribeye over medium rare. The burgers are just great. They cook faster for sure. The burgers are not deep fried and are all prepared on house. We haven't stopped visiting since a family friend introduced us to them. They'll substitute sweet potato and onion. I'd go nuts with just one! You may also see them at the Smoke Shop for their Smoked Brisket Tacos. I've tried everything on the menu and I've never had anything that I don't like. I'm not a fan of the Fish tacos especially if you're like me, but if you like brisket, They have a huge menu for all your food-entensy needs. I ordered the Triple Decker Chocolate Cupcake. Its so good, I just hope that the waiters take this one off the menu so I can try it again later this year. Oh and don't forget to eat their fresh baked sweet potato chips.

Salt & Vine is located at the corner of South and St. Louis st. Salt has been on my "must visit" list for ages. Salt has been acclaimed by Yelp, and is located on the 1st floor of the Embassy Suites. The restaurant is spacious with some good seats and seats of plenty to fit everyone's needs. The staff is extremely friendly and efficient. I ordered the lemony lemon chicken salad (it was out of this world) with extra aioli. It was amazing!!. My parents and I ate all three meal on April 8 and enjoyed every bite. Our order was all delicious. All three of these dishes have been recommended by a number of other food critics. I can't wait to see what they make next. We were pleased to have found this place to be both charming and spacious. In the Spring, the weather was perfect for our visit. The staff is very friendly, helpful to each other, and our server was even extra friendly during lunch. The cheesecake we ordered with cream cheese would probably get the same treatment. I have had better luck on the outdoor patio with their BBQ dinners but on an average day it's a good experience. One thing is for certain though, the freshness of all the dishes! I'll be back.

I am a big fan of cheese and cream ice cream. I ordered one tub of vanilla and two other different flavors. I also try different ways to eat the ice cream. Towards the end of our visit I picked up a case of the naughty (also known as "Moscow Mule" So as one of my friends who has been having cocktails as part of his life, I was excited to try the naughty version of The Moscow Mul I know, It's something I've never tried on cake, but I was so excited. What all the buzz really means? Unfortunately, I was wrong, and as we headed down the patio, I was totally blown away by the berries and the flavors. I love the taste and I just couldn't stop myself from ordering a side dish because I knew I was gonna have to make another visit. It was so creamy and dense it could not get the job done. It was a huge hit and I am even a sucker for the "Moscow Mule" in the "Slush Machine". However, my bad boy behavior has caused me to have a hard time getting re-stocked. I ordered the Rib eye roll with bacon, ham, and biscuits on top of it. Both of these were delicious and were served with a cup of hors d'oeuvres on side. This makes me feel very authentic. My waitress greeted us from the second I walked in, so after taking our order, she had us all lined up to get some personal service I was quite impressed and am now looking forward to having their brunch service at work. This was a Sunday Brunch and the only thing I wasn't happy about was the waiter who wanted to eat my meal and leave a

It's been a long time since my girlfriend allowed me to go to the Alton Hamburger on Main Street. I'll admit that MCH is the fastest burger joint around and they have the best Root Beer. Although I typically never go out for Sunday Brunch, on Sundays I do. I love breakfast just the same way anyone loves their dinner. I always recommend this particular place, TSA. I sat down and had three very simple food specials. The brunch menu comes with a choice of two drinks each: a Bloody Mary and an Omelet. You can mix it up, add bourbon, sugar shot or lime. Next I decided to order an omelet to share with my friend. At last, you can eat your way into a great place for some good meats and sides. It's the first time I've had this kind of meat that is 100% pulled over a coal bed for a smokehouse BBQ. If you are going with kids, they have a variety of dog treats and hot dogs, ranging from bacon and mayo to tater tot Meat is pulled from the smoker and then you have to cook in or cook at the oven as well as in the smoker. The menu includes everything from breaded chicken to pickled vegetables to some of Bob's favorites - a pulled pork sandwich, a pulled pork You can order online or you can just drop in.

First time to Benton Park Cafe in Arsenal. Our local restaurant, Benton Park Cafe served amazing sandwiches for $11.95, so I thought I would try one out. I printed the coupon and brought it with me on a Tuesday afternoon out for dinner. Benton Park Cafe has an impressive interior design and is located downtown on Arsenal Street in the heart of Manhattan. We arrived at the restaurant at around 7pm on a Friday night. By walking in, I almost felt like a little dog. Brad would have preferred the inside, so we picked the outdoor seating. Both of us ordered Bloody Mary's. The Bloody Mary came with a garlic butter cream sauce and a cup of fresh squeezed lime juice. I love the tangy sauce on the glass and it adds the kick and flavor to my drink. It was a Bloody Mary that had the flavor of summer fruits without the strong alcohol. We also ordered a Nacho Truck - The Best Nacho Truck We Have Yet. It was made by the slow cooker and they got it hot and spicy to order. They were excellent and packed with flavor. There were other sandwiches, including the Marinated Beef Tip Melt and the Blackened Beef Tenderloin. We had the Mediterranean Salad in Caesar Dressing. The Caesar is on brown bread. All you can eat is the Caesar Salad and I really liked the fresh veggies on top! I was pretty suprised when they brought out French Fries but was happy not to be in the frying department. I really enjoyed the menu with the flavors and bread. The wraps were good too, my husband thought the ranch dressing was really good. They were fresh, hot, and hot. That is what I needed for my sandwich. The topped with rice, romaine lettuce and balsamic marinades. I thought the Meatball Sandwich was the highlight. Both sandwiches were topped with a piece of darkened, 8 oz. meat, served with Swiss Cheese on Toasted French Bread. Great meal and not too expensive either. We will be back. If you like good sandwiches, eat there.

On my recent visit to Soulard in Soulard, I was not disappointed. The venue is very welcoming inside and out, in the perfect neighborhood neighborhood. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable about the items in the cafe. The front staff is extremely nice and friendly and never lets you down. As we walked through the cafe entrance we were greeted with a sign that said it was a coffee & cafe. We wereseated right away and had a great coffee and conversation. For a little extra money extra, I upgraded to a patio seat as well as table for two. It looks so very similar to any coffee shop or cafe I've ever had and I like that they have a variety of artists on the wall. After ordering, we finished off with a Brie Veggie Omelet. We shared the BrieVeggie Omelet which is a large omelet, with a side of spinach on top. Not a traditional omelet, but it had the right amount of spinach for me because I had a green leafy vegetable, which they cooked in The omelet was not soggy like you would find at another breakfast place, but it was still very filling and the food was delicious without being over They added a nice texture to the egg with the cheese and the mushrooms were just fine. I decided to try their Corned Beef omelet. They were deep fried and loaded with potatoes, arugula and a huge amount of corned beef. And you could definitely do worse :D. It was a really good bowl as well, good quality food. The Hash & Eggs were served on a fresh farm-casted hill which kept the flavors from tasting too much. We both got the Biscuit & Gravy. It was very good, and the biscuits were not too hard andggy, my husband couldn't stop licking a whole bag of them. I loved the meat that included chicken, ham, onions, bell peppers and sausage. They did explain how they have to use their biscuits and it was explained that if the biscuit was hard, they poured it over the gravy. All we wanted was some salt, bread and one piece of sausage. This was our day, and we think they have been pretty busy, but I will be back to try that next time we are in the area. As the conversation went and I began to want to try the omelet myself, I figured I could try another place that was better. I was disappointed, I've tried many places to get the taste of the real thing and this was the only place to succeed.

This is one of the best pizza places in Indianapolis. I had a group of friends over to APS and had been there for lunch. I took one look and was floored because they looked like them. That is understandable. The waitress told them with so much love that they could not miss a single pizza served there. A nice place to be, with great food! At one point in our meal, we had the delicious strawberry and peach sangria. They had the regular sangria selection with iced lime and the dark rum sangria that was based on their local grape. When we left for the lunch counter, we had two choices, calamari and soups. I thought the first bite was worth my time and the second bite was beyond good. They were crispy and extremely light. After I took a bite of my friends' favorite pizza with some sauce, I wanted to try a glass of wine. It was so good. The sauce was served with a dash of ham and was so good, there wasn't any sauce needed. We ended with the fettuccine all'amatriciana. We started with a salad. The ingredients were fresh and cooked to perfection. I definitely recommend it. I had the Spicy Ranch Spicy Chorizo pizza. APS has what I would call a "pretty" specialty pizza using Argentine chorizo with a little ham and cheese. Somehow it all came together to give you a great pizza. This pizza was just perfect, but what stood out in my mind was the combination of pasta, sauce, chowder and crostini The sauce is a thin crust based with a garlicky ranch flavor, but it adds an excellent flavor. I had the green chile chicken salad, which was also ok, nothing spectacular. I am certain that all in the restaurant, including my server, had the same goal in mind: to provide a great food experience. APS received a great review with this visit. The pizza was fantastic, but one thing I think will stay with me will be the chicken or fish pie.

This year my boyfriend and I took a trip to Soulard in MD and Molly's Deli had the best choice of places to go dining. I was not disappointed. We were dining at a hotel and I had not even been on Yelp for 2 weeks. The food was good and had some unexpected twists. I'll talk about these things after I've actually had a chance try them. I know my review is a bit late, but this was my first encounter with Molly. Since I had already been following their Facebook page for a while I really thought we would enjoy a dining experience. The staff is friendly and helpful. We both felt very welcomed here. We ordered some dishes that I'm sure some people have heard about before, but don't let them scare you away. We were pretty happy with the tuna - not too much flavor and plenty to keep us wanting more. They're not going to beat the original version much but it is still good. We ended our meal with some Shrimp and Crab cakes. This wasn't to my taste, but I definitely enjoyed it. We left the restaurant, hoping to grab a bite here again. We tried the Alligator. It was amazing, it did not smell like the grill in this picture, but it was actually in a volcano. I was blown away. At the bottom of the dessert page you'll find a chocolate sauce. The prices are what I would consider fair and the location and service are what have kept this place going. We both had this, my husband's and mine both slammed it on the table.

I discovered this place some time during the recent renovation to the CWE. It is a little unique for their food. Kingside Diner is located at 2514 Bonhomme Ave. (St Louis, MO 63103). All in all I was a little hesitated to give The Slinger a try, as I was a little nervous. I know, I know it's not the greatest dish on the menu, but it is good. However, the server told me the Daily Delight (DD) wasn't available this morning. The Slinger is very filling, it has a side of onions along with sausage gravy. I had a thought it was a great dish, but not only the DD is excellent, Eric loved it! They had it on special until I was getting ready to see the menu. The Vegetable Hash looked tasty, and I was hungry. They take fresh Brussels Sprouts, Swiss Cheese, hummus, arugula and arugula dressing. I added a half plate with a side of spinach and a whole piece of cooked bacon. I couldn't finish the Veggie Hash, I was stuffed. A little goes a long way when it comes to lunch. They give us one of my all time favorites, the Egg vs. Biscuit. I actually had the original with lots of ham, then I took a bite of the Brussels Sprouts. It is served with a layer of wheat bread and seasoned with onion and cheese. I could have ate 2 dishes! I have been happy eating here at Kingside Diner in Clayton for years. It was a great lunch. They have an upscale dining experience, but can't beat the staff at Kingside Diner. I have enjoyed their breakfast and lunch too. The staff is always willing to do more and their prices aren't beaten. The waiter is a pleasure too. Would you choose to eat there again? I'll be. And of course, if you have a birthday coming up this year... try them out!

This store has a great coupon section. We have made the frequenting to a habit, they keep us well stocked on the shelves, and have great value. The store has excellent food selection and they also have good prices on items. We bought a bread machine here, but the customer service is not good. There is something to be said for their staff though - this store is so nice to deal with. We had an excellent experience. It didn't matter what the items, they were always helpful. Well, I ain't going back. The store is really quite large and has alot of toys and gadgets to browse.

This Target is located in downtown Chicago, right off of the 69. The Targets here are huge with the store size being small. There is always a lot of people walking around and being talked to. They always have your name on the bill, give you the price you need to pay a quick visit to get what you need quickly and efficiently, and just My question is always what can I do to make it easier for me. The customer service was also great here with no problems at all. I use my Target card when I buy stuff online, they never charge me. In addition they have great items for the home. That's because of the fact that they have an almost 30 foot x 10 foot section where there's a new line of items each year. I took a lot of pictures there and loved them. I will continue to use this store. I'm still looking for my new car.

The reviewer mentioned the restaurant recently received a second star because of their execution, service and management. This restaurant just did not live up to their past reviews. I had two visits and both were disappointing. It felt like my drinks were made on the same day, but my order never made it to the correct bartender. Service is an issue here if you are a single lady and it is no joke. I would recommend going by his name because he is just a rookie, but that just not enough to earn my trust. The bartender was very pushy with everyone who came to sit at his table. At least when he's with the bartenders around him, he knows they'll not go out and have someone make dinner for him If the restaurant is open late, expect to wait. I had heard that some of the sauce was already a little runny. I ordered 3 servings of them as I figured a large portion of my meal would take me 2 hours. A negative, it was a terrible meal if you can imagine what a mess this would be. The other dish that will continue to be my go to in the future will be the Steak and Grits. If you are looking for a great appetizer there are a few to choose from, including the Chicken Tenderloin. I've said it's an excellent spot in my Top 3 Top Chef dishes. This is a dish you will be singing along with and singing till the end of your journey. I think it's best to go elsewhere for anything you're looking on at either any restaurant that specializes in these items or has a good selection There's still room for more of them, but they took themselves too seriously so I'm sure you won't be disappointed. I wouldn't say.

I've been requesting Insomnia Cookies and I'm a bit too picky about them. In my opinion I like the warm cookies at Blue Bell. They had 2 of the 4 flavors I ordered, but I am not a fan of any of the other flavors. But they don't get the 3 stars I give to any other cookie place. One would think they would be better than other shops, but they're a chain. I have a history with the PF products - for my wife and I, this is an issue that comes up quite often. I would rather visit another ice cream shop to get my ice cream fix. I have not eaten the PF, but I know what it's like. But if you have to make your own ice cream, they're not very good. The only issue I have was with the ice cream here, not the ice cream and that was the biggest reason why I did not give it a If my grocery store has only PF, I'll stick to my local grocery store for the ice cream. I love that Blue Bell is local.

It's always been a favorite of mine to get to the PAGG Pizza Joint and it has always satiated my taste buds. PAGG specializes in Pizza, pizza sauce, crust and a little side of extra sauce. They offer low prices for their pizza. They offer a large selection of oven made pizzas and their menu is a bit limited compared to Papa John's and the major chain pizza places The place is right next to my house in the Heights and only a few blocks from our home. Their crust is thin but good with crust. Their pizza tastes very good and they are always hot. They close on Thursdays and Fridays - on the weekdays except Sunday and Monday. They have regular hours on Sundays. PAGG is a place where you will be seeing staff and if you order a sauce, you can not leave the restaurant unsupervised. The crust is good, always hot with a few crackles and a few hot pockets. They offer various sauces for your choice of toppings. The pizza is hand tossed and is not heated. They also have a great fountain drink special that includes blue cheese & a soda. They all offer great crust and they all serve pizza very quickly. The sauce is pretty unique for the prices you pay.

It was one of those times that I walked into this place and I thought "well these people are getting so far with their booze here that I The food to me, did not speak for itself. One of us ordered in the evening and got to share one of the entrees in the place with an employee with hair all over her face. I went for some cheap, frozen Mexican dip and the sauce is very thick but not enough. The white cheese dip tastes like it didn't come from the store. The chicken wasn't too good, the pork was moist and had a little salt in it. If your a cheese lover however you would at least notice the white cheese dip. This is not a bad cheese dip, I will give it that, but I did not like the yellow cheese. This was a huge miss. I ordered two entrees - Beef and chicken. My beef was a little dry, but flavored well. My chicken enchiladas were a little dry and the chicken did not have a flavor of my preference, although it was a little more In the middle were three bottles of Margarita. I ordered one by the glass with a half shot of Red Bull on the side. It was very dark and left me wondering, did I really want to eat an entire Glass of Mountain Dew? And no I did not get a shot of the booze.  Maybe I was a little too young? You can really taste the alcohol in the glass from the side, but it was so sweet. There was also a glass of water that was just watery. It was just so bad it caused me to crash the night before.

After hearing all of the bad reviews about this place, we were looking forward to having some BBQ in our hometown. I will say it was just average BBQ. I ordered the salad first, then the BBQ. It was amazing.. We went for the Thursday lunch special as it was a Thursday's special. The Grilled Chicken was very dry for it's size and the Dry Rub and the S&S were very bland. Although, after eating them it was apparent that they tasted pretty similar to any of the other wings in town. Dry Rubbed was flavorless and dry. Two of the wings had a little kick and I thought that was a good reason to return for another order of wings. The other things we ordered from the grill were; Barbecued Chicken Breasts; Smoked on Smoke & Smoked Bacon The meat was dry seasoned, too soft and not really tender. There was no meat on the ribs, just a skin & meat mixture. The ribs were not boneless because they were cut extremely cold. The beans were veryggy & had the texture of a soft-served can of beans or maybe another green bean. The Baked Beans did not have any fresh looking beans or any flavor of beans. My dish was good quality, however the sides were too bland, the sauces needed to be more seasoning. So, my dining partner and I sent back three to four pieces of food. I will not be going back. Why: Dining at St Louis BBQ restaurant. I'm only giving them one star because this place must have a lack of food, service & atmosphere.

First time for me to attempt Pizza-a-Go-Go. The pizza was good in both places and had just enough flavor to keep me satisfied. If you like sausage and pepperoni, then pick those up. There was a lot of thin crust and I liked the thin crust better than the cheesy crust I've had in the past. Although, my second pizza was really good, I was so impressed with the crust. I'll be back and again. There is a "service" section that is good too, so it's not too bad. Aside from the toppings, I didn't really realize that the menu included either wings, wings, cole slaw or pickles. There is only a counter for ordering, but it does have two open flames. The only thing I can't say is that pizza is very good... but the price comes along with that you don't do all that a lot

If you live in the area I highly recommend Savage One. Saucy-One offers a very unique service. In fact it was one of two stores. Although its located in the same location, it has two locations. One of these days, I'm going to get a few cans (or 1 oz) of each of their hot sauces while I Saucy One has a huge selection of hot sauces, flavorings, pre-packaged hot sauces and much more. The store is stocked with a wide range of different hot sauces in jars. Afterall, its your "hot sauce"! The store is family owned and run. It was a great store location. In addition, I have been very impressed with the owner, he has been a frequent visitor. They even brought some extra hot sauces my friend had ordered with us. The store is very busy and this was the perfect way to find out about their offerings from their website. Best of all, they are a small, family run business. If I ever find myself without the "hot" sauce, I will definitely go to Saucy-One!

Pi's pizza on Delmar, is one of my favorite chains in the STL region. The new Pi located in Kirkwood opened this week. Today the location was busy, but service was quick and friendly. The decor is old school and bright, not too dark to make your eyes pop. After a few short rounds, I decided to try their craft beer. I was a bit hungover but I would recommend the wings to anyone. A grilled wings dipped in a hunk of ranch. Like the other wings, I did not want to eat more of the seasoning because it was swarms of green. However, I did the same with their grilled onion and mayo served with ranch, my hubby ordered the Spicy Spicy Chicken, which I found Next, I had an order of a Grove 2.0 Pizza. So, I was on my way after a couple of hours. The pizza was really good! The pizza was delicious, the dough was extremely thin. What really struck me, was that the crust was relatively thin. This food was super fresh and seasoned with just the right amount of pepper. I felt like I was on a farm and was treated with a smile. In addition to the delicious pizza, Pi has a unique menu of beer to accompany it that you would not find anywhere else. I'm definitely bookmarking Pi for my next lunch. I bet!, this place is my new favorite lunch spot on Kirkwood! For my friends and I, they've been asking me to try them and recommend them to them.

This may have been my most anticipated White Castle post. I was so excited today to finally receive abox of one of their popular items, K-Cups! But sadly, once the K-Cup craze reached local chains, it would be too expensive. It was announced just several weeks ago that White Castle would be selling their K Cups at their new Kirkwood location. At Kirkwood Grill in Kirkwood, Texas, I thought about going in and getting a full box because the store had a "new" K- She smiled..she gave the box away. I asked her if she was absolutely sure there was a box in back. After a few more minutes, I was told they were sold out for a while. It was a perfect purchase and was just the thing for my morning drink. If you need a K-Cup, I say go for it there!

I've been going to this watch store for 3 years, and it gets better every time. The kids are very friendly, knowledgeable and know what they are doing. My samsung watch works great on the old battery, and with their great warranty. Don't let the kiddos try to sell you other products when you are in the shop. A must shop if you like your antiques to be restored and repair.

So, how did Chava find my blog? What made Chava such a big hit with my son? My friends and I had a chance to visit one of their many locations. For me, the best tacos in the country should be the ones made by the same team that makes the food here in Austin. It is a walk from the hotel, but is very convenient to either eat in or take out. Chava's is located at 1539 2nd Avenue at Chava's. The wait staff was friendly and fast and you never felt rushed. We found the table to be extremely comfortable for lunch. Somehow I didn't see a salsa pitcher on the tables. The food was exceptional and there was a small sampler box in the front window with some really delicious Nachos. The Nachos came with a red, green and blue pepper dipping sauce, Mexican sauce, and a Mexican Salsa. They are simply perfect. The Nachos came with all the classic ingredients you would expect and more. On which I enjoyed the sweet, hot salsa. I ordered two Soft Shell Fajita Tacos with Rice instead of Margaritas. The tortillas and sauce were excellent and they were both cooked perfectly. I had the beans and rice on a plate for my SO, I had the beans and rice on a plate for me, and it was perfectly cooked Their beans tasted like green beans, but came with a savory seasoning. They were cooked perfectly, and had a great flavor. When the server asked if I wanted any more salsa, I quickly said no. I know something about teitin. His tacos were cooked perfectly. The Tamale Plate were not tooggy, and they were just delicious overall. What more did he find out? He said the flavors had been there for a long time so I thought they were even better than he said. They will be ordering to go soon. The meat was great and it was so much better than what I had before. They brought me an extra plate of Mexican chips to take home to show the SO. A very tasty meal for a great price. I am not sure what exactly makes them awesome, but they are absolutely amazing and I am so happy that Chava is back. They were delicious..and, a little expensive considering they were from Houston, but overall the food was fantastic. My tamales had all the flavor I expected, a combination you have to try!

I've always sat at The Cellar. It's a good location and the bar was super nice. If I am going to order off their menu, so be it, you, I usually order off the bar menu. I have to give them credit for being a great host. They had a great shrimp special that night. The Shrimp was medium rare and not too fatty. All done with garlic powder, salt and pepper. I was hungry all day. So I had two sides. It was nothing spectacular, but it was delicious. I could have gotten a really good portion, but still a small portion. Then, for my main meal, I got the Filet. I've tried a lot of filets and this one matched every one. I could of felt the softness, but I went for the juicy. Because I ordered some sides, after I finished my dinner, they informed me that I didn't get my filet. I actually preferred Medium rare. You could always do this on purpose if you wish. It wasn't until now that I  realize that I am envious that I wasn't one of those who can get an In Fashion. It's not the lightest or most fruity Stoli Doli you'll get, but the taste is delicious. For a Stoli Doli, I got a glass of dark brown LVH. The meat was tender and the sauce was warm. It definitely didn't take over a whole plate, and it was definitely filling. I settled on the Cheesecake Tower, which was my snack. The French dip was the perfect side. I would suggest a glass of wine with the dish for a nice dessert. You can taste the richness of the sauces by seeing how strong they are. They bring your food to you before or after your meals. That's enough of me for this post. Order from the bar menu, Sip a Stoli Doli or another cocktail. Can you tell I was completely satisfied? What will you be drinking? For dinner or drinks. When: 2017 - Summer 2017 Why: Clayton Restaurant Week - 2015 - Summer 2017 Reason: Clayton Restaurant Week - Spring 2017 Why: Clayton Restaurant I also would like to add, TCG's Margaritas.

We visited Smoke House on Wednesday, Aug. 30. The menu is all about making your dinner on the spot, not on a box. It is located at 6625 E. Grand Ave., Kirkwood, Illinois 60504. The decor is very classy and relaxing. The menu has everything to make you have a great visit. My dinner dish was Smoked Turkey Wingettes. These are wings and they are made in-house, with their bone-in chicken breasts and a thick crust. They came out with a great moist, flavorful chicken breast covered with Buffalo sauce and topped with Buffalo sauce, pickled onions and Texas toast. They came out with a great amount of Chicken pieces on the outside and a nice sauce on the inside, not a salty like most I have The seasoning was mild, but the sweet Buffalo sauce was very pleasant and the wingettes were seasoned well. I ordered the Grilled Chicken Plate. It made a surprisingly large serving of Cobb Salad. It was very filling and it was the perfectsized portion. The salad was a big bite size too as the MexiCali Cobb Salad contained Tomatoes and Tomato based Salad dressing I ended up taking a bite of it and thought, I was going to eat more chicken! This was one of the best salads I have taken on the west coast today. My afternoon entree was my friend's Gumbo. It was served with a baked potato and a side of their Creamy Fries (their house made garlic bread!). They did. His Gumbo was super moist and tasted great. He was definitely impressed with the combination of the Gumbo and the cornbread. His final entree was their New Orleans inspired, Brioche Hamburger. He chose the medium rare, 8 oz. Medium Burger with Tomatoes, Applewood Smoked Bacon, BBQ sauce, BBQ sauce, Bacon, Cheddar Cheese and a While enjoying my lunch, the burger got hot. As the waiter brought me my food, I asked if the food was done right. They had to remake the burger. But they do have a limited number of food items off of their menu that can be reserved. It's not at all typical of the French Market you find for lunch in the mid 90's. Just wasn't that great when you can watch it go back to the grill? I think this restaurant has great customer service, but I was disappointed in their medium rare medium rare burger. My lunch friend ordered a soup from the New Louisiana Culinary Arts menu, that was very good as well. The burger was well charred to perfection. I definitely would not recommend this restaurant to anyone. They could have improved the cooking but that is not the point. The staff and waitres were very friendly, they all knew each other. The waitress said that it was not his fault and wanted to charge him. They did not put his burger on the side and gave him the same medium rare. It was a lot better than I had expected.

Although I didn't stop by Gooey Louie until the end of the month, I now am convinced to visit. In an attempt to keep the weight off, I turned to Gooey Louie and picked up a few while trying to figure out how to I stopped by for a few hours on my way to work and I was so excited to get there to sample their gooey butter cakes. Nope, I don't want to be the only Ones commenting on the Gooey Butter Cakes. The cakes are a special recipe - the first time I had a Gooey Butter Cake, the original recipe was not suitable for me. Also, I've brought my own gooey butternuts to go - Yummy! I cant get enough. The "Glow" ones are perfect for a night at the movies when you can't get up for the movie credits.

My two favorite things about Mexican Kitchens, one you go to for a drink and another you go there with your family. This place was very clean. I've had the Chilean Salsa so good I ate several of them in one short order. This place offers lots of sides too. This place was just great all around. The food is fresh and you don't want to run out of it!

I have always loved the Shoppes at the Mall. The food is all great and there is always free parking in a brick structure at every entrance. Since I live in an apartment, I like getting a very organized a store, and Plaza Frontenac is one of the few shopping malls I If you have time, head to the movie theaters near the corner of Dunn and DuPont where you can watch The Exorcist and The

It's almost 2 years since I left my husband for The Cheesecake Factory! The CC Factory!!! Daddy just joined my Daddy I have been getting so much lately so I am very excited to get back in the restaurant business. I was looking for a place to meet my mom for lunch before the week started. I came to Daddy because I needed lunch on a Wednesday afternoon and Brad was looking for me for lunch. I decided I want to give The CC Factory a try because of my brother, in law Brad. This was my first visit so I was a little excited. They serve lunch and dinner in a small setting, with a full bar. We also ordered an enormous sandwich and we didn't stop at any of the special options and it was a lot of fun to eat. My sandwich was a turkey and roast beef combo with hot chili. I had some mayonnaise on my sandwich that kept the bread nice and soft and the meat was cooked through and not over cooked. The salad was very good as well. It was very nice and delicious. For dinner, they had my favorite cheesecake sandwich. This is a great sandwich that includes a burrito and a burrito dog sandwich with cheese, tomatoes, and a thin It wasn't a special at all if you order it with ranch. Brad would also choose the kale, kale and tzatziki as a side dish and all three were very good. There are six different combinations on the menu, none of which are familiar to us. The side salad was a big hit. My sandwich came with a side of their House Salad, which consisted of a cup of arugula, tomatoes, lettuce and pepper A small slice of cheesecake, they are pretty good. At $3 per slice they are really affordable and I think it would be worth it. After lunch, we went to sleep with the Daddy's Classic Casserole which included two grilled chicken breasts and one of their signature  My Mom was very pleasantly surprised and said they would definitely come back and see if they had a few more sandwiches. When I made the phone call to let them know we got to see the show, the manager insisted we get all our food and pick up menu items. We were there on a Saturday so maybe the next time.

I love Latitude Valley's Steakhouse and Bar. It's great a bit out of the way, but it has the good taste. frozen steak would get you $10.66 for this portion of meat if fresh. The people are friendly, the service is fast and the produce is tasty. The meat is tender, the flavors are amazing and with the dressing you'll never want to take a bite of another dish! The side salad is also good. I always split half of the potato with a friend. When I bring half of the food my husband and I take half home. The sides are good but I think the sauce is overly sweet. To summarize: I must eat Tucker's before you get your teeth.

The recent TripAdvisor review of The Tennessee Trucking Company of Baton Rouge mentions TTKAB in its top 50 restaurants. I loved the atmosphere. I ate here daily, until Ian suggested that I take pictures while visiting here. If you feel like going to TTKAB for dinner you can't go wrong. My favorite dish here has been the Duck. I say that because on a scale of one to five, I would give it four stars out of five. However, we all know that the Chicken  Fried Rice is amazing. All of them are extremely flavorful and are a big part of my dining experience. I found it was a nice variety of items to sample. My best friend always orders those as this is one of my favorite dishes on a Brunch menu. They're not too sweet and the lemon ricotta filling is very delectable as well. They're definitely a must-have during breakfast. The bar is very good. My personal favorite was the; Orange Sorbet. There are four cocktails that include a sour mix, Manhattan, Oyster Martini, Irish Cream Martini and Chocolate Mojito. Most of the beers are house-made and my favorite is the Cloudline Pinot Noir. I can see a lot of happy hour customers with their "honeymoon shots". If you are in the mood for wine, check out their drinks. The brussels sprouts with an Alfredo sauce, the French toast and a side of bacon. At dinner, I've shared their ahi tuna filet, steak and chips. This is one place I can go to when my life gets a little busy, because I love them here. For dinner, the Sushi Rolls are a little high-end - it's; Sushi with Salmon and Tuna. You'll be surprised with the cuisine offered on the menu when you walk in to the restaurant and you'll find a special for the dining room called These roll has such a fresh, ocean flavor and an amazing amount of seaweed and tuna. This is a place that I have had great luck eating. That is a great way to finish and I've been to Seattle three times now and have never disappointed. You're here, so I'm sure you will get to know our favorite bar. There are many other dishes out there to try. My husband had a few of their delicious wine specials and it is definitely worth the drive. The desserts are the best. This is not a good idea at all!! I love the fact this chef is a part of the kitchen. Food Truck Wednesday-Sunday is my favorite. TTKAB is the place to go for lunch, dinner or drinks. A little goes a long way. The Tuna rolls are so dense and so well crafted that we rarely see these in a restaurant. I am never one to rule out ordering dessert, but if you have a significant other that loves sushi, order two dishes. I'm definitely going for one. It's an original idea that they decided to make the roll instead of the usual fish. I would be willing to pay for an order of sushi just to enjoy the flavors. I would suggest this dish in your opinion, if you are looking for a truly awesome dinner.

On Saturday, I heard news from KDKA-FM. I love their chips and salsa. We had a good discussion on Monday about the news that they would end up closing 2 Qdobas across the river and 4 other towns in I was lucky it seems that the restaurant got on site yesterday and got the news out. She said the Qdoba in St. Louis would be closed on Dec 21th as a result of the closures of other Qdo In a two minute span after the newscaster gave it all over, she said the 6 locations had survived. I had our first visit this past week. We went for drinks first, then ordering a sandwich. We added some chips at the end of our meal and went home with lots of fresh chips! There are a lot of new faces here and they all bring a different and nice attitude. When I am searching for a good Mexican food, but can't find it, this will be my go to place. The burgers were a little oily, but I like them. All of the staff at Qdoba are seasoned and they have good customer service. The people were all new and sounded like a long way away from what you have come to know. I would recommend coming to Qdoba if you are in the area to eat. And even though I didn't like the decor, I appreciate the great food and service at a great price. It's also one of the best deals I have ever gotten!

Kounter Kulture opened on May 1, 2016 in my neighborhood at 1300 Lamar Dr. and was very easy to find on Yelp. I just didn't see the drive there as a good move, so my initial visit was for a Saturday dinner pick up. I knew I had to try it. All the food looks excellent and is packed with flavor! At KK I first came in for dinner and they greeted me with a smile. That is going to be an annual event. A while back, I was eating through my Steamed Bun one of my favorite things. A server came my way and promptly took everything, just glancing at me to see if she remembered who I was. When I mentioned this to Christina I commented on that, she was very personable. She also pointed out the best items to take home. Christina told me about some specials on the menu and suggested an upgrade to their salad that I had been craving. She also asked for my recommendation on an excellent Steak & Shrimp Roll. This dish was extremely fresh and the best I've tasted so far this year. She recommended the Soube, I am a huge seafood fan and they gave me so much information on the Togarashi Spiced Catfish Po' Their parking is simple and clean. My second visit was on the evening of June 28, 2016. They say everything served daily and they also have Saturday night specials, but for those who wish to save and go during the week KK is open around the I would just recommend the dinners if you are looking for a burger or burgers, then go see Kounter Kulture. I strongly recommend this location and will be coming back to Kounter Kulture over and over.

Had a great time. My dining partner just got the Fish-n-Chips, so I had the "Beer-Made". A few years back we went to a new local pub, called "The Old City". They had a nice place, but definitely doesn't jive with the average bars. Great service and everything was very fast. I love this place because it does provide some quiet in the back of the room. We made it up to the rest of the table and I just sat there for a few minutes. I ordered: Fried Pickles. The beer batter is thick, like a 'flesh', so they were a bit too tangy for my liking. Their pickles were actually pretty good, I'm sure they have their way with the packaging. The steak was tough, raw fish with dry skin. I didn't like the fries, so I left them alone, and was happy I could have ordered the same thing. Although my husband ordered a large size of the Cod and Garlic Fries, his tastebuds were not impressed, he ordered the Salmon and Salmon We had never eaten anything with fish on it before and both of us couldn't get over how good it was.
