We all enjoy the holidays each year. A friend & I drank a few beers while trying to stay warm. I headed down to the Loop, across the street from Prince. They didn't seem to list any at the time, which I thought was typical of the restaurant business. A few days earlier, I checked for my parking garage on Grand and found Prince, but I didn't feel comfortable with parking around there. On my way to the dining room, I noticed there was no parking available. We made it to Blueberry Hill with almost no delay. The directions from Duke University and the loop are very clear. I saw a sign in the parking lot for the Blueberry Hill. So I waited. I wasn't expecting to be there. On our way in, the doors opened and there were folks lining up on either side of the door. There were 3 people ahead of us, and it was a packed room. There were signs that told people what to do and they could get seated. As the doors opened, one could see a large crowd lined up with a couple in their 50's, 80's and 90's and As the doors opened, they put down menus where they got people up to check their order. The line to get a booth number was long, but the waiters were friendly and they ushered you to the appropriate booth. My dining partner and I waited for about an hour to make our way down the line. All you had to do was tell them what the food was and they would come in and take it back. I waited at the kitchen all night to pick up my order before I even made my way to the door. This is an interesting restaurant as one would expect that it will be packed when they open. There were many others who came from far away who enjoyed the food and service. As for the actual food, it was very good. Even though this meal was not what I was looking for a couple Christmases ago, I had a good time with a lot of different food I'm so glad we ate at BH and enjoyed ourselves.

Here's what I have to say about the Shop N Save grocery store I visited in Hampton Village. I went just before Christmas, but I have not been really to the Hampton location. But now I do not mind them. The store is a re-designed and expanded version of the old one that closed months ago. Some of my favorites were in the section of produce and meats. There was a small fresh produce section that was impressive - lots of things to buy. There was even a food court for food ordering. I was also pleasantly impressed with the new hot bar. I enjoyed the steaks. I'll say it's a nice touch, but there was no meat section in the store. The shop was relatively fast to open. I hope that everything is improved with the renovations. I don't think they had to spend money upgrading the store, but a little more effort will eventually pay off. I'm very pleased with this facility. Why: My baby was sick during the week and I don't know what to do. My daughter loves this store and the kids have a blast there!

C & H is one of the best bars on the East Side. While a few years ago I first frequented the restaurant with my friend and family in downtown Cleveland, I don't remember the long wait times here It's a wonderful spot to work, take a cab, drop by for a lunch or dinner and sip your favorite cocktail. I was invited to pick up my cousin from work to join us for lunch on our birthday. If you haven't tried C-H in years, I strongly suggest it. When we enter the bar the hostess gave us a warm welcome and offered us a drink special. This is their signature cocktail since it includes a martini glass. This drink, like so many of theirs, is a blend of two of their top choices. So I needed a shot glass for my drink and the Red Wedding was the perfect choice. I've been to C-H a couple of times and I love it. Once my cousin arrived I noticed a few tables opened and settled into the bar. We were seated immediately and we chatted for a while. While we ate, my cousin chatted with his guests who had a very nice time. This was the perfect start to a great lunchtime experience. We all enjoyed eatout at C-H so it was time to start our lunch and our meal. We ordered a bowl of soup from the menu and a dessert from the bar. They looked like a lot of beets and so much better than I expected. They aren't just vegetables, they are also served in a sauce that contains cucumbers, peaches, red roses and pecans. The presentation is simple but very delicious. We then decided on the C&H Pork Sub. They served their sandwiches as a standard, but we also had the option to add a personal touch to each sandwich. One of my favorite sandwiches is their Crab Cakes with Sauteed Sprouted Mushrooms and Carrots. They are very fresh and they are thinly sliced. I was pleasantly surprised with how fresh they were. They are served in a light brownish coating and would be perfect with any meal. Sloppy Joe - Thick cut with swiss, jack cheese, and shaved parmesan, served on a Pulled Pork - Tender cut cut with a combination of chicken, bacon, romaine, dill, green onions and mayonnais So, for my 60th birthday on Thursday, March 18th, 2008 C&H was the perfect choice...for lunch! We had a great lunch with a great company and the food was great. In my opinion you can't go wrong with anything C-H is providing. I've had a few  Ham sandwiches here at some point before I moved to Minnesota. I am so glad we had a lovely lunch. Pulled Pork - Thin cut, served on Texas Toast topped with capers and shallots. Pulled Pork - Thick cut, served on Texas Toast topped with a mix of chicken, bacon, cheese, mayo, mayonnais Pulled Pork - Thick cut, served on Texas Toast topped with mayo and pickle. Pulled Pork - Topped with Parmesan cheese, grilled onions, dill, mayonnaise and pickled red onion peppers Pulled Pork - Thick cut, served on a skewer with green onions, lettuce, tomato, mayo, cheese, sauce, Pulled Pork - Thick cut, served on Texas Toast topped with pepper and hot sauce. A generous portion with tons of flavor. This is my favorite C-H sandwich. I love the agglomeration of meat and the bacon to balance the sandwich out.

Best salsa in Las Vegas! The wings are so good, sweet and salty, which I like. Plaza Frontenac is the biggest mall in the city and probably one of the most visited malls in America. Its right next door to the Galleria at the Palais de la Ville. When: June 2, 2015 Why: Waterloo. We had our friends birthday and decided to treat them to an afternoon of chicken dinner. The drive was pretty short, at about 3:00 that afternoon and I thought it would be a good idea to head to Waterloo. This place is unique because there is something for every taste. Gallagher's menu is a family style dinner of their choice. They also have a "Themed" Steaks & Steak Bar. They come with fried chicken, corn bread bread, milk gravy, corn bread & some delicious home made sides like: mashed potatoes, corn cu This dinner was a fantastic spread that was made just the way they described the dinner - homemade dessert! It was the best chicken dinner we have had in a very long time. Chicken: Fresh battered with seasonings and seasoned throughout. Green Beans: I really enjoyed this dish with a bowl of corn custard. The mashed potatoes: This was just another one on the bowl of potatoes they offer, but I thought they would really make your plate. Milk Gravy: Just enough milk, just good enough and not overly gravyy. The waiters are all very friendly. When you are done with all of this great food, fill your bellies with a drink. They have a great selection of local and national beers. We had the whiskey cocktails (tastings will be posted shortly), which were delicious. The atmosphere was casual and friendly. Staff of 8 is very knowledgeable about all things chicken, fried chicken, and many other items. The server was quick and informative and went above and beyond to help me. What: One of my all time favorite places to eat. Food would be even better!

If you love the taste of antiques, go visit Gingham Buffalo. This is the store for you. I was first introduced to Gingham Buffalo last October and when I opened it I was delighted. They have the best selection of wallpaper and framed pictures and frames that won't break your bank. I went to the dressing room while waiting to get ready for today's visit. All the stores offer you a chance to sit and browse. They have great interior design and I didn't leave disappointed. I wasn't disappointed in what I bought. I never expected to find such an extensive collection of handcrafted pieces when I first went here. If you're looking for a unique place to gather and re-organize pieces, this is a great place. You will find treasures so rare that they are rare. You won't be disappointed. They're professional and friendly. If you love what you're buying, and you want local support, come to Gingham Buffalo.

I can't imagine anything more expensive being listed on the Internet for a used cookbook. That is a violation of their policies. This is the kind of store that I should be looking for at the beginning of Spring, in my opinion. They also have limited checkout with no staffed checkout counter and only "convenience" checkout. However, on my visit and the last three times that I When I called that I needed a store visit, the store was too busy with crowds of customers to respond to the question. I would not return. As part of National Margarita Day, I was honoring the restaurants that hosted the best Margaritas and Flautas on National Marga They're right on the corner of 4th and Elm Sts. It was a busy Friday night in St Louis with the NMD-Nixta being a Friday night in St Louis. One of my best friends recommended that I visit before heading to a party downtown. However, it wasn't until NMD 2019 that I stopped in for a refreshing Margarita (literally). No wait!, the hottest weekend of my trip. A huge crowd was there. I was greeted by a really friendly staff member when I walked in. They made me nervous and told me that no one else was in. The food selections were nice and all was very delicious. My first Margarita was paired with, the, pumpkin hummus. They were delicious!. The chips were like Spanish chipotle chips without any of the grease. Not overly salty, but really good. I decided to take the rest of my Margarita (my second Margarita) to share with friends. They were very light textured flautas with a delicious, tangy Mexican sauce. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for Mexican food, but not the average. I cannot believe how good those were but also how they were served. I feel, that they really need to increase their bartenders and manager to give them more attention. - What's their Margaritas like? Yes..I am not opposed to the menu items based on its size and quality. You might as well just make a reservation.

The Gin Room is a hidden gem located at 71, Norma Avenue in Phoenix. I had the opportunity to sample one of my favorite Gin cocktails; their, "Raw Gin" cocktail where I was paired up with Natasha There, I told Natasha all about my love of Gin and how she likes to use it to create her cocktails. Natasha was a great server and taught me how to prepare the perfect cocktail. The mule I had was made using Gin with Hendrick's Gin. Using Hendrick's Gin, she served the mule with a shot glass full of sherry, just like I think you' I asked if I could have one with no mixer and if was a good idea, she said that she'd make it. In celebration of my 12th birthday, I got myself a $18.99 birthday gift from Chicago Pizza Paradise. The gift coupon is $10 off. My sister and I are not able to purchase pizza but we still had a fun night at the house. There are no fees, and all I had to do was pay a receipt. You'll always get a free bottle of beverage when you sign up with Cecil Whittaker. They also offer special deals on other items. This is an awesome community. We were so full by the time it became time for my bday, that I wasn't sure what to eat.

The coffee was excellent, and the decor is very fresh. This is an old town coffee shop with lots of charm and a comfortable atmosphere. The place is open 24 hours per day for coffee, tea, snacks, and juices. They serve milkshakes and cakes like this at the front desk. There is only one bar that you can get a bar snack if you prefer and I could see some drinks for dinner as well. The decor was very cool, especially the mural on the wall with the colors to the mugs. I did like that all lattes and coffees are stocked at the front. I would recommend it for lunchtime lunch or to the office or home office. They also have a small bar for take-out. :) The price is reasonable and they offer discounts on their speciality sweet treat which includes a coupon for a free sip. Good prices and really good staff.

Imagine a 15some party. We were invited to celebrate the first anniversary of our Yelp page. Imagine then having a waitress assigned to the group? You get this concept. Last night I was kindly asked to serve at Mango with Kelsie for one night only. I think that every waitress has great potential, I was hesitating because I didn't think she would be a great cook. How could we be sitting at tables that were 45 minutes apart from each other? Kelsie did a fantastic job. She got the entire group down on her heels to a great start. She had this big smile on her face (that was awesome) and was really friendly to work with. When it came to the food, I had an experience that was not only memorable, but also delicious. Her recommendations included Chicken Quesadillas, Chicken Patagonian, Salsa Mexicana, Andado guacam A refreshing drink full of taste, this drink was very nice. Kelsie took care of me every step of the way. The next item on the menu was Sangranada. This menu item was a delight. With soup I ordered the Sopa Dried Beef and Tomato Soup. Oh, and what a broth. I ordered our main dish from the restaurant a small bowl of Mussels in White Wine, along with a side of a bowl of French bread I ordered it the next round but it took me a while to complete my dinner, so I didn't get to take a bite. Kelsie said that she would be happy to recommend a vanilla cake with chocolate fudge icing. She told me about the decadent coconut cream. No problem, she sent me the Torta Chocolate, which didn't even come with cream or icing. I was ready for dessert, but when I walked past the cake, the icing still didn't fully dry. I was so very glad that Mango took such great care of us during the night. And finally; chocolate cake with fudge icing. YES!!! I LOVE COFFEE! On the drive home I realized, "I am going to eat it up, but first, I have to make sure it is not too soggy". There is a reason I am in business; for being a foodie.

Thank you Lesher's for your very fast availability and quick delivery! I was blown away with the flowers. We've just landed in the Fyler-Hampton area. I called Lesher's Florist, They were able to deliver the flowers and delivered it the day before the celebration and our guests loved it. Lesher's has a reputation for providing excellent customer service, incredibly fast, and always delivers what is promised. With a full house that night, it was difficult for me to find a florist, let alone a florist in Hampton. I wanted to know before I did anything, if there was a good florist in that area, how it could fit our budget and if it would I called and dialed 251. I had to make sure I wasn't late in the game. She said that if you come back in the morning with fresh flowers and you're still ready to go after work she will open after 4am. I discovered The Butcher & Baker in the morning, thinking that it would be too warm, but as soon as I walked in, I knew it A must try: If you are looking for quality and great food, look for Butcher & Baker. I knew everything before seeing the menu and even know that my husband has been coming here since we were grown up, so I was excited with what was on the The food was amazing. I had planned to order a single serving of Salmon Wellington on Sunday, but they had the recipe for it already. My meal was for two and included three of their delicious cocktails! This really saved over $4.40 per person. I'm not a chef, but I'd say I'd pay way more if the menu is as good as this. It sure was a lot of food for the amount of money! The Seasonal Salad is my go to Mediterranean Salad. The Prime Rib was delicious, melt atop the crust, and would have been even better with a little sauce (which I didn't do I also received a large side of potatoes and they were just the right size for me. Sam's Mashed Potatoes were great and I enjoyed the cheesy goodness of the sauce on top. At this point, I could not bring myself to eat other potatoes. The meat was cooked tender and tender and the side potatoes too. The Brussels Sprouts were excellent and I ordered the soy glaze. They were slightly sweeter than usual, but still tasted fantastic. When my waiter called me to inform me that this was the last entree on the menu, I was so excited. My husband and I can't wait to try the Smoked Salmon Wellington, I ate it at an eating party and loved it. I had a great experience and am so glad it was only $45! Love this place!. I haven't had this great service at any of the other places I have been.

Recently it was over 9 month since we experienced The Tasting Room at Restaurant on Lake. I had my dinner here in a tasting menu and I am still loving it. I was so pleased and then I had another amazing lunch and I really enjoyed the lunch I had. That was a three years ago and I was sure it would be long on the wait list because the restaurant had just not been around and they had to open I know that the owners and staff were great and made this a great dining experience for a lunch time outing. There was a really big deal about starting a new eating adventure, just recently. My goal is to visit all three locations of, The Shack. The only way to verify all three locations is to walk in and order a "Balancing Plate", if you like. The Three..Frontenac, Montreal and Ottawa. No time for an adult beverage, so I had what I think is the best drink on the list. It's a New York Blondie (and the owner is awesome). The Dude Abides is a brew that is a little sweet and has gin, lemon, and lime. This drink can be purchased at most bar locations, but there is also a simple and easy drink. The other my friend chose the, Morning Scream. It's a mix of fresh fruit, peach and red grape juice. As I am not a big fan of eggs I opt for some kind of breakfast dish. A Brussels Sprout from the Brussels Sprouts section with fruit. This is a thick and creamy bowl of eggs with bacon, eggs, Gruyère, Brussels sprouts, red peppers, arugula Brussels..and some extra cheese. I choose, "Salty. I would say, "I've had more than enough of my breakfast here." A little healthy, but a little too sweet. It was a perfect meal to start the day. The meals are not served in mini-bowls, so you have to have one of each to share. The prices are reasonable. If you really want a good meal at a delicious price on your breakfast, then visit any of the three., The Shack restaurants. I can't remember the last time I saw food served with a French dip.

The entire staff at Cleveland-Heath is amazing. My husband and I went to Cleveland-Heath for the Brunch on Saturday this past Saturday. I was there for a Tuesday dinner and decided to take a Sunday Brunch. This past spring has been great, even though I have driven through the area at least 2 times and never had a reservation. I recently had an unannounced birthday party, but I have not been back for over two years. Until recently it was pretty expensive, but I thought I'd try an old school Friday night meal. I ordered the Chicken Casserole, which is delicious, but I always love when a restaurant goes out of their way to make it even better. We got the chicken that was dipped in their sauce and seasoned to perfection. As a main course we decided on the Wings and the broasted chicken. I have to say, the Mashed potatoes were delicious! The cheeseburger with the sauce and beans that came with it was pretty good, but it would be a bit too much sauce, so try adding some mustard The wings were good, but I felt they were a little too greasy. Our server, Julie (Eric) said their was a lot of staff working and I couldn't believe how efficiently this place was running even on  There was little to no wait, but the staff was really friendly and welcoming. This is my first time to visit Doc's at Godfrey, which is a sports bar. I was veryhesitant going here at the time although they have since been moved. I have been in several sports bars in the area and have had no problems dining out there, but I am looking to take a few out here. We enjoyed a visit to The Foundry today. The food was simple but delicious. We had an event at The Diner as a party of 5 who was celebrating my 2 year old birthday and I wanted to celebrate. We stopped by on our way to my parents house and it was open for lunch. We enjoyed a few drinks and then went back to the bar. We were chatted about our plans and I compared it to our last night at the The Foundry, in Seattle. The menu was full of choices. I ordered them and then they came out at the same time. Our salad was a combination of the, White Meat Bacon Salad and the, Fried Brussels Sprouts. These were soft fried Brussels Sprouts, served with a buttery dressing and seasoned with salt and pepper. They also served with a mixture of walnuts, celery, jalapeos, cheese and pepper. Not too many ingredients and was really good. And that's just for starters. The large was a very serving and I had full sized tots, but I didn't notice it. It was a lot less than the large and they were very good at piping hot. Yes.. yes.. yes. We each had a couple of these and both of us enjoyed them. The seasoning on the tots was excellent, though it was the seasoning on the fried Brussels Sprouts which really added in to this I also had the, Smoked Smoked Chicken Thighs. I adore a good burger. It was a thin patty of meat in a bowl. The meat was moist and seasoned just right with both the smoked rind and the seasonings and dressing. We had about 30 dollars for an entree, so we asked for a large serving of pies. I loved the seasoning on the ranch dressing over the smoked thighs. I could of finished this one in 1 bite. My next main course was the, Chicken Breast with Shrimp. The second guest ordered, Fried Turkey Wings and we all enjoyed them. My other dining partner went full on, with the bigburger for his lunch. He didn't leave the menu with anything new. Regardless, I eat at my local location everyday as I enjoy it just as much. I also ate a cheeseburger from the deli. No problem, he ordered it and we had the option of keeping it and taking him back. Thank you for the review, I truly enjoyed the food as much as he did. I will definitely be back. He wasn't that big a fan of burgers so I left about a quarter of a portion behind to eat later. They were very polite, and quick. I will definitely return. I would go back, but I don't want to spend too much time there. I thought this is delicious so I did the regular, burger. Our overall experience was very good. It's a really nice, casual dining experience. After several visits, I am still satisfied with their lunch options, plus the wait time for their food to start. That's what we call a "dining party lunch". They were a little pricey for a Sunday lunch, but even still, they were a great lunch to share. So you can see how much I enjoyed it.

While living in the Bay Area, I've found that a lot of restaurants are not my "must go" in San Jose. It's not that BO hasn't become a favorite since my first visit. They've been a big part of my life here in Charlotte, with the food,ambiance and service. At lunch today, my co-worker arrived in the area to bring his wife for a lunch. The Cafe did not have any food available for my visit. I will come back again soon to try their food! What I also found odd about this visit was the amount of time it took to service. I can't wait again to try the other milk products. I did not buy coffee or coffee products but will definitely be using Nadoz.

I have been wanting to try this place since I had seen it last month at lunch. Food was excellent the food was delicious and the service was great! Sweetie Pie's is not a chain like other places and it doesn't take many people to find it. I got the fried chicken wings and potatoes. The fish they served was cooked perfectly and the chicken was huge, I can't believe they had chicken that big. I had my chicken fried steak, my sister had beef. The chicken was perfectly fried the way I like it and you would think someone could put burger oil on them. The chicken was moist and tender. Sweetie Pie's has a great patio and the whole restaurant is really clean. Don't visit without stopping in for lunch, go check it out, you won't regret it.

TGP is one of the largest parks in  Missouri and is a must see. I don't believe any other city in America has park/river access to such a park. TGP is beautiful and I can't imagine this city with a better park. It does a great job of keeping itself looking and clean. The pavilions look like they were just installed and every year, the city paints them green to brighten up the park. I like to see the area as a greenspace to go on long walks, so my two children always enjoyed our trip. Not so much for the bathrooms. The reason is that there is a simple problem. This park is shutting down the bathrooms, if they were open. There is no way to go there to wash our hands. If we go in after 6:00pm, the lockup consists of the bathroom. I'm a kid and can't even imagine a teenager being as young and intoxicated as I am, or having as much fun as That's the point? I am not a man, I am a woman and there are no rules that says no one can use the bathroom until 7 AM. I have no choice but to try to avoid being a park Ranger. However, they are still looking to sell their pavilions as the park is in the middle of building the park.

They do a great jobrepairing the lace threads! I went to a dozen shoe retailers for replacement laces on my shoes. The laces were difficult to find. I found someone who did have the correct kind on their website but could not get an appointment. I decided to go to Dillard's and try the place out. The store is right across town from my job. They acted quickly, walked me to the place where they had the replacement laces and I left with new pair. When I came in I was able to find the shoelaces I needed. Just by luck, they sold my boots for $96 which were not refurbished. You really don't need to need an appointment; they're open on Saturdays (as long as they're open at your time of the Another big plus was that the store itself was just as nice as the ones in other shoe stores that I've been to.

My friend and I sat at Bobby's on Washington for our lunch break and it ended up being a great lunch. I have yet to try their sandwiches, which was kind of fun to make at a deli. I was pleasantly surprised by the service I received from their server, who was very polite and friendly. A few minutes after you entered the cashier's office, I walked around ordering. The bread was fresh, the sandwiches were delicious and with every bite I had left me full and satisfied. A big hit, the sandwiches were huge and had so many delicious features! I really enjoy a good Reuben as well so despite the name, I was concerned to see if they had a more creative version, which However, Brown Bag deserved to be able to deliver. It comes with six cheese slices with a side of sauerkraut and cream cheese. It's a large size, but with a great beer selection. It is made with Frenchman's Hamburger with all the meat and sauce he has used on it served on a huge, marble rye The sandwich was paired with homemade ketchup served with a side vegetable. The sauce was thick and rich, with flavors that didn't remind too much of a Philly cheeseburger. My cuz picked up an additional item. She was so envious of this little sandwich. Rosie of all Rotisseries. The cheese made it perfect and was so simple to make. My cousin was also in town for lunch and I ordered a club sandwich. The table we sat at had a nook that didn't have an open restaurant door and we didn't use it. I decided to get one of their Club Sammies. It was a Club Sammie. They were a huge slab of ham on a grilled marble rye with a spicy cranberry aioli, and For those of you interested in what goes into the Bistro Club, the menu is a great resource. My cuz went with the Pastrami Benedict. I love their pretzels and my "kiss of lunch", a Pretzel stick order. I just wish I could afford to try this lunch. This was one of the best sandwiches the whole family has had in years. This joint is in my favorite part of the city! It was amazing! and not to mention, I ordered my own coffee - which was a very good service, that also came with the purchase. The BBB staff would love to help you choose what to eat or bring along. I am so impressed with this sandwich shoppe, and love the fact that the service is so friendly. A friend of mine started eating at a place with the names of the new restaurants on campus, including Brown Bag Bistro, which is located at 1360 During the warmer months, their outdoor patio is a great place to sit, gather people and watch the game.

At this past weekend's Lone Star Dog Days at Home event, Three Dog became a "Right in the Lou" with the reopened Now that my four dogs are home, their new location is available for dogs in their home town of St. Louis! This location is more laid back than the Lone Wolf one in Ladue. Three Dog Bakery is a great little bakery when you're in a rush. Three Dog has a wide selection of dog treats and it's all fresh. They also have a store of the season. The location is super convenient and the food is delicious. The products that are in the new store are just as good to the taste as those you can find in the old location. Have a doggie treat night at the new Three Dog.

What a beautiful city. They have a nice play area, a great BBQ grill and a beautiful playground. I walked my dog here everyday and it's great to walk it every day. I love that I can come out in the summer and not have to be out in the cold. It is a very friendly and friendly neighborhood that is perfect for a walk.

Shaved Duck is the star of a new musical. My husband and I ordered smotheredfried fries. These fries are good. You should go to TSD if you're a vegan and this must be your first visit. At Shaved Duck, they treat their food with the respect it deserves. We were at Shaved Duck with some friend before Labor Day weekend and my daughter, Kimberly, was just a bit hungry. They are ghetto, they are cheap and the quality of ingredients are cheesy and I wish I could cook this kind of food I can picture it now. I couldn't do that justice, I want them again. It took some work to get the fries (I waited at the smashed potatoes station but they took care of it). The ribs were made with their own sauce. I also had a nice little hot sauce just to taste which I think is a Hot Cheddar sauce. The sauce had a rich sauce with a buttery sauce. This is the only sauce I didn't use so I don't know how it tasted. My favorites were the Cornbread and Honey Butter. The Cornbread was buttery and a little bit sweet. I had too much. I could have ate a load. This corn was really hot. We both were really impressed with their sauce and had a smile about the amount and the taste. These little jalapenos give it that classic Southern flavor. My favorite side came out with some BBQ sauce. There are still a bunch more items, but it was a simple selection of sides, Mac-n-Cheese and some extra creamy The Mac-n-Cheese was thick and flavorful enough that if I would have wanted the full burger I'd not have The drinks were all great and theambiance was great. Their staff were well informed, made suggestions for me, and even provided some great suggestions for my next meal.

Luvy Duvy's Cafe has a great breakfast special you won't want to miss! Luvy Duvy's Cafe in downtown St. Louis is located inside the Older Homestead at 900 South Market in St. Louis. I couldnt wait to try my delicious taste from the grill of Luvy Duvys Cafe in the city's North Side. We arrived at Luvy Duvy's Cafe at 7:30am and were seated right away. My order was taking forever then I figured after a bit of waiting, I'd get a delivery next week. They served their creations on a plate of waffles and ate them right away. A couple of lady gave me some samplers. It was obvious that they had made Jammers to be a special treat for their customers in their hometown. My sweet little jammer was just right. They were so good even after I had left, I still wanted to take one home. The biscuits didn't taste too runny and there was just some sweetness all over them. I really enjoyed that visit and will definitely add it to my menu this summer! Good local restaurants that are affordable and in the heart of St Louis.

Southern Fried Chicken has become my go to restaurant in Southern Missouri, both for that reason alone and for the comfort food you'll get. I'm a little surprised that they serve a chicken fried rice, and I have to admit their meal would be a little less satisfying  It's so good, you won't even mention it when you tell people that it's not healthy. I didn't mind or even try anything on their menu, except as long as it was delicious, I was all set. I ordered their Grilled Wings to try to test out newer items. I know a little about fresh tomatoes, but my favorite is fried in buttermilk lime dressing. This dish should be on your list. They were perfect and the sides were excellent. We used to order the fried nits without a dipping sauce, and I really hated it when a dipping sauce has been added I will say, I could've ate all 12 tomatoes that I had, but I think this place was worth a try. I decided to ask about the Spice level of chicken they had in their restaurant. Another amazing thing about the fried tomatoes is that they are pre-cooked, which ties to the natural flavor, and then the taste is added to the The chicken was perfect. The sauce is really sweet and has a very well balanced flavor. It was grilled perfectly, it was fried to perfection, I loved them! I loved the mashed potatoes with a side of Pan Gravy. The name of the dish is a relic of a farm home, and the meat was cooked in this thick bacon fat and butter, making the I thought it was some kind of a processed version made out of brown sugar. Although this was a huge hit, I could not have asked for a better mashed potatoes than in the southern home. The sauce was thick and sauced with a nice garlicy flavor, adding a kick to a dish that is a bit more "fried" I had an awesome Mac-n-Cheese with a side of Mac n' Cheese. But I would not recommend it to anyone who is looking for a light meal, but has taste buds waiting for a heartier chicken dinner. There are many versions of this dish and this was one of the better. It wasn't what it seemed to be- but I enjoyed it. I found them to be so much better than what can be found at the chain restaurants (see below). I hope they continue to provide their true Southern flavor, so that they don't have to change the menu again. It's like eating my heart out and enjoying the heartburn and being tired and stressed out. That is if my carbs weren't already causing me to have heartburn. Our experience with Southern was a happy one. I was happy, so was my friend. They're right down my street. The Mac-n-Cheese was good but I will definitely be back. I definitely wanted to leave a note about all these delicious and satisfying comfort foods. I don't know what else could you have ordered, but the flavor and texture was as good as it was fast and sweet. We had three pieces of chicken, and I don't get tired of it. This place also offers vegan options. I ended up getting the Large Breakfast Sandwich- a full size meal with a side of gravy. This is definitely my new favorite place to eat because they always have great food and service. The only gripe I have about Southern is the price. I went back and tried another fried piece of chicken. It was a sweet lunch. If the word comfort food rings out in my mouth to you, then stop reading...I am going to be ordering.

Earlier this month, DQ has released an Outrageous Blizzard. When I ordered the Blizzard, I added a graham cracker as the third ingredient. The recipe sounds like a huge Blizzard that has enough chocolate covered pieces to make anyone lick their lips as fast as you can! If you tried this as a dessert, you probably don't want to eat it. The Blizzard was made with the flavor of a warm, gooey cream, with a chocolate coating to give it an extra layer My friends and I have mixed the vanilla custard with the peanut butter cups. Both were delicious.It's so easy to get a brisk, sweet, delicious feeling with those simple ingredients. At any rate, a Caramel drizzle was a bonus. I would have preferred they used a little less of the caramel. I'm not a huge fan of the decor at this DQ, but the food is not. Their staff always checks on you to make sure your drink is ready when you arrive. Where: Westgate Mall, 2521 NW 100 South, Newark, NJ 08908 Why: On I-81. Yes, it will definitely be. I will definitely check them out!

A week later I called the food detachment and got a call at 2PM stating the first item would be my Margarita. The atmosphere of the place was perfect in every way. The menu is very interesting, and it's all about the food. I did not expect to be let down by the quality and taste of the food. The waittime is on a Tuesday and Thursday night, and there is no sign of a restaurant opening there anytime soon. I'm not a fan of Mexican food, but Latitude has a perfect blend and made us feel very welcome.

GFS at 8905 E Main St nw. - This store is much better then its competitors. We checked out this store with the intention of having a bite to eat at breakfast and it wasn't too bad. The food selection was amazing. I was glad to see that their menu items included the "Clubhouse" menu, which was awesome. This costco GFS allows you to make up your own party supply bag or bring your own. I will definitely be back. It's one of their best kept secrets. They have a variety and lots of produce and organics. The store is clean and the food selections are very good. I would go back and try everything.

Have you ever stopped in and thought, "you are so delicious, I've been meaning to try it". I sincerely hope you were as pleased as me. Your Bloody Mary was amazing. After our initial wait, I ordered a Bloody Mary. These weren't just another Bloody Mary. It was a hearty, cold bloody mary that didn't have the saltiness that I feel most people need. It was rich, full of flavor, packed with some good flavor and also had an added kick from the fresh jalapeos. This was my only issue with your Bloody Mary and my first visit to an Irish pub was a disaster with a prank. Just like your Bloody Mary, I ordered two half orders of Benedict's and Biscuits & Gravy. Two half orders for 2 people was enough for me. Thank you. Unfortunately, it didn't fit into my normal plan. I can't say I was disappointed because your Breakfast Benedict was outstanding. I rely on Benedict's for breakfast because it's always so filling and a great choice. This brunch nailed it. Your eggs were done with a rich white sauce and topped with a very smooth hollandaise sauce. We shared your omelet and slurped up your Benedict's. You guys have been cooking eggs at Scarlett's for years, so that knowledge makes you a better cook. For the dessert, I came across your Biscuits & Gravy. You baked the biscuits right with the butter, and you made them with sausage. Once I got a taste of yours, I went back and ordered an entire pound. I had the same chicken/bones & gravy sandwich as before, but opted for turkey instead of bacon. The breading was so thick when I took it home, I thought it almost had to be cooked longer. It even came with a side of hollandaise sauce. That's really all that was missing. The servers took a great interest in us and kept us being happy. It was nice working away from home. I can wait to go back for brunch as often as you want, but I'm not sure I'll be able to enjoy your menu over the I would!.Scarlett's and Sasha's will be there before you know it. My husband was disappointed as well, thinking that the egg grits were not as good as we always get them.

Ian - a famous runner and a local foodie has discovered a sandwich they love and want to share with you. I had been wanting to try it for ages. I came here on a whim as I was curious about how it would taste with a piece of bread instead of bread that had been toasted I had heard little about it from anyone before so I made it a priority. So I did and decided to try out the Muffaletta. Muffulettas are great to have on any day of the week. It had great taste, but did not bring me the same sensation of joy and satisfaction as the Prosciutto. I also had a cup of cola with it. I had never had such a wonderful sandwich and am so glad I did. With the exception of the Prosciutto Cotto, the sandwiches would be a good 10 minutes of eating. I have tried the Mufflet as well as the Prosciutto Cotto and it is still going on my list. I have had this sandwich every week since I have been to Stl. I'll eat it every day. Ian has made "I'll Never Go Back" a staple of his STL 100 list. This sandwich is going to become a permanent fixture on my rotation. Thank you Salume Beddu! It's like a second skin on your body, and a good lunch on top of it.

I have heard of Scarlett's Pub and Grille, and I cannot believe how incredible it is. I've been to this cafe only a couple of times since it was created on the back patio during a hot August afternoon. I haven't tried the food yet, but the staff is always super nice and helpful. I felt I was dining at a cafeteria in a tiny area. Their menu has a lot of choices for how to spend your time. I got a couple drinks on our first stop and it was a great experience. During lunches there are only two menu items, so the portions are big. I was irked to say the least, but she was so nice and welcoming that I could even pull a smile off my face. I tried to run before I fell. I ate at a pace that was too slowly for me, but I didn't mind it as long as I was comfortable eating. The lunch was great! After being at the cafe, they had me ready for my next stop. The owner, who also works at a restaurant, smiled and informed my friends that we were being asked to take the burger back at lunchtime. We were given plenty of time to sample the menu. Besides the burgers, there are four great options you can choose from. I'll probably come back. One word, Jerk is really good. Special Ed Sandwich is made with an extra thin crust tater tots that had a golden color. The sandwiches were served hot or cold. As a special gift, they add a special waffle for you to enjoy at The Village Cafe, so you do not need to worry about a The waffle batter is a dark brown, egg white fluff. Order came quick and they came within 10 minutes. The waffles did not dissapoint. They were thick and chewy on the outside but soft and tender in the inside. The wing pieces on the other hand were a little tough but that was my fault. The chicken is made with a bit of ricotta cheese and an onion. They were served with a sweet glaze and a fried edge. They were just so flavorful, simple and delicious. Now, don't get me wrong, I'm not the biggest fan of waffles, but I really loved the flavor of this. These are not to be missed! Although it started to feel a little on the stale side from the first bite, the cheesecake waffles in a tin bowl Their chips and salsa with their garlic sauce were also delicious and so cheesy. The Fried Chicken sandwich with BBQ sauce, which is on an ice hockey rink is great because there is no meat or cheese. The chicken salad was a light yellow salad, with a delicious meat filling and a perfect blend of green, chicken and ranch.

Baked T's is a popular T-shirts store in St. Louis that has an awesome costume part and costume store front, too! Their staff is friendly and patient. My husband and I love to put on costumes at Halloween parties, and I am lucky that there are some places in St Louis, MO. One day, my SO and I were at a party with some friends and I needed some custom apparel for a friend's Halloween costume. The manager called over Baked T's to get me a referral. I've got to say, the whole process was so streamlined and amazing. This was a great place to shop for your holiday T-shirts and hats. After getting there the same day to my appointment they were almost full. I didn't recognize the owners, but I soon discovered them to be locals in Kansas City. They said the Tshirt industry was advancing and they have a speciality in using their graphic design skills. We were just inquiring and I responded, "Baked T's is a design studio. Then I need a design to go with it." And right away, they were really friendly, excited about what they'd be able to do for us and helped me design the most unique shirt I could Now we had the creative power to start a "dress up". Getting my shirt delivered was even better. The workers at Baked T's are incredibly quick too! The custom designs were so creative, the shirt came out even better. I ended up saving both a lot of money, and the design turned out really good. While I was at Baked T's, my SO asked me if I was comfortable with having the same design on his shirt. I suggested that my little boy a make his own Tshirt as well. They really seemed to enjoy the creative energy of this store. I had seen Bakerd T's on social media, and when I got there, the lady at the counter chatted with me, and we discussed the Baked T's provides this service to me and my SO. I will be back.

When my husband sent to me a note that he'd gotten in the kitchen for his Father's Day gifts this past week to check out I walked into the store with my 3 teenage daughters and she was blown away with the decor. In fact, I would shop everywhere to find one of their pots. In the kitchen section you can find all kinds of supplies you'll need from cooking utensils to a huge basket of cookie cutters. I ended up buying some cutlery that I could use for all of my grandchildren's wedding gift needs. They had so many shapes and sizes to choose from, it was so many to chose from. The cookie cutters were perfect for all the girls that I need for the Christmas season. The cutters will go a long way in making my Christmas gift perfect and easy for my kids. I love these cute little cutters because they fit nicely on my cutting board and they make good cutlery. When I finished browsing, I walked over to the basement. For more than 10 miles they carried a huge, huge selection of vintage ceramic dishes. I found so many dishes I have been on the lookout for. I bought a mug that was just the right size. The best display I saw was around the corner. This was a wonderful picnic basket! I have a basket and can't bear to give it up. They really did make me very happy, it was that simple. My husband is the owner and he came in all the time. I felt like a little part of the family. I look forward to going back to see if I can find anything more that I like.

Southern Barbecue has been in business in the area since 1999. I'm based in Northern, Michigan, so they're a local favorite. I knew with my eye only that I was going to try the Catfish. They are a little pricey, but I was well satisfied with their offerings. I thought, "It's worth it, I just can't find a other place like that, it's like being on your own The server told me that their catfish was farm raised. At least, so did the waiter. So here I am, standing at the counter, waiting for my order to be taken and waiting to be served. I was told that the chicken is the most tender chicken they have, and the catfish did not disappoint. The sauce is mild and not too much of a "twist". The seasoning added a little something extra, but not enough to really make it worth the wait. The fish itself tasted really, really good, considering I wasn't expecting it to be a gourmet meal. I had to bite it because the flavor did not compare to my old favorite, because the Buffalo wings are far too strong. In my opinion, the chicken and the sauce would give the fish a more complex flavor. Themashed Butternut squash really threw me off. At Southern, they don't include any fillers or seasonings, so you have your options, and I am happy I went with the "s There is a great selection of beer and wine on tap, so please ask about adding it to your order. I feel like most establishments, like Southern, are trying to make money off of my stomach. As I've mentioned before, the catfish was amazing, and the mac cheese was sooo good! I will definitely be putting this restaurant on repeat menus, as I was on my way to work today. If you're in the area, I recommend it. I'll be sure to add this one to our menu. Southern's menu and service are perfect and I would highly recommend a visit if you're looking for a great lunch option.

A couple of months ago when I had a yea, I did a chocolate shopping expedition, and came across the Egg nog Truffle This second visit was my favorite. A couple of months later, we got back to it as the chocolate is still as good. I was made to feel at home and very friendly. After finishing my shopping experience, and getting out of my car, I saw two boxes of Caramel Truffles. The Truffle are so moist and delicious! Very kind people, great Chocolate, good service, great business. Thank you to the whole staff and they were really sweet.

A nice little re-route that looks great tacked up to a rock wall. It's perfect for adding some soil to the yard before adding planting seed. A quick blitz of these beds and we already have a few in our garden. Great price point..

So today was the day that I made myself go out to the store and get a chocolate fix. Although, I am only a few months old, I am a "Chiller addict" and I am absolutely in love with their treats. The food trucks are amazing. The best is the Dairy Caramel Shortcake with a "French Flavor"... It was very sweet with an amazing vanilla and So much so it seems the company is trying to take the Cupcakes. I feel a little guilty for raving about this chocolate, but even that is an understatement. I am excited for our new delivery truck! I don't really know why I don't get these two on a regular basis. I've had this brittle with bacon on it, and it was amazing. Then upon hearing this I knew I had to visit his store in Dallas because we would be having our birthday and wanted a Brittle or two. This was the best brittle I have ever had. I wanted to know if there was crackling on my teeth. However, the brittle was like the meat to the brittle because the meat is cooked to perfection. Although I enjoyed eating there, I didn't enjoy the customer service and have to start with the "strange thing". Not because of any customer service or anything, but due to when they put me in line for check out. If the phone was in the store she wouldn't have been able to take the order. She was very nice on the phone and came over to the phone when I saw her because she knew the customer was from the kitchen. When the second customer was to be assisting with her order, our waitress rang the phone and we were still in line. I understand why the company put her two stars, however I will never give this experience up.

Visiting the Westfield area (Old Hollywood / Westfield Town Center) has not only become a regular, it is become an absolute favorites Since the last time we went to Old Fashioned on Main, the staff has changed. It's not too late to start thinking about this lunch place. The menu is great for those of us who are looking for a quick bite; and you will love the fresh, homemade food. They aren't that blasphemy and are trying to make a change in a restaurant with their dining options. The Cobb Salad is simple and delectable. The Cobb is light, but rich. I've had better Cobb Salads and have been told that the Cobb Salads are made to order! Although I was looking for a gaff for lunch when I had this my eyes were watching my waiter. When I was a kid, the TV was on our TV and we were cooking in the booth (it was an old school TV set). The burger did not come with a side of fries, but that's what I wanted. This burger is 12 oz. , topped with burger, onion rings, cheese, tomatoes, red onion and pickles, and served with honey mustard ranch dressing. If you like the burger, you can add the French Fries. The potato fries were perfect, but we had to leave because you couldn't get the potatoes to be any thicker. My friend and I had the Fries topped with a huge handful of bacon. I had the same fry and I can easily go back for seconds with less bun (I think the cheese was a bit off). At The Burger Shop, they use locally sourced ingredients, I especially like they use the "Hot Pot" style for their meat & cheese. Its my little secret, that I am in love with Mathew's.

Y'all, Today was a pretty bad day. And my Chocolate fix had just gotten worst. One of my favorite restaurants of all time, Bissinger's has been selling their chocolates for many years. I picked up some "new" caramel. The caramel had a tangy, fruity flavor with a smoky, spicy hit. "Salted Caramel" is actually a combination of Salted Caramels, Chocolate Chip with a Little Pear and a Well they did.The flavor is a bit of a surprise. I was happy to go up to Bissinger's after meeting their awesome owner, Joselyn, but that did not last for long. I wanted to have that chili, but I am a picky person. The caramel is a bit intense and the flavor is very intense. The Salted Caramels have been around for several years and have been well received. They are the best salted caramel I have had. I highly recommend Bissinger's. I never had the chance to even visit their store on the old Maryland Avenue. This location is definitely getting a look in my local area. We must take the chocolate to our friends up North to enjoy the taste. I may have to stop by, the smell is really fresh, but you can't replace a home sweet home. You should..LOL!

You can pretty much tell from their Yelp page that they are all about the home cooked, comfort food with a little kick to it. I told a friend about their delicious Biscuits and Gravy. I heard them was the number 1 breakfast place in town. I bought the lunch box and picked up my husband and daughter. We called, made an appointment, did some Internet research and ate breakfast at a local cafe. They did not have biscuits and gravy or milk. The fact that their biscuits and gravy would be served to me on Tuesday should not be a surprise. I was extremely surprised. The first thing I had to order was the Bloody Mary. The first time I had a Bloody Mary, I didn't want to pay attention to the amount in the jar. The kids didn't care though. Then I opted for their fresh chicken burger with the pickle spear and pepperoncini. As you might have seen, they just might have the best Bloody Mary in Jackson. If you think I love breakfast, you have to try their grits! It's a good value and the food is just as good, if not better than the food you would find on a buffet. Cassady is a true southern lady that makes it a point for her customers to taste their food and order what seems just right. They even have a good special on Tuesdays, which is  Grilled Beef & Sautéed Mushrooms served the traditional If you enjoy their breakfast/lunch menu, I do recommend this Spice Cake! The pie was soft, moist and perfect for my taste in pie. I will be coming back here again on my next trip. I'd give it a shot again if they had a Wednesday special.

I've been dying to go in and see when Melissa and Doug at the Village Market is open! How could it not be my first visit to this shop? Well, this was a long time ago. I was inspired by the great selection of Christmas gifts with very friendly shopping associates. It just so happens, that I was excited about going there to shop at the new store. I was blown away by the collection of items I could purchase from Auris and Edie. I found a full selection of items for everyone. I was ecstatic that Kelly has all the Cardinal and Blues supplies. I especially fell in love with the polka-dot tablecloth. She also had one of the greatest baby shower supplies. My favorite would be the food bar. You can even plan a special family dinner here, and she has the perfect tablescape you can design and paint so that any unused or left-over They had an extensive selection of little girls' outfits, accessories, clothing and accessories. As a result, we have never had one of Steve's Hot Dogs. I like it when I can find a good restaurant, good service, good food and good wine. It has a good size and seating area. They were very clean and Steve made them taste great! Four dogs..synthesized to suit our needs. It was almost like choosing from the dog you bought. All of them ARE great hot dogs. I think we were the only ones at the table, but what the hell, I love hot dogs so I guess I'll find a more appropriate restaurant I will stick with the Texas & Cheddar blend. We did not try it on the day of the party and it was not as good. All of the toppings were very good and made me a little bit hungry. As for the dogs, there was an assortment of beef, pork, chicken with different cuts of bacon and cheese, a few pieces of sausage, and two The Bacon was so tender and topped with a good amount of meat, you could feel the fat that was cooked throughout the dog.

We recently had the opportunity to visit this restaurant for lunch, the first time after my wife's first day with us and not wanting to be disappointed with her We were first introduced to this place during the last few months. My goal is to enjoy living my Mexican life more than I do. They could be hard to remember, especially because I am a southern girl. A few days ago I was a bit worried about my Mexican badge bringing me down to Texas again. I never did realize that I am making it to the top in both of those rankings. I started driving past Kirkwood, Illinois, over Memorial Day weekend and recently was craving a quick and delicious lunch. I had heard about the new fast lunch pizza place called MOD pizza. I found out that MOD was named, "Best New Pizza Architect in Kirkwood" and would love to recommend you to your friends & family. I ate like a million dollars - a piece of pizza or a salad. I was there for lunch and they were serving lemonade. I can't wait to see what more MOD Pizza can do for me. I had the new, Cherry & Cream Popsicle. It's a unique lemonade that is flavorful, but did not taste like soda. I wanted to share a pizza with you. The Pizza itself was perfect but that's as much about it as it is about MOD. The chicken was a delicious crisp texture that was just right, along with the jalapeos. It was actually my first time trying the Calexico and it was delicious with grilled chicken and jalapeos. They took the time to offer me more salad choices so I could choose my favorites from their menu. MOD pizza is the place to be. You'll love it. The menu at MOD Pizza is well written and I encourage you to check out their online menu for more information.

The movie was a quality picture that could have satisfied my curiosity. All the seats were comfortable. Many theatres are lacking this feature because they are not equipped with stadium seating. I didn't get the chance to visit Kitchen Sink with my BF at the start of the month. I was stoked, as this is one of my favorite little diners. For several months to come I didn't give in. Congratulations on your newest addition to your neighborhood, Mathew. You absolutely have won me over. I have to be honest, my favorite is your Egg Nog. It is definitely one of my favorites. After sitting home all day to do yoga and listening to audiobooks, my thoughts were racing with how I could make hump day at home even better. This past Saturday we both had to share an unforgettable feast to celebrate the opening of Cafe La Bistro. We ate at a French restaurant called Le Table - a place that has a great food scene, great prices and amazing service. It's even better when you slather on some cheesy butter and icecream. I got the tripel with my dinner on February 23, 2008 that was a perfect example of the food experience of French France. We were on our way to the French Market when I heard of the French Market and when we arrived, we found the place was just full of delicious food. The bartender could sense the emotions from those who made the dishes and the customers just couldn't wait to try them all. I was so excited about the Terrine, because I loved the texture and the flavor you get from eating some of the delicious liver. To start of was a white cream sauce that was very similar to molten cream. It was amazing and the chicken liver and marrow were plated on a small serving bowl; amazing! When the lid opened, I immediately snuck out and had a large chunk of the skin, which made me linger for a moment and After the Terrine, we ordered the French clams with the tomato sauce and pickled garlic. There were two kinds of escargot, chicken liver and a garlic escargot. After our desserts, we shared a trio of creme brûlée, with cream cheese and fruit sorbet. The texture was just a touch thin and I was so full of bites I couldn't stop gushing. We finished off with a brioche with Mussels de Marimiere. They were the absolute best I've had and if you don't go for a seafood pot of mussels, you'll be a The pots were really impressive and held a steady stream of mussels with the lid pressed against it. They were placed in a large porcelain bowl and it fit perfectly inside the pot. It was easy to throw the excess shells into a pan of water and use a fork to scoop the water away. I'm a fan of both the Provencales and the A la Marimiere. I'm so glad that I did, because it tasted like an entire piece of food! Our afternoon was filled with dessert. There's a good-sized dessert menu for $2 each. It does not even have to be a dessert. We both chose dipped ice cream for dessert, and I wanted the Cream Cheesecake. I would have loved to share a bite. We also ordered the Chocolate Chip Cake and I went with it too. We wanted to return the next day. Hee Hee, don't go home without dessert! I got to try a new dessert that I had not had in years and I had a bit of a hiccup. So many menu options, so little time (and effort). I was literally just bursting with joy about this food experience. There is no better place than Cafe Du Chemin at the Grand St. Louis Museum of Art. The dessert menu is all of French. It was the perfect meal that was made more so by each bite that I went home with so many smiley faces. I could even have told all my friends how mouthwatering this was. The restaurant gave them a lovely touch of flavor as an added touch for the desserts. The Belgian Waffles were light, but very moistened. Now, we just must go find one of those little wooden dollops and go in.

Today we went to Luvy Duvy's for breakfast. The eggs Benedict was so average, it's just unforgivable. We did not realize what was beneath the crust of our food in what was a gross attempt at trying to be a real quiche. To the surprise of the waitress, who was there with us this morning, they charged us more than they did. It was an ordinary sized egg dish with a hole in the middle. The ham was dry and flavorless. We ordered a side of ham and cheese. This was clearly an unlabeled version because it was just a plain white refried egg with ham inside. We also ordered two eggs and a hash brown. The hostess, Cassidy was great. Although, he was a little "insider" when he walked by and the hostess had to open doors to make sure The last thing I wanted to do was get some coffee, not because I thought they were bad, but because they didn't provide coffee for free. This had nothing to do with the quality of the coffee, but we are all used to getting something different on our bill. Upon inspection, the servers seemed friendly, helpful, personable, and friendly. It was better in February. The only thing I can say is that the food and service is what they have at this time, on the patio. It's no surprise the food is not much better and I'll probably not go back to this location.

The Dierberg's on Broadway in Buffalo, NY is the best grocer I have been to. My new favorite dinning and grocery shopping bag is the one from the new Dixie Grocers supermarket. I love you, Mathew, for opening your restaurant across from my house. I would be happy to have you come visit for dinner or a glass of wine, I was so impressed with everything! The first stop on our two day visit was the Bar, they are located in the old Hotel at 8100 Main St. We were there for drinks and I For a restaurant new to St. Louis Hills, they have worked really hard to get a feel for the place. From the look of the restaurant to the decor, it seemed like a great place for the weekend. Mathew is the one who owns this joint and continues to grow the business. Mathew is more than a chef, he is someone who truly loves serving up great food to the customer. MK goes for really big plates, and is even more than it looks. He's also not afraid to slap the grill on his entrees. We came back around dinner time and had seated ourselves at a booth. During the rush a few of the tables were empty if you could call it that, so we thought it might be worth a couple of hours Our wait was about 35 minutes for the drinks and a table. One of the first things I noticed in the restaurant was the grilled salad. I ordered this based on their video of them grilling kale, but what I really loved was how the Caesar leaves stayed all the way on The meat is not heavy or too fat, just the right amount. The only person who did not look pleased at the clunky new collar, was Buddy. The new collar was the perfect fit for him. He was so excited, he started barking his soft vocals into the car. It was very interesting to be with our little boy dog, and the staff was very knowledgeable about Buddy. We were so excited to see the new Coach collar in the store. Also, he was the person who took our picture. I showed her my brother Buddy's collar. My son, who has been going to the vet for the past 12 years was also looking at a number of things for Buddy. He helped me pick out new leads for Buddy, and he also showed me a few new products to help him with his fears. The treatments included a t-shirt, a heat therapy w.e.f. Jeff was a great guy to pick up your order from. I am so grateful to this place for showing my dogs how healthy they can truly be. I have always given four stars to Four Muddy Paws because of how fast they were responsive to my needs and how friendly they were. I guess now I'll go back and get more help for my little boy Buddy.

Are you a bit picky about spices? There is none better than the spices at Penzeys. This store has you covered with spices for almost any season of the year. They are right across from the Canada Post Store on Unionville Lane near the Dundas line and have a great selection of spices. If you are looking for some new spice for your recipes, stop in, they'll be glad to help. Also don't forget to check out the spice rack, which is made from stainless steel to make sure that it's not only fresh, but also  You also have the option on how you would like to purchase the spices, to order them online or to pick up the spices in person.

How: This was my 2nd visit to this place and I would never go back. The chicken sandwich and waffle fries are excellent. My first disappointment occurred during my lunch service. After writing this blog, many of you may have seen me having a cheeseburger/slice of chicken on a bun. It felt like the entire bun had been microwaved. I'm not one to judge a product, but it's not a bad bun. If you would serve the chicken with its own sauce, I would go ahead and give you 3 Stars. I entered your door. He kept pushing, trying to find me before I gave up. He was a white man. Then we were given my receipt and I was handed my burger. If the man was aware of who I am and what I'm doing, he/she would have put a stop to any attempt to try You were not wrong. You can't fault everyone.
