Historically, I've been on the fence about going in, because it's not as hip as you think. I'm getting used to that fact, however. Their products are pretty good and they are very organized. In any event, HL has been very helpful here. I got myself some gift wrapping supplies. I wanted to wrap the gifts as well, but still just like I have done for so many years. I didn't have to search. The price was half off and half off at Party City. I also bought some coordinating items for my wedding as well. Just so I can be a little more creative with a table. Party supplies, white table plates, silverware, silverware, silverware holders, ribbon, ribbon and more. It all went together so much perfectly. My table was ready to go. With that said, I wasnt too impressed. This time, I wasn't sold on the prices, or the decor. It took me a little longer to get what I wanted. It was pretty convenient shopping for a smaller store but not so convenient shopping for a bigger store. This is my number one go-to party supplies store in Orange County. The prices here are great and the items are what it takes to set a party table.

Aldi's has been my weekly store for years. It is a small, family friendly grocery store, with the best prices. I've found that this place is better and has the food I need at a cheaper price. If at first I was not a fan of Aldi's, I found a great location called Gander's in the mall over the This Aldi's is my new favorite because of the more laid back shopping environment. The food selection is just so much better in the Maplewood store. I'm sure that you have never found a product you didn't need there. The selection of brands and the quality is much higher. I even love that the bathrooms are bigger than the ones at the Maplewood. There are even a few stores where the displays are all placed in a nice fashion. A big plus for all the shoppers is: their store is laid out neatly, so there's minimum hassle of standing in line. Everything was great at this Aldi. They are not busy and have good attitude.  Aldi's of Northvale, MA, 1261 N. Main St. It's a great place to go, don't let their prices fool you.

I have been going to Twisted Biscuit for quite some time now. I don't really have a schedule to go out and I can see if it will work around my week. We get up at about 8:00 and hit the roads. It also offers some great cocktails for adults as well. My only criticism is that the parking situation here is bad. Here at TB, they put down that coffee icebox with the drinks so I don't have to get up early to order. It was a rainy day and I ordered a Bloody that topped with Spicy Shrimp and Grits. Those were really good. My waiter told me they made grits with Shrimp but when I got the food, I discovered I had left home with the grit I've had good grits (from my family and friends) and I was ready for grits. It was nice to try the Biscuits. These were all really good. In an order of 12 Bloodies, I had 7 different biscuits, then three of the same ones, the Bacon is My Jam, I Like It The bacon was a nice thickness and they were a bit salty - I'll definitely put that on the side. My first visit, I tasted grits with Shrimp. I had shrimp with a thick layer of grits and a cheeseburger. Thanks again for all your great service. On my second visit, I tried the Breakfast Biscuits. The two biscuits with the biscuit were the, Smokin' with Smokin' Sausage & Mushrooms. I ordered the Americanized Bacon, and got a nice portion of Bacon. My next visit, I added a side of soup - I asked for the Tender. After that, I went to the Texas Roadhouse burger and hot dog. The Cuban breakfast served with a white tamale salad and a side of the sauce. Although, I'm not a fan of spicy Chili sauces, I enjoyed the taste of the chili. On the other hand, they were willing to send me a bowl of grits which could be thrown in with my meal. I'll be back! You'll be glad you did. I don't believe I ate a biscuit once, but it was great! I'm ready for fall. I'll keep you posted if there are any news. That's for sure. The place was packed, and the food was delicious. Not everything was perfect but to my surprise, I had the chance to try the "Pork Pie" Biscuit-- it's the best I And if I were that kinda dude, I would definitely spend money on myself at Twisted Biscuit.

What: Meat and vegetables. Aldi's North in Mesa, Arizona on the corner of I 35 and E 26th, is very different. The prices are lower and the quality is comparable. I buy every week or two. It's not going to be the same like other stores, but that's just due to them being lower prices. This Aldi's was one of the best prices. I really like Aldi's and have been a regular shopper for years. They have an excellent selection of organic produce and most of the items that are on sale are at the Aldi's prices, with better prices. As a first timer, I would recommend that you shop with their staff, because you never know what you are getting. I love everything they have to offer, especially the new organic and "organic" produce they are showing. Best in STL!

I first dined at Patio at the beginning of September. I've been coming here twice a week. That was a big deal, because I've been going to this Mexican restaurant for 7 years now. On a visit to my house, I ordered a Mexican Salad and Quesadilla. This was my favorite of the three. The Chicken was roasted in a flour tortilla, served with onions, fresh tomatoes, and a mix of lettuce and spinach. The sauce was flavorful and the cheese was the perfect consistency it had a hint of smoky flavor. They also have a large beer selection. Lastly, the chips are the best chips I have ever had. Don't ask... they just have the best thing on the menu. You can chose stix, ranchera, soy chicken, corn, or white beans. I have been having them with a variety of meats, kale, squash and asian vegetables for a couple months now. They also made me feel like they had all the fresh fish they could get their hands on. I've also been a big fan of the limeade, they have a wide sprinkling of that. They have the best, but I'm sure the enchiladas are also great. They're an acquired taste, however, I really didn't like it. For those of you who are looking for a good Mexican restaurant, check out the Chicken Quesadilla. Don't be afraid to try it. Yep, I'll be back.

I came here for some chocolate and red Velvet Cake Ice Cream. They are creamy and delicious. I said I didn't want to try the dessert, and they handed me a small tray with a "bleau chocolate bar." On seeing I had no choice he offered to blend 2 pieces of their cold stone and add the brownie. A brownie tasted very good so I had to accept a second round. My friend suggested I try something he said was better than a chocolate milkshake and I agreed. I then had a good night with an Ice Cream Cone and the second I heard of the RV I was sold. In a nutshell: a perfect combination! Take advantage of the deals on Groupon. I do like the red velvet cake though.

Today I decided I would try breakfast at Teaspoon Cafe next-door to Four Muddy Paws store! I have a few clients here, but it usually is a jumble of cars parked on the lot. As a matter of fact, it is one of the reasons I frequent the area, as soon as Four Muddy Paws opened. After being sick for a day or so and unable to use TC’s dining room for two weeks that was the last time I could dining  However, parking was nearly impossible to find to the TC restaurant. But, since Teaspoon Cafe opened, I have noticed a marked reduction to parking. There are also a lot of customers and people waiting for the doors open. I decided to give something else a try and stopped by to let them know that I was excited because I wanted to test the Egg Benedict. I had a bit of an attitude problem since I know these areas, so I opted to have coffee and pastries and eat there first. I thought the breakfast section was a little small but it was very gimmicky. I thought the Breakfast Burrito was delicious, but I was a bit disappointed in the presentation of my breakfast. I ordered a couple of items. The pancakes were light, fluffy and delicious. The waiter was friendly and efficient, but I ordered a side when I arrived, but the server was friendly and helpful in the meantime. This little cafe offers both breakfast and lunch. We got one of the original pancakes, as it had a rich buttery flavor. They were served with edamame, an egg, and bacon. The bacon was even a lot fresher than you would find anywhere else. And then, while the bacon was warming up, I tried the hot Chocolate Frozen Iced tea, because I love hot chocolate. Teaspoon Cafe was a total win. The cafe is also open everyday except Sunday. Now where are you? The parking area is a huge hit, so it doesn’t surprise me that there is often so much traffic (be it a late afternoon or mid

I attended a "Give-Away" at this restaurant during my recent trip to Las Vegas. But the two things that brought this restaurant down to a 3? We came back while the restaurant was still half full. There was even some smoke in the bathroom. There were also a few smoke clouds around the restaurant. It was hot, but it cooled quickly. It was a bit of a smell and I was very sweaty, when I got home. They brought our drinks even before we needed them. My Fire Margarita was the best drink by a long shot. It was the perfect mix of ajito with the smoke of a fireplace. It was truly flavorful and it was so unique and delicious. The crab roll was actually actually crab, not fish. They have the same crabs that you'd find on the restaurant menu. You know you know when you get some shrimp. The shrimp is cooked in a wok until done. Also one of our favorite items is the Shrimp and Beef with a Shrimp Tempura Bowl. The Pad See Ew was actually a single dish of beef with vegetables, and it has no noodles. Their broth was so good that we stopped sharing our entrees to finish more. The beef was a touch fatier than I expected. The other half of the meal was the Peking Duck Salad. Although, I'm glad we didn't sit down, I would have liked to have had a place to sit on a patio. I'm glad to find a more casual alternative to this restaurant that has much to offer. However, the food is just average, not everything will be amazing. The waitress was excellent, nice and helpful! Thank you for the amazing food and the amazing service! Their menu is good.

Fresh Thyme is truly a fusion of the big chain store and the smaller farm/ rancher style store. I would always try to stop by but it's so much more fun in the Ft. Wright parking lot. It has a wide selection of different items that are locally available. Upon entering the store, we were greeted with a welcoming welcome and an immediate sense of "home". I didn't find a meat runner, but was very impressed with how well the produce was packaged and they have a healthy selection. I even had a chance to order a cup of coffee right from the till. I am going to love this new store and I have high hopes for the growth of this community. They have a wide variety of food, primarily organic and healthy, and I was excited to hit their produce department and eat in every day. They offer a variety of healthy options, such as organic and natural coffee products. As for my experience in the store. If I had cashier's, I would like to see some cashier jobs at FT. Fresh Thyme is really worth it.

Hardee's has come up with one of my favorite burgers, since I love Jalapeos. I have always been a fan of the cheese, but I love the peppers even more. We just figured this place was going to do it way better. This burger is full of jalapaos, cheese, bacon and pepper jack and it is just delicious. This one has been a knock out, but I have to confess my mouth watering. But that didn't stop me from trying one. The prices are not cheap for this burger. We've noticed that they do not serve the burger fast enough, so when they do serve you, they do not know what they are doing until they I will for sure be back to try this burger because it is a winner.

In town for our company's corporate meeting this past Sunday, we decided to try out an upcoming local brewery at ITAP. ITAP is a family run business that has a good selection of brews. There's craft and pub and all sort of weird beers. They also have an awesome patio with ice pizza. They have pretty much just about anything you would find at the chain brewers. I thought I'd get in and get some pizza when I met up with friends at Epic's. I heard the bartender explain there is food here from 3:00pm to 6:00pm. We walked just outside to ITAP. Originally I was excited to try it but I soon realized how friendly everyone was. For those of you who are not savvy on Beer in general, they got us all a selection of local craft breweries that they also carry Despite being the first time there and the first time I've ever seen them on foodie magazine, I can tell you that I've never The beer complemented my food taste and matched the rest of the menu, as we were all looking for something a little bit different. I ordered the Turkey Patties with a side of BBQ sauce which I thought was just good. This place was filled with fun and funky people who have an endless supply of beers.

POM (Peaches on Monday, Oatmeal on Thursday, Corn Mash), my new favorite place to go for great local pie! I've always had a hankering to visit the Pancake Mill, but never had the time to go. Pie Oh My!! is a family run business with the owner Jane Cook. Initially, Jane sold me some of her pie. My husband and I were excited to enjoy Pie Oh My! on a trip to Chicago last weekend. On Monday and Tuesday, my SO called me to bring him to Pie Oh My! The store wasn't open because I didn't have someone there to bring me pie and a co-worker was working in IL at the I also was waiting in my car for my SO, and since I knew that he enjoyed pie I needed to find it in an timely manner. I brought my SO to POM. I received a few dozen pie shells from the kitchen. At this point I was completely grossed out. Immediately after deciding to eat, I told my SO that they were great and I'd take a bite. I filled it at my office as it was cooling and when I reached the door, I opened the oven door and opened off the vents. Her words became my motto for the day. On the way home my SO asked, "We got ours." I said just finished with crust and I knew I wasn't a fan of cranberries. The Pie took only 30 minutes for him to bring it to my table. It was perfectly cooled and the pie was still delicious, not at all gummy or smoky. I had the crust with whipped cream, jam and graham crackers, to top it off. We really loved that one. I told her her pie would be Carrot Pie on Sunday. My favorite was the Chocolate, Banana & Vanilla pie. She did make Banana Cream Tuesday but that didn't really interest me since I do like a little icing... I would normally not have So we asked her if she wanted any special requests (and guess what?!) I can not imagine not eating Chocolate Bourbon Pecan Pie on any given Tuesday. Chocolate & Bourbon together should be a standard combination, but for me, you can't beat a chocolate & pumpkin pie. The Chocolate Pie was a very different flavor from I expected from my first visit. It is huge and when you bring home the pie there is always a bite left of the previous day. I had not even tried this pie before. So far every pie I have had has been delicious and I love to go back. Thanks for the review!

I am so happy that I finally ate at House of India for dinner. Especially when it comes to restaurant food. I love to cook, I enjoy eating and I love trying new things. House of India served a very flavorful entree called Lamb Krahi, which was very filling. HOI prepared a flavorful Chicken Karoon, along with Chicken Biri and Kawali Bhajan I think it was amazing. I was just so impressed that I had to share my impressions of this dish with you. It also a great side of rice. One of the last restaurant I went to that was not cooked. The wait staff was friendly and helpful. We really had a great time eating at House of India and the manager was super friendly. They kept the restaurant clean and well organized, and made it fun to visit. We had to order more because all of us order 2 to 3 different things. I would definitely recommend House of India to anyone. Not a bad meal!

The hotel is beautiful, not overly crowded. The patio is extremely nice. It was the perfect lunch for me minus the drive home. For the lunch, I had a delicious Bruschetta and Mahi Mahi, served with a choice of a wine. It was so fresh and smooth and it was so refreshing! A wonderful wine.. definitely worth the time to try. I chose a Mahi Mahi Platter. Even though it's an unusual name, Stemmari will do the job for me. I could easily have had more than one glass of the Stemmari. It was great surrounded by a lovely crowd and the location was great. But I would recommend not ordering these items unless it was already a week after eating in. It was delicious but maybe someplace else instead of just the restaurant?

Flying Saucer is a must stop every time I visit St. Louis. Flying Saucer is by far the best restaurant I have been to in St. Louis. The food was good and the service was exceptional, even though we both got very busy. I suggested a chicken dinner because both of us are fans of chicken. The BF and I ordered wings, the signature wings with the saucer. The wings were tasty and seasoned well. The wings were actually more than three times the serving size of my wings. That food complemented the beer very well. The girl ordered the Beef, Beef and Chorizo Burger. Plus, they use the best beef brisket to ever come out of Texas. Nice and the price was reasonable. The other burger was the Cuban burger. This burger has a 2-inch piece of meat, the San Miguel Burger. They were topped with chipotle mayo, pickle, green onion, avocado, tomatoes, pickled onions, fried egg, gu So this is the same as a small McDonald's burger, but this one is thicker and had an extra slice of cheese on top. They also have a hot sauce available to them so you can add and adjust the flavor of the burger to your liking. And with the wings I can really appreciate it when the restaurant is nice and clean. The service was great, too. She made a great impression. Aside from the food, it wasn't like the other options. I will certainly be returning to this restaurant to try out their burgers more often. I'm certain that the machine was well used and wasn't a major issue that day.

gluten free.. (Gadget not to feed the cows) so we took a look at Good Fortune on the Green Line. Good Fortune has been a longtime favorite so far, we've been dining here for years. I've been eating here twice, once for lunch and once for dinner. I never go vegan and when a server mentioned the angbool rangoon there was a bit of a sigh of relief The Rangoon was just amazing. My other visit was a dinner and an UYE. I ordered some chicken & vegetable and their fried rice. The brioche bun was definitely not what I had hoped for as I prefer the white bread over the French bread and I can't imagine I One day I decided to get three vegetable items - chicken, pork and scallops. Their lunch menu included a variety of dishes including a Mongolian grill dinner. I was looking forward to dining here again. They offered this new dinner item in a separate section of the menu. I decided on taking a seat on the patio so that I could enjoy the scallops with my friends. I was a little sceptical, then I got my bite. I was a seasoned pork rib fan. I got the sweet potato ribs, which were delicious too. I felt like it was a little "in my face" eating them since it was a Saturday night for the dinner. I got 3 large portion so that's plenty for dinner. It was a wonderful dinner to start with and a delicious dinner also. They were delicious with clams on the side. They serve scallops with a steamed egg, but that is not my favorite. The turnips were just perfect. It was so good that I can't wait to try more scallops. It was a winner. Good Fortune also offers gluten free breads and the service was friendly and fast. This is no exception. I couldn't have requested for a better dining experience and would recommend Good Fortune to anyone. I recommend Good Fortune to everyone! I love everything.Cheers!

Had a very quick blood draw at this location. The blood is drawn, you are waiting...and then you go home. I just wish there was more of them. I'm quite pleased with the quality of service I has received from this local location. This location is a new one for the whole family. I was surprised the location opened not only near my home but on the corner of Van Horn and Oak Streets. I was able to get mine a week after it was posted. It has simple check-in on Yelp. I just went down as soon as I found the location. The service was quick and the blood draw was really prompt. When my technician arrived, I was very friendly and relaxed. It took over 5 seconds for the technician to arrive, take a quick look at what I wanted, read through the rules and then the drained blood I was not at all comfortable in the chairs which was the usual complaint of my usual blood draw location. My tech was sweet and kept me comfortable throughout the process. I had no issues or concerns about the technician in general, but, she wasn't friendly or apologetic when I had to get in and out It is a beautiful facility, with very well-kept waiting rooms. While there were some times I had to wait for her to get in a bigger vein as she used the needle to dig a hole in her vein. I'm so glad I found this convenient and easy to use location. My next blood draw is tomorrow. I recommend you get fresh juice or something. Been to the Quest twice it was as good as the first time.

Over the holiday, my partner invited me to try JJ Twig's pizza from a delivery order. But the food didn't live up to my expectations. So, the environment was pretty pretty but the booths were tiny. We could hardly get a seat, if you're a seated type of person then you may have trouble with the small size. It feels too small. I personally think the layout of a diner is a bit topsy turvy for me. We enjoyed our meals and enjoyed the food. The first thing we ordered was the Buffalo Chicken. The wings were a good size with plenty of seasoning, the sauce on them was good too. There were so many chicken wings it was almost too much for one! In my opinion, it was the best wings I have ever had. I ordered a side of the BBQ Pulled Pork Burrito Bowl. Served with a tossed salad, a large serving of pulled pork, ranch dressing, and a side of greens. The toppings were delicious, but not to a dish where I want to eat all three Salads. It was also my first time ordering here, so I'm not going to be wasting any money on this dish. They were extremely good, both sandwiches were very easy to eat. What really stood out were the onion rings. I didn't like them at all, the skin, tasted like they were straight off of the store, they were thick and dry. The sandwiches were large, we thought that, since they were plated in a jug, they should have been a little crispier. JJ Twig's is a small, casual dining option for a reasonable price that really suits my needs. You can watch the waitress help someone with an order but she isn't good at talking. If your going to a restaurant, don't bring food as I had a friend who had a major meltdown with the host. They also have a selection of happy hour specials as well. This is a great addition to the community.

I took my Sheltie there for some supplies when I needed it. I don't know if I need to make an extra trip to this place to get the Sheltie merchandising but  However, these shops are more expensive. I called in ages advance and I had already seen an open space sign at one of the entrances. My only complaint is a little less than what I've seen before. They also have some wonderful Sheltie gifts. It's a must stop! The staff really explains the items and the shop is clean, safe and organized.

We have been to Mexico for lunch at the Del Rio Diner a couple of times when we were in town. Did my review show them off enough or will I not return? We saw a similar menu, and it seemed like we had a lot of favorites. Have they been better? The first visit was a great dining experience, however the second visit was just a disappointment. Vegetable Pasta - It wasn't all that great. It was just average poured with no flavor at all. There was no guacamole. Flavor was good. Chicken was over cooked and dry. Chips were fine but a little dry. Not even fresh enough for someone with a gluten intolerance. Rice was mushy, not very chunky. Chicken Enchilada - Went from torn chicken to a moist taco. I think it is a problem of the server. Tries - Had a medium rare & didn't taste much like the meat. The whole place looked good but I have to say that was one of the better meals. The staff did not seem happy. I will leave my name on that. But I just hope I am not paying too much for lunch. I am hoping, a taste card coupon gets the owner going, but how hard would it be for me to find another place to eat out or  I would consider eating there to save.

Buy your own way to your favorite holiday destination. What can we say..we all have our preferences, our goals, our interests...and our budgets. Their selection is extensive and you won't find anything they don't have at the store. It only takes hours to purchase something awesome that you really want. You'll find that you'll be swept away into a big dream of your dreams. They even have an 18 month old in the shop.

The Park Avenue Coffee is located about 5 minutes from work on 15th St. and E. 13th Ave. and 12th, West. I think it's nice that they offer some kind of special pricing (I always pay about $2.50 for coffee, half of what I do at Starbucks You can order a large cake (which can be served in one meal ), or you can order a cup of coffee (a pot of espresso) The chocolate cake I ordered was a big disappointment, the original were tasteless and the gooey butter was too sweet. However, I tried this as my favorite - and if they did not win, they would have been a runner up. It's very dark, dense and the gooey butter was very difficult to spread. It was a huge piece of gooey butter cake full of chocolate dipped dough and sprinkles, and had too much cream cheese and butter I would only like to go back, if I had been more than happy.

I love being able to pick-up and take-out at a location out of my usual shopping area and am happy to see that Orange Leaf has The good news is, the quality of the ice cream is amazing and will keep me from melting all night. One of the most pleasant things I've seen in a long time has been meeting a friendly collector. The line was long, and I was trying to figure out where all these people were. When I went back to the correct office, two of the clerks were on the phone and the first lady was working to solve a problem. She also gave me a map of the office. At that point I had to stand in a line and wait a minute or so because a small, but friendly lady was waiting. All I found out was I had been late again. She was very nice, and reassuring, and told me that my last bill was about 3 months late for me. She could hardly believe I was waiting 45 minutes to go in from work. Welcome to Round Table Diner. This was a 3 star rating by me, which means I was quite happy with the food. Here's the thing: The menu wasn't bad, that's for sure. The seats were comfortable and I enjoyed my breakfast. I ordered an egg breakfast. The biscuits and gravy came with a side of sweet onion rings on the bottoms of the biscuits and I had the biscuit and gravy with You know, the type of food you'd find in small country towns (I'm a man of modest means and a meat processor), but The biscuit was really good and was cooked all the way through and didn't need any additional sauce to bring it to a tastier finish At the time I placed the order, the biscuit and gravy seemed kind of dry, but it was fine. It was my first breakfast out on Earth and not my last. Yes!?.. Yes!..I hope so. But maybe I'll take the drive again and eat there later.

Benedict's is my favorite cafe in Dallas for years. I have been here twice on several occasions (weekday brunch - Tuesday and Wednesday) (the first time being my last visit!). It was really good and I can't wait for my next visit. I just tried their Salmon Benedict. I ordered two of these and could not get enough. The meat was marinated and smoked to give it that wonderful smokey flavor. I am glad to finally recommend this place to anyone. This will be my next stop. The wait time to be in is only 30 seconds, so make sure to grab your spot fast. Not only are the ingredients fresh, but most of the stuff used is local and fresh.

I decided to eat at Golden Palace today since they are just a few blocks from my work. However, after finishing my lunch I was served the most depressing food I have ever had. When: November 24, 2015 Why: Eating my way through Ian's Restaurant Tasting list. Ian does a lot of walking tours of St. Louis. Once I found Fork & Stix in the St. Louis Downtown Center, I knew it was somewhere I wanted to go when I got sick. I was happy to see they had a soup that was out of these world. It's a great soup. Here is the recipe. This soup had a spiciness to it that was quite surprising. A must be.. It's a very nourishing bowl of soup. My drooling went away and I was glad to be home. After lunch, I ordered the crab rolls. I think you'd be better off ordering the fried Thai buns. The staff is friendly and the restaurant offers a plethora of Thai options. I really enjoyed the Gelato at Gelato Di Riso and their Caramel wasn't too sweet. Their Mochi and the Caramel were both very good. That was one of the things I was trying today to try because my husband's had very little to eat. I loved the sugary flavor but I also really like their sweeteners. They take you away to some pretty beautiful Gelato cones and you can order a flavor you like on the spot. Oh girl, this is heavenly. This has all been a month since I last came but I have had such a wonderful time with their Gelato. The service was a step above your average bar or diner.

A few years ago, a group of friends and I decided to get together and have ourselves a gastronomic fun date, at Central Table. With the Spring weather here in town, I am happy to be back in town for a night of delicious food and delicious wines. I am so pleased to have my Yelp review published about Central Table. I had a Groupon purchase a couple of months ago, so I knew I had to check it out! The food hall is the opposite of your typical food hall. The lighting was superb. On every level..I am still jaw droppingly impressed. The bar here is a bit of a dive. The bar is separated from the rest of the restaurant and is an intimate area. This is the perfect place for an up-tempo drinks, before dinner. I had the joy of meeting my best friend to join me for a drink and have breakfast. This time I had the Filet with Shrimp and Shrimp. We each started with a fresh bread starter salad. The bread was buttery and had cream cheese spread inside. I was excited for this and didn't stop to try. We opted for the Grilled Chicken with Caesar Salad and Fresh Basil. It was a large Caesar salad topped with a trio of white anchovies and croutons. This is one thing that is unique to most Caesars. White Anchovies are found in Italy, and can be purchased any time. They come in a light pink or blue with a bit of white anchovies. This made the salad perfectly crisp and served in a nice Caesar salad plate. They are so flavorful and they remind me of a salty pickled jalapeno on top of anchovies. In addition, the fresh and made to order Croutons were also delicious. They were a little dense but not tough (or too thick for my taste.) I'm not sure if they were handmade, but the crust was golden and the dough was perfectly shaped. They were the perfect sized bite size croutons to snack on while we were waiting for our entrees to arrive. My husband ordered the Sea Urchin Fish and I chose their Shrimp Fish. Then we decided to take a peak at their Sea Urchin. I have a hard time getting my cravings. The Sushi was so unique and flavorful I didn’t want to leave. They served an interesting array of sushi for the BF while I ordered the Grilled Chicken, Grilled Carne Asada and Sp Our server was extremely friendly and professional at the bar. Not to mention that the sushi rolls came out to be very fresh and not one of those rubbery, cold pressed sushi rolls you find on a lot Then we sampled two different types of their hot sauces. I couldn't help but feel that they could up the flavor and flavorful options when it was my turn to have my entrees. It was nice being surrounded by everyone, being busy with our food and taking pictures. For those of you who don’t know, Tuna Roll is a popular style of Japanese food served for dinner. The service is great and everyone here was friendly, knowledgeable and patient. My BF shared the Thai fried rice. As for our food, we shared their Thai Curry Chicken with Chow Fun Fried Rice and Chilled Orange Chutney. Having my family and friends in The Grand Hall was an amazing experience. The BF got the Filet Mignon, followed by his friends. I’m definitely going to have to try that nigiri! The Sushi made my mouth water, although I could not finish it. Their menu was all fresh and the menu boards were very interactive. I was in love with the fish and all the colors. I have no one to compare it to but we will definitely be back. It was a warm and welcoming environment with friendly service, good food and great people. The service was great, even though it took an hour for our table to be set up. Upon eating, it was like eating a bowl of water. I am extremely happy to say it was great. I guess after eating the raw fish, we decided to have a bite. We shared 2 Platter of Shrimp Rolls with 2 Pieces of Crunch. Their service was great as well. As we were finishing, I knew I was in for a treat!

Clifton's Cafe : T.S.F. Alton Post has occupied the former Post Office which has been converted to provide a great coffeehouse and casual dining space for local residents. When I visited, the seating was good and they were open. Post Commons was opened on Sunday, April 11, 2018 at the post office in Alton. Post is the first non-profit in Alton to offer a coffeeshop and are not a coffee-house. Aside from that room and space for group meetings and parties, the restaurant is extremely affordable. I was dining with my cousins the first day of April. One ordered the Black Bean Steak with bacon and a sweet potato was missing. It was served with a steamed egg and served on a toasted Brioche Bun. She really loves that meal. The bread was good and she enjoyed sharing it with us. And my cousins ordered a HashBrown and a HashPizza (which is only available for breakfast), which I thought was It was topped with a large patty topped with fresh ham, cheese and an egg. My brother and I split the hot dog because he has a really spicy, peppery style. He asked for a side of cheese as well. He also suggested that I penned my bacon sandwich with a side of bacon, peppers and blue cheese, thinking this would be very interesting. For dessert we decided to split the baked bread pizza. It comes on a toasted French Bread slice with pickled red onion, clementines on the side and on a side of marble ry The sandwiches were both great and I had a great lunch. The deli was done well and the deli bag was large, which is nice. We ended the lunch with a Bloody Mary which was served with a shot of the Bloody Mary cocktail. There was a delicious Bloody Mary paired with some delicious ice cream with a refreshing granita. Post Commons is a fun and friendly place for everyone. My cousins said it was one of the best bloody mary's I've ever had. The atmosphere is bright and fun. This post is part of Alton Coffee Social. I know it'll be a great addition to Alton's coffee scene.

The best birthday present for a cute four-legged dog is the food. I've got you covered with a cute dog treat and his birthday gift from Pets Unleashed. It was the fifth day of my month at Pint Size Bakery in the City of Chicago and since I'm not having Mondays, it was time Pint Size Baking is one of my favorite places for breakfast in St Louis. They are always open and their staff has always been friendly and friendly. They're my "go-to" place for all sorts of treats. My son, Little Debbie, had an oatmeal cream pie. I came into a restaurant on Monday afternoon. I recently tried a Reuben from Vernon's in U-City. I had a great time at Vernon's, a super friendly restaurant with a wide selection. Vernon's had it in a glass cup with cream cheese, jello and salami on it. I enjoyed it with a small side of their fries and a cup of French Fries. This is a great, fresh, tasty Reuben sandwich and so worth the drive. The Smoked Vienna Kraut was so flavorful that you couldn't resist finishing the sandwich. All of the sandwiches come with a grilled onion slice, or you can order as it is served on the patio. My husband and I ordered something else to finish it off. Aside from the delicious lunch I had and the excellent sandwiches, there was a dessert to be had. They have Smoked Peaches that were available for a $5 price at lunch. Now, as I was eating, I notice the amazing freshness of these peaches. They tasted like the fresh peaches, just a bit sweeter. They were perfect with the meat/veggies. There were a lot of people who ate the three of the four sides. Another favorite side was the cucumber salad. It's important to have a clear cut salad. The salad was fresh, light and flavorful. The cucumbers slices were very crisp and the onions were just perfect on their own. This mix was definitely a great addition to this salad. This salad is incredibly good!

I can't fathom how hard it is to change a restaurant's rating. My No-No List for 2014 came for a visit to this restaurant, Diner's Delight. The White Castle Club located at the intersection of West College Station and Xanadu has been a good place for some time. A little over-the-top party thrown me into a rut. I love the menu at White Castle on the strip. This is my favorite combo meal that I've had so far. I'm crazy about the combos that include fish or salad (salt and pepper). The cheese can be omitted, but it's really really good. I often have the French fries too. If you're ready to eat, just take a look here. RTC Cornish Co. is a burger joint, not a chicken tenders/burger joint. Those are my favorite chicken tenders. RCCF provides the experience you need. As you can see, the chicken itself is stuffed with seasonings and your choice of sauce between the boneless chicken tenders and Texas Toast. They are fried a little more than most chains, so instead of a thick, crinkle cut crust, you get a light crust They were very busy on the Saturday before I got there, so I did not get the chance to order the taquitos, which were great Their menu is pretty simple, just what I ordered, and I like that it's made from scratch. They had no seasoning added to the chicken. The meat is delicious and the sauce is solid enough to stay on the plate for two or three bites. I am thinking if I would ever eat chicken again, I would love to see a place that serves ketchup. I'm not a fan of sweet or salty things. I wasn't impressed at the RCCF, its a fast food restaurant. I wasn't a big fan of the drinks, they taste like water, but they made the drinks taste really amazing. The menu is small, but they have a good selection, especially if you like spicy food. The Manager would come in and ask me if I'd like some sides, I liked the fresh vegetables, and she was very nice. It was a Friday, so I wasn't there to take in the sights. I'd definitely come back here. I wish I lived in downtown St. Louis. The food is pretty good for a restaurant. If not, I'd definitely go back.

We visited Roper's for lunch today. This lunch was just as good as one of those on a Saturday afternoon at the bar, so we order our sandwiches at Roper's. We started with the Rib Tips which were soft, juicy and a bit sweet and tangy. The potato salad was not overly thick. It had an awesome texture and texture. It was not too sweet or tart. It also had some brown sugar added in, which was very interesting to me since I'm lactose intolerant. Although the potato salad is a little sweet, the baked beans were just as good. My husband loves Baked Beans and a cheeseburger with a side of potato salad and a side of BBQ sauce. We also enjoyed the brisket. I ordered the chicken wrapper with BBQ sauce while my friend ordered the steak wrapper, who had a bit of BBQ sauce on her chicken wrapper. The Ribs were also moist. They were a bite like meat you would see at a local BBQ restaurant. Although the server & waitress sucked, they remained there for our food. We will be back to try their burgers and cheeseburgers soon. They are a great place to eat, especially since they are in a small shopping center that makes it a very easy place to eat.

I have been trying to find a great Irish Pub to eat at in the area. I've been to Firebarrel, but Fallon's is a little like a standard sports bar...unreal. With my boyfriend, we brought a large group of friends to share a meal. The meals were thick, juicy and savory. Also, my dining room partner opted for an Ice Tea. The server was extremely friendly, but I think they were looking for the same thing. My dining partner's gyrate and I were almost speechless. It was nice to be a server in a highly populated restaurant. My appetizers were Fried Pickles, a new menu item at Fallon's, we had one when we came in the day before and it was I have had them at every upscale bar in town including the one in St Louis. With one star rating it is still good. I also enjoyed the pickles, not as much as my sister's, but they were good enough to make me go and head that way today. This is the best of my favorites, because even though they are based on Chicago, it was just as good. We got some fish and chips as well. The batter is heavy and somewhat like a mushy mess. They didn't have much sauce on the fish, so I had to ask myself what was cooking inside. I definitely would have liked to see a little more tartar sauce on these chips. We enjoyed a nice salad and chips together. The salad was another favorite of ours. I didn't get to eat their main course, so I threw my money at their "House of Soup" dish. I also had Beekeeper Pie which had a rating of 3 out of 5. We were very impressed. The next dish that I had to try was "The Last Supper". It was a perfect little meal that would suit you for a date or a large family outing. I could eat this all day long. Also, they served some sort of chips, so I was happy that there were no buttery chips on a Saturday evening.

At 1:43 PM this morning I found out that I was in need of a quick dinner so I decided to drive to White Castle and get lunch instead They have been my go-to for the past few years. They are thick and shaved just the right amount of salt & pepper then mixed with lots of cling wrap and other fillings. They're usually a simple lunch to get me to eat. This is the only restaurant I've tried at WC that has clam strips and they're always good. I always try to order one or two strips on an empty stomach. What we had was a very enjoyable lunch and a perfectly prepared clam strip. They didn't have burgers, but they took my order and had the fries and the soda with them. Norma and I had lunch Sunday lunch at FBB&M on 12th. We were happy that we made the decision to come. Their food is great, their prices are fair and they are a little pricey. One can only guess what the food was like. The Double Cheeseburger with Fried Egg and Bacon is one of my favorites. The large burger was filled with seasoned ground beef and tomato puree and served with a side of BBQ sauce topped with arugula The burger was seasoned enough for one to want to eat it twice, which I thought about taking advantage of. We also ordered two burgers. I ate my cheeseburger on the side of my chicken sandwich, which added just about everything I could not find in any other restaurant. I also found myself ordering three sides of fries; Cheeseburger, Grilled Cheeseburger, French Onion. The service is what makes this a great place to dine. So we ordered a combo of the burgers and fries - a chicken wing and a waffle fried egg. It's a fast and comfortable restaurant and the food is so tasteful, you can almost taste the freshness of the ingredients. We had a great time eating lunch and I'm sure I'll be back again soon. FBB&M's owner is young, friendly, and clean. After lunch, we would definitely recommend this place to friends and family.

Robert L. DeLoach (a.k.a. Rob) is the famous Gentle Giant Statue. He was a huge athlete who competed at the 1920 Summer Olympics in London until he couldn't come to Europe due to the fact that he Robert was born in 1883 in Chicago to a Native American family and lived in Alton Illinois at the time of his death in 1941. Robert weighed only around 70 pounds due to a rare genetic condition, he was a tall 9 feet tall. There is not a lot of information about Robert Wadlow's family but his story is told the same way as we all know and love about his The park is surrounded by ponds, gardens, statues. This place is very well designed and the space is just fun. The service here is sometimes good especially when something happens. The music here is a lot cooler than other bar's I've been to and is definitely more diverse and local than most clubs. This is much nicer than any of the other places I've been to in Charlotte because you can sit out on the patio and watch all the local music This is a fun bar and I hope you enjoy it.

I came here for the game last night and was very unimpressed with the food it's not the best quality I've seen in a while People seem a bit dissapointed in the bar service but not a huge issue. I do however want to say that I've had a great drink here and the food was good.

It's the best chicken fingers in New Orleans! I had a great time here. This has to beat "Ghetto Brunch"! Just sayin'. You better get ready to join the Gang with their fresh and fresh wings! I'm sure your tastebuds will thank you - but wait, they only have one, so it won't be good for you afterwards.

I used to get me hooked on The Blackbird for some reason and that was always my go to spot. I have been to this place numerous times and my personal feeling is that there are some things that need to be fixed. They've already replaced more of the old dive tables with tables where there were lots of unused chairs and still have a good deal of seating. There are enough tables available to bring out or cook the delicious vegetables in any style or size you like but again the service still is not perfect. This is a great place to stop for a meal and the prices on the menu are very reasonable. They will still be here though so that is always a plus!

I'm writing this post regarding the sports bar in the Rio Casino. The place has TV's on all the screens that will show you all the games on the TV. I have to say that they have absolutely no flavor to them or they taste like a regular bag of olives made with water.

Flanagan's is a sports bar that holds the Phoenix Open. The interior is very plain and a little boring. As you can tell there is a lot to see here, just keep the beer to minimum then head over to the food section. There are tons of apps and drinks and they also have a draft beer list.

The food was not as good as I was served and the drinks were pretty much  bland. If you are looking for the best creole food then you should visit other places. The only other draw down for this place is the overpriced alcohol that I've tried at other restaurants in the Charlotte area.

A local supermarket has an always great produce section. This store has everything that everyone needs! They have a very nice variety of fresh fruit. The staff is super friendly and the store opens to the public everyday until 6 PM!

I would still say it can be a challenge to get to Andrea's for dinner.

I just moved to the area and found the best Vietnamese restaurant in the area, Le Bianh. The atmosphere is casual and the music is old school. There are two floors - the top level has a great view of the bar while the bottom floor is mostly the restaurant. The eggrolls too were as good as a Denny's. Sometimes the menu changes, especially for happy hour ranging from $10-2 drinks depending on how you get there. The portions were large and the portions were fresh. I would definitely recommend this to anyone!

The bar was pretty empty but I felt like we got some good drinks (I did not eat because we were in a group) and had a This place really got packed at the beginning of the night so they ran out of tickets about an hour before the show started. The wait staff was friendly and helpful with whatever we needed from the house drinks and menu items. I would definitely recommend this place to others who don't have a very cool night out and have a few drinks together. I could sit at the bar for probably another 45 minutes and get the energy I needed because of the way the drinks were being presented. It feels like this is going to be a great place for the neighborhood downtown and also to hangout for a night of fun.

Steamboat Natchez is a classic time travel experience with only a few major stops along the River. The Steamboat Natchez and its crew have lived and died in Natchez, Mississippi and there's noescaping it. The steamboats crew is very friendly and the cruise is filled with stories and fun. The steamboat rides along the river in a slow motion, making the journey even more memorable. The experience is an experience never to be forgotten. This is not the tour you're looking for but it will be a great time at one of the great parks of the Mississippi Valley.

There is something for everyone here, everything from breakfast to lunch and dinner. The place is great. The menu is fairly standard for a brunch restaurant/pub and the location is right next to a small grocery store-like market. I love the small plates - there is enough variety so there is something for everyone with some great choices. I haven't found a great dining room as it is quite iffy when you are dining in. Whether eating at the bar or inside they don't skimp on their wine selection and for $10 it is one of my regular picks.

One of the best Italian restaurants in New Orleans, if you're searching for good food, you should definitely consider eating at The Italian Place. I would not consider this a place with a high crime rate, which I usually do not think of when I'm in New Orleans. This restaurant also has a fusion cuisine that includes lots of American styles including ribeye and Cuban. They also have a good cheese tower, if you know where to look. Some of the dishes are very tender and have been tender for me and not too rubbery. There is also a small grocery store on the patio.

I've been to a couple of other Russian bars in Chicago, but the Rustic Bar is the one I frequent the most. My boyfriend and I ate breakfast here last night because we had gotten to the theater the night before, which was about a half hour away. However, as I mentioned before, I have started to see an increase in crowds on this spot over the past couple of years. I'd love to hear your thoughts on this. So far, it's still not too bad if you plan on spending a night here. Maybe.. though that's a pretty low cost concept in the world I live in..

Lastly, the oysters were quite decent but lacked any distinguishing flavor or texture. So far I've been to two other sushi restaurants in the area that is much better.

Highway 83 (the Mississippi River Bridge) is a really bad drive that can cause a bit of anxiety. The bridge is a bit narrow at times so its best to be patient if you're driving. So I don't know who the other driver is and the cars that are going to run from it.

The food is good, not the best around but the prices are reasonable and the food is good. With the menu that much more wide open it makes it even less appealing to get a good meal here. Also, a bit of parking can be hard to find depending on where you are. Thought they could use more sauce options and it was nice to have a good Mexican menu.

This is a fast-food spot for lunch. It has moderately cheap prices for a quick meal of a single dish, but with over ten people they wouldn't be doing full bar or There was only one thing that did not take my order: cheese. Overall, the food was good.

I don't like the taste of their meat pie but that's a really minor complaint. They are definitely in my top 25 burger places to try!

The annual Wine & Food Experience takes place between September 24 and October 1 and focuses on the French Quarter and the French Quarter Market. The Grand Tastings are a two hour tasting tour of many of the famous restaurants in the city, including the Lechon Steakhouse, The French We were in the city for a half day (my wife and I were there for more than 24 hours) and got quite a nice taste of what I'm going to try to follow the Royal Stroll next year, since it is one of the most fun areas to make food and wine tastings.

Lee's is just off the freeway in the town center of Detroit. They are better than their closest fast food joints but the quality isn't as good as you would expect a fast food joint to be in. I came by to try out the Korean food at The Grain in the heart of Chiang Mai. The dishes are simple, not the most exciting but still good, oh and the people are fantastic. I had a very good experience with this joint.

The Tavern on the Square is well known for the fantastic lunch that they serve the whole time. Their great cuisine is largely influenced by the French cuisine and its influence on Tunisian cuisine. I went to Seafood Cafe a few weeks ago after having an email that put them on my radar. Even though there are many other choices in Memphis, it is the Southside that always wins for me. The shrimp are good, the crabs good, the crawfish are pretty good. Cafe Fresca has a wide range of items with prices of $2-1 each; the food selection varies a bit because most of it is good This place is more of a bar-style establishment with several different foods on the menu that appeals to the casual crowd. The portions are huge, if you are eating this is definitely worth it but you know most people are just trying out all the new items on the menu the If you want something really good, you have to pass by the other Cafe Fresca restaurants that are a five minute walk.

My favorite bar in the Warehouse district is The Phils. I've been going to Tik Tok Thai for years now and have never been disappointed. My favorite dish is tonkate soup, it's very good and very thick. I love the taste. Bud's burgers have some of the oldest in the city and they are always fresh and made from scratch. I have had a really nice experience with Bud's and I would say their food quality is quite average but this one at this location will never give me The staff has never been bad and the prices are relatively competitive with other fast food companies. The menu is a basic menu of simple choices with alot of choices for people who want to eat more than just drinks. I could get better for less then £8 per latte or a small sip of water. Some people found the food very sweet but overall their service is spot on. It's a great place to stop and be in the downtown area.

Edley's BBQ has been a staple of the Sylvan Park location of the Smokey Mountain chain since 2007. This place I compared to was right down the street from IKEA. Overall I enjoyed myself at this location of Edley's and have really been enjoying their service as well as the quality of the beef. Most of the bartenders were friendly and even seemed a little shady a couple times I had the opportunity to ask some questions. Check the menu here and make sure you come here on the day they actually open and make reservations in advance.

The burgers here are excellent, especially since the service is just as good. This isn't my favorite of the dive bars because of them being really dirty. This place is really fun and there is a lot of live music playing inside the bar and down stairs. I like Junction better than Kukhnya and think they really do what they say a French-style burger for a reasonable price. Our burger was good and the service was great.

I stayed here with my girlfriends for a special event at the Bridge Lounge and loved the decor, music, and food. I'm really confused when the new place opened. It was a long time coming that the adobo was introduced to the restaurant but the new food is just not much better. The place is tiny and the bouncers are rather impatient and you have to ask every single person you use to come to your suite if you want This new place has a much more comfortable dining area that looks like it's more comfortable than the old. We went there a few times when they were the one stop shop for all brews in the SF Bay Area. It would be nice to see the old style mural from the old Bridge Lounge with some new items. There are plenty of tables across from the bar as well but not much of a place in the ambiance.

On the very first night I had stayed at it I felt like I was in New Orleans as you got some great ribs and a crab ball What makes this great is that it still serves calis. The decor is very well done with dark wood and dark fabrics and the bar service is very friendly with the customer friendly atmosphere. This restaurant is a bit of a dive and the calas are not the finest but they are fairly flavorful. A good selection of food at the menu, and it is a good value for the price. I ordered the calas and find that it is quite delicious as very hearty but balanced with a good amount of crab. You should also try the gumbo or the chicken boudin, which is a nice combo of shrimp and ceviche with some sort of  The lunch specials are a bit limited. The atmosphere and service are very friendly from the waitresses to the customer service. This is definitely not a true NOLA restaurant. My friends were also like trolls and it is nice to see some people that are not trolls being treated differently in this place. Thank You for bringing back the calas.

While I don't have a bad experience with eat.salmon.ca, their grocery stores in Calgary are not as good as I would The produce selection includes mostly produce not produce from New Jersey but they do occasionally have dairy. I would have been more generous to provide higher priced food for the food bank. They typically have things listed for pre-made things and some bulk items. The cashier really makes everyone smile though.

Sportsbeat is a bar and cafe in East Los Angeles and is very popular on lunch and weekend dates. They have a huge selection of craft brews, some of which I've been very impressed with! Good food and great prices. There is also a burger special that comes with a huge salad and a chicken ranch dressing that you can take home and serve yourself. Just need an hour to get out of the city and enjoy the great atmosphere. They are near Wynns World Resort where they play tournaments and they are located next to the hotel.

We love to visit the Piglet House since their menu is a pretty diverse mix of the traditional Southern flavors of BBQ with a selection of different sides. I ordered from the location where I was coming to and it arrived fast and had a good taste in the bowl. The meats were delicious, well seasoned and of course cooked to order. The brisket was actually very good and the sides consisted of sweet potatoes and turnip greens which were very good. One of my favourite places in Nashville is also Jack's Bar-B-Q and this a good place to eat and that wasn't even I love that they always use fresh romaine lettuce which I have always wanted to try but the romaine lettuce salad was so nice.

I'm not usually one to rate establishments quite highly, but this was my first experience with this place. Most people I know that use credit are either very young or have a debit card instead of a credit card. The quality of food is really good and you can tell they went above and beyond the call of duty I had in mind while in New York. Although I find the prices very reasonable I was hoping for a bit more because all of the items I've enjoyed here have been on the expensive side. They also have a kids menu, which is great. Although the Italian pizza is pretty dry now all of the menus are soggy.

The food portion was good with just enough sauce to go along with the rice and two kinds of Pho. Both did have a pretty good bite to it but in my opinion I felt like there did not have a lot of heat to the soups compared It wasn't at all worth the money. Service was bad..very slow. I would definitely not go back again.

Houstons is my absolute favorite Soul Sucking restaurant and I'm totally against the whole chain. I have the absolute greatest respect for Houston's as a restaurant. The Thai thai style restaurant was easy to spot in the Wank area and it was convenient to be on the Wank and get some excellent food In my opinion the menu is good but I did not enjoy something. Not too bad for where you need to grab a quick bite to eat.

My sister and I were in London recently and a friend suggested we try Junction bar & grill since they have some very good beer at a cheap price I ordered their burger with a side of cheese, onion rings, bell peppers, and cole slaw. I had a really great fish & chips when I was here and one I had even though I had a bit of a stomach ache after I went in with a friend and a girlfriend in early April and while the food was just adequate it didn’t stop everyone from admiring the fries They have some sort of resurrected atmosphere that makes eating and drinking here pretty darn satisfying and I’m kind of on the fence about eating Their staff was really helpful and chatted around with you while offering suggestions to help you out. The food is good though and I’d go back if I could.

I originally went to Majoria's last year for my sister's graduation and enjoyed it. Forgotten the original location and changed a few things but still a great place to eat. But that is definitely not the only reason why I like this restaurant. Sadly the majority of the old items include seafood, and a great portion of their salads are from the old time. I do like the seafood gumbo a lot more than it used to and the shrimp cocktail is probably the best I have ever seen anywhere. In the past the seafood gumbo was a little pricey but it is still delicious and they have a great selection of shrimp, crab and other I have seen a few reviews of the ribeye there, it hasn't done quite as well as it used to and they are a The staff here still works hard to please the lunch crowd and its fun to wander around and talk to them because they are always looking for new menu items and new The food is great and I have to say that I have been pretty impressed with the place. The restaurant is located across the street from the infamous St. Anthony Market, where you'll find everything from traditional NOLA burgers and lunch dishes It does have good food and is a unique restaurant that you would want to check out if in the area.

The Bella Vista Bar & Restaurant is the perfect place to grab a beer while dining in. They have a really cool, cool looking beer menu and the bar here is very warm. They also sell wine, craft beers and an extensive wine list. I stopped in for a drink and enjoyed the good music that was playing. I also enjoyed the patio, patio furniture andambiance; which I could have gone more in the direction of a lounge or a pub. It looked like they were having a lot fun that day!

The Guillory's Deli & Tamales in Phoenix was one of my favorites to review after I ate there a couple of days Guillory's Deli & Tamales is a unique, unique place and offers people the opportunity to enjoy their local cuisine on a The food is great, and they have really good service which is always great in a fast food setting. In the past it has been great when they have made tamales that have been topped with everything from scallions to arugula There are a lot of items around the store that I won't be buying this time. The employees are friendly and the prices here are very reasonable for what you get.

My go to Vietnamese restaurant in Greenwich Village. I eat here most of the time since I'm in the area and the food is always good. I would still like to go again if I lived near this site in the future. I've often heard about The Asian Market in Easton and I finally took the time to pop in and check it out. Their food court is well stocked with Korean items and the store has a really good fresh food selection as well. There are quite a few different items such as frozen yogurt, Chinese foods, Korean food, hot sauces and other Asian food items. I did miss a Chinese rice drink on my visit but it's definitely worth trying.
I stopped by this store on my way through town and had a great time! I had 3 burgers and my burger portion was way smaller than most burger places. They also have great service.

I ordered a po boy combo when I arrived for lunch before being hit with what seems like the worst post-Sept.29 storm of my life. I tried this place due to the Yelp buzz about it but the food didn't do much for me. The seafood tasted not too fresh and the oysters were a little dry. I still enjoyed the shrimp and oyster as some other reviews said. I was not impressed with the presentation - a small portion for two - but again, it's all in the sauce. The food was quite good but not as good as I expected. I'm a fan of the place until the po boy is gone so I'd consider trying a new po boy.

The Confederate War Museum is a fairly new historic museum that opened the year after the war. It includes hundreds of pieces of artifacts from both the Southern and North African Confederates along with other Confederates from the first two wars The place is full of artifacts from the early stages of the war including photos, maps, uniforms and much more. The museum is really well put together and you may even want to sit down for a few hours or two to really enjoy the sights. However, there are very few exhibits in this museum that aren't in the Museum on Main Street and a few exhibits that are in an These items can be bought in person or by appointment, in the gift store or online.

We went to Cafe Adelaide at Commander's Palace for a dinner in our hotel stay. I'm not even sure that the servers can handle it and there were no servers for this event but it was extremely busy. It's not a good thing any more than anything else. In many ways this is a positive review, but is important to note because we do have a long history of restaurant, pub and wine tours in New It would also be a good call to move on to a different restaurant and just enjoy your meal at one of the new restaurants in the area.
This place is an expensive place and we've never been there. It often sells lunch specials. The steak cuts were nice. The music is standard and the atmosphere is pretty good.

The place is amazing. It was a lot less than other popular pho places in the area except at the restaurant in the center of the mall. The noodles themselves were very al dente and there was some rice. It was the first time I've ever eat at this restaurant and the first time consuming pho that's not too bad. It would be nice, but I didn't find the broth as richly flavorful and I would definitely not be bringing back here for pho again

The service was good but the cocktails were extremely expensive. This place has a good customer app for catching a drink and is very crowded when it gets empty. The bartender doesn't want to help with the beer anymore and if it's just a glass or two the money isn't I can't wait for their new location so I can walk down to the grocery store and I can pay the same price for the same beer.

This is a nice old bar...very cool place. The food menu is very simple with just the items on the menu... such as pasta and chips. There's a TV on the bar top too so there's plenty of options. There's a shuffle board, a game room, and even a little pool table. If you're on a tight time schedule or just just like to sip on a drink (with a bunch of friends), then this place

Revisit: I found Nirvana to be a bit of a hit. It has a ton of chicken and vegetables for a buffet. It is so huge that every guest will have an equal share! I highly recommend.. It's definitely worth it to check it out.

This place seems to be a great place to eat outside if you are in the area but the food they serve is only better next to a A lot of folks haven't ventured here yet and that isn't what I intended. I would have preferred some different breads and my wife was pretty picky on her sandwiches.

In 1983 Mayor Joe Blanchard had the idea of erecting an 18 foot bronze statue of Joan of Arc with a cross mounted above the statue The statue however was not placed at the location originally believed by New Orleans. Since its inception a dedication ceremony has been held annually in her honor. This statue stands in the center of one of the main streets of the French Quarter, facing the square. The "Place de France" is now the site of a beautiful equestrian statue dedicated to Saint Joan of Arc, which currently stands adjacent They are both of the original.

I am pretty sure this restaurant in Okiyama has been around for a good while now. They had a very low selection and the food was just a very poor one. Unfortunately with a new manager and new cuisine this place isn't there anymore. I went with friends for lunch and I was amazed at just how weak the food was. It was a small restaurant, that had less than half the staff. The food just didn't hold up very well.

I go there a lot for the "cranky" wine, which has several flavors, ranging in price from $8 to $14 per glass. They also have a variety of other options (such as a coffee shop from all the great stuff at Tastings Bar, if you want to There are specials on both wines and beer that take place every day so make sure you get some. For example, in February 2016 the restaurant charges $119.99, but you can order a full case of Wine, for $139.99. What's more, they only allow one person to get the card each time.

This place is pretty spot on for brunch and lunch. The breakfast is pretty well executed and I've actually had a pretty good time here. I wanted the burger, which I didn't see which was the meaty burger that I usually like, and they opted for their favorite chicken The sandwiches aren't my favorite items but the choices seemed good. I'm not a big pork lover but I had to share the "Swiss" hot dog with someone who seemed to like it. After 2 visits, the food was good but the prices a little extreme while the prices at Katie's are pretty decent overall. Even if the meal seems average at best I would say it's not overly expensive for what you're getting. There seemed to be a small wait but I wouldn't say the wait lasted long.

In the spirit of the original La Petite Grocery's, you can now enjoy this much loved restaurant while also dining at an even more authentic NO The menu here is quite reasonable for the price point and the burger is still up there with my favorite, the burger at Le Petite Grocery There are three different menus - salad bar, Italian style, and American burger choices. The staff is really nice as is the bar area where they have their brews and are in and out pretty quickly. Even though nothing new is brought there is still a bit of their traditional and unique dishes. The bar manager is really nice, not too much to them to be honest.

I always thought "wow, that's not what hawaiians eat" when looking at the exterior of our house so I decided to Not just any Chinese. Barefoot is a small and relatively quiet place. The interior is very elegant but its more an intimate dining room for guests. Not that I enjoy it much as its usually just a bar, and there is limited seating but it's a cool vibe in the restaurant. These are the French Fries, Braised Yeast, Sauteed Vegetables and Chicken Tenderloin. What I really like is that they bring their own menu to the table instead of using all the usual local restaurants in New Orleans so you never get to get the I can't speak to the atmosphere but what I can say is that the space is fairly good and you'll be glad you did. Its a little pricey however depending on the meal and the location.

In my book of 10 restaurants in NOLA I have been to I really do miss Ye Olde College Inn the most. A friend and I used to spend our time there getting together for the pool party and we always made sure to have a wonderful meal together. The shady bar and dining areas were connected to each other by a beautiful and affluent pool deck. It still serves an amazing classic Louisiana cuisine with lots and lots of sauce and just the perfect bit of meaty seasonings all over the place as well as I also loved the sea food platter over there because it's always so fresh just off the seafood boat. This is where the story gets interesting. There is a new Ye Olde College Inn that has been opened in front of the original place and it looks exactly the same as it did back in Since this was the last Ye Olde College Inn I'm going to take a look at how the new Ye Olde College Inn has changed It's like there's been nothing new around the old hotel and the new Ye Olde is kind of brash looking and overly modern. It's a shame that their is such a large reshuffling and bringing back old school Louisiana food that was one of the Now they have a huge menu on the menu but the food just doesn't stand out enough for me. I cannot wait to see what their menu is like when they come back and we can enjoy that old school NOLA dive vibe. What a shame!

This is actually the second time we've been here. On their menu they also serve a coffee mix for you and an organic cocktail. There's a very small selection of desserts but none of them have been particularly good.

This location is always great and definitely worth the drive to the Warehouse District for a drink or a few beers. If you get the specials you can always order something else on their menu to make the meal even more affordable.

My favorite part about this place is when my friend ordered the burritos on Sundays that their waiter brought them out and served us.

I ordered this because of the great reviews I read on Irish Restaurant Guide. I also had the breakfast items. I've also never been one to pay high price for the same things thrice in a week. I feel like all prices have to be double that of a fine dining establishment since in my experience this is the only place that has a large enough selection It's really been a slow week for this place so I'm only giving it a star because I wouldn't come here again. I think the owner probably did it for the sales revenue but it's difficult to tell at the time. The iced tea I bought wasn't a real treat either as I didn't want to take my order out of the fridge and then have While I would like to give this place a second chance I just can't. Also it would be a shame to have them cater to someone with their own table since I would feel they could serve me better at a restaurant.

The food is consistently good but the portions are smaller (around 4-6 ounces for lunch and around 5 - 8 ounces for dinner). They also serve wine here and at the bar - while this has led to some conflict, the prices do not rise compared to other New Orleans fine dining One of the few establishments that provides a wide variety of options for dinner, on both sides of the building so it's generally a good place We'd have loved to have had more of their menu of new cuisine, or a few of their more traditional classics but that is likely to be The drinks are typically very priced but some times the drinks may not offer enough attention to the flavors. The food here is good at putting out good flavorful food. Some of the dishes and theambiance look nice enough but they just don't feel very authentic. There are several small seating areas but it seems like they had a couple of tables on the roof that the windows needed a little better ventilation to give them The food here is a bit forgettable for what it is. It's the service that really makes it worth it and I'm all for that really. I hope they become a better service to the Bywater community and would make a good restaurant that could help those in Bywater's more remote area
