Despite the fact that the window cleaning station was at one time manned, there was no toilet or sink available. If you were in the parking lot, they would have someone waiting to check the meter. When I asked what were the prices, they gave the same price to gas and a different price to the oil. The wawa said they had a few security cameras, but nothing else. The parking lot is a little iffy and there are a lot of people that park here. For the price I was expecting something like this at this wawa.

Went to DAMME FLUFF this morning after it opened. The owner, Ivan (Nora) O'Brien, has been selling pillows for 30 plus years through a number of small, local shops One of my favorite things was the display of lamps, t-shirts, quilts, and other items. Each piece, is hand made in house. You'll find amazing finds you'll want for all your special occasions. When they started out, they didn't have a whole bunch of wall hangings, but everything they had was incredibly well designed. If you want a cool necklace/ring - that are hand shaped, with tiny, creative little crystals, that will make your neck look like Your wedding guests will too! Be sure to stop in on Sundays while they're open!

I saw the Big & Tall outlet store on W. 4th St. at the Fremont mall a couple of weeks ago. Not sure of the name of their line, but they look like they make it by hand, and all this items are really good quality! I found a pair of ballet flats - those have little holes - I am getting some new tights, and they look great. I also found a couple of skirts for my daughter-in-law. They had a bunch of great deals for women's clothes, and everything is extremely low. I will be getting rid of everything that doesn't fit me, and I am considering a full purchase of a new shoe. Not really a big difference - I ended up having more money. The one thing I do wish it would have was the attitude. When I came in - there was a young girl standing up right in front of me. She was trying to push that product on me to get me something else. I should have left because I was very disappointed! The best part of this place is they have to pay for service for you, so I would say give them a try.
I brought in the donuts for work because my brother works at the school. We are looking for better service. The coffees were very average. Looks like I'm going back for lunch.

Holy hog.com is my go-to for yum! Holy hog! Holy hog! I ordered the French fries and holy hog. I think it was the last time I ate there. Don't miss this place. They might change their menu soon, but they are the first place in New York City to get it.

The price to quality ratio was great, and it was a very cool product. This is what I got. I flocked to their little store and it was great. Our waitress, Jenna (at the counter), was so friendly and kind, and made us feel like home.

I had walked past an intersection (where I see the Lion's Den) every chance I got. The parking lot was extremely packed, and I was able to get through the gates a little bit faster. It was a good show, and Jenny did some great solo shows. I'm glad I did. There's a DJ playing great music, great people, great service, and a full bar. It gets packed during lunchtime, so it's always packed. I've always enjoyed a good hookah, but this one is a little better! Not a big deal at all. In reality!, they are only half a block away! however, all the smoke is good! I didn't get the chance to go out there too much, but I'm definitely looking forward to going back.

I came to Beef's on Tuesday to take in the opening of the NPR Wings at NPR. I had a friend come and pick her up. I went in with my family and the first person I met was Sally, and I really welcomed her. It definitely helped that the place has several TVs, and was very clean. The food was very tasty and a little bit pricey for small plates (the wings I ordered came with a side salad). I wanted to make sure I had one of their amazing wings. I also ordered the hot collard greens, which were great, n a nice sauce combination with a lot of fresh vegetables. The service was great, and the wings were delicious and juicy! The wings are the perfect balance of spicy, salty and crisp.

So, we were really excited to join them for my husband's birthday. My family and I, all seniors, came to celebrate and was very happy to be there. We started eating our food before he came in and then found us a table. Only two tables in front of us. Their staff was friendly and helpful. We wanted to try their tomato sauce (she had ordered from a store she usually buys), and we mentioned that the other two people were trying their We opted for the beer and wine. Mom made a suggestion to try the French onion soup..The waiter looked at our order and suggested the chicken dishes..We were told the  The other people said they had had it before but it was surprisingly good, so we ordered up two dishes. I had the Chicken and vegetables with my eggs and potatoes in a tomato sauce. I did not like the chicken bryan or the pork tenderloins. All and all, this is the first time we have tried their new options. She ordered the pork tenderloins. Probably an inconsistency as one would expect. The grill is not hot, it's so hot, both of the pork and the grill are burning, really hot. It was flavorful, but it was soggy, very oily inside. So, no burger/parmesan combo or bone marrow patty. The greens were thinning and wilty, but they tasted a little too warm. The lasagne was surprisingly good. The lasagne was nothing special, mainly just a thin layer of bread. It was charred black and had a hard crust. The chicken came out a little soft, a bit fatty, very little on the sides. Mom preferred the creamy mushroom cream sauce, but the vegetable soup was pretty soupy. Our server was nice. It's been a while since this took place. Their website says, "We do not accept reservations."

In February of 2008, we had no idea where we'd go for a scavenger hunt. This was a great choice! We started the day with the check-in and got to see everything, the place is clean, fun, fun. This must have been such a different experience than the last time we went, but that also worked out really well. I'm a pro and I can see a place to come here. I'll definitely be back.

I've been to this spot before and I LOVEDD IT! If the Yelp Event went to plan, I'd be there again in my 88th year. However, this time, the food was not to my taste. I chose the restaurant of choice, and what a surprise: I was sat in a bad fish odor waiting area, which was a It was my first time there before, so a little busy. One item I loved was the hush puppies (I haven't had one before), and the chipolata. We had a great lunch! Not enough food, but so good and very quick service.

The restaurant is very quick at serving you. We just walked in, and it took them a while to see what the menu had to offer. The apps that are available: Android and iOS. When can I check my menu? Not like I'm actually asking - just waiting for my app (I didn't have one). The dinner took almost 30 minutes to get served. I ordered the Caesar salad. Ordering three of my friend's dinners was not too great. My other plate was the green beans. I went for two different combos, which I'll share on another day, and the shrimp and chicken. It was amazing.. just as I ordered it. The sauce was really good and I couldn't finish the whole plate, the shrimp wasn't dry, the salad was actually very nice and flavorful; For our price, I'll say that despite my complaints, I'd definitely go back.

Its great central-point hotel. I did find a nice bar in the airport. Most of the airport's restaurants are family run restaurants/bars. They're located on the far side of the runways and you can take a pic of the taxis in the terminal as they pass, and the

We were raving because of the pizza at Backdraughts Pizza. And I'm so happy to say, that I did come to the right place. It's tucked away in this nice looking shopping center. One star for the servers. There are also TVs outside and inside of the house that keep the heat on for a romantic and intimate dinner. Food was great!, fresh, tasty and tasty. It wasn't the best pizza I've had but it was absolutely delicious. I had to try this. Finally, the main courses. We both just ate it.. mmmmmm... I'm a sucker for white pizzas. The side salads and drinks were all delicious although kind of overpriced when you consider the prices. With their large pitcher of martinis served up outside, the patio was gorgeous!

What can I say, this is the best bar in the neighborhood. If you go in early, it has good crowds and the food is tasty, but there's no choice but to have a salad. There is one location close to me that I will be driving to whenever I want to eat some Comfort food.

To my surprise, I came to the Disney Store today to pick up some donuts for the family for lunch, erm, lunch. ...except that I had to get the Walt Disney World Resorts Express Park and Resort Car pass in advance. The store was a small complex with a small restaurant on the ground floor for everyone to eat at. I came in at 11:43 AM, which pushed me to go faster, although I tried not to think. I walked into the store, and the person I was with, was... A woman. This wasn't much of an issue, I managed to find the pass.

We took our first order to HP and found that this printer ran very slowly. The employee gave us a tip when we asked how to get the cartridge to work. The new ink was about half the cost we received from the original one. It’s not just a printer in a store..just a good one!

If you've gone through Phoenix there's one market you've been looking forward to since you came through. But of course now it is just a run down place. Now it's pretty much a ghost town. I haven't had a chance to stop in for a good while while I was in the area, so I was kind of excited to finally But it was so... boring. It was very quiet and pretty much a dead zone. A few years back, when i was there there was so much competition - cheap, cheap, cheap. When you look through all the stalls it was really not very interesting. All of the merchandise would be from Dollar Tree and other online stores. A woman selling flowers was selling them for a pound and then some man selling rags. What makes a street market resemble a dollar tree is how low the prices go.

I decided to give Zag's a try for our first dinner date (and that was at 10pm) so we decided to stop in and check It's a regular spot for us and we were really excited. They made me feel comfortable and very welcome and the girl at the front was really helpful. She was really friendly and was very informative. She showed us what to ordered for dinner, and let me tell you, it was all very good. Our dinner started out quite good. We also ordered their burritos which were very tasty. The pork was tender, the plantain was slightly soft and tender and the mango salsa had a nice kick to it. YUMMY! I haven't had this salsa in a long time so I always try to keep a little extra to throw extra sauce on my plate. Some of the ingredients were a little sweet but still tasted good. The zitzaladas with the chile was tastier, but still nothing to brag about - those were good. I really appreciated that this was our first time. When we left, we had to pay and it didn't make it any easier! This place was a solid 5. This place is definitely a foodie place.

So, I first heard of this company from another friend.. and then I stopped to try their signature rubs in the North Country of New Jersey. A few years ago I started shopping with you in Michigan, they got great product, it's always been different and delicious too! You will enjoy the experience as well as the aromas...tastings, samplers, etc. - It is so good! If you like a dash of spice, they also have great cocktails. Be sure to visit!

It was like our last visit to the Old City Diner. If you're looking for a really good place to get pulled pork, call up Mama's. We had the drive-thru option, and when we saw the sign, we gave it a shot. I went into the restaurant with a great feeling - that's what most people do - and asked for help. We walked around in the dining rooms and noticed the menu, including some of the sides, and some of the options. We decided to split the Pulled Pork and Pulled Chicken and have our order delivered to us after dinner. The staff was friendly, and took the time to talk to us who were sitting inside and asked how we were doing. We were given the standard menu, and told what we ordered. We got the main course - Pulled Pork, Beef, Pulled Cajun Bison and Garlic Rings. This sauce comes in a 32ox bottle. We asked for their ranch sauce, which was kind of a disappointment since it tasted like ranch dressing. After weighing the meat and sides and deciding how it would compare to my favorites, we started eating and sampling the delicious food. I would not have chosen the Pulled pork unless they said it was fresh, which I thought was a plus. It had a bitty exterior, but a tender, chewy interior. I drank the sauce and the chicken was cooked just fine, not overly rich like it was supposed to be. And what i didn't like.. They were pretty good, but the burger and onion rings were just a bit dry. The salad was ice-cold at that point. They seemed to just be going through the motions. They were just salty and not fresh at all.

A while back I picked up a magazine and decided... let's take a trip to the "Raw Shop." As a baby, there were always plenty of stores I'd want to go to- and so far I've only visited one or two. It was back in October that my husband and I headed up to meet some friends at one of the many stores in the area, and ended up stopping at Alice After a long road trip with our youngest sister we ventured on to find a really fun and unique jewelry store in my hometown, North Haven, Connecticut I wasn't exactly excited to head to this little gem but on the plus side, it's only $5 and they have a really nice patio outside I couldn't believe I had walked in my whole life, there was so much in there. I was there when the shop was open so I was at the ready. I was in the "Missip Girl" section and there were so many miserable little shops I could say I didn't even notice Some of the best pieces I saw were: a couple of Dog shirts, furs and some t-shirts. Inside is a bit understated as well, unless you're a girl! The owner is fantastic and friendly. And if you want to see a place where you can buy vintage or find an unusual item, you've hit the jackpot! For only $10 in a weekend, for a girls day, a "night out" and one SPECIAL occasion; just the place for the I'm not going to be a slave to a shopping list!

I was looking for a nail salon in The Colony for Bill. I stopped by my usual nail salon to get a mani and to pick up my husband. There was an appointment, but it took 45 minutes for him to come in. He said this was what he was doing for years! I'm glad he felt like he was getting so much love for this procedure. I really didn't want any nail art done around my face because I'm not a big fan of art and I thought it might be some time I had no idea that the mani would chip, but thought what could happen if it was so, I went on the counter and decided on a This mani was very good. I like pink and I would not go there again. Despite not being as good as i thought, I still thought they looked good!

I have been a lifelong fan of Christo's (across the street from my house) and it turns out that I really don't You know like this one, Churcho's? We were greeted by a smiley server, and the husbeastie immediately smiled. So we decided to take the short drive down the road until we turned the corner and there was Christo's right next door! But even though we couldn't spot the place, it got pretty crowded and didn't take us very long to find it. It was a Sunday lunchtime, but a beautiful day with an excellent staff, and a kindly server, who greeted us promptly and She did a great job getting our drinks, and we made the easy call to get some bread. We decided we wanted some plates to share. One thing that took a lot of time was ordering, that was a bit of a let down - we needed one of the dishes from the At Christo's, you don't get any of this. The husbeastie had the steak burger and had a very delicious burger, with a zing of flavour from the ket It definitely didn't taste like it were the regular cheese I don't consider too fattoo, but as a person watching those that eat The French toast was good too, I mean, it was very nice. It is easy to see why Christo's is one of the best breakfast place in the country. It was probably the best food I've had in quite some time.

I had surgery at the Dr. Ayer's location and their staff treated me well. The nursing department was great. The nurses were incredibly kind. The doctors all did great work. The OB/GYN has been very understanding and caring. The only issue I have is that I have my own personal doctor and I need to ask for help when I am not feeling well. As much as I like trying to be good all the time, I've actually had to resort to having to keep calling the nursing staff and telling them how With that said, there are times that I do care about their treatment, for instance, sometimes they can be kind to me... Be patient, they'll get her attention if you'r just patient.

This week we went to Starlight Academy wich was also their 3rd visit. This wasn't my first Hip Express show, but it was still wonderful. I was confused why the venue is in Eastchester. But on this night, I had a chance to see some of my old college friends. One thing this party does do is make it way more sociable for people. And then there was "Cheezing Out", a great set by a group of singers and dancers. Unlike much of HED's events around here, they have classes to help you get in the shape from morning to night. After viewing the show, I decided on a "Post and Future" dance class. There was a lot of great music, especially the gang from the school dancing.

For a little nightcap, my husband and I took a trip to Mekong for dinner. As we were arriving in Thailand and walking down the steps, we were greeted by a lady who was cleaning up after the staff. The waitress at the front desk was super helpful and friendly, we had the usual waitresses that were friendly, but a little more organized and At the bar a bar staff was waiting to serve us and took the order for us. This place is a dive, but the place is comfortable, the food was excellent, and the waiter was prompt and polite. The food was very good! We ordered dishes that came out at the same time, since people tended to order earlier than we. The fried shrimp salad was also very good, they included many small pieces of fried shrimp and Thai-style shrimp. They had the fresh rolls, which were served with 2 phung chun (rice with soy sauce), chicken, red onion, mint, The Pho was super spicy, flavorful and very filling. The staff was pretty friendly and the food was surprisingly good.

It's called Mammal & Sons and they have been in business for over 12 years. The selection is fantastic! The most delicious thing on the menu is the fresh vegetable soups served in large bowls. There are many different types of iced teas, alcoholic beverages and lemonade out in the restaurant and it's great to get some nice All in all, I wouldn't mind having dinner there just for the soup because it's just so good. On our visit we had a very happy wife from a long time ago who always bought us soup but always made us soup when it comes time to go It all combines to really be tasty! It always includes a side of ice cream and the bread is served with a generous slice of tomato (the apron).

I love salads! I love their food and their service. Sometimes, we will just go to one or two locations to try them out. I have never been to Red Robin in the South! I asked if they had a new special deal right now. We waited a little bit before the employees came over and they told us there were only 5 restaurants open at the time. How come?!? We both ordered a couple cold salads and a hot soup. I ordered the breakfast combo of the chicken and eggs and potato eggroll, with blue cheese and chorizo. If anything, I didn't want any cheese, and wore the cheese out of my shirt. The salad was nice and big enough for lunch, but my salad was just too soupey. They were all very thick, and didn't taste fresh at all. As fast as it was placed in the bowl, I was shocked. I ordered it because I don't drink salads, and this is not an option. So I left with a very dry salad. When it came, Dani, I just knew, was feeling a little bad. Unfortunately, she didn't bring the manager over for the food, and the manager was never able to come over and see the food until they were done I was then advised to leave the place.

We were thinking about going to lunch today and the boyfriend and I decided to take off for lunch. By the time the pizza arrived (as we had parked in the Plaza, waiting for the check), the crowd had dissipated. We thought it was a good place - it smelled of  pizza, had good toppings and nice crust. The table is right outside the restaurant so you can get your drink inside, and still watch while you eat. We had our waitress help us out while eating (we have different types and sizes). The cheese was very fresh, but it was not thick enough. The pizza was great. It's a good pizza place!

On a hot day in Toronto, I drove to Indian restaurants by myself and was able to taste what I'd rather not lick. And if it was spicy, I would not say it is that spicy. It definitely wasn't for me. I asked that my friends try to help me get the right dish, so that when we got there I wouldn't be so surprised. The Waitress was pretty nice - very friendly and patient through the lunch, and I'm not the largest of Indian Indian restaurants, so I didnt When the Waitress came to ask us to order our meals, the first thing we did was to ask her what we wanted in terms of the taste of the The waitress was there to talk about orders and to make sure we could get the drinks we wanted/needed to go. But, it seemed people wanted the hot. The Waitress tried to ask the people not to expect it to be hot. (My friends were like that too.) I ordered them both, and my husband called from work, so I asked his wife "do you want a glass of beer?" She reply, " The Butter Chicken was very tender and very flavorful. The garlic naan was delicious, had the most perfect ratio of chewy to soft. While it was a bit dry, it was an excellent choice for an Indian food restaurant. a huge difference in taste after the meal. Also the desserts.. were a bit of a letdown. I ordered a paneer kabab (it was surprisingly dry). When the waitress brought it out I was soered, that the tastebuds were already dead. It tasted as though it was refried. I asked my friends what's wrong with it? That was ok.. But then my friend ordered the kadai dosa. They were also really bad, the batter of each doughnut was soggy, it felt like its been standing out all over its way to the bottom of the The last couple ordered a drink. And when they came out, I have to say, I was beyond hungry.

After a long day spent with our friend at our local Humane Society, Mary had her dog cut short. Several people in the hair shop are waiting for a haircut, and a couple are looking for a good place to go get a hair trim We decided we needed a cutting service, so we had the guy come in and get his ear washed. It wasn't that bad with those poor people. I couldn't believe it. They did have some good cut up and waxing, but they were going to waste their time and money on the "good" service. We'll see where it goes.

After an 8 hour drive I finally got on and tried out the BBQ restaurant in the South of the city, which is called Rockin' Tacos. I was hoping that a parking deal would be available, because I have been down to Portillos for over a year, the only other time were I went there with my wife and her girlfriend. As I entered I thought I had waited 15 minutes, and had no way to get to the register! People can also stand and get their orders done. I got a table in the back which was also the place where I got my order. I had to get my seat before the order came out. As part of the meal I received 3 Hot Dogs, Two Chili Dogs with Hamburger Rings, 2 Fried Chicken Rings with Buffalo Ranch, 3 The hotdog was good, but the cheese was a bit overdone. The chili dog tasted like a microwave dog. Whether I took the heat off or not I enjoyed it every bite. And the onion rings were good. When finished and not sitting outside with the others a bit later, the place was BUSY, but we didn't notice any other people. I hope they keep up the tradition of Portillos, I think it would be a good stop on the road and you won't wait too long
My husband suggested the Oolong for me since he is a big fan and it is on the patio. It turns out the answer was YES. I was very disappointed. The a little cold then turned sour. So there we were.

No ice cream in this drive through. I was greeted by their courteous host, who spoke English. At that point I wanted the donut holes because they were very tasty, and they were still warm. I think it would have been better since there was only a small variety of different items and I am not a fan of the McDonald's franchises

The beach is always great in the months between the Memorial Day weekend and Labor Day weekend. One of my favorite locations to come to during a nice day. If you can stomach a storm this big, it was much worse than usual. It was so hot, I couldn't stay out at all! I was a bit disappointed that the piers didn't have any fish. If you haven't been, there's a pretty nice walk right upriver from the center. The boats were still there, but the piers were even more popular than ever than ever. The mangroves and beach are lovely and relaxing, but the fish are dangling!

Food is OK, and service is excellent. We dined at this place downtown. But at least we had a spot to eat because the dining room was at this point. This was the best meal I've had in a week. A nice little food court for Geek dinners, not the best for everyone.

It's a good place, but I'm not really sure where this place is. It's a place where people can see the people from their boats. But what a nice idea! There are two dining areas that are located along the waters edge. The inside is a little better, though not the best, since you're seated at an outdoor bar. The bar area is not huge, the one with the flat screen ITV was very comfortable. My husbee was excited and that's good because it's only a $5 entrance fee though you could pay a little more. After the lunch, NPR went inside, which was enjoyable! We ordered our starters, a basket of chicken wraps with a side of slaw and a green bean medley. The gator was moist and not too salty. All the bites were fried and just plain tasted like the gator. I wasn't a fan of their dessert, I thought the flavors were nice except for the ghee. I ordered the fish and chips. The bacon had been chewy and hard. There were no real complaints on the fish. There is not much variety of tater tots, but you can have a number of dishes to chose from. I liked this.. the portion was much smaller than I normally expect it to be though. We also had a horchata. I'd give this place 5 stars but it was a short trip back on the boat. If you're driving in and the parking is paid for, you can pay to park outside. Just a couple of times I've had to park at this place and had to sit in line for a long time, and never left when the I would have liked the parking lot to have been wider. Don't get me wrong, I am not in love with the food at this venue. There's more to this place than just a burger joint and a patio area.
Great coffee house.. We are regulars to this gem. They also have some great samples. Also, the staff here know their stuff. Good place for the weekend.

I've been going to 'Adult Closet' for over 11 years. I always like looking through all the styles, but then the best part is that they have a great variety of new brands! If you've stayed in the past then probably you have come across the great Black & White Jean. I had never seen one before and they were amazing! I also found this dress in a new version of my mom's dress that everyone is wearing. Don't feel pressure by the word Curv though, we're not a regular store. For a lot less you can get just about anything.

I was seated at the tables with the host who set our table for the night. On the way to the restaurant another few of us stopped at the bar as we waited for people to come in, which took about 10 minutes. We had a long wait for dinner in the lobby. We have the most expensive dinner in Pittsburgh, and that is the best time of the day, but what started my night off wrong. Food wasn't shown on the menu and it was not brought out to our table. A few of us ordered for wine to be taken, but our waiter didn't come out right away. We also were waited on by many table-side servers, they had to sit until our order came out which was an odd thing to wait on, but We sat down with dinner and the food was delivered at 11:30 (I was sitting there all afternoon, not even getting ready for meal). We received an invoice to try another dish that had been subbed up, a burger with mushrooms. Overall, a food and service experience will not be repeated without having to wait a long amount of time. We did pay $10 more than expected because our table came with 4 seats. If you are looking for dinner in Pittsburgh, I'd recommend you look elsewhere.

This was a quick and easy visit for two very late evening dinners. We sat on a patio outside and had a short conversation with the waitress, who was very good. I will definitely be back. Thank you!!! -Sarah - Food.com.
